name: dualTensorHom_finsupp_bijective
statement:
theorem dualTensorHom_finsupp_bijective (fin : Finite ι ∨ Module.Finite R M)
    (h : Function.Bijective (dualTensorHom R M N)) :
    Function.Bijective (dualTensorHom R M (ι →₀ N))
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [dualTensorHom_finsupp, coe_comp]
  refine .comp ?_ ((Finsupp.mapRange_bijective _ (map_zero _) h).comp (LinearEquiv.bijective _))
  cases fin
  · apply finsuppLinearMap_bijective_of_finite
  · apply finsuppLinearMap_bijective_of_moduleFinite

name: dualTensorHom_bijective_of_comp_eq_id_right
statement:
theorem dualTensorHom_bijective_of_comp_eq_id_right (f : N →ₗ[R] P) (g : P →ₗ[R] N)
    (comp_eq_id : g ∘ₗ f = .id) (h : Function.Bijective (dualTensorHom R M P)) :
    Function.Bijective (dualTensorHom R M N) where
  left
proof:
:= .of_comp (f := f.compRight R) <| by
    rw [← coe_comp, ← dualTensorHom_comp_lTensor]
    refine h.1.comp (injective_of_comp_eq_id _ (g.lTensor _) ?_)
    rw [← lTensor_comp, comp_eq_id, lTensor_id]
  right := .of_comp (g := g.lTensor _) <| by
    rw [← coe_comp, dualTensorHom_comp_lTensor, coe_comp]
    refine (surjective_of_comp_eq_id (f.compRight R) _ ?_).comp h.2
    ext; exact congr($comp_eq_id _)

name: dualTensorHom_fun_bijective
statement:
theorem dualTensorHom_fun_bijective [Finite ι] (h : Function.Bijective (dualTensorHom R M N)) :
    Function.Bijective (dualTensorHom R M (ι → N))
proof:
:=
  dualTensorHom_bijective_of_comp_eq_id_right
    (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R N ι).symm
    (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite ..).toLinearMap (by ext; simp)
    (dualTensorHom_finsupp_bijective (.inl ‹_›) h)

name: dualTensorHom_bijective_of_finite_projective_right
statement:
theorem dualTensorHom_bijective_of_finite_projective_right [Module.Finite R N] [Projective R N] :
    Function.Bijective (dualTensorHom R M N)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_n, f, g, _, _, eq⟩ := Finite.exists_comp_eq_id_of_projective R N
  dualTensorHom_bijective_of_comp_eq_id_right g f eq <|
    dualTensorHom_fun_bijective dualTensorHom_self_right_bijective

name: dualTensorHom_bijective_of_finite_left_projective_right
statement:
theorem dualTensorHom_bijective_of_finite_left_projective_right [Module.Finite R M]
    [Projective R N] : Function.Bijective (dualTensorHom R M N)
proof:
:=
  have ⟨f, eq⟩ := projective_def'.mp ‹Projective R N›
  dualTensorHom_bijective_of_comp_eq_id_right _ _ eq <|
    dualTensorHom_finsupp_bijective (.inr ‹_›) dualTensorHom_self_right_bijective

name: dualTensorHom_bijective
statement: lemma dualTensorHom_bijective : Function.Bijective (dualTensorHom R M N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, f, g, -, -, eq⟩ := Finite.exists_comp_eq_id_of_projective R M
  refine ⟨.of_comp (f := f.lcomp R N) ?_, .of_comp (g := g.dualMap.rTensor N) ?_⟩
  · rw [← coe_comp, ← dualTensorHom_comp_rTensor_dualMap, coe_comp,
      ← coe_dualTensorHomEquivOfBasis (Pi.basisFun ..)]
    refine (EquivLike.injective _).comp (injective_of_comp_eq_id _ (rTensor _ g.dualMap) ?_)
    simp [← rTensor_comp, dualMap_comp_dualMap g f, eq]
  · rw [← coe_comp, dualTensorHom_comp_rTensor_dualMap, coe_comp,
      ← coe_dualTensorHomEquivOfBasis (Pi.basisFun ..)]
    refine (surjective_of_comp_eq_id (f.lcomp R N) _ ?_).comp (EquivLike.surjective _)
    ext φ x
    exact congr(φ ($eq x))

name: dualDistrib_dualDistribInvOfBasis_left_inverse
statement:
@[deprecated dualDistribEquiv (since := "2026-09-01")]
lemma dualDistrib_dualDistribInvOfBasis_left_inverse (b : Basis ι R M) (c : Basis κ R N) :
    (dualDistrib R M N).comp (dualDistribInvOfBasis b c) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply (b.tensorProduct c).dualBasis.ext
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  apply (b.tensorProduct c).ext
  rintro ⟨i', j'⟩
  simp only [dualDistrib, Basis.coe_dualBasis, coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    dualDistribInvOfBasis_apply, Basis.coord_apply, Basis.tensorProduct_repr_tmul_apply,
    Basis.repr_self, _root_.map_sum, map_smul, homTensorHomMap_apply, compRight_apply,
    Basis.tensorProduct_apply, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, map_tmul, lid_tmul, smul_eq_mul, id_coe, id_eq]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simpa using mul_comm _ _
  all_goals { intros; simp [*] at * }

proof:
:= by

  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  simp only [Basis.tensorProduct_apply, Basis.coe_dualBasis, coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    dualDistribInvOfBasis_apply, dualDistrib_apply, Basis.coord_apply, Basis.repr_self,

name: traceAux_def
statement:
theorem traceAux_def (b : Basis ι R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    traceAux R b f = Matrix.trace (LinearMap.toMatrix b b f)

name: traceAux_eq
statement: theorem traceAux_eq : traceAux R b = traceAux R c
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun f =>
    calc
      Matrix.trace (LinearMap.toMatrix b b f) =
          Matrix.trace (LinearMap.toMatrix b b ((LinearMap.id.comp f).comp LinearMap.id)) := by
        rw [LinearMap.id_comp, LinearMap.comp_id]
      _ = Matrix.trace (LinearMap.toMatrix c b LinearMap.id * LinearMap.toMatrix c c f *
          LinearMap.toMatrix b c LinearMap.id) := by
        rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp _ c, LinearMap.toMatrix_comp _ c]
      _ = Matrix.trace (LinearMap.toMatrix c c f * LinearMap.toMatrix b c LinearMap.id *
          LinearMap.toMatrix c b LinearMap.id) := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
      _ = Matrix.trace (LinearMap.toMatrix c c ((f.comp LinearMap.id).comp LinearMap.id)) := by
        rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp _ b, LinearMap.toMatrix_comp _ c]
      _ = Matrix.trace (LinearMap.toMatrix c c f) := by rw [LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.comp_id]

name: trace_eq_matrix_trace_of_finset
statement:
theorem trace_eq_matrix_trace_of_finset {s : Finset M} (b : Basis s R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    trace R M f = Matrix.trace (LinearMap.toMatrix b b f)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s R M) := ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩
  rw [trace, dite_eq_left this, ← traceAux_def]
  congr 1
  apply traceAux_eq

name: trace_eq_matrix_trace
statement:
theorem trace_eq_matrix_trace (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    trace R M f = Matrix.trace (LinearMap.toMatrix b b f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [trace_eq_matrix_trace_of_finset R b.reindexFinsetRange, ← traceAux_def, ← traceAux_def,
    traceAux_eq R b b.reindexFinsetRange]

name: _root_.Matrix.trace_toLin_eq

name: trace_mul_comm
statement: theorem trace_mul_comm (f g : M →ₗ[R] M) : trace R M (f * g) = trace R M (g * f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases H : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s R M)
  · let ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩ := H
    simp_rw [trace_eq_matrix_trace R b, LinearMap.toMatrix_mul]
    apply Matrix.trace_mul_comm
  · rw [trace, dite_eq_right H, LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]

statement:
lemma trace_mul_cycle' (f g h : M →ₗ[R] M) :

name: trace_lie_mul_eq
statement:
lemma trace_lie_mul_eq {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (f g h : M →ₗ[R] M) : trace R M (⁅f, g⁆ * h) = trace R M (f * ⁅g, h⁆)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ring.lie_def, sub_mul, mul_sub, map_sub, mul_assoc]
  rw [trace_mul_comm R g (f * h), mul_assoc]

name: trace_conj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_conj (g : M →ₗ[R] M) (f : (M →ₗ[R] M)ˣ) :
    trace R M (↑f * g * ↑f⁻¹) = trace R M g

name: trace_lie
statement:
@[simp]
lemma trace_lie {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f g : Module.End R M) :
    trace R M ⁅f, g⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ring.lie_def, map_sub, trace_mul_comm]
  exact sub_self _

name: trace_eq_contract_of_basis
statement:
theorem trace_eq_contract_of_basis [Finite ι] (b : Basis ι R M) :
    LinearMap.trace R M ∘ₗ dualTensorHom R M M = contractLeft R M
proof:
:= by
  classical
    cases nonempty_fintype ι
    apply Basis.ext (Basis.tensorProduct (Basis.dualBasis b) b)
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Basis.tensorProduct_apply, Basis.coe_dualBasis, coe_comp]
    rw [trace_eq_matrix_trace R b, toMatrix_dualTensorHom]
    obtain rfl | hij := eq_or_ne i j
    · simp
    rw [Matrix.trace_single_eq_of_ne j i (1 : R) hij.symm]
    simp [hij]

name: trace_eq_contract_of_basis'
statement:
theorem trace_eq_contract_of_basis' [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (b : Basis ι R M) :
    LinearMap.trace R M = contractLeft R M ∘ₗ (dualTensorHomEquivOfBasis b).symm.toLinearMap

name: trace_eq_contract
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_eq_contract : LinearMap.trace R M ∘ₗ dualTensorHom R M M = contractLeft R M

name: trace_eq_contract_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_eq_contract_apply (x : Module.Dual R M ⊗[R] M) :
    (LinearMap.trace R M) ((dualTensorHom R M M) x) = contractLeft R M x

name: trace_eq_contract'
statement:
theorem trace_eq_contract' :
    LinearMap.trace R M = contractLeft R M ∘ₗ (dualTensorHomEquiv R M M).symm.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dualTensorHomEquivOfBasis_eq_dualTensorHomEquiv (Module.Free.chooseBasis R M)]
  exact trace_eq_contract_of_basis' _

name: trace_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_one : trace R M 1 = (finrank R M : R)
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · simp [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton]
  have b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R M
  rw [trace_eq_matrix_trace R b, toMatrix_one, finrank_eq_card_chooseBasisIndex]
  simp

name: trace_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_id : trace R M id = (finrank R M : R)

name: trace_transpose
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_transpose : trace R (Module.Dual R M) ∘ₗ Module.Dual.transpose = trace R M
proof:
:= by
  let e := dualTensorHomEquiv R M M
  have h : Function.Surjective e.toLinearMap := e.surjective
  refine (cancel_right h).1 ?_
  ext f m; simp [e]

name: trace_prodMap
statement:
theorem trace_prodMap :
    trace R (M × N) ∘ₗ prodMapLinear R M N M N R =
      (coprod id id : R × R →ₗ[R] R) ∘ₗ prodMap (trace R M) (trace R N)
proof:
:= by
  let e := (dualTensorHomEquiv R M M).prodCongr (dualTensorHomEquiv R N N)
  have h : Function.Surjective e.toLinearMap := e.surjective
  refine (cancel_right h).1 ?_
  ext <;> simp [e]

name: trace_prodMap'
statement:
theorem trace_prodMap' (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (g : N →ₗ[R] N) :
    trace R (M × N) (prodMap f g) = trace R M f + trace R N g
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.ext_iff.1 (trace_prodMap R M N) (f, g)
  simp only [coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, prodMap_apply, coprod_apply, id,
    prodMapLinear_apply] at h
  exact h

name: trace_tensorProduct
statement:
theorem trace_tensorProduct : compr₂ (mapBilinear (.id R) M N M N) (trace R (M ⊗ N)) =
    compl₁₂ (lsmul R R : R →ₗ[R] R →ₗ[R] R) (trace R M) (trace R N)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    (compl₁₂_inj (show Surjective (dualTensorHom R M M) from (dualTensorHomEquiv R M M).surjective)
        (show Surjective (dualTensorHom R N N) from (dualTensorHomEquiv R N N).surjective)).1
  ext f m g n
  simp only [AlgebraTensorModule.curry_apply, TensorProduct.curry_apply,
    coe_restrictScalars, compl₁₂_apply, compr₂_apply, mapBilinear_apply,
    trace_eq_contract_apply, contractLeft_apply, lsmul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    map_dualTensorHom, dualDistrib_apply]

name: trace_comp_comm
statement:
theorem trace_comp_comm :
    compr₂ (llcomp R M N M) (trace R M) = compr₂ (llcomp R N M N).flip (trace R N)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    (compl₁₂_inj (show Surjective (dualTensorHom R N M) from (dualTensorHomEquiv R N M).surjective)
        (show Surjective (dualTensorHom R M N) from (dualTensorHomEquiv R M N).surjective)).1
  ext g m f n
  simp only [AlgebraTensorModule.curry_apply, TensorProduct.curry_apply,
    coe_restrictScalars, compl₁₂_apply, compr₂_apply, flip_apply, llcomp_apply',
    comp_dualTensorHom, LinearMapClass.map_smul, trace_eq_contract_apply,
    contractLeft_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: trace_transpose'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_transpose' (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    trace R _ (Module.Dual.transpose (R := R) f) = trace R M f

name: trace_tensorProduct'
statement:
theorem trace_tensorProduct' (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (g : N →ₗ[R] N) :
    trace R (M ⊗ N) (map f g) = trace R M f * trace R N g
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.ext_iff.1 (LinearMap.ext_iff.1 (trace_tensorProduct R M N) f) g
  simp only [compr₂_apply, mapBilinear_apply, compl₁₂_apply, lsmul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul] at h
  exact h

name: trace_comp_comm'
statement:
theorem trace_comp_comm' (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] M) :
    trace R M (g ∘ₗ f) = trace R N (f ∘ₗ g)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.ext_iff.1 (LinearMap.ext_iff.1 (trace_comp_comm R M N) g) f
  simp only [llcomp_apply', compr₂_apply, flip_apply] at h
  exact h

name: trace_smulRight
statement:
@[simp]
lemma trace_smulRight (f : M →ₗ[R] R) (x : M) :
    trace R M (f.smulRight x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_matrix_trace _ (Free.chooseBasis R M), ← (Free.chooseBasis R M).sum_repr x]
  simp [-Basis.sum_repr, dotProduct]

name: trace_comp_cycle
statement:
lemma trace_comp_cycle (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (h : P →ₗ[R] M) :
    trace R P (g ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ h) = trace R N (f ∘ₗ h ∘ₗ g)

name: trace_comp_cycle'
statement:
lemma trace_comp_cycle' (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P) (h : P →ₗ[R] M) :
    trace R P ((g ∘ₗ f) ∘ₗ h) = trace R M ((h ∘ₗ g) ∘ₗ f)

name: trace_conj'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem trace_conj' (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : trace R N (e.conj f) = trace R M f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hM : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s R M)
  · obtain ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩ := hM
    have := Module.Finite.of_basis b
    have := (Module.free_def R M).mpr ⟨_, ⟨b⟩⟩
    have := Module.Finite.of_basis (b.map e)
    have := (Module.free_def R N).mpr ⟨_, ⟨(b.map e).reindex (e.toEquiv.image _)⟩⟩
    rw [e.conj_apply, trace_comp_comm', ← comp_assoc, LinearEquiv.comp_coe,
      LinearEquiv.self_trans_symm, LinearEquiv.refl_toLinearMap, id_comp]
  · rw [trace, trace, dite_eq_right hM, dite_eq_right ?_, zero_apply, zero_apply]
    rintro ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩
    exact hM ⟨s.image e.symm, ⟨(b.map e.symm).reindex
      ((e.symm.toEquiv.image s).trans (Set.equivOfEq Finset.coe_image.symm))⟩⟩

name: trace_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem trace_map {K V W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module K W] {F : Type*} [EquivLike F (End K V) (End K W)] [AlgEquivClass F K _ _]
    (f : F) (x : End K V) : (f x).trace K W = x.trace K V
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_, h⟩ := (AlgEquiv.ofClass f).eq_linearEquivConjAlgEquiv
  (by simpa using congr($h x)) ▸ trace_conj' _ _

name: _root_.Matrix.trace_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem _root_.Matrix.trace_map {K m n : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] {F : Type*} [EquivLike F (Matrix m m K) (Matrix n n K)]
    [AlgEquivClass F K _ _] (f : F) (x : Matrix m m K) : (f x).trace = x.trace
proof:
:= by
  simpa [toMatrixAlgEquiv', Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv'] using
    LinearMap.trace_map ((Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv'.symm.trans
      (AlgEquiv.ofClass f)).trans Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv') x.toLin'

name: _root_.Matrix.trace_map'
statement:
@[simp] theorem _root_.Matrix.trace_map' {K m F : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    [FunLike F (Matrix m m K) (Matrix m m K)] [AlgHomClass F K _ _] (f : F) (x : Matrix m m K) :
    (f x).trace = x.trace
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! Nonempty m
  · exact Matrix.trace_map (AlgEquiv.ofBijective _ (AlgHom.ofClass f).bijective) x
  · simp

name: IsProj.trace
statement:
theorem IsProj.trace {p : Submodule R M} {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (h : IsProj p f) [Module.Free R p]
    [Module.Finite R p] [Module.Free R (ker f)] [Module.Finite R (ker f)] :
    trace R M f = (finrank R p : R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.eq_conj_prodMap, trace_conj', trace_prodMap', trace_id, map_zero, add_zero]

name: IsIdempotentElem.trace_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.trace_eq_zero_iff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [CharZero R]
    {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {e : M →ₗ[R] M} (he : IsIdempotentElem e)
    [Module.Free R (range e)] [Module.Finite R (range e)]
    [Module.Free R (ker e)] [Module.Finite R (ker e)] :
    trace R M e = 0 ↔ e = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [he.isProj_range.trace, Nat.cast_eq_zero, finrank_eq_zero_iff_of_free,
    Submodule.subsingleton_iff_eq_bot, range_eq_bot]

name: isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent
statement:
lemma isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (hf : IsNilpotent f) :
    IsNilpotent (trace R M f)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s R M)
  swap
  · rw [LinearMap.trace, dite_eq_right H]
    exact IsNilpotent.zero
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩ := H
  classical
  rw [trace_eq_matrix_trace R b]
  apply Matrix.isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent
  simpa

name: trace_comp_eq_mul_of_commute_of_isNilpotent
proof:
:= by
  set n := g - algebraMap R _ μ
  replace hg : trace R M (f ∘ₗ n) = 0 := by
    rw [← isNilpotent_iff_eq_zero, ← Module.End.mul_eq_comp]
    refine isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent (Commute.isNilpotent_mul_left ?_ hg)
    exact h_comm.sub_right (Algebra.commute_algebraMap_right μ f)
  have hμ : g = algebraMap R _ μ + n := eq_add_of_sub_eq' rfl
  have : f ∘ₗ algebraMap R _ μ = μ • f := by ext; simp 
  rw [hμ, comp_add, map_add, hg, add_zero, this, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: trace_baseChange
statement:
@[simp]
lemma trace_baseChange [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] :
    trace A _ (f.baseChange A) = algebraMap R A (trace R _ f)
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R M
  let b' := Algebra.TensorProduct.basis A b
  change _ = (algebraMap R A : R →+ A) _
  simp [b', trace_eq_matrix_trace R b, trace_eq_matrix_trace A b', AddMonoidHom.map_trace]

name: Module.Free.bijective_algebraMap_of_finrank_eq_one
statement:
lemma Module.Free.bijective_algebraMap_of_finrank_eq_one {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [Ring S]
    [Algebra R S] [Nontrivial R] [Free R S] (h : finrank R S = 1) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap R S)
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.Finite R S := finite_of_finrank_pos (by grind)
  have : Free R (Module.End R S) := .of_equiv (dualTensorHomEquiv R S S)
  let f : S →ₐ[R] (S →ₗ[R] S) := Algebra.lmul R S
  have h1 : LinearMap.trace R S ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ Algebra.linearMap R S = LinearMap.id := by ext; simp [h]
  let b : Basis (Unit × Unit) R (End R S) :=
    .map (.tensorProduct (.dualBasis <| basisUnique Unit h) (basisUnique Unit h))
      (dualTensorHomEquiv R S S)
  have h2 : (f ∘ₗ Algebra.linearMap R S) ∘ₗ LinearMap.trace R S = LinearMap.id :=
    b.ext fun i ↦
      (basisUnique Unit h).ext fun j ↦ (by simp [f, b, Basis.tensorProduct, dualTensorHomEquiv])
  let eq : R ≃ₗ[R] End R S := .ofLinearMap (f ∘ₗ Algebra.linearMap R S) (.trace R S) h2 h1
  have hf : Function.Bijective f := ⟨Algebra.lmul_injective, .of_comp eq.surjective⟩
  exact (Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff' hf _).mp eq.bijective

name: eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_finset_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_finset_eq_zero (degree_f_lt : f.degree < #s)
    (eval_f : ∀ x ∈ s, f.eval x = 0) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_degreeLT] at degree_f_lt
  simp_rw [eval_eq_sum_degreeLTEquiv degree_f_lt] at eval_f
  rw [← degreeLTEquiv_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero degree_f_lt]
  exact
    Matrix.eq_zero_of_forall_index_sum_mul_pow_eq_zero
      (Injective.comp (Embedding.subtype _).inj' (equivFinOfCardEq (card_coe _)).symm.injective)
      fun _ => eval_f _ (Finset.coe_mem _)

name: eq_of_degree_sub_lt_of_eval_finset_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_degree_sub_lt_of_eval_finset_eq (degree_fg_lt : (f - g).degree < #s)
    (eval_fg : ∀ x ∈ s, f.eval x = g.eval x) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_finset_eq_zero _ degree_fg_lt ?_
  simp_rw [eval_sub, sub_eq_zero]
  exact eval_fg

name: eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_finset_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_finset_eq (degree_f_lt : f.degree < #s)
    (degree_g_lt : g.degree < #s) (eval_fg : ∀ x ∈ s, f.eval x = g.eval x) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_degreeLT] at degree_f_lt degree_g_lt
  refine eq_of_degree_sub_lt_of_eval_finset_eq _ ?_ eval_fg
  rw [← mem_degreeLT]; exact Submodule.sub_mem _ degree_f_lt degree_g_lt

name: eq_of_degree_le_of_eval_finset_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_degree_le_of_eval_finset_eq
    (h_deg_le : f.degree ≤ #s)
    (h_deg_eq : f.degree = g.degree)
    (hlc : f.leadingCoeff = g.leadingCoeff)
    (h_eval : ∀ x ∈ s, f.eval x = g.eval x) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · rwa [degree_zero, eq_comm, degree_eq_bot, eq_comm] at h_deg_eq
  · exact eq_of_degree_sub_lt_of_eval_finset_eq s
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (degree_sub_lt_left h_deg_eq hf hlc) h_deg_le) h_eval

name: eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero (hvs : Set.InjOn v s)
    (degree_f_lt : f.degree < #s) (eval_f : ∀ i ∈ s, f.eval (v i) = 0) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [← card_image_of_injOn hvs] at degree_f_lt
    refine eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_finset_eq_zero _ degree_f_lt ?_
    intro x hx
    rcases mem_image.mp hx with ⟨_, hj, rfl⟩
    exact eval_f _ hj

name: eq_of_degree_sub_lt_of_eval_index_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_degree_sub_lt_of_eval_index_eq (hvs : Set.InjOn v s)
    (degree_fg_lt : (f - g).degree < #s) (eval_fg : ∀ i ∈ s, f.eval (v i) = g.eval (v i)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_degree_lt_of_eval_index_eq_zero _ hvs degree_fg_lt ?_
  simp_rw [eval_sub, sub_eq_zero]
  exact eval_fg

name: eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_index_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_index_eq (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (degree_f_lt : f.degree < #s)
    (degree_g_lt : g.degree < #s) (eval_fg : ∀ i ∈ s, f.eval (v i) = g.eval (v i)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_degree_sub_lt_of_eval_index_eq _ hvs ?_ eval_fg
  rw [← mem_degreeLT] at degree_f_lt degree_g_lt ⊢
  exact Submodule.sub_mem _ degree_f_lt degree_g_lt

name: eq_of_degree_le_of_eval_index_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_degree_le_of_eval_index_eq (hvs : Set.InjOn v s)
    (h_deg_le : f.degree ≤ #s)
    (h_deg_eq : f.degree = g.degree)
    (hlc : f.leadingCoeff = g.leadingCoeff)
    (h_eval : ∀ i ∈ s, f.eval (v i) = g.eval (v i)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
  · rwa [degree_zero, eq_comm, degree_eq_bot, eq_comm] at h_deg_eq
  · exact eq_of_degree_sub_lt_of_eval_index_eq s hvs
      (lt_of_lt_of_le (degree_sub_lt_left h_deg_eq hf hlc) h_deg_le)
      h_eval

name: basisDivisor_self
statement: theorem basisDivisor_self : basisDivisor x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basisDivisor, sub_self, inv_zero, map_zero, zero_mul]

name: basisDivisor_inj
statement: theorem basisDivisor_inj (hxy : basisDivisor x y = 0) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [basisDivisor, mul_eq_zero, X_sub_C_ne_zero, or_false, C_eq_zero, inv_eq_zero,
    sub_eq_zero] at hxy
  exact hxy

name: basisDivisor_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basisDivisor_eq_zero_iff : basisDivisor x y = 0 ↔ x = y

name: basisDivisor_ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem basisDivisor_ne_zero_iff : basisDivisor x y ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ y

name: degree_basisDivisor_of_ne
statement: theorem degree_basisDivisor_of_ne (hxy : x ≠ y) : (basisDivisor x y).degree = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [basisDivisor, degree_mul, degree_X_sub_C, degree_C, zero_add]
  exact inv_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hxy)

name: degree_basisDivisor_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_basisDivisor_self : (basisDivisor x x).degree = ⊥

name: natDegree_basisDivisor_self
statement: theorem natDegree_basisDivisor_self : (basisDivisor x x).natDegree = 0

name: natDegree_basisDivisor_of_ne
statement: theorem natDegree_basisDivisor_of_ne (hxy : x ≠ y) : (basisDivisor x y).natDegree = 1

name: eval_basisDivisor_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_basisDivisor_right : eval y (basisDivisor x y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basisDivisor, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_sub, eval_X, sub_self, mul_zero]

name: eval_basisDivisor_left_of_ne
statement: theorem eval_basisDivisor_left_of_ne (hxy : x ≠ y) : eval x (basisDivisor x y) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basisDivisor, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_sub, eval_X]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hxy)

name: basis_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basis_empty : Lagrange.basis ∅ v i = 1

name: basis_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basis_singleton (i : ι) : Lagrange.basis {i} v i = 1

name: basis_pair_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basis_pair_left (hij : i ≠ j) : Lagrange.basis {i, j} v i = basisDivisor (v i) (v j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Lagrange.basis, hij, erase_insert_eq_erase, erase_eq_of_notMem, mem_singleton,
    not_false_iff, prod_singleton]

name: basis_pair_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basis_pair_right (hij : i ≠ j) : Lagrange.basis {i, j} v j = basisDivisor (v j) (v i)

name: basis_ne_zero
statement: theorem basis_ne_zero (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hi : i ∈ s) : Lagrange.basis s v i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Lagrange.basis, prod_ne_zero_iff, Ne, mem_erase]
  rintro j ⟨hij, hj⟩
  rw [basisDivisor_eq_zero_iff, hvs.eq_iff hi hj]
  exact hij.symm

name: eval_basis_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_basis_self (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval (v i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Lagrange.basis, eval_prod]
  refine prod_eq_one fun j H => ?_
  rw [eval_basisDivisor_left_of_ne]
  rcases mem_erase.mp H with ⟨hij, hj⟩
  exact mt (hvs hi hj) hij.symm

name: eval_basis_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_basis_of_ne (hij : i ≠ j) (hj : j ∈ s) : (Lagrange.basis s v i).eval (v j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Lagrange.basis, eval_prod, prod_eq_zero_iff]
  exact ⟨j, ⟨mem_erase.mpr ⟨hij.symm, hj⟩, eval_basisDivisor_right⟩⟩

name: natDegree_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natDegree_basis (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (Lagrange.basis s v i).natDegree = #s - 1
proof:
:= by
  have H : ∀ j, j ∈ s.erase i → basisDivisor (v i) (v j) ≠ 0 := by
    simp_rw [Ne, mem_erase, basisDivisor_eq_zero_iff]
    exact fun j ⟨hij₁, hj⟩ hij₂ => hij₁ (hvs hj hi hij₂.symm)
  rw [← card_erase_of_mem hi, card_eq_sum_ones]
  convert! natDegree_prod _ _ H using 1
  refine sum_congr rfl fun j hj => (natDegree_basisDivisor_of_ne ?_).symm
  rw [Ne, ← basisDivisor_eq_zero_iff]
  exact H _ hj

name: degree_basis
statement:
theorem degree_basis (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (Lagrange.basis s v i).degree = ↑(#s - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree_eq_natDegree (basis_ne_zero hvs hi), natDegree_basis hvs hi]

name: sum_basis
statement:
theorem sum_basis (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    ∑ j ∈ s, Lagrange.basis s v j = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_index_eq s hvs (lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sum_le _ _) ?_) ?_ ?_
  · rw [Nat.cast_withBot, Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe #s)]
    intro i hi
    rw [degree_basis hvs hi, Nat.cast_withBot, WithBot.coe_lt_coe]
    exact Nat.pred_lt (card_ne_zero_of_mem hi)
  · rw [degree_one, ← WithBot.coe_zero, Nat.cast_withBot, WithBot.coe_lt_coe]
    exact Nonempty.card_pos hs
  · intro i hi
    rw [eval_finsetSum, eval_one, ← add_sum_erase _ _ hi, eval_basis_self hvs hi,
      add_eq_left]
    refine sum_eq_zero fun j hj => ?_
    rcases mem_erase.mp hj with ⟨hij, _⟩
    rw [eval_basis_of_ne hij hi]

name: basisDivisor_add_symm
statement:
theorem basisDivisor_add_symm {x y : F} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    basisDivisor x y + basisDivisor y x = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← sum_basis Function.injective_id.injOn ⟨x, mem_insert_self _ {y}⟩,
    sum_insert (notMem_singleton.mpr hxy), sum_singleton, basis_pair_left hxy,
    basis_pair_right hxy, id, id]

name: leadingCoeff_basis
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_basis (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (Lagrange.basis s v i).leadingCoeff = (∏ j ∈ s.erase i, ((v i) - (v j)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have : (∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (X - C (v j))).coeff (#s - 1) = 1 := by
    simpa [hi] using (monic_prod_X_sub_C v (s.erase i)).coeff_natDegree
  simp_rw [leadingCoeff, natDegree_basis hvs hi, Lagrange.basis]
  simp [basisDivisor, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, ← map_prod, this]

name: interpolate_empty
statement: theorem interpolate_empty : interpolate ∅ v r = 0

name: interpolate_singleton
statement: theorem interpolate_singleton : interpolate {i} v r = C (r i)

name: interpolate_one
statement: theorem interpolate_one (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hs : s.Nonempty) : interpolate s v 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [interpolate_apply, Pi.one_apply, map_one, one_mul]
  exact sum_basis hvs hs

name: eval_interpolate_at_node
statement:
theorem eval_interpolate_at_node (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    eval (v i) (interpolate s v r) = r i
proof:
:= by
  rw [interpolate_apply, eval_finsetSum, ← add_sum_erase _ _ hi]
  simp_rw [eval_mul, eval_C, eval_basis_self hvs hi, mul_one, add_eq_left]
  refine sum_eq_zero fun j H => ?_
  rw [eval_basis_of_ne (mem_erase.mp H).1 hi, mul_zero]

name: degree_interpolate_le
statement:
theorem degree_interpolate_le (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) :
    (interpolate s v r).degree ≤ ↑(#s - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine (degree_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  rw [Finset.sup_le_iff]
  intro i hi
  rw [degree_mul, degree_basis hvs hi]
  by_cases hr : r i = 0
  · simpa only [hr, map_zero, degree_zero, WithBot.bot_add] using bot_le
  · rw [degree_C hr, zero_add]

name: degree_interpolate_lt
statement: theorem degree_interpolate_lt (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) : (interpolate s v r).degree < #s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_withBot]
  rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty s with (rfl | h)
  · rw [interpolate_empty, degree_zero, card_empty]
    exact WithBot.bot_lt_coe _
  · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_interpolate_le _ hvs) ?_
    rw [Nat.cast_withBot, WithBot.coe_lt_coe]
    exact Nat.sub_lt (Nonempty.card_pos h) zero_lt_one

name: degree_interpolate_erase_lt
statement:
theorem degree_interpolate_erase_lt (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (interpolate (s.erase i) v r).degree < ↑(#s - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi]
  exact degree_interpolate_lt _ (Set.InjOn.mono (coe_subset.mpr (erase_subset _ _)) hvs)

name: values_eq_on_of_interpolate_eq
statement:
theorem values_eq_on_of_interpolate_eq (hvs : Set.InjOn v s)
    (hrr' : interpolate s v r = interpolate s v r') : ∀ i ∈ s, r i = r' i
proof:
:= fun _ hi => by
  rw [← eval_interpolate_at_node r hvs hi, hrr', eval_interpolate_at_node r' hvs hi]

name: interpolate_eq_of_values_eq_on
statement:
theorem interpolate_eq_of_values_eq_on (hrr' : ∀ i ∈ s, r i = r' i) :
    interpolate s v r = interpolate s v r'
proof:
:=
  sum_congr rfl fun i hi => by rw [hrr' _ hi]

name: interpolate_eq_iff_values_eq_on
statement:
theorem interpolate_eq_iff_values_eq_on (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) :
    interpolate s v r = interpolate s v r' ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, r i = r' i

name: eq_interpolate
statement:
theorem eq_interpolate {f : F[X]} (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (degree_f_lt : f.degree < #s) :
    f = interpolate s v fun i => f.eval (v i)
proof:
:=
  eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_index_eq _ hvs degree_f_lt (degree_interpolate_lt _ hvs) fun _ hi =>
    (eval_interpolate_at_node (fun x ↦ eval (v x) f) hvs hi).symm

name: eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq
statement:
theorem eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq {f : F[X]} (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (degree_f_lt : f.degree < #s)
    (eval_f : ∀ i ∈ s, f.eval (v i) = r i) : f = interpolate s v r
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_interpolate hvs degree_f_lt]
  exact interpolate_eq_of_values_eq_on _ _ eval_f

name: eq_interpolate_iff
statement:
theorem eq_interpolate_iff {f : F[X]} (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) :
    (f.degree < #s ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, eval (v i) f = r i) ↔ f = interpolate s v r
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · exact eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq _ hvs h.1 h.2
  · rw [h]
    exact ⟨degree_interpolate_lt _ hvs, fun _ hi => eval_interpolate_at_node _ hvs hi⟩

name: interpolate_eq_sum_interpolate_insert_sdiff
statement:
theorem interpolate_eq_sum_interpolate_insert_sdiff (hvt : Set.InjOn v t) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    interpolate t v r = ∑ i ∈ s, interpolate (insert i (t \ s)) v r * Lagrange.basis s v i
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine eq_interpolate_of_eval_eq _ hvt (lt_of_le_of_lt (degree_sum_le _ _) ?_) fun i hi => ?_
  · simp_rw [Nat.cast_withBot, Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe #t), degree_mul]
    intro i hi
    have hs : 1 ≤ #s := Nonempty.card_pos ⟨_, hi⟩
    have hst' : #s ≤ #t := card_le_card hst
    have H : #t = 1 + (#t - #s) + (#s - 1) := by
      rw [add_assoc, tsub_add_tsub_cancel hst' hs, ← add_tsub_assoc_of_le (hs.trans hst'),
        Nat.succ_add_sub_one, zero_add]
    rw [degree_basis (Set.InjOn.mono hst hvt) hi, H, WithBot.coe_add, Nat.cast_withBot,
      WithBot.add_lt_add_iff_right (@WithBot.coe_ne_bot _ (#s - 1))]
    convert!
      degree_interpolate_lt _
        (hvt.mono (coe_subset.mpr (insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨hst hi, sdiff_subset⟩)))
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem (notMem_sdiff_of_mem_right hi), card_sdiff_of_subset hst, add_comm]
  · simp_rw [eval_finsetSum, eval_mul]
    by_cases hi' : i ∈ s
    · rw [← add_sum_erase _ _ hi', eval_basis_self (hvt.mono hst) hi',
        eval_interpolate_at_node _
          (hvt.mono (coe_subset.mpr (insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨hi, sdiff_subset⟩)))
          (mem_insert_self _ _),
        mul_one, add_eq_left]
      refine sum_eq_zero fun j hj => ?_
      rcases mem_erase.mp hj with ⟨hij, _⟩
      rw [eval_basis_of_ne hij hi', mul_zero]
    · have H : (∑ j ∈ s, eval (v i) (Lagrange.basis s v j)) = 1 := by
        rw [← eval_finsetSum, sum_basis (hvt.mono hst) hs, eval_one]
      rw [← mul_one (r i), ← H, mul_sum]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
      congr
      exact
        eval_interpolate_at_node _ (hvt.mono (insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨hst hj, sdiff_subset⟩))
          (mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr (mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hi, hi'⟩)))

name: interpolate_eq_add_interpolate_erase
statement:
theorem interpolate_eq_add_interpolate_erase (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hi : i ∈ s) (hj : j ∈ s)
    (hij : i ≠ j) :
    interpolate s v r =
      interpolate (s.erase j) v r * basisDivisor (v i) (v j) +
        interpolate (s.erase i) v r * basisDivisor (v j) (v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [interpolate_eq_sum_interpolate_insert_sdiff _ hvs ⟨i, mem_insert_self i {j}⟩ _,
    sum_insert (notMem_singleton.mpr hij), sum_singleton, basis_pair_left hij,
    basis_pair_right hij, sdiff_insert_insert_of_mem_of_notMem hi (notMem_singleton.mpr hij),
    sdiff_singleton_eq_erase, pair_comm,
    sdiff_insert_insert_of_mem_of_notMem hj (notMem_singleton.mpr hij.symm),
    sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]
  exact insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨hi, singleton_subset_iff.mpr hj⟩

name: interpolate_eq_sum
statement:
theorem interpolate_eq_sum : interpolate s v r =
    ∑ i ∈ s, C (r i / ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (v i - v j)) * (∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (X - C (v j)))
proof:
:= by
  simp [Lagrange.basis, basisDivisor, div_eq_mul_inv, prod_mul_distrib, ← map_prod,
    ← prod_inv_distrib, mul_assoc]

name: iterate_derivative_interpolate
statement:
theorem iterate_derivative_interpolate (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < #s) :
    derivative^[k] (interpolate s v r) =
      k.factorial * ∑ i ∈ s, C (r i / ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (v i - v j)) *
        ∑ t ∈ (s.erase i).powersetCard (#s - (k + 1)), ∏ a ∈ t, (X - C (v a))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [interpolate_eq_sum, iterate_derivative_sum, iterate_derivative_C_mul, mul_sum s,
    ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (k.factorial : F[X]), mul_assoc]
  congr! 2 with i hi
  have hvs' := hvs.mono (coe_subset.mpr (erase_subset i s))
  calc
    derivative^[k] (∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (X - C (v j))) =
    derivative^[k] (∏ vj ∈ (s.erase i).image v, (X - C vj)) := by rw [Finset.prod_image hvs']
    _ = k.factorial * ∑ t ∈ ((s.erase i).image v).powersetCard (#s - (k + 1)),
          ∏ va ∈ t, (X - C va) := by
        grind [iterate_derivative_prod_X_sub_C]
    _ = k.factorial * ∑ t ∈ (s.erase i).powersetCard (#s - (k + 1)), ∏ a ∈ t, (X - C (v a)) := by
        rw [powersetCard_eq_filter, powerset_image, eq_comm]
        congrm k.factorial * ?_
        refine sum_nbij (·.image v) (fun a ha ↦ ?hi) ?i_inj (fun t ht ↦ ?i_surj) fun a ha ↦ ?h
        case hi => grind [card_image_of_injOn, hvs'.mono]
        case i_inj => exact (image_injOn_powerset_of_injOn hvs').mono (by grind)
        case i_surj => grind [card_image_of_injOn, hvs'.mono]
        case h => exact eq_comm.mp <| prod_image <| by grind [hvs'.mono]

name: eval_iterate_derivative_eq_sum
statement:
theorem eval_iterate_derivative_eq_sum (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) {P : Polynomial F} (hP : P.degree < #s)
    {k : ℕ} (hk : k < #s) (x : F) :
    (derivative^[k] P).eval x =
      k.factorial * ∑ i ∈ s, (P.eval (v i) / ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (v i - v j)) *
        ∑ t ∈ (s.erase i).powersetCard (#s - (k + 1)), ∏ a ∈ t, (x - v a)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rewrite 1 [eq_interpolate hvs hP, iterate_derivative_interpolate _ hvs hk]
  simp [eval_finsetSum, eval_prod]

name: coeff_eq_sum
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_sum
    (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) {P : Polynomial F} (hP : P.degree < #s) :
    P.coeff (#s - 1) = ∑ i ∈ s, (P.eval (v i)) / ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (v i - v j)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rewrite 1 [eq_interpolate hvs hP, interpolate_apply, finsetSum_coeff]
  congr! with i hi
  rw [coeff_C_mul, ← natDegree_basis hvs hi, ← leadingCoeff, leadingCoeff_basis hvs hi]
  field_simp

name: leadingCoeff_eq_sum
statement:
theorem leadingCoeff_eq_sum
    (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) {P : Polynomial F} (hP : #s = P.degree + 1) :
    P.leadingCoeff = ∑ i ∈ s, (P.eval (v i)) / ∏ j ∈ s.erase i, (v i - v j)
proof:
:= by
  lift P.degree to ℕ using (by contrapose! hP; simp [hP]) with deg hdeg
  rw [← WithBot.coe_one, ← WithBot.coe_add] at hP
  replace hP : #s = deg + 1 := WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mp hP
  have hdegree : P.degree = ↑(#s - 1) := hdeg.symm.trans (WithBot.coe_eq_coe.mpr (by grind))
  rw [leadingCoeff, natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some hdegree]
  exact coeff_eq_sum hvs (by rw [hdegree]; norm_cast; lia)

name: _root_.Polynomial.exists_eval_eq_iff
statement:
lemma _root_.Polynomial.exists_eval_eq_iff {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (x y : ι → F) :
    (∃ q : F[X], ∀ i, q.eval (x i) = y i) ↔ ∀ i j, x i = x j → y i = y j
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨q, hq⟩ i j hij ↦ by rw [← hq, ← hq, hij], fun hwd ↦ ?_⟩
  classical
  have : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun d : F ↦ d) (Finset.univ.image x) := Function.injective_id.injOn
  set v : F → F := fun z ↦ if h : ∃ i, x i = z then y h.choose else 0 with v_def
  refine ⟨Lagrange.interpolate (Finset.univ.image x) (fun d : F ↦ d) v, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node _ hinj (by simp), v_def]
  simp only
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hwd _ _ h.choose_spec
  · aesop

name: nodal_eq
statement: theorem nodal_eq (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → R) : nodal s v = ∏ i ∈ s, (X - C (v i))

name: nodal_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodal_empty : nodal ∅ v = 1

name: natDegree_nodal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natDegree_nodal [Nontrivial R] : (nodal s v).natDegree = #s
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [nodal, natDegree_prod_of_monic (h := fun i _ => monic_X_sub_C (v i)),
    natDegree_X_sub_C, sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: nodal_ne_zero
statement: theorem nodal_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] : nodal s v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with (rfl | h)
  · exact one_ne_zero
  · apply ne_zero_of_natDegree_gt (n := 0)
    simp only [natDegree_nodal, h.card_pos]

name: degree_nodal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_nodal [Nontrivial R] : (nodal s v).degree = #s

name: nodal_monic
statement: theorem nodal_monic : (nodal s v).Monic
proof:
:=
  monic_prod_of_monic s (fun i ↦ X - C (v i)) fun i _ ↦ monic_X_sub_C (v i)

name: eval_nodal
statement: theorem eval_nodal {x : R} : (nodal s v).eval x = ∏ i ∈ s, (x - v i)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [nodal, eval_prod, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]

name: eval_nodal_at_node
statement: theorem eval_nodal_at_node {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) : eval (v i) (nodal s v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_nodal]
  exact s.prod_eq_zero hi (sub_self (v i))

name: eval_nodal_not_at_node
statement:
theorem eval_nodal_not_at_node [Nontrivial R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {x : R}
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, x ≠ v i) : eval x (nodal s v) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [nodal, eval_prod, prod_ne_zero_iff, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, sub_ne_zero]
  exact hx

name: nodal_eq_mul_nodal_erase
statement:
theorem nodal_eq_mul_nodal_erase [DecidableEq ι] {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    nodal s v = (X - C (v i)) * nodal (s.erase i) v
proof:
:= by
    simp_rw [nodal, Finset.mul_prod_erase _ (fun x => X - C (v x)) hi]

name: X_sub_C_dvd_nodal
statement: theorem X_sub_C_dvd_nodal (v : ι → R) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) : X - C (v i) ∣ nodal s v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact ⟨nodal (s.erase i) v, nodal_eq_mul_nodal_erase hi⟩

name: nodal_insert_eq_nodal
statement:
theorem nodal_insert_eq_nodal [DecidableEq ι] {i : ι} (hi : i ∉ s) :
    nodal (insert i s) v = (X - C (v i)) * nodal s v

name: derivative_nodal
statement:
theorem derivative_nodal [DecidableEq ι] :
    derivative (nodal s v) = ∑ i ∈ s, nodal (s.erase i) v
proof:
:= by
  refine s.induction_on ?_ fun i t hit IH => ?_
  · rw [nodal_empty, derivative_one, sum_empty]
  · rw [nodal_insert_eq_nodal hit, derivative_mul, IH, derivative_sub, derivative_X, derivative_C,
      sub_zero, one_mul, sum_insert hit, mul_sum, erase_insert hit, add_right_inj]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun j hjt => ?_
    rw [t.erase_insert_of_ne (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hjt hit).symm,
      nodal_insert_eq_nodal (mem_of_mem_erase.mt hit)]

name: eval_nodal_derivative_eval_node_eq
statement:
theorem eval_nodal_derivative_eval_node_eq [DecidableEq ι] {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    eval (v i) (derivative (nodal s v)) = eval (v i) (nodal (s.erase i) v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivative_nodal, eval_finsetSum, ← add_sum_erase _ _ hi, add_eq_left]
  exact sum_eq_zero fun j hj => (eval_nodal_at_node (mem_erase.mpr ⟨(mem_erase.mp hj).1.symm, hi⟩))

name: nodal_subgroup_eq_X_pow_card_sub_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem nodal_subgroup_eq_X_pow_card_sub_one [IsDomain R]
    (G : Subgroup Rˣ) [Fintype G] :
    nodal (G : Set Rˣ).toFinset ((↑) : Rˣ → R) = X ^ (Fintype.card G) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : degree (1 : R[X]) < degree ((X : R[X]) ^ Fintype.card G) := by simp [Fintype.card_pos]
  apply eq_of_degree_le_of_eval_index_eq (v := ((↑) : Rˣ → R)) (G : Set Rˣ).toFinset
  · exact Units.val_injective.injOn
  · simp
  · rw [degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt h, degree_nodal, Set.toFinset_card, degree_pow, degree_X,
      nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Nat.cast_inj]
    exact rfl
  · rw [nodal_monic, leadingCoeff_sub_of_degree_lt h, monic_X_pow]
  · intro i hi
    rw [eval_nodal_at_node hi]
    replace hi : i ∈ G := by simpa using hi
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ : ∃ g : G, g.val = i := ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩
    simp [← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← Subgroup.coe_pow G]

name: nodalWeight_eq_eval_nodal_erase_inv
statement:
theorem nodalWeight_eq_eval_nodal_erase_inv :
    nodalWeight s v i = (eval (v i) (nodal (s.erase i) v))⁻¹

name: nodal_erase_eq_nodal_div
statement:
theorem nodal_erase_eq_nodal_div (hi : i ∈ s) :
    nodal (s.erase i) v = nodal s v / (X - C (v i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [nodal_eq_mul_nodal_erase hi, mul_div_cancel_left₀]
  exact X_sub_C_ne_zero _

name: nodalWeight_eq_eval_derivative_nodal
statement:
theorem nodalWeight_eq_eval_derivative_nodal (hi : i ∈ s) :
    nodalWeight s v i = (eval (v i) (Polynomial.derivative (nodal s v)))⁻¹

name: nodalWeight_ne_zero
statement: theorem nodalWeight_ne_zero (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hi : i ∈ s) : nodalWeight s v i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [nodalWeight, prod_ne_zero_iff]
  intro j hj
  rcases mem_erase.mp hj with ⟨hij, hj⟩
  exact inv_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero_of_ne (mt (hvs.eq_iff hi hj).mp hij.symm))

name: basis_eq_prod_sub_inv_mul_nodal_div
statement:
theorem basis_eq_prod_sub_inv_mul_nodal_div (hi : i ∈ s) :
    Lagrange.basis s v i = C (nodalWeight s v i) * (nodal s v / (X - C (v i)))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Lagrange.basis, basisDivisor, nodalWeight, prod_mul_distrib, map_prod, ←
    nodal_erase_eq_nodal_div hi, nodal]

name: eval_basis_not_at_node
statement:
theorem eval_basis_not_at_node (hi : i ∈ s) (hxi : x ≠ v i) :
    eval x (Lagrange.basis s v i) = eval x (nodal s v) * (nodalWeight s v i * (x - v i)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm, basis_eq_prod_sub_inv_mul_nodal_div hi, eval_mul, eval_C, ←
    nodal_erase_eq_nodal_div hi, eval_nodal, eval_nodal, mul_assoc, ← mul_prod_erase _ _ hi, ←
    mul_assoc (x - v i)⁻¹, inv_mul_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hxi), one_mul]

name: interpolate_eq_nodalWeight_mul_nodal_div_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem interpolate_eq_nodalWeight_mul_nodal_div_X_sub_C :
    interpolate s v r = ∑ i ∈ s, C (nodalWeight s v i) * (nodal s v / (X - C (v i))) * C (r i)
proof:
:=
  sum_congr rfl fun j hj => by rw [mul_comm, basis_eq_prod_sub_inv_mul_nodal_div hj]

name: eval_interpolate_not_at_node
statement:
theorem eval_interpolate_not_at_node (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, x ≠ v i) :
    eval x (interpolate s v r) =
      eval x (nodal s v) * ∑ i ∈ s, nodalWeight s v i * (x - v i)⁻¹ * r i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [interpolate_apply, mul_sum, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul, eval_C]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm, eval_basis_not_at_node hi (hx _ hi)]

name: sum_nodalWeight_mul_inv_sub_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sum_nodalWeight_mul_inv_sub_ne_zero (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, x ≠ v i)
    (hs : s.Nonempty) : (∑ i ∈ s, nodalWeight s v i * (x - v i)⁻¹) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  @right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one _ _ _ (eval x (nodal s v)) _ <| by
    simpa only [Pi.one_apply, interpolate_one hvs hs, eval_one, mul_one] using
      (eval_interpolate_not_at_node 1 hx).symm

name: eval_interpolate_not_at_node'
statement:
theorem eval_interpolate_not_at_node' (hvs : Set.InjOn v s) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, x ≠ v i) :
    eval x (interpolate s v r) =
      (∑ i ∈ s, nodalWeight s v i * (x - v i)⁻¹ * r i) /
        ∑ i ∈ s, nodalWeight s v i * (x - v i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← div_one (eval x (interpolate s v r)), ← @eval_one _ _ x, ← interpolate_one hvs hs,
    eval_interpolate_not_at_node r hx, eval_interpolate_not_at_node 1 hx]
  simp only [mul_div_mul_left _ _ (eval_nodal_not_at_node hx), Pi.one_apply, mul_one]

name: vandermonde_eq_projVandermonde
statement: lemma vandermonde_eq_projVandermonde (v : Fin n → R) : vandermonde v = projVandermonde v 1

name: projVandermonde_apply
statement:
theorem projVandermonde_apply {v w : Fin n → R} {i j : Fin n} :
    projVandermonde v w i j = (v i) ^ j.1 * (w i) ^ j.rev.1

name: rectVandermonde_apply
statement:
theorem rectVandermonde_apply {α : Type*} {v w : α → R} {i : α} {j : Fin n} :
    rectVandermonde v w n i j = (v i) ^ j.1 * (w i) ^ j.rev.1

name: vandermonde_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vandermonde_apply (v : Fin n → R) (i j) : vandermonde v i j = v i ^ (j : ℕ)

name: vandermonde_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vandermonde_cons (v0 : R) (v : Fin n → R) :
    vandermonde (Fin.cons v0 v : Fin n.succ → R) =
      Fin.cons (fun (j : Fin n.succ) => v0 ^ (j : ℕ)) fun i => Fin.cons 1
      fun j => v i * vandermonde v i j
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  refine Fin.cases (by simp) (fun i => ?_) i
  refine Fin.cases (by simp) (fun j => ?_) j
  simp [pow_succ']

name: vandermonde_succ
statement:
theorem vandermonde_succ (v : Fin n.succ → R) :
    vandermonde v = .of
      Fin.cons (fun (j : Fin n.succ) => v 0 ^ (j : ℕ)) fun i =>
        Fin.cons 1 fun j => v i.succ * vandermonde (Fin.tail v) i j
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Fin.cons_self_tail v, vandermonde_cons]
  rfl

name: vandermonde_mul_vandermonde_transpose
statement:
theorem vandermonde_mul_vandermonde_transpose (v w : Fin n → R) (i j) :
    (vandermonde v * (vandermonde w)ᵀ) i j = ∑ k : Fin n, (v i * w j) ^ (k : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vandermonde_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, mul_pow]

name: vandermonde_transpose_mul_vandermonde
statement:
theorem vandermonde_transpose_mul_vandermonde (v : Fin n → R) (i j) :
    ((vandermonde v)ᵀ * vandermonde v) i j = ∑ k : Fin n, v k ^ (i + j : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vandermonde_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, pow_add]

name: rectVandermonde_apply_zero_right
statement:
theorem rectVandermonde_apply_zero_right {α : Type*} {v w : α → R} {i : α} (hw : w i = 0) :
    rectVandermonde v w (n + 1) i = Pi.single (Fin.last n) ((v i) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  obtain rfl | hlt := j.le_last.eq_or_lt
  · simp [rectVandermonde_apply]
  rw [rectVandermonde_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hlt.ne, hw, zero_pow, mul_zero]
  simpa [Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le] using! hlt

name: projVandermonde_apply_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem projVandermonde_apply_of_ne_zero
    {v w : Fin (n + 1) → K} {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (hw : w i ≠ 0) :
    projVandermonde v w i j = (v i) ^ j.1 * (w i) ^ n / (w i) ^ j.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [projVandermonde_apply, eq_div_iff (by simp [hw]), mul_assoc, ← pow_add, rev_add_cast]

name: projVandermonde_apply_zero_right
statement:
theorem projVandermonde_apply_zero_right {v w : Fin (n + 1) → R} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hw : w i = 0) :
    projVandermonde v w i = Pi.single (Fin.last n) ((v i) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  obtain rfl | hlt := j.le_last.eq_or_lt
  · simp [projVandermonde_apply]
  rw [projVandermonde_apply, Pi.single_eq_of_ne hlt.ne, hw, zero_pow, mul_zero]
  simpa [Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le] using! hlt

name: projVandermonde_comp
statement:
theorem projVandermonde_comp {v w : Fin n → R} (f : Fin n → Fin n) :
    projVandermonde (v ∘ f) (w ∘ f) = (projVandermonde v w).submatrix f id

name: projVandermonde_map
statement:
theorem projVandermonde_map {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] (φ : R →+* R') (v w : Fin n → R) :
    projVandermonde (fun i ↦ φ (v i)) (fun i ↦ φ (w i)) = φ.mapMatrix (projVandermonde v w)

name: det_projVandermonde_of_field
statement:
private theorem det_projVandermonde_of_field (v w : Fin n → K) :
    (projVandermonde v w).det = ∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (v j * w i - v i * w j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
  /- We can assume not all `w i` are zero, and therefore that `w 0 ≠ 0`,
  since otherwise we can swap row `0` with another nonzero row. -/
  wlog h0 : w 0 ≠ 0 generalizing v w with aux
  · obtain h0' | ⟨i₀, hi₀ : w i₀ ≠ 0⟩ := forall_or_exists_not (w · = 0)
    · obtain rfl | hne := eq_or_ne n 0
      · simp [projVandermonde_apply]
      rw [det_eq_zero_of_column_eq_zero 0 (fun i ↦ by simpa [projVandermonde_apply, h0']),
        Finset.prod_sigma', Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := ⟨0, Fin.last n⟩) (by simpa) (by simp [h0'])]
    rw [← mul_right_inj' (a := ((Equiv.swap 0 i₀).sign : K))
      (by simp [show 0 ≠ i₀ by rintro rfl; contradiction]), ← det_permute, ← projVandermonde_comp,
      aux _ _ (by simpa), ← (Equiv.swap 0 i₀).prod_Ioi_comp_eq_sign_mul_prod (by simp)]
    rfl
  /- Let `W` be obtained from the matrix by subtracting `r = (v 0) / (w 0)` times each column
  from the next column, starting from the penultimate column. This doesn't change the determinant.-/
  set r := v 0 / w 0 with hr
  set W : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) K := .of fun i ↦ (cons (projVandermonde v w i 0)
    (fun j ↦ projVandermonde v w i j.succ - r * projVandermonde v w i j.castSucc))
  
  have hW_eq : (W.submatrix succ succ) = .of fun i j ↦ (v (succ i) - r * w (succ i)) *
      projVandermonde (v ∘ succ) (w ∘ succ) i j := by
    ext i j
    simp only [projVandermonde_apply, val_zero, rev_zero, val_last, val_succ,
      val_castSucc, submatrix_apply, Function.comp_apply, rev_succ,
      W, r, rev_castSucc]
    simp
    ring
  /- The first row of `W` is `[(w 0)^n, 0, ..., 0]` - take a cofactor expansion along this row,
  and apply induction. -/
  rw [det_eq_of_forall_col_eq_smul_add_pred (B := W) (c := fun _ ↦ r) (by simp [W])
    (fun i j ↦ by simp [W, r, projVandermonde_apply]), det_succ_row_zero,
    Finset.sum_eq_single 0 _ (by simp)]
  · rw [succAbove_zero, hW_eq, det_mul_column, ih]
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, coe_ofNat_eq_mod, Nat.zero_mod,
      pow_zero, show W 0 0 = w 0 ^ n by simp [W, projVandermonde_apply], one_mul, hr]
    field_simp
    simp only [Finset.prod_div_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_fin, Function.comp_apply]
    field_simp
    simp only [prod_univ_succ, Ioi_zero_eq_map, Finset.prod_map, coe_succEmb, prod_Ioi_succ]
  intro j _ hj0
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := j.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hj0
  rw [mul_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero]
  refine .inl (.inr ?_)
  simp only [of_apply, projVandermonde_apply_of_ne_zero h0, val_succ, val_castSucc, cons_succ, W, r]
  ring

name: det_projVandermonde
statement:
theorem det_projVandermonde (v w : Fin n → R) : (projVandermonde v w).det =
    ∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Finset.Ioi i, (v j * w i - v i * w j)
proof:
:= by
  let u (b : Bool) (i : Fin n) := (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Bool) ℤ)
    (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Bool) ℤ))) (MvPolynomial.X ⟨i, b⟩)
  have hdet := det_projVandermonde_of_field (u true) (u false)
  simp only [u] at hdet
  norm_cast at hdet
  rw [projVandermonde_map, ← RingHom.map_det, IsFractionRing.coe_inj] at hdet
  apply_fun MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (Int.castRingHom R) (fun x ↦ (if x.2 then v else w) x.1) at hdet
  rw [RingHom.map_det] at hdet
  convert! hdet <;>
  simp [← Matrix.ext_iff, projVandermonde_apply]

name: det_vandermonde
statement:
theorem det_vandermonde (v : Fin n → R) :
    det (vandermonde v) = ∏ i : Fin n, ∏ j ∈ Ioi i, (v j - v i)

name: det_vandermonde_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem det_vandermonde_eq_zero_iff [IsDomain R] {v : Fin n → R} :
    det (vandermonde v) = 0 ↔ ∃ i j : Fin n, v i = v j ∧ i ≠ j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [det_vandermonde v, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero, forall_exists_index]
    rintro i ⟨_, j, h₁, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨j, i, h₂, (mem_Ioi.mp h₁).ne'⟩
  · simp only [Ne, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
    refine fun i j h₁ h₂ => Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq h₂ (funext fun k => ?_)
    rw [vandermonde_apply, vandermonde_apply, h₁]

name: det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff [IsDomain R] {v : Fin n → R} :
    det (vandermonde v) ≠ 0 ↔ Function.Injective v
proof:
:= by
  unfold Function.Injective
  simp only [det_vandermonde_eq_zero_iff, Ne, not_exists, not_and, Classical.not_not]

name: det_vandermonde_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_vandermonde_add (v : Fin n → R) (a : R) :
    (Matrix.vandermonde fun i ↦ v i + a).det = (Matrix.vandermonde v).det

name: det_vandermonde_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_vandermonde_sub (v : Fin n → R) (a : R) :
    (Matrix.vandermonde fun i ↦ v i - a).det = (Matrix.vandermonde v).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [← det_vandermonde_add v (-a)]
  simp only [← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: eq_zero_of_forall_index_sum_pow_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_index_sum_pow_mul_eq_zero [IsDomain R] {f v : Fin n → R}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hfv : ∀ j, (∑ i : Fin n, f j ^ (i : ℕ) * v i) = 0) : v = 0

name: eq_zero_of_forall_index_sum_mul_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_index_sum_mul_pow_eq_zero [IsDomain R] {f v : Fin n → R}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hfv : ∀ j, (∑ i, v i * f j ^ (i : ℕ)) = 0) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_forall_index_sum_pow_mul_eq_zero hf
  simp_rw [mul_comm]
  exact hfv

name: eq_zero_of_forall_pow_sum_mul_pow_eq_zero
eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_vandermonde_mul_matrixOfPolynomials
statement:
theorem eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_vandermonde_mul_matrixOfPolynomials (v : Fin n → R)
    (p : Fin n → R[X]) (h_deg : ∀ i, (p i).natDegree ≤ i) :
    Matrix.of (fun i j => ((p j).eval (v i))) =
    (Matrix.vandermonde v) * (Matrix.of (fun (i j : Fin n) => (p j).coeff i))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp_rw [Matrix.mul_apply, eval, Matrix.of_apply, eval₂_eq_sum]
  simp only [Matrix.vandermonde]
  have : (p j).support ⊆ range n := supp_subset_range <| Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (h_deg j) <| Fin.prop j
  rw [Polynomial.sum_eq_of_subset _ (fun j => zero_mul ((v i) ^ j)) this,
    ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  congr
  ext k
  rw [mul_comm, Matrix.of_apply, RingHom.id_apply]

name: det_eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_det_vandermonde
statement:
theorem det_eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_det_vandermonde (v : Fin n → R) (p : Fin n → R[X])
    (h_deg : ∀ i, (p i).natDegree = i) (h_monic : ∀ i, Monic <| p i) :
    (Matrix.vandermonde v).det = (Matrix.of (fun i j => ((p j).eval (v i)))).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_vandermonde_mul_matrixOfPolynomials v p (fun i ↦
      Nat.le_of_eq (h_deg i)), Matrix.det_mul,
      Matrix.det_matrixOfPolynomials p h_deg h_monic, mul_one]

name: det_vandermonde_id_eq_superFactorial
statement:
lemma det_vandermonde_id_eq_superFactorial (n : ℕ) :
    (vandermonde fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ (i : R)).det = n.superFactorial
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [Nat.superFactorial, det_vandermonde, Fin.prod_univ_succAbove _ 0]
    push_cast
    congr
    · simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero]
      norm_cast
      simp [Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun i ↦ (↑i + 1)) (n + 1)]
    · rw [det_vandermonde] at hn
      simp [hn]

name: of_eval_descPochhammer_eq_mul_of_choose
statement:
private lemma of_eval_descPochhammer_eq_mul_of_choose {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → ℕ) :
    (of fun i j : Fin n => (descPochhammer ℤ j).eval (v i : ℤ)).det =
    (∏ i : Fin n, Nat.factorial i) *
      (of fun i j : Fin n => (Nat.choose (v i) j : ℤ)).det
proof:
:= by
  convert! det_mul_row (fun (i : Fin n) => ((Nat.factorial (i : ℕ)) : ℤ)) _
  · rw [of_apply, descPochhammer_eval_eq_descFactorial ℤ _ _]
    congr
    exact Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose _ _
  · rw [Nat.cast_prod]

name: superFactorial_dvd_vandermonde_det
statement:
lemma superFactorial_dvd_vandermonde_det {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℤ) :
    ↑n.superFactorial ∣ (vandermonde v).det
proof:
:= by
  let m := inf' univ ⟨0, mem_univ _⟩ v
  let w' := fun i ↦ (v i - m).toNat
  have hw' : ∀ i, (w' i : ℤ) = v i - m := fun i ↦ Int.toNat_sub_of_le (inf'_le _ (mem_univ _))
  have h := det_eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_det_vandermonde (fun i ↦ ↑(w' i))
      (fun i => descPochhammer ℤ i)
      (fun i => descPochhammer_natDegree ℤ i)
      (fun i => monic_descPochhammer ℤ i)
  conv_lhs at h => simp only [hw', det_vandermonde_sub]
  use (of (fun (i j : Fin (n + 1)) => (Nat.choose (w' i) (j : ℕ) : ℤ))).det
  simp [h, of_eval_descPochhammer_eq_mul_of_choose w', Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range]

name: linearIndependent_single
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_single [Semiring R] [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (Ms i)] [∀ i, Module R (Ms i)]
    [DecidableEq η] (v : ∀ j, ιs j → Ms j) (hs : ∀ i, LinearIndependent R (v i)) :
    LinearIndependent R fun ji : Σ j, ιs j ↦ Pi.single ji.1 (v ji.1 ji.2)

name: linearIndependent_single_one
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_single_one (ι R : Type*) [Semiring R] [DecidableEq ι] :
    LinearIndependent R (fun i : ι ↦ Pi.single i (1 : R))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← linearIndependent_equiv (Equiv.sigmaPUnit ι)]
  exact Pi.linearIndependent_single (fun (_ : ι) (_ : Unit) ↦ (1 : R))
    <| by simp +contextual [Fintype.linearIndependent_iffₛ]

name: linearIndependent_single_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma linearIndependent_single_of_ne_zero [Ring R] [IsDomain R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [IsTorsionFree R M] [DecidableEq ι] {v : ι → M} (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent R fun i : ι ↦ Pi.single i (v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← linearIndependent_equiv (Equiv.sigmaPUnit ι)]
  exact linearIndependent_single (fun i (_ : Unit) ↦ v i) <| by simp +contextual [hv]

name: basis_repr_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basis_repr_single [DecidableEq η] (s : ∀ j, Basis (ιs j) R (Ms j)) (j i) :
    (Pi.basis s).repr (Pi.single j (s j i)) = Finsupp.single ⟨j, i⟩ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ⟨j', i'⟩
  by_cases hj : j = j'
  · subst hj
    simp only [Pi.basis, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
      LinearEquiv.piCongrRight, Finsupp.sigmaFinsuppLEquivPiFinsupp_symm_apply,
      Basis.repr_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_mk]
    symm
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply]
  simp only [Pi.basis, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Finsupp.sigmaFinsuppLEquivPiFinsupp_symm_apply,
    LinearEquiv.piCongrRight]
  dsimp
  rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hj), map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply,
    Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne]
  rintro ⟨⟩
  contradiction

name: basis_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basis_apply [DecidableEq η] (s : ∀ j, Basis (ιs j) R (Ms j)) (ji) :
    Pi.basis s ji = Pi.single ji.1 (s ji.1 ji.2)

name: basis_repr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basis_repr (s : ∀ j, Basis (ιs j) R (Ms j)) (x) (ji) :
    (Pi.basis s).repr x ji = (s ji.1).repr (x ji.1) ji.2

name: basisFun_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basisFun_apply [DecidableEq η] (i) :
    basisFun R η i = Pi.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [basisFun, Basis.coe_ofEquivFun, LinearEquiv.refl_symm, LinearEquiv.refl_apply]

name: basisFun_repr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basisFun_repr (x : η → R) (i : η) : (Pi.basisFun R η).repr x i = x i

name: basisFun_equivFun
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basisFun_equivFun : (Pi.basisFun R η).equivFun = LinearEquiv.refl _ _

name: mem_spanSubset_iff
statement:
lemma mem_spanSubset_iff {s : Set η} {v : η → R} :
    v ∈ spanSubset R s ↔ ∀ i ∉ s, v i = 0

name: AlgHom.eq_piEvalAlgHom
statement:
lemma AlgHom.eq_piEvalAlgHom {k G : Type*} [CommSemiring k] [NoZeroDivisors k] [Nontrivial k]
    [Finite G] (φ : (G → k) →ₐ[k] k) : ∃ (s : G), φ = Pi.evalAlgHom _ _ s
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := map_one φ
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite G
  simp only [← Finset.univ_sum_single (1 : G → k), Pi.one_apply, map_sum] at h1
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ (s : G), φ (Pi.single s 1) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra
    simp_all
  have h2 : ∀ t ≠ s, φ (Pi.single t 1) = 0 := by
    refine fun _ _ ↦ (eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero ?_).resolve_left hs
    rw [← map_mul]
    convert! map_zero φ
    ext u
    by_cases u = s <;> simp_all
  have h3 : φ (Pi.single s 1) = 1 := by
    rwa [Fintype.sum_eq_single s h2] at h1
  use s
  refine AlgHom.toLinearMap_injective ((Pi.basisFun k G).ext fun t ↦ ?_)
  by_cases t = s <;> simp_all

name: piEquiv_apply_apply
statement:
lemma piEquiv_apply_apply (ι R M : Type*) [Fintype ι] [CommSemiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (v : ι → M) (w : ι → R) :
    piEquiv ι R M v w = ∑ i, w i • v i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [piEquiv, Basis.constr_apply_fintype, Basis.equivFun_apply]
  congr

name: range_piEquiv

@[simp] lemma range_piEquiv (v : ι → M) :

name: surjective_piEquiv_apply_iff

@[simp] lemma surjective_piEquiv_apply_iff (v : ι → M) :

name: le_of_fin_injective
statement:
theorem le_of_fin_injective [StrongRankCondition R] {n m : ℕ} (f : (Fin n → R) →ₗ[R] Fin m → R) :
    Injective f → n ≤ m

name: strongRankCondition_iff_succ
statement:
theorem strongRankCondition_iff_succ :
    StrongRankCondition R ↔
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin (n + 1) → R) →ₗ[R] Fin n → R), ¬Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h n => fun f hf => ?_, fun h => ⟨@fun n m f hf => ?_⟩⟩
  · exact Nat.not_succ_le_self n (le_of_fin_injective R f hf)
  · by_contra H
    exact
      h m (f.comp (Function.ExtendByZero.linearMap R (Fin.castLE (not_le.1 H))))
        (hf.comp (Function.extend_injective (Fin.strictMono_castLE _).injective _))

name: card_le_of_injective
statement:
theorem card_le_of_injective [StrongRankCondition R] {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (f : (α → R) →ₗ[R] β → R) (i : Injective f) : Fintype.card α ≤ Fintype.card β

name: card_le_of_injective'
statement:
theorem card_le_of_injective' [StrongRankCondition R] {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (f : (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] β →₀ R) (i : Injective f) : Fintype.card α ≤ Fintype.card β
proof:
:= by
  let P := Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R R β
  let Q := (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R R α).symm
  exact card_le_of_injective R (P.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ Q) (P.injective.comp (i.comp Q.injective))

name: le_of_fin_surjective
statement:
theorem le_of_fin_surjective [RankCondition R] {n m : ℕ} (f : (Fin n → R) →ₗ[R] Fin m → R) :
    Surjective f → m ≤ n

name: card_le_of_surjective
statement:
theorem card_le_of_surjective [RankCondition R] {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (f : (α → R) →ₗ[R] β → R) (i : Surjective f) : Fintype.card β ≤ Fintype.card α

name: card_le_of_surjective'
statement:
theorem card_le_of_surjective' [RankCondition R] {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (f : (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] β →₀ R) (i : Surjective f) : Fintype.card β ≤ Fintype.card α
proof:
:= by
  let P := Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R R β
  let Q := (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R R α).symm
  exact card_le_of_surjective R (P.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ Q) (P.surjective.comp (i.comp Q.surjective))

name: Module.Finite.exists_nat_not_surjective
statement:
theorem Module.Finite.exists_nat_not_surjective [RankCondition R] (M) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    [Module.Finite R M] : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ f : M →ₗ[R] (Fin n → R), ¬Surjective f
proof:
:=
  have ⟨n, f, hf⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin' R M
  ⟨n + 1, fun g hg ↦ by simpa using le_of_fin_surjective R (g ∘ₗ f) (hg.comp hf)⟩

name: strongRankCondition_iff_forall_not_injective
statement:
theorem strongRankCondition_iff_forall_not_injective :
    StrongRankCondition R ↔ ∀ n (f : (ℕ →₀ R) →ₗ[R] Fin n → R), ¬ Injective f
proof:
:= by
  rw [strongRankCondition_iff_succ, ← not_iff_not]; push Not
  constructor <;> refine fun ⟨n, f, inj⟩ ↦ ⟨n, ?_⟩
  · exact f.exists_finsupp_nat_of_fin_fun_injective inj
  · exact ⟨f ∘ₗ Finsupp.lmapDomain R R (↑) ∘ₗ (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite ..).symm.toLinearMap,
      inj.comp <| by simpa using! Finsupp.mapDomain_injective Fin.val_injective⟩

name: eq_of_fin_equiv
statement: theorem eq_of_fin_equiv {n m : ℕ} : ((Fin n → R) ≃ₗ[R] Fin m → R) → n = m

name: card_eq_of_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem card_eq_of_linearEquiv {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (f : (α → R) ≃ₗ[R] β → R) :
    Fintype.card α = Fintype.card β
proof:
:=
  eq_of_fin_equiv R
    (.funCongrLeft R R (Fintype.equivFin α) ≪≫ₗ f ≪≫ₗ
      .symm (.funCongrLeft R R (Fintype.equivFin β)))

name: nontrivial_of_invariantBasisNumber

name: map
statement:
theorem map (H : M.LinearDisjoint N) {T : Type w} [Semiring T] [Algebra R T]
    (f : S →ₐ[R] T) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (M.map (f : S →ₗ[R] T)).LinearDisjoint (N.map (f : S →ₗ[R] T))
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearDisjoint_iff] at H ⊢
  have := hf.comp H
  rw [← coe_mulMap_comp_eq] at this
  refine this.of_comp_right ?_
  apply TensorProduct.map_surjective <;> exact LinearMap.submoduleMap_surjective _ _

name: of_basis_left'
statement:
theorem of_basis_left' {ι : Type*} (m : Basis ι R M)
    (H : Function.Injective (mulLeftMap N m)) : M.LinearDisjoint N
proof:
:= by
  classical simp_rw [mulLeftMap_eq_mulMap_comp, ← Basis.coe_repr_symm,
    ← LinearEquiv.coe_rTensor, LinearEquiv.comp_coe, LinearMap.coe_comp,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, EquivLike.injective_comp] at H

    ← LinearEquiv.coe_lTensor, LinearEquiv.comp_coe, LinearMap.coe_comp,
    LinearEquiv.coe_coe, EquivLike.injective_comp] at H

name: of_basis_mul'
statement:
theorem of_basis_mul' {κ ι : Type*} (m : Basis κ R M) (n : Basis ι R N)
    (H : Function.Injective (Finsupp.linearCombination R fun i : κ × ι ↦ (m i.1 * n i.2 : S))) :
    M.LinearDisjoint N
proof:
:= by
  let i0 := (finsuppTensorFinsupp' R κ ι).symm
  let i1 := TensorProduct.congr m.repr n.repr
  let i := mulMap M N ∘ₗ (i0.trans i1.symm).toLinearMap
  have : i = Finsupp.linearCombination R fun i : κ × ι ↦ (m i.1 * n i.2 : S) := by
    ext x
    simp [i, i0, i1, finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_eq_single_one_tmul]
  simp_rw [← this, i, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, EquivLike.injective_comp] at H
  exact ⟨H⟩

name: of_linearDisjoint_fg_left
statement:
theorem of_linearDisjoint_fg_left
    (H : ∀ M' : Submodule R S, M' ≤ M → M'.FG → M'.LinearDisjoint N) :
    M.LinearDisjoint N
proof:
:= (linearDisjoint_iff _ _).2 fun x y hxy ↦ by
  obtain ⟨M', hM, hFG, h⟩ :=
    TensorProduct.exists_finite_submodule_left_of_setFinite' {x, y} (Set.toFinite _)
  rw [Module.Finite.iff_fg] at hFG
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := h (show x ∈ {x, y} by simp)
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := h (show y ∈ {x, y} by simp)
  rw [← hx', ← hy']; congr
  exact (H M' hM hFG).injective (by simp [← mulMap_comp_rTensor _ hM, hx', hy', hxy])

name: of_linearDisjoint_fg_right
statement:
theorem of_linearDisjoint_fg_right
    (H : ∀ N' : Submodule R S, N' ≤ N → N'.FG → M.LinearDisjoint N') :
    M.LinearDisjoint N
proof:
:= (linearDisjoint_iff _ _).2 fun x y hxy ↦ by
  obtain ⟨N', hN, hFG, h⟩ :=
    TensorProduct.exists_finite_submodule_right_of_setFinite' {x, y} (Set.toFinite _)
  rw [Module.Finite.iff_fg] at hFG
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := h (show x ∈ {x, y} by simp)
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := h (show y ∈ {x, y} by simp)
  rw [← hx', ← hy']; congr
  exact (H N' hN hFG).injective (by simp [← mulMap_comp_lTensor _ hN, hx', hy', hxy])

name: of_linearDisjoint_fg
statement:
theorem of_linearDisjoint_fg
    (H : ∀ (M' N' : Submodule R S), M' ≤ M → N' ≤ N → M'.FG → N'.FG → M'.LinearDisjoint N') :
    M.LinearDisjoint N
proof:
:=
  of_linearDisjoint_fg_left _ _ fun _ hM hM' ↦
    of_linearDisjoint_fg_right _ _ fun _ hN hN' ↦ H _ _ hM hN hM' hN'

theorem linearIndependent_left_of_flat (H : M.LinearDisjoint N) [Module.Flat R N]

proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ker_eq_bot_of_injective ?_
  classical simp_rw [mulLeftMap_eq_mulMap_comp, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    ← Function.comp_assoc, EquivLike.injective_comp]
  rw [LinearIndependent] at hm
  exact H.injective.comp (Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := N) _ hm)

name: linearIndependent_mul_of_flat_left
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_mul_of_flat_left (H : M.LinearDisjoint N) [Module.Flat R M]
    {κ ι : Type*} {m : κ → M} {n : ι → N} (hm : LinearIndependent R m)
    (hn : LinearIndependent R n) : LinearIndependent R fun (i : κ × ι) ↦ (m i.1).1 * (n i.2).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearIndependent] at hm hn ⊢
  let i0 := (finsuppTensorFinsupp' R κ ι).symm
  let i1 := LinearMap.rTensor (ι →₀ R) (Finsupp.linearCombination R m)
  let i2 := LinearMap.lTensor M (Finsupp.linearCombination R n)
  let i := mulMap M N ∘ₗ i2 ∘ₗ i1 ∘ₗ i0.toLinearMap
  have h1 : Function.Injective i1 := Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ hm
  have h2 : Function.Injective i2 := Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ hn
  have h : Function.Injective i := H.injective.comp h2 |>.comp h1 |>.comp i0.injective
  have : i = Finsupp.linearCombination R fun i ↦ (m i.1).1 * (n i.2).1 := by
    ext x
    simp [i, i0, i1, i2, finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_eq_single_one_tmul]
  rwa [this] at h

name: linearIndependent_mul_of_flat_right
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_mul_of_flat_right (H : M.LinearDisjoint N) [Module.Flat R N]
    {κ ι : Type*} {m : κ → M} {n : ι → N} (hm : LinearIndependent R m)
    (hn : LinearIndependent R n) : LinearIndependent R fun (i : κ × ι) ↦ (m i.1).1 * (n i.2).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearIndependent] at hm hn ⊢
  let i0 := (finsuppTensorFinsupp' R κ ι).symm
  let i1 := LinearMap.lTensor (κ →₀ R) (Finsupp.linearCombination R n)
  let i2 := LinearMap.rTensor N (Finsupp.linearCombination R m)
  let i := mulMap M N ∘ₗ i2 ∘ₗ i1 ∘ₗ i0.toLinearMap
  have h1 : Function.Injective i1 := Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ hn
  have h2 : Function.Injective i2 := Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ hm
  have h : Function.Injective i := H.injective.comp h2 |>.comp h1 |>.comp i0.injective
  have : i = Finsupp.linearCombination R fun i ↦ (m i.1).1 * (n i.2).1 := by
    ext x
    simp [i, i0, i1, i2, finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_eq_single_one_tmul]
  rwa [this] at h

statement:
theorem linearIndependent_mul_of_flat (H : M.LinearDisjoint N)
    (hf : Module.Flat R M ∨ Module.Flat R N)
    {κ ι : Type*} {m : κ → M} {n : ι → N} (hm : LinearIndependent R m)
    (hn : LinearIndependent R n) : LinearIndependent R fun (i : κ × ι) ↦ (m i.1).1 * (n i.2).1

  · exact H.linearIndependent_mul_of_flat_left hm hn

name: of_le_left_of_flat

theorem of_le_left_of_flat (H : M.LinearDisjoint N) {M' : Submodule R S}

:= by
  let i := mulMap M N ∘ₗ (inclusion h).rTensor N
  have hi : Function.Injective i := H.injective.comp <|

name: not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat_left
statement:
theorem not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat_left [Module.Flat R M]
    (a b : ↥(M ⊓ N)) (hc : Commute a.1 b.1) : ¬LinearIndependent R ![a, b]
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  let n : Fin 2 → N := (inclusion inf_le_right) ∘ ![a, b]
  have hn : LinearIndependent R n := h.map' _ (ker_inclusion _ _ _)
  
  let : AddCommGroup (Fin 2 →₀ M) := Finsupp.instAddCommGroup
  let m : Fin 2 →₀ M := .single 0 ⟨b.1, b.2.1⟩ - .single 1 ⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩
  have hm : mulRightMap M n m = 0 := by simp [m, n, show _ * _ = _ * _ from hc]
  rw [← LinearMap.mem_ker, H.linearIndependent_right_of_flat hn, mem_bot] at hm
  simp only [Fin.isValue, sub_eq_zero, Finsupp.single_eq_single_iff, zero_ne_one, Subtype.mk.injEq,
    SetLike.coe_eq_coe, false_and, false_or, m] at hm
  repeat rw [AddSubmonoid.mk_eq_zero, ZeroMemClass.coe_eq_zero] at hm
  exact h.ne_zero 0 hm.2

name: not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat_right
statement:
theorem not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat_right [Module.Flat R N]
    (a b : ↥(M ⊓ N)) (hc : Commute a.1 b.1) : ¬LinearIndependent R ![a, b]
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  let m : Fin 2 → M := (inclusion inf_le_left) ∘ ![a, b]
  have hm : LinearIndependent R m := h.map' _ (ker_inclusion _ _ _)
  
  let : AddCommGroup (Fin 2 →₀ N) := Finsupp.instAddCommGroup
  let n : Fin 2 →₀ N := .single 0 ⟨b.1, b.2.2⟩ - .single 1 ⟨a.1, a.2.2⟩
  have hn : mulLeftMap N m n = 0 := by simp [m, n, show _ * _ = _ * _ from hc]
  rw [← LinearMap.mem_ker, H.linearIndependent_left_of_flat hm, mem_bot] at hn
  simp only [Fin.isValue, sub_eq_zero, Finsupp.single_eq_single_iff, zero_ne_one, Subtype.mk.injEq,
    SetLike.coe_eq_coe, false_and, false_or, n] at hn
  repeat rw [AddSubmonoid.mk_eq_zero, ZeroMemClass.coe_eq_zero] at hn
  exact h.ne_zero 0 hn.2

name: not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat
statement:
theorem not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat (hf : Module.Flat R M ∨ Module.Flat R N)
    (a b : ↥(M ⊓ N)) (hc : Commute a.1 b.1) : ¬LinearIndependent R ![a, b]
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with _ | _
  · exact H.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat_left a b hc
  · exact H.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat_right a b hc

name: rank_inf_le_one_of_commute_of_flat
statement:
theorem rank_inf_le_one_of_commute_of_flat (hf : Module.Flat R M ∨ Module.Flat R N)
    (hc : ∀ (m n : ↥(M ⊓ N)), Commute m.1 n.1) : Module.rank R ↥(M ⊓ N) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  refine _root_.rank_le fun s h ↦ ?_
  by_contra hs
  rw [not_le, ← Fintype.card_coe, Fintype.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial] at hs
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hs.exists_pair_ne
  refine H.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat hf a.1 b.1 (hc a.1 b.1) ?_
  have := h.comp ![a, b] fun i j hij ↦ by
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · rfl
    · simp [hab] at hij
    · simp [hab.symm] at hij
    · rfl
  convert! this
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp

name: rank_inf_le_one_of_commute_of_flat_left
statement:

name: subsingleton_of_finrank_eq_one
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_finrank_eq_one [Module.Free R V] (d1 : Module.finrank R V = 1) :
    Subsingleton (SpecialLinearGroup R V) where
  allEq u v
proof:
:= by
    nontriviality R
    ext x
    by_cases hx : x = 0
    · simp [hx]
    suffices ∀ (u : SpecialLinearGroup R V), (u : V →ₗ[R] V) = LinearMap.id by
      simp only [LinearMap.ext_iff, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq] at this
      simp [this u, this v]
    intro u
    ext x
    set c := (LinearEquiv.smul_id_of_finrank_eq_one d1).symm u with hc
    rw [LinearEquiv.eq_symm_apply] at hc
    suffices c = 1 by
      simp [← hc, LinearEquiv.smul_id_of_finrank_eq_one, this]
    have hu := u.prop
    simpa [← Units.val_inj, LinearEquiv.coe_det, ← hc,
      LinearEquiv.smul_id_of_finrank_eq_one, d1] using hu

name: center_eq_bot_of_finrank_le_one
statement:
theorem center_eq_bot_of_finrank_le_one (h : Module.finrank R V ≤ 1) :
    Subgroup.center (SpecialLinearGroup R V) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R V
  have : Subsingleton (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R V) := by
    rwa [← Finite.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton,
      Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b]
  have : Subsingleton (Subgroup.center
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R V) R)) := by
    infer_instance
  rw [Equiv.subsingleton_congr
    (Subgroup.centerCongr (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin_equiv b)).toEquiv] at this
  exact Subgroup.eq_bot_of_subsingleton _

name: mem_center_iff
statement:
theorem mem_center_iff {g : SpecialLinearGroup R V} :
    g ∈ Subgroup.center (SpecialLinearGroup R V) ↔
      ∃ (r : R), r ^ (Module.finrank R V) = 1 ∧
        (g : V →ₗ[R] V) = r • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with hR | hR
  · have : Subsingleton (SpecialLinearGroup R V) := inferInstance
    simp [Subsingleton.eq_one g]
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R V
  let := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex.fintype R V
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b]
  let e := (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin_equiv b).symm
  rw [← show e g ∈ Subgroup.center _ ↔ g ∈ Subgroup.center _ from
    MulEquivClass.apply_mem_center_iff e]
  rw [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mem_center_iff]
  apply exists_congr
  simp only [Matrix.scalar_apply, and_congr_right_iff, e]
  intro r hr
  suffices ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin_equiv b).symm g) =
    Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (b.repr (g (b j))) i by
    simp only [this]
    rw [← (LinearMap.toMatrix b b).injective.eq_iff]
    simp only [← Matrix.ext_iff, Matrix.of_apply]
    apply forall₂_congr
    intro i j
    simp [Matrix.diagonal, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
      Finsupp.single, Pi.single_apply, Iff.symm eq_comm]
  ext
  simp [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin_equiv.symm_toLinearMap_eq, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]

name: mem_center_iff_spec
proof:
:= by
  let H := (mem_center_iff.mp hg).choose_spec.2
  rw [LinearMap.ext_iff] at H
  simp [H]

name: centerEquivRootsOfUnity_apply
statement:
theorem centerEquivRootsOfUnity_apply
    (g : Subgroup.center (SpecialLinearGroup R V)) :
    (g : V →ₗ[R] V) = (centerEquivRootsOfUnity g) • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  simp only [centerEquivRootsOfUnity, Or.by_cases, MulEquiv.coe_mk, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
    dite_smul, one_smul, Subgroup.mk_smul, Units.smul_isUnit, dite_eq_ite]
  split_ifs with hR hV
  · have : Subsingleton V := Module.subsingleton R V
    apply Subsingleton.eq_one
  · apply Subsingleton.eq_one
  · rw [not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial] at hV
    rw [← (mem_center_iff.mp g.prop).choose_spec.2]

statement:

name: centerEquivRootsOfUnity_apply_of_finrank_le_one
statement:
