name: centerEquivRootsOfUnity_symm_apply
statement:
theorem centerEquivRootsOfUnity_symm_apply
    (r : rootsOfUnity (max (Module.finrank R V) 1) R) :
    (centerEquivRootsOfUnity.symm r : V →ₗ[R] V) = r • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  simp only [centerEquivRootsOfUnity, MulEquiv.symm_mk, MulEquiv.coe_mk, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk,
    centerEquivRootsOfUnity_invFun, LinearMap.coe_equivOfIsUnitDet]
  congr

name: centerCongr_toLin_equiv_trans_centerEquivRootsOfUnity_eq
statement:
theorem centerCongr_toLin_equiv_trans_centerEquivRootsOfUnity_eq (g) :
    ((centerCongr (toLin_equiv b)).trans centerEquivRootsOfUnity g).val =
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.center_equiv_rootsOfUnity g
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  by_cases hV : Subsingleton V
  · convert! Eq.refl (1 : Rˣ) <;>
    · apply rootsOfUnity.eq_one
      rw [← Module.finrank_eq_zero_iff_of_free (R := R)] at hV
      simp only [hV, sup_eq_right, zero_le_one, ← Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b]
  · have hι : ¬ IsEmpty ι := fun hι ↦ hV (by
      rw [← Module.finrank_eq_zero_iff_of_free (R := R),
        Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b, Fintype.card_of_isEmpty])
    rw [not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial] at hV
    have := Module.Free.instFaithfulSMulOfNontrivial R V
    suffices (((((Subgroup.centerCongr (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin_equiv b)).trans
      centerEquivRootsOfUnity g).val : R) • LinearMap.id) : V →ₗ[R] V) =
        ((Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.center_equiv_rootsOfUnity g).val : R) • LinearMap.id by
      rw [← Units.val_inj]
      apply FaithfulSMul.eq_of_smul_eq_smul (α := V)
      intro x
      simp only [MulEquiv.trans_apply, LinearMap.ext_iff, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_coe,
        id_eq] at this
      rw [MulEquiv.trans_apply, this]
    simp only [MulEquiv.trans_apply]
    have hgg' := Subgroup.centerCongr_apply_coe (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin_equiv b) g
    rw [← Subtype.coe_inj, ← LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_inj, LinearMap.ext_iff] at hgg'
    set g' := ((Subgroup.centerCongr (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin_equiv b)) g)
    ext x
    have := centerEquivRootsOfUnity_apply_apply g' x
    simp only [Subgroup.smul_def, Units.smul_def] at this
    simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq]
    rw [this, ← LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap, hgg',
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin_equiv.toLinearMap_eq,
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.eq_scalar_center_equiv_rootsOfUnity g,
      Matrix.toLin_scalar]
    simp

name: kronecker_mem_unitary
statement:
theorem kronecker_mem_unitary {R m : Type*} [Semiring R] [StarRing R] [Fintype m]
    [DecidableEq m] {U₁ : Matrix n n R} {U₂ : Matrix m m R}
    (hU₁ : U₁ ∈ unitary (Matrix n n R)) (hU₂ : U₂ ∈ unitary (Matrix m m R)) :
    U₁ ⊗ₖ U₂ ∈ unitary (Matrix (n × m) (n × m) R)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Unitary.mem_iff, star_eq_conjTranspose, conjTranspose_kronecker']
  constructor <;> ext <;> simp only [mul_apply, submatrix_apply, kroneckerMap_apply, Prod.fst_swap,
    conjTranspose_apply, ← star_apply, Prod.snd_swap, ← mul_assoc]
  · simp_rw [mul_assoc _ (star U₁ _ _), ← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Matrix.mul_apply, hU₁.1, Matrix.one_apply,
      mul_boole, ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_irrel, ← Matrix.mul_apply, hU₂.1,
      Matrix.one_apply, Finset.sum_const_zero, ← ite_and, Prod.eq_iff_fst_eq_snd_eq]
  · simp_rw [mul_assoc _ _ (star U₂ _ _), ← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product,
      ← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Matrix.mul_apply, hU₂.2, Matrix.one_apply, mul_boole,
      ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_irrel, ← Matrix.mul_apply, hU₁.2, Matrix.one_apply,
      Finset.sum_const_zero, ← ite_and, and_comm, Prod.eq_iff_fst_eq_snd_eq]

    A ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup n R ↔ Aᵀ * A = 1

name: mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff
statement:
theorem mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff :
    A ∈ specialOrthogonalGroup n R ↔ A ∈ orthogonalGroup n R ∧ A.det = 1

name: of_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_fin_two_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma of_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_fin_two_iff {a b c d : R} :
    !![a, b; c, d] ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin 2) R ↔
      a = d ∧ b = -c ∧ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  trans ((a * a + b * b = 1 ∧ a * c + b * d = 0) ∧
    c * a + d * b = 0 ∧ c * c + d * d = 1) ∧ a * d - b * c = 1
  · simp [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff, Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff,
      ← Matrix.ext_iff, Fin.forall_fin_succ, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail]
  grind

name: mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_fin_two_iff
statement:
lemma mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_fin_two_iff {M : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) R} :
    M ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin 2) R ↔
      M 0 0 = M 1 1 ∧ M 0 1 = - M 1 0 ∧ M 0 0 ^ 2 + M 0 1 ^ 2 = 1

name: coe_toFun_eq_coe

@[simp]
theorem coe_toFun_eq_coe (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) : (f.toFun : f.domain → F) = f

name: toFun_eq_coe

@[simp]
theorem toFun_eq_coe (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x : f.domain) : f.toFun x = f x

name: ext
statement:
@[ext (iff := false)]
theorem ext {f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} (h : f.domain = g.domain)
    (h' : ∀ ⦃x : E⦄ ⦃hf : x ∈ f.domain⦄ ⦃hg : x ∈ g.domain⦄, f ⟨x, hf⟩ = g ⟨x, hg⟩) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  rcases f with ⟨f_dom, f⟩
  rcases g with ⟨g_dom, g⟩
  obtain rfl : f_dom = g_dom := h
  congr
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply h'

name: dExt
statement:
theorem dExt {f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} (h : f.domain = g.domain)
    (h' : ∀ ⦃x : f.domain⦄ ⦃y : g.domain⦄ (_h : (x : E) = y), f x = g y) : f = g

name: map_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_zero (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) : f 0 = 0

name: ext_iff
statement:
theorem ext_iff {f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} :
    f = g ↔
      f.domain = g.domain ∧
        ∀ ⦃x : E⦄ ⦃hf : x ∈ f.domain⦄ ⦃hg : x ∈ g.domain⦄, f ⟨x, hf⟩ = g ⟨x, hg⟩
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl; simp, fun ⟨deq, feq⟩ ↦ ext deq feq⟩

name: dExt_iff
statement:
theorem dExt_iff {f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} :
    f = g ↔
      ∃ _domain_eq : f.domain = g.domain,
        ∀ ⦃x : f.domain⦄ ⦃y : g.domain⦄ (_h : (x : E) = y), f x = g y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun EQ =>
    EQ ▸
      ⟨rfl, fun x y h => by
        congr
        exact mod_cast h⟩,
    fun ⟨deq, feq⟩ => dExt deq feq⟩

name: ext'
statement: theorem ext' {s : Submodule R E} {f g : s →ₛₗ[σ] F} (h : f = g) : mk s f = mk s g

name: map_add
statement: theorem map_add (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x y : f.domain) : f (x + y) = f x + f y

name: map_neg
statement: theorem map_neg (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x : f.domain) : f (-x) = -f x

name: map_sub
statement: theorem map_sub (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x y : f.domain) : f (x - y) = f x - f y

name: map_smul
statement: theorem map_smul [Module R F] (f : E →ₗ.[R] F) (c : R) (x : f.domain) : f (c • x) = c • f x

name: map_smul
statement: theorem map_smulₛₗ (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (c : R) (x : f.domain) : f (c • x) = σ c • f x

name: mk_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_apply (p : Submodule R E) (f : p →ₛₗ[σ] F) (x : p) : mk p f x = f x

name: ker_eq_bot'
statement: theorem ker_eq_bot' : f.ker = ⊥ ↔ ∀ x, f x = 0 → x = 0

name: ker_eq_bot
statement: theorem ker_eq_bot : f.ker = ⊥ ↔ Function.Injective f

name: mem_ker_iff
statement: theorem mem_ker_iff {x : E} : x ∈ f.ker ↔ ∃ (y : f.domain), x = y ∧ f y = 0

name: coe_mem_ker_iff
statement: theorem coe_mem_ker_iff {x : f.domain} : ↑x ∈ f.ker ↔ f x = 0

statement: theorem ker_le_domain : f.ker ≤ f.domain

name: domain_mkSpanSingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem domain_mkSpanSingleton (x : E) (y : F) (H : ∀ c : R, c • x = 0 → σ c • y = 0) :
    (mkSpanSingleton' x y H).domain = R ∙ x

name: mkSpanSingleton'_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkSpanSingleton'_apply (x : E) (y : F) (H : ∀ c : R, c • x = 0 → σ c • y = 0) (c : R) (h) :
    mkSpanSingleton' x y H ⟨c • x, h⟩ = σ c • y
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [mkSpanSingleton']
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← sub_smul, ← RingHom.map_sub]
  apply H
  simp only [sub_smul, sub_eq_zero]
  apply Classical.choose_spec (mem_span_singleton.1 h)

name: mkSpanSingleton'_apply_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkSpanSingleton'_apply_self (x : E) (y : F) (H : ∀ c : R, c • x = 0 → σ c • y = 0) (h) :
    mkSpanSingleton' x y H ⟨x, h⟩ = y
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← one_smul S y]
  rw [← RingHom.map_one, ← mkSpanSingleton'_apply x y H 1 ?_]
  · congr
    rw [one_smul]
  · rwa [one_smul]

name: mkSpanSingleton_apply
statement:
theorem mkSpanSingleton_apply (K L : Type*) {E F : Type*} [DivisionRing K] [DivisionRing L]
    {σ : K →+* L} [AddCommGroup E] [Module K E] [AddCommGroup F] [Module L F] {x : E} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (y : F) :
    (mkSpanSingleton x y hx : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F)
      ⟨x, (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self x : x ∈ Submodule.span K {x})⟩ = y

name: fst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fst_apply [Module R F] (p : Submodule R E) (p' : Submodule R F) (x : p.prod p') :
    LinearPMap.fst p p' x = (x : E × F).1

name: snd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snd_apply [Module R F] (p : Submodule R E) (p' : Submodule R F) (x : p.prod p') :
    LinearPMap.snd p p' x = (x : E × F).2

name: apply_comp_inclusion
statement:
theorem apply_comp_inclusion {T S : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} (h : T ≤ S) (x : T.domain) :
    T x = S (Submodule.inclusion h.1 x)

name: exists_of_le
statement:
theorem exists_of_le {T S : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} (h : T ≤ S) (x : T.domain) :
    ∃ y : S.domain, (x : E) = y ∧ T x = S y

name: eq_of_le_of_domain_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_le_of_domain_eq {f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} (hle : f ≤ g) (heq : f.domain = g.domain) :
    f = g

name: le_of_eqLocus_ge
statement: theorem le_of_eqLocus_ge {f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} (H : f.domain ≤ f.eqLocus g) : f ≤ g
proof:
:=
  suffices f ≤ f ⊓ g from le_trans this inf_le_right
  ⟨H, fun _x _y hxy => ((inf_le_left : f ⊓ g ≤ f).2 hxy.symm).symm⟩

name: domain_mono
statement: theorem domain_mono : StrictMono (domain (σ := σ) (E := E) (F := F))
proof:
:=
  fun _f _g hlt =>
    lt_of_le_of_ne hlt.1.1 fun heq => ne_of_lt hlt <| eq_of_le_of_domain_eq (le_of_lt hlt) heq

name: sup_aux
statement:
private theorem sup_aux (f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F)
    (h : ∀ (x : f.domain) (y : g.domain), (x : E) = y → f x = g y) :
    ∃ fg : ↥(f.domain ⊔ g.domain) →ₛₗ[σ] F,
      ∀ (x : f.domain) (y : g.domain) (z : ↥(f.domain ⊔ g.domain)),
        (x : E) + y = ↑z → fg z = f x + g y
proof:
:= by
  choose x hx y hy hxy using fun z : ↥(f.domain ⊔ g.domain) => mem_sup.1 z.prop
  set fg := fun z => f ⟨x z, hx z⟩ + g ⟨y z, hy z⟩
  have fg_eq : ∀ (x' : f.domain) (y' : g.domain) (z' : ↥(f.domain ⊔ g.domain))
      (_H : (x' : E) + y' = z'), fg z' = f x' + g y' := by
    intro x' y' z' H
    dsimp [fg]
    rw [add_comm, ← sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add, eq_comm, ← map_sub, ← map_sub]
    apply h
    simp only [← eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at hxy
    simp only [AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub, hxy, ← sub_add, ← sub_sub, sub_self,
      zero_sub, ← H]
    apply neg_add_eq_sub
  use { toFun := fg, map_add' := ?_, map_smul' := ?_ }, fg_eq
  · rintro ⟨z₁, hz₁⟩ ⟨z₂, hz₂⟩
    rw [← add_assoc, add_right_comm (f _), ← map_add, add_assoc, ← map_add]
    apply fg_eq
    simp only [coe_add, ← add_assoc]
    rw [add_right_comm (x _), hxy, add_assoc, hxy, coe_mk, coe_mk]
  · intro c z
    rw [smul_add, ← map_smulₛₗ, ← map_smulₛₗ]
    apply fg_eq
    simp only [coe_smul, ← smul_add, hxy]

name: domain_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem domain_sup (f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F)
    (h : ∀ (x : f.domain) (y : g.domain), (x : E) = y → f x = g y) :
    (f.sup g h).domain = f.domain ⊔ g.domain

name: sup_apply
statement:
theorem sup_apply {f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} (H : ∀ (x : f.domain) (y : g.domain), (x : E) = y → f x = g y)
    (x : f.domain) (y : g.domain) (z : ↥(f.domain ⊔ g.domain)) (hz : (↑x : E) + ↑y = ↑z) :
    f.sup g H z = f x + g y
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (sup_aux f g H) x y z hz

name: left_le_sup
statement:
protected theorem left_le_sup (f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F)
    (h : ∀ (x : f.domain) (y : g.domain), (x : E) = y → f x = g y) : f ≤ f.sup g h
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨le_sup_left, fun z₁ z₂ hz => ?_⟩
  rw [← add_zero (f _), ← g.map_zero]
  refine (sup_apply h _ _ _ ?_).symm
  simpa

name: right_le_sup
statement:
protected theorem right_le_sup (f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F)
    (h : ∀ (x : f.domain) (y : g.domain), (x : E) = y → f x = g y) : g ≤ f.sup g h
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨le_sup_right, fun z₁ z₂ hz => ?_⟩
  rw [← zero_add (g _), ← f.map_zero]
  refine (sup_apply h _ _ _ ?_).symm
  simpa

name: sup_le
proof:
:=
  have Hf : f ≤ f.sup g H ⊓ h := le_inf (f.left_le_sup g H) fh
  have Hg : g ≤ f.sup g H ⊓ h := le_inf (f.right_le_sup g H) gh
  le_of_eqLocus_ge <| sup_le Hf.1 Hg.1

name: sup_h_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem sup_h_of_disjoint (f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (h : Disjoint f.domain g.domain) (x : f.domain)
    (y : g.domain) (hxy : (x : E) = y) : f x = g y
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_def] at h
  have hy : y = 0 := Subtype.ext (h y (hxy ▸ x.2) y.2)
  have hx : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (hxy.trans <| congr_arg _ hy)
  simp [*]

name: zero_domain
statement:
@[simp, grind .]
theorem zero_domain : (0 : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F).domain = ⊤

name: zero_apply
statement:
@[simp, grind .]
theorem zero_apply (x : (⊤ : Submodule R E)) : (0 : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) x = 0

name: ker_zero
statement:
@[simp, grind .]
theorem ker_zero : (0 : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F).ker = ⊤

name: ker_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_eq_top {f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} : f.ker = ⊤ ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by grind⟩
  have : f.domain = ⊤ := eq_top_mono ker_le_domain h
  ext x hf _ <;> grind [mem_ker_iff]

name: eqLocus_zero
statement: theorem eqLocus_zero {f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F} : f.eqLocus 0 = f.ker

name: smul_domain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_domain (a : M) (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) : (a • f).domain = f.domain

name: smul_apply
statement: theorem smul_apply (a : M) (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x : (a • f).domain) : (a • f) x = a • f x

name: coe_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_smul (a : M) (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) : ⇑(a • f) = a • ⇑f

name: neg_domain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_domain (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) : (-f).domain = f.domain

name: neg_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem neg_apply (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x) : (-f) x = -f x

name: ker_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_neg (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) : (-f).ker = f.ker

name: add_domain
statement: theorem add_domain (f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) : (f + g).domain = f.domain ⊓ g.domain

name: add_apply
statement:
theorem add_apply (f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x : (f.domain ⊓ g.domain : Submodule R E)) :
    (f + g) x = f ⟨x, x.prop.1⟩ + g ⟨x, x.prop.2⟩

name: vadd_domain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vadd_domain (f : E →ₛₗ[σ] F) (g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) : (f +ᵥ g).domain = g.domain

name: vadd_apply
statement:
theorem vadd_apply (f : E →ₛₗ[σ] F) (g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x : (f +ᵥ g).domain) :
    (f +ᵥ g) x = f x + g x

name: coe_vadd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_vadd (f : E →ₛₗ[σ] F) (g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) : ⇑(f +ᵥ g) = ⇑(f.comp g.domain.subtype) + ⇑g

name: sub_domain
statement: theorem sub_domain (f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) : (f - g).domain = f.domain ⊓ g.domain

name: sub_apply
statement:
theorem sub_apply (f g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x : (f.domain ⊓ g.domain : Submodule R E)) :
    (f - g) x = f ⟨x, x.prop.1⟩ - g ⟨x, x.prop.2⟩

name: domain_supSpanSingleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem domain_supSpanSingleton (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x : E) (y : F) (hx : x ∉ f.domain) :
    (f.supSpanSingleton x y hx).domain = f.domain ⊔ K ∙ x

name: supSpanSingleton_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supSpanSingleton_apply_mk (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) (x : E) (y : F) (hx : x ∉ f.domain) (x' : E)
    (hx' : x' ∈ f.domain) (c : K) :
    f.supSpanSingleton x y hx
        ⟨x' + c • x, mem_sup.2 ⟨x', hx', _, mem_span_singleton.2 ⟨c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩⟩ =
      f ⟨x', hx'⟩ + σ c • y
proof:
:= by
  unfold supSpanSingleton
  rw [sup_apply _ ⟨x', hx'⟩ ⟨c • x, _⟩, mkSpanSingleton'_apply]
  · rfl
  · exact mem_span_singleton.2 ⟨c, rfl⟩

name: supSpanSingleton_apply_smul_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supSpanSingleton_apply_smul_self (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) {x : E} (y : F) (hx : x ∉ f.domain)
    (c : K) :
    f.supSpanSingleton x y hx ⟨c • x, mem_sup_right <| mem_span_singleton.2 ⟨c, rfl⟩⟩ =
      σ c • y
proof:
:= by
  simpa [(mk_eq_zero _ _).mpr rfl] using supSpanSingleton_apply_mk f x y hx 0 (zero_mem _) c

name: supSpanSingleton_apply_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supSpanSingleton_apply_self (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) {x : E} (y : F) (hx : x ∉ f.domain) :
    f.supSpanSingleton x y hx ⟨x, mem_sup_right <| mem_span_singleton_self _⟩ = y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using supSpanSingleton_apply_smul_self f y hx 1

name: supSpanSingleton_apply_of_mem
statement:
theorem supSpanSingleton_apply_of_mem (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) {x : E} (y : F) (hx : x ∉ f.domain)
    (x' : (f.supSpanSingleton x y hx).domain) (hx' : (x' : E) ∈ f.domain) :
    f.supSpanSingleton x y hx x' = f ⟨x', hx'⟩
proof:
:= by
  simpa using supSpanSingleton_apply_mk f x y hx x' hx' 0

name: supSpanSingleton_apply_mk_of_mem
statement:
theorem supSpanSingleton_apply_mk_of_mem (f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) {x : E} (y : F) (hx : x ∉ f.domain)
    {x' : E} (hx' : (x' : E) ∈ f.domain) :
    f.supSpanSingleton x y hx ⟨x', mem_sup_left hx'⟩ = f ⟨x', hx'⟩

name: sSup_aux
statement:
private theorem sSup_aux (c : Set (E →ₛₗ.[σ] F)) (hc : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) c) :
    ∃ f : ↥(sSup (domain '' c)) →ₛₗ[σ] F, (⟨_, f⟩ : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F) ∈ upperBounds c
proof:
:= by
  rcases c.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | cne
  · simp
  have hdir : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) (domain '' c) :=
    directedOn_image.2 (hc.mono @(domain_mono.monotone))
  have P : ∀ x : ↥(sSup (domain '' c)), { p : c // (x : E) ∈ p.val.domain } := by
    rintro x
    apply Classical.indefiniteDescription
    have := (mem_sSup_of_directed (cne.image _) hdir).1 x.2
    rwa [Set.exists_mem_image, ← bex_def, SetCoe.exists'] at this
  set f : ↥(sSup (domain '' c)) → F := fun x => (P x).val.val ⟨x, (P x).property⟩
  have f_eq : ∀ (p : c) (x : ↥(sSup (domain '' c))) (y : p.1.1) (_hxy : (x : E) = y),
      f x = p.1 y := by
    intro p x y hxy
    rcases hc (P x).1.1 (P x).1.2 p.1 p.2 with ⟨q, _hqc, ⟨hxq1, hxq2⟩, ⟨hpq1, hpq2⟩⟩
    exact (hxq2 (y := ⟨y, hpq1 y.2⟩) hxy).trans (hpq2 rfl).symm
  use { toFun := f, map_add' := ?_, map_smul' := ?_ }, ?_
  · intro x y
    rcases hc (P x).1.1 (P x).1.2 (P y).1.1 (P y).1.2 with ⟨p, hpc, hpx, hpy⟩
    set x' := inclusion hpx.1 ⟨x, (P x).2⟩
    set y' := inclusion hpy.1 ⟨y, (P y).2⟩
    rw [f_eq ⟨p, hpc⟩ x x' rfl, f_eq ⟨p, hpc⟩ y y' rfl, f_eq ⟨p, hpc⟩ (x + y) (x' + y') rfl,
      map_add]
  · intro c x
    rw [f_eq (P x).1 (c • x) (c • ⟨x, (P x).2⟩) rfl, ← map_smulₛₗ]
  · intro p hpc
    refine ⟨le_sSup <| Set.mem_image_of_mem domain hpc, fun x y hxy => Eq.symm ?_⟩
    exact f_eq ⟨p, hpc⟩ _ _ hxy.symm

name: domain_sSup
statement:
theorem domain_sSup {c : Set (E →ₛₗ.[σ] F)} (hc : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) c) :
    (LinearPMap.sSup c hc).domain = sSup (LinearPMap.domain '' c)

name: mem_domain_sSup_iff
statement:
theorem mem_domain_sSup_iff {c : Set (E →ₛₗ.[σ] F)} (hnonempty : c.Nonempty)
    (hc : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) c) {x : E} :
    x ∈ (LinearPMap.sSup c hc).domain ↔ ∃ f ∈ c, x ∈ f.domain
proof:
:= by
  rw [domain_sSup, Submodule.mem_sSup_of_directed (hnonempty.image _)
    (DirectedOn.mono_comp LinearPMap.domain_mono.monotone hc)]
  simp

name: le_sSup
statement:
protected theorem le_sSup {c : Set (E →ₛₗ.[σ] F)} (hc : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) c) {f : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F}
    (hf : f ∈ c) : f ≤ LinearPMap.sSup c hc

name: sSup_le
statement:
protected theorem sSup_le {c : Set (E →ₛₗ.[σ] F)} (hc : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) c) {g : E →ₛₗ.[σ] F}
    (hg : ∀ f ∈ c, f ≤ g) : LinearPMap.sSup c hc ≤ g
proof:
:=
  le_of_eqLocus_ge <|
    sSup_le fun _ ⟨f, hf, Eq⟩ =>
      Eq ▸
        have : f ≤ LinearPMap.sSup c hc ⊓ g := le_inf (LinearPMap.le_sSup _ hf) (hg f hf)
        this.1

name: sSup_apply
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply (Classical.choose_spec (sSup_aux c hc) hl).2
  rfl

theorem mem_graph_iff [Module R F] (f : E →ₗ.[R] F) {x : E × F} :

name: graph_map_fst_eq_domain
statement:
theorem graph_map_fst_eq_domain [Module R F] (f : E →ₗ.[R] F) :
    f.graph.map (LinearMap.fst R E F) = f.domain
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Submodule.mem_map, mem_graph_iff, Subtype.exists, exists_and_left, exists_eq_left,
    LinearMap.fst_apply, Prod.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rcases h with ⟨x, hx, _⟩
    exact hx
  · use f ⟨x, h⟩
    simp only [h, exists_const]

name: smul_graph
statement:
theorem smul_graph (f : E →ₗ.[R] F) (z : M) :
    (z • f).graph =
      f.graph.map ((LinearMap.id : E →ₗ[R] E).prodMap (z • (LinearMap.id : F →ₗ[R] F)))
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x_fst, x_snd⟩
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rw [mem_graph_iff] at h
    rcases h with ⟨y, hy, h⟩
    rw [LinearPMap.smul_apply] at h
    rw [Submodule.mem_map]
    simp only [mem_graph_iff, LinearMap.prodMap_apply, LinearMap.id_coe, id,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, Prod.mk_inj, Prod.exists, exists_exists_and_eq_and]
    use x_fst, y, hy
  rw [Submodule.mem_map] at h
  rcases h with ⟨x', hx', h⟩
  cases x'
  simp only [LinearMap.prodMap_apply, LinearMap.id_coe, id, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    Prod.mk_inj] at h
  rw [mem_graph_iff] at hx' ⊢
  rcases hx' with ⟨y, hy, hx'⟩
  use y
  rw [← h.1, ← h.2]
  simp [hy, hx']

name: neg_graph
statement:
theorem neg_graph (f : E →ₗ.[R] F) :
    (-f).graph =
    f.graph.map ((LinearMap.id : E →ₗ[R] E).prodMap (-(LinearMap.id : F →ₗ[R] F)))
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x_fst, x_snd⟩
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rw [mem_graph_iff] at h
    rcases h with ⟨y, hy, h⟩
    rw [LinearPMap.neg_apply] at h
    rw [Submodule.mem_map]
    simp only [mem_graph_iff, LinearMap.prodMap_apply, LinearMap.id_coe, id,
      LinearMap.neg_apply, Prod.mk_inj, Prod.exists, exists_exists_and_eq_and]
    use x_fst, y, hy
  rw [Submodule.mem_map] at h
  rcases h with ⟨x', hx', h⟩
  cases x'
  simp only [LinearMap.prodMap_apply, LinearMap.id_coe, id, LinearMap.neg_apply,
    Prod.mk_inj] at h
  rw [mem_graph_iff] at hx' ⊢
  rcases hx' with ⟨y, hy, hx'⟩
  use y
  rw [← h.1, ← h.2]
  simp [hy, hx']

name: le_of_le_graph
statement: theorem le_of_le_graph {f g : E →ₗ.[R] F} (h : f.graph ≤ g.graph) : f ≤ g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    rw [mem_domain_iff] at hx ⊢
    obtain ⟨y, hx⟩ := hx
    use y
    exact h hx
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ hxy
  rw [image_iff]
  refine h ?_
  simp only at hxy
  rw [hxy] at hx
  rw [← image_iff hx]
  simp [hxy]

name: le_graph_of_le
statement: theorem le_graph_of_le {f g : E →ₗ.[R] F} (h : f ≤ g) : f.graph ≤ g.graph
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_graph_iff] at hx ⊢
  obtain ⟨y, hx⟩ := hx
  use ⟨y, h.1 y.2⟩
  simp only [hx, true_and]
  convert! hx.2 using 1
  refine (h.2 ?_).symm
  simp only [hx.1]

name: le_graph_iff
statement: theorem le_graph_iff {f g : E →ₗ.[R] F} : f.graph ≤ g.graph ↔ f ≤ g

name: eq_of_eq_graph

proof:
:= by
  apply dExt
  · ext
    exact mem_domain_iff_of_eq_graph h
  · apply (le_of_le_graph h.le).2

name: existsUnique_from_graph
proof:
:= by
  refine existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique ?_ ?_
  · convert! ha
    simp
  intro y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂
  have hy : ((0 : E), y₁ - y₂) ∈ g := by
    convert! g.sub_mem hy₁ hy₂
    exact (sub_self _).symm
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hg hy (by simp))

name: valFromGraph_mem
toLinearPMap_domain
statement:
theorem toLinearPMap_domain (g : Submodule R (E × F)) :

name: toLinearPMap_apply_aux
statement:
theorem toLinearPMap_apply_aux {g : Submodule R (E × F)}
    (hg : ∀ (x : E × F) (_hx : x ∈ g) (_hx' : x.fst = 0), x.snd = 0)
    (x : g.map (LinearMap.fst R E F)) :
    g.toLinearPMap x = valFromGraph hg x.2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (if hg : _ then g.toLinearPMapAux hg else 0) x = _
  rw [dite_eq_left]
  · rfl
  · exact hg

name: mem_graph_toLinearPMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [toLinearPMap_apply_aux hg]
  exact valFromGraph_mem hg x.2

name: toLinearPMap_graph_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toLinearPMap_graph_eq (g : Submodule R (E × F))
    (hg : ∀ (x : E × F) (_hx : x ∈ g) (_hx' : x.fst = 0), x.snd = 0) :
    g.toLinearPMap.graph = g
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x_fst, x_snd⟩
  constructor <;> intro hx
  · rw [LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨y, hx1, hx2⟩
    convert! g.mem_graph_toLinearPMap hg y using 1
    exact Prod.ext hx1.symm hx2.symm
  rw [LinearPMap.mem_graph_iff]
  have hx_fst : x_fst ∈ g.map (LinearMap.fst R E F) := by
    simp only [mem_map, LinearMap.fst_apply, Prod.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right]
    exact ⟨x_snd, hx⟩
  refine ⟨⟨x_fst, hx_fst⟩, Subtype.coe_mk x_fst hx_fst, ?_⟩
  rw [toLinearPMap_apply_aux hg]
  exact (existsUnique_from_graph @hg hx_fst).unique (valFromGraph_mem hg hx_fst) hx

proof:
:= by

:= by
  ext x
  simp only [comp_apply, mem_ker, subtype_apply, sub_apply, id_apply, sub_eq_zero]

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
    rintro x ⟨hpx, hfx⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_ker, hf ⟨x, hpx⟩, mk_eq_zero] at hfx
    simp only [hfx, zero_mem]
  · rw [codisjoint_iff_le_sup]
    intro x _
    rw [mem_sup']
    refine ⟨f x, ⟨x - f x, ?_⟩, add_sub_cancel _ _⟩
    rw [mem_ker, map_sub, hf, sub_self]

:= by
