name: prodEquivOfIsCompl_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodEquivOfIsCompl_symm_apply (hpq : IsCompl p q) (x : E) :
    (p.prodEquivOfIsCompl q hpq).symm x =
      (p.projectionOnto q hpq x, q.projectionOnto p hpq.symm x)
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext rfl congr(($(prodComm_trans_prodEquivOfIsCompl p q hpq).symm x).1)

name: toLinearMap_prodEquivOfIsCompl_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toLinearMap_prodEquivOfIsCompl_symm (hpq : IsCompl p q) :
    (p.prodEquivOfIsCompl q hpq).symm.toLinearMap =
      (p.projectionOnto q hpq).prod (q.projectionOnto p hpq.symm)

name: sub_projection_mem
statement: theorem sub_projection_mem (h : IsCompl p q) (x : E) : x - p.projection q h x ∈ q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← projection_eq_self_sub_projection h]
  exact projection_apply_mem h.symm x

name: quotientEquivOfIsCompl_comp_mkQ
statement:
theorem quotientEquivOfIsCompl_comp_mkQ (h : IsCompl p q) :
    (quotientEquivOfIsCompl p q h : E ⧸ p →ₗ[R] q) ∘ₗ p.mkQ = q.projectionOnto p h.symm

name: quotientEquivOfIsCompl_apply_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientEquivOfIsCompl_apply_mk (h : IsCompl p q) (x : E) :
    quotientEquivOfIsCompl p q h (Quotient.mk x) = q.projectionOnto p h.symm x

name: quotientEquivOfIsCompl_apply_mk_right
statement:
theorem quotientEquivOfIsCompl_apply_mk_right (h : IsCompl p q) (x : q) :
    quotientEquivOfIsCompl p q h (Quotient.mk x) = x

name: mk_quotientEquivOfIsCompl_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_quotientEquivOfIsCompl_apply (h : IsCompl p q) (x : E ⧸ p) :
    (Quotient.mk (quotientEquivOfIsCompl p q h x) : E ⧸ p) = x

name: toLinearMap_quotientEquivOfIsCompl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toLinearMap_quotientEquivOfIsCompl (h : IsCompl p q) :
    (p.quotientEquivOfIsCompl q h).toLinearMap = p.liftQ (q.projectionOnto p h.symm) (by simp)

name: toLinearMap_symm_quotientEquivOfIsCompl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toLinearMap_symm_quotientEquivOfIsCompl (h : IsCompl p q) :
    (p.quotientEquivOfIsCompl q h).symm.toLinearMap = p.mkQ ∘ₗ q.subtype

name: linearProjOfIsCompl_apply_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearProjOfIsCompl_apply_left (x : F) : linearProjOfIsCompl q i hi h (i x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ix, rfl⟩ := (LinearEquiv.ofInjective i hi).symm.surjective x
  simp [linearProjOfIsCompl]

name: linearProjOfIsCompl_apply_right'
statement:
lemma linearProjOfIsCompl_apply_right' (x : E) (hx : x ∈ q) :
    linearProjOfIsCompl q i hi h x = 0

name: linearProjOfIsCompl_apply_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma linearProjOfIsCompl_apply_right (x : q) : linearProjOfIsCompl q i hi h x = 0

name: ker_linearProjOfIsCompl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ker_linearProjOfIsCompl : ker (linearProjOfIsCompl q i hi h) = q

name: ofIsCompl_apply_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofIsCompl_apply_left (h : IsCompl p q) {φ : p →ₗ[R] F} {ψ : q →ₗ[R] F} (u : p) :
    ofIsCompl h φ ψ (u : E) = φ u

name: ofIsCompl_apply_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofIsCompl_apply_right (h : IsCompl p q) {φ : p →ₗ[R] F} {ψ : q →ₗ[R] F} (v : q) :
    ofIsCompl h φ ψ (v : E) = ψ v

name: ofIsCompl_eq
statement:
theorem ofIsCompl_eq (h : IsCompl p q) {φ : p →ₗ[R] F} {ψ : q →ₗ[R] F} {χ : E →ₗ[R] F}
    (hφ : ∀ u, φ u = χ u) (hψ : ∀ u, ψ u = χ u) : ofIsCompl h φ ψ = χ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨_, _, rfl, _⟩ := existsUnique_add_of_isCompl h x
  simp [ofIsCompl, hφ, hψ]

name: ofIsCompl_eq'
statement:
theorem ofIsCompl_eq' (h : IsCompl p q) {φ : p →ₗ[R] F} {ψ : q →ₗ[R] F} {χ : E →ₗ[R] F}
    (hφ : φ = χ.comp p.subtype) (hψ : ψ = χ.comp q.subtype) : ofIsCompl h φ ψ = χ
proof:
:=
  ofIsCompl_eq h (fun _ => hφ.symm ▸ rfl) fun _ => hψ.symm ▸ rfl

name: ofIsCompl_eq_add
statement:
theorem ofIsCompl_eq_add (hpq : IsCompl p q) {φ : p →ₗ[R] F} {ψ : q →ₗ[R] F} :
    ofIsCompl hpq φ ψ = (φ ∘ₗ p.projectionOnto q hpq) + (ψ ∘ₗ q.projectionOnto p hpq.symm)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl, _⟩ := existsUnique_add_of_isCompl hpq x
  simp

name: ofIsCompl_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofIsCompl_zero (h : IsCompl p q) : (ofIsCompl h 0 0 : E →ₗ[R] F) = 0

name: ofIsCompl_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofIsCompl_add (h : IsCompl p q) {φ₁ φ₂ : p →ₗ[R] F} {ψ₁ ψ₂ : q →ₗ[R] F} :
    ofIsCompl h (φ₁ + φ₂) (ψ₁ + ψ₂) = ofIsCompl h φ₁ ψ₁ + ofIsCompl h φ₂ ψ₂

name: ofIsCompl_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofIsCompl_smul {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module R E]
    {F : Type*} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] {p q : Submodule R E} (h : IsCompl p q)
    {φ : p →ₗ[R] F} {ψ : q →ₗ[R] F} (c : R) : ofIsCompl h (c • φ) (c • ψ) = c • ofIsCompl h φ ψ

name: surjective_comp_projectionOnto
statement:
theorem surjective_comp_projectionOnto (h : IsCompl p q) [Module R M] :
    Function.Surjective (comp (p.projectionOnto q h) : (M →ₗ[R] E) → _)
proof:
:=
  fun f ↦ ⟨p.subtype ∘ₗ f, by ext; simp⟩

name: surjective_comp_subtype_of_isComplemented
statement:
theorem surjective_comp_subtype_of_isComplemented (h : IsComplemented p) [Module R M] :
    Function.Surjective fun f : E →ₗ[R] M ↦ f ∘ₗ p.subtype
proof:
:=
  have ⟨q, h⟩ := h; fun f ↦ ⟨f ∘ₗ p.projectionOnto q h, by ext; simp⟩

name: range_ofIsCompl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem range_ofIsCompl (hpq : IsCompl p q) {φ : p →ₗ[R] F} {ψ : q →ₗ[R] F} :
    range (ofIsCompl hpq φ ψ) = range φ ⊔ range ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofIsCompl_eq_add]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply range_add_le _ _ |>.trans
    gcongr
    all_goals exact range_comp_le_range ..
  · apply sup_le
    all_goals rintro - ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact ⟨x, by simp⟩

name: ofIsCompl_subtype_zero_eq
statement:
theorem ofIsCompl_subtype_zero_eq (hpq : IsCompl p q) :
    ofIsCompl hpq p.subtype 0 = p.projection q hpq

name: ofIsCompl_symm
statement:
theorem ofIsCompl_symm (hpq : IsCompl p q) {φ : p →ₗ[R] F} {ψ : q →ₗ[R] F} :
    ofIsCompl hpq.symm ψ φ = ofIsCompl hpq φ ψ

name: ofIsComplProd_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofIsComplProd_apply {p q : Submodule R₁ E} (h : IsCompl p q)
    (φ : (p →ₗ[R₁] F) × (q →ₗ[R₁] F)) : ofIsComplProd h φ = ofIsCompl h φ.1 φ.2

name: projectionOnto_of_proj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectionOnto_of_proj (f : E →ₗ[R] p) (hf : ∀ x : p, f x = x) :
    p.projectionOnto (ker f) (isCompl_of_proj hf) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have : x ∈ p ⊔ (ker f) := by simp only [(isCompl_of_proj hf).sup_eq_top, mem_top]
  rcases mem_sup'.1 this with ⟨x, y, rfl⟩
  simp [hf]

name: coe_equivProdOfSurjectiveOfIsCompl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_equivProdOfSurjectiveOfIsCompl {f : E →ₗ[R] F} {g : E →ₗ[R] G} (hf : range f = ⊤)
    (hg : range g = ⊤) (hfg : IsCompl (ker f) (ker g)) :
    (equivProdOfSurjectiveOfIsCompl f g hf hg hfg : E →ₗ[R] F × G) = f.prod g

name: equivProdOfSurjectiveOfIsCompl_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivProdOfSurjectiveOfIsCompl_apply {f : E →ₗ[R] F} {g : E →ₗ[R] G} (hf : range f = ⊤)
    (hg : range g = ⊤) (hfg : IsCompl (ker f) (ker g)) (x : E) :
    equivProdOfSurjectiveOfIsCompl f g hf hg hfg x = (f x, g x)

name: coe_isComplEquivProj_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_isComplEquivProj_apply (q : { q // IsCompl p q }) :
    (p.isComplEquivProj q : E →ₗ[R] p) = projectionOnto p q q.2

name: coe_isComplEquivProj_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_isComplEquivProj_symm_apply (f : { f : E →ₗ[R] p // ∀ x : p, f x = x }) :
    (p.isComplEquivProj.symm f : Submodule R E) = ker (f : E →ₗ[R] p)

name: isProj_range_iff_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem isProj_range_iff_isIdempotentElem (f : M →ₗ[S] M) :
    IsProj (range f) f ↔ IsIdempotentElem f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ?_, fun hf =>
    ⟨fun x => mem_range_self f x, fun x ⟨y, hy⟩ => by rw [← hy, ← Module.End.mul_apply, hf.eq]⟩⟩
  ext x
  exact h2 (f x) (h1 x)

name: isProj_iff_isIdempotentElem
statement:
theorem isProj_iff_isIdempotentElem (f : M →ₗ[S] M) :
    (∃ p : Submodule S M, IsProj p f) ↔ IsIdempotentElem f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨p, hp⟩ => ?_, fun h => ⟨_, IsIdempotentElem.isProj_range _ h⟩⟩
  ext x
  exact hp.map_id (f x) (hp.map_mem x)

name: isIdempotentElem
statement: theorem isIdempotentElem {f : M →ₗ[S] M} (h : IsProj m f) : IsIdempotentElem f

name: mem_iff_map_id
statement:
theorem mem_iff_map_id {f : M →ₗ[S] M} (hf : IsProj m f) {x : M} :
    x ∈ m ↔ f x = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨hf.map_id x, fun h ↦ h ▸ hf.map_mem x⟩

name: codRestrict_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codRestrict_apply {f : M →ₗ[S] M} (h : IsProj m f) (x : M) : ↑(h.codRestrict x) = f x

name: codRestrict_apply_cod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem codRestrict_apply_cod {f : M →ₗ[S] M} (h : IsProj m f) (x : m) : h.codRestrict x = x
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [codRestrict_apply]
  exact h.map_id x x.2

name: codRestrict_ker
statement: theorem codRestrict_ker {f : M →ₗ[S] M} (h : IsProj m f) : ker h.codRestrict = ker f

name: isCompl
statement: theorem isCompl {f : E →ₗ[R] E} (h : IsProj p f) : IsCompl p (ker f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← codRestrict_ker h]
  exact isCompl_of_proj h.codRestrict_apply_cod

name: eq_conj_prod_map'
statement:
theorem eq_conj_prod_map' {f : E →ₗ[R] E} (h : IsProj p f) :
    f = (p.prodEquivOfIsCompl (ker f) h.isCompl).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        prodMap id 0 ∘ₗ (p.prodEquivOfIsCompl (ker f) h.isCompl).symm.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc, LinearEquiv.eq_comp_toLinearMap_symm]
  ext x
  · simp only [coe_prodEquivOfIsCompl, comp_apply, coe_inl, coprod_apply, coe_subtype,
      map_zero, add_zero, h.map_id x x.2, prodMap_apply, id_apply]
  · simp only [coe_prodEquivOfIsCompl, comp_apply, coe_inr, coprod_apply, map_zero,
      coe_subtype, zero_add, map_coe_ker, prodMap_apply, zero_apply, add_zero]

name: submodule_unique
statement:
theorem submodule_unique {f : M →ₗ[S] M} {m₁ m₂ : Submodule S M}
    (hf₁ : IsProj m₁ f) (hf₂ : IsProj m₂ f) : m₁ = m₂

name: range
statement: protected theorem range {f : M →ₗ[S] M} (h : IsProj m f) : range f = m

name: bot
statement: protected theorem bot : IsProj (⊥ : Submodule S M) (0 : M →ₗ[S] M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨congrFun rfl, by simp only [mem_bot, zero_apply, forall_eq]⟩

name: top
statement: protected theorem top : IsProj (⊤ : Submodule S M) (id (R := S))

name: subtype_comp_codRestrict
statement:
theorem subtype_comp_codRestrict {U : Submodule S M} {f : M →ₗ[S] M} (hf : IsProj U f) :
    U.subtype ∘ₗ hf.codRestrict = f

name: submodule_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem submodule_eq_top_iff {f : M →ₗ[S] M} (hf : IsProj m f) :
    m = (⊤ : Submodule S M) ↔ f = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro rfl
  · ext
    simp [hf.map_id]
  · rw [← hf.range, range_id]

name: submodule_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem submodule_eq_bot_iff {f : M →ₗ[S] M} (hf : IsProj m f) :
    m = (⊥ : Submodule S M) ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro rfl
  · ext
    simpa using hf.map_mem _
  · rw [← hf.range, range_zero]

name: IsIdempotentElem.isCompl
statement:
lemma IsIdempotentElem.isCompl {f : E →ₗ[R] E} (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) :
    IsCompl (range f) (ker f)

name: IsIdempotentElem.mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.mem_range_iff {p : M →ₗ[S] M} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) {x : M} :
    x ∈ range p ↔ p x = x

name: IsIdempotentElem.eq_projection
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.eq_projection {T : E →ₗ[R] E} (hT : IsIdempotentElem T) :
    T = T.range.projection T.ker hT.isCompl
proof:
:= by
  convert! ofIsCompl_subtype_zero_eq hT.isCompl
  exact ofIsCompl_eq _ (by simp [hT.isProj_range.map_id]) (by simp) |>.symm

name: isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_projection_range_ker
statement:
theorem isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_projection_range_ker {T : E →ₗ[R] E} :
    IsIdempotentElem T ↔ ∃ (h : IsCompl (range T) (ker T)), T = T.range.projection T.ker h
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hT => ⟨hT.isProj_range.isCompl, hT.eq_projection⟩,
   fun ⟨hT, h⟩ => h.symm ▸ isIdempotentElem_projection hT⟩

name: IsIdempotentElem.comp_eq_right_iff
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.comp_eq_right_iff {q : M →ₗ[S] M} (hq : IsIdempotentElem q)
    {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E] [Module S E] (p : E →ₗ[S] M) :
    q.comp p = p ↔ range p ≤ range q
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [LinearMap.ext_iff, comp_apply, ← hq.mem_range_iff,
    SetLike.le_def, mem_range, forall_exists_index, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff]

name: IsIdempotentElem.ext_iff
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨congrArg range h, congrArg ker h⟩, fun ⟨hr, hk⟩ => ?_⟩
  ext x
  obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, ⟨w, hw⟩, rfl, _⟩ :=
    (ker p).existsUnique_add_of_isCompl hp.isCompl.symm x
  simp [mem_ker.mp, hv, (hk ▸ hv), (mem_range_iff hp).mp, hw, (mem_range_iff hq).mp, (hr ▸ hw)]

name: IsIdempotentElem.range_eq_ker
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.range_eq_ker {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module S E]
    {p : E →ₗ[S] E} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) : LinearMap.range p = LinearMap.ker (id - p)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff.mpr hp.one_sub_mul_self)
    fun x hx ↦ ⟨x, by simpa [sub_eq_zero, eq_comm (a := x)] using hx⟩

name: IsIdempotentElem.range_eq_ker_one_sub
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.range_eq_ker_one_sub {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module S E]
    {p : E →ₗ[S] E} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) : LinearMap.range p = LinearMap.ker (1 - p)

name: IsIdempotentElem.ker_eq_range
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.ker_eq_range {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module S E]
    {p : E →ₗ[S] E} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) : LinearMap.ker p = LinearMap.range (id - p)

name: IsIdempotentElem.ker_eq_range_one_sub
statement:
theorem IsIdempotentElem.ker_eq_range_one_sub {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module S E]
    {p : E →ₗ[S] E} (hp : IsIdempotentElem p) : LinearMap.ker p = LinearMap.range (1 - p)

name: IsIdempotentElem.comp_eq_left_iff
proof:
:= by
  simp [hq.ker_eq_range, range_le_ker_iff, comp_sub, sub_eq_zero, eq_comm]

name: IsProj.eq_conj_prodMap
statement:
theorem IsProj.eq_conj_prodMap {f : E →ₗ[R] E} (h : IsProj p f) :
    f = (p.prodEquivOfIsCompl (ker f) h.isCompl).conj (prodMap id 0)

name: range_mem_invtSubmodule_iff
statement:
lemma range_mem_invtSubmodule_iff (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) :
    range f ∈ Module.End.invtSubmodule T ↔ f ∘ₗ T ∘ₗ f = T ∘ₗ f

name: _root_.LinearMap.IsProj.mem_invtSubmodule_iff
statement:
lemma _root_.LinearMap.IsProj.mem_invtSubmodule_iff {U : Submodule R E}
    (hf : IsProj U f) : U ∈ Module.End.invtSubmodule T ↔ f ∘ₗ T ∘ₗ f = T ∘ₗ f

name: ker_mem_invtSubmodule_iff
statement:
lemma ker_mem_invtSubmodule_iff (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) :
    ker f ∈ Module.End.invtSubmodule T ↔ f ∘ₗ T ∘ₗ f = f ∘ₗ T
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_assoc, hf.comp_eq_left_iff, ker_comp, Module.End.mem_invtSubmodule]

name: commute_iff
statement:
lemma commute_iff (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) :
    Commute f T ↔ (range f ∈ Module.End.invtSubmodule T ∧ ker f ∈ Module.End.invtSubmodule T)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [hf.range_mem_invtSubmodule_iff, hf.ker_mem_invtSubmodule_iff, ← Module.End.mul_eq_comp]
  exact ⟨fun h => (by simp [← h.eq, ← mul_assoc, hf.eq]), fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => h2.symm.trans h1⟩

name: commute_iff_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem commute_iff_of_isUnit (hT : IsUnit T) (hf : IsIdempotentElem f) :
    Commute f T ↔ (range f).map T = range f ∧ (ker f).map T = ker f
proof:
:= by
  lift T to GeneralLinearGroup R E using hT
  simp_rw [← GeneralLinearGroup.generalLinearEquiv_to_linearMap, le_antisymm_iff,
    ← Module.End.mem_invtSubmodule_iff_map_le, ← Module.End.mem_invtSubmodule_symm_iff_le_map,
    and_and_and_comm (c := (ker f ∈ _)), ← hf.commute_iff,
    GeneralLinearGroup.generalLinearEquiv_to_linearMap, iff_self_and]
  exact Commute.units_inv_right

name: goursatFst_toAddSubgroup
statement:
lemma goursatFst_toAddSubgroup :
    (goursatFst L).toAddSubgroup = L.toAddSubgroup.goursatFst

name: goursatSnd_toAddSubgroup
statement:
lemma goursatSnd_toAddSubgroup :
    (goursatSnd L).toAddSubgroup = L.toAddSubgroup.goursatSnd

name: goursatFst_prod_goursatSnd_le
statement: lemma goursatFst_prod_goursatSnd_le : L.goursatFst.prod L.goursatSnd ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← toAddSubgroup_le, goursatFst_toAddSubgroup, goursatSnd_toAddSubgroup]
    using! L.toAddSubgroup.goursatFst_prod_goursatSnd_le

name: goursat_surjective
statement:
lemma goursat_surjective : ∃ e : (M ⧸ L.goursatFst) ≃ₗ[R] N ⧸ L.goursatSnd,
    LinearMap.range ((L.goursatFst.mkQ.prodMap L.goursatSnd.mkQ).comp L.subtype) = e.graph
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨(e : M ⧸ L.goursatFst ≃+ N ⧸ L.goursatSnd), he⟩ :=
    L.toAddSubgroup.goursat_surjective hL₁ hL₂
  
  have (r : R) (x : M ⧸ L.goursatFst) : e (r • x) = r • e x := by
    change (r • x, r • e x) ∈ e.toAddMonoidHom.graph
    rw [← he, ← Prod.smul_mk]
    have : (x, e x) ∈ e.toAddMonoidHom.graph := rfl
    rw [← he, AddMonoidHom.mem_range] at this
    rcases this with ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, hl'⟩
    use ⟨r • l, L.smul_mem r hl⟩
    rw [← hl']
    rfl
  
  use { e with map_smul' := this }
  rw [← toAddSubgroup_injective.eq_iff]
  convert! he using 1
  ext v
  rw [mem_toAddSubgroup, mem_graph_iff, Eq.comm]
  rfl

name: goursat
statement:
lemma goursat : ∃ (M' : Submodule R M) (N' : Submodule R N) (M'' : Submodule R M')
    (N'' : Submodule R N') (e : (M' ⧸ M'') ≃ₗ[R] N' ⧸ N''),
    L = (e.graph.comap <| M''.mkQ.prodMap N''.mkQ).map (M'.subtype.prodMap N'.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  let M' := L.map (LinearMap.fst ..)
  let N' := L.map (LinearMap.snd ..)
  let P : L →ₗ[R] M' := (LinearMap.fst ..).submoduleMap L
  let Q : L →ₗ[R] N' := (LinearMap.snd ..).submoduleMap L
  let L' : Submodule R (M' × N') := LinearMap.range (P.prod Q)
  have hL₁' : Surjective (Prod.fst ∘ L'.subtype) := by
    simp only [← coe_fst (R := R), ← coe_comp, ← range_eq_top, LinearMap.range_comp, range_subtype]
    simpa only [L', ← LinearMap.range_comp, fst_prod, range_eq_top] using
      (LinearMap.fst ..).submoduleMap_surjective L
  have hL₂' : Surjective (Prod.snd ∘ L'.subtype) := by
    simp only [← coe_snd (R := R), ← coe_comp, ← range_eq_top, LinearMap.range_comp, range_subtype]
    simpa only [L', ← LinearMap.range_comp, snd_prod, range_eq_top] using
      (LinearMap.snd ..).submoduleMap_surjective L
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := goursat_surjective hL₁' hL₂'
  use M', N', L'.goursatFst, L'.goursatSnd, e
  rw [← he]
  simp only [LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_subtype, L', M', N', P, Q]
  rw [comap_map_eq_self]
  · ext ⟨m, n⟩
    constructor
    · simp only [mem_map, LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.prod_apply, Function.prod_apply,
      Subtype.exists, Prod.exists, LinearMap.prodMap_apply, subtype_apply, Prod.mk.injEq,
      Subtype.ext_iff, submoduleMap_coe_apply, fst_apply, snd_apply]
      grind
    · simp only [mem_map, LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.prod_apply, Function.prod_apply,
      Subtype.exists, Prod.exists, LinearMap.prodMap_apply, subtype_apply, Prod.mk.injEq,
      snd_apply, fst_apply, Subtype.ext_iff, submoduleMap_coe_apply]
      grind
  · convert! goursatFst_prod_goursatSnd_le (range <| P.prod Q)
    simp only [ker_prodMap, ker_mkQ, Submodule.ext_iff]
    grind

name: det_comm
statement: theorem det_comm [DecidableEq n] (M N : Matrix n n A) : det (M * N) = det (N * M)

name: det_comm'
statement:
theorem det_comm' [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] {M : Matrix n m A} {N : Matrix m n A}
    {M' : Matrix m n A} (hMM' : M * M' = 1) (hM'M : M' * M = 1) : det (M * N) = det (N * M)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  
  
  let e := indexEquivOfInv hMM' hM'M
  rw [← det_submatrix_equiv_self e, ← submatrix_mul_equiv _ _ _ (Equiv.refl n) _, det_comm,
    submatrix_mul_equiv, Equiv.coe_refl, submatrix_id_id]

name: det_conj_of_mul_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [← det_comm' hM'M hMM', ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hM'M, Matrix.one_mul]

name: det_toMatrix_eq_det_toMatrix
statement:
theorem det_toMatrix_eq_det_toMatrix [DecidableEq κ] (b : Basis ι A M) (c : Basis κ A M)
    (f : M →ₗ[A] M) : det (LinearMap.toMatrix b b f) = det (LinearMap.toMatrix c c f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix c b c, ← basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix b c b,
      Matrix.det_conj_of_mul_eq_one] <;>
    rw [Basis.toMatrix_mul_toMatrix, Basis.toMatrix_self]

name: detAux_def'
statement:
theorem detAux_def' (b : Basis ι A M) (f : M →ₗ[A] M) :
    LinearMap.detAux (Trunc.mk b) f = Matrix.det (LinearMap.toMatrix b b f)
proof:
:= by
  #adaptation_note /
  The first line below was previously just `rw [detAux]`.
  The replacement proof is a short-term fix, and we request that the authors/maintainers of
  this file review the proof, and either approve it by removing this note, revise
  the proof or the prerequisites appropriately, or minimize a problem in lean4 that still
  needs addressing. -/
  simp only [detAux_def, Trunc.lift_mk]
  rfl

name: detAux_def''
statement:
theorem detAux_def'' {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (tb : Trunc <| Basis ι A M)
    (b' : Basis ι' A M) (f : M →ₗ[A] M) :
    LinearMap.detAux tb f = Matrix.det (LinearMap.toMatrix b' b' f)
proof:
:= by
  induction tb using Trunc.induction_on with
  | h b => rw [detAux_def', det_toMatrix_eq_det_toMatrix b b']

name: detAux_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem detAux_id (b : Trunc <| Basis ι A M) : LinearMap.detAux b LinearMap.id = 1

name: detAux_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem detAux_comp (b : Trunc <| Basis ι A M) (f g : M →ₗ[A] M) :
    LinearMap.detAux b (f.comp g) = LinearMap.detAux b f * LinearMap.detAux b g

name: coe_det
statement:
theorem coe_det [DecidableEq M] :
    ⇑(LinearMap.det : (M →ₗ[A] M) →* A) =
      if H : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s A M) then
        LinearMap.detAux (Trunc.mk H.choose_spec.some)
      else 1
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [LinearMap.det_def]
  split_ifs
  · congr 
  rfl

name: _root_.Module.Free.of_det_ne_one
statement:
theorem _root_.Module.Free.of_det_ne_one {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (hf : f.det ≠ 1) :
    Module.Free R M
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Module.Basis s R M)
  · rcases H with ⟨s, ⟨hs⟩⟩
    exact Module.Free.of_basis hs
  · classical simp [LinearMap.coe_det, H] at hf

name: det_eq_det_toMatrix_of_finset
statement:
theorem det_eq_det_toMatrix_of_finset [DecidableEq M] {s : Finset M} (b : Basis s A M)
    (f : M →ₗ[A] M) : LinearMap.det f = Matrix.det (LinearMap.toMatrix b b f)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s A M) := ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩
  rw [LinearMap.coe_det, dite_eq_left this, detAux_def'' _ b]

name: det_toMatrix
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_toMatrix (b : Basis ι A M) (f : M →ₗ[A] M) :
    Matrix.det (toMatrix b b f) = LinearMap.det f
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq M
  rw [det_eq_det_toMatrix_of_finset b.reindexFinsetRange,
    det_toMatrix_eq_det_toMatrix b b.reindexFinsetRange]

name: det_toMatrix'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_toMatrix' {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (f : (ι → A) →ₗ[A] ι → A) :
    Matrix.det (LinearMap.toMatrix' f) = LinearMap.det f

name: det_toLin
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_toLin (b : Basis ι R M) (f : Matrix ι ι R) :
    LinearMap.det (Matrix.toLin b b f) = f.det

name: det_toLin'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_toLin' (f : Matrix ι ι R) : LinearMap.det (Matrix.toLin' f) = Matrix.det f

name: det_cases
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem det_cases [DecidableEq M] {P : A → Prop} (f : M →ₗ[A] M)
    (hb : ∀ (s : Finset M) (b : Basis s A M), P (Matrix.det (toMatrix b b f))) (h1 : P 1) :
    P (LinearMap.det f)
proof:
:= by
  if H : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s A M) then
    obtain ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩ := H
    rw [← det_toMatrix b]
    exact hb s b
  else
    rwa [LinearMap.det_def, dite_eq_right H]

name: det_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_comp (f g : M →ₗ[A] M) :
    LinearMap.det (f.comp g) = LinearMap.det f * LinearMap.det g

name: det_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_id : LinearMap.det (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[A] M) = 1

name: det_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_smul [Module.Free A M] (c : A) (f : M →ₗ[A] M) :
    LinearMap.det (c • f) = c ^ Module.finrank A M * LinearMap.det f
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality A
  by_cases H : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s A M)
  · have : Module.Finite A M := by
      rcases H with ⟨s, ⟨hs⟩⟩
      exact Module.Finite.of_basis hs
    simp only [← det_toMatrix (Module.finBasis A M), map_smul, Fintype.card_fin, Matrix.det_smul]
  · classical
      have : Module.finrank A M = 0 := finrank_eq_zero_of_not_exists_basis H
      simp [coe_det, H, this]

name: det_zero'
statement:
theorem det_zero' {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] [Nonempty ι] (b : Basis ι A M) :
    LinearMap.det (0 : M →ₗ[A] M) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq ι
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  rw [← det_toMatrix b, map_zero, det_zero]

name: det_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_zero [Module.Free A M] :
    LinearMap.det (0 : M →ₗ[A] M) = (0 : A) ^ Module.finrank A M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← zero_smul A (1 : M →ₗ[A] M), det_smul, mul_one, map_one]

name: det_eq_one_of_not_module_finite
statement: theorem det_eq_one_of_not_module_finite (h : ¬Module.Finite R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) : f.det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.det, dite_eq_right, MonoidHom.one_apply]
  exact fun ⟨_, ⟨b⟩⟩ ↦ h (Module.Finite.of_basis b)

name: det_eq_one_of_subsingleton
statement:
@[nontriviality]
theorem det_eq_one_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton M] (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    LinearMap.det (f : M →ₗ[R] M) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have b : Basis (Fin 0) R M := Basis.empty M
  rw [← f.det_toMatrix b]
  exact Matrix.det_isEmpty

name: det_eq_one_of_finrank_eq_zero
statement:
theorem det_eq_one_of_finrank_eq_zero {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module 𝕜 M] (h : Module.finrank 𝕜 M = 0) (f : M →ₗ[𝕜] M) :
    LinearMap.det (f : M →ₗ[𝕜] M) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
    refine @LinearMap.det_cases M _ 𝕜 _ _ _ (fun t => t = 1) f ?_ rfl
    intro s b
    have : IsEmpty s := by
      rw [← Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff]
      exact (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b).symm.trans h
    exact Matrix.det_isEmpty

name: det_conj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_conj {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] (f : M →ₗ[A] M) (e : M ≃ₗ[A] N) :
    LinearMap.det ((e : M →ₗ[A] N) ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ (e.symm : N →ₗ[A] M)) = LinearMap.det f
proof:
:= by
  classical
    by_cases H : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s A M)
    · rcases H with ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩
      rw [← det_toMatrix b f, ← det_toMatrix (b.map e), toMatrix_comp (b.map e) b (b.map e),
        toMatrix_comp (b.map e) b b, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.det_conj_of_mul_eq_one]
      · rw [← toMatrix_comp, LinearEquiv.comp_coe, e.symm_trans_self, LinearEquiv.refl_toLinearMap,
          toMatrix_id]
      · rw [← toMatrix_comp, LinearEquiv.comp_coe, e.self_trans_symm, LinearEquiv.refl_toLinearMap,
          toMatrix_id]
    · have H' : ¬∃ t : Finset N, Nonempty (Basis t A N) := by
        contrapose H
        rcases H with ⟨s, ⟨b⟩⟩
        exact ⟨_, ⟨(b.map e.symm).reindexFinsetRange⟩⟩
      simp only [coe_det, H, H', MonoidHom.one_apply, dite_eq_right, not_false_eq_true]

name: isUnit_det
statement:
theorem isUnit_det {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Module A M] (f : M →ₗ[A] M) (hf : IsUnit f) :
    IsUnit (LinearMap.det f)

name: isUnit_iff_isUnit_det
statement:
lemma isUnit_iff_isUnit_det [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Free R M] (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    IsUnit f ↔ IsUnit f.det
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R M
  rw [← isUnit_toMatrix_iff b, ← det_toMatrix b, Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det (toMatrix b b f)]

name: free_of_det_ne_one
statement: theorem free_of_det_ne_one {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (hf : f.det ≠ 1) : Module.Free R M
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s R M)
  · rcases H with ⟨s, ⟨hs⟩⟩
    exact Module.Free.of_basis hs
  · classical simp [LinearMap.coe_det, H] at hf

name: finite_of_det_ne_one
statement: theorem finite_of_det_ne_one {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (hf : f.det ≠ 1) : Module.Finite R M
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : ∃ s : Finset M, Nonempty (Basis s R M)
  · rcases H with ⟨s, ⟨hs⟩⟩
    exact Module.Finite.of_basis hs
  · classical simp [LinearMap.coe_det, H] at hf

name: bot_lt_ker_of_det_eq_zero
statement:
theorem bot_lt_ker_of_det_eq_zero [IsDomain R] [Free R M] {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (hf : f.det = 0) :
    ⊥ < ker f
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.Finite R M := by simp [finite_of_det_ne_one (f := f), hf]
  let b := Module.finBasis R M
  suffices ∃ x, f x = 0 ∧ x ≠ 0 by simpa [bot_lt_iff_ne_bot, ker_eq_bot']
  obtain ⟨v, hv_ne_zero, hv_zero⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.mpr (det_toMatrix b f ▸ hf)
  refine ⟨b.equivFun.symm v, ?_, b.equivFun.symm.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hv_ne_zero⟩
  rw [← b.equivFun.injective.eq_iff]
  simp_all [funext_iff, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, toMatrix_apply, mul_comm]

name: det_eq_zero_iff_ker_ne_bot
statement:
theorem det_eq_zero_iff_ker_ne_bot [IsDomain R] [Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] {f : M →ₗ[R] M} :
    f.det = 0 ↔ ker f ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · exact bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mp (bot_lt_ker_of_det_eq_zero h)
  · let b := Module.finBasis R M
    obtain ⟨v, ⟨_, hv_ne_zero⟩⟩ := (ker f).ne_bot_iff.mp h
    rw [← det_toMatrix b, ← Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff]
    refine ⟨fun i => b.repr v i, by simpa, by simpa [toMatrix_mulVec_repr]⟩

name: range_lt_top_of_det_eq_zero
statement:
theorem range_lt_top_of_det_eq_zero [IsDomain R] [Free R M] {f : M →ₗ[R] M}
    (hf : f.det = 0) : range f < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
  intro h
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := f.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective h
  simpa [hf] using congr_arg LinearMap.det hg

name: det_ring
statement: @[simp] lemma det_ring (f : R →ₗ[R] R) : f.det = f 1

name: det_mulLeft
statement: lemma det_mulLeft (a : R) : (mulLeft R a).det = a

name: det_mulRight
statement: lemma det_mulRight (a : R) : (mulRight R a).det = a

name: det_prodMap
statement:
theorem det_prodMap [Module.Free R M] [Module.Free R M'] [Module.Finite R M] [Module.Finite R M']
    (f : Module.End R M) (f' : Module.End R M') :
    (prodMap f f').det = f.det * f'.det
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R M
  let b' := Module.Free.chooseBasis R M'
  rw [← det_toMatrix (b.prod b'), ← det_toMatrix b, ← det_toMatrix b', toMatrix_prodMap,
    det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, det_toMatrix]

name: det_pi
statement:
theorem det_pi [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] (f : ι → M →ₗ[R] M) :
    (LinearMap.pi (fun i ↦ (f i).comp (LinearMap.proj i))).det = ∏ i, (f i).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R M
  let B := (Pi.basis (fun _ : ι ↦ b)).reindex <|
    (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd _ _).trans (Equiv.prodComm _ _)
  simp_rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix B, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b]
  have : ((LinearMap.toMatrix B B) (LinearMap.pi fun i ↦ f i ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj i)) =
      Matrix.blockDiagonal (fun i ↦ LinearMap.toMatrix b b (f i)) := by
    ext ⟨i₁, i₂⟩ ⟨j₁, j₂⟩
    unfold B
    simp_rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply', Matrix.blockDiagonal_apply, Basis.coe_reindex,
      Function.comp_apply, Basis.repr_reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_trans_apply, Equiv.prodComm_symm,
      Equiv.prodComm_apply, Equiv.sigmaEquivProd_symm_apply, Prod.swap_prod_mk, Pi.basis_apply,
      Pi.basis_repr, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.toMatrix_apply', LinearMap.coe_proj, Function.eval, Pi.single_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [h]
    · simp only [map_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  rw [this, Matrix.det_blockDiagonal]

name: det_lsmul
statement: lemma det_lsmul (x : R) : LinearMap.det (lsmul R R S x) = x ^ finrank R S

name: coe_det
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_det (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M) : ↑(LinearEquiv.det f) = LinearMap.det (f : M →ₗ[R] M)

name: coe_inv_det
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_inv_det (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M) : ↑(LinearEquiv.det f)⁻¹ = LinearMap.det (f.symm : M →ₗ[R] M)

name: det_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_refl : LinearEquiv.det (LinearEquiv.refl R M) = 1

name: det_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_trans (f g : M ≃ₗ[R] M) :
    LinearEquiv.det (f.trans g) = LinearEquiv.det g * LinearEquiv.det f

name: det_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_symm (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M) : LinearEquiv.det f.symm = LinearEquiv.det f⁻¹

name: det_conj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_conj (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M) (e : M ≃ₗ[R] M') :
    LinearEquiv.det ((e.symm.trans f).trans e) = LinearEquiv.det f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Units.val_inj, coe_det, coe_det, ← comp_coe, ← comp_coe, LinearMap.det_conj]

name: LinearMap.det_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem LinearMap.det_map {K V W : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] {F : Type*} [EquivLike F (End K V) (End K W)]
    [AlgEquivClass F K _ _] (f : F) (x : End K V) : (f x).det = x.det
proof:
:=
  have ⟨_, h⟩ := (AlgEquiv.ofClass f).eq_linearEquivConjAlgEquiv
  (by simpa using congr($h x)) ▸ det_conj _ _

name: Matrix.det_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem Matrix.det_map {K m n : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype m] [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n] {F : Type*} [EquivLike F (Matrix m m K) (Matrix n n K)]
    [AlgEquivClass F K _ _] (f : F) (x : Matrix m m K) : (f x).det = x.det
proof:
:= by
  simpa [toMatrixAlgEquiv', Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv'] using
    LinearMap.det_map ((Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv'.symm.trans
      (AlgEquiv.ofClass f)).trans Matrix.toLinAlgEquiv') x.toLin'

name: Matrix.det_map'
statement:
@[simp] theorem Matrix.det_map' {K m F : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m]
    [FunLike F (Matrix m m K) (Matrix m m K)] [AlgHomClass F K _ _] (f : F) (x : Matrix m m K) :
    (f x).det = x.det
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! Nonempty m
  · exact det_map (AlgEquiv.ofBijective _ (AlgHom.ofClass f).bijective) x
  · simp

name: LinearEquiv.det_mul_det_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LinearEquiv.det_mul_det_symm {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Module A M] (f : M ≃ₗ[A] M) :
    LinearMap.det (f : M →ₗ[A] M) * LinearMap.det (f.symm : M →ₗ[A] M) = 1

name: LinearEquiv.det_symm_mul_det
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LinearEquiv.det_symm_mul_det {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Module A M] (f : M ≃ₗ[A] M) :
    LinearMap.det (f.symm : M →ₗ[A] M) * LinearMap.det (f : M →ₗ[A] M) = 1

name: LinearEquiv.isUnit_det
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.isUnit_det (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M') (v : Basis ι R M) (v' : Basis ι R M') :
    IsUnit (LinearMap.toMatrix v v' f).det
proof:
:= by
  apply isUnit_det_of_left_inverse
  simpa using (LinearMap.toMatrix_comp v v' v f.symm f).symm

name: LinearEquiv.isUnit_det'
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.isUnit_det' {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Module A M] (f : M ≃ₗ[A] M) :
    IsUnit (LinearMap.det (f : M →ₗ[A] M))

name: LinearEquiv.det_coe_symm
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.det_coe_symm {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] [Module 𝕜 M] (f : M ≃ₗ[𝕜] M) :
    LinearMap.det (f.symm : M →ₗ[𝕜] M) = (LinearMap.det (f : M →ₗ[𝕜] M))⁻¹

name: LinearEquiv.coe_ofIsUnitDet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LinearEquiv.coe_ofIsUnitDet {f : M →ₗ[R] M'} {v : Basis ι R M} {v' : Basis ι R M'}
    (h : IsUnit (LinearMap.toMatrix v v' f).det) :
    (LinearEquiv.ofIsUnitDet h : M →ₗ[R] M') = f

name: LinearMap.equivOfIsUnitDet_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LinearMap.equivOfIsUnitDet_apply
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (h : IsUnit f.det) (x : M) :
    (LinearMap.equivOfIsUnitDet h) x = f x
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality M
  simp [equivOfIsUnitDet, dite_eq_left (Module.nontrivial R M)]

name: LinearMap.coe_equivOfIsUnitDet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LinearMap.coe_equivOfIsUnitDet
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (h : IsUnit f.det) :
    (LinearMap.equivOfIsUnitDet h : M →ₗ[R] M) = f

name: LinearMap.associated_det_of_eq_comp
statement:
theorem LinearMap.associated_det_of_eq_comp (e : M ≃ₗ[R] M) (f f' : M →ₗ[R] M)
    (h : ∀ x, f x = f' (e x)) : Associated (LinearMap.det f) (LinearMap.det f')
proof:
:= by
  suffices Associated (LinearMap.det (f' ∘ₗ ↑e)) (LinearMap.det f') by
    convert! this using 2
    ext x
    exact h x
  rw [← mul_one (LinearMap.det f'), LinearMap.det_comp]
  exact Associated.mul_left _ (associated_one_iff_isUnit.mpr e.isUnit_det')

name: LinearMap.associated_det_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem LinearMap.associated_det_comp_equiv {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (f : N →ₗ[R] M) (e e' : M ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    Associated (LinearMap.det (f ∘ₗ ↑e)) (LinearMap.det (f ∘ₗ ↑e'))
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.associated_det_of_eq_comp (e.trans e'.symm) _ _ ?_
  intro x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: det_apply
statement: theorem det_apply (v : ι → M) : e.det v = Matrix.det (e.toMatrix v)

name: det_self
statement: theorem det_self : e.det e = 1

name: det_isEmpty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_isEmpty [IsEmpty ι] : e.det = AlternatingMap.constOfIsEmpty R M ι 1

name: det_ne_zero
statement: theorem det_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] : e.det ≠ 0
proof: := fun h => by simpa [h] using e.det_self

name: smul_det
statement:
theorem smul_det {G} [Group G] [DistribMulAction G M] [SMulCommClass G R M]
    (g : G) (v : ι → M) :
    (g • e).det v = e.det (g⁻¹ • v)

name: is_basis_iff_det
statement:
theorem is_basis_iff_det {v : ι → M} :
    LinearIndependent R v ∧ span R (Set.range v) = ⊤ ↔ IsUnit (e.det v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hli, hspan⟩
    set v' := Basis.mk hli hspan.ge
    rw [e.det_apply]
    convert! LinearEquiv.isUnit_det (LinearEquiv.refl R M) v' e using 2
    ext i j
    simp [v']
  · intro h
    rw [Basis.det_apply, Basis.toMatrix_eq_toMatrix_constr] at h
    set v' := Basis.map e (LinearEquiv.ofIsUnitDet h) with v'_def
    have : ⇑v' = v := by
      ext i
      rw [v'_def, Basis.map_apply, LinearEquiv.ofIsUnitDet_apply, e.constr_basis]
    rw [← this]
    exact ⟨v'.linearIndependent, v'.span_eq⟩

name: isUnit_det
statement: theorem isUnit_det (e' : Basis ι R M) : IsUnit (e.det e')

name: AlternatingMap.eq_smul_basis_det
statement: theorem AlternatingMap.eq_smul_basis_det (f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] R) : f = f e • e.det
proof:
:= by
  refine Basis.ext_alternating e fun i h => ?_
  let σ : Equiv.Perm ι := Equiv.ofBijective i (Finite.injective_iff_bijective.1 h)
  change f (e ∘ σ) = (f e • e.det) (e ∘ σ)
  simp [AlternatingMap.map_perm, Basis.det_self]

name: AlternatingMap.map_basis_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AlternatingMap.map_basis_eq_zero_iff {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (e : Basis ι R M)
    (f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] R) : f e = 0 ↔ f = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    cases nonempty_fintype ι
    let := Classical.decEq ι
    simpa [h] using f.eq_smul_basis_det e,
   fun h => h.symm ▸ AlternatingMap.zero_apply _⟩

name: AlternatingMap.map_basis_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem AlternatingMap.map_basis_ne_zero_iff {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (e : Basis ι R M)
    (f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] R) : f e ≠ 0 ↔ f ≠ 0

name: det_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_comp (e : Basis ι A M) (f : M →ₗ[A] M) (v : ι → M) :
    e.det (f ∘ v) = (LinearMap.det f) * e.det v
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_apply, det_apply, ← f.det_toMatrix e, ← Matrix.det_mul,
    e.toMatrix_eq_toMatrix_constr (f ∘ v), e.toMatrix_eq_toMatrix_constr v, ← toMatrix_comp,
    e.constr_comp]

name: det_comp_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_comp_basis [Module A M'] (b : Basis ι A M) (b' : Basis ι A M') (f : M →ₗ[A] M') :
    b'.det (f ∘ b) = LinearMap.det (f ∘ₗ (b'.equiv b (Equiv.refl ι) : M' →ₗ[A] M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_apply, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b', LinearMap.toMatrix_comp _ b, Matrix.det_mul,
    LinearMap.toMatrix_basis_equiv, Matrix.det_one, mul_one]
  congr 1; ext i j
  rw [toMatrix_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Function.comp_apply]

name: det_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_basis (b : Basis ι A M) (b' : Basis ι A M) :
    LinearMap.det (b'.equiv b (Equiv.refl ι)).toLinearMap = b'.det b

name: det_mul_det
statement:
theorem det_mul_det (b b' b'' : Basis ι A M) :
    b.det b' * b'.det b'' = b.det b''
proof:
:= by
  have : b'' = (b'.equiv b'' (Equiv.refl ι)).toLinearMap ∘ b' := by
    ext; simp
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [this, Basis.det_comp, det_basis, mul_comm]

name: det_inv
statement:
theorem det_inv (b : Basis ι A M) (b' : Basis ι A M) :
    (b.isUnit_det b').unit⁻¹ = b'.det b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Units.mul_eq_one_iff_inv_eq, IsUnit.unit_spec, ← det_basis, ← det_basis]
  exact LinearEquiv.det_mul_det_symm _

name: det_reindex
statement:
theorem det_reindex {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (b : Basis ι R M) (v : ι' → M)
    (e : ι ≃ ι') : (b.reindex e).det v = b.det (v ∘ e)

name: det_reindex'
statement:
theorem det_reindex' {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (b : Basis ι R M)
    (e : ι ≃ ι') : (b.reindex e).det = b.det.domDomCongr e

name: det_reindex_symm
statement:
theorem det_reindex_symm {ι' : Type*} [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι'] (b : Basis ι R M)
    (v : ι → M) (e : ι' ≃ ι) : (b.reindex e.symm).det (v ∘ e) = b.det v

name: det_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_map (b : Basis ι R M) (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M') (v : ι → M') :
    (b.map f).det v = b.det (f.symm ∘ v)

name: det_map'
statement:
theorem det_map' (b : Basis ι R M) (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M') :
    (b.map f).det = b.det.compLinearMap f.symm

name: Pi.basisFun_det
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Pi.basisFun_det : (Pi.basisFun R ι).det = Matrix.detRowAlternating
proof:
:= by
  ext M
  rw [Basis.det_apply, Basis.coePiBasisFun.toMatrix_eq_transpose, det_transpose, det]

name: Pi.basisFun_det_apply
statement:
theorem Pi.basisFun_det_apply (v : ι → ι → R) :
    (Pi.basisFun R ι).det v = (Matrix.of v).det

name: det_smul_mk_coord_eq_det_update
statement:
theorem det_smul_mk_coord_eq_det_update {v : ι → M} (hli : LinearIndependent R v)
    (hsp : ⊤ ≤ span R (range v)) (i : ι) :
    e.det v • (Basis.mk hli hsp).coord i = e.det.toMultilinearMap.toLinearMap v i
proof:
:= by
  apply (Basis.mk hli hsp).ext
  intro k
  rcases eq_or_ne k i with (rfl | hik) <;>
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, coe_mk, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      MultilinearMap.toLinearMap_apply]
  · rw [mk_coord_apply_eq, mul_one, update_eq_self]
    congr
  · rw [mk_coord_apply_ne hik, mul_zero, eq_comm]
    exact e.det.map_eq_zero_of_eq _ (by simp [hik]) hik

name: det_unitsSMul
statement:
theorem det_unitsSMul (e : Basis ι R M) (w : ι → Rˣ) :
    (e.unitsSMul w).det = (↑(∏ i, w i)⁻¹ : R) • e.det
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  change
    (Matrix.det fun i j => (e.unitsSMul w).repr (f j) i) =
      (↑(∏ i, w i)⁻¹ : R) • Matrix.det fun i j => e.repr (f j) i
  simp only [e.repr_unitsSMul]
  convert! Matrix.det_mul_column (fun i => (↑(w i)⁻¹ : R)) fun i j => e.repr (f j) i
  simp [← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]

name: det_unitsSMul_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_unitsSMul_self (w : ι → Rˣ) : e.det (e.unitsSMul w) = ∏ i, (w i : R)

name: det_isUnitSMul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_isUnitSMul {w : ι → R} (hw : ∀ i, IsUnit (w i)) :
    e.det (e.isUnitSMul hw) = ∏ i, w i

name: _root_.LinearMap.det_dualMap
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.det_dualMap
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M] (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    f.dualMap.det = f.det
proof:
:= by
  set b := Module.Free.chooseBasis R M
  have : Fintype (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R M) :=
    Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex.fintype R M
  rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b.dualBasis]
  simp [LinearMap.dualMap_def, LinearMap.toMatrix_transpose]

name: LinearMap.det_eq_det_mul_det
statement:
theorem LinearMap.det_eq_det_mul_det (e : V →ₗ[R] V) (he : W ≤ W.comap e) :
    e.det = (e.restrict he).det * (W.mapQ W e he).det
proof:
:= by
  let m := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R W
  let bW : Basis m R W := Module.Free.chooseBasis R W
  let n := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R (V ⧸ W)
  let bQ : Basis n R (V ⧸ W) := Module.Free.chooseBasis R (V ⧸ W)
  let b := sumQuot bW bQ
  let A : Matrix m m R := LinearMap.toMatrix bW bW (e.restrict he)
  let B : Matrix m n R := Matrix.of fun i l ↦
    ((sumQuot bW bQ).repr (e ((sumQuot bW bQ) (Sum.inr l)))) (Sum.inl i)
  let D : Matrix n n R := LinearMap.toMatrix bQ bQ (W.mapQ W e he)
  suffices LinearMap.toMatrix b b e = Matrix.fromBlocks A B 0 D by
    rw [← LinearMap.det_toMatrix b, this, ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix bW,
      ← LinearMap.det_toMatrix bQ, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
  ext u v
  cases u with
  | inl i =>
    cases v with
    | inl k =>
      simp only [b, sumQuot_inl, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁, A, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
      apply sumQuot_repr_inl_of_mem
    | inr l => simp [b, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₂, B]
  | inr j =>
    cases v with
    | inl k =>
      suffices W.mkQ (e (bW k)) = 0 by simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, b, this]
      rw [← LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.ker_mkQ]
      exact he (Submodule.coe_mem (bW k))
    | inr l =>
      simp only [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, sumQuot_repr_inr,
        Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₂₂, b, D]
      rw [← sumQuot_inr bW bQ l, W.mapQ_apply]
      simp

name: isSemisimple_iff'
statement:
lemma isSemisimple_iff' :
    f.IsSemisimple ↔ ∀ p : invtSubmodule f, ∃ q : invtSubmodule f, IsCompl p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsSemisimple, isSemisimpleModule_iff, (AEval.mapSubmodule R M f).symm.complementedLattice_iff,
    complementedLattice_iff]
  rfl

name: isSemisimple_iff
statement:
lemma isSemisimple_iff :
    f.IsSemisimple ↔ ∀ p ∈ invtSubmodule f, ∃ q ∈ invtSubmodule f, IsCompl p q

name: isSemisimple_restrict_iff
statement:
lemma isSemisimple_restrict_iff (p) (hp : p ∈ invtSubmodule f) :
    IsSemisimple (LinearMap.restrict f hp) ↔
    ∀ q ∈ f.invtSubmodule, q ≤ p → ∃ r ≤ p, r ∈ f.invtSubmodule ∧ Disjoint q r ∧ q ⊔ r = p
proof:
:= by
  let e : Submodule R[X] (AEval' (f.restrict hp)) ≃o Iic (AEval.mapSubmodule R M f ⟨p, hp⟩) :=
    (Submodule.orderIsoMapComap <| AEval.restrict_equiv_mapSubmodule f p hp).trans
      (Submodule.mapIic _)
  simp_rw [IsSemisimple, isSemisimpleModule_iff, e.complementedLattice_iff, disjoint_iff,
    ← (OrderIso.Iic _ _).complementedLattice_iff, Iic.complementedLattice_iff, Subtype.forall,
    Subtype.exists, Subtype.mk_le_mk, Sublattice.mk_inf_mk, Sublattice.mk_sup_mk, Subtype.mk.injEq,
    exists_and_left, exists_and_right, invtSubmodule.mk_eq_bot_iff, exists_prop, and_assoc]
  rfl

name: isFinitelySemisimple_iff'
statement:
lemma isFinitelySemisimple_iff' :
    f.IsFinitelySemisimple ↔ ∀ p (hp : p ∈ invtSubmodule f),
      Module.Finite R p → IsSemisimple (LinearMap.restrict f hp)

name: isFinitelySemisimple_iff
statement:
lemma isFinitelySemisimple_iff :
    f.IsFinitelySemisimple ↔ ∀ p ∈ invtSubmodule f, Module.Finite R p → ∀ q ∈ invtSubmodule f,
      q ≤ p → ∃ r, r ≤ p ∧ r ∈ invtSubmodule f ∧ Disjoint q r ∧ q ⊔ r = p

name: isSemisimple_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isSemisimple_zero [IsSemisimpleModule R M] : IsSemisimple (0 : Module.End R M)

name: isSemisimple_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isSemisimple_id [IsSemisimpleModule R M] : IsSemisimple (LinearMap.id : Module.End R M)

name: isSemisimple_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma isSemisimple_neg : (-f).IsSemisimple ↔ f.IsSemisimple

name: _root_.LinearEquiv.isSemisimple_iff
statement:
protected lemma _root_.LinearEquiv.isSemisimple_iff {M₂ : Type*} [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module R M₂]
    (g : End R M₂) (e : M ≃ₗ[R] M₂) (he : e ∘ₗ f = g ∘ₗ e) :
    f.IsSemisimple ↔ g.IsSemisimple
proof:
:= by
  let e : AEval' f ≃ₗ[R[X]] AEval' g := LinearEquiv.ofAEval _ (e.trans (AEval'.of g)) fun x ↦ by
    simpa [AEval'.X_smul_of] using LinearMap.congr_fun he x
  simp_rw [IsSemisimple, isSemisimpleModule_iff,
    (Submodule.orderIsoMapComap e).complementedLattice_iff]

name: eq_zero_of_isNilpotent_isSemisimple
statement: lemma eq_zero_of_isNilpotent_isSemisimple (hn : IsNilpotent f) (hs : f.IsSemisimple) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨n, h0⟩ := hn
  rw [← aeval_X (R := R) f]; rw [← aeval_X_pow (R := R) f] at h0
  rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, ← AEval.annihilator_eq_ker_aeval (M := M)] at h0 ⊢
  exact hs.annihilator_isRadical _ _ ⟨n, h0⟩

name: eq_zero_of_isNilpotent_of_isFinitelySemisimple
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_isNilpotent_of_isFinitelySemisimple
    (hn : IsNilpotent f) (hs : IsFinitelySemisimple f) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have (p) (hp₁ : p ∈ f.invtSubmodule) (hp₂ : Module.Finite R p) : f.restrict hp₁ = 0 := by
    specialize hs p hp₁ hp₂
    replace hn : IsNilpotent (f.restrict hp₁) := isNilpotent.restrict hp₁ hn
    exact eq_zero_of_isNilpotent_isSemisimple hn hs
  ext x
  obtain ⟨k : ℕ, hk : f ^ k = 0⟩ := hn
  let p := Submodule.span R {(f ^ i) x | (i : ℕ) (_ : i ≤ k)}
  have hp₁ : p ∈ f.invtSubmodule := by
    simp only [mem_invtSubmodule, p, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro - ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hi with hik | rfl
    · exact ⟨i + 1, hik, by simpa [Module.End.pow_apply] using iterate_succ_apply' f i x⟩
    · exact ⟨i, by simp [hk]⟩
  have hp₂ : Module.Finite R p := by
    let g : ℕ → M := fun i ↦ (f ^ i) x
    have hg : {(f ^ i) x | (i : ℕ) (_ : i ≤ k)} = g '' Iic k := by ext; simp [g]
    exact Module.Finite.span_of_finite _ <| hg ▸ toFinite (g '' Iic k)
  simpa [LinearMap.restrict_apply, Subtype.ext_iff] using
    LinearMap.congr_fun (this p hp₁ hp₂) ⟨x, Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, k.zero_le, rfl⟩⟩

name: isSemisimple_sub_algebraMap_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isSemisimple_sub_algebraMap_iff {μ : R} :
    (f - algebraMap R (End R M) μ).IsSemisimple ↔ f.IsSemisimple
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ p : Submodule R M, p ≤ p.comap (f - algebraMap R (Module.End R M) μ) ↔ p ≤ p.comap f by
    simp [mem_invtSubmodule, isSemisimple_iff, this]
  refine fun p ↦ ⟨fun h x hx ↦ ?_, fun h x hx ↦ p.sub_mem (h hx) (p.smul_mem μ hx)⟩
  simpa using p.add_mem (h hx) (p.smul_mem μ hx)

name: IsSemisimple.restrict
statement:
lemma IsSemisimple.restrict {p : Submodule R M} (hp : p ∈ f.invtSubmodule) (hf : f.IsSemisimple) :
    IsSemisimple (f.restrict hp)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsSemisimple] at hf ⊢
  let e : Submodule R[X] (AEval' (LinearMap.restrict f hp)) ≃o
      Iic (AEval.mapSubmodule R M f ⟨p, hp⟩) :=
    (Submodule.orderIsoMapComap <| AEval.restrict_equiv_mapSubmodule f p hp).trans <|
      Submodule.mapIic _
  exact (isSemisimpleModule_iff ..).mpr (e.complementedLattice_iff.mpr inferInstance)

name: IsSemisimple.isFinitelySemisimple
statement:
lemma IsSemisimple.isFinitelySemisimple (hf : f.IsSemisimple) :
    f.IsFinitelySemisimple

name: isFinitelySemisimple_iff_isSemisimple
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isFinitelySemisimple_iff_isSemisimple [Module.Finite R M] :
    f.IsFinitelySemisimple ↔ f.IsSemisimple
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf ↦ isSemisimple_iff.mpr fun p hp ↦ ?_, IsSemisimple.isFinitelySemisimple⟩
  obtain ⟨q, -, hq₁, hq₂, hq₃⟩ :=
    isFinitelySemisimple_iff.mp hf ⊤ (invtSubmodule.top_mem f) inferInstance p hp le_top
  exact ⟨q, hq₁, hq₂, codisjoint_iff.mpr hq₃⟩

name: isFinitelySemisimple_sub_algebraMap_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isFinitelySemisimple_sub_algebraMap_iff {μ : R} :
    (f - algebraMap R (End R M) μ).IsFinitelySemisimple ↔ f.IsFinitelySemisimple
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ p : Submodule R M, p ≤ p.comap (f - algebraMap R (Module.End R M) μ) ↔ p ≤ p.comap f by
    simp_rw [isFinitelySemisimple_iff, mem_invtSubmodule, this]
  refine fun p ↦ ⟨fun h x hx ↦ ?_, fun h x hx ↦ p.sub_mem (h hx) (p.smul_mem μ hx)⟩
  simpa using p.add_mem (h hx) (p.smul_mem μ hx)

name: IsFinitelySemisimple.restrict
statement:
lemma IsFinitelySemisimple.restrict {p : Submodule R M} (hp : p ∈ f.invtSubmodule)
    (hf : f.IsFinitelySemisimple) :
    IsFinitelySemisimple (f.restrict hp)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq₁ hq₂
  have := invtSubmodule.map_subtype_mem_of_mem_invtSubmodule f hp hq₁
  let e : q ≃ₗ[R] q.map p.subtype := p.equivSubtypeMap q
  rw [e.isSemisimple_iff ((LinearMap.restrict f hp).restrict hq₁) (LinearMap.restrict f this) rfl]
  exact hf _ this (Finite.map q p.subtype)

name: IsSemisimple_smul_iff
statement:
lemma IsSemisimple_smul_iff {t : K} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (t • f).IsSemisimple ↔ f.IsSemisimple
proof:
:= by
  simp [isSemisimple_iff, mem_invtSubmodule, Submodule.comap_smul f (h := ht)]

name: IsSemisimple_smul
statement:
lemma IsSemisimple_smul (t : K) (h : f.IsSemisimple) :
    (t • f).IsSemisimple
proof:
:= by
  wlog ht : t ≠ 0; · simp [not_not.mp ht]
  rwa [IsSemisimple_smul_iff ht]

name: isSemisimple_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem isSemisimple_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero {p : K[X]}
    (hp : Squarefree p) (hpf : aeval f p = 0) : f.IsSemisimple
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RingHom.mem_ker, ← AEval.annihilator_eq_ker_aeval (M := M), mem_annihilator,
      ← IsTorsionBy, ← isTorsionBySet_singleton_iff, isTorsionBySet_iff_is_torsion_by_span] at hpf
  let R := K[X] ⧸ Ideal.span {p}
  have : IsReduced R :=
    (Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced _).mp (isRadical_iff_span_singleton.mp hp.isRadical)
  have : FiniteDimensional K R := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis hp.ne_zero).finite
  have : IsArtinianRing R := .of_finite K R
  have : IsSemisimpleRing R := IsArtinianRing.isSemisimpleRing_of_isReduced R
  let : Module R (AEval' f) := Module.IsTorsionBySet.module hpf
  let e : AEval' f →ₛₗ[Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {p})] AEval' f :=
    { AddMonoidHom.id _ with map_smul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  exact (e.isSemisimpleModule_iff_of_bijective bijective_id).mpr inferInstance

name: IsSemisimple.minpoly_squarefree
statement: theorem IsSemisimple.minpoly_squarefree : Squarefree (minpoly K f)
proof:
:=
  IsRadical.squarefree (minpoly.ne_zero <| IsIntegral.isIntegral _) <| by
    rw [isRadical_iff_span_singleton, span_minpoly_eq_annihilator]; exact hf.annihilator_isRadical

name: IsSemisimple.aeval
statement: protected theorem IsSemisimple.aeval (p : K[X]) : (aeval f p).IsSemisimple
proof:
:=
  let R := K[X] ⧸ Ideal.span {minpoly K f}
  have : Module.Finite K R :=
    (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' <| minpoly.monic <| IsIntegral.isIntegral f).finite
  have : IsReduced R := (Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced _).mp <|
    span_minpoly_eq_annihilator K f ▸ hf.annihilator_isRadical
  isSemisimple_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero ((minpoly.isRadical K _).squarefree <|
    minpoly.ne_zero <| .of_finite K <| Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K (.span {minpoly K f}) p) <| by
      rw [← Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ_comp (.span {minpoly K f}) (aeval f)
        fun a h ↦ by rwa [Ideal.span, ← minpoly.ker_aeval_eq_span_minpoly] at h, aeval_algHom,
        AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply, ← aeval_algHom_apply, minpoly.aeval, map_zero]

name: IsSemisimple.of_mem_adjoin_singleton
statement:
theorem IsSemisimple.of_mem_adjoin_singleton {a : End K M}
    (ha : a ∈ K[f]) : a.IsSemisimple
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval] at ha; obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := ha; exact .aeval hf _

name: IsSemisimple.pow
statement: protected theorem IsSemisimple.pow (n : ℕ) : (f ^ n).IsSemisimple

name: IsSemisimple.of_mem_adjoin_pair
statement:
theorem IsSemisimple.of_mem_adjoin_pair {a : End K M} (ha : a ∈ K[f, g]) :
    a.IsSemisimple
proof:
:= by
  let R := K[X] ⧸ Ideal.span {minpoly K f}
  let S := AdjoinRoot ((minpoly K g).map <| algebraMap K R)
  have : Module.Finite K R :=
    (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' <| minpoly.monic <| IsIntegral.isIntegral f).finite
  have : Module.Finite R S :=
    (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' <| (minpoly.monic <| IsIntegral.isIntegral g).map _).finite
  have : Module.Finite K S := .trans R S
  have : IsArtinianRing R := .of_finite K R
  have : IsReduced R := (Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced _).mp <|
    span_minpoly_eq_annihilator K f ▸ hf.annihilator_isRadical
  have : IsReduced S := by
    simp_rw [S, AdjoinRoot, ← Ideal.isRadical_iff_quotient_reduced, ← isRadical_iff_span_singleton]
    exact (PerfectField.separable_iff_squarefree.mpr hg.minpoly_squarefree).map.squarefree.isRadical
  let φ : S →ₐ[K] End K M := Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ _ (eval₂AlgHom (Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ _ (aeval f)
    fun a ↦ ?_) g ?_) ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).mpr ?_ : _ ≤ RingHom.ker _)
  rotate_left 1
  · rw [Ideal.span, ← minpoly.ker_aeval_eq_span_minpoly]; exact id
  · rintro ⟨p⟩; exact p.induction_on (fun k ↦ by simp [R, commute_algebraMap_left])
      (fun p q hp hq ↦ by simpa [R] using! hp.add_left hq)
      fun n k ↦ by simpa [R, pow_succ, ← mul_assoc _ _ X] using! (·.mul_left comm)
  · simpa only [RingHom.mem_ker, eval₂AlgHom_apply, eval₂_map, AlgHom.comp_algebraMap_of_tower]
      using! minpoly.aeval K g
  have : K[f, g] ≤ φ.range := adjoin_le fun x ↦ by
    rintro (hx | hx) <;> rw [hx]
    · exact ⟨AdjoinRoot.of _ (AdjoinRoot.root _), (eval₂_C _ _).trans (aeval_X f)⟩
    · exact ⟨AdjoinRoot.root _, eval₂_X _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := (AlgHom.mem_range _).mp (this ha)
  refine isSemisimple_of_squarefree_aeval_eq_zero
    ((minpoly.isRadical K p).squarefree <| minpoly.ne_zero <| .of_finite K p) ?_
  rw [aeval_algHom, φ.comp_apply, minpoly.aeval, map_zero]

statement:
lemma mker_mapRangeAddMonoidHom (f : ∀ i, β₁ i →+ β₂ i) :

name: mrange_mapRangeAddMonoidHom
statement:
lemma mrange_mapRangeAddMonoidHom (f : ∀ i, β₁ i →+ β₂ i) :
    AddMonoidHom.mrange (mapRange.addMonoidHom f) =
      (AddSubmonoid.pi Set.univ (fun i ↦ AddMonoidHom.mrange (f i))).comap coeFnAddMonoidHom
proof:
:= by

    ext i

name: iSup_eq_range_dfinsupp_lsum
statement:
theorem iSup_eq_range_dfinsupp_lsum (p : ι → Submodule R N) :
    iSup p = LinearMap.range (DFinsupp.lsum ℕ fun i => (p i).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le _
    intro i y hy
    simp only [LinearMap.mem_range, lsum_apply_apply]
    exact ⟨DFinsupp.single i ⟨y, hy⟩, DFinsupp.sumAddHom_single _ _ _⟩
  · rintro x ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact dfinsuppSumAddHom_mem _ v _ fun i _ => (le_iSup p i : p i ≤ _) (v i).2

statement:
theorem biSup_eq_range_dfinsupp_lsum (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (S : ι → Submodule R N) :
    ⨆ (i) (_ : p i), S i =
      LinearMap.range
        (LinearMap.comp
          (DFinsupp.lsum ℕ (fun i => (S i).subtype))
            (DFinsupp.filterLinearMap R _ p))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup₂_le fun i hi y hy => ⟨DFinsupp.single i ⟨y, hy⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, filterLinearMap_apply, filter_single_pos _ _ hi]
    simp only [lsum_apply_apply, sumAddHom_single, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, coe_subtype]
  · rintro x ⟨v, rfl⟩
    refine dfinsuppSumAddHom_mem _ _ _ fun i _ => ?_
    refine mem_iSup_of_mem i ?_
    by_cases hp : p i
    · simp [hp]
    · simp [hp]

name: mem_iSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp
statement:
theorem mem_iSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp (p : ι → Submodule R N) (x : N) :
    x ∈ iSup p ↔
      ∃ f : Π₀ i, p i, DFinsupp.lsum ℕ (fun i => (p i).subtype) f = x

name: mem_iSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp'
statement:
theorem mem_iSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp' (p : ι → Submodule R N) [∀ (i) (x : p i), Decidable (x ≠ 0)]
    (x : N) : x ∈ iSup p ↔ ∃ f : Π₀ i, p i, (f.sum fun _ xi => ↑xi) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_iSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp]
  simp_rw [DFinsupp.lsum_apply_apply, DFinsupp.sumAddHom_apply,
    LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, coe_subtype]

name: mem_biSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp
statement:
theorem mem_biSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (S : ι → Submodule R N)
    (x : N) :
    (x ∈ ⨆ (i) (_ : p i), S i) ↔
      ∃ f : Π₀ i, S i,
        DFinsupp.lsum ℕ (fun i => (S i).subtype) (f.filter p) = x

name: mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp
statement:
lemma mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp (p : ι → Submodule R N) (x : N) :
    x ∈ iSup p ↔ ∃ (f : ι →₀ N), (∀ i, f i ∈ p i) ∧ (f.sum fun _i xi ↦ xi) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_iSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp']
  refine ⟨fun ⟨f, hf⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨f.support, fun i ↦ (f i : N), by simp⟩, by simp, hf⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨DFinsupp.mk f.support fun i ↦ ⟨f i, hf i⟩, Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · ext; simp [mk_eq_zero]
  · simp [Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi]

name: mem_iSup_finset_iff_exists_sum
statement:
theorem mem_iSup_finset_iff_exists_sum {s : Finset ι} (p : ι → Submodule R N) (a : N) :
    (a ∈ ⨆ i ∈ s, p i) ↔ ∃ μ : ∀ i, p i, (∑ i ∈ s, (μ i : N)) = a
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp']
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨μ, hμ⟩
    · use fun i => ⟨μ i, (iSup_const_le : _ ≤ p i) (coe_mem <| μ i)⟩
      rw [← hμ]
      symm
      apply Finset.sum_subset
      · intro x
        contrapose
        intro hx
        rw [mem_support_iff, not_ne_iff]
        ext
        rw [coe_zero, ← mem_bot R]
        suffices ⊥ = ⨆ (_ : x ∈ s), p x from this.symm ▸ coe_mem (μ x)
        exact (iSup_neg hx).symm
      · intro x _ hx
        rw [mem_support_iff, not_ne_iff] at hx
        rw [hx]
        rfl
    · refine ⟨DFinsupp.mk s ?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        refine ⟨μ i, ?_⟩
        rw [iSup_pos]
        · exact coe_mem _
        · exact hi
      simp only [DFinsupp.sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_subset support_mk_subset, ← hμ]
      · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => by rw [mk_of_mem hx]
      · intro x _ hx
        rw [mem_support_iff, not_ne_iff] at hx
        rw [hx]
        rfl

name: iSupIndep_iff_forall_dfinsupp
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_iff_forall_dfinsupp (p : ι → Submodule R N) :
    iSupIndep p ↔
      ∀ (i) (x : p i) (v : Π₀ i : ι, ↥(p i)),
        lsum ℕ (fun i => (p i).subtype) (erase i v) = x → x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [iSupIndep_def, Submodule.disjoint_def,
    Submodule.mem_biSup_iff_exists_dfinsupp, exists_imp, filter_ne_eq_erase]
  refine forall_congr' fun i => Subtype.forall'.trans ?_
  simp_rw [Submodule.coe_eq_zero]

name: iSupIndep_of_dfinsupp_lsum_injective
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_of_dfinsupp_lsum_injective (p : ι → Submodule R N)
    (h : Function.Injective (lsum ℕ fun i => (p i).subtype)) :
    iSupIndep p
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSupIndep_iff_forall_dfinsupp]
  intro i x v hv
  replace hv : lsum ℕ (fun i => (p i).subtype) (erase i v) =
      lsum ℕ (fun i => (p i).subtype) (single i x) := by
    simpa only [lsum_single] using! hv
  have := DFunLike.ext_iff.mp (h hv) i
  simpa [eq_comm] using! this

:= by

  exact iSupIndep_of_dfinsupp_lsum_injective _ h

statement:
theorem lsum_comp_mapRange_toSpanSingleton [∀ m : R, Decidable (m ≠ 0)] (p : ι → Submodule R N)
    {v : ι → N} (hv : ∀ i : ι, v i ∈ p i) :
    (lsum ℕ fun i => (p i).subtype : _ →ₗ[R] _).comp
        ((mapRange.linearMap fun i => LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R (↥(p i)) ⟨v i, hv i⟩ :
              _ →ₗ[R] _).comp
          (finsuppLequivDFinsupp R : (ι →₀ R) ≃ₗ[R] _).toLinearMap) =
      Finsupp.linearCombination R v

statement:
theorem iSupIndep_of_dfinsuppSumAddHom_injective' (p : ι → AddSubgroup N)
    (h : Function.Injective (sumAddHom fun i => (p i).subtype)) : iSupIndep p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSupIndep_map_orderIso_iff (AddSubgroup.toIntSubmodule : AddSubgroup N ≃o _)]

name: iSupIndep.dfinsupp_lsum_injective
statement:
theorem iSupIndep.dfinsupp_lsum_injective {p : ι → Submodule R N} (h : iSupIndep p) :
    Function.Injective (lsum ℕ fun i => (p i).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [iSupIndep_iff_forall_dfinsupp] at h
  suffices LinearMap.ker (lsum ℕ fun i => (p i).subtype) = ⊥ by
    
    let thisI : AddCommGroup (Π₀ i, p i) := inferInstance
    rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot] at this
    exact this
  rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro m hm
  ext i : 1
  
  rw [DFinsupp.zero_apply, ← neg_eq_zero]
  refine h i (-m i) m ?_
  rwa [← erase_add_single i m, map_add, lsum_single, Submodule.subtype_apply,
    add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg, ← Submodule.coe_neg] at hm

name: iSupIndep.dfinsuppSumAddHom_injective
statement:
theorem iSupIndep.dfinsuppSumAddHom_injective {p : ι → AddSubgroup N} (h : iSupIndep p) :
    Function.Injective (sumAddHom fun i => (p i).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSupIndep_map_orderIso_iff (AddSubgroup.toIntSubmodule : AddSubgroup N ≃o _)] at h
  exact h.dfinsupp_lsum_injective

name: iSupIndep_iff_dfinsupp_lsum_injective
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_iff_dfinsupp_lsum_injective (p : ι → Submodule R N) :
    iSupIndep p ↔ Function.Injective (lsum ℕ fun i => (p i).subtype)

name: iSupIndep_iff_finsetSum_eq_zero_imp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_iff_finsetSum_eq_zero_imp_eq_zero (p : ι → Submodule R N) :
    iSupIndep p ↔ ∀ (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → N),
    (∀ i ∈ s, v i ∈ p i) → (∑ i ∈ s, v i = 0) → ∀ i ∈ s, v i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [iSupIndep_def, Submodule.disjoint_def]
  constructor
  · intro h s v hv hv0 i hi
    apply h _ _ (hv i hi)
    rw [← s.add_sum_erase _ hi, add_eq_zero_iff_neg_eq] at hv0
    rw [← Submodule.neg_mem_iff, hv0]
    exact SetLike.le_def.mp (biSup_mono <| by grind) (Submodule.sum_mem_biSup <| by grind)
  · intro h i x hx hsup
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp ..).mp hsup
    contrapose! h
    use insert i f.support, fun j ↦ if j = i then -f.sum fun _ x ↦ x else f j
    refine ⟨fun j hj ↦ ?_, ?_, by grind⟩
    · beta_reduce
      split_ifs with h
      · exact (p j).neg_mem (h ▸ hx)
      · simpa [h] using hf j
    · specialize hf i
      simp at hf
      grind [Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_congr]

name: iSupIndep_iff_finsetSum_eq_imp_eq
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_iff_finsetSum_eq_imp_eq (p : ι → Submodule R N) :
    iSupIndep p ↔ ∀ (s : Finset ι) (v w : ι → N),
    (∀ i ∈ s, v i ∈ p i ∧ w i ∈ p i) → (∑ i ∈ s, v i = ∑ i ∈ s, w i) → ∀ i ∈ s, v i = w i
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSupIndep_iff_finsetSum_eq_zero_imp_eq_zero]
  constructor
  · intro h s v w hvw
    simpa [sub_eq_zero] using h s (v - w) fun i hi => (p i).sub_mem (hvw i hi).1 (hvw i hi).2
  · intro h s v hv hv0
    specialize h s v 0
    simp_all

name: iSupIndep_iff_dfinsuppSumAddHom_injective
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_iff_dfinsuppSumAddHom_injective (p : ι → AddSubgroup N) :

name: iSupIndep.linearEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem iSupIndep.linearEquiv_symm_apply {p : ι → Submodule R N} (ind : iSupIndep p)
    (iSup_top : ⨆ i, p i = ⊤) {i : ι} {x : N} (h : x ∈ p i) :
    (ind.linearEquiv iSup_top).symm x = .single i ⟨x, h⟩

name: iSupIndep.linearIndependent
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff]
  intro l hl
  let a :=
    DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap (fun i => LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R (p i) ⟨v i, hv i⟩)
      l.toDFinsupp
  have ha : a = 0 := by
    apply hp.dfinsupp_lsum_injective
    rwa [← lsum_comp_mapRange_toSpanSingleton _ hv] at hl
  ext i
  apply smul_left_injective R (hv' i)
  have : l i • v i = a i := rfl
  simp only [coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, smul_eq_zero, ha] at this
  simpa

name: iSupIndep_iff_linearIndependent_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_iff_linearIndependent_of_ne_zero [IsDomain R] [IsTorsionFree R N]
    {ι : Type*} {v : ι → N} (h_ne_zero : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) :
    iSupIndep (R ∙ v ·) ↔ LinearIndependent R v where
  mp hv
proof:
:= hv.linearIndependent _ (fun i => Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self <| v i) h_ne_zero
  mpr hv := hv.iSupIndep_span_singleton

name: coevaluation_apply_one
statement:
theorem coevaluation_apply_one :
    (coevaluation K V) (1 : K) =
      let bV
proof:
:= Basis.ofVectorSpace K V
      ∑ i : Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex K V, bV i ⊗ₜ[K] bV.coord i := by
  simp only [coevaluation]
  rw [(Basis.singleton Unit K).constr_apply_fintype K]
  simp only [Fintype.univ_punit, Finset.sum_const, one_smul, Basis.singleton_repr,
    Basis.equivFun_apply, Basis.coe_ofVectorSpace, Finset.card_singleton]

name: contractLeft_assoc_coevaluation
statement:
theorem contractLeft_assoc_coevaluation :
    (contractLeft K V).rTensor _ ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc K _ _ _).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          (coevaluation K V).lTensor (Module.Dual K V) =
      (TensorProduct.lid K _).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.rid K _).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  let := Classical.decEq (Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex K V)
  apply TensorProduct.ext
  apply (Basis.ofVectorSpace K V).dualBasis.ext; intro j; apply LinearMap.ext_ring
  rw [LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap]
  rw [rid_tmul, one_smul, lid_symm_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, coevaluation_apply_one]
  rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sum, map_sum]; simp only [assoc_symm_tmul]
  rw [map_sum]; simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, contractLeft_apply]
  simp only [Basis.coe_dualBasis, Basis.coord_apply, Basis.repr_self_apply, TensorProduct.ite_tmul]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']; simp only [Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]

name: contractLeft_assoc_coevaluation'
statement:
theorem contractLeft_assoc_coevaluation' :
    (contractLeft K V).lTensor _ ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc K _ _ _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (coevaluation K V).rTensor V =
      (TensorProduct.rid K _).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.lid K _).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  let := Classical.decEq (Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex K V)
  apply TensorProduct.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext_ring; apply (Basis.ofVectorSpace K V).ext; intro j
  rw [LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, LinearMap.compr₂ₛₗ_apply, TensorProduct.mk_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap]
  rw [lid_tmul, one_smul, rid_symm_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, coevaluation_apply_one]
  rw [TensorProduct.sum_tmul, map_sum]; simp only [assoc_tmul]
  rw [map_sum]; simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, contractLeft_apply]
  simp only [Basis.coord_apply, Basis.repr_self_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_ite]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]; simp only [Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]

name: Countable.of_moduleFinite
statement: theorem Countable.of_moduleFinite [Countable R] [Module.Finite R M] : Countable M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, s, h⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin (R := R) (M := M)
  rw [← Set.countable_univ_iff]
  have : Countable (Submodule.span R (Set.range s)) := inferInstance
  rwa [h] at this

name: Uncountable.of_moduleFinite

proof:
:= by

  exact (uncountable_iff_not_countable _).mp hM <| Countable.of_moduleFinite (R := R)

name: rank_eq
statement:
theorem rank_eq [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] :
    Module.rank R (FreeAlgebra R X) = Cardinal.lift.{u} (Cardinal.mk (List X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (Basis.mk_eq_rank'.{_, _, _, u} (basisFreeMonoid R X)).trans (Cardinal.lift_id _),

name: Algebra.rank_adjoin_le
statement:
theorem Algebra.rank_adjoin_le {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [Ring S] [Algebra R S]
    (s : Set S) : Module.rank R (adjoin R s) ≤ max #s ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjoin_eq_range_freeAlgebra_lift]
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · rw [rank_subsingleton]; exact one_le_aleph0.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  rw [← lift_le.{max u v}]
  refine (lift_rank_range_le (FreeAlgebra.lift R ((↑) : s → S)).toLinearMap).trans ?_
  rw [FreeAlgebra.rank_eq, lift_id'.{v, u}, lift_umax.{v, u}, lift_le, max_comm]
  exact mk_list_le_max _

statement:
lemma dualSubmoduleToDual_injective [IsDomain R] (hB : B.Nondegenerate) [IsTorsionFree R S]
    (N : Submodule R M) (hN : Submodule.span S (N : Set M) = ⊤) :
    Function.Injective (B.dualSubmoduleToDual N)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y e
  ext
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp hB.ker_eq_bot
  apply LinearMap.ext_on hN
  intro z hz
  simpa using congr_arg (algebraMap R S) (LinearMap.congr_fun e ⟨z, hz⟩)

name: dualSubmodule_span_of_basis
statement:
lemma dualSubmodule_span_of_basis {ι} [Finite ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (hB : B.Nondegenerate) (b : Basis ι S M) :
    B.dualSubmodule (Submodule.span R (Set.range b)) =
      Submodule.span R (Set.range <| B.dualBasis hB b)
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    rw [← (B.dualBasis hB b).sum_repr x]
    apply sum_mem
    rintro i -
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp <| hx (b i) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩)
    simp only [dualBasis_repr_apply, ← hr, algebraMap_smul]
    apply Submodule.smul_mem
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩ y hy
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).mp hy
    simp only [map_sum]
    apply sum_mem
    rintro j -
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul S (f j), map_smul]
    simp_rw [apply_dualBasis_left]
    rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, ← (algebraMap R S).map_zero, ← apply_ite]
    exact Submodule.mem_one.mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: dualSubmodule_dualSubmodule_flip_of_basis
statement:
lemma dualSubmodule_dualSubmodule_flip_of_basis {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]

      Submodule.span R (Set.range b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := b.finiteDimensional_of_finite
  rw [dualSubmodule_span_of_basis _ hB.flip, dualSubmodule_span_of_basis B hB,
    dualBasis_dualBasis_flip hB]

proof:

  classical

  rw [dualSubmodule_span_of_basis B hB, dualSubmodule_span_of_basis _ hB.flip,
    dualBasis_flip_dualBasis hB]

name: dualSubmodule_dualSubmodule_of_basis

name: isOrtho_smul_left
statement:
@[deprecated "`BilinMap.IsOrtho` has been deprecated" (since := "2026-03-30")]

proof:

name: linearIndependent_of_iIsOrtho
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_of_iIsOrtho {n : Type w} {B : BilinForm K V} {v : n → V}
    (hv₁ : B.iIsOrtho v) (hv₂ : ∀ i, B (v i) (v i) ≠ 0) : LinearIndependent K v
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s w hs i hi
  have : B (s.sum fun i : n => w i • v i) (v i) = 0 := by rw [hs, zero_left]
  have hsum : (s.sum fun j : n => w j * B (v j) (v i)) = w i * B (v i) (v i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i hi
    intro j _ hij
    rw [iIsOrtho_def.1 hv₁ _ _ hij, mul_zero]
  simp_rw [sum_left, smul_left, hsum] at this
  exact eq_zero_of_ne_zero_of_mul_right_eq_zero (hv₂ i) this

name: toLin_restrict_ker_eq_inf_ker
statement:
theorem toLin_restrict_ker_eq_inf_ker (B : BilinForm K V) (W : Subspace K V) :
    (LinearMap.ker <| B.domRestrict W).map W.subtype = W ⊓ B.ker
proof:
:= by
  ext x; constructor <;> intro hx
  · rcases hx with ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hker, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · simp [hx]
    · simpa
  · simp_rw [Submodule.mem_map, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx.1⟩, hx.right, rfl⟩

name: toLin_restrict_ker_eq_inf_orthogonal
statement:
theorem toLin_restrict_ker_eq_inf_orthogonal (B : BilinForm K V) (W : Subspace K V) (b : B.IsRefl) :
    (LinearMap.ker <| B.domRestrict W).map W.subtype = W ⊓ B.orthogonal ⊤

name: toLin_restrict_range_dualCoannihilator_eq_orthogonal
statement:
theorem toLin_restrict_range_dualCoannihilator_eq_orthogonal (B : BilinForm K V)
    (W : Subspace K V) :
    (LinearMap.range (B.domRestrict W)).dualCoannihilator = B.orthogonal W
proof:
:= by
  ext x; constructor <;> rw [mem_orthogonal_iff] <;> intro hx
  · intro y hy
    rw [Submodule.mem_dualCoannihilator] at hx
    exact hx (B.domRestrict W ⟨y, hy⟩) ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩
  · rw [Submodule.mem_dualCoannihilator]
    rintro _ ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hx w hw

name: ker_restrict_eq_of_codisjoint
statement:
lemma ker_restrict_eq_of_codisjoint {p q : Submodule R M} (hpq : Codisjoint p q)
    {B : LinearMap.BilinForm R M} (hB : ∀ x ∈ p, ∀ y ∈ q, B x y = 0) :
    LinearMap.ker (B.restrict p) = (LinearMap.ker B).comap p.subtype
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨z, hz⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · ext w
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Submodule.codisjoint_iff_exists_add_eq.mp hpq w
    simpa [hB z hz y hy] using LinearMap.congr_fun h ⟨x, hx⟩
  · ext ⟨x, hx⟩
    simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: inf_orthogonal_self_le_ker_restrict
statement:
lemma inf_orthogonal_self_le_ker_restrict {W : Submodule R M} (b₁ : B.IsRefl) :
    W ⊓ B.orthogonal W ≤ (LinearMap.ker <| B.restrict W).map W.subtype
proof:
:= by
  rintro v ⟨hv : v ∈ W, hv' : v ∈ B.orthogonal W⟩
  simp only [Submodule.mem_map, mem_ker, restrict_apply, Submodule.coe_subtype, Subtype.exists,
    exists_and_left, exists_prop, exists_eq_right_right]
  refine ⟨?_, hv⟩
  ext ⟨w, hw⟩
  exact b₁ w v <| hv' w hw

name: finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal'
statement:
theorem finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal' (W : Submodule K V) :
    finrank K W + finrank K (B.orthogonal W) =
      finrank K V + finrank K (W ⊓ B.ker : Subspace K V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toLin_restrict_ker_eq_inf_ker _ _, ←
    toLin_restrict_range_dualCoannihilator_eq_orthogonal _ _, finrank_map_subtype_eq]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← @Subspace.finrank_add_finrank_dualCoannihilator_eq K V _ _ _ _
        (LinearMap.range (B.domRestrict W)),
      add_comm, ← add_assoc, add_comm (finrank K (LinearMap.ker (B.domRestrict W))),
      LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker]

name: finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
statement:
theorem finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal (b₁ : B.IsRefl) (W : Submodule K V) :
    finrank K W + finrank K (B.orthogonal W) =
      finrank K V + finrank K (W ⊓ B.orthogonal ⊤ : Subspace K V)

name: finrank_orthogonal
statement:
lemma finrank_orthogonal (hB : B.Nondegenerate) (W : Submodule K V) :
    finrank K (B.orthogonal W) = finrank K V - finrank K W
proof:
:= by
  have := finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal' (B := B) W
  rw [hB.ker_eq_bot, inf_bot_eq, finrank_bot, add_zero] at this
  lia

name: orthogonal_orthogonal
statement:
lemma orthogonal_orthogonal (hB : B.Nondegenerate) (hB₀ : B.IsRefl) (W : Submodule K V) :
    B.orthogonal (B.orthogonal W) = W
proof:
:= by
  apply (eq_of_le_of_finrank_le (LinearMap.BilinForm.le_orthogonal_orthogonal hB₀) _).symm
  simp only [finrank_orthogonal hB]
  lia

name: isCompl_orthogonal_iff_disjoint
statement:
lemma isCompl_orthogonal_iff_disjoint (hB₀ : B.IsRefl) :
    IsCompl W (B.orthogonal W) ↔ Disjoint W (B.orthogonal W)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨IsCompl.disjoint, fun h ↦ ⟨h, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [codisjoint_iff]
  apply (eq_top_of_finrank_eq <| (finrank_le _).antisymm _)
  calc
    finrank K V ≤ finrank K V + finrank K ↥(W ⊓ B.orthogonal ⊤) := le_self_add
    _ ≤ finrank K ↥(W ⊔ B.orthogonal W) + finrank K ↥(W ⊓ B.orthogonal W) := ?_
    _ ≤ finrank K ↥(W ⊔ B.orthogonal W) := by simp [h.eq_bot]
  rw [finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq, finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal hB₀ W]

name: isCompl_orthogonal_of_restrict_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem isCompl_orthogonal_of_restrict_nondegenerate
    (b₁ : B.IsRefl) (b₂ : (B.restrict W).Nondegenerate) : IsCompl W (B.orthogonal W)
proof:
:= by
  have : W ⊓ B.orthogonal W = ⊥ := by
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := mem_inf.1 hx
    refine Subtype.mk_eq_mk.1 (b₂.1 ⟨x, hx₁⟩ ?_)
    rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    simp only [restrict_apply, domRestrict_apply]
    exact b₁ n x (b₁ x n (b₁ n x (hx₂ n hn)))
  refine IsCompl.of_eq this (eq_top_of_finrank_eq <| (finrank_le _).antisymm ?_)
  conv_rhs => rw [← add_zero (finrank K _)]
  rw [← finrank_bot K V, ← this, finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq,
    finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal b₁]
  exact le_self_add

name: restrict_nondegenerate_iff_isCompl_orthogonal
statement:
theorem restrict_nondegenerate_iff_isCompl_orthogonal
    (b₁ : B.IsRefl) : (B.restrict W).Nondegenerate ↔ IsCompl W (B.orthogonal W)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun b₂ => isCompl_orthogonal_of_restrict_nondegenerate b₁ b₂, fun h =>
    B.nondegenerate_restrict_of_disjoint_orthogonal b₁ h.1⟩

name: orthogonal_eq_top_iff
statement:
lemma orthogonal_eq_top_iff (b₁ : B.IsRefl) (b₂ : (B.restrict W).Nondegenerate) :
    B.orthogonal W = ⊤ ↔ W = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by simp [h]⟩
  have := (B.isCompl_orthogonal_of_restrict_nondegenerate b₁ b₂).inf_eq_bot
  rwa [h, inf_top_eq] at this

name: eq_top_of_restrict_nondegenerate_of_orthogonal_eq_bot
statement:
lemma eq_top_of_restrict_nondegenerate_of_orthogonal_eq_bot
    (b₁ : B.IsRefl) (b₂ : (B.restrict W).Nondegenerate) (b₃ : B.orthogonal W = ⊥) :
    W = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have := (B.isCompl_orthogonal_of_restrict_nondegenerate b₁ b₂).sup_eq_top
  rwa [b₃, sup_bot_eq] at this

name: orthogonal_eq_bot_iff
statement:
lemma orthogonal_eq_bot_iff
    (b₁ : B.IsRefl) (b₂ : (B.restrict W).Nondegenerate) (b₃ : B.Nondegenerate) :
    B.orthogonal W = ⊥ ↔ W = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨eq_top_of_restrict_nondegenerate_of_orthogonal_eq_bot b₁ b₂, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [h, eq_bot_iff]
  exact fun x hx ↦ b₃.1 x fun y ↦ b₁ y x <| by simpa using! hx y

name: restrict_nondegenerate_orthogonal_spanSingleton
statement:
theorem restrict_nondegenerate_orthogonal_spanSingleton (B : BilinForm K V) (b₁ : B.Nondegenerate)
    (b₂ : B.IsRefl) {x : V} (hx : B x x ≠ 0) :
    Nondegenerate <| B.restrict <| B.orthogonal (K ∙ x)
proof:
:= by
  have (n : V) : n ∈ K ∙ x ⊔ B.orthogonal (K ∙ x) :=
    (span_singleton_sup_orthogonal_eq_top hx).symm ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  refine ⟨fun m hm => Submodule.coe_eq_zero.1 (b₁.1 m fun n ↦ ?_),
    fun m hm => Submodule.coe_eq_zero.1 (b₁.2 m fun n ↦ ?_)⟩ <;>
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 <| this n
  · rw [add_right, b₂ y m <| m.2 y hy, show B m z = 0 from hm ⟨z, hz⟩, add_zero]
  · rw [add_left, m.2 y hy, show B z m = 0 from hm ⟨z, hz⟩, add_zero]
