theorem isSymm_iff_flip : B.IsSymm ↔ flipHom B = B where
  mp
proof:
:= fun ⟨h⟩ ↦ by ext; simp [h]
  mpr h := ⟨fun x y ↦ by rw [← flip_apply, h]⟩

name: IsSymm.polarization
statement:
lemma IsSymm.polarization (x y : M) (hB : B.IsSymm) :
    B x y = (B (x + y) (x + y) - B x x - B y y) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  rw [hB.eq y x]
  ring_nf
  rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ two_ne_zero, mul_one]

name: ext_of_isSymm
statement:
lemma ext_of_isSymm (hB : IsSymm B) (hC : IsSymm C)
    (h : ∀ x, B x x = C x x) : B = C
proof:
:= by
  ext x y
  rw [hB.polarization, hC.polarization]
  simp_rw [h]

name: ext_iff_of_isSymm
statement:

    B = C ↔ ∀ x, B x x = C x x where
  mp h
proof:
:= by simp [h]
  mpr := ext_of_isSymm hB hC

name: isSymm_iff_basis
statement:
lemma isSymm_iff_basis {ι : Type*} (b : Basis ι R M) :
    IsSymm B ↔ ∀ i j, B (b i) (b j) = B (b j) (b i) where
  mp
proof:
:= fun ⟨h⟩ i j ↦ h _ _
  mpr := by
    refine fun h ↦ ⟨fun x y ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨fx, tx, ix, -, hx⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_iff_exists_finset_subset.1
      (by simp : x ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range b))
    obtain ⟨fy, ty, iy, -, hy⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_iff_exists_finset_subset.1
      (by simp : y ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range b))
    rw [← hx, ← hy]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b₁ h₁ ↦ Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b₂ h₂ ↦ ?_)
    rw [mul_left_comm]
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ix h₁
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := iy h₂
    rw [h]

:= by
  have := b.finiteDimensional_of_finite
  rw [dualBasis, Basis.map_apply, Basis.coe_dualBasis, ← toDual_def hB,

proof:
:= by
  ext i
  refine LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp hB.ker_eq_bot ((B.flip.dualBasis hB.flip b).ext (fun j ↦ ?_))
  simp_rw [apply_dualBasis_left, ← B.flip_apply, apply_dualBasis_left, @eq_comm _ i j]

    fun h ↦ funext fun _ ↦ (B.dualBasis hB b).ext_elem_iff.mpr fun _ ↦ by

    B.isAdjointPair_unique_of_nondegenerate b φ ψ _ h

name: prodEquivTensorForwardAux_apply_mul
statement:
private lemma prodEquivTensorForwardAux_apply_mul (m : M × N) :
    (prodEquivTensorForwardAux R M N) m * (prodEquivTensorForwardAux R M N) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  let a : ⋀[R]^1 M := ⟨ι R m.1, by simp⟩
  let b : ⋀[R]^1 N := ⟨ι R m.2, by simp⟩
  have h : prodEquivTensorForwardAux R M N m = a.val ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] 1 + 1 ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b.val := rfl
  rw [h, add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_one_mul_coe_tmul,
    GradedTensorProduct.tmul_one_mul_one_tmul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_coe_tmul,
    GradedTensorProduct.tmul_coe_mul_one_tmul]
  simp [a, b, mul_one, one_mul, Units.neg_smul, one_smul, GradedTensorProduct.tmul,
    TensorProduct.zero_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]

name: map_inl_inr_anticomm
statement:
lemma map_inl_inr_anticomm (i j : ℕ) (a : ⋀[R]^i M) (b : ⋀[R]^j N) :
    (map (LinearMap.inl R M N)) a * (map (LinearMap.inr R M N)) b =
      (-1) ^ (j * i) • ((map (LinearMap.inr R M N)) b * (map (LinearMap.inl R M N)) a)
proof:
:= by
  have amem : a.1 ∈ ⋀[R]^i M := a.2
  have bmem : b.1 ∈ ⋀[R]^j N := b.2
  rw [← (Submodule.ext_iff.mp (ιMulti_span_fixedDegree R _))] at amem bmem
  refine Submodule.span_induction₂ (p := fun x y hx hy ↦
    (map (LinearMap.inl R M N)) x * (map (LinearMap.inr R M N)) y =
      (-1) ^ (j * i) • ((map (LinearMap.inr R M N)) y * (map (LinearMap.inl R M N)) x))
        ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ amem bmem
  · rintro x y ⟨mx, rfl⟩ ⟨my, rfl⟩
    rw [map_apply_ιMulti, map_apply_ιMulti]
    exact ιMulti_mul_ιMulti_anticomm R _ _
  all_goals simp +contextual [add_mul, mul_add]

name: hom_ext
induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction {C : ExteriorAlgebra R M → Prop}
    (algebraMap : ∀ r, C (algebraMap R (ExteriorAlgebra R M) r)) (ι : ∀ x, C (ι R x))
    (mul : ∀ a b, C a → C b → C (a * b)) (add : ∀ a b, C a → C b → C (a + b))
    (a : ExteriorAlgebra R M) : C a
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.induction algebraMap ι mul add a

name: map_comp_map

theorem map_comp_map (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] N') :

name: toTrivSqZeroExt_comp_map
statement:
theorem toTrivSqZeroExt_comp_map [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [IsCentralScalar R M] [Module Rᵐᵒᵖ N]
    [IsCentralScalar R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    toTrivSqZeroExt.comp (map f) = (TrivSqZeroExt.map f).comp toTrivSqZeroExt
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_toLinearMap, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_apply_ι, toTrivSqZeroExt_ι, TrivSqZeroExt.map_inr, forall_const]

name: leftInverse_map_iff

proof:

statement:

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h y ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ CliffordAlgebra.map_surjective _ h⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h (ι R y)
  existsi ιInv x
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← ιInv_comp_map, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  simp [hx, ιInv]

name: GradedAlgebra.
statement:
theorem GradedAlgebra.ι_apply (m : M) :
    GradedAlgebra.ι R M m =
      DirectSum.of (fun i : ℕ => ⋀[R]^i M) 1
        ⟨ι R m, by simpa only [pow_one] using LinearMap.mem_range_self _ m⟩

name: GradedAlgebra.
statement: theorem GradedAlgebra.ι_sq_zero (m : M) : GradedAlgebra.ι R M m * GradedAlgebra.ι R M m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GradedAlgebra.ι_apply, DirectSum.of_mul_of]
  exact DFinsupp.single_eq_zero.mpr (Subtype.ext <| ExteriorAlgebra.ι_sq_zero _)

name: GradedAlgebra.lift
statement:
theorem GradedAlgebra.liftι_eq (i : ℕ) (x : ⋀[R]^i M) :
    GradedAlgebra.liftι R M x = DirectSum.of (fun i => ⋀[R]^i M) i x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  dsimp only [Subtype.coe_mk, DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
  induction hx using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap => simp_rw [AlgHom.commutes, DirectSum.algebraMap_apply]; rfl
  | add _ _ _ _ _ ihx ihy => simp_rw [map_add, ihx, ihy, ← map_add]; rfl
  | mem_mul _ hm _ _ _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := hm
      simp_rw [map_mul, ih, GradedAlgebra.liftι, lift_ι_apply, GradedAlgebra.ι_apply R M,
        DirectSum.of_mul_of]
      exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq (Sigma.subtype_ext (add_comm _ _) rfl)

lemma basis_apply_powersetCard :

statement:
lemma basis_mul_of_not_disjoint (h : ¬Disjoint s.val t.val) :
    b.ExteriorAlgebra s * b.ExteriorAlgebra t = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [basis_apply_powersetCard] using ιMulti_family_mul_of_not_disjoint R b s t h

name: basis_mul_of_disjoint
statement:
lemma basis_mul_of_disjoint (h : Disjoint s.val t.val) :
    b.ExteriorAlgebra s * b.ExteriorAlgebra t =
      (permOfDisjoint h).sign • b.ExteriorAlgebra (disjUnion h)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [basis_apply_powersetCard] using ιMulti_family_mul_of_disjoint R b s t h

name: liftAlternating_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAlternating_ι (f : ∀ i, M [⋀^Fin i]→ₗ[R] N) (m : M) :
    liftAlternating (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) f (ι R m) = f 1 ![m]
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [liftAlternating]
  rw [foldl_ι, LinearMap.mk₂_apply, AlternatingMap.curryLeft_apply_apply]
  congr!

name: liftAlternating_
statement:
theorem liftAlternating_ι_mul (f : ∀ i, M [⋀^Fin i]→ₗ[R] N) (m : M)
    (x : ExteriorAlgebra R M) :
    liftAlternating (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) f (ι R m * x) =
    liftAlternating (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) (fun i => (f i.succ).curryLeft m) x

name: liftAlternating_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAlternating_one (f : ∀ i, M [⋀^Fin i]→ₗ[R] N) :
    liftAlternating (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) f (1 : ExteriorAlgebra R M) = f 0 0

name: liftAlternating_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAlternating_algebraMap (f : ∀ i, M [⋀^Fin i]→ₗ[R] N) (r : R) :
    liftAlternating (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) f (algebraMap _ (ExteriorAlgebra R M) r) =
    r • f 0 0

name: liftAlternating_apply_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAlternating_apply_ιMulti {n : ℕ} (f : ∀ i, M [⋀^Fin i]→ₗ[R] N)
    (v : Fin n → M) : liftAlternating (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) f (ιMulti R n v) = f n v
proof:
:= by
  rw [ιMulti_apply]
  induction n generalizing f with
  | zero => rw [List.ofFn_zero, List.prod_nil, liftAlternating_one, Subsingleton.elim 0 v]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ, List.prod_cons, liftAlternating_ι_mul, ih,
      AlternatingMap.curryLeft_apply_apply]
    congr
    exact Matrix.cons_head_tail _

name: liftAlternating_comp_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAlternating_comp_ιMulti {n : ℕ} (f : ∀ i, M [⋀^Fin i]→ₗ[R] N) :
    (liftAlternating (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) f).compAlternatingMap (ιMulti R n) = f n

name: liftAlternating_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAlternating_comp (g : N →ₗ[R] N') (f : ∀ i, M [⋀^Fin i]→ₗ[R] N) :
    (liftAlternating (R := R) (M := M) (N := N') fun i => g.compAlternatingMap (f i)) =
    g ∘ₗ liftAlternating (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) f
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  induction v using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction generalizing f with
  | algebraMap =>
    rw [liftAlternating_algebraMap, liftAlternating_algebraMap, map_smul,
      LinearMap.compAlternatingMap_apply]
  | add _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | ι_mul _ _ hx =>
    rw [liftAlternating_ι_mul, liftAlternating_ι_mul, ← hx]
    simp_rw [AlternatingMap.curryLeft_compAlternatingMap]

name: liftAlternating_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftAlternating_ιMulti :
    liftAlternating (R := R) (M := M) (N := ExteriorAlgebra R M) (ιMulti R) =
    (LinearMap.id : ExteriorAlgebra R M →ₗ[R] ExteriorAlgebra R M)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  dsimp
  induction v using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap => rw [liftAlternating_algebraMap, ιMulti_zero_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | add _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy]
  | ι_mul _ _ hx => simp_rw [liftAlternating_ι_mul, ιMulti_succ_curryLeft, liftAlternating_comp,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, hx]

name: lhom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem lhom_ext ⦃f g : ExteriorAlgebra R M →ₗ[R] N⦄
    (h : ∀ i, f.compAlternatingMap (ιMulti R i) = g.compAlternatingMap (ιMulti R i)) : f = g

name: independent_iff
statement: theorem independent_iff : Independent f ↔ LinearIndependent K (Projectivization.rep ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨ff, hff, hh⟩
    choose a ha using fun i : ι => exists_smul_eq_mk_rep K (ff i) (hff i)
    convert! hh.units_smul a
    ext i
    exact (ha i).symm
  · convert! Independent.mk _ _ h
    · simp only [mk_rep, Function.comp_apply]
    · intro i
      apply rep_nonzero

name: independent_iff_iSupIndep
statement: theorem independent_iff_iSupIndep : Independent f ↔ iSupIndep fun i => (f i).submodule
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hi⟩
    simp only [submodule_mk]
    exact (iSupIndep_iff_linearIndependent_of_ne_zero (R := K) hf).mpr hi
  · rw [independent_iff]
    refine h.linearIndependent (Projectivization.submodule ∘ f) (fun i => ?_) fun i => ?_
    · simpa only [Function.comp_apply, submodule_eq] using Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
    · exact rep_nonzero (f i)

name: dependent_iff
statement: theorem dependent_iff : Dependent f ↔ ¬LinearIndependent K (Projectivization.rep ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨ff, hff, hh1⟩
    contrapose hh1
    choose a ha using fun i : ι => exists_smul_eq_mk_rep K (ff i) (hff i)
    convert! hh1.units_smul a⁻¹
    ext i
    simp only [← ha, inv_smul_smul, Pi.smul_apply', Pi.inv_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  · convert! Dependent.mk _ _ h
    · simp only [mk_rep, Function.comp_apply]
    · exact fun i => rep_nonzero (f i)

name: dependent_iff_not_independent
statement: theorem dependent_iff_not_independent : Dependent f ↔ ¬Independent f

name: independent_iff_not_dependent
statement: theorem independent_iff_not_dependent : Independent f ↔ ¬Dependent f

name: dependent_pair_iff_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dependent_pair_iff_eq (u v : ℙ K V) : Dependent ![u, v] ↔ u = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [dependent_iff_not_independent, independent_iff, linearIndependent_fin2]
  dsimp only [Function.comp_def, Matrix.cons_val]
  simp only [not_and, not_forall, not_not, ← mk_eq_mk_iff' K _ _ (rep_nonzero u) (rep_nonzero v),
    mk_rep, Classical.imp_iff_right_iff]
  exact Or.inl (rep_nonzero v)

name: independent_pair_iff_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem independent_pair_iff_ne (u v : ℙ K V) : Independent ![u, v] ↔ u ≠ v

name: independent_mk_iff_LinearIndependent
statement:
lemma independent_mk_iff_LinearIndependent {u v : V} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Independent ![mk K u hu, mk K v hv] ↔ LinearIndependent K ![u, v]
proof:
:= by
  rw [independent_pair_iff_ne, ne_eq, mk_eq_mk_iff' K u v hu hv, linearIndependent_fin2]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨hv, fun a ha ↦ h ⟨a, ha⟩⟩, fun ⟨_, h⟩ ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ h a ha⟩

name: mk'_eq_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk'_eq_mk (v : { v : V // v ≠ 0 }) : mk' K v = mk K ↑v v.2

name: lift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
protected lemma lift_mk {α : Type*} (f : { v : V // v ≠ 0 } → α)
    (hf : ∀ (a b : { v : V // v ≠ 0 }) (t : K), a = t • (b : V) → f a = f b)
    (v : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Projectivization.lift f hf (mk K v hv) = f ⟨v, hv⟩

name: rep_nonzero
statement: theorem rep_nonzero (v : ℙ K V) : v.rep ≠ 0

name: mk_rep
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_rep (v : ℙ K V) : mk K v.rep v.rep_nonzero = v

name: mk_eq_mk_iff
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff (v w : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    mk K v hv = mk K w hw ↔ ∃ a : Kˣ, a • w = v

name: mk_eq_mk_iff'
statement:
theorem mk_eq_mk_iff' (v w : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    mk K v hv = mk K w hw ↔ ∃ a : K, a • w = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_mk_iff K v w hv hw]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    refine ⟨Units.mk0 a fun c => hv.symm ?_, ha⟩
    rwa [c, zero_smul] at ha

name: exists_smul_eq_mk_rep
statement: theorem exists_smul_eq_mk_rep (v : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) : ∃ a : Kˣ, a • v = (mk K v hv).rep

name: ind
statement:
@[elab_as_elim, cases_eliminator, induction_eliminator]
theorem ind {P : ℙ K V → Prop} (h : ∀ (v : V) (h : v ≠ 0), P (mk K v h)) : ∀ p, P p

name: submodule_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem submodule_mk (v : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) : (mk K v hv).submodule = K ∙ v

name: submodule_eq
statement: theorem submodule_eq (v : ℙ K V) : v.submodule = K ∙ v.rep

name: finrank_submodule
statement: theorem finrank_submodule (v : ℙ K V) : finrank K v.submodule = 1

name: submodule_injective
statement:
theorem submodule_injective :
    Function.Injective (Projectivization.submodule : ℙ K V → Submodule K V)
proof:
:= fun u v h ↦ by
  induction u using ind with | h u hu =>
  induction v using ind with | h v hv =>
  rw [submodule_mk, submodule_mk, Submodule.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton] at h
  exact ((mk_eq_mk_iff K v u hv hu).2 h).symm

name: submodule_mk''
statement:
@[simp]
theorem submodule_mk'' (H : Submodule K V) (h : finrank K H = 1) : (mk'' H h).submodule = H

name: mk''_submodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk''_submodule (v : ℙ K V) : mk'' v.submodule v.finrank_submodule = v

name: map_mk
statement:
theorem map_mk {σ : K →+* L} (f : V →ₛₗ[σ] W) (hf : Function.Injective f) (v : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    map f hf (mk K v hv) = mk L (f v) (map_zero f ▸ hf.ne hv)

name: map_injective
statement:
theorem map_injective {σ : K →+* L} {τ : L →+* K} [RingHomInvPair σ τ] (f : V →ₛₗ[σ] W)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective (map f hf)
proof:
:= fun u v h ↦ by
  induction u using ind with | h u hu => induction v using ind with | h v hv =>
  simp only [map_mk, mk_eq_mk_iff'] at h ⊢
  rcases h with ⟨a, ha⟩
  refine ⟨τ a, hf ?_⟩
  rwa [f.map_smulₛₗ, RingHomInvPair.comp_apply_eq₂]

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[K] V) (LinearEquiv.refl K V).injective = id

name: map_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comp {F U : Type*} [DivisionRing F] [AddCommGroup U] [Module F U] {σ : K →+* L}
    {τ : L →+* F} {γ : K →+* F} [RingHomCompTriple σ τ γ] (f : V →ₛₗ[σ] W)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (g : W →ₛₗ[τ] U) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hgf : Function.Injective (g.comp f) := hg.comp hf) :
    map (g.comp f) hgf = map g hg ∘ map f hf

name: linearIndependent_pair_iff_ne
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_pair_iff_ne {D D' : ℙ K V} :
  LinearIndependent K ![D.rep, D'.rep] ↔ D ≠ D'
proof:
:= by
    rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff' (rep_nonzero _)]
    refine ⟨fun h hD ↦ h 1 (by simp [hD]), fun h a hD ↦ h ?_⟩
    rw [eq_comm, ← mk_rep D, ← mk_rep D', mk_eq_mk_iff]
    suffices a ≠ 0 by refine ⟨(Ne.isUnit this).unit, by simp [← hD]⟩
    exact fun ha ↦ D'.rep_nonzero (by simp [← hD, ha])

name: linearIndepOn_pair
statement:
theorem linearIndepOn_pair (D D' : ℙ K V) :
    LinearIndepOn K id {D.rep, D'.rep}
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : D = D'
  · simpa [h] using D'.rep_nonzero
  rw [← ne_eq, ← linearIndependent_pair_iff_ne, LinearIndependent.pair_symm_iff,
    ← linearIndepOn_id_range_iff] at h
  · simpa using h
  · simpa [injective_pair_iff_ne, injective_pair_iff_ne, ne_eq] using h.injective

name: mem_carrier_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_carrier_iff (A : Subspace K V) (x : ℙ K V) : x ∈ A.carrier ↔ x ∈ A

name: mem_add
statement:
theorem mem_add (T : Subspace K V) (v w : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) (hvw : v + w ≠ 0) :
    Projectivization.mk K v hv ∈ T →
      Projectivization.mk K w hw ∈ T → Projectivization.mk K (v + w) hvw ∈ T
proof:
:=
  T.mem_add' v w hv hw hvw

name: subset_span
statement: theorem subset_span (S : Set (ℙ K V)) : S ⊆ span S

name: span_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma span_induction {S : Set (ℙ K V)} {motive : ∀ x, x ∈ span S → Prop}
    (of_mem : ∀ (x) (hx : x ∈ S), motive x (subset_span S hx))
    (add : ∀ (v w : V) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) (hvw : v + w ≠ 0)
      (hv' : Projectivization.mk K v hv ∈ span S)
      (hw' : Projectivization.mk K w hw ∈ span S), motive _ hv' → motive _ hw' →
      motive (Projectivization.mk K (v + w) hvw) ((span S).mem_add v w hv hw hvw hv' hw'))
    {x : ℙ K V} (hx : x ∈ span S) : motive x hx
proof:
:= by
  induction hx with
  | of_mem _ hx => exact of_mem _ hx
  | add v w hv hw hvw _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact add v w hv hw hvw _ _ ih₁ ih₂

name: span_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_coe (W : Subspace K V) : span ↑W = W

name: span_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_empty : span (∅ : Set (ℙ K V)) = ⊥

name: span_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_univ : span (Set.univ : Set (ℙ K V)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, SetLike.le_def]
  intro x _hx
  exact subset_span _ (Set.mem_univ x)

name: span_le_subspace_iff
statement: theorem span_le_subspace_iff {S : Set (ℙ K V)} {W : Subspace K V} : span S ≤ W ↔ S ⊆ W

name: monotone_span
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem monotone_span : Monotone (span : Set (ℙ K V) → Subspace K V)

name: span_le_span
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma span_le_span {s t : Set (ℙ K V)} (hst : s ⊆ t) : span s ≤ span t

name: subset_span_trans
statement:
theorem subset_span_trans {S T U : Set (ℙ K V)} (hST : S ⊆ span T) (hTU : T ⊆ span U) :
    S ⊆ span U

name: span_union
statement: theorem span_union (S T : Set (ℙ K V)) : span (S ∪ T) = span S ⊔ span T

name: span_iUnion
statement: theorem span_iUnion {ι} (s : ι → Set (ℙ K V)) : span (⋃ i, s i) = ⨆ i, span (s i)

name: sup_span
statement: theorem sup_span {S : Set (ℙ K V)} {W : Subspace K V} : W ⊔ span S = span (W ∪ S)

name: span_sup
statement: theorem span_sup {S : Set (ℙ K V)} {W : Subspace K V} : span S ⊔ W = span (S ∪ W)

name: mem_span
statement:
theorem mem_span {S : Set (ℙ K V)} (u : ℙ K V) :
    u ∈ span S ↔ ∀ W : Subspace K V, S ⊆ W → u ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← span_le_subspace_iff]
  exact ⟨fun hu W hW => hW hu, fun W => W (span S) (le_refl _)⟩

name: span_eq_sInf
statement: theorem span_eq_sInf {S : Set (ℙ K V)} : span S = sInf { W : Subspace K V| S ⊆ W }
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp_rw [mem_carrier_iff, mem_span x]
  refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx W hW => ?_⟩
  · rintro W ⟨T, hT, rfl⟩
    exact hx T hT
  · exact (@sInf_le _ _ { W : Subspace K V | S ⊆ ↑W } W hW) hx

name: span_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem span_eq_of_le {S : Set (ℙ K V)} {W : Subspace K V} (hS : S ⊆ W) (hW : W ≤ span S) :
    span S = W

name: span_eq_span_iff
statement: theorem span_eq_span_iff {S T : Set (ℙ K V)} : span S = span T ↔ S ⊆ span T ∧ T ⊆ span S
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h ▸ subset_span S, h.symm ▸ subset_span T⟩, fun h =>
    le_antisymm (span_le_subspace_iff.2 h.1) (span_le_subspace_iff.2 h.2)⟩

name: mem_submodule_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_submodule_iff (s : Projectivization.Subspace K V) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    v ∈ submodule s ↔ Projectivization.mk K v hv ∈ s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h hv, fun h _ => h⟩

name: bot_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bot_coe : ((⊥ : Subspace K V) : Set (Projectivization K V)) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  induction x using ind with | h v hv =>
  rwa [← Subspace.mem_submodule_iff _ hv, Subspace.submodule.map_bot, Submodule.mem_bot]

name: mk_mem_projectivization_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_mem_projectivization_iff (s : Submodule K V) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    Projectivization.mk K v hv ∈ s.projectivization ↔ v ∈ s

name: mem_projectivization_iff_submodule_le
statement:
theorem mem_projectivization_iff_submodule_le (s : Submodule K V) (x : ℙ K V) :
    x ∈ s.projectivization ↔ x.submodule ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  rw [mk_mem_projectivization_iff, Projectivization.submodule_mk,
    Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]

name: finite_iff_of_finite
statement: lemma finite_iff_of_finite [Finite k] : Finite (ℙ k V) ↔ Finite V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ inferInstance⟩
  let e := nonZeroEquivProjectivizationProdUnits k V
  have : Finite { v : V // v ≠ 0 } := Finite.of_equiv _ e.symm
  let eq : { v : V // v ≠ 0 } ⊕ Unit ≃ V :=
    ⟨(Sum.elim Subtype.val (fun _ ↦ 0)), fun v ↦ if h : v = 0 then Sum.inr () else Sum.inl ⟨v, h⟩,
      by intro x; aesop, by intro x; aesop⟩
  exact Finite.of_equiv _ eq

name: card
statement: lemma card : Nat.card V - 1 = Nat.card (ℙ k V) * (Nat.card k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality V
  cases finite_or_infinite k with
  | inr h =>
    have : Infinite V := Module.Free.infinite k V
    simp
  | inl h =>
  cases finite_or_infinite V with
  | inr h =>
    have := not_iff_not.mpr (finite_iff_of_finite k V)
    push Not at this
    have : Infinite (ℙ k V) := by rwa [this]
    simp
  | inl h =>
  classical
  have : Fintype V := Fintype.ofFinite V
  have : Fintype (ℙ k V) := Fintype.ofFinite (ℙ k V)
  have : Fintype k := Fintype.ofFinite k
  have hV : Fintype.card { v : V // v ≠ 0 } = Fintype.card V - 1 := by simp
  simp_rw [← Fintype.card_eq_nat_card, ← Fintype.card_units (α := k), ← hV]
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (nonZeroEquivProjectivizationProdUnits k V), Fintype.card_prod]

name: card'
statement: lemma card' [Finite V] : Nat.card V = Nat.card (ℙ k V) * (Nat.card k - 1) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card k V]
  have : Nat.card V > 0 := Nat.card_pos
  lia

name: card''
statement: lemma card'' [Finite k] : Nat.card (ℙ k V) = (Nat.card V - 1) / (Nat.card k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have : 1 < Nat.card k := Finite.one_lt_card
  rw [card k, Nat.mul_div_cancel]
  lia

name: card_of_finrank
statement:
lemma card_of_finrank [Finite k] {n : ℕ} (h : Module.finrank k V = n) :
    Nat.card (ℙ k V) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Nat.card k ^ i
proof:
:= by
  wlog hf : Finite V
  · have : Infinite (ℙ k V) := by
      contrapose! hf
      rwa [finite_iff_of_finite] at hf
    have : n = 0 := by
      rw [← h]
      apply Module.finrank_of_not_finite
      contrapose hf
      simpa using Module.finite_of_finite k
    simp [this]
  have : 1 < Nat.card k := Finite.one_lt_card
  refine Nat.mul_right_cancel (m := Nat.card k - 1) (by lia) ?_
  let e : V ≃ₗ[k] (Fin n → k) := LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq _ _ (by simpa)
  have hc : Nat.card V = Nat.card k ^ n := by simp [Nat.card_congr e.toEquiv, Nat.card_fun]
  zify
  conv_rhs => rw [Int.natCast_sub this.le, Int.natCast_one, geom_sum_mul]
  rw [← Int.natCast_mul, ← card k V, hc]
  simp

name: card_of_finrank_two
statement:
lemma card_of_finrank_two [Finite k] (h : Module.finrank k V = 2) :
    Nat.card (ℙ k V) = Nat.card k + 1

name: orthogonal_mk
statement:
lemma orthogonal_mk {v w : m → F} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    orthogonal (mk F v hv) (mk F w hw) ↔ v ⬝ᵥ w = 0

name: orthogonal_comm
statement: lemma orthogonal_comm {v w : ℙ F (m → F)} : orthogonal v w ↔ orthogonal w v
proof:
:= by
  induction v with | h v hv => induction w with | h w hw =>
  rw [orthogonal_mk hv hw, orthogonal_mk hw hv, dotProduct_comm]

name: exists_not_self_orthogonal
statement: lemma exists_not_self_orthogonal (v : ℙ F (m → F)) : ∃ w, ¬ orthogonal v w
proof:
:= by
  induction v with | h v hv =>
  rw [ne_eq, ← dotProduct_eq_zero_iff, not_forall] at hv
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hv
  exact ⟨mk F w fun h ↦ hw (by rw [h, dotProduct_zero]), hw⟩

name: exists_not_orthogonal_self
statement: lemma exists_not_orthogonal_self (v : ℙ F (m → F)) : ∃ w, ¬ orthogonal w v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orthogonal_comm]
  exact exists_not_self_orthogonal v

name: mk_eq_mk_iff_crossProduct_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mk_eq_mk_iff_crossProduct_eq_zero {v w : Fin 3 → F} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    mk F v hv = mk F w hw ↔ crossProduct v w = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_iff_not, mk_eq_mk_iff', not_exists, ← LinearIndependent.pair_iff' hw,
    ← crossProduct_ne_zero_iff_linearIndependent, ← cross_anticomm, neg_ne_zero]

name: cross_mk
statement:
lemma cross_mk {v w : Fin 3 → F} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    cross (mk F v hv) (mk F w hw) =
      if h : crossProduct v w = 0 then mk F v hv else mk F (crossProduct v w) h
proof:
:= by
  change Quotient.mk'' _ = _
  split_ifs with h <;> simp only [h] <;> rfl

name: cross_mk_of_cross_eq_zero
statement:
lemma cross_mk_of_cross_eq_zero {v w : Fin 3 → F} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (h : crossProduct v w = 0) :
    cross (mk F v hv) (mk F w hw) = mk F v hv

name: cross_mk_of_cross_ne_zero
statement:
lemma cross_mk_of_cross_ne_zero {v w : Fin 3 → F} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0)
    (h : crossProduct v w ≠ 0) :
    cross (mk F v hv) (mk F w hw) = mk F (crossProduct v w) h

name: cross_self
statement: lemma cross_self (v : ℙ F (Fin 3 → F)) : cross v v = v
proof:
:= by
  induction v with | h v hv =>
  rw [cross_mk_of_cross_eq_zero]
  rw [← mk_eq_mk_iff_crossProduct_eq_zero hv]

name: cross_mk_of_ne
statement:
lemma cross_mk_of_ne {v w : Fin 3 → F} (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w ≠ 0) (h : mk F v hv ≠ mk F w hw) :
    cross (mk F v hv) (mk F w hw) = mk F (crossProduct v w)
      (mt (mk_eq_mk_iff_crossProduct_eq_zero hv hw).mpr h)

name: cross_comm
statement: lemma cross_comm (v w : ℙ F (Fin 3 → F)) : cross v w = cross w v
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne v w with rfl | h
  · rfl
  · induction v with | h v hv =>
    induction w with | h w hw =>
    rw [cross_mk_of_ne hv hw h, cross_mk_of_ne hw hv h.symm, mk_eq_mk_iff_crossProduct_eq_zero,
      ← cross_anticomm v w, map_neg, _root_.cross_self, neg_zero]

name: cross_orthogonal_left
statement:
theorem cross_orthogonal_left {v w : ℙ F (Fin 3 → F)} (h : v ≠ w) :
    (cross v w).orthogonal v
proof:
:= by
  induction v with | h v hv =>
  induction w with | h w hw =>
  rw [cross_mk_of_ne hv hw h, orthogonal_mk, dotProduct_comm, dot_self_cross]

name: cross_orthogonal_right
statement:
theorem cross_orthogonal_right {v w : ℙ F (Fin 3 → F)} (h : v ≠ w) :
    (cross v w).orthogonal w

name: orthogonal_cross_left
statement:
theorem orthogonal_cross_left {v w : ℙ F (Fin 3 → F)} (h : v ≠ w) :
    v.orthogonal (cross v w)

name: orthogonal_cross_right
statement:
lemma orthogonal_cross_right {v w : ℙ F (Fin 3 → F)} (h : v ≠ w) :
    w.orthogonal (cross v w)

name: IsCollinear_iff
statement:
lemma IsCollinear_iff : IsCollinear S ↔ ∃ (M : Subspace K V), Module.Finite K M.submodule ∧
  Module.finrank K M.submodule ≤ 2 ∧ S ⊆ M

name: IsCollinear_iff_rank
statement:
lemma IsCollinear_iff_rank :
    IsCollinear S ↔
      ∃ (M : Subspace K V), Module.rank K M.submodule ≤ 2 ∧ S ⊆ M
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsCollinear_iff]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨M, hM1, hM2, hM3⟩ ↦ ⟨M, ?_, hM3⟩, fun ⟨M, hM1, hM2⟩ ↦ ⟨M, ?_, ?_, hM2⟩⟩
  · exact FiniteDimensional.finrank_le_iff_rank_le (K := K) (V := M.submodule) (n := 2)|>.1 hM2
  · exact Module.rank_lt_aleph0_iff.1 (hM1.trans_lt (by norm_num))
  · exact Module.finrank_le_of_rank_le hM1

name: isCollinear_empty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isCollinear_empty : IsCollinear (∅ : Set (Projectivization K V))

name: isCollinear_subset
statement: lemma isCollinear_subset (s t : Set (ℙ K V)) (hst : s ⊆ t) (h : IsCollinear t) : IsCollinear s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hMfin, hM1, hM2⟩ := h
  exact ⟨M, hMfin, hM1, hst.trans hM2⟩

name: isCollinear_singleton'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma isCollinear_singleton' (a : ℙ K V) : IsCollinear {a}
proof:
:= by
  induction a using ind with | h v hv =>
  refine ⟨(Submodule.span K {v}).projectivization, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Subspace.submodule.apply_symm_apply]
    exact Module.Finite.span_of_finite _ (Set.toFinite _)
  · rw [Subspace.submodule.apply_symm_apply, finrank_span_singleton hv]
    omega
  · simp [Submodule.mem_span_of_mem]

name: isCollinear_subsingleton
statement:
lemma isCollinear_subsingleton (hS : S.Subsingleton) :
    IsCollinear S
proof:
:= by
  obtain hS' | ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS.eq_empty_or_singleton <;> simp_all

name: isCollinear_pair
statement: lemma isCollinear_pair (a b : ℙ K V) : IsCollinear {a, b}
proof:
:= by
  if h : a = b then simp [h] else
  induction a using Projectivization.ind with | h v hv =>
  induction b using Projectivization.ind with | h w hw =>
  rw [← ne_eq, ← independent_pair_iff_ne, independent_mk_iff_LinearIndependent] at h
  refine ⟨(Submodule.span K {v, w}).projectivization, ?_, ?_, fun s hs ↦ hs.casesOn ?_ ?_⟩
  · rw [Subspace.submodule.apply_symm_apply]
    exact Module.Finite.span_of_finite _ (Set.toFinite _)
  · rw [Subspace.submodule.apply_symm_apply, ← Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty v w ![]]
    simp [finrank_span_eq_card h]
  all_goals rintro rfl; simp [Submodule.mem_span_of_mem]

name: isCollinear_of_card_eq_two
statement: lemma isCollinear_of_card_eq_two (hS : S.ncard = 2) : IsCollinear S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, _, rfl⟩ := Set.ncard_eq_two.1 hS
  exact isCollinear_pair x y

name: line_unique'
statement:
lemma line_unique' {u v : V} (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) (huv : LinearIndependent K ![u, v])
    (p : Submodule K V) (hp1 : Module.finrank K p = 2)
    (hp2 : mk K u hu ∈ p.projectivization) (hp3 : mk K v hv ∈ p.projectivization) :
    p = Submodule.span K {u, v}
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Submodule.span K {u, v} ≤ p := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    simp only [Submodule.mk_mem_projectivization_iff] at hp2 hp3
    refine hx.casesOn ?_ ?_ <;> simp_all
  have : Module.Finite K p := Module.finite_of_finrank_eq_succ hp1
  refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq h1 ?_ |>.symm
  rw [hp1, ← Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty _ _ ![]]
  simp [finrank_span_eq_card huv]

name: line_unique
statement:
lemma line_unique {x y : ℙ K V} (hxy : x ≠ y) (p q : Submodule K V) (hp1 : Module.finrank K p = 2)
    (hq1 : Module.finrank K q = 2) (hp2 : x ∈ p.projectivization) (hp3 : y ∈ p.projectivization)
    (hq2 : x ∈ q.projectivization) (hq3 : y ∈ q.projectivization) : p = q
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ind with | h v hv =>
  induction y using ind with | h w hw =>
  rw [← independent_pair_iff_ne, independent_mk_iff_LinearIndependent] at hxy
  rw [line_unique' hv hw hxy p hp1 hp2 hp3, line_unique' hv hw hxy q hq1 hq2 hq3]

name: generalLinearGroup_smul_def
statement:
lemma generalLinearGroup_smul_def (g : LinearMap.GeneralLinearGroup K V) (x : ℙ K V) :
    g • x = x.map g.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap g.toLinearEquiv.injective

name: matrixSpecialLinearGroup_smul_def
statement:
lemma matrixSpecialLinearGroup_smul_def {ι F : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Field F]
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) (x : ℙ F (ι → F)) :
    g • x = g.toLin'_equiv • x

name: smul_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma smul_mk (g : G) {v : V} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    g • mk K v hv = mk K (g • v) ((smul_ne_zero_iff_ne g).mpr hv)

name: specialLinearGroup_smul_def
statement:
theorem specialLinearGroup_smul_def (g : SpecialLinearGroup K V) (D : ℙ K V) :
    g • D = g.toLinearEquiv • D

name: SL_mulAction_ker
statement:
lemma SL_mulAction_ker :
    (MulAction.toPermHom (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι K) (ℙ K (ι → K))).ker =
      Subgroup.center (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι K)
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [MonoidHom.mem_ker, toPermHom_apply, Equiv.Perm.one_def, DFunLike.ext_iff, toPerm_apply,
    Equiv.refl_apply, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mem_center_iff]
  refine ⟨fun hm ↦ ?_, fun ⟨r, hr1, hr2⟩ l ↦ ?_⟩
  · set f : (ι → K) →ₗ[K] ι → K := (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin' m).toLinearMap with hf
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := f.exists_eq_smul_id_of_forall_notLinearIndependent fun (v : ι → K) ↦ by
      by_cases hv : v = 0
      · simp [hv, linearIndependent_fin2]
      · simpa [LinearIndependent.pair_iff' hv, mk_eq_mk_iff'] using! hm (.mk K v hv)
    have hscalar : m.1 = Matrix.scalar ι a := calc
      m.1 = LinearMap.toMatrix' f := by
        rw [hf, Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin'_to_linearMap, LinearMap.toMatrix'_toLin']
      _ = (algebraMap K (Module.End K (ι → K)) a).toMatrix' := congrArg LinearMap.toMatrix' ha
      _ = Matrix.scalar ι a := LinearMap.toMatrix'_algebraMap a
    exact ⟨a, by simpa [hscalar] using m.2, hscalar.symm⟩
  · induction l using Projectivization.ind with | _ v hv =>
    simp only [smul_mk, mk_eq_mk_iff']
    use r
    change _ = m.1 • v
    simp [← hr2]

name: _root_.Matrix.ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup.smul_proj_mk
statement:
lemma _root_.Matrix.ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup.smul_proj_mk (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι K)
    (p : ℙ K (ι → K)) : (g : Matrix.ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup ι K) • p = g • p

name: _root_.Matrix.ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup.toPermHom_injective
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup.toPermHom_injective :
    Function.Injective (PSLAction.toPermHom (K := K) (ι := ι))
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
  intro g hg
  rwa [← MonoidHom.mem_ker, PSLAction.toPermHom,
    QuotientGroup.ker_lift, SL_mulAction_ker, QuotientGroup.map_mk'_self,
    Subgroup.mem_bot] at hg

name: PGL.mk_smul_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma PGL.mk_smul_mk (g : GL ι K) {v : ι → K} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    (.mk g : PGL(ι, K)) • mk K v hv = mk K (g • v) (smul_ne_zero_iff_ne g|>.2 hv)

name: smul_sum
statement:
theorem smul_sum [Zero β] [AddCommMonoid M] [DistribSMul R M] {v : α →₀ β} {c : R} {h : α → β → M} :
    c • v.sum h = v.sum fun a b => c • h a b

name: sum_smul_index_semilinearMap'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_smul_index_semilinearMap' [Semiring R] [Semiring R₂] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module R₂ M₂] {σ : R →+* R₂} {v : α →₀ M} {c : R} {h : α → M →ₛₗ[σ] M₂} :
    ((c • v).sum fun a => h a) = σ c • v.sum fun a => h a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.sum_smul_index', Finsupp.smul_sum]
  · simp only [map_smulₛₗ]
  · intro i
    exact (h i).map_zero

name: sum_smul_index_linearMap'
statement:
theorem sum_smul_index_linearMap' [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [AddCommMonoid M₂]
    [Module R M₂] {v : α →₀ M} {c : R} {h : α → M →ₗ[R] M₂} :
    ((c • v).sum fun a => h a) = c • v.sum fun a => h a

name: coe_lsum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_lsum (f : α → M →ₛₗ[σ] N) : (lsum S f : (α →₀ M) → N) = fun d => d.sum fun i => f i

name: lsum_apply
statement: theorem lsum_apply (f : α → M →ₛₗ[σ] N) (l : α →₀ M) : Finsupp.lsum S f l = l.sum fun b => f b

name: lsum_single
statement:
theorem lsum_single (f : α → M →ₛₗ[σ] N) (i : α) (m : M) :
    Finsupp.lsum S f (Finsupp.single i m) = f i m

name: lsum_comp_lsingle
statement:
@[simp] theorem lsum_comp_lsingle (f : α → M →ₛₗ[σ] N) (i : α) :
    Finsupp.lsum S f ∘ₛₗ lsingle i = f i

name: lsum_symm_apply
statement: theorem lsum_symm_apply (f : (α →₀ M) →ₛₗ[σ] N) (x : α) : (lsum S).symm f x = f.comp (lsingle x)

name: lift_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_symm_apply (f) (x) : ((lift M R X).symm f) x = f (single x 1)

name: lift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_apply (f) (g) : ((lift M R X) f) g = g.sum fun x r => r • f x

name: llift_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem llift_apply (f : X → M) (x : X →₀ R) : llift M R S X f x = lift M R X f x

name: llift_symm_apply
statement:

proof:

    DFinsupp.mapRange.linearMap (fun i ↦ linearCombination R (f i)) ∘ₗ
    (sigmaFinsuppLequivDFinsupp R).toLinearMap := by ext; simp
  rw [LinearIndependent, this]

name: lcomapDomain_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl
statement:
lemma lcomapDomain_eq_linearProjOfIsCompl {α β : Type*}
    {u : α → ι} {v : β → ι} (hu : u.Injective) (h : IsCompl (Set.range u) (Set.range v)) :
    lcomapDomain u hu =
      LinearMap.linearProjOfIsCompl (.span R (Set.range fun x : β ↦ single (v x) (1 : R)))
        (lmapDomain _ _ u) (mapDomain_injective hu) (isCompl_range_lmapDomain_span h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finsupp.basisSingleOne.ext fun i ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩ : i ∈ Set.range u ⊔ .range v := by rw [codisjoint_iff.mp h.2]; trivial
  · have : single (u i) 1 = lmapDomain R R u (.single i 1) := by simp
    simp only [coe_basisSingleOne, lcomapDomain_apply, comapDomain_single]
    rw [this, LinearMap.linearProjOfIsCompl_apply_left]
  · rw [LinearMap.linearProjOfIsCompl_apply_right']
    · ext j
      simp only [coe_basisSingleOne, lcomapDomain_apply, comapDomain_apply, single_apply,
        coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, ite_eq_right_iff]
      intro hij
      exact (Set.disjoint_range_iff.mp h.1 j i hij.symm).elim
    · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: fst_prodOfFinsuppNat
statement: theorem fst_prodOfFinsuppNat (x : ℕ →₀ P) : (prodOfFinsuppNat f x).1 = x 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [prodOfFinsuppNat, coe_lsum, sum, Prod.fst_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0 (fun n _ hn ↦ ?_) (by simp)]
  · simp
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := n.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
  simp [pow_succ']

name: snd_prodOfFinsuppNat
statement:
theorem snd_prodOfFinsuppNat (x : ℕ →₀ P) :
    (prodOfFinsuppNat f x).2 =
    f (prodOfFinsuppNat f <| comapDomain.addMonoidHom (add_left_injective 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [prodOfFinsuppNat, coe_lsum, sum, Prod.snd_sum]
  rw [← Finset.sum_preimage (· + 1) _ (add_left_injective 1).injOn _ (by simp_all)]
  simp [pow_succ']

name: prodOfFinsuppNat_injective
statement: theorem prodOfFinsuppNat_injective (inj : Injective f) : Injective (prodOfFinsuppNat f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  let s := x.support ∪ y.support
  obtain eq | ne := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · simp_all [s]
  set n := s.max' ne with hn
  clear_value n; revert x y
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h n ih =>
  intro x y s _ hn eq
  rw [← x.single_add_erase 0, ← y.single_add_erase 0]
  simp_rw [← mapDomain_comapDomain_nat_add_one, ← f.fst_prodOfFinsuppNat, eq]
  congr 2
  by_contra ne
  apply ne (ih _ _ _ rfl (inj _))
  · contrapose! ne; simp_all [-comapDomain_support]
  · simp +contextual [hn, s, ← Nat.succ_le_iff, Finset.le_max']
  simp_rw [← snd_prodOfFinsuppNat, eq]

proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx

name: range_mapRange_linearMap

proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    simp [← hy]
  · intro hx
    choose y hy using hx
    refine ⟨⟨x.support, y, fun i => ?_⟩, by ext; simp_all⟩
    constructor
    <;> contrapose
    <;> simp_all +contextual [← hy, map_zero, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.1 hf]

theorem lsingle_apply (a : α) (b : M) : (lsingle a : M →ₗ[R] α →₀ M) b = single a b

name: lapply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lapply_apply (a : α) (f : α →₀ M) : (lapply a : (α →₀ M) →ₗ[R] M) f = f a

name: lapply_comp_lsingle_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lapply_comp_lsingle_same (a : α) : lapply a ∘ₗ lsingle a = (.id : M →ₗ[R] M)

name: lapply_comp_lsingle_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lapply_comp_lsingle_of_ne (a a' : α) (h : a ≠ a') :
    lapply a ∘ₗ lsingle a' = (0 : M →ₗ[R] M)

name: lmapDomain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lmapDomain_apply (f : α → α') (l : α →₀ M) :
    (lmapDomain M R f : (α →₀ M) →ₗ[R] α' →₀ M) l = mapDomain f l

name: coe_lmapDomain
statement: lemma coe_lmapDomain (f : α → α') : ⇑(lmapDomain M R f) = Finsupp.mapDomain f

name: lmapDomain_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lmapDomain_id : (lmapDomain M R _root_.id : (α →₀ M) →ₗ[R] α →₀ M) = LinearMap.id

name: lmapDomain_comp
statement:
theorem lmapDomain_comp (f : α → α') (g : α' → α'') :
    lmapDomain M R (g ∘ f) = (lmapDomain M R g).comp (lmapDomain M R f)

name: mapDomain.coe_linearEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapDomain.coe_linearEquiv (f : α ≃ α') :
    ⇑(linearEquiv M R f) = mapDomain f

name: mapDomain.toLinearMap_linearEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapDomain.toLinearMap_linearEquiv (f : α ≃ α') :
    (linearEquiv M R f : _ →ₗ[R] _) = lmapDomain M R f

name: mapDomain.linearEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapDomain.linearEquiv_symm (f : α ≃ α') :
