name: leftInverse_lcomapDomain_mapDomain
statement:
theorem leftInverse_lcomapDomain_mapDomain (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.LeftInverse (lcomapDomain (R := R) (M := M) f hf) (mapDomain f)

name: mapRange.linearMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapRange.linearMap_id :
    mapRange.linearMap LinearMap.id = (LinearMap.id : (α →₀ M) →ₗ[R] _)

name: mapRange.linearMap_comp
statement:
theorem mapRange.linearMap_comp (f : N →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] P) (f₂ : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) :
    (mapRange.linearMap (f.comp f₂) : (α →₀ _) →ₛₗ[σ₁₃] _) =
      (mapRange.linearMap f).comp (mapRange.linearMap f₂)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext <| mapRange_comp f f.map_zero f₂ f₂.map_zero (comp f f₂).map_zero

name: mapRange.linearMap_toAddMonoidHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapRange.linearMap_toAddMonoidHom (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) :
    (mapRange.linearMap f).toAddMonoidHom =
      (mapRange.addMonoidHom f.toAddMonoidHom : (α →₀ M) →+ _)

name: mapRange.linearEquiv_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapRange.linearEquiv_refl :
    mapRange.linearEquiv (LinearEquiv.refl R M) = LinearEquiv.refl R (α →₀ M)

name: mapRange.linearEquiv_trans
statement:
theorem mapRange.linearEquiv_trans (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) (f₂ : N ≃ₛₗ[σ₂₃] P) :
    (mapRange.linearEquiv (f.trans f₂) : (α →₀ _) ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₃] _) =
      (mapRange.linearEquiv f).trans (mapRange.linearEquiv f₂)
proof:
:=
  LinearEquiv.ext <| mapRange_comp f₂ f₂.map_zero f f.map_zero (f.trans f₂).map_zero

name: mapRange.linearEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapRange.linearEquiv_symm (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) :
    ((mapRange.linearEquiv f).symm : (α →₀ _) ≃ₛₗ[σ₂₁] _) = mapRange.linearEquiv f.symm

name: mapRange.linearEquiv_toAddEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapRange.linearEquiv_toAddEquiv (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) :
    (mapRange.linearEquiv f).toAddEquiv = (mapRange.addEquiv f.toAddEquiv : (α →₀ M) ≃+ _)

name: mapRange.linearEquiv_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapRange.linearEquiv_toLinearMap (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) :
    (mapRange.linearEquiv f).toLinearMap =
    (mapRange.linearMap f.toLinearMap : (α →₀ M) →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] _)

name: curryLinearEquiv_symm_apply_apply
statement:
theorem curryLinearEquiv_symm_apply_apply (f : α →₀ β →₀ M) (xy) :
    (curryLinearEquiv R).symm f xy = f xy.1 xy.2

name: ringHomEndFinsupp_surjective
statement:
theorem ringHomEndFinsupp_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (ringHomEndFinsupp (R := R) (M := M) ι)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  obtain _ | ⟨⟨i⟩⟩ := isEmpty_or_nonempty ι
  · exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim ..⟩
  · exact ⟨_, (ringEquivEndFinsupp i).right_inv f⟩

name: ker_lsingle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_lsingle (a : α) : ker (lsingle a : M →ₗ[R] α →₀ M) = ⊥

name: lsingle_range_le_ker_lapply
statement:
theorem lsingle_range_le_ker_lapply (s t : Set α) (h : Disjoint s t) :
    ⨆ a ∈ s, LinearMap.range (lsingle a : M →ₗ[R] α →₀ M) ≤
      ⨅ a ∈ t, ker (lapply a : (α →₀ M) →ₗ[R] M)
proof:
:= by
  refine iSup_le fun a₁ => iSup_le fun h₁ => range_le_iff_comap.2 ?_
  simp only [(ker_comp _ _).symm, eq_top_iff, SetLike.le_def, mem_ker, comap_iInf, mem_iInf]
  intro b _ a₂ h₂
  have : a₂ ≠ a₁ := fun eq => h.le_bot ⟨h₁, eq.symm ▸ h₂⟩
  exact single_eq_of_ne this

name: iInf_ker_lapply_le_bot
statement: theorem iInf_ker_lapply_le_bot : ⨅ a, ker (lapply a : (α →₀ M) →ₗ[R] M) ≤ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SetLike.le_def, mem_iInf, mem_ker, mem_bot, lapply_apply]
  exact fun a h => Finsupp.ext h

name: iSup_lsingle_range
statement: theorem iSup_lsingle_range : ⨆ a, LinearMap.range (lsingle a : M →ₗ[R] α →₀ M) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 <| SetLike.le_def.2 fun f _ => ?_
  rw [← sum_single f]
  exact sum_mem fun a _ => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem a ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: disjoint_lsingle_lsingle
statement:
theorem disjoint_lsingle_lsingle (s t : Set α) (hs : Disjoint s t) :
    Disjoint (⨆ a ∈ s, LinearMap.range (lsingle a : M →ₗ[R] α →₀ M))
      (⨆ a ∈ t, LinearMap.range (lsingle a : M →ₗ[R] α →₀ M))
proof:
:= by
  refine
    (Disjoint.mono
      (lsingle_range_le_ker_lapply s sᶜ disjoint_compl_right)
      (lsingle_range_le_ker_lapply t tᶜ disjoint_compl_right))
      ?_
  rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
  refine le_trans (le_iInf fun i => ?_) iInf_ker_lapply_le_bot
  classical
    by_cases his : i ∈ s
    · by_cases hit : i ∈ t
      · exact (hs.le_bot ⟨his, hit⟩).elim
      exact inf_le_of_right_le (iInf_le_of_le i <| iInf_le _ hit)
    exact inf_le_of_left_le (iInf_le_of_le i <| iInf_le _ his)

name: span_single_image
statement:
theorem span_single_image (s : Set M) (a : α) :
    Submodule.span R (single a '' s) = (Submodule.span R s).map (lsingle a : M →ₗ[R] α →₀ M)

name: range_lmapDomain
statement:
lemma range_lmapDomain {β : Type*} (u : α → β) :
    LinearMap.range (lmapDomain R R u) = .span R (.range fun x ↦ single (u x) 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rintro x ⟨x, rfl⟩
    induction x using induction_linear with
    | single i s =>
        rw [lmapDomain_apply, mapDomain_single, ← Finsupp.smul_single_one]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    | zero => simp
    | add f g hf hg =>
        rw [map_add]
        exact Submodule.add_mem _ hf hg
  · rw [Submodule.span_le, Set.range_subset_iff]
    intro i
    exact ⟨Finsupp.single i 1, by simp⟩

name: span_single_eq_top
statement: lemma span_single_eq_top : span R {single i x | (i : α) (x : M)} = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff'.mpr fun x ↦ ?_
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem ..
  | add f g f_in g_in => exact add_mem f_in g_in
  | single a b => exact mem_span_of_mem ⟨a, b, rfl⟩

name: exists_finset_of_mem_iSup
statement:
theorem exists_finset_of_mem_iSup {ι : Sort _} (p : ι → Submodule R M) {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ ⨆ i, p i) : ∃ s : Finset ι, m ∈ ⨆ i ∈ s, p i
proof:
:= by
  have := (Submodule.singleton_span_isCompactElement m).exists_finset_of_le_iSup p
  simp only [Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem] at this
  exact this hm

name: mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset
statement:
theorem mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset {ι : Sort _} {p : ι → Submodule R M} {m : M} :
    (m ∈ ⨆ i, p i) ↔ ∃ s : Finset ι, m ∈ ⨆ i ∈ s, p i
proof:
:=
  ⟨Submodule.exists_finset_of_mem_iSup p, fun ⟨_, hs⟩ =>
    iSup_mono (fun i => (iSup_const_le : _ ≤ p i)) hs⟩

name: mem_sSup_iff_exists_finset
statement:
theorem mem_sSup_iff_exists_finset {S : Set (Submodule R M)} {m : M} :
    m ∈ sSup S ↔ ∃ s : Finset (Submodule R M), ↑s ⊆ S ∧ m ∈ ⨆ i ∈ s, i
proof:
:= by
  rw [sSup_eq_iSup, iSup_subtype', Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨s, hs⟩ ↦ ⟨s.map (Function.Embedding.subtype (· ∈ S)), ?_, ?_⟩,
          fun ⟨s, hsS, hs⟩ ↦ ⟨s.preimage (↑) Subtype.coe_injective.injOn, ?_⟩⟩
  · simp
  · suffices m ∈ ⨆ (i) (hi : i ∈ S) (_ : ⟨i, hi⟩ ∈ s), i by simpa
    rwa [iSup_subtype']
  · have : ⨆ (i) (_ : i ∈ S ∧ i ∈ s), i = ⨆ (i) (_ : i ∈ s), i := by convert! rfl; grind
    simpa only [Finset.mem_preimage, iSup_subtype, iSup_and', this]

name: range_lsum_smul
statement:
lemma range_lsum_smul (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (f : σ → R) :
    (lsum (S := R) (f · • φ)).range = Set.range f • φ.range
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [range_eq_map, ← span_single_eq_top, ← span_univ, map_span, set_smul_span]
  congr 1
  aesop (add simp Set.mem_smul)

name: image_smul_top_eq_range_lsum
statement:
theorem image_smul_top_eq_range_lsum (s : Set σ) (f : σ → R) :
    (f '' s • ⊤ : Submodule R M) = (lsum (S := R) fun i : s ↦ f i • .id).range
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Set.range_comp] using (range_lsum_smul (.id (R := R) (M := M)) (f ∘ (↑) : s → R)).symm

name: smul_top_eq_range_lsum
statement:
theorem smul_top_eq_range_lsum (s : Set R) :
    (s • ⊤ : Submodule R M) = (lsum (S := R) fun i : s ↦ i.val • .id).range
proof:
:= by
  simpa using image_smul_top_eq_range_lsum (M := M) s id

name: mem_supported
statement: theorem mem_supported {s : Set α} (p : α →₀ M) : p ∈ supported M R s ↔ ↑p.support ⊆ s

name: mem_supported'
statement:
theorem mem_supported' {s : Set α} (p : α →₀ M) :
    p ∈ supported M R s ↔ ∀ x ∉ s, p x = 0

name: mem_supported_support
statement: theorem mem_supported_support (p : α →₀ M) : p ∈ Finsupp.supported M R (p.support : Set α)

name: single_mem_supported
statement:
theorem single_mem_supported {s : Set α} {a : α} (b : M) (h : a ∈ s) :
    single a b ∈ supported M R s

name: supported_eq_span_single
statement:
theorem supported_eq_span_single (s : Set α) :
    supported R R s = span R ((fun i => single i 1) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  refine (span_eq_of_le _ ?_ (SetLike.le_def.2 fun l hl => ?_)).symm
  · rintro _ ⟨_, hp, rfl⟩
    exact single_mem_supported R 1 hp
  · rw [← l.sum_single]
    refine sum_mem fun i il => ?_
    rw [show single i (l i) = l i • single i 1 by simp]
    exact smul_mem _ (l i) (subset_span (mem_image_of_mem _ (hl il)))

name: single_mem_span_single
statement:
lemma single_mem_span_single [Nontrivial R] {a : α} {s : Set α} :
    single a 1 ∈ Submodule.span R ((single · (1 : R)) '' s) ↔ a ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => Submodule.subset_span <| Set.mem_image_of_mem _ h⟩
  rw [← Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single, Finsupp.mem_supported,
    Finsupp.support_single _ (one_ne_zero' R)] at h
  simpa using h

name: span_le_supported_biUnion_support
statement:
theorem span_le_supported_biUnion_support (s : Set (α →₀ M)) :
    span R s ≤ supported M R (⋃ x ∈ s, x.support)

name: restrictDom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictDom_apply (s : Set α) (l : α →₀ M) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] :
    (restrictDom M R s l : α →₀ M) = Finsupp.filter (· ∈ s) l

name: restrictDom_comp_subtype
statement:
theorem restrictDom_comp_subtype (s : Set α) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] :
    (restrictDom M R s).comp (Submodule.subtype _) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext l a
  by_cases h : a ∈ s
  · simp [h]
  simpa [h] using ((mem_supported' R l.1).1 l.2 a h).symm

name: range_restrictDom
statement:
theorem range_restrictDom (s : Set α) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] :
    LinearMap.range (restrictDom M R s) = ⊤

name: supported_mono
statement: theorem supported_mono {s t : Set α} (st : s ⊆ t) : supported M R s ≤ supported M R t

name: supported_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supported_empty : supported M R (∅ : Set α) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_iff.2 fun l h => (Submodule.mem_bot R).2 <| by ext; simp_all [mem_supported']

name: supported_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem supported_univ : supported M R (Set.univ : Set α) = ⊤

name: supported_iUnion
statement:
theorem supported_iUnion {δ : Type*} (s : δ → Set α) :
    supported M R (⋃ i, s i) = ⨆ i, supported M R (s i)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (iSup_le fun i => supported_mono <| Set.subset_iUnion _ _)
  have := Classical.decPred fun x => x ∈ ⋃ i, s i
  suffices
    LinearMap.range ((Submodule.subtype _).comp (restrictDom M R (⋃ i, s i))) ≤
      ⨆ i, supported M R (s i) by
    rwa [LinearMap.range_comp, range_restrictDom, Submodule.map_top, range_subtype] at this
  rw [range_le_iff_comap, eq_top_iff]
  rintro l ⟨⟩
  induction l using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero => exact zero_mem _
  | single_add x a l _ _ ih =>
    refine add_mem ?_ ih
    by_cases h : ∃ i, x ∈ s i
    · simp only [mem_comap, coe_comp, coe_subtype, Function.comp_apply, restrictDom_apply,
        mem_iUnion, h, filter_single_of_pos]
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
      exact le_iSup (fun i => supported M R (s i)) i (single_mem_supported R _ hi)
    · simp [h]

name: supported_union
statement:
theorem supported_union (s t : Set α) :
    supported M R (s ∪ t) = supported M R s ⊔ supported M R t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.union_eq_iUnion, supported_iUnion, iSup_bool_eq, Bool.cond_true, Bool.cond_false]

name: supported_iInter
statement:
theorem supported_iInter {ι : Type*} (s : ι → Set α) :
    supported M R (⋂ i, s i) = ⨅ i, supported M R (s i)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.ext fun x => by simp [mem_supported, subset_iInter_iff]

name: supported_inter
statement:
theorem supported_inter (s t : Set α) :
    supported M R (s ∩ t) = supported M R s ⊓ supported M R t

name: disjoint_supported_supported
statement:
theorem disjoint_supported_supported {s t : Set α} (h : Disjoint s t) :
    Disjoint (supported M R s) (supported M R t)
proof:
:=
  disjoint_iff.2 <| by rw [← supported_inter, disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.1 h, supported_empty]

name: disjoint_supported_supported_iff
statement:
theorem disjoint_supported_supported_iff [Nontrivial M] {s t : Set α} :
    Disjoint (supported M R s) (supported M R t) ↔ Disjoint s t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hx1 hx2 => ?_, disjoint_supported_supported⟩
  rcases exists_ne (0 : M) with ⟨y, hy⟩
  have := h.le_bot ⟨single_mem_supported R y hx1, single_mem_supported R y hx2⟩
  rw [mem_bot, single_eq_zero] at this
  exact hy this

name: codisjoint_supported_supported
statement:
lemma codisjoint_supported_supported {s t : Set α} (h : Codisjoint s t) :
    Codisjoint (supported M R s) (supported M R t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [codisjoint_iff, eq_top_iff, ← supported_union,
    show s ∪ t = .univ from codisjoint_iff.mp h, supported_univ]

name: codisjoint_supported_supported_iff
statement:
lemma codisjoint_supported_supported_iff [Nontrivial M] {s t : Set α} :
    Codisjoint (supported M R s) (supported M R t) ↔ Codisjoint s t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ codisjoint_iff.mpr (eq_top_iff.mpr fun a ↦ ?_), codisjoint_supported_supported⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
  rw [codisjoint_iff, ← supported_union, eq_top_iff'] at h
  simpa [Finsupp.mem_supported, Finsupp.support_single _ hx] using h (Finsupp.single a x)

name: supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_apply_coe (s : Set α) [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)]
    (f : s →₀ M) : (supportedEquivFinsupp (R := R) s).symm f = f.extendDomain

name: supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_single (s : Set α) (i : s) (a : M) :
    ((supportedEquivFinsupp (R := R) s).symm (single i a) : α →₀ M) = single ↑i a

name: supported_comap_lmapDomain
statement:
theorem supported_comap_lmapDomain (f : α → α') (s : Set α') :
    supported M R (f ⁻¹' s) ≤ (supported M R s).comap (lmapDomain M R f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro l (hl : (l.support : Set α) ⊆ f ⁻¹' s)
  change ↑(mapDomain f l).support ⊆ s
  rw [← Set.image_subset_iff, ← Finset.coe_image] at hl
  exact Set.Subset.trans mapDomain_support hl

name: lmapDomain_supported
statement:
theorem lmapDomain_supported (f : α → α') (s : Set α) :
    (supported M R s).map (lmapDomain M R f) = supported M R (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty α
  · simp [s.eq_empty_of_isEmpty]
  refine
    le_antisymm
      (map_le_iff_le_comap.2 <|
        le_trans (supported_mono <| Set.subset_preimage_image _ _)
          (supported_comap_lmapDomain M R _ _))
      ?_
  intro l hl
  refine ⟨(lmapDomain M R (Function.invFunOn f s) : (α' →₀ M) →ₗ[R] α →₀ M) l, fun x hx => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases Finset.mem_image.1 (mapDomain_support hx) with ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact Function.invFunOn_mem (by simpa using hl hc)
  · rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← lmapDomain_comp]
    refine (mapDomain_congr fun c hc => ?_).trans mapDomain_id
    exact Function.invFunOn_eq (by simpa using hl hc)

name: lmapDomain_disjoint_ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
  rintro l ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_ker, lmapDomain_apply, mapDomain] at h₂
  simp only [mem_bot]; ext x
  have := Classical.decPred fun x => x ∈ s
  by_cases xs : x ∈ s
  · have : Finsupp.sum l (fun a => Finsupp.single (f a)) (f x) = 0 := by
      rw [h₂]
      rfl
    rw [Finsupp.sum_apply, Finsupp.sum_eq_single x, single_eq_same] at this
    · simpa
    · intro y hy xy
      simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_supported, subset_def, mem_support_iff] at h₁
      simp [mt (H _ (h₁ _ hy) _ xs) xy]
    · simp +contextual
  · by_contra h
    exact xs (h₁ <| Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h)

name: fst_sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp
statement:
theorem fst_sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp {α β : Type*} (f : α ⊕ β →₀ M) (x : α) :
    (sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp R f).1 x = f (Sum.inl x)

name: snd_sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp
statement:
theorem snd_sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp {α β : Type*} (f : α ⊕ β →₀ M) (y : β) :
    (sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp R f).2 y = f (Sum.inr y)

name: sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp_symm_inl
statement:
theorem sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp_symm_inl {α β : Type*} (fg : (α →₀ M) × (β →₀ M)) (x : α) :
    ((sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp R).symm fg) (Sum.inl x) = fg.1 x

name: sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp_symm_inr
statement:
theorem sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp_symm_inr {α β : Type*} (fg : (α →₀ M) × (β →₀ M)) (y : β) :
    ((sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp R).symm fg) (Sum.inr y) = fg.2 y

name: sigmaFinsuppLEquivPiFinsupp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sigmaFinsuppLEquivPiFinsupp_apply {M : Type*} {ιs : η → Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module R M] (f : (Σ j, ιs j) →₀ M) (j i) : sigmaFinsuppLEquivPiFinsupp R f j i = f ⟨j, i⟩

name: sigmaFinsuppLEquivPiFinsupp_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sigmaFinsuppLEquivPiFinsupp_symm_apply {M : Type*} {ιs : η → Type*} [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Module R M] (f : (j : _) → (ιs j →₀ M)) (ji) :
    (Finsupp.sigmaFinsuppLEquivPiFinsupp R).symm f ji = f ji.1 ji.2

name: linearCombination_apply
statement: theorem linearCombination_apply (l : α →₀ R) : linearCombination R v l = l.sum fun i a => a • v i

name: linearCombination_apply_of_mem_supported
statement:
theorem linearCombination_apply_of_mem_supported {l : α →₀ R} {s : Finset α}
    (hs : l ∈ supported R R (↑s : Set α)) : linearCombination R v l = s.sum fun i => l i • v i
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_subset hs fun x _ hxg =>
    show l x • v x = 0 by rw [notMem_support_iff.1 hxg, zero_smul]

name: linearCombination_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearCombination_single (c : R) (a : α) :
    linearCombination R v (single a c) = c • v a

name: linearCombination_zero_apply
statement: theorem linearCombination_zero_apply (x : α →₀ R) : (linearCombination R (0 : α → M)) x = 0

name: linearCombination_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearCombination_zero : linearCombination R (0 : α → M) = 0

name: linearCombination_single_index
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearCombination_single_index (c : M) (a : α) (f : α →₀ R) [DecidableEq α] :
    linearCombination R (Pi.single a c) f = f a • c
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearCombination_apply, sum_eq_single a, Pi.single_eq_same]
  · exact fun i _ hi ↦ by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hi, smul_zero]
  · exact fun _ ↦ by simp only [zero_smul]

name: linearCombination_linear_comp
statement:
theorem linearCombination_linear_comp (f : M →ₗ[R] M') :
    linearCombination R (f ∘ v) = f ∘ₗ linearCombination R v

name: apply_linearCombination
statement:
theorem apply_linearCombination (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (v) (l : α →₀ R) :
    f (linearCombination R v l) = linearCombination R (f ∘ v) l

name: apply_linearCombination_id
statement:
theorem apply_linearCombination_id (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (l : M →₀ R) :
    f (linearCombination R _root_.id l) = linearCombination R f l

name: linearCombination_unique
statement:
theorem linearCombination_unique [Unique α] (l : α →₀ R) (v : α → M) :
    linearCombination R v l = l default • v default

name: linearCombination_surjective
statement:
theorem linearCombination_surjective (h : Function.Surjective v) :
    Function.Surjective (linearCombination R v)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h x
  exact ⟨single y 1, by simp [hy]⟩

name: linearCombination_range
statement:
theorem linearCombination_range (h : Function.Surjective v) :
    LinearMap.range (linearCombination R v) = ⊤

name: linearCombination_id_surjective
statement:
theorem linearCombination_id_surjective (M) [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] :
    Function.Surjective (linearCombination R (id : M → M))

name: range_linearCombination
statement: theorem range_linearCombination : LinearMap.range (linearCombination R v) = span R (range v)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [LinearMap.mem_range] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨l, hl⟩
    rw [← hl]
    rw [linearCombination_apply]
    exact sum_mem fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (subset_span (mem_range_self i))
  · apply span_le.2
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨i, hi⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_range]
    use single i 1
    simp [hi]

name: _root_.span_range_eq_top_iff_surjective_finsuppLinearCombination
statement:
theorem _root_.span_range_eq_top_iff_surjective_finsuppLinearCombination :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range v) = ⊤ ↔
      Function.Surjective (Finsupp.linearCombination R v)

name: lmapDomain_linearCombination
statement:
theorem lmapDomain_linearCombination (f : α → α') (g : M →ₗ[R] M') (h : ∀ i, g (v i) = v' (f i)) :
    (linearCombination R v').comp (lmapDomain R R f) = g.comp (linearCombination R v)

name: linearCombination_comp_lmapDomain
statement:
theorem linearCombination_comp_lmapDomain (f : α → α') :
    (linearCombination R v').comp (Finsupp.lmapDomain R R f) = linearCombination R (v' ∘ f)

name: linearCombination_embDomain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearCombination_embDomain (f : α ↪ α') (l : α →₀ R) :
    (linearCombination R v') (embDomain f l) = (linearCombination R (v' ∘ f)) l

name: linearCombination_mapDomain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearCombination_mapDomain (f : α → α') (l : α →₀ R) :
    (linearCombination R v') (mapDomain f l) = (linearCombination R (v' ∘ f)) l

name: linearCombination_equivMapDomain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearCombination_equivMapDomain (f : α ≃ α') (l : α →₀ R) :
    (linearCombination R v') (equivMapDomain f l) = (linearCombination R (v' ∘ f)) l

name: span_eq_range_linearCombination
statement:
theorem span_eq_range_linearCombination (s : Set M) :
    span R s = LinearMap.range (linearCombination R ((↑) : s → M))

name: mem_span_iff_linearCombination
statement:
theorem mem_span_iff_linearCombination (s : Set M) (x : M) :
    x ∈ span R s ↔ ∃ l : s →₀ R, linearCombination R (↑) l = x

name: mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp
statement:
theorem mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp {v : α → M} {x : M} :
    x ∈ span R (range v) ↔ ∃ c : α →₀ R, (c.sum fun i a => a • v i) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Finsupp.range_linearCombination, LinearMap.mem_range, linearCombination_apply]

name: span_image_eq_map_linearCombination
statement:
theorem span_image_eq_map_linearCombination (s : Set α) :
    span R (v '' s) = Submodule.map (linearCombination R v) (supported R R s)
proof:
:= by
  apply span_eq_of_le
  · intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_image] at hx
    apply Exists.elim hx
    intro i hi
    exact ⟨_, Finsupp.single_mem_supported R 1 hi.1, by simp [hi.2]⟩
  · refine map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun z hz => ?_
    have : ∀ i, z i • v i ∈ span R (v '' s) := by
      intro c
      have := Classical.decPred fun x => x ∈ s
      by_cases h : c ∈ s
      · exact smul_mem _ _ (subset_span (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ h))
      · simp [(Finsupp.mem_supported' R _).1 hz _ h]
    rw [mem_comap, linearCombination_apply]
    refine sum_mem ?_
    simp [this]

name: mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination
statement:
theorem mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination {s : Set α} {x : M} :
    x ∈ span R (v '' s) ↔ ∃ l ∈ supported R R s, linearCombination R v l = x

name: linearCombination_option
statement:
theorem linearCombination_option (v : Option α → M) (f : Option α →₀ R) :
    linearCombination R v f =
      f none • v none + linearCombination R (v ∘ Option.some) f.some

name: linearCombination_linearCombination
statement:
theorem linearCombination_linearCombination {α β : Type*} (A : α → M) (B : β → α →₀ R)
    (f : β →₀ R) : linearCombination R A (linearCombination R B f) =
      linearCombination R (fun b => linearCombination R A (B b)) f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [linearCombination_apply]
  induction f using induction_linear with
  | zero => simp only [sum_zero_index]
  | add f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ => simp [sum_add_index, h₁, h₂, add_smul]
  | single => simp [sum_single_index, sum_smul_index, smul_sum, mul_smul]

name: linearCombination_smul
statement:
theorem linearCombination_smul [Module R S] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M] {w : α' → S} :
    linearCombination R (fun i : α × α' ↦ w i.2 • v i.1) = (linearCombination S v).restrictScalars R
      ∘ₗ mapRange.linearMap (linearCombination R w) ∘ₗ (curryLinearEquiv R).toLinearMap

name: linearCombination_fin_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearCombination_fin_zero (f : Fin 0 → M) : linearCombination R f = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  apply finZeroElim i

name: linearCombinationOn_range
statement:
theorem linearCombinationOn_range (s : Set α) :
    LinearMap.range (linearCombinationOn α M R v s) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearCombinationOn, LinearMap.range_eq_map, LinearMap.map_codRestrict,
    ← LinearMap.range_le_iff_comap, range_subtype, Submodule.map_top, LinearMap.range_comp,
    range_subtype]
  exact (span_image_eq_map_linearCombination _ _).le

name: linearCombination_restrict
statement:
theorem linearCombination_restrict (s : Set α) :
    linearCombination R (s.domRestrict v) = Submodule.subtype _ ∘ₗ
      linearCombinationOn α M R v s ∘ₗ (supportedEquivFinsupp s).symm.toLinearMap

name: linearCombination_comp
statement:
theorem linearCombination_comp (f : α' → α) :
    linearCombination R (v ∘ f) = (linearCombination R v).comp (lmapDomain R R f)

name: linearCombination_comapDomain
statement:
theorem linearCombination_comapDomain (f : α → α') (l : α' →₀ R)
    (hf : Set.InjOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑l.support)) : linearCombination R v (Finsupp.comapDomain f l hf) =
      (l.support.preimage f hf).sum fun i => l (f i) • v i

name: linearCombination_onFinset
statement:
theorem linearCombination_onFinset {s : Finset α} {f : α → R} (g : α → M)
    (hf : ∀ a, f a ≠ 0 → a ∈ s) :
    linearCombination R g (Finsupp.onFinset s f hf) = Finset.sum s fun x : α => f x • g x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.onFinset_apply, Finsupp.support_onFinset]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter_of_ne]
  intro x _ h
  contrapose h
  simp [h]

name: bilinearCombination_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bilinearCombination_apply :
    bilinearCombination R S v = linearCombination R v

name: Fintype.linearCombination_apply
statement: theorem Fintype.linearCombination_apply (f) : Fintype.linearCombination R v f = ∑ i, f i • v i

name: Fintype.linearCombination_apply_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Fintype.linearCombination_apply_single [DecidableEq α] (i : α) (r : R) :
    Fintype.linearCombination R v (Pi.single i r) = r • v i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Pi.single_apply, ite_smul, zero_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq', ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_univ _)]

name: Finsupp.linearCombination_eq_fintype_linearCombination_apply
statement:
theorem Finsupp.linearCombination_eq_fintype_linearCombination_apply (x : α → R) :
    linearCombination R v ((Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R R α).symm x) =
      Fintype.linearCombination R v x
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · exact Finset.subset_univ _
  · intro x _ hx
    rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hx]
    exact zero_smul _ _

name: Finsupp.linearCombination_eq_fintype_linearCombination
statement:
theorem Finsupp.linearCombination_eq_fintype_linearCombination :
    (linearCombination R v).comp (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R R α).symm.toLinearMap =
      Fintype.linearCombination R v

name: Fintype.range_linearCombination
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Fintype.range_linearCombination :
    LinearMap.range (Fintype.linearCombination R v) = Submodule.span R (Set.range v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finsupp.linearCombination_eq_fintype_linearCombination, LinearMap.range_comp,
      LinearEquiv.range, Submodule.map_top, Finsupp.range_linearCombination]

name: span_range_eq_top_iff_surjective_fintypeLinearCombination
statement:
theorem span_range_eq_top_iff_surjective_fintypeLinearCombination :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range v) = ⊤ ↔
      Function.Surjective (Fintype.linearCombination R v)

name: Fintype.bilinearCombination_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Fintype.bilinearCombination_apply :
    Fintype.bilinearCombination R S v = Fintype.linearCombination R v

name: Fintype.bilinearCombination_apply_single
statement:
theorem Fintype.bilinearCombination_apply_single [DecidableEq α] (i : α) (r : R) :
    Fintype.bilinearCombination R S v (Pi.single i r) = r • v i

name: Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun
statement:
theorem Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun :
    x ∈ span R (range v) ↔ ∃ c : α → R, ∑ i, c i • v i = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.surjective.exists]
  simp only [Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp, Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite_apply]
  exact exists_congr fun c => Eq.congr_left <| Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ fun i => zero_smul _ _

name: Submodule.top_le_span_range_iff_forall_exists_fun
statement:
theorem Submodule.top_le_span_range_iff_forall_exists_fun :
    ⊤ ≤ span R (range v) ↔ ∀ x, ∃ c : α → R, ∑ i, c i • v i = x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun]
  exact ⟨fun h x => h trivial, fun h x _ => h x⟩

name: Submodule.mem_span_image_iff_exists_fun
statement:
theorem Submodule.mem_span_image_iff_exists_fun {s : Set α} :
    x ∈ span R (v '' s) ↔ ∃ t : Finset α, ↑t ⊆ s ∧ ∃ c : t → R, ∑ i, c i • v i = x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨t, ht, c, hx⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨l, hl, hx⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination R).mp h
    refine ⟨l.support, hl, l ∘ (↑), ?_⟩
    rw [← hx]
    exact l.support.sum_coe_sort fun a ↦ l a • v a
  · rw [← hx]
    exact sum_smul_mem (span R (v '' s)) c fun a _ ↦ subset_span <| by aesop

name: Submodule.mem_span_image_finset_iff_exists_fun
statement:
theorem Submodule.mem_span_image_finset_iff_exists_fun {s : Finset α} :
    x ∈ span R (v '' s) ↔ ∃ c : s → R, ∑ i, c i • v i = x

name: Submodule.mem_span_image_finset_iff_exists_fun'
statement:
theorem Submodule.mem_span_image_finset_iff_exists_fun' {s : Finset α} :
    x ∈ span R (v '' s) ↔ ∃ c : α → R, ∑ i ∈ s, c i • v i = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_image_finset_iff_exists_fun]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨c, hc⟩ ↦ ?_, fun ⟨c, hc⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨fun i ↦ if h : i ∈ s then c ⟨i, h⟩ else 0, ?_⟩
    rw [← hc, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort (s := s)]
    simp
  · refine ⟨fun i ↦ c i, ?_⟩
    rw [← hc, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort (s := s)]

name: Fintype.mem_span_image_iff_exists_fun
statement:
theorem Fintype.mem_span_image_iff_exists_fun {s : Set α} [Fintype s] :
    x ∈ span R (v '' s) ↔ ∃ c : s → R, ∑ i, c i • v i = x

name: Span.finsupp_linearCombination_repr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Span.finsupp_linearCombination_repr {w : Set M} (x : span R w) :
    Finsupp.linearCombination R ((↑) : w → M) (Span.repr R w x) = x

name: LinearMap.map_finsupp_linearCombination
statement:
theorem LinearMap.map_finsupp_linearCombination (f : M →ₗ[R] N) {ι : Type*} {g : ι → M}
    (l : ι →₀ R) : f (linearCombination R g l) = linearCombination R (f ∘ g) l

name: Submodule.mem_span_iff_exists_finset_subset
statement:
lemma Submodule.mem_span_iff_exists_finset_subset {s : Set M} {x : M} :
    x ∈ span R s ↔
      ∃ (f : M → R) (t : Finset M), ↑t ⊆ s ∧ f.support ⊆ t ∧ ∑ a ∈ t, f a • a = x where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    rw [← s.image_id, mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination]
    rintro ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨l, l.support, by simpa [linearCombination, Finsupp.sum] using! hl⟩
  mpr := by
    rintro ⟨n, t, hts, -, rfl⟩; exact sum_mem fun x hx ↦ smul_mem _ _ <| subset_span <| hts hx

name: Submodule.mem_span_finset
statement:
lemma Submodule.mem_span_finset {s : Finset M} {x : M} :
    x ∈ span R s ↔ ∃ f : M → R, f.support ⊆ s ∧ ∑ a ∈ s, f a • a = x where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    rw [mem_span_iff_exists_finset_subset]
    rintro ⟨f, t, hts, hf, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨f, hf.trans hts, .symm <| Finset.sum_subset hts ?_⟩
    simp +contextual [Function.support_subset_iff'.1 hf]
  mpr := by rintro ⟨f, -, rfl⟩; exact sum_mem fun x hx ↦ smul_mem _ _ <| subset_span <| hx

name: Submodule.mem_span_iff_of_fintype
statement:
lemma Submodule.mem_span_iff_of_fintype {s : Set M} [Fintype s] {x : M} :
    x ∈ span R s ↔ ∃ f : s → R, ∑ a : s, f a • a.1 = x
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Subtype.range_val (s := s)]
  exact mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _

name: Submodule.mem_span_finset'
statement:
lemma Submodule.mem_span_finset' {s : Finset M} {x : M} :
    x ∈ span R s ↔ ∃ f : s → R, ∑ a : s, f a • a.1 = x

name: Submodule.mem_span_set
statement:
theorem Submodule.mem_span_set {m : M} {s : Set M} :
    m ∈ Submodule.span R s ↔
      ∃ c : M →₀ R, (c.support : Set M) ⊆ s ∧ (c.sum fun mi r => r • mi) = m
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← Set.image_id s]
  exact Finsupp.mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination R (v := _root_.id (α := M))

name: Submodule.mem_span_set'
statement:
lemma Submodule.mem_span_set' {m : M} {s : Set M} :
    m ∈ Submodule.span R s ↔ ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → R) (g : Fin n → s),
      ∑ i, f i • (g i : M) = m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases mem_span_set.1 h with ⟨c, cs, rfl⟩
    have A : c.support ≃ Fin c.support.card := Finset.equivFin _
    refine ⟨_, fun i ↦ c (A.symm i), fun i ↦ ⟨A.symm i, cs (A.symm i).2⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [Finsupp.sum, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort c.support]
    exact Fintype.sum_equiv A.symm _ (fun j ↦ c j • (j : M)) (fun i ↦ rfl)
  · rintro ⟨n, f, g, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ (fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (g i).2))

name: Submodule.span_eq_iUnion_nat
statement:
lemma Submodule.span_eq_iUnion_nat (s : Set M) :
    (Submodule.span R s : Set M) = ⋃ (n : ℕ),
      (fun (f : Fin n → (R × M)) ↦ ∑ i, (f i).1 • (f i).2) '' ({f | ∀ i, (f i).2 ∈ s})
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_iUnion, mem_image, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_span_set']
  refine exists_congr (fun n ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
  · rintro ⟨f, g, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fun i ↦ (f i, g i), fun i ↦ (g i).2, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨fun i ↦ (f i).1, fun i ↦ ⟨(f i).2, (hf i)⟩, rfl⟩

name: Finsupp.linearCombination_comp_addSingleEquiv
statement:
theorem Finsupp.linearCombination_comp_addSingleEquiv (v : ι → M) :
    linearCombination R v ∘ₗ addSingleEquiv i c h₀ = linearCombination R (v + (c · • v i))

name: pow_mul_of_le
statement:
theorem pow_mul_of_le {x y : R} (h : x ≡ y [SMOD J]) (hJI : J ≤ I) :
    x ^ p ≡ y ^ p [SMOD J * I]
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := idealQuotientMk.mp <| h.mono hJI
  rw [SModEq.sub_mem] at h ⊢
  rw [← Commute.mul_neg_geom_sum₂ (.all _ _)]
  refine Ideal.mul_mem_mul h ?_
  have h₂ : (p : R ⧸ I) = 0 := by simpa using Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hpI
  simp only [← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, map_sum, map_mul, map_pow, h₁, ← pow_add]
  trans ∑ x ∈ Finset.range p, Ideal.Quotient.mk I y ^ (p - 1)
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ by grind
  simp [h₂]

name: pow_add_one
statement:
theorem pow_add_one {x y : R} {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (h : x ≡ y [SMOD I ^ m]) :
    x ^ p ≡ y ^ p [SMOD I ^ (m + 1)]

name: pow_pow_add_one
statement:
theorem pow_pow_add_one {x y : R} (h : x ≡ y [SMOD I]) (m : ℕ) :
    x ^ p ^ m ≡ y ^ p ^ m [SMOD I ^ (m + 1)]
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simpa
  | succ m ih =>
    simp_rw [pow_succ _ m, pow_mul]
    exact ih.pow_add_one hpI m.succ_ne_zero

name: smul'
statement:
theorem smul' (hxy : x ≡ y [SMOD U])
    {c : R} (hc : c ∈ I) : c • x ≡ c • y [SMOD (I • U)]
proof:
:= by
  rw [SModEq.sub_mem] at hxy ⊢
  rw [← smul_sub]
  exact smul_mem_smul hc hxy

name: SModEq.def
statement:
protected theorem SModEq.def :
    x ≡ y [SMOD U] ↔ (Submodule.Quotient.mk x : M ⧸ U) = Submodule.Quotient.mk y

name: sub_mem
statement: theorem sub_mem : x ≡ y [SMOD U] ↔ x - y ∈ U

name: top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem top : x ≡ y [SMOD (⊤ : Submodule R M)]

name: bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bot : x ≡ y [SMOD (⊥ : Submodule R M)] ↔ x = y

name: mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem mono (HU : U₁ ≤ U₂) (hxy : x ≡ y [SMOD U₁]) : x ≡ y [SMOD U₂]

name: of_toAddSubgroup_le
statement:
lemma of_toAddSubgroup_le {U : Submodule R M} {V : Submodule S M}
    (h : U.toAddSubgroup ≤ V.toAddSubgroup) {x y : M} (hxy : x ≡ y [SMOD U]) : x ≡ y [SMOD V]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SModEq, Submodule.Quotient.eq] at hxy ⊢
  exact h hxy

name: refl
statement:
@[refl, simp]
protected theorem refl (x : M) : x ≡ x [SMOD U]

name: rfl
statement: protected theorem rfl : x ≡ x [SMOD U]

name: comm
statement: theorem comm : x ≡ y [SMOD U] ↔ y ≡ x [SMOD U]

name: add
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem add (hxy₁ : x₁ ≡ y₁ [SMOD U]) (hxy₂ : x₂ ≡ y₂ [SMOD U]) : x₁ + x₂ ≡ y₁ + y₂ [SMOD U]
proof:
:= by
  rw [SModEq.def] at hxy₁ hxy₂ ⊢
  simp_rw [Quotient.mk_add, hxy₁, hxy₂]

name: sum
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp [SModEq.rfl]
  | cons i s _ ih =>
    grw [Finset.sum_cons, Finset.sum_cons, hxy i (Finset.mem_cons_self i s),
      ih (fun j hj ↦ hxy j (Finset.mem_cons_of_mem hj))]

name: smul
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem smul (hxy : x ≡ y [SMOD U]) (c : R) : c • x ≡ c • y [SMOD U]
proof:
:= by
  rw [SModEq.def] at hxy ⊢
  simp_rw [Quotient.mk_smul, hxy]

name: nsmul
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma nsmul (hxy : x ≡ y [SMOD U]) (n : ℕ) : n • x ≡ n • y [SMOD U]
proof:
:= by
  rw [SModEq.def] at hxy ⊢
  simp_rw [Quotient.mk_smul, hxy]

name: zsmul
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma zsmul (hxy : x ≡ y [SMOD U]) (n : ℤ) : n • x ≡ n • y [SMOD U]
proof:
:= by
  rw [SModEq.def] at hxy ⊢
  simp_rw [Quotient.mk_smul, hxy]

name: mul
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem mul {I : Ideal A} {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : A} (hxy₁ : x₁ ≡ y₁ [SMOD I])
    (hxy₂ : x₂ ≡ y₂ [SMOD I]) : x₁ * x₂ ≡ y₁ * y₂ [SMOD I]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SModEq.def, Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk, map_mul] at hxy₁ hxy₂ ⊢
  rw [hxy₁, hxy₂]

name: prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp [SModEq.rfl]
  | cons i s _ ih =>
    grw [Finset.prod_cons, Finset.prod_cons, hxy i (Finset.mem_cons_self i s),
      ih (fun j hj ↦ hxy j (Finset.mem_cons_of_mem hj))]

name: pow
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma pow {I : Ideal A} {x y : A} (n : ℕ) (hxy : x ≡ y [SMOD I]) :
    x ^ n ≡ y ^ n [SMOD I]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SModEq.def, Ideal.Quotient.mk_eq_mk, map_pow] at hxy ⊢
  rw [hxy]

name: neg
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma neg (hxy : x ≡ y [SMOD U]) : -x ≡ - y [SMOD U]

name: sub
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma sub (hxy₁ : x₁ ≡ y₁ [SMOD U]) (hxy₂ : x₂ ≡ y₂ [SMOD U]) : x₁ - x₂ ≡ y₁ - y₂ [SMOD U]
proof:
:= by
  rw [SModEq.def] at hxy₁ hxy₂ ⊢
  simp_rw [Quotient.mk_sub, hxy₁, hxy₂]

name: zero
statement: theorem zero : x ≡ 0 [SMOD U] ↔ x ∈ U

name: _root_.sub_smodEq_zero
statement: theorem _root_.sub_smodEq_zero : x - y ≡ 0 [SMOD U] ↔ x ≡ y [SMOD U]

name: map
statement: theorem map (hxy : x ≡ y [SMOD U]) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : f x ≡ f y [SMOD U.map f]

name: comap
statement: theorem comap {f : M →ₗ[R] N} (hxy : f x ≡ f y [SMOD V]) : x ≡ y [SMOD V.comap f]
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).2 <|
    show f (x - y) ∈ V from (f.map_sub x y).symm ▸ (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).1 hxy

name: eval
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem eval {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {x y : R} (h : x ≡ y [SMOD I]) (f : R[X]) :
    f.eval x ≡ f.eval y [SMOD I]

name: restrictScalars
statement:
theorem restrictScalars [SMul S R] [IsScalarTower S R M] : x ≡ y [SMOD U.restrictScalars S] ↔
    x ≡ y [SMOD U]

name: idealQuotientMk
statement:
theorem idealQuotientMk {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {I : Ideal R} {x y : R} :
    x ≡ y [SMOD I] ↔ Ideal.Quotient.mk I x = Ideal.Quotient.mk I y

name: _root_.Submodule.vadd_set_subset_vadd_set_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Submodule.vadd_set_subset_vadd_set_iff :
    x +ᵥ (U : Set M) ⊆ y +ᵥ (U : Set M) ↔ x ≡ y [SMOD U]
proof:
:= by
  rw [SModEq.sub_mem]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Set.vadd_set_subset_iff_subset_neg_vadd_set, vadd_vadd, neg_add_eq_sub] at h
    simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using h U.zero_mem
  · rw [Set.vadd_set_subset_iff_subset_neg_vadd_set, vadd_vadd, neg_add_eq_sub]
    intro z hz
    simpa [Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem] using U.add_mem h hz

name: _root_.Submodule.vadd_set_eq_vadd_set_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Submodule.vadd_set_eq_vadd_set_iff :
    x +ᵥ (U : Set M) = y +ᵥ (U : Set M) ↔ x ≡ y [SMOD U]
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ Submodule.vadd_set_subset_vadd_set_iff.mp h.subset,
    fun h ↦ Set.Subset.antisymm (Submodule.vadd_set_subset_vadd_set_iff.mpr h)
      (Submodule.vadd_set_subset_vadd_set_iff.mpr h.symm)⟩

name: directSum_lof_tmul_lof
statement:
@[simp]
theorem directSum_lof_tmul_lof (i₁ : ι₁) (m₁ : M₁ i₁) (i₂ : ι₂) (m₂ : M₂ i₂) :
    TensorProduct.directSum R S M₁ M₂ (DirectSum.lof S ι₁ M₁ i₁ m₁ ⊗ₜ DirectSum.lof R ι₂ M₂ i₂ m₂) =
      DirectSum.lof S (ι₁ × ι₂) (fun i => M₁ i.1 ⊗[R] M₂ i.2) (i₁, i₂) (m₁ ⊗ₜ m₂)

name: directSum_symm_lof_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem directSum_symm_lof_tmul (i₁ : ι₁) (m₁ : M₁ i₁) (i₂ : ι₂) (m₂ : M₂ i₂) :
    (TensorProduct.directSum R S M₁ M₂).symm
      (DirectSum.lof S (ι₁ × ι₂) (fun i => M₁ i.1 ⊗[R] M₂ i.2) (i₁, i₂) (m₁ ⊗ₜ m₂)) =
      (DirectSum.lof S ι₁ M₁ i₁ m₁ ⊗ₜ DirectSum.lof R ι₂ M₂ i₂ m₂)

name: directSumLeft_tmul_lof
statement:
@[simp]
theorem directSumLeft_tmul_lof (i : ι₁) (x : M₁ i) (y : M₂') :
    directSumLeft R S M₁ M₂' (DirectSum.lof S _ _ i x ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
    DirectSum.lof S _ _ i (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [directSumLeft] using! lequivCongrLeft_lof S (by simp) _ _ rfl

name: directSumLeft_symm_lof_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem directSumLeft_symm_lof_tmul (i : ι₁) (x : M₁ i) (y : M₂') :
    (directSumLeft R S M₁ M₂').symm (DirectSum.lof S _ _ i (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)) =
      DirectSum.lof S _ _ i x ⊗ₜ[R] y

name: directSumLeft_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma directSumLeft_tmul (m : ⨁ i, M₁ i) (n : M₂') (i : ι₁) :
    directSumLeft R S M₁ M₂' (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) i = (m i) ⊗ₜ[R] n
proof:
:= by
  suffices (DirectSum.component S ι₁ _ i) ∘ₗ (directSumLeft R S M₁ M₂').toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      ((AlgebraTensorModule.mk R S (⨁ i, M₁ i) M₂').flip n) =
        ((AlgebraTensorModule.mk R S (M₁ i) M₂').flip n) ∘ₗ (DirectSum.component S ι₁ M₁ i) by
    simpa using! LinearMap.congr_fun this m
  ext j n
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj; simp
  · simp [DirectSum.component.of, hj]

name: directSumLeft_symm_of
statement:
lemma directSumLeft_symm_of {i : ι₁} (x : (M₁ i) ⊗[R] M₂') :
    (directSumLeft R S M₁ M₂').symm ((of (fun i ↦ M₁ i ⊗[R] M₂') i) x) =
      rTensor M₂' (lof R ι₁ M₁ i) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul x y => rw [← lof_eq_of S, directSumLeft_symm_lof_tmul, rTensor_tmul, lof_eq_of, lof_eq_of]
  | add x y h₁ h₂ => simp [h₁, h₂]

name: directSumRight_tmul_lof
statement:
@[simp]
theorem directSumRight_tmul_lof (x : M₁') (i : ι₂) (y : M₂ i) :
    directSumRight R S M₁' M₂ (x ⊗ₜ[R] DirectSum.lof R _ _ i y) =
    DirectSum.lof S _ _ i (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [directSumRight] using! lequivCongrLeft_lof S (by simp) _ _ rfl

name: directSumRight_symm_lof_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem directSumRight_symm_lof_tmul (x : M₁') (i : ι₂) (y : M₂ i) :
    (directSumRight R S M₁' M₂).symm (DirectSum.lof S _ _ i (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)) =
      x ⊗ₜ[R] DirectSum.lof R _ _ i y

name: directSumRight_comp_rTensor
statement:
lemma directSumRight_comp_rTensor (f : M₁' →ₗ[R] M₂') :
    (directSumRight R R M₂' M₁).toLinearMap ∘ₗ f.rTensor _ =
      (lmap fun _ ↦ f.rTensor _) ∘ₗ directSumRight R R M₁' M₁

name: directSumRight_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma directSumRight_tmul (m : M₁') (n : ⨁ i, M₂ i) (i : ι₂) :
    directSumRight R S M₁' M₂ (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) i = m ⊗ₜ[R] (n i)
proof:
:= by
  suffices (DirectSum.component S ι₂ _ i).restrictScalars R ∘ₗ
      (directSumRight R S M₁' M₂).toLinearMap.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.mk R M₁' (⨁ i, M₂ i) m) =
          (TensorProduct.mk R M₁' (M₂ i) m) ∘ₗ (DirectSum.component R ι₂ M₂ i) by
    simpa using! LinearMap.congr_fun this n
  ext j n
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj; simp
  · simp [DirectSum.component.of, hj]

name: restrictScalar_directSumRight
statement:
lemma restrictScalar_directSumRight :
    (directSumRight R S M₁' M₂).restrictScalars S₀ = directSumRight R S₀ M₁' M₂
proof:
:=
  LinearEquiv.restrictScalars_injective R <| LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_injective <| by ext; simp [lof]

name: coe_directSumRight
statement:
lemma coe_directSumRight :
    ⇑(directSumRight R S M₁' M₂) = directSumRight R R M₁' M₂

name: finsuppLeft_apply_tmul
statement:
lemma finsuppLeft_apply_tmul (p : ι →₀ M) (n : N) :
    finsuppLeft R S M N ι (p ⊗ₜ[R] n) = p.sum fun i m ↦ Finsupp.single i (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => simp [add_tmul, map_add, hf, hg, Finsupp.sum_add_index]
  | single => simp [finsuppLeft]

name: finsuppLeft_apply_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsuppLeft_apply_tmul_apply (p : ι →₀ M) (n : N) (i : ι) :
    finsuppLeft R S M N ι (p ⊗ₜ[R] n) i = p i ⊗ₜ[R] n
proof:
:= by
  rw [finsuppLeft_apply_tmul, Finsupp.sum_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_eq_single i (fun _ _ ↦ Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne') (by simp), Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: finsuppLeft_apply
statement:
theorem finsuppLeft_apply (t : (ι →₀ M) ⊗[R] N) (i : ι) :
    finsuppLeft R S M N ι t i = rTensor N (Finsupp.lapply i) t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | tmul f n => simp only [finsuppLeft_apply_tmul_apply, rTensor_tmul, Finsupp.lapply_apply]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy]

name: finsuppLeft_symm_apply_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsuppLeft_symm_apply_single (i : ι) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (finsuppLeft R S M N ι).symm (Finsupp.single i (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)) =
      Finsupp.single i m ⊗ₜ[R] n

name: finsuppRight_apply_tmul
statement:
lemma finsuppRight_apply_tmul (m : M) (p : ι →₀ N) :
    finsuppRight R S M N ι (m ⊗ₜ[R] p) = p.sum fun i n ↦ Finsupp.single i (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f g hf hg => simp [tmul_add, map_add, hf, hg, Finsupp.sum_add_index]
  | single => simp [finsuppRight]

name: finsuppRight_apply_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsuppRight_apply_tmul_apply (m : M) (p : ι →₀ N) (i : ι) :
    finsuppRight R S M N ι (m ⊗ₜ[R] p) i = m ⊗ₜ[R] p i
proof:
:= by
  rw [finsuppRight_apply_tmul, Finsupp.sum_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_eq_single i (fun _ _ ↦ Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne') (by simp), Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: finsuppRight_apply
statement:
theorem finsuppRight_apply (t : M ⊗[R] (ι →₀ N)) (i : ι) :
    finsuppRight R S M N ι t i = lTensor M (Finsupp.lapply i) t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | tmul m f => simp [finsuppRight_apply_tmul_apply]
  | add x y hx hy => simp [map_add, hx, hy]

name: finsuppRight_tmul_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsuppRight_tmul_single (i : ι) (m : M) (n : N) :
    finsuppRight R S M N ι (m ⊗ₜ[R] Finsupp.single i n) = Finsupp.single i (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)

name: finsuppRight_symm_apply_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsuppRight_symm_apply_single (i : ι) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (finsuppRight R S M N ι).symm (Finsupp.single i (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)) =
      m ⊗ₜ[R] Finsupp.single i n

name: finsuppLeft_smul'
statement:
lemma finsuppLeft_smul' (s : S) (t : (ι →₀ M) ⊗[R] N) :
    finsuppLeft R S M N ι (s • t) = s • finsuppLeft R S M N ι t

name: finsuppScalarLeft_apply_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsuppScalarLeft_apply_tmul_apply (p : ι →₀ R) (n : N) (i : ι) :
    finsuppScalarLeft R N ι (p ⊗ₜ[R] n) i = p i • n

name: finsuppScalarLeft_apply_tmul
statement:
lemma finsuppScalarLeft_apply_tmul (p : ι →₀ R) (n : N) :
    finsuppScalarLeft R N ι (p ⊗ₜ[R] n) = p.sum fun i m ↦ Finsupp.single i (m • n)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [finsuppScalarLeft_apply_tmul_apply, Finsupp.sum_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_eq_single i (fun _ _ ↦ Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne') (by simp), Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: finsuppScalarLeft_apply
statement:
lemma finsuppScalarLeft_apply (pn : (ι →₀ R) ⊗[R] N) (i : ι) :
    finsuppScalarLeft R N ι pn i = TensorProduct.lid R N ((Finsupp.lapply i).rTensor N pn)

name: finsuppScalarLeft_symm_apply_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsuppScalarLeft_symm_apply_single (i : ι) (n : N) :
    (finsuppScalarLeft R N ι).symm (Finsupp.single i n) =
      (Finsupp.single i 1) ⊗ₜ[R] n

name: finsuppScalarRight_apply_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsuppScalarRight_apply_tmul_apply (m : M) (p : ι →₀ R) (i : ι) :
    finsuppScalarRight R S M ι (m ⊗ₜ[R] p) i = p i • m

name: finsuppScalarRight_apply_tmul
statement:
lemma finsuppScalarRight_apply_tmul (m : M) (p : ι →₀ R) :
    finsuppScalarRight R S M ι (m ⊗ₜ[R] p) = p.sum fun i n ↦ Finsupp.single i (n • m)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [finsuppScalarRight_apply_tmul_apply, Finsupp.sum_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_eq_single i (fun _ _ ↦ Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne') (by simp), Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: finsuppScalarRight_apply
statement:
lemma finsuppScalarRight_apply (t : M ⊗[R] (ι →₀ R)) (i : ι) :
    finsuppScalarRight R S M ι t i =
      AlgebraTensorModule.rid R S M ((Finsupp.lapply i).lTensor M t)

name: finsuppScalarRight_symm_apply_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finsuppScalarRight_symm_apply_single (i : ι) (m : M) :
    (finsuppScalarRight R S M ι).symm (Finsupp.single i m) =
      m ⊗ₜ[R] (Finsupp.single i 1)

name: finsuppScalarRight_smul
statement:
theorem finsuppScalarRight_smul (s : S) (t) :
    finsuppScalarRight R S M ι (s • t) = s • finsuppScalarRight R S M ι t

name: Finsupp.linearCombination_one_tmul
statement:
theorem Finsupp.linearCombination_one_tmul [DecidableEq ι] {v : ι → M} :
    (linearCombination S ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] v ·)).restrictScalars R =
      (linearCombination R v).lTensor S ∘ₗ (finsuppScalarRight R R S ι).symm

name: finsuppTensorFinsupp_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsuppTensorFinsupp_single (i : ι) (m : M) (k : κ) (n : N) :
    finsuppTensorFinsupp R S M N ι κ (Finsupp.single i m ⊗ₜ Finsupp.single k n) =
      Finsupp.single (i, k) (m ⊗ₜ n)

name: finsuppTensorFinsupp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsuppTensorFinsupp_apply (f : ι →₀ M) (g : κ →₀ N) (i : ι) (k : κ) :
    finsuppTensorFinsupp R S M N ι κ (f ⊗ₜ g) (i, k) = f i ⊗ₜ g k
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂ => simp [add_tmul, hf₁, hf₂]
  | single i' m =>
    induction g using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add g₁ g₂ hg₁ hg₂ => simp [tmul_add, hg₁, hg₂]
    | single k' n =>
      classical
      simp_rw [finsuppTensorFinsupp_single, Finsupp.single_apply, Prod.mk_inj, ite_and]
      split_ifs <;> simp

name: finsuppTensorFinsupp_symm_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsuppTensorFinsupp_symm_single (i : ι × κ) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (finsuppTensorFinsupp R S M N ι κ).symm (Finsupp.single i (m ⊗ₜ n)) =
      Finsupp.single i.1 m ⊗ₜ Finsupp.single i.2 n

name: finsuppTensorFinsuppLid_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsuppTensorFinsuppLid_apply_apply (f : ι →₀ R) (g : κ →₀ N) (a : ι) (b : κ) :
    finsuppTensorFinsuppLid R N ι κ (f ⊗ₜ[R] g) (a, b) = f a • g b

name: finsuppTensorFinsuppLid_single_tmul_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsuppTensorFinsuppLid_single_tmul_single (a : ι) (b : κ) (r : R) (n : N) :
    finsuppTensorFinsuppLid R N ι κ (Finsupp.single a r ⊗ₜ[R] Finsupp.single b n) =
      Finsupp.single (a, b) (r • n)

name: finsuppTensorFinsuppLid_symm_single_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsuppTensorFinsuppLid_symm_single_smul (i : ι × κ) (r : R) (n : N) :
    (finsuppTensorFinsuppLid R N ι κ).symm (Finsupp.single i (r • n)) =
      Finsupp.single i.1 r ⊗ₜ Finsupp.single i.2 n

name: finsuppTensorFinsuppRid_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsuppTensorFinsuppRid_apply_apply (f : ι →₀ M) (g : κ →₀ R) (a : ι) (b : κ) :
    finsuppTensorFinsuppRid R M ι κ (f ⊗ₜ[R] g) (a, b) = g b • f a

name: finsuppTensorFinsuppRid_single_tmul_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsuppTensorFinsuppRid_single_tmul_single (a : ι) (b : κ) (m : M) (r : R) :
    finsuppTensorFinsuppRid R M ι κ (Finsupp.single a m ⊗ₜ[R] Finsupp.single b r) =

name: finsuppTensorFinsuppRid_symm_single_smul

theorem finsuppTensorFinsuppRid_symm_single_smul (i : ι × κ) (m : M) (r : R) :

name: finsuppTensorFinsupp'_apply_apply

@[simp]
theorem finsuppTensorFinsupp'_apply_apply (f : ι →₀ R) (g : κ →₀ R) (a : ι) (b : κ) :
    finsuppTensorFinsupp' R ι κ (f ⊗ₜ[R] g) (a, b) = f a * g b
proof:
:=
  finsuppTensorFinsuppLid_apply_apply R R ι κ f g a b

name: finsuppTensorFinsupp'_single_tmul_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finsuppTensorFinsupp'_single_tmul_single (a : ι) (b : κ) (r₁ r₂ : R) :

proof:

name: finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_mul
statement:
theorem finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_mul (i : ι × κ) (r₁ r₂ : R) :

      Finsupp.single i.1 r₁ ⊗ₜ Finsupp.single i.2 r₂

  finsuppTensorFinsuppLid_symm_single_smul R R ι κ i r₁ r₂

name: finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_eq_single_one_tmul

theorem finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_eq_single_one_tmul (i : ι × κ) (r : R) :

      Finsupp.single i.1 1 ⊗ₜ Finsupp.single i.2 r

:= by

  exact finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_mul R ι κ i _ _

name: finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_eq_tmul_single_one
statement:
theorem finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_eq_tmul_single_one (i : ι × κ) (r : R) :
    (finsuppTensorFinsupp' R ι κ).symm (Finsupp.single i r) =
      Finsupp.single i.1 r ⊗ₜ Finsupp.single i.2 1
proof:
:= by

  exact finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_mul R ι κ i _ _

name: directSum_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem directSum_ext [Finite ι] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)]
    ⦃f g : MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ ⨁ j : κ i, M i j) M'⦄
    (h : ∀ p : (i : ι) → κ i,
      f.compLinearMap (fun i => DirectSum.lof _ _ _ (p i)) =
      g.compLinearMap (fun i => DirectSum.lof _ _ _ (p i))) : f = g

name: fromDirectSumEquiv_lof
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fromDirectSumEquiv_lof [Finite ι] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)]
    (f : (p : (i : ι) → κ i) → MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ M i (p i)) M')
    (p : (i : ι) → κ i) (x : (i : ι) → M i (p i)) :
    fromDirectSumEquiv f (fun i => lof R _ _ _ (x i)) = f p x
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  rw [fromDirectSumEquiv, ← fromDFinsuppEquiv_single]
  convert! rfl

name: fromDirectSumEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem fromDirectSumEquiv_apply [Fintype ι] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)]
    [Π i (j : κ i) (x : M i j), Decidable (x ≠ 0)]
    (f : (p : (i : ι) → κ i) → MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ M i (p i)) M')
    (x : ⨁ i, ⨁ (j : κ i), M i j) :
    fromDirectSumEquiv f x =
      ∑ p ∈ Fintype.piFinset (fun i ↦ (x i).support), f p (fun i ↦ x i (p i))

name: fromDirectSumEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fromDirectSumEquiv_symm_apply [Finite ι] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)]
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ ⨁ j : κ i, M i j) M')
    (p : (i : ι) → κ i) :
    fromDirectSumEquiv.symm f p = f.compLinearMap (fun i ↦ DirectSum.lof _ _ _ (p i))
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  simp_rw [fromDirectSumEquiv, DirectSum.lof, ← fromDFinsuppEquiv_symm_apply]
  convert! rfl

name: LinearMap.uncurryLeft_apply

theorem LinearMap.uncurryLeft_apply (f : M 0 →ₗ[R] MultilinearMap R (fun i : Fin n => M i.succ) M₂)

theorem MultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply (f : MultilinearMap R M M₂) (x : M 0)

theorem MultilinearMap.curryRight_apply (f : MultilinearMap R M M₂)

name: MultilinearMap.uncurry_curryRight

name: currySum_apply
statement:

theorem currySum_apply (f : MultilinearMap R N M₂)

    currySum f u v = f (Sum.rec u v)

name: currySum_apply'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem currySum_apply' {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N]
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι ⊕ ι' ↦ N) M₂)
    (u : ι → N) (v : ι' → N) :
    currySum f u v = f (Sum.elim u v)

name: currySum_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma currySum_add (f₁ f₂ : MultilinearMap R N M₂) :
    currySum (f₁ + f₂) = currySum f₁ + currySum f₂

name: currySum_smul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma currySum_smul (r : R) (f : MultilinearMap R N M₂) :
    currySum (r • f) = r • currySum f

name: uncurrySum_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem uncurrySum_apply
    (g : MultilinearMap R (fun i : ι ↦ N (.inl i))
      (MultilinearMap R (fun i : ι' ↦ N (.inr i)) M₂)) (u) :
    g.uncurrySum u =
      g (fun i ↦ u (.inl i)) (fun i' ↦ u (.inr i'))

name: uncurrySum_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma uncurrySum_add
    (g₁ g₂ : MultilinearMap R (fun i : ι ↦ N (.inl i))
      (MultilinearMap R (fun i : ι' ↦ N (.inr i)) M₂)) :
    uncurrySum (g₁ + g₂) = uncurrySum g₁ + uncurrySum g₂

name: uncurrySum_smul
statement:
lemma uncurrySum_smul
    (r : R) (g : MultilinearMap R (fun i : ι ↦ N (.inl i))
      (MultilinearMap R (fun i : ι' ↦ N (.inr i)) M₂)) :
    uncurrySum (r • g) = r • uncurrySum g

name: uncurrySum_currySum
statement:
@[simp]
lemma uncurrySum_currySum (f : MultilinearMap R N M₂) :
    uncurrySum (currySum f) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [uncurrySum_apply, currySum_apply]
  congr
  ext (_ | _) <;> simp

name: currySum_uncurrySum
statement:
@[simp]
lemma currySum_uncurrySum
    (g : MultilinearMap R (fun i : ι ↦ N (.inl i))

statement:

theorem coe_currySumEquiv : ⇑(currySumEquiv (R := R) (N := N) (M₂ := M₂)) = currySum

name: coe_currySumEquiv_symm
statement:

theorem coe_currySumEquiv_symm : ⇑(currySumEquiv (R := R) (N := N) (M₂ := M₂)).symm = uncurrySum

name: curryFinFinset_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryFinFinset_apply {k l n : ℕ} {s : Finset (Fin n)} (hk : #s = k) (hl : #sᶜ = l)
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin n => M') M₂) (mk : Fin k → M') (ml : Fin l → M') :
    curryFinFinset R M₂ M' hk hl f mk ml =
      f fun i => Sum.elim mk ml ((finSumEquivOfFinset hk hl).symm i)

name: curryFinFinset_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryFinFinset_symm_apply {k l n : ℕ} {s : Finset (Fin n)} (hk : #s = k)
    (hl : #sᶜ = l)
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => M') (MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin l => M') M₂))
    (m : Fin n → M') :
    (curryFinFinset R M₂ M' hk hl).symm f m =
      f (fun i => m <| finSumEquivOfFinset hk hl (Sum.inl i)) fun i =>
        m <| finSumEquivOfFinset hk hl (Sum.inr i)

name: curryFinFinset_symm_apply_piecewise_const
statement:
theorem curryFinFinset_symm_apply_piecewise_const {k l n : ℕ} {s : Finset (Fin n)} (hk : #s = k)
    (hl : #sᶜ = l)
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => M') (MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin l => M') M₂))
    (x y : M') :
    (curryFinFinset R M₂ M' hk hl).symm f (s.piecewise (fun _ => x) fun _ => y) =
      f (fun _ => x) fun _ => y
proof:
:= by
  rw [curryFinFinset_symm_apply]; congr
  · ext
    rw [finSumEquivOfFinset_inl, Finset.piecewise_eq_of_mem]
    apply Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem
  · ext
    rw [finSumEquivOfFinset_inr, Finset.piecewise_eq_of_notMem]
    exact Finset.mem_compl.1 (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ _)

name: curryFinFinset_symm_apply_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curryFinFinset_symm_apply_const {k l n : ℕ} {s : Finset (Fin n)} (hk : #s = k)
    (hl : #sᶜ = l)
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin k => M') (MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin l => M') M₂))
    (x : M') : ((curryFinFinset R M₂ M' hk hl).symm f fun _ => x) = f (fun _ => x) fun _ => x

name: curryFinFinset_apply_const
statement:
theorem curryFinFinset_apply_const {k l n : ℕ} {s : Finset (Fin n)} (hk : #s = k)
    (hl : #sᶜ = l) (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin n => M') M₂) (x y : M') :
    (curryFinFinset R M₂ M' hk hl f (fun _ => x) fun _ => y) =
      f (s.piecewise (fun _ => x) fun _ => y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← curryFinFinset_symm_apply_piecewise_const hk hl, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: domCoprod_domDomCongr_sumCongr
statement:
theorem domCoprod_domDomCongr_sumCongr (a : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι₁ => N) N₁)
    (b : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι₂ => N) N₂) (σa : ι₁ ≃ ι₃) (σb : ι₂ ≃ ι₄) :

name: pi_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem pi_ext [Finite ι] [∀ i, Finite (κ i)] [∀ i, DecidableEq (κ i)]
    ⦃f g : MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ Π j : κ i, M i j) N⦄
    (h : ∀ p : Π i, κ i,
      f.compLinearMap (fun i => LinearMap.single R _ (p i)) =
      g.compLinearMap (fun i => LinearMap.single R _ (p i))) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change f (fun i ↦ x i) = g (fun i ↦ x i)
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := nonempty_fintype ι
  have (i : _) := (nonempty_fintype (κ i)).some
  have := Classical.decEq ι
  rw [funext (fun i ↦ Eq.symm (Finset.univ_sum_single (x i)))]
  simp_rw [MultilinearMap.map_sum_finset]
  congr! 1 with p
  simp_rw [MultilinearMap.ext_iff] at h
  exact h _ _

name: piFamily_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem piFamily_single [Fintype ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (κ i)]
    (f : Π (p : Π i, κ i), MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ M i (p i)) (N p))
    (p : ∀ i, κ i) (m : ∀ i, M i (p i)) :
    piFamily f (fun i => Pi.single (p i) (m i)) = Pi.single p (f p m)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  obtain rfl | hpq := eq_or_ne p q
  · simp
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne' hpq]
    rw [Function.ne_iff] at hpq
    obtain ⟨i, hpqi⟩ := hpq
    apply (f q).map_coord_zero i
    simp_rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne' hpqi]

name: piFamily_single_left_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem piFamily_single_left_apply [Fintype ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (κ i)]
    (p : Π i, κ i) (f : MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ M i (p i)) (N p)) (x : Π i j, M i j) :
    piFamily (Pi.single p f) x = Pi.single p (f fun i => x i (p i))
proof:
:= by
  ext p'
  obtain rfl | hp := eq_or_ne p p'
  · simp
  · simp [hp]

name: piFamily_single_left
statement:
theorem piFamily_single_left [Fintype ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (κ i)]
    (p : Π i, κ i) (f : MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ M i (p i)) (N p)) :
    piFamily (Pi.single p f) =
      (LinearMap.single R _ p).compMultilinearMap (f.compLinearMap fun i => .proj (p i))

name: piFamily_compLinearMap_lsingle
statement:
@[simp]
theorem piFamily_compLinearMap_lsingle [Fintype ι] [∀ i, DecidableEq (κ i)]
    (f : Π (p : Π i, κ i), MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ M i (p i)) (N p)) (p : ∀ i, κ i) :
    (piFamily f).compLinearMap (fun i => LinearMap.single _ _ (p i))
      = (LinearMap.single _ _ p).compMultilinearMap (f p)

name: piFamily_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem piFamily_zero :

name: piFamily_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem piFamily_add (f g : Π (p : Π i, κ i), MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ M i (p i)) (N p)) :
    piFamily (f + g) = piFamily f + piFamily g

name: piFamily_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem piFamily_smul
    [Monoid S] [∀ p, DistribMulAction S (N p)] [∀ p, SMulCommClass R S (N p)]
    (s : S) (f : Π (p : Π i, κ i), MultilinearMap R (fun i ↦ M i (p i)) (N p)) :
    piFamily (s • f) = s • piFamily f

name: map_update_add
statement:

protected theorem map_update_add [DecidableEq ι] (m : ∀ i, M₁ i) (i : ι) (x y : M₁ i) :

name: map_coord_zero
statement: theorem map_coord_zero {m : ∀ i, M₁ i} (i : ι) (h : m i = 0) : f m = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
    have : (0 : R) • (0 : M₁ i) = 0 := by simp
    rw [← update_eq_self i m, h, ← this, f.map_update_smul, zero_smul]

name: map_update_zero
statement:

statement:

name: cons_add
statement:
theorem cons_add (f : MultilinearMap R M M₂) (m : ∀ i : Fin n, M i.succ) (x y : M 0) :
    f (cons (x + y) m) = f (cons x m) + f (cons y m)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← update_cons_zero x m (x + y), f.map_update_add, update_cons_zero]

    f (cons (c • x) m) = c • f (cons x m)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← update_cons_zero x m (c • x), f.map_update_smul, update_cons_zero]

name: snoc_add
statement:
theorem snoc_add (f : MultilinearMap R M M₂)
    (m : ∀ i : Fin n, M (castSucc i)) (x y : M (last n)) :
    f (snoc m (x + y)) = f (snoc m x) + f (snoc m y)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← update_snoc_last x m (x + y), f.map_update_add, update_snoc_last]

name: snoc_smul
statement:
theorem snoc_smul (f : MultilinearMap R M M₂) (m : ∀ i : Fin n, M (castSucc i)) (c : R)
    (x : M (last n)) : f (snoc m (c • x)) = c • f (snoc m x)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← update_snoc_last x m (c • x), f.map_update_smul, update_snoc_last]

name: map_insertNth_add
statement:
theorem map_insertNth_add (f : MultilinearMap R M M₂) (p : Fin (n + 1)) (m : ∀ i, M (p.succAbove i))
    (x y : M p) : f (p.insertNth (x + y) m) = f (p.insertNth x m) + f (p.insertNth y m)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using f.map_update_add (p.insertNth 0 m) p x y

name: map_insertNth_smul
statement:
theorem map_insertNth_smul (f : MultilinearMap R M M₂) (p : Fin (n + 1))
    (m : ∀ i, M (p.succAbove i)) (c : R) (x : M p) :
    f (p.insertNth (c • x) m) = c • f (p.insertNth x m)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using f.map_update_smul (p.insertNth 0 m) p c x

name: compLinearMap_apply
statement:

theorem compLinearMap_apply (g : MultilinearMap R M₁' M₂) (f : ∀ i, M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i)
    (m : ∀ i, M₁ i) : g.compLinearMap f m = g fun i => f i (m i)

name: compLinearMap_assoc
statement:
theorem compLinearMap_assoc (g : MultilinearMap R M₁'' M₂) (f₁ : ∀ i, M₁' i →ₗ[R] M₁'' i)
    (f₂ : ∀ i, M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i) :
    (g.compLinearMap f₁).compLinearMap f₂ = g.compLinearMap fun i => f₁ i ∘ₗ f₂ i

name: zero_compLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_compLinearMap (f : ∀ i, M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i) :
    (0 : MultilinearMap R M₁' M₂).compLinearMap f = 0

name: compLinearMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compLinearMap_id (g : MultilinearMap R M₁' M₂) :
    (g.compLinearMap fun _ => LinearMap.id) = g

name: compLinearMap_injective
statement:
theorem compLinearMap_injective (f : ∀ i, M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i) (hf : ∀ i, Surjective (f i)) :
    Injective fun g : MultilinearMap R M₁' M₂ => g.compLinearMap f
proof:
:= fun g₁ g₂ h =>
  ext fun x => by
    simpa [fun i => surjInv_eq (hf i)]
      using MultilinearMap.ext_iff.mp h fun i => surjInv (hf i) (x i)

name: compLinearMap_inj
statement:
theorem compLinearMap_inj (f : ∀ i, M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i) (hf : ∀ i, Surjective (f i))
    (g₁ g₂ : MultilinearMap R M₁' M₂) : g₁.compLinearMap f = g₂.compLinearMap f ↔ g₁ = g₂

name: comp_linearEquiv_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_linearEquiv_eq_zero_iff (g : MultilinearMap R M₁' M₂) (f : ∀ i, M₁ i ≃ₗ[R] M₁' i) :
    (g.compLinearMap fun i => (f i : M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i)) = 0 ↔ g = 0
proof:
:= by
  set f' := fun i => (f i : M₁ i →ₗ[R] M₁' i)
  rw [← zero_compLinearMap f', compLinearMap_inj f' fun i => (f i).surjective]

name: map_piecewise_add
statement:
theorem map_piecewise_add [DecidableEq ι] (m m' : ∀ i, M₁ i) (t : Finset ι) :
    f (t.piecewise (m + m') m') = ∑ s ∈ t.powerset, f (s.piecewise m m')
proof:
:= by
  revert m'
  refine Finset.induction_on t (by simp) ?_
  intro i t hit Hrec m'
  have A : (insert i t).piecewise (m + m') m' = update (t.piecewise (m + m') m') i (m i + m' i) :=
    t.piecewise_insert _ _ _
  have B : update (t.piecewise (m + m') m') i (m' i) = t.piecewise (m + m') m' := by
    ext j
    by_cases h : j = i
    · rw [h]
      simp [hit]
    · simp [h]
  let m'' := update m' i (m i)
  have C : update (t.piecewise (m + m') m') i (m i) = t.piecewise (m + m'') m'' := by
    ext j
    by_cases h : j = i
    · rw [h]
      simp [m'', hit]
    · by_cases h' : j ∈ t <;> simp [m'', h, h']
  rw [A, f.map_update_add, B, C, Finset.sum_powerset_insert hit, Hrec, Hrec, add_comm (_ : M₂)]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs => ?_
  have : (insert i s).piecewise m m' = s.piecewise m m'' := by
    ext j
    by_cases h : j = i
    · rw [h]
      simp [m'', Finset.notMem_of_mem_powerset_of_notMem hs hit]
    · by_cases h' : j ∈ s <;> simp [m'', h, h']
  rw [this]

name: map_add_univ
statement:
theorem map_add_univ [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (m m' : ∀ i, M₁ i) :
    f (m + m') = ∑ s : Finset ι, f (s.piecewise m m')
proof:
:= by
  simpa using f.map_piecewise_add m m' Finset.univ

name: map_sum_finset_aux
statement:
theorem map_sum_finset_aux [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {n : ℕ} (h : (∑ i, #(A i)) = n) :
    (f fun i => ∑ j ∈ A i, g i j) = ∑ r ∈ piFinset A, f fun i => g i (r i)
proof:
:= by
  let := fun i => Classical.decEq (α i)
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing A with | h n IH =>
  
  by_cases! Ai_empty : ∃ i, A i = ∅
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, ∑ j ∈ A i, g i j = 0 := Ai_empty.imp fun i hi ↦ by simp [hi]
    have hpi : piFinset A = ∅ := by simpa
    rw [f.map_coord_zero i hi, hpi, Finset.sum_empty]
  
  
  by_cases! Ai_singleton : ∀ i, #(A i) ≤ 1
  · have Ai_card : ∀ i, #(A i) = 1 := by
      intro i
      have pos : #(A i) ≠ 0 := by rw [Finset.card_ne_zero]; exact Ai_empty i
      have : #(A i) ≤ 1 := Ai_singleton i
      exact le_antisymm this (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (_root_.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr pos))
    have :
      ∀ r : ∀ i, α i, r ∈ piFinset A → (f fun i => g i (r i)) = f fun i => ∑ j ∈ A i, g i j := by
      intro r hr
      congr with i
      have : ∀ j ∈ A i, g i j = g i (r i) := by
        intro j hj
        congr
        apply Finset.card_le_one_iff.1 (Ai_singleton i) hj
        exact mem_piFinset.mp hr i
      simp only [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, Finset.sum_const, Ai_card i, one_nsmul]
    simp only [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, Ai_card, card_piFinset, prod_const_one, one_nsmul,
      Finset.sum_const]
  
  
  
  
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ : ∃ i, 1 < #(A i) := Ai_singleton
  obtain ⟨j₁, j₂, _, hj₂, _⟩ : ∃ j₁ j₂, j₁ ∈ A i₀ ∧ j₂ ∈ A i₀ ∧ j₁ ≠ j₂ :=
    Finset.one_lt_card_iff.1 hi₀
  let B := Function.update A i₀ (A i₀ \ {j₂})
  let C := Function.update A i₀ {j₂}
  have B_subset_A : ∀ i, B i ⊆ A i := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · rw [hi]
      simp only [B, Finset.sdiff_subset, update_self]
    · simp only [B, hi, update_of_ne, Ne, not_false_iff, Finset.Subset.refl]
  have C_subset_A : ∀ i, C i ⊆ A i := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · rw [hi]
      simp only [C, hj₂, Finset.singleton_subset_iff, update_self]
    · simp only [C, hi, update_of_ne, Ne, not_false_iff, Finset.Subset.refl]
  
  have A_eq_BC :
    (fun i => ∑ j ∈ A i, g i j) =
      Function.update (fun i => ∑ j ∈ A i, g i j) i₀
        ((∑ j ∈ B i₀, g i₀ j) + ∑ j ∈ C i₀, g i₀ j) := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · rw [hi, update_self]
      have : A i₀ = B i₀ ∪ C i₀ := by
        simp only [B, C, Function.update_self, Finset.sdiff_union_self_eq_union]
        symm
        simp only [hj₂, Finset.singleton_subset_iff, Finset.union_eq_left]
      rw [this]
      refine Finset.sum_union <| Finset.disjoint_right.2 fun j hj => ?_
      have : j = j₂ := by
        simpa [C] using hj
      rw [this]
      simp only [B, Finset.mem_sdiff, not_true, not_false_iff, Finset.mem_singleton,
        update_self, and_false]
    · simp [hi]
  have Beq :
    Function.update (fun i => ∑ j ∈ A i, g i j) i₀ (∑ j ∈ B i₀, g i₀ j) = fun i =>
      ∑ j ∈ B i, g i j := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · rw [hi]
      simp only [update_self]
    · simp only [B, hi, update_of_ne, Ne, not_false_iff]
  have Ceq :
    Function.update (fun i => ∑ j ∈ A i, g i j) i₀ (∑ j ∈ C i₀, g i₀ j) = fun i =>
      ∑ j ∈ C i, g i j := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = i₀
    · rw [hi]
      simp only [update_self]
    · simp only [C, hi, update_of_ne, Ne, not_false_iff]
  
  have Brec : (f fun i => ∑ j ∈ B i, g i j) = ∑ r ∈ piFinset B, f fun i => g i (r i) := by
    have : ∑ i, #(B i) < ∑ i, #(A i) := by
      refine sum_lt_sum (fun i _ => card_le_card (B_subset_A i)) ⟨i₀, mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      have : {j₂} ⊆ A i₀ := by simp [hj₂]
      simp only [B, Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset this, Function.update_self, Finset.card_singleton]
      exact Nat.pred_lt (ne_of_gt (lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one hi₀))
    rw [h] at this
    exact IH _ this B rfl
  
  have Crec : (f fun i => ∑ j ∈ C i, g i j) = ∑ r ∈ piFinset C, f fun i => g i (r i) := by
    have : (∑ i, #(C i)) < ∑ i, #(A i) :=
      Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun i _ => Finset.card_le_card (C_subset_A i))
        ⟨i₀, Finset.mem_univ _, by simp [C, hi₀]⟩
    rw [h] at this
    exact IH _ this C rfl
  have D : Disjoint (piFinset B) (piFinset C) :=
    haveI : Disjoint (B i₀) (C i₀) := by simp [B, C]
    piFinset_disjoint_of_disjoint B C this
  have pi_BC : piFinset A = piFinset B ∪ piFinset C := by
    apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
    · intro r hr
      by_cases hri₀ : r i₀ = j₂
      · apply Finset.mem_union_right
        refine mem_piFinset.2 fun i => ?_
        by_cases hi : i = i₀
        · have : r i₀ ∈ C i₀ := by simp [C, hri₀]
          rwa [hi]
        · simp [C, hi, mem_piFinset.1 hr i]
      · apply Finset.mem_union_left
        refine mem_piFinset.2 fun i => ?_
        by_cases hi : i = i₀
        · have : r i₀ ∈ B i₀ := by simp [B, hri₀, mem_piFinset.1 hr i₀]
          rwa [hi]
        · simp [B, hi, mem_piFinset.1 hr i]
    · exact
        Finset.union_subset (piFinset_subset _ _ fun i => B_subset_A i)
          (piFinset_subset _ _ fun i => C_subset_A i)
  rw [A_eq_BC]
  simp only [MultilinearMap.map_update_add, Beq, Ceq, Brec, Crec, pi_BC]
  rw [← Finset.sum_union D]

name: map_sum_finset
statement:
theorem map_sum_finset [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] :
    (f fun i => ∑ j ∈ A i, g i j) = ∑ r ∈ piFinset A, f fun i => g i (r i)

name: map_sum
statement:
theorem map_sum [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] [∀ i, Fintype (α i)] :
    (f fun i => ∑ j, g i j) = ∑ r : ∀ i, α i, f fun i => g i (r i)

name: map_update_sum
statement:
theorem map_update_sum {α : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (t : Finset α) (i : ι) (g : α → M₁ i)
    (m : ∀ i, M₁ i) : f (update m i (∑ a ∈ t, g a)) = ∑ a ∈ t, f (update m i (g a))
proof:
:= by
  classical
    induction t using Finset.induction with
    | empty => simp
    | insert _ _ has ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert has, ih]

name: coe_restrictScalars
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_restrictScalars (f : MultilinearMap A M₁ M₂) : ⇑(f.restrictScalars R) = f

name: domDomCongr_trans
statement:
theorem domDomCongr_trans (σ₁ : ι₁ ≃ ι₂) (σ₂ : ι₂ ≃ ι₃)
    (m : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι₁ => M₂) M₃) :
    m.domDomCongr (σ₁.trans σ₂) = (m.domDomCongr σ₁).domDomCongr σ₂

name: domDomCongr_mul

theorem domDomCongr_mul (σ₁ : Equiv.Perm ι₁) (σ₂ : Equiv.Perm ι₁)
    (m : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι₁ => M₂) M₃) :
    m.domDomCongr (σ₂ * σ₁) = (m.domDomCongr σ₁).domDomCongr σ₂

name: domDomCongr_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem domDomCongr_eq_iff (σ : ι₁ ≃ ι₂) (f g : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι₁ => M₂) M₃) :
    f.domDomCongr σ = g.domDomCongr σ ↔ f = g

name: domDomRestrict_aux
statement:
lemma domDomRestrict_aux {ι} [DecidableEq ι] (P : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred P] {M₁ : ι → Type*}
    [DecidableEq {a // P a}]
    (x : (i : {a // P a}) → M₁ i) (z : (i : {a // ¬ P a}) → M₁ i) (i : {a : ι // P a})
    (c : M₁ i) : (fun j ↦ if h : P j then Function.update x i c ⟨j, h⟩ else z ⟨j, h⟩) =
    Function.update (fun j => if h : P j then x ⟨j, h⟩ else z ⟨j, h⟩) i c

name: domDomRestrict_aux_right
statement:
lemma domDomRestrict_aux_right {ι} [DecidableEq ι] (P : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred P] {M₁ : ι → Type*}
    [DecidableEq {a // ¬ P a}]
    (x : (i : {a // P a}) → M₁ i) (z : (i : {a // ¬ P a}) → M₁ i) (i : {a : ι // ¬ P a})
    (c : M₁ i) : (fun j ↦ if h : P j then x ⟨j, h⟩ else Function.update z i c ⟨j, h⟩) =
    Function.update (fun j => if h : P j then x ⟨j, h⟩ else z ⟨j, h⟩) i c
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [dite_not] using domDomRestrict_aux _ z (fun j ↦ x ⟨j.1, not_not.mp j.2⟩) i c

name: domDomRestrict_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma domDomRestrict_apply (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) (P : ι → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] (x : (i : {a // P a}) → M₁ i) (z : (i : {a // ¬ P a}) → M₁ i) :
    f.domDomRestrict P z x = f (fun j => if h : P j then x ⟨j, h⟩ else z ⟨j, h⟩)

name: linearDeriv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma linearDeriv_apply [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂)
    (x y : (i : ι) → M₁ i) :
    f.linearDeriv x y = ∑ i, f (update x i (y i))
proof:
:= by
  unfold linearDeriv
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_sum, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearMap.coe_proj, Finset.sum_apply,
    Function.comp_apply, Function.eval, toLinearMap_apply]

name: coe_compMultilinearMap

theorem coe_compMultilinearMap (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) :

name: compMultilinearMap_apply
statement:

theorem compMultilinearMap_apply (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) (m : ∀ i, M₁ i) :

name: id_compMultilinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_compMultilinearMap (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) :

    (g.comp g').compMultilinearMap f = g.compMultilinearMap (g'.compMultilinearMap f)

name: compMultilinearMap_compLinearMap
statement:
theorem compMultilinearMap_compLinearMap
    (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) (f' : ∀ i, M₁' i →ₗ[R] M₁ i) :
    g.compMultilinearMap (f.compLinearMap f') = (g.compMultilinearMap f).compLinearMap f'

name: compMultilinearMap_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compMultilinearMap_zero (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) :
    g.compMultilinearMap (0 : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) = 0

name: zero_compMultilinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_compMultilinearMap (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) :
    (0 : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃).compMultilinearMap f = 0

name: compMultilinearMap_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compMultilinearMap_add (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (f₁ f₂ : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) :
    g.compMultilinearMap (f₁ + f₂) = g.compMultilinearMap f₁ + g.compMultilinearMap f₂

name: add_compMultilinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_compMultilinearMap (g₁ g₂ : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) :
    (g₁ + g₂).compMultilinearMap f = g₁.compMultilinearMap f + g₂.compMultilinearMap f

name: compMultilinearMap_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compMultilinearMap_smul [DistribSMul S M₂] [DistribSMul S M₃]
    [SMulCommClass R S M₂] [SMulCommClass R S M₃] [CompatibleSMul M₂ M₃ S R]
    (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (s : S) (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) :
    g.compMultilinearMap (s • f) = s • g.compMultilinearMap f

name: smul_compMultilinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_compMultilinearMap [Monoid S] [DistribMulAction S M₃] [SMulCommClass R S M₃]

name: subtype_compMultilinearMap_codRestrict
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subtype_compMultilinearMap_codRestrict (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂) (p : Submodule R M₂)
    (h) : p.subtype.compMultilinearMap (f.codRestrict p h) = f

name: compMultilinearMap_codRestrict
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compMultilinearMap_codRestrict (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (f : MultilinearMap R M₁ M₂)
    (p : Submodule R M₃) (h) :
    (g.codRestrict p h).compMultilinearMap f =
      (g.compMultilinearMap f).codRestrict p fun v => h (f v)

name: compMultilinearMap_domDomCongr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compMultilinearMap_domDomCongr (σ : ι₁ ≃ ι₂) (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃)
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι₁ => M') M₂) :
    (g.compMultilinearMap f).domDomCongr σ = g.compMultilinearMap (f.domDomCongr σ)

name: iteratedFDeriv_aux
statement:
lemma iteratedFDeriv_aux {ι} {M₁ : ι → Type*} {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Set ι) [DecidableEq { x // x ∈ s }] (e : α ≃ s)
    (m : α → ((i : ι) → M₁ i)) (a : α) (z : (i : ι) → M₁ i) :
    (fun i ↦ update m a z (e.symm i) i) =
      (fun i ↦ update (fun j ↦ m (e.symm j) j) (e a) (z (e a)) i)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rcases eq_or_ne a (e.symm i) with rfl | hne
  · rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply e i, update_self, update_self]
  · rw [update_of_ne hne.symm, update_of_ne fun h ↦ (Equiv.symm_apply_apply .. ▸ h ▸ hne) rfl]

name: map_piecewise_smul
statement:
theorem map_piecewise_smul [DecidableEq ι] (c : ι → R) (m : ∀ i, M₁ i) (s : Finset ι) :
    f (s.piecewise (fun i => c i • m i) m) = (∏ i ∈ s, c i) • f m
proof:
:= by
  refine s.induction_on (by simp) ?_
  intro j s j_notMem_s Hrec
  have A :
    Function.update (s.piecewise (fun i => c i • m i) m) j (m j) =
      s.piecewise (fun i => c i • m i) m := by
    ext i
    by_cases h : i = j
    · rw [h]
      simp [j_notMem_s]
    · simp [h]
  rw [s.piecewise_insert, f.map_update_smul, A, Hrec]
  simp [j_notMem_s, mul_smul]

name: map_smul_univ
statement:
theorem map_smul_univ [Fintype ι] (c : ι → R) (m : ∀ i, M₁ i) :
    (f fun i => c i • m i) = (∏ i, c i) • f m
proof:
:= by
  classical simpa using map_piecewise_smul f c m Finset.univ

name: map_update_smul_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_update_smul_left [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι]
    (m : ∀ i, M₁ i) (i : ι) (c : R) (x : M₁ i) :
    f (update (c • m) i x) = c ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) • f (update m i x)
proof:
:= by
  have : f ((Finset.univ.erase i).piecewise (c • update m i x) (update m i x)) =
      (∏ _i ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, c) • f (update m i x) :=
    map_piecewise_smul f _ _ _
  simpa [← Function.update_smul c m] using this

name: ext_ring
statement:
@[ext]
