lemma tmul_mem_baseChange_of_mem (a : A) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ p) :
    a ⊗ₜ[R] m ∈ p.baseChange A

name: baseChange_eq_span
statement: lemma baseChange_eq_span : p.baseChange A = span A (p.map (TensorProduct.mk R A M 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [baseChange, LinearMap.range_le_iff_comap, eq_top_iff,
      ← span_eq_top_of_span_eq_top R A _ (span_tmul_eq_top R ..), span_le]
    refine fun _ ⟨a, m, h⟩ ↦ ?_
    rw [← h, SetLike.mem_coe, mem_comap, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, ← mul_one a, ← smul_eq_mul,
      ← smul_tmul']
    exact smul_mem _ a (subset_span ⟨m, m.2, rfl⟩)
  · refine span_le.2 fun _ ⟨m, hm, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ ⟨1 ⊗ₜ[R] ⟨m, hm⟩, rfl⟩

name: baseChange_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChange_bot : (⊥ : Submodule R M).baseChange A = ⊥

name: baseChange_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChange_top : (⊤ : Submodule R M).baseChange A = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← span_eq_top_of_span_eq_top R A _ (span_tmul_eq_top R ..)]
  exact span_le.2 fun _ ⟨a, m, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ tmul_mem_baseChange_of_mem _ trivial

name: baseChange_mono
statement: theorem baseChange_mono (h : p ≤ q) : p.baseChange A ≤ q.baseChange A
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseChange, LinearMap.baseChange, ← subtype_comp_inclusion p q h,
    ← LinearMap.id_comp LinearMap.id, AlgebraTensorModule.map_comp]
  apply LinearMap.range_comp_le_range

name: baseChange_span
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChange_span (s : Set M) :
    (span R s).baseChange A = span A (TensorProduct.mk R A M 1 '' s)

name: coe_toBaseChange_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_toBaseChange_tmul (a : A) (x : p) :
    (p.toBaseChange A (a ⊗ₜ x) : A ⊗[R] M) = a ⊗ₜ (x : M)

name: toBaseChange_surjective
statement: lemma toBaseChange_surjective : Function.Surjective (p.toBaseChange A)

name: toBaseChange_surjective'
statement:
lemma toBaseChange_surjective' {y : A ⊗[R] M} (hy : y ∈ p.baseChange A) :
    ∃ x : A ⊗[R] p, p.toBaseChange A x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := toBaseChange_surjective A p ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact ⟨x, congr($hx)⟩

name: baseChange_comp_cancelBaseChange_symm_self
statement:
lemma baseChange_comp_cancelBaseChange_symm_self (f : (A ⊗[R] M) →ₗ[A] N) :
    f.baseChange A ∘ₗ (cancelBaseChange R A A A M).symm = (TensorProduct.lid A N).symm ∘ₗ f

name: ker_baseChange_comp_cancelBaseChange_symm
statement:
lemma ker_baseChange_comp_cancelBaseChange_symm (f : (A ⊗[R] M) →ₗ[A] N) :
    (f.baseChange A ∘ₗ (cancelBaseChange R A A A M).symm).ker = f.ker

name: map_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_tmul (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) (m : M) (n : N) :
    map f g (m ⊗ₜ n) = f m ⊗ₜ g n

name: map_comp_comm_eq
statement:
lemma map_comp_comm_eq (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    map f g ∘ₛₗ (TensorProduct.comm R N M).toLinearMap =
      (TensorProduct.comm R₂ N₂ M₂).toLinearMap ∘ₛₗ map g f

name: map_comm
statement:
lemma map_comm (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) (x : N ⊗[R] M) :
    map f g (TensorProduct.comm R N M x) = TensorProduct.comm R₂ N₂ M₂ (map g f x)

name: range_map
statement:
theorem range_map (f : M →ₗ[R] P) (g : N →ₗ[R] Q) :
    range (map f g) = .map₂ (mk R _ _) (range f) (range g)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Submodule.map_top, Submodule.map₂_map_map, ← map₂_mk_top_top_eq_top,
    Submodule.map_map₂]
  rfl

name: range_map_eq_span_tmul
statement:
theorem range_map_eq_span_tmul (f : M →ₗ[R] P) (g : N →ₗ[R] Q) :
    range (map f g) = Submodule.span R { t | ∃ m n, f m ⊗ₜ g n = t }
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Submodule.map_top, ← span_tmul_eq_top, Submodule.map_span]
  congr; ext t
  simp

name: range_mapIncl
statement:
lemma range_mapIncl (p : Submodule R P) (q : Submodule R Q) :
    LinearMap.range (mapIncl p q) = .map₂ (mk R _ _) p q

name: map
statement:
theorem map₂_eq_range_lift_comp_mapIncl (f : P →ₗ[R] Q →ₗ[R] M)
    (p : Submodule R P) (q : Submodule R Q) :
    Submodule.map₂ f p q = LinearMap.range (lift f ∘ₗ mapIncl p q)

name: map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (f₂ : M₂ →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] M₃) (g₂ : N₂ →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] N₃)
    (f₁ : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g₁ : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    map (f₂ ∘ₛₗ f₁) (g₂ ∘ₛₗ g₁) = (map f₂ g₂) ∘ₛₗ (map f₁ g₁)

name: map_map
statement:
theorem map_map (f₂ : M₂ →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] M₃) (g₂ : N₂ →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] N₃)
    (f₁ : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g₁ : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) (x : M ⊗[R] N) :
    map f₂ g₂ (map f₁ g₁ x) = map (f₂ ∘ₛₗ f₁) (g₂ ∘ₛₗ g₁) x

name: range_map_mono
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [range_map]
  exact Submodule.map₂_le_map₂ hab hcd

name: range_mapIncl_mono
statement:
lemma range_mapIncl_mono {p p' : Submodule R P} {q q' : Submodule R Q} (hp : p ≤ p') (hq : q ≤ q') :
    LinearMap.range (mapIncl p q) ≤ LinearMap.range (mapIncl p' q')

name: lift_comp_map
statement:
theorem lift_comp_map (i : M₂ →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] N₂ →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] P₃) (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    (lift i).comp (map f g) = lift ((i.comp f).compl₂ g)

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map (id : M →ₗ[R] M) (id : N →ₗ[R] N) = .id
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [mk_apply, id_coe, compr₂ₛₗ_apply, _root_.id, map_tmul]

name: map_one
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_one : map (1 : M →ₗ[R] M) (1 : N →ₗ[R] N) = 1

name: map_mul
statement:
protected theorem map_mul (f₁ f₂ : M →ₗ[R] M) (g₁ g₂ : N →ₗ[R] N) :
    map (f₁ * f₂) (g₁ * g₂) = map f₁ g₁ * map f₂ g₂

name: map_pow
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_pow (f : M →ₗ[R] M) (g : N →ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ) :
    map f g ^ n = map (f ^ n) (g ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, TensorProduct.map_one]
  | succ n ih => simp only [pow_succ', ih, TensorProduct.map_mul]

name: map_add_left
statement:
theorem map_add_left (f₁ f₂ : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    map (f₁ + f₂) g = map f₁ g + map f₂ g
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [add_tmul, compr₂ₛₗ_apply, mk_apply, map_tmul, add_apply]

name: map_add_right
statement:
theorem map_add_right (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g₁ g₂ : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    map f (g₁ + g₂) = map f g₁ + map f g₂
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [tmul_add, compr₂ₛₗ_apply, mk_apply, map_tmul, add_apply]

name: map_smul_left
statement:
theorem map_smul_left (r : R₂) (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    map (r • f) g = r • map f g
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [smul_tmul, compr₂ₛₗ_apply, mk_apply, map_tmul, smul_apply, tmul_smul]

name: map_smul_right
statement:
theorem map_smul_right (r : R₂) (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    map f (r • g) = r • map f g
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [compr₂ₛₗ_apply, mk_apply, map_tmul, smul_apply, tmul_smul]

name: mapBilinear_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapBilinear_apply (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    mapBilinear σ₁₂ M N M₂ N₂ f g = map f g

name: lTensorHomToHomLTensor_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lTensorHomToHomLTensor_apply (m₂ : M₂) (f : P →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) (p : P) :

name: rTensorHomToHomRTensor_apply

theorem rTensorHomToHomRTensor_apply (f : P →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (n₂ : N₂) (p : P) :

name: homTensorHomMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homTensorHomMap_apply (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    homTensorHomMap _ M N M₂ N₂ (f ⊗ₜ g) = map f g

name: map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map₂_apply_tmul (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₃] M₂ →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] M₃) (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₃] N₂ →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] N₃)
    (m : M) (n : N) :
    map₂ f g (m ⊗ₜ n) = map (f m) (g n)

name: map_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_zero_left (g : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) : map (0 : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) g = 0

name: map_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_zero_right (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) : map f (0 : N →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) = 0

name: homTensorHomMap_comp_map_lcomp
statement:
lemma homTensorHomMap_comp_map_lcomp (f : M' →ₗ[R] M) (f' : N' →ₗ[R] N) :
    homTensorHomMap (.id R) M' N' P Q ∘ₗ map (f.lcomp R P) (f'.lcomp R Q) =
      (map f f').lcomp R (P ⊗[R] Q) ∘ₗ homTensorHomMap (.id R) M N P Q

name: toLinearMap_congr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toLinearMap_congr (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    (congr f g).toLinearMap = map f g

name: congr_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem congr_tmul (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) (m : M) (n : N) :
    congr f g (m ⊗ₜ n) = f m ⊗ₜ g n

name: congr_symm_tmul
statement:
theorem congr_symm_tmul (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) (p : M₂) (q : N₂) :
    (congr f g).symm (p ⊗ₜ q) = f.symm p ⊗ₜ g.symm q

name: congr_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem congr_symm (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) (g : N ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N₂) :
    (congr f g).symm = congr f.symm g.symm

name: congr_refl_refl
statement: @[simp] theorem congr_refl_refl : congr (.refl R M) (.refl R N) = .refl R _

name: congr_trans
statement: theorem congr_trans : congr (f₁.trans f₂) (g₁.trans g₂) = (congr f₁ g₁).trans (congr f₂ g₂)

name: congr_congr
statement:
theorem congr_congr (x : M ⊗[R] N) :
    congr f₂ g₂ (congr f₁ g₁ x) = congr (f₁.trans f₂) (g₁.trans g₂) x

name: congr_mul
statement:
theorem congr_mul (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M) (g : N ≃ₗ[R] N) (f' : M ≃ₗ[R] M) (g' : N ≃ₗ[R] N) :
    congr (f * f') (g * g') = congr f g * congr f' g'

name: congr_pow
statement:
@[simp] theorem congr_pow (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M) (g : N ≃ₗ[R] N) (n : ℕ) :
    congr f g ^ n = congr (f ^ n) (g ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact congr_refl_refl.symm
  | succ n ih => simp_rw [pow_succ, ih, congr_mul]

name: congr_zpow
statement:
@[simp] theorem congr_zpow (f : M ≃ₗ[R] M) (g : N ≃ₗ[R] N) (n : ℤ) :
    congr f g ^ n = congr (f ^ n) (g ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat n => exact congr_pow _ _ _
  | negSucc n => simp_rw [zpow_negSucc, congr_pow]; exact congr_symm _ _

name: smul_lTensor
statement:
theorem smul_lTensor {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S] [SMul R S] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M]
    [SMulCommClass R S M] (s : S) (m : M ⊗[R] N) : s • (f.lTensor M) m = (f.lTensor M) (s • m)
proof:
:=
  have h : s • (f.lTensor M) = f.lTensor M ∘ₗ (LinearMap.lsmul S (M ⊗[R] N) s).restrictScalars R :=
    TensorProduct.ext rfl
  congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe h) m

  rw [this]

theorem liftAux.smulₛₗ (r : R) (x) : liftAux f' (r • x) = σ₁₂ r • liftAux f' x
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.inductionOn x
    (fun p q => by simp_rw [← tmul_smul, liftAux_tmul, (f' p).map_smulₛₗ])

proof:
:=

name: neg_add_cancel
statement: protected theorem neg_add_cancel (x : M ⊗[R] N) : -x + x = 0
proof:
:=
  x.inductionOn
    (fun x y => by convert! (add_tmul (R := R) (-x) x y).symm; rw [neg_add_cancel, zero_tmul])
    fun x y hx hy => by
    suffices -x + x + (-y + y) = 0 by
      rw [← this]
      unfold Neg.neg neg
      simp only
      rw [map_add]
      abel
    rw [hx, hy, add_zero]

name: neg_tmul
statement: theorem neg_tmul (m : M) (n : N) : (-m) ⊗ₜ n = -m ⊗ₜ[R] n

name: tmul_neg
statement: theorem tmul_neg (m : M) (p : P) : m ⊗ₜ (-p) = -m ⊗ₜ[R] p

name: tmul_sub
statement: theorem tmul_sub (m : M) (p₁ p₂ : P) : m ⊗ₜ (p₁ - p₂) = m ⊗ₜ[R] p₁ - m ⊗ₜ[R] p₂

name: sub_tmul
statement: theorem sub_tmul (m₁ m₂ : M) (n : N) : (m₁ - m₂) ⊗ₜ n = m₁ ⊗ₜ[R] n - m₂ ⊗ₜ[R] n

name: quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotTensorEquivQuotSMul_mk_tmul (I : Ideal R) (r : R) (x : M) :
    quotTensorEquivQuotSMul M I (Ideal.Quotient.mk I r ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (r • x)
proof:
:=
  (quotTensorEquivQuotSMul M I).eq_symm_apply.mp <|
    Eq.trans (congrArg (· ⊗ₜ[R] x) <|
        Eq.trans (congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
                    (Eq.trans (smul_eq_mul ..) (mul_one r))).symm <|
          Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul I r 1) <|
      smul_tmul r _ x

name: ker_mapOfCompatibleSMul
proof:
:= by
  refine (Submodule.span_eq_of_le (mapOfCompatibleSMul A R A M N).ker ?_ ?_).symm
  · rintro - ⟨a, m, n, rfl⟩
    simp [smul_tmul]
  · let S := Submodule.span A {(a • m) ⊗ₜ[R] n - m ⊗ₜ[R] (a • n) | (a : A) (m : M) (n : N)}
    let F : M ⊗[A] N →ₗ[A] (M ⊗[R] N) ⧸ S := TensorProduct.lift ({
      toFun m := {
        toFun n := S.mkQ (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)
        map_add' _ _ := by simp [tmul_add]
        map_smul' a n := by
          rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, eq_comm,
            Submodule.Quotient.eq, RingHom.id_apply]
          exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨a, m, n, rfl⟩ }
      map_add' _ _ := by ext _; simp [add_tmul]
      map_smul' _ _ := by simp; rfl })
    have h : F ∘ₗ mapOfCompatibleSMul A R A M N = S.mkQ := by ext; simp [S, F]
    change (mapOfCompatibleSMul A R A M N).ker ≤ S
    rw [← Submodule.ker_mkQ S, ← h]
    exact (mapOfCompatibleSMul A R A M N).ker_le_ker_comp F

name: le_comap_range_lTensor

name: LinearMap.lTensor_surjective
statement:
theorem LinearMap.lTensor_surjective (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    Function.Surjective (lTensor Q g)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  induction z with
  | tmul q p =>
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hg p
    exact ⟨q ⊗ₜ[R] n, rfl⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨x + y, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: LinearMap.lTensor_range
statement:
theorem LinearMap.lTensor_range :
    range (lTensor Q g) =
      range (lTensor Q (Submodule.subtype (range g)))
proof:
:= by
  have : g = (Submodule.subtype _).comp g.rangeRestrict := rfl
  nth_rewrite 1 [this]
  rw [lTensor_comp]
  apply range_comp_of_range_eq_top
  rw [range_eq_top]
  apply lTensor_surjective
  rw [← range_eq_top, range_rangeRestrict]

lemma LinearMap.rTensor_exact_iff_lTensor_exact :

    (e₂ := TensorProduct.comm _ _ _) (e₃ := TensorProduct.comm _ _ _)

name: lTensor.inverse_of_rightInverse_apply
statement:
lemma lTensor.inverse_of_rightInverse_apply
    {h : P → N} (hgh : Function.RightInverse h g) (y : Q ⊗[R] N) :
    (lTensor.inverse_of_rightInverse Q hfg hgh) ((lTensor Q g) y) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (p := (LinearMap.range (lTensor Q f))) y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← Submodule.mkQ_apply]
  rw [exact_iff] at hfg
  apply LinearMap.congr_fun
  apply TensorProduct.ext'
  intro n q
  suffices Submodule.Quotient.mk (n ⊗ₜ[R] h (g q)) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (n ⊗ₜ[R] q) by
    simpa
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
  apply le_comap_range_lTensor f n
  rw [← hfg, mem_ker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero, hgh]

lemma lTensor.inverse_of_rightInverse_comp_lTensor
    {h : P → N} (hgh : Function.RightInverse h g) :

      Submodule.mkQ (p := LinearMap.range (lTensor Q f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.ext_iff]
  intro y
  simp only [coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply,
    lTensor.inverse_of_rightInverse_apply]

name: lTensor_exact
statement: theorem lTensor_exact : Exact (lTensor Q f) (lTensor Q g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [exact_iff, ← Submodule.ker_mkQ (p := range (lTensor Q f)),
    ← lTensor.inverse_comp_lTensor Q hfg hg]
  apply symm
  apply LinearMap.ker_comp_of_ker_eq_bot
  rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
  exact (lTensor.equiv Q hfg hg).symm.injective

name: LinearMap.ker_tensorProductMk
statement:
lemma LinearMap.ker_tensorProductMk {I : Ideal R} :
    ker (TensorProduct.mk R (R ⧸ I) Q 1) = I • ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply comap_injective_of_surjective (TensorProduct.lid R Q).surjective
  rw [← ker_comp]
  convert! rTensor_mkQ Q I
  · ext; simp
  rw [comap_equiv_eq_map_symm, map_symm_eq_iff, map_range_rTensor_subtype_lid]

name: TensorProduct.map_ker
statement:
theorem TensorProduct.map_ker :
    ker (TensorProduct.map g g') = range (lTensor N f') ⊔ range (rTensor N' f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lTensor_comp_rTensor]
  rw [ker_comp]
  rw [← Exact.linearMap_ker_eq (rTensor_exact N' hfg hg)]
  rw [← Submodule.comap_map_eq]
  apply congr_arg₂ _ rfl
  rw [range_eq_map, ← Submodule.map_comp, rTensor_comp_lTensor,
    Submodule.map_top]
  rw [← lTensor_comp_rTensor, range_eq_map, Submodule.map_comp,
    Submodule.map_top]
  rw [range_eq_top.mpr (rTensor_surjective M' hg), Submodule.map_top]
  rw [Exact.linearMap_ker_eq (lTensor_exact P hfg' hg')]

name: Ideal.map_includeLeft_eq
statement:
lemma Ideal.map_includeLeft_eq (I : Ideal A) :
    (I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B)).restrictScalars R
      = LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor B (Submodule.subtype (I.restrictScalars R)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.coe_set_eq]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_range]
    rw [Ideal.map, ← submodule_span_eq] at hx
    refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro x
      simp only [includeLeft_apply, Set.mem_image, SetLike.mem_coe]
      rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      use ⟨y, hy⟩ ⊗ₜ[R] 1
      rfl
    · use 0
      simp only [map_zero]
    · rintro x y - - ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      use x + y
      simp only [map_add]
    · rintro a x - ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      induction a with
      | tmul a b =>
        induction x with
        | tmul x y =>
          use (a • x) ⊗ₜ[R] (b * y)
          simp only [smul_eq_mul]
          with_unfolding_all rfl
        | add x y hx hy =>
          obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hx
          obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hy
          use x' + y'
          simp only [map_add, hx', smul_add, hy']
      | add a b ha hb =>
        obtain ⟨x', ha'⟩ := ha
        obtain ⟨y', hb'⟩ := hb
        use x' + y'
        simp only [map_add, ha', add_smul, hb']
  · rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    induction y with
    | tmul a b =>
        simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, Submodule.coe_subtype]
        suffices (a : A) ⊗ₜ[R] b = ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] b) * ((a : A) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) by
          simp only [Submodule.coe_restrictScalars, SetLike.mem_coe]
          rw [this]
          apply Ideal.mul_mem_left
          
          apply Ideal.mem_map_of_mem includeLeft
          exact Submodule.coe_mem a
        simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
          mul_one, one_mul]
    | add x y hx hy =>
        rw [map_add]
        apply Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy

name: Ideal.map_includeRight_eq
statement:
lemma Ideal.map_includeRight_eq (I : Ideal B) :
    (I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : B →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] B)).restrictScalars R
      = LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lTensor A (Submodule.subtype (I.restrictScalars R)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.coe_set_eq]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_range]
    rw [Ideal.map, ← submodule_span_eq] at hx
    refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
    · intro x
      simp only [includeRight_apply, Set.mem_image, SetLike.mem_coe]
      rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      use 1 ⊗ₜ[R] ⟨y, hy⟩
      rfl
    · use 0
      simp only [map_zero]
    · rintro x y - - ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      use x + y
      simp only [map_add]
    · rintro a x - ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      induction a with
      | tmul a b =>
        induction x with
        | tmul x y =>
          use (a * x) ⊗ₜ[R] (b • y)
          simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, Submodule.coe_subtype, smul_eq_mul, tmul_mul_tmul]
          rfl
        | add x y hx hy =>
          obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hx
          obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hy
          use x' + y'
          simp only [map_add, hx', smul_add, hy']
      | add a b ha hb =>
        obtain ⟨x', ha'⟩ := ha
        obtain ⟨y', hb'⟩ := hb
        use x' + y'
        simp only [map_add, ha', add_smul, hb']
  · rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    induction y with
    | tmul a b =>
        simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, Submodule.coe_subtype]
        suffices a ⊗ₜ[R] (b : B) = (a ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) * ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] (b : B)) by
          rw [this]
          simp only [Submodule.coe_restrictScalars, SetLike.mem_coe]
          apply Ideal.mul_mem_left
          
          apply Ideal.mem_map_of_mem includeRight
          exact Submodule.coe_mem b
        simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
          mul_one, one_mul]
    | add x y hx hy =>
        rw [map_add]
        apply Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy

name: TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.range_lTensor_idealMap
statement:
lemma TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.range_lTensor_idealMap (S : Type*) [CommSemiring S]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra S A] [IsScalarTower R S A] (I : Ideal B) :
    LinearMap.range (lTensor S A (I.subtype.restrictScalars R)) =
      (I.map (includeRight (A := A) (R := R))).restrictScalars S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (Submodule.restrictScalars_injective R _ _).eq_iff]
  exact (I.map_includeRight_eq (R := R) (A := A)).symm

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor_ker
statement:
lemma Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor_ker (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    RingHom.ker (map (AlgHom.id R A) g) =
      (RingHom.ker g).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : C →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.restrictScalars_inj R]
  have : (RingHom.ker (map (AlgHom.id R A) g)).restrictScalars R =
    LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.lTensor A (AlgHom.toLinearMap g)) := rfl
  rw [this, Ideal.map_includeRight_eq]
  rw [(lTensor_exact A g.toLinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map hg).linearMap_ker_eq]
  rfl

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.rTensor_ker
statement:
lemma Algebra.TensorProduct.rTensor_ker (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    RingHom.ker (map f (AlgHom.id R C)) =
      (RingHom.ker f).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.restrictScalars_inj R]
  have : (RingHom.ker (map f (AlgHom.id R C))).restrictScalars R =
    LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.rTensor C (f.restrictScalars R).toLinearMap) := rfl
  rw [this, Ideal.map_includeLeft_eq]
  rw [(rTensor_exact C (f.restrictScalars R).toLinearMap.exact_subtype_ker_map hf).linearMap_ker_eq]
  rfl

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.map_surjective
statement:
theorem Algebra.TensorProduct.map_surjective
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    Function.Surjective (map f g)

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.map_ker
statement:
theorem Algebra.TensorProduct.map_ker (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    RingHom.ker (map f g) =
      (RingHom.ker f).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] C) ⊔
        (RingHom.ker g).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : C →ₐ[R] A ⊗[R] C)
proof:
:= by
  
  have : map f g = (map f (AlgHom.id R D)).comp (map (AlgHom.id S A) g) := ext rfl rfl
  rw [this]
  
  
  simp only [AlgHom.ker_coe, AlgHom.comp_toRingHom]
  rw [← RingHom.comap_ker]
  simp only [← AlgHom.ker_coe]
  
  rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor_ker _ hg, RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot (map (AlgHom.id R A) g)]
  rw [← Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective (map (AlgHom.id R A) g) (LinearMap.lTensor_surjective A hg)]
  
  rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.rTensor_ker _ hf]
  apply congr_arg₂ _ rfl
  simp only [AlgHom.coe_ideal_map, Ideal.map_map]
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_toRingHom, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp_includeLeft]
  rfl

name: zero_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_tmul (n : N) : (0 : M) ⊗ₜ[R] n = 0

name: add_tmul
statement: theorem add_tmul (m₁ m₂ : M) (n : N) : (m₁ + m₂) ⊗ₜ n = m₁ ⊗ₜ n + m₂ ⊗ₜ[R] n

name: tmul_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_zero (m : M) : m ⊗ₜ[R] (0 : N) = 0

name: tmul_add
statement: theorem tmul_add (m : M) (n₁ n₂ : N) : m ⊗ₜ (n₁ + n₂) = m ⊗ₜ n₁ + m ⊗ₜ[R] n₂

name: inductionOn
statement:
@[elab_as_elim, induction_eliminator]
protected theorem inductionOn {motive : M ⊗[R] N → Prop} (z : M ⊗[R] N)
    (tmul : ∀ x y, motive <| x ⊗ₜ[R] y)
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) : motive z
proof:
:=
  AddCon.induction_on z fun x =>
    FreeAddMonoid.recOn x (by simpa using! tmul 0 0) fun ⟨m, n⟩ y ih => by
      simpa using! add _ _ (tmul ..) ih

name: induction_on
statement:
@[deprecated "Use `TensorProduction.inductionOn` instead" (since := "2026-09-07")]
protected theorem induction_on {motive : M ⊗[R] N → Prop} (z : M ⊗[R] N)
    (zero : motive 0)
    (tmul : ∀ x y, motive <| x ⊗ₜ[R] y)
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) : motive z

name: smul_tmul
statement:
theorem smul_tmul [DistribMulAction R' N] [CompatibleSMul R R' M N] (r : R') (m : M) (n : N) :
    (r • m) ⊗ₜ n = m ⊗ₜ[R] (r • n)

name: SMul.aux_of
statement:
theorem SMul.aux_of {R' : Type*} [SMul R' M] (r : R') (m : M) (n : N) :
    SMul.aux r (.of (m, n)) = (r • m) ⊗ₜ[R] n

name: smul_zero
statement: protected theorem smul_zero (r : R') : r • (0 : M ⊗[R] N) = 0

name: smul_add
statement: protected theorem smul_add (r : R') (x y : M ⊗[R] N) : r • (x + y) = r • x + r • y

name: zero_smul
statement: protected theorem zero_smul (x : M ⊗[R] N) : (0 : R'') • x = 0
proof:
:=
  have : ∀ (r : R'') (m : M) (n : N), r • m ⊗ₜ[R] n = (r • m) ⊗ₜ n := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  x.inductionOn
    (fun m n => by rw [this, zero_smul, zero_tmul]) fun x y ihx ihy => by
    rw [TensorProduct.smul_add, ihx, ihy, add_zero]

name: one_smul
statement: protected theorem one_smul (x : M ⊗[R] N) : (1 : R') • x = x
proof:
:=
  have : ∀ (r : R') (m : M) (n : N), r • m ⊗ₜ[R] n = (r • m) ⊗ₜ n := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  x.inductionOn
    (fun m n => by rw [this, one_smul])
    fun x y ihx ihy => by rw [TensorProduct.smul_add, ihx, ihy]

name: add_smul
statement: protected theorem add_smul (r s : R'') (x : M ⊗[R] N) : (r + s) • x = r • x + s • x
proof:
:=
  have : ∀ (r : R'') (m : M) (n : N), r • m ⊗ₜ[R] n = (r • m) ⊗ₜ n := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  x.inductionOn
    (fun m n => by simp_rw [this, add_smul, add_tmul]) fun x y ihx ihy => by
    simp_rw [TensorProduct.smul_add]
    rw [ihx, ihy, add_add_add_comm]

name: _root_.IsAddUnit.tmul_left
statement: theorem _root_.IsAddUnit.tmul_left {n : N} (hn : IsAddUnit n) (m : M) : IsAddUnit (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isAddUnit_iff_exists_neg] at hn ⊢
  have ⟨b, eq⟩ := hn
  exact ⟨m ⊗ₜ[R] b, by rw [← tmul_add, eq, tmul_zero]⟩

name: _root_.IsAddUnit.tmul_right
statement: theorem _root_.IsAddUnit.tmul_right {m : M} (hm : IsAddUnit m) (n : N) : IsAddUnit (m ⊗ₜ[R] n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isAddUnit_iff_exists_neg] at hm ⊢
  have ⟨b, eq⟩ := hm
  exact ⟨b ⊗ₜ[R] n, by rw [← add_tmul, eq, zero_tmul]⟩

name: smul_tmul'
statement: theorem smul_tmul' (r : R') (m : M) (n : N) : r • m ⊗ₜ[R] n = (r • m) ⊗ₜ n

name: tmul_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tmul_smul [DistribMulAction R' N] [CompatibleSMul R R' M N] (r : R') (x : M) (y : N) :
    x ⊗ₜ (r • y) = r • x ⊗ₜ[R] y

name: smul_tmul_smul
statement: theorem smul_tmul_smul (r s : R) (m : M) (n : N) : (r • m) ⊗ₜ[R] (s • n) = (r * s) • m ⊗ₜ[R] n

name: tmul_eq_smul_one_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_eq_smul_one_tmul {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [Module R S] [SMulCommClass R S S]
    (s : S) (m : M) : s ⊗ₜ[R] m = s • (1 ⊗ₜ[R] m)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← mul_one s, ← smul_eq_mul, smul_tmul']

name: mk_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_apply (m : M) (n : N) : mk R M N m n = m ⊗ₜ n

name: ite_tmul
statement:
theorem ite_tmul (x₁ : M) (x₂ : N) (P : Prop) [Decidable P] :
    (if P then x₁ else 0) ⊗ₜ[R] x₂ = if P then x₁ ⊗ₜ x₂ else 0

statement:

name: tmul_single
statement:
lemma tmul_single {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M i)]
    [∀ i, Module R (M i)] (i : ι) (x : N) (m : M i) (j : ι) :
    x ⊗ₜ[R] Pi.single i m j = (Pi.single i (x ⊗ₜ[R] m) : ∀ i, N ⊗[R] M i) j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = j <;> aesop

name: single_tmul
statement:
lemma single_tmul {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M i)]
    [∀ i, Module R (M i)] (i : ι) (x : N) (m : M i) (j : ι) :
    Pi.single i m j ⊗ₜ[R] x = (Pi.single i (m ⊗ₜ[R] x) : ∀ i, M i ⊗[R] N) j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = j <;> aesop

name: sum_tmul
statement:
theorem sum_tmul {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (m : α → M) (n : N) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, m a) ⊗ₜ[R] n = ∑ a ∈ s, m a ⊗ₜ[R] n
proof:
:= by
  classical
    induction s using Finset.induction with
    | empty => simp
    | insert _ _ has ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert has, add_tmul, ih]

name: tmul_sum
statement:
theorem tmul_sum (m : M) {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (n : α → N) :
    (m ⊗ₜ[R] ∑ a ∈ s, n a) = ∑ a ∈ s, m ⊗ₜ[R] n a
proof:
:= by
  classical
    induction s using Finset.induction with
    | empty => simp
    | insert _ _ has ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert has, tmul_add, ih]

name: span_tmul_eq_top
statement: theorem span_tmul_eq_top : Submodule.span R { t : M ⊗[R] N | ∃ m n, m ⊗ₜ n = t } = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext t; simp only [Submodule.mem_top, iff_true]
  refine t.inductionOn ?_ ?_
  · intro m n
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    use m, n
  · intro t₁ t₂ ht₁ ht₂
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ ht₁ ht₂

name: map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map₂_mk_top_top_eq_top : Submodule.map₂ (mk R M N) ⊤ ⊤ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← top_le_iff, ← span_tmul_eq_top, Submodule.map₂_eq_span_image2]
  exact Submodule.span_mono fun _ ⟨m, n, h⟩ => ⟨m, trivial, n, trivial, h⟩

name: exists_eq_tmul_of_forall
statement:
theorem exists_eq_tmul_of_forall (x : TensorProduct R M N)
    (h : ∀ (m₁ m₂ : M) (n₁ n₂ : N), ∃ m n, m₁ ⊗ₜ n₁ + m₂ ⊗ₜ n₂ = m ⊗ₜ[R] n) :
    ∃ m n, x = m ⊗ₜ n
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | tmul m n => use m, n
  | add x y h₁ h₂ =>
    obtain ⟨m₁, n₁, rfl⟩ := h₁
    obtain ⟨m₂, n₂, rfl⟩ := h₂
    apply h

name: mulMap_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mulMap_tmul (m : M) (n : N) : mulMap M N (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = m.1 * n.1

name: mulMap_map_comp_eq
statement:
theorem mulMap_map_comp_eq {T : Type w} [Semiring T] [Algebra R T] (f : S →ₐ[R] T) :
    mulMap (M.map (f : S →ₗ[R] T)) (N.map (f : S →ₗ[R] T)) ∘ₗ
      TensorProduct.map ((f : S →ₗ[R] T).submoduleMap M) ((f : S →ₗ[R] T).submoduleMap N)
        = (f : S →ₗ[R] T) ∘ₗ mulMap M N
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.curry_apply,
    TensorProduct.curry_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars,
    Function.comp_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, mulMap_tmul, LinearMap.coe_ofClass, map_mul]
  rfl

name: coe_mulMap_comp_eq
statement:
theorem coe_mulMap_comp_eq {T : Type w} [Semiring T] [Algebra R T] (f : S →ₐ[R] T) :
    mulMap (M.map (f : S →ₗ[R] T)) (N.map (f : S →ₗ[R] T)) ∘
      TensorProduct.map ((f : S →ₗ[R] T).submoduleMap M) ((f : S →ₗ[R] T).submoduleMap N)
        = f ∘ mulMap M N

name: mulMap_op
statement:
theorem mulMap_op :
    mulMap (equivOpposite.symm (MulOpposite.op M)) (equivOpposite.symm (MulOpposite.op N)) =
    (MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv R).toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulMap N M ∘ₗ
    (TensorProduct.congr
      (LinearEquiv.ofSubmodule' (MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv R).symm M)
      (LinearEquiv.ofSubmodule' (MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv R).symm N) ≪≫ₗ
    TensorProduct.comm R M N).toLinearMap

name: mulMap_comm_of_commute
statement:
theorem mulMap_comm_of_commute (hc : ∀ (m : M) (n : N), Commute m.1 n.1) :
    mulMap N M = mulMap M N ∘ₗ TensorProduct.comm R N M
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorProduct.ext' fun n m ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, TensorProduct.comm_tmul, mulMap_tmul]
  exact (hc m n).symm

name: mulMap_comp_rTensor

name: mulMap_range
statement: theorem mulMap_range : LinearMap.range (mulMap M N) = M * N
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (mul_le.2 fun m hm n hn ↦ ⟨⟨m, hm⟩ ⊗ₜ[R] ⟨n, hn⟩, rfl⟩)
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  induction x with
  | tmul a b => exact mul_mem_mul a.2 b.2
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: includeRight_lid

lemma includeRight_lid {S : Type*} [Semiring S] [Algebra R S] (m : R ⊗[R] M) :

      (LinearMap.rTensor M (Algebra.algHom R R S).toLinearMap) m

name: rid_symm_apply

lemma tensorProductAssoc_def (eA : A ≃ₗ[R] A') (eB : B ≃ₗ[R] B') (eC : C ≃ₗ[R] C') :
    TensorProduct.assoc R A B C = .trans (congr (congr eA eB) eC) (.trans
      (TensorProduct.assoc R A' B' C') <| congr eA.symm <| congr eB.symm (eC).symm)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  induction x with
  | add => simp [*]
  | tmul x a => induction x <;> simp [*, add_tmul]

name: exists_multiset
statement:
theorem exists_multiset (x : M ⊗[R] N) :
    ∃ S : Multiset (M × N), x = (S.map fun i ↦ i.1 ⊗ₜ[R] i.2).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | tmul x y => exact ⟨{(x, y)}, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨Sx, hx⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨Sy, hy⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨Sx + Sy, by rw [Multiset.map_add, Multiset.sum_add, hx, hy]⟩

name: exists_finsupp_left
statement:
theorem exists_finsupp_left (x : M ⊗[R] N) :
    ∃ S : M →₀ N, x = S.sum fun m n ↦ m ⊗ₜ[R] n
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | tmul x y => exact ⟨Finsupp.single x y, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨Sx, hx⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨Sy, hy⟩ := hy
    use Sx + Sy
    rw [hx, hy]
    exact (Finsupp.sum_add_index' (by simp) TensorProduct.tmul_add).symm

name: exists_finsupp_right
statement:
theorem exists_finsupp_right (x : M ⊗[R] N) :
    ∃ S : N →₀ M, x = S.sum fun n m ↦ m ⊗ₜ[R] n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, h⟩ := exists_finsupp_left (TensorProduct.comm R M N x)
  refine ⟨S, (TensorProduct.comm R M N).injective ?_⟩
  simp_rw [h, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, comm_tmul]

name: exists_finset
statement:
theorem exists_finset (x : M ⊗[R] N) :
    ∃ S : Finset (M × N), x = S.sum fun i ↦ i.1 ⊗ₜ[R] i.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, h⟩ := exists_finsupp_left x
  use S.graph
  rw [h, Finsupp.sum]
  apply Finset.sum_nbij' (fun m ↦ ⟨m, S m⟩) Prod.fst <;> simp

name: exists_finite_submodule_of_setFinite
statement:
theorem exists_finite_submodule_of_setFinite (s : Set (M ⊗[R] N)) (hs : s.Finite) :
    ∃ (M' : Submodule R M) (N' : Submodule R N), Module.Finite R M' ∧ Module.Finite R N' ∧
      s ⊆ LinearMap.range (mapIncl M' N')
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Module.Finite.iff_fg]
  induction s, hs using Set.Finite.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨_, _, fg_bot, fg_bot, Set.empty_subset _⟩
  | @insert a s _ _ ih =>
  obtain ⟨M', N', hM', hN', h⟩ := ih
  refine TensorProduct.inductionOn a (fun x y ↦ ?_) fun x y hx hy ↦ ?_
  · refine ⟨_, _, hM'.sup (fg_span_singleton x),
      hN'.sup (fg_span_singleton y), Set.insert_subset ?_ fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨x, mem_sup_right (mem_span_singleton_self x)⟩ ⊗ₜ
        ⟨y, mem_sup_right (mem_span_singleton_self y)⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact range_mapIncl_mono le_sup_left le_sup_left (h hz)
  · obtain ⟨M₁', N₁', hM₁', hN₁', h₁⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨M₂', N₂', hM₂', hN₂', h₂⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨_, _, hM₁'.sup hM₂', hN₁'.sup hN₂', Set.insert_subset (add_mem ?_ ?_) fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
    · exact range_mapIncl_mono le_sup_left le_sup_left (h₁ (Set.mem_insert x s))
    · exact range_mapIncl_mono le_sup_right le_sup_right (h₂ (Set.mem_insert y s))
    · exact range_mapIncl_mono le_sup_left le_sup_left (h₁ (Set.subset_insert x s hz))

name: exists_finite_submodule_left_of_setFinite
statement:
theorem exists_finite_submodule_left_of_setFinite (s : Set (M ⊗[R] N)) (hs : s.Finite) :
    ∃ M' : Submodule R M, Module.Finite R M' ∧ s ⊆ LinearMap.range (M'.subtype.rTensor N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M', _, hfin, _, h⟩ := exists_finite_submodule_of_setFinite s hs
  refine ⟨M', hfin, ?_⟩
  rw [mapIncl, ← LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor] at h
  exact h.trans (LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _)

name: exists_finite_submodule_right_of_setFinite
statement:
theorem exists_finite_submodule_right_of_setFinite (s : Set (M ⊗[R] N)) (hs : s.Finite) :
    ∃ N' : Submodule R N, Module.Finite R N' ∧ s ⊆ LinearMap.range (N'.subtype.lTensor M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, N', _, hfin, h⟩ := exists_finite_submodule_of_setFinite s hs
  refine ⟨N', hfin, ?_⟩
  rw [mapIncl, ← LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor] at h
  exact h.trans (LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _)

name: exists_finite_submodule_of_setFinite'
statement:
theorem exists_finite_submodule_of_setFinite' (s : Set (M₁ ⊗[R] N₁)) (hs : s.Finite) :
    ∃ (M' : Submodule R M) (N' : Submodule R N) (hM : M' ≤ M₁) (hN : N' ≤ N₁),
      Module.Finite R M' ∧ Module.Finite R N' ∧
        s ⊆ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (inclusion hM) (inclusion hN))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M', N', _, _, h⟩ := exists_finite_submodule_of_setFinite s hs
  have hM := map_subtype_le M₁ M'
  have hN := map_subtype_le N₁ N'
  refine ⟨_, _, hM, hN, .map _ _, .map _ _, ?_⟩
  rw [mapIncl,
    show M'.subtype = inclusion hM ∘ₗ M₁.subtype.submoduleMap M' by ext; simp,
    show N'.subtype = inclusion hN ∘ₗ N₁.subtype.submoduleMap N' by ext; simp,
    map_comp] at h
  exact h.trans (LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _)

name: exists_finite_submodule_left_of_setFinite'
statement:
theorem exists_finite_submodule_left_of_setFinite' (s : Set (M₁ ⊗[R] N₁)) (hs : s.Finite) :
    ∃ (M' : Submodule R M) (hM : M' ≤ M₁), Module.Finite R M' ∧
      s ⊆ LinearMap.range ((inclusion hM).rTensor N₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M', _, hM, _, hfin, _, h⟩ := exists_finite_submodule_of_setFinite' s hs
  refine ⟨M', hM, hfin, ?_⟩
  rw [← LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor] at h
  exact h.trans (LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _)

name: exists_finite_submodule_right_of_setFinite'
statement:
theorem exists_finite_submodule_right_of_setFinite' (s : Set (M₁ ⊗[R] N₁)) (hs : s.Finite) :
    ∃ (N' : Submodule R N) (hN : N' ≤ N₁), Module.Finite R N' ∧
      s ⊆ LinearMap.range ((inclusion hN).lTensor M₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, N', _, hN, _, hfin, h⟩ := exists_finite_submodule_of_setFinite' s hs
  refine ⟨N', hN, hfin, ?_⟩
  rw [← LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor] at h
  exact h.trans (LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _)

name: exists_sum_tmul_eq
statement:
lemma exists_sum_tmul_eq (x : M ⊗[R] N) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (m : Fin k → M) (n : Fin k → N), x = ∑ j, m j ⊗ₜ n j
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | tmul x y => exact ⟨1, fun _ ↦ x, fun _ ↦ y, by simp⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨kx, mx, nx, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨ky, my, ny, rfl⟩ := hy
    use kx + ky, Fin.addCases mx my, Fin.addCases nx ny
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_add]

name: minpoly_coeff_zero_of_injective
statement:
theorem minpoly_coeff_zero_of_injective [Nontrivial R] (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (minpoly R f).coeff 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := X_dvd_iff.2 h
  have hdegP : P.degree < (minpoly R f).degree := by
    rw [hP, mul_comm]
    refine degree_lt_degree_mul_X fun h => ?_
    rw [h, mul_zero] at hP
    exact minpoly.ne_zero (isIntegral f) hP
  have hPmonic : P.Monic := by
    suffices (minpoly R f).Monic by
      rwa [Monic.def, hP, mul_comm, leadingCoeff_mul_X, ← Monic.def] at this
    exact minpoly.monic (isIntegral f)
  have hzero : aeval f (minpoly R f) = 0 := minpoly.aeval _ _
  simp only [hP, Module.End.mul_eq_comp, LinearMap.ext_iff, hf, aeval_X, map_eq_zero_iff, coe_comp,
    map_mul, zero_apply, Function.comp_apply] at hzero
  exact not_le.2 hdegP (minpoly.min _ _ hPmonic (LinearMap.ext hzero))

name: charpoly_toMatrix
statement:
@[simp]
theorem charpoly_toMatrix {ι : Type w} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι R M) :
    (toMatrix b b f).charpoly = f.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  unfold LinearMap.charpoly
  set b' := chooseBasis R M
  rw [← basis_toMatrix_mul_linearMap_toMatrix_mul_basis_toMatrix b b' b b']
  set P := b.toMatrix b'
  set A := toMatrix b' b' f
  set Q := b'.toMatrix b
  let e := Basis.indexEquiv b b'
  let ι' := ChooseBasisIndex R M
  let φ := reindexLinearEquiv R R e e
  let φ₁ := reindexLinearEquiv R R e (Equiv.refl ι')
  let φ₂ := reindexLinearEquiv R R (Equiv.refl ι') (Equiv.refl ι')
  let φ₃ := reindexLinearEquiv R R (Equiv.refl ι') e
  calc
    (P * A * Q).charpoly = (φ (P * A * Q)).charpoly := (charpoly_reindex ..).symm
    _ = (φ₁ P * φ₂ A * φ₃ Q).charpoly := by rw [reindexLinearEquiv_mul, reindexLinearEquiv_mul]
    _ = A.charpoly := by rw [charpoly_mul_comm, ← mul_assoc]; simp [P, Q, φ₁, φ₂, φ₃]

name: charpoly_prodMap
statement:
lemma charpoly_prodMap (f₁ : M₁ →ₗ[R] M₁) (f₂ : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₂) :
    (f₁.prodMap f₂).charpoly = f₁.charpoly * f₂.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  let b₁ := chooseBasis R M₁
  let b₂ := chooseBasis R M₂
  let b := b₁.prod b₂
  rw [← charpoly_toMatrix f₁ b₁, ← charpoly_toMatrix f₂ b₂, ← charpoly_toMatrix (f₁.prodMap f₂) b,
    toMatrix_prodMap b₁ b₂ f₁ f₂, Matrix.charpoly_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]

name: LinearEquiv.charpoly_conj

lemma LinearEquiv.charpoly_conj (e : M₁ ≃ₗ[R] M₂) (φ : Module.End R M₁) :
    (e.conj φ).charpoly = φ.charpoly
proof:
:= by
  let b := chooseBasis R M₁
  rw [← LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix φ b, ← LinearMap.charpoly_toMatrix (e.conj φ) (b.map e)]
  congr 1
  ext i j : 1
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix]

lemma LinearMap.charpoly_baseChange :

  let I := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R M

  rw [← f.charpoly_toMatrix b, ← (f.baseChange A).charpoly_toMatrix (b.baseChange A),
    ← Matrix.charpoly_map]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, ← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]

name: subsingleton_of_span_eq_top_of_card_lt

lemma subsingleton_of_span_eq_top_of_card_lt {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (g : ι → M)
    (hg : Submodule.span R (range g) = ⊤) (i : ℕ) (hi : Nat.card ι < i) :
    Subsingleton (⋀[R]^i M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin ι
  let : LinearOrder ι := LinearOrder.lift' e e.injective
  replace hi : range (ιMulti_family R i g) = ∅ := by
    rw [range_eq_empty_iff, powersetCard.eq_empty_iff.mpr hi, isEmpty_coe_sort]
  suffices (⊥ : Submodule R (⋀[R]^i M)) = ⊤ by
    rwa [subsingleton_iff_bot_eq_top, Submodule.subsingleton_iff] at this
  rw [← ιMulti_family_span_of_span R hg, hi, Submodule.span_empty]

  rw [Basis.coord_apply]
  by_cases! hst : s = t

name: pairingDual_apply_dualBasis_exteriorPower
statement:
lemma pairingDual_apply_dualBasis_exteriorPower [Finite I] (s : powersetCard I n) :
    pairingDual R M n (b.dualBasis.exteriorPower n s) = (b.exteriorPower n).dualBasis s

name: pairingDual_eq_dualBasis_constr
statement:
lemma pairingDual_eq_dualBasis_constr [Finite I] :
    pairingDual R M n = (b.dualBasis.exteriorPower n).constr R (b.exteriorPower n).dualBasis
proof:
:= by
  set b₁ := b.dualBasis.exteriorPower n
  set b₂ := (b.exteriorPower n).dualBasis
  refine b₁.ext fun s ↦ ?_
  rw [Basis.constr_basis]
  simpa [b₁, b₂] using pairingDual_apply_dualBasis_exteriorPower n b s

name: finrank_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma finrank_eq [Nontrivial R] :
    finrank R (⋀[R]^n M) = (finrank R M).choose n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : LinearOrder (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex R M) := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
  let B := (Module.Free.chooseBasis R M).exteriorPower n
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (Module.Free.chooseBasis R M), Module.finrank_eq_card_basis B,
    Fintype.card_eq_nat_card, powersetCard.card, Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]

name: bijective_pairingDual
statement:
lemma bijective_pairingDual :
    Bijective (pairingDual R M n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R
  · have : Subsingleton (⋀[R]^n (Dual R M)) := Module.subsingleton R _
    exact bijective_of_subsingleton' _
  · classical
    obtain ⟨I, b⟩ := Module.Free.exists_basis R M
    let : LinearOrder I := linearOrderOfSTO WellOrderingRel
    have : Finite I := Module.Finite.finite_basis b
    let b₁ := b.dualBasis.exteriorPower n
    let b₂ := (b.exteriorPower n).dualBasis
    rw [pairingDual_eq_dualBasis_constr n b]
    refine ⟨b₁.injective_constr_of_linearIndependent b₂.linearIndependent, ?_⟩
    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, Basis.constr_range, b₂.span_eq]

name: toTensorPower_apply_
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toTensorPower_apply_ιMulti {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → M) :
    toTensorPower R M n (ιMulti R n v) =
      ∑ σ : Perm (Fin n), Perm.sign σ • PiTensorProduct.tprod R (fun i ↦ v (σ i))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [toTensorPower]
  simp only [alternatingMapLinearEquiv_apply_ιMulti,
    MultilinearMap.alternatization_apply, MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply]

name: alternatingMapToDual_apply_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem alternatingMapToDual_apply_ιMulti {n : ℕ}
    (f : (_ : Fin n) → Module.Dual R M) (v : Fin n → M) :
    alternatingMapToDual R M n f (ιMulti _ _ v) =
      Matrix.det (n := Fin n) (.of (fun i j ↦ f j (v i)))

name: pairingDual_
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pairingDual_ιMulti_ιMulti {n : ℕ} (f : (_ : Fin n) → Module.Dual R M) (v : Fin n → M) :
    pairingDual R M n (ιMulti _ _ f) (ιMulti _ _ v) =
      Matrix.det (n := Fin n) (.of (fun i j ↦ f j (v i)))

name: pairingDual_apply_apply_eq_one
statement:
@[deprecated "no replacement" (since := "2026-08-23")]
lemma pairingDual_apply_apply_eq_one (a : Fin n ↪o ι) :
    pairingDual R M n (ιMulti _ _ (f ∘ a)) (ιMulti _ _ (x ∘ a)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairingDual_ιMulti_ιMulti, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [← Matrix.det_one (n := Fin n)]
  congr
  ext i j
  dsimp
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst hij
    simp only [h₁, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
  · rw [h₀ (by simpa using Ne.symm hij), Matrix.one_apply_ne hij]

name: pairingDual_apply_apply_eq_one_zero
statement:
@[deprecated "no replacement" (since := "2026-08-23")]
lemma pairingDual_apply_apply_eq_one_zero (a b : Fin n ↪o ι) (h : a ≠ b) :
    pairingDual R M n (ιMulti _ _ (f ∘ a)) (ιMulti _ _ (x ∘ b)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairingDual_ιMulti_ιMulti, Function.comp_apply, Matrix.det_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun σ _ ↦ ?_)
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply, smul_eq_iff_eq_inv_smul, smul_zero]
  by_contra h'
  apply h
  have : a = b ∘ σ := by
    ext i
    by_contra hi
    exact h' (Finset.prod_eq_zero (i := i) (by simp) (h₀ hi))
  have hσ : Monotone σ := fun i j hij ↦ by
    have h'' := congr_fun this
    dsimp at h''
    rw [← a.map_rel_iff] at hij
    simpa only [← b.map_rel_iff, ← h'']
  have hσ' : Monotone σ.symm := fun i j hij ↦ by
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := σ.surjective i
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := σ.surjective j
    simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    by_contra! h
    obtain rfl : i = j := σ.injective (le_antisymm hij (hσ h.le))
    simp only [lt_self_iff_false] at h
  obtain rfl : σ = 1 := by
    ext i : 1
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (Subsingleton.elim (σ.toOrderIso hσ hσ') (OrderIso.refl _)) i
  ext
  apply congr_fun this

name: finrank_fixedSubmodule_add_le
statement:
theorem finrank_fixedSubmodule_add_le :
    finrank K e.fixedSubmodule + finrank K f.fixedSubmodule ≤
      finrank K ↥(e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ f.fixedSubmodule) +
        finrank K (e * f).fixedSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have := finrank_mono (fixedSubmodule_inf_fixedSubmodule_le_comp e.toLinearMap f.toLinearMap)
  rwa [← Nat.add_le_add_iff_left, finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq] at this

name: finrank_le_one_add_finrank_fixedSubmodule_dilatransvection
statement:
theorem finrank_le_one_add_finrank_fixedSubmodule_dilatransvection
    (he : e ∈ dilatransvections K V) :
    finrank K V ≤ 1 + finrank K e.fixedSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedSubmodule_eq_ker, add_comm, ← Nat.add_le_add_iff_left,
    ← add_assoc, finrank_range_add_finrank_ker, add_comm]
  simpa [← mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank]

name: le_one_add_finrank_fixedSubmodule_dilatransvection_mul
statement:
theorem le_one_add_finrank_fixedSubmodule_dilatransvection_mul (hf : f ∈ dilatransvections K V) :
    finrank K e.fixedSubmodule ≤ 1 + finrank K (f * e).fixedSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have := finrank_fixedSubmodule_add_le f e
  have := finrank_le_one_add_finrank_fixedSubmodule_dilatransvection f hf
  have : finrank K ↥(f.fixedSubmodule ⊔ e.fixedSubmodule) ≤ finrank K V :=
    finrank_le _
  linarith

name: finrank_fixedSubmodule_dilatransvection_mul_le
statement:
theorem finrank_fixedSubmodule_dilatransvection_mul_le (hf : f ∈ dilatransvections K V) :
    finrank K (f * e).fixedSubmodule ≤ 1 + finrank K e.fixedSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [show e = f⁻¹ * (f * e) by simp]
  rw [← inv_mem_dilatransvections_iff] at hf
  exact le_one_add_finrank_fixedSubmodule_dilatransvection_mul (f * e) f⁻¹ hf

name: le_one_add_finrank_fixedSubmodule_mul_dilatransvection
statement:
theorem le_one_add_finrank_fixedSubmodule_mul_dilatransvection (hf : f ∈ dilatransvections K V) :
    finrank K e.fixedSubmodule ≤ 1 + finrank K (e * f).fixedSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  have := finrank_fixedSubmodule_add_le e f
  have := finrank_le_one_add_finrank_fixedSubmodule_dilatransvection f hf
  have : finrank K ↥(e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ f.fixedSubmodule) ≤ finrank K V :=
    finrank_le _
  linarith

name: finrank_fixedSubmodule_mul_dilatransvection_le
statement:
theorem finrank_fixedSubmodule_mul_dilatransvection_le (hf : f ∈ dilatransvections K V) :
    finrank K (e * f).fixedSubmodule ≤ 1 + finrank K e.fixedSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [show e = (e * f) * f⁻¹ by simp]
  rw [← inv_mem_dilatransvections_iff] at hf
  exact le_one_add_finrank_fixedSubmodule_mul_dilatransvection (e * f) f⁻¹ hf

name: fixedSubmodule_transvection_mul
statement:
theorem fixedSubmodule_transvection_mul {f : Dual K V} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∉ e.fixedSubmodule) (hf : e.fixedSubmodule.map f = ⊥)
    (hfv : f (v - e v) = 0) (hfv' : f (e v) = 1) :
    (transvection hfv * e).fixedSubmodule = e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v
proof:
:= by
  symm
  suffices e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v ≤ (transvection hfv * e).fixedSubmodule by
    apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le this
    rw [finrank_sup_span_singleton hv, add_comm]
    apply finrank_fixedSubmodule_dilatransvection_mul_le
    exact transvection_mem_dilatransvections hfv
  simp only [sup_le_iff, Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
  have ht : e.fixedSubmodule ≤ (transvection hfv).fixedSubmodule := fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [mem_fixedSubmodule_transvection_iff, smul_eq_zero]
    left
    rw [← Submodule.mem_bot K, ← hf]
    exact mem_map_of_mem hx
  constructor
  · 
    intro x hx
    simp only [mem_fixedSubmodule_iff, LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap, LinearEquiv.mul_apply]
    suffices transvection hfv x = x by
      simp only [mem_fixedSubmodule_iff, LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap] at hx
      simp only [hx, this]
    rw [← LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap, ← mem_fixedSubmodule_iff]
    exact ht hx
  · 
    simp only [mem_fixedSubmodule_iff, LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap,
      LinearEquiv.mul_apply, transvection.apply]
    simp [hfv']

name: auxTransvection_fixed
proof:
:= fun x hx ↦ by
  simp [auxTransvection, LinearMap.transvection.apply, ← LinearMap.mem_ker, hf (mem_sup_left hx)]

name: auxTransvection_mul_fixed
proof:
:= by
  apply fixedSubmodule_transvection_mul
  · intro hu'
    replace hu' := hf (mem_sup_left hu')
    rw [mem_ker] at hu'
    simp [hu'] at hfu
  · rw [eq_bot_iff]
    rw [gc_map_comap, Submodule.comap_bot]
    exact le_trans le_sup_left hf
  · rw [← hfu, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, ← mem_ker]
    refine hf (mem_sup_right ?_)
    simp

name: finrank_quotient_sup_span_singleton
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_sup_span_singleton {W : Submodule K V} {v : V} (hv : v ∉ W) :
    finrank K (V ⧸ (W ⊔ K ∙ v)) + 1 = finrank K (V ⧸ W)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := finrank_quotient_add_finrank (W ⊔ K ∙ v)
  have h2 := finrank_quotient_add_finrank W
  rw [finrank_sup_span_singleton hv] at h1
  omega

name: sup_span_singleton_lt_top
statement:
theorem sup_span_singleton_lt_top {W : Submodule K V} (v : V)
    (hW : 1 < finrank K (V ⧸ W)) : W ⊔ K ∙ v < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
  intro htop
  have h1 := finrank_quotient_add_finrank W
  have h2 : finrank K ↥(W ⊔ K ∙ v) ≤ finrank K W + 1 := by
    refine le_trans (Submodule.finrank_add_le_finrank_add_finrank _ _) ?_
    simp only [add_le_add_iff_left]
    exact le_trans (finrank_span_le_card {v}) (by simp)
  rw [htop, finrank_top] at h2
  omega

name: finrank_mod_auxTransvection_mul_fixed
proof:
:= by
  rw [auxTransvection_mul_fixed hfu]
  exact finrank_quotient_sup_span_singleton hu

name: mem_transvections_pow_mul_dilatransvections_of_fixedReduce_eq_one
statement:
theorem mem_transvections_pow_mul_dilatransvections_of_fixedReduce_eq_one
    {e : V ≃ₗ[K] V} (he : e.fixedReduce = 1) :
    e ∈ transvections K V ^ (finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) - 1) * dilatransvections K V
proof:
:= by
  induction h : finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) generalizing e he with
  | zero => simp [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient, h]
  | succ n hind =>
    match n with
    | 0 => simp [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient, h]
    | n + 1 =>
      simp only [add_assoc, Nat.reduceAdd] at h
      simp only [add_tsub_cancel_right] at hind
      simp only [add_tsub_cancel_right, pow_succ', mul_assoc, Set.mem_mul]
      /- We construct a linear form `f` which vanishes on `e.fixedSubmodule`,
        and a vector `v` such that `f v = 1`.
        Consider the transvection `t = transvection f v`.
        Then `t * e` satisfies the induction hypothesis and
        the relation `e = t⁻¹ * (t * e)` implies that `e` satisfies the theorem.
        This transvection is given by `auxTransvection`. -/
      have : ∃ f : Dual K V, ∃ v : V, e.fixedSubmodule ≤ ker f ∧ f v = 1 := by
        have : ∃ u : V, u ∉ e.fixedSubmodule := by
          by_contra! he
          rw [← Submodule.eq_top_iff'] at he
          rw [he, ← Nat.add_left_inj, Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank, finrank_top] at h
          simp at h
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := this
        obtain ⟨f, hfu, hf⟩ := Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem hu inferInstance
        let v := (f u)⁻¹ • u
        have hv : f v = 1 := by simp [v, inv_mul_cancel₀ hfu]
        exact ⟨f, v, by rwa [LinearMap.le_ker_iff_map], hv⟩
      obtain ⟨f, v, hf, hv⟩ := this
      
      
      have hv_notMem : v ∉ e.fixedSubmodule := fun hv' ↦ by
        apply one_ne_zero' K
        rw [← hv, ← LinearMap.mem_ker]
        exact hf hv'
      
      have hv' : v - e v ∈ e.fixedSubmodule := by
        rw [← e.fixedSubmodule.ker_mkQ, LinearMap.mem_ker,
          map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
        simp [← fixedReduce_mk, he]
      set t := auxTransvection (e := e) (f := f) (u := v) (by
        simpa [hf] using hf (sub_mem_comm_iff.mp hv')) with ht
      refine ⟨t⁻¹, ?_, t * e, ?_, by simp⟩
      · 
        rw [inv_mem_transvections_iff, ht]
        apply mem_transvections
      
      apply hind
      · 
        simp only [ht, one_eq_refl, fixedReduce_eq_one, auxTransvection_mul_fixed hv] at he ⊢
        intro w
        simp only [auxTransvection, LinearEquiv.mul_apply, transvection.apply,
          add_sub_right_comm]
        apply mem_sup_left
        apply Submodule.add_mem _ (he w)
        exact smul_mem _ _ hv'
      · 
        rw [← Nat.add_left_inj, finrank_mod_auxTransvection_mul_fixed hv hv_notMem, h]

name: apply_notMem_sup_of_linearIndependent
statement:
private theorem apply_notMem_sup_of_linearIndependent {u : V}
    (hu : LinearIndependent K
      ![e.fixedSubmodule.mkQ u, e.fixedReduce (e.fixedSubmodule.mkQ u)]) :
    e u ∉ e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e u - u)
proof:
:= fun hu' ↦ by
  rw [Submodule.mem_sup] at hu'
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hu'⟩ := hu'
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hz
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hz
  simp only [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at hu
  specialize hu a (1 - a) ?_
  · simp only [← LinearMap.map_smul, ← LinearEquiv.map_smul]
    simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, fixedReduce_mk]
    simp only [← Submodule.mkQ_apply, ← map_add, ← mem_ker,
      Submodule.ker_mkQ]
    convert hy
    grind [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul, map_smul]
  aesop

name: exists_dual_of_fixedReduce_ne_smul
statement:
private theorem exists_dual_of_fixedReduce_ne_smul
    (he : ∀ a : K, ∃ x, e.fixedReduce x ≠ a • x)
    (h : 1 < finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule)) :
    ∃ (f : Dual K V) (v : V),
      LinearIndependent K ![e.fixedSubmodule.mkQ v, e.fixedReduce (e.fixedSubmodule.mkQ v)] ∧
        e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ≤ LinearMap.ker f ∧ f v = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have : ∃ v, LinearIndependent K ![v, e.fixedReduce v] := by
    contrapose! he
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
      LinearMap.exists_mem_center_apply_eq_smul_of_forall_notLinearIndependent h.ne' he
    refine ⟨a, fun x ↦ by
      simp only [← coe_toLinearMap, ha, LinearMap.smul_apply, one_apply, Subring.smul_def]⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hu⟩ := this
  
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := e.fixedSubmodule.mkQ_surjective v
  
  
  obtain ⟨f, hfu, hf⟩ :=
    exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem (apply_notMem_sup_of_linearIndependent hu) inferInstance
  replace hfu : f u ≠ 0 := by
    contrapose hfu
    rw [← hfu, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, ← Submodule.mem_bot K, ← hf]
    exact mem_map_of_mem (mem_sup_right (mem_span_singleton_self _))
  set v := (f u)⁻¹ • u with v_def
  have hspan : K ∙ (e v - v) = K ∙ (e u - u) := by
    simp only [Submodule.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton]
    use (Ne.isUnit hfu).unit
    simp [v_def, _root_.map_smul, Units.smul_isUnit, smul_sub,
      ← mul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hfu]
  rw [← hspan, ← le_ker_iff_map] at hf
  refine ⟨f, v, ?_, hf,
    by simp only [_root_.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, v_def, inv_mul_cancel₀ hfu]⟩
  rw [← LinearIndependent.pair_smul_smul_iff (Ne.isUnit hfu).inv (Ne.isUnit hfu).inv] at hu
  simpa only [← LinearMap.map_smul, ← LinearEquiv.map_smul, ← v_def] using hu

name: not_forall_fixedReduce_eq_smul
statement:
private theorem not_forall_fixedReduce_eq_smul {f g : Dual K V} {v : V} {a b : K}
    (hv : LinearIndependent K
      ![e.fixedSubmodule.mkQ v, e.fixedReduce (e.fixedSubmodule.mkQ v)])
    {hf : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ≤ LinearMap.ker f} (hfv : f v = 1)
    {hg : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ≤ LinearMap.ker (f + g)} (hfgv : (f + g) v = 1)
    (hg0 : g ≠ 0) (hne_top : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ⊔ K ∙ v < ⊤)
    (ha : ∀ x, (auxTransvection hf * e).fixedReduce x = a • x)
    (hb : ∀ x, (auxTransvection hg * e).fixedReduce x = b • x) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fixedReduce_eq_smul_iff, auxTransvection_mul_fixed hfv] at ha
  simp only [fixedReduce_eq_smul_iff, auxTransvection_mul_fixed hfgv] at hb
  /- Since `auxTransvection hf = transvection f (v - e v)` and
    `auxTransvection hg = transvection (f + g) (v - e v)`,
    subtracting the relations `ha` and `hb` gives the following: -/
  set c := b - a with hc
  have key (x : V) : g (e x) • (v - e v) - c • x ∈ e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v := by
    have ha := ha x
    have hb := hb x
    simp only [LinearEquiv.mul_apply, transvection.apply, auxTransvection] at ha hb
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, add_smul, ← add_assoc] at hb
    convert Submodule.sub_mem _ hb ha using 1
    
    simp only [add_comm _ (g (e x) • _), ← add_assoc]
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
    simp only [add_sub_assoc, add_assoc, add_right_inj, sub_smul, smul_sub, hc]
    abel
  
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with hc0 | hc0
  · 
    apply one_ne_zero (α := K)
    rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at hv
    have hmem : v - e v ∈ e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v := by
      simp only [hc0, zero_smul, sub_zero] at key
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, g w ≠ 0 := by
        contrapose! hg0
        exact LinearMap.ext hg0
      simpa [hw] using key ((g w)⁻¹ • e⁻¹ w)
    simp only [mem_sup, mem_span_singleton, exists_exists_eq_and] at hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy, k, hk⟩ := hmem
    refine (hv (k - 1) 1 ?_).right
    simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, fixedReduce_mk]
    simp only [← e.fixedSubmodule.mkQ_apply, ← LinearMap.map_smul, ← map_add,
      ← LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.ker_mkQ]
    rw [← Submodule.neg_mem_iff] at hy
    convert hy using 1
    rw [eq_comm, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at hk
    rw [← hk]
    simp only [sub_smul, one_smul]
    abel
  · 
    refine hne_top.ne ?_
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    have h1 : g (e x) • (v - e v) ∈ K ∙ (e v - v) :=
      mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨-g (e x), by rw [neg_smul, smul_sub, smul_sub, neg_sub]⟩
    have hle : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v ≤ e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ⊔ K ∙ v :=
      sup_le_sup_right le_sup_left _
    have h2 : c • x ∈ e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ⊔ K ∙ v := by
      rw [show c • x = g (e x) • (v - e v) - (g (e x) • (v - e v) - c • x) by abel]
      exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (mem_sup_left (mem_sup_right h1)) (hle (key x))
    simpa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc0] using Submodule.smul_mem _ c⁻¹ h2

name: mem_transvections_pow_mul_dilatransvections_of_fixedReduce_ne_smul_id
statement:
theorem mem_transvections_pow_mul_dilatransvections_of_fixedReduce_ne_smul_id
    {e : V ≃ₗ[K] V}
    (he : ∀ a : K, ∃ x, e.fixedReduce x ≠ a • x) :
    e ∈ transvections K V ^ (finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) - 1) * dilatransvections K V
proof:
:= by
  induction h : finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) generalizing e he with
  | zero => simp [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient, h]
  | succ n hind =>
    match n with
    | 0 => simp [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient, h]
    | n + 1 =>
      simp only [ne_eq, add_tsub_cancel_right] at hind ⊢
      simp only [add_assoc, Nat.reduceAdd] at h
      rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, Set.mem_mul]
      /- The strategy is similar to the first non-exceptional case:
        we construct `f : Dual K V` and `v : V` such that,
        setting `t = auxTransvection hf`, we have `e = t⁻¹ * (t * e)`
        and `t * e` satisfies the induction hypothesis,
        after possibly replacing `f` by `f + g` for a suitable `g`. -/
      obtain ⟨f, v, hv, hf, hfv⟩ := exists_dual_of_fixedReduce_ne_smul he (by omega)
      have hv_notMem : v ∉ e.fixedSubmodule := by
        simpa [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] using hv.ne_zero 0
      have hrank : finrank K (V ⧸ (e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ v)) = n + 1 := by
        have := finrank_quotient_sup_span_singleton hv_notMem
        omega
      
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with hn0 | hn_pos
      · simp only [hn0, pow_zero, one_mul]
        refine ⟨(auxTransvection hf)⁻¹, ?_, auxTransvection hf * e, ?_, by simp⟩
        · rw [inv_mem_transvections_iff]
          apply mem_transvections
        · rw [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient,
            auxTransvection_mul_fixed hfv, hrank, hn0, zero_add]
      by_cases he' : auxTransvection hf * e ∈ transvections K V ^ n * dilatransvections K V
      · 
        
        refine ⟨(auxTransvection hf)⁻¹, ?_, auxTransvection hf * e, he', by simp⟩
        rw [inv_mem_transvections_iff]
        apply mem_transvections
      
      have hne_top : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ⊔ K ∙ v < ⊤ := by
        rw [sup_right_comm]
        exact sup_span_singleton_lt_top _ (by rw [hrank]; omega)
      obtain ⟨g : Dual K V, hg0 : g ≠ 0, hg2⟩ :=
        Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_lt_top hne_top inferInstance
      rw [← le_ker_iff_map] at hg2
      have hg : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ K ∙ (e v - v) ≤ ker (f + g) := fun x hx ↦ by
        rw [mem_ker, LinearMap.add_apply, mem_ker.mp (hf hx),
          mem_ker.mp (hg2 (mem_sup_left hx)), add_zero]
      have hfgv : (f + g) v = 1 := by
        rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hfv,
          mem_ker.mp (hg2 (mem_sup_right (mem_span_singleton_self v))), add_zero]
      refine ⟨(auxTransvection hg)⁻¹, ?_, auxTransvection hg * e, ?_, by simp⟩
      · rw [inv_mem_transvections_iff]
        apply mem_transvections
      
      apply hind ?_ (by rw [auxTransvection_mul_fixed hfgv, hrank])
      
      
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : K, ∀ x, (auxTransvection hf * e).fixedReduce x = a • x := by
        contrapose! he'
        exact hind he' (by rw [auxTransvection_mul_fixed hfv, hrank])
      
      intro b
      by_contra! hb
      exact not_forall_fixedReduce_eq_smul hv hfv hfgv hg0 hne_top ha hb

name: mem_transvections_pow_mul_dilatransvections_of_not_isExceptional
statement:
theorem mem_transvections_pow_mul_dilatransvections_of_not_isExceptional
    {e : V ≃ₗ[K] V} (he : ¬ IsExceptional e) :
    e ∈ transvections K V ^ (finrank K (V ⧸ e.fixedSubmodule) - 1) * dilatransvections K V
proof:
:= by
  simp only [not_and_or] at he
  push Not at he
  rcases he with he | he | he
  · simpa [Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le he, mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient] using he
  · exact mem_transvections_pow_mul_dilatransvections_of_fixedReduce_eq_one he
  · exact mem_transvections_pow_mul_dilatransvections_of_fixedReduce_ne_smul_id he

name: eq_id_of_finrank_le_one
statement:
theorem eq_id_of_finrank_le_one
    {R V : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V]
    [Free R V] [Module.Finite R V] [StrongRankCondition R]
    {f : Dual R V} {v : V} (hfv : f v = 0) (h1 : finrank R V ≤ 1) :
    transvection f v = id
proof:
:= by
  interval_cases h : finrank R V
  · have : Subsingleton V := (finrank_eq_zero_iff_of_free R V).mp h
    simp [Subsingleton.eq_zero v]
  · let b := finBasis R V
    ext x
    suffices f x • v = 0 by
      simp [apply, this]
    let i : Fin (finrank R V) := ⟨0, by simp [h]⟩
    suffices ∀ x, x = b.repr x i • (b i) by
      rw [this v, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] at hfv
      rw [this x, this v, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_smul, mul_assoc, hfv, mul_zero, zero_smul]
    intro x
    have : x = ∑ i, b.repr x i • b i := (b.sum_equivFun x).symm
    rwa [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i (Finset.mem_univ i) (by grind)] at this

name: mem_dilatransvections_iff_rank
statement:
theorem mem_dilatransvections_iff_rank {e : V ≃ₗ[K] V} :
    e ∈ dilatransvections K V ↔
      Module.rank K (range ((e : V →ₗ[K] V) - LinearMap.id (R := K))) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dilatransvections]
  constructor
  · simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    rintro ⟨f, v, he⟩
    apply le_trans (rank_mono (t := K ∙ v) ?_)
    · apply le_trans (rank_span_le _) (by simp)
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    simp [mem_span_singleton, he, LinearMap.transvection.apply]
  · intro he
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    set u := (e : V →ₗ[K] V) - LinearMap.id with hu
    rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at hu
    by_cases hr : Module.rank K (range u) = 0
    · use 0, 0
      ext x
      suffices u x = 0 by simp [← hu, this]
      rw [rank_zero_iff] at hr
      simpa [← Subtype.coe_inj] using Subsingleton.allEq (⟨u x , mem_range_self u x⟩ : range u) 0
    rw [← ne_eq, ← Cardinal.one_le_iff_ne_zero] at hr
    replace he : Module.rank K (range u) = 1 := le_antisymm he hr
    rw [rank_eq_one_iff_finrank_eq_one, finrank_eq_one_iff Unit] at he
    obtain ⟨b⟩ := he
    use (b.coord default) ∘ₗ u.rangeRestrict, b default
    ext x
    rw [← hu, LinearMap.transvection.apply, add_comm]
    suffices u x = b.repr (u.rangeRestrict x) default • b default by
      simp [this]
    suffices u.rangeRestrict x = u x by
      rw [← this, ← Submodule.coe_smul, Subtype.coe_inj]
      nth_rewrite 1 [← b.linearCombination_repr (u.rangeRestrict x)]
      rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum_eq_single default] <;> simp
    exact codRestrict_apply (range u) u x

      finrank K (range ((e : V →ₗ[K] V) - LinearMap.id (R := K))) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_dilatransvections_iff_rank, finrank, ← one_toNat,

name: mem_transvections_iff_mem_dilatransvections_and_fixedReduce_eq_one
statement:
theorem mem_transvections_iff_mem_dilatransvections_and_fixedReduce_eq_one
    [Module.Finite K V] (e : V ≃ₗ[K] V) :
    e ∈ transvections K V ↔ e ∈ dilatransvections K V ∧ e.fixedReduce = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨f, v, hfv, he⟩ ↦ ?_, fun ⟨he, he'⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · rw [he]
      exact transvection_mem_dilatransvections hfv
    · rw [one_eq_refl, fixedReduce_eq_one, he]
      intro x
      apply ker_le_fixedSubmodule_transvection hfv
      rw [transvection.apply]
      simp [hfv]
  · by_cases he_one : e = 1
    · use 0, 0, by simp, by aesop
    have hefixed_ne_top : e.fixedSubmodule ≠ ⊤ := by
      rwa [ne_eq, LinearEquiv.fixedSubmodule_eq_top_iff]
    obtain ⟨w : V, hw : w ∉ e.fixedSubmodule⟩ :=
      SetLike.exists_not_mem_of_ne_top e.fixedSubmodule hefixed_ne_top rfl
    obtain ⟨f, hfw, hf⟩ := Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem hw inferInstance
    rw [mem_dilatransvections_iff_finrank_quotient] at he
    have hf' : e.fixedSubmodule = LinearMap.ker f := by
      suffices finrank K (V ⧸ LinearMap.ker f) = 1 by
        apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le
        · intro x
          rw [mem_ker, ← Submodule.mem_bot K, ← hf]
          exact mem_map_of_mem
        rw [← Nat.add_le_add_iff_right, finrank_quotient_add_finrank] at he
        have := (LinearMap.ker f).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
        linarith
      rw [← Nat.add_left_inj, Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank]
      rw [← f.finrank_ker_add_one_of_ne_zero, add_comm]
      aesop
    have eq_top : e.fixedSubmodule ⊔ Submodule.span K {w} = ⊤ := by
      rw [Submodule.sup_span_singleton_eq_top_iff hw]
      apply le_antisymm he
      apply Nat.one_le_of_lt
      rw [← Nat.ne_zero_iff_zero_lt]
      contrapose hefixed_ne_top
      apply eq_top_of_finrank_eq
      rw [← Nat.add_left_cancel_iff, finrank_quotient_add_finrank, hefixed_ne_top, zero_add]
    set v := (f w)⁻¹ • (e w - w)
    suffices hfv : f v = 0 by
      use f, v, hfv
      rw [← LinearEquiv.toLinearMap_inj,
        ← sub_eq_zero, ← LinearMap.ker_eq_top, eq_top_iff, ← eq_top]
      simp only [LinearEquiv.transvection.coe_toLinearMap,
        sup_le_iff, Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply,
        LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        suffices f x = 0 by
          simpa [this, LinearMap.transvection.apply, sub_eq_zero] using hx
        rwa [hf', LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx
      · simp_all [v, LinearMap.transvection.apply]
    suffices e w - w ∈ LinearMap.ker f by
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub] at this
      simp only [v, LinearMap.map_smul, map_sub, this, smul_zero]
    rw [← hf', ← Submodule.ker_mkQ e.fixedSubmodule, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    simp [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, ← fixedReduce_mk, he']

name: det_ofField
statement:
private theorem det_ofField [FiniteDimensional K V] (f : Dual K V) (v : V) :
    (LinearMap.transvection f v).det = 1 + f v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hfv : f v = 0
  · by_cases hv : v = 0
    · simp [hv]
    by_cases hf : f = 0
    · simp [hf]
    obtain ⟨ι, b, i, j, hi, hj⟩ := exists_basis_of_pairing_eq_zero hfv hf hv
    have : Fintype ι := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex b
    rw [← det_toMatrix b]
    suffices toMatrix b b (LinearMap.transvection f v) = Matrix.transvection i j 1 by
      rw [this, Matrix.det_transvection_of_ne i j hi 1, hfv, add_zero]
    ext x y
    rw [toMatrix_apply, transvection.apply, Matrix.transvection]
    simp only [hj.2, Basis.coord_apply, Basis.repr_self, hj.1, map_add, map_smul,
      Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Matrix.add_apply]
    apply congr_arg₂
    · by_cases h : x = y
      · rw [h]; simp
      · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne h, Matrix.one_apply_ne h]
    · by_cases h : i = x ∧ j = y
      · rw [h.1, h.2]; simp
      · rcases not_and_or.mp h with h' | h' <;>
          simp [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne' h',
            Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne h',
            Matrix.single_apply_of_ne (h := h)]
  · obtain ⟨ι, b, i, hv, hf⟩ := exists_basis_of_pairing_ne_zero hfv
    have : Fintype ι := FiniteDimensional.fintypeBasisIndex b
    rw [← det_toMatrix b]
    suffices toMatrix b b (transvection f v) =
      Matrix.diagonal (Function.update 1 i (1 + f v)) by
      rw [this]
      simp only [Matrix.det_diagonal]
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_single i]
      · simp
      · intro j _ hj
        simp [Function.update_of_ne hj]
      · simp
    ext x y
    rw [toMatrix_apply, transvection.apply, Matrix.diagonal]
    simp only [map_add, Basis.repr_self, map_smul, Finsupp.coe_add, Finsupp.coe_smul,
      Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Matrix.of_apply]
    rw [hv, Function.update_apply, Basis.repr_self, Pi.one_apply, hf]
    simp only [smul_apply, Basis.coord_apply, Basis.repr_self, smul_eq_mul,
      Finsupp.single_eq_same, mul_one]
    split_ifs with hxy hxi
    · simp [← hxy, hxi]
    · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hxi]; simp [hxy]
    · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hxy, zero_add, mul_assoc]
      convert! mul_zero _
      by_cases hxi : x = i
      · simp [← hxi, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hxy]
      · simp [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hxi]

name: det_ofDomain
statement:
private theorem det_ofDomain [Free R V] [Module.Finite R V] [IsDomain R] (f : Dual R V) (v : V) :
    (transvection f v).det = 1 + f v
proof:
:= by
  let K := FractionRing R
  let : Field K := inferInstance
  apply FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R K
  have := det_ofField (f.baseChange K) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] v)
  rw [← transvection.baseChange, det_baseChange,
    ← algebraMap.coe_one (R := R) (A := K)] at this
  simpa [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, add_smul] using this

name: det
statement:
@[simp] theorem det [Free R V] [Module.Finite R V] (f : Dual R V) (v : V) :
    (transvection f v).det = 1 + f v
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with hR | hR
  · subsingleton
  let b := finBasis R V
  set n := finrank R V
  let S := MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) ℤ
  let γ : S →+* R :=
    (MvPolynomial.aeval (Sum.elim (fun i ↦ f (b i)) (fun i ↦ b.coord i v)) :
      MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) ℤ →ₐ[ℤ] R)
  have : IsDomain S := inferInstance
  let _ : Algebra S R := RingHom.toAlgebra γ
  let _ : Module S V := compHom V γ
  have _ : IsScalarTower S R V := IsScalarTower.of_compHom S R V
  have ibc := IsBaseChange.of_fintype_basis S b
  set ε := Fintype.linearCombination S (fun i ↦ b i)
  set M := Fin n → S
  have hε (i) : ε (Pi.single i 1) = b i := by
    rw [Fintype.linearCombination_apply_single, one_smul]
  let fM : Dual S M :=
    Fintype.linearCombination S fun i ↦ MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i)
  let vM : M := fun i ↦ MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr i)
  have hf : ibc.toDual fM = f := by
    apply b.ext
    intro i
    rw [← hε, toDual_comp_apply, Fintype.linearCombination_apply_single,
      one_smul, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, hε]
    apply MvPolynomial.aeval_X
  have hv : ε vM = v := by
    rw [of_fintype_basis_eq]
    ext i
    rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
    simp only [vM, γ, Function.comp_apply]
    apply MvPolynomial.aeval_X
  rw [← hf, ← hv, ← IsBaseChange.transvection, det_endHom, det_ofDomain]
  rw [map_add, map_one, add_right_inj, toDual_comp_apply]

name: _root_.LinearEquiv.transvection.det_eq_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem _root_.LinearEquiv.transvection.det_eq_one
    {f : Dual R V} {v : V} (hfv : f v = 0) :
    (LinearEquiv.transvection hfv).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Units.val_inj, LinearEquiv.coe_det,
    LinearEquiv.transvection.coe_toLinearMap hfv, Units.val_one]
  by_contra! h
  have : Free R V := Free.of_det_ne_one h
  have : Module.Finite R V := finite_of_det_ne_one h
  apply h
  rw [transvection.det, hfv, add_zero]

name: ofDirectSumEquiv_tprod_lof
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDirectSumEquiv_tprod_lof [Fintype ι] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)]
    (p : Π i, κ i) (x : Π i, M i (p i)) :
    ofDirectSumEquiv (⨂ₜ[R] i, DirectSum.lof R _ _ (p i) (x i)) =
      DirectSum.lof R _ _ p (⨂ₜ[R] i, x i)

  classical
  rw [ofDirectSumEquiv]
  convert! ofDFinsuppEquiv_tprod_single p x

name: ofDirectSumEquiv_symm_lof_tprod

@[simp]
theorem ofDirectSumEquiv_symm_lof_tprod [Fintype ι] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (κ i)]
    (p : Π i, κ i) (x : Π i, M i (p i)) :
    ofDirectSumEquiv.symm (DirectSum.lof R _ _ p (tprod R x)) =
      (⨂ₜ[R] i, DirectSum.lof R _ _ (p i) (x i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [ofDirectSumEquiv]
  convert! ofDFinsuppEquiv_symm_single_tprod p x

name: ofDirectSumEquiv_tprod_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDirectSumEquiv_tprod_apply [Finite ι]
    (x : Π i, ⨁ j, M i j) (p : Π i, κ i) :
    ofDirectSumEquiv (tprod R x) p = ⨂ₜ[R] i, x i (p i)
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  convert! ofDFinsuppEquiv_tprod_apply _ _

name: zero_tprodCoeff
statement: theorem zero_tprodCoeff (f : Π i, s i) : tprodCoeff R 0 f = 0

name: zero_tprodCoeff'
statement: theorem zero_tprodCoeff' (z : R) (f : Π i, s i) (i : ι) (hf : f i = 0) : tprodCoeff R z f = 0

name: add_tprodCoeff
statement:
theorem add_tprodCoeff [DecidableEq ι] (z : R) (f : Π i, s i) (i : ι) (m₁ m₂ : s i) :
    tprodCoeff R z (update f i m₁) + tprodCoeff R z (update f i m₂) =
      tprodCoeff R z (update f i (m₁ + m₂))
proof:
:=
  Quotient.sound' <| AddConGen.Rel.of _ _ (Eqv.of_add _ z f i m₁ m₂)

name: add_tprodCoeff'
statement:
theorem add_tprodCoeff' (z₁ z₂ : R) (f : Π i, s i) :
    tprodCoeff R z₁ f + tprodCoeff R z₂ f = tprodCoeff R (z₁ + z₂) f

name: smul_tprodCoeff_aux
statement:
theorem smul_tprodCoeff_aux [DecidableEq ι] (z : R) (f : Π i, s i) (i : ι) (r : R) :
    tprodCoeff R z (update f i (r • f i)) = tprodCoeff R (r * z) f

name: smul_tprodCoeff
statement:
theorem smul_tprodCoeff [DecidableEq ι] (z : R) (f : Π i, s i) (i : ι) (r : R₁) [SMul R₁ R]
    [IsScalarTower R₁ R R] [SMul R₁ (s i)] [IsScalarTower R₁ R (s i)] :
    tprodCoeff R z (update f i (r • f i)) = tprodCoeff R (r • z) f
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : r • z = r • (1 : R) * z := by rw [smul_mul_assoc, one_mul]
  have h₂ : r • f i = (r • (1 : R)) • f i := (smul_one_smul _ _ _).symm
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  exact smul_tprodCoeff_aux z f i _

name: induction_on'
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction_on' {motive : (⨂[R] i, s i) → Prop} (z : ⨂[R] i, s i)
    (tprodCoeff : ∀ (r : R) (f : Π i, s i), motive (tprodCoeff R r f))
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) :
    motive z
proof:
:= by
  have C0 : motive 0 := by
    have h₁ := tprodCoeff 0 0
    rwa [zero_tprodCoeff] at h₁
  refine AddCon.induction_on z fun x ↦ FreeAddMonoid.recOn x C0 ?_
  simp_rw [AddCon.coe_add]
  refine fun f y ih ↦ add _ _ ?_ ih
  convert! tprodCoeff f.1 f.2

name: smul_tprodCoeff'
statement:
theorem smul_tprodCoeff' (r : R₁) (z : R) (f : Π i, s i) :
    r • tprodCoeff R z f = tprodCoeff R (r • z) f

name: smul_add
statement: protected theorem smul_add (r : R₁) (x y : ⨂[R] i, s i) : r • (x + y) = r • x + r • y

name: tprod_eq_tprodCoeff_one
statement:
theorem tprod_eq_tprodCoeff_one :
    ⇑(tprod R : MultilinearMap R s (⨂[R] i, s i)) = tprodCoeff R 1

name: tprodCoeff_eq_smul_tprod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tprodCoeff_eq_smul_tprod (z : R) (f : Π i, s i) : tprodCoeff R z f = z • tprod R f
proof:
:= by
  have : z = z • (1 : R) := by simp only [mul_one, smul_eq_mul]
  conv_lhs => rw [this]
  rfl

name: _root_.FreeAddMonoid.toPiTensorProduct
statement:
lemma _root_.FreeAddMonoid.toPiTensorProduct (p : FreeAddMonoid (R × Π i, s i)) :
    AddCon.toQuotient (c := addConGen (PiTensorProduct.Eqv R s)) p =
    List.sum (List.map (fun x ↦ x.1 • ⨂ₜ[R] i, x.2 i) p.toList)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using FreeAddMonoid.inductionOn' with
  | zero => rfl
  | of_add b a ih =>
    rw [FreeAddMonoid.toList_of_add, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ← ih, ← tprodCoeff_eq_smul_tprod]
    rfl

name: mem_lifts_iff
statement:
lemma mem_lifts_iff (x : ⨂[R] i, s i) (p : FreeAddMonoid (R × Π i, s i)) :
    p ∈ lifts x ↔ List.sum (List.map (fun x ↦ x.1 • ⨂ₜ[R] i, x.2 i) p.toList) = x

name: nonempty_lifts
statement: lemma nonempty_lifts (x : ⨂[R] i, s i) : Set.Nonempty (lifts x)
proof:
:= by
  existsi Quot.out x
  simp [lifts, ← AddCon.quot_mk_eq_coe]

name: lifts_zero
statement: lemma lifts_zero : 0 ∈ lifts (0 : ⨂[R] i, s i)

name: lifts_add
statement:
lemma lifts_add {x y : ⨂[R] i, s i} {p q : FreeAddMonoid (R × Π i, s i)}
    (hp : p ∈ lifts x) (hq : q ∈ lifts y) : p + q ∈ lifts (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lifts, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, AddCon.coe_add]
  rw [hp, hq]

name: lifts_smul
statement:
lemma lifts_smul {x : ⨂[R] i, s i} {p : FreeAddMonoid (R × Π i, s i)} (h : p ∈ lifts x) (a : R) :
    p.map (fun (y : R × Π i, s i) ↦ (a * y.1, y.2)) ∈ lifts (a • x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_lifts_iff] at h ⊢
  rw [← h]
  simp [Function.comp_def, mul_smul, List.smul_sum]

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction_on {motive : (⨂[R] i, s i) → Prop} (z : ⨂[R] i, s i)
    (smul_tprod : ∀ (r : R) (f : Π i, s i), motive (r • tprod R f))
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) :
    motive z
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← tprodCoeff_eq_smul_tprod] at smul_tprod
  exact PiTensorProduct.induction_on' z smul_tprod add

name: ext
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext ?_
  refine fun z ↦
    PiTensorProduct.induction_on' z ?_ fun {x y} hx hy ↦ by rw [φ₁.map_add, φ₂.map_add, hx, hy]
  · intro r f
    rw [tprodCoeff_eq_smul_tprod, φ₁.map_smul, φ₂.map_smul]
    apply congr_arg
    exact MultilinearMap.congr_fun H f

name: span_tprod_eq_top
statement:
theorem span_tprod_eq_top :
    Submodule.span R (Set.range (tprod R)) = (⊤ : Submodule R (⨂[R] i, s i))
proof:
:=
  Submodule.eq_top_iff'.mpr fun t ↦ t.induction_on
    (fun _ _ ↦ Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span (by simp only [Set.mem_range, exists_apply_eq_apply])))
    (fun _ _ hx hy ↦ Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy)

name: liftAux_tprod
statement: theorem liftAux_tprod (φ : MultilinearMap R s E) (f : Π i, s i) : liftAux φ (tprod R f) = φ f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [liftAux, liftAddHom, tprod_eq_tprodCoeff_one, tprodCoeff, AddCon.coe_mk']
  
  
  
  
  
  conv_lhs => apply AddCon.lift_coe
  simp

name: liftAux_tprodCoeff
statement:
theorem liftAux_tprodCoeff (φ : MultilinearMap R s E) (z : R) (f : Π i, s i) :
    liftAux φ (tprodCoeff R z f) = z • φ f

name: liftAux.smul
statement:
theorem liftAux.smul {φ : MultilinearMap R s E} (r : R) (x : ⨂[R] i, s i) :
    liftAux φ (r • x) = r • liftAux φ x
proof:
:= by
  refine PiTensorProduct.induction_on' x ?_ ?_
  · intro z f
    rw [smul_tprodCoeff' r z f, liftAux_tprodCoeff, liftAux_tprodCoeff, smul_assoc]
  · intro z y ihz ihy
    rw [smul_add, (liftAux φ).map_add, ihz, ihy, (liftAux φ).map_add, smul_add]

proof:

  simp only [Set.mem_range, comp_apply, map_tprod, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
