name: mem_span_insert'
statement:
theorem mem_span_insert' {x y} {s : Set M} :
    x ∈ span R (insert y s) ↔ ∃ a : R, x + a • y ∈ span R s
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_span_insert]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨-a, by simp [hz, add_assoc]⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, h⟩
    exact ⟨-a, _, h, by simp [add_comm]⟩

name: span_range_update_add_smul
statement:
lemma span_range_update_add_smul (hij : i ≠ j) (v : ι → M) (r : R) :
    span R (Set.range (Function.update v j (v j + r • v i))) = span R (Set.range v)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_ <;> simp only [span_le, Set.range_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe] <;>
    intro k <;> obtain rfl | hjk := eq_or_ne j k
  · rw [update_self]
    exact add_mem (subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩) <| smul_mem _ _ <| subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · exact subset_span ⟨k, (update_of_ne hjk.symm ..).symm⟩
  · nth_rw 2 [← add_sub_cancel_right (v j) (r • v i)]
    exact sub_mem (subset_span ⟨j, update_self ..⟩)
      (smul_mem _ _ (subset_span ⟨i, update_of_ne hij ..⟩))
  · exact subset_span ⟨k, update_of_ne hjk.symm ..⟩

name: span_range_update_sub_smul
statement:

name: Module.isPrincipal_submodule_iff
statement:
theorem Module.isPrincipal_submodule_iff {p : Submodule R M} :
    IsPrincipal R p ↔ p.IsPrincipal
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsPrincipal, isPrincipal_iff]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
  · refine ⟨a, le_antisymm (fun m hm ↦ ?_) <| (span_singleton_le_iff_mem ..).mpr a.2⟩
    have ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_span_singleton.mp (ha ▸ (trivial : (⟨m, hm⟩ : p) ∈ ⊤))
    exact mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨r, congr($hr)⟩
  · refine ⟨⟨a, ha ▸ mem_span_singleton_self a⟩, .symm <| top_unique fun x _ ↦ ?_⟩
    have ⟨r, hr⟩ := mem_span_singleton.mp (ha.le x.2)
    exact mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨r, Subtype.ext hr⟩

name: Module.IsPrincipal.of_surjective
statement:
theorem Module.IsPrincipal.of_surjective (f : M →ₗ[R] M₂) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    [IsPrincipal R M] : IsPrincipal R M₂ where
  principal
proof:
:= by
    have ⟨m, hm⟩ := IsPrincipal.principal (⊤ : Submodule R M)
    refine ⟨f m, .symm <| top_unique fun y _ ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hf y
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := mem_span_singleton.mp (hm.le (trivial : x ∈ ⊤))
    simpa only [map_smul] using smul_mem _ r (mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: Commute.span_left
statement:
theorem Commute.span_left {s : Set A} {x : A} (h : ∀ y ∈ s, Commute y x) :
    ∀ y ∈ span R s, Commute y x
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  induction hy using span_induction with
  | mem _ _ => aesop
  | zero => exact .zero_left _
  | add _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => exact h₁.add_left h₂
  | smul _ _ _ h => exact h.smul_left _

name: Commute.span_right
statement:

    ∀ y ∈ span R s, Commute x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Commute.symm_iff (a := x)] at *
  exact .span_left h

statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorDistrib_tmul (Q₁ : QuadraticMap A M₁ N₁) (Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ N₂) (m₁ : M₁)
    (m₂ : M₂) : tensorDistrib R A (Q₁ ⊗ₜ Q₂) (m₁ ⊗ₜ m₂) = Q₁ m₁ ⊗ₜ Q₂ m₂
proof:
:=
  letI : Invertible (2 : A) := (Invertible.map (algebraMap R A) 2).copy 2 (map_ofNat _ _).symm
  (BilinMap.tensorDistrib_tmul _ _ _ _ _ _).trans <| congr_arg₂ _
    (associated_eq_self_apply _ _ _) (associated_eq_self_apply _ _ _)

name: associated_tmul
statement:
theorem associated_tmul [Invertible (2 : A)]
    (Q₁ : QuadraticMap A M₁ N₁) (Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ N₂) :
    (Q₁.tmul Q₂).associated = Q₁.associated.tmul Q₂.associated
proof:
:= by
  let : Invertible (2 : A) := (Invertible.map (algebraMap R A) 2).copy 2 (map_ofNat _ _).symm
  rw [QuadraticMap.tmul, BilinMap.tmul]
  have : Subsingleton (Invertible (2 : A)) := inferInstance
  convert!
    associated_left_inverse A
      (LinearMap.BilinMap.tmul_isSymm (QuadraticMap.associated_isSymm A Q₁)
        (QuadraticMap.associated_isSymm R Q₂))

name: tensorDistrib_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorDistrib_tmul (Q₁ : QuadraticForm A M₁) (Q₂ : QuadraticForm R M₂) (m₁ : M₁) (m₂ : M₂) :
    tensorDistrib R A (Q₁ ⊗ₜ Q₂) (m₁ ⊗ₜ m₂) = Q₂ m₂ • Q₁ m₁
proof:
:=
  letI : Invertible (2 : A) := (Invertible.map (algebraMap R A) 2).copy 2 (map_ofNat _ _).symm
  (LinearMap.BilinForm.tensorDistrib_tmul _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _).trans <| congr_arg₂ _
    (associated_eq_self_apply _ _ _) (associated_eq_self_apply _ _ _)

name: associated_tmul
statement:
theorem associated_tmul [Invertible (2 : A)] (Q₁ : QuadraticForm A M₁) (Q₂ : QuadraticForm R M₂) :
    (Q₁.tmul Q₂).associated = BilinForm.tmul Q₁.associated Q₂.associated
proof:
:= by
  rw [BilinForm.tmul, BilinForm.tensorDistrib, LinearMap.comp_apply, ← BilinMap.tmul,
    ← QuadraticMap.associated_tmul Q₁ Q₂, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.congrRight₂_apply]
  ext : 6
  simp [associated_apply]
  rfl

name: polarBilin_tmul
statement:
theorem polarBilin_tmul [Invertible (2 : A)] (Q₁ : QuadraticForm A M₁) (Q₂ : QuadraticForm R M₂) :

proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← two_nsmul_associated A, ← two_nsmul_associated R, BilinForm.tmul, tmul_smul,
    ← smul_tmul', map_nsmul, associated_tmul]
  rw [smul_comm (_ : A) (_ : ℕ), ← smul_assoc, two_smul _ (_ : A), invOf_two_add_invOf_two,
    one_smul]

statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChange_tmul (Q : QuadraticForm R M₂) (a : A) (m₂ : M₂) :

name: associated_baseChange
statement:
theorem associated_baseChange [Invertible (2 : A)] (Q : QuadraticForm R M₂) :
    associated (R := A) (Q.baseChange A) = BilinForm.baseChange A (associated (R := R) Q)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [QuadraticForm.baseChange, LinearMap.baseChange]
  rw [associated_tmul (QuadraticMap.sq (R := A)) Q, associated_sq]
  exact rfl

name: polarBilin_baseChange
statement:
theorem polarBilin_baseChange [Invertible (2 : A)] (Q : QuadraticForm R M₂) :
    polarBilin (Q.baseChange A) = BilinForm.baseChange A (polarBilin Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [QuadraticForm.baseChange, BilinForm.baseChange, polarBilin_tmul, BilinForm.tmul,
    ← map_smul, smul_tmul', ← two_nsmul_associated R, coe_associatedHom, associated_sq,
    smul_comm, ← smul_assoc, two_smul, invOf_two_add_invOf_two, one_smul]

name: baseChange_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem baseChange_ext ⦃Q₁ Q₂ : QuadraticMap A (A ⊗[R] M₂) N₁⦄
    (h : ∀ m, Q₁ (1 ⊗ₜ m) = Q₂ (1 ⊗ₜ m)) :
    Q₁ = Q₂
proof:
:= by
  replace h (a m) : Q₁ (a ⊗ₜ m) = Q₂ (a ⊗ₜ m) := by
    rw [← mul_one a, ← smul_eq_mul, ← smul_tmul', QuadraticMap.map_smul, QuadraticMap.map_smul, h]
  ext x
  induction x with
  | tmul => simp [h]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    have : Q₁.polarBilin = Q₂.polarBilin := by
      ext
      dsimp [polar]
      rw [← TensorProduct.tmul_add, h, h, h]
    replace := congr($this x y)
    dsimp [polar] at this
    linear_combination (norm := module) this + hx + hy

anisotropic_of_prod
statement:
theorem anisotropic_of_prod
    {Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ P} {Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ P} (h : (Q₁.prod Q₂).Anisotropic) :
    Q₁.Anisotropic ∧ Q₂.Anisotropic
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Anisotropic, prod_apply, Prod.forall, Prod.mk_eq_zero] at h
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    refine (h x 0 ?_).1
    rw [hx, zero_add, map_zero]
  · intro x hx
    refine (h 0 x ?_).2
    rw [hx, add_zero, map_zero]

name: nonneg_prod_iff
statement:
theorem nonneg_prod_iff [Preorder P] [AddLeftMono P]
    {Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ P} {Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ P} :
    (∀ x, 0 ≤ (Q₁.prod Q₂) x) ↔ (∀ x, 0 ≤ Q₁ x) ∧ ∀ x, 0 ≤ Q₂ x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Prod.forall, prod_apply]
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro x; simpa only [add_zero, map_zero] using h x 0
    · intro x; simpa only [zero_add, map_zero] using h 0 x
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ x₁ x₂
    exact add_nonneg (h₁ x₁) (h₂ x₂)

name: posDef_prod_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_prod_iff [PartialOrder P] [AddLeftMono P]
    {Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ P} {Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ P} :
    (Q₁.prod Q₂).PosDef ↔ Q₁.PosDef ∧ Q₂.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [posDef_iff_nonneg, nonneg_prod_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hle₁, hle₂⟩, ha⟩
    obtain ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩ := anisotropic_of_prod ha
    exact ⟨⟨hle₁, ha₁⟩, ⟨hle₂, ha₂⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hle₁, ha₁⟩, ⟨hle₂, ha₂⟩⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hle₁, hle₂⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ (hx : Q₁ x₁ + Q₂ x₂ = 0)
    rw [add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (hle₁ x₁) (hle₂ x₂), ha₁.eq_zero_iff, ha₂.eq_zero_iff] at hx
    rwa [Prod.mk_eq_zero]

@[simp] theorem polar_prod (Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ P) (Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ P) (x y : M₁ × M₂) :
    polar (Q₁.prod Q₂) x y = polar Q₁ x.1 y.1 + polar Q₂ x.2 y.2

name: polarBilin_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem polarBilin_prod (Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ P) (Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ P) :
    (Q₁.prod Q₂).polarBilin =
      Q₁.polarBilin.compl₁₂ (.fst R M₁ M₂) (.fst R M₁ M₂) +
      Q₂.polarBilin.compl₁₂ (.snd R M₁ M₂) (.snd R M₁ M₂)

name: associated_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem associated_prod [Invertible (2 : R)]
    (Q₁ : QuadraticMap R M₁ P) (Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M₂ P) :
    associated (Q₁.prod Q₂) =
      (associated Q₁).compl₁₂ (.fst R M₁ M₂) (.fst R M₁ M₂) +
      (associated Q₂).compl₁₂ (.snd R M₁ M₂) (.snd R M₁ M₂)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [associated, associatedHom]
  rw [polarBilin_prod, smul_add]
  rfl

name: pi_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pi_apply [Fintype ι] (Q : ∀ i, QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P) (x : ∀ i, Mᵢ i) :
    pi Q x = ∑ i, Q i (x i)

name: pi_apply_single
statement:
theorem pi_apply_single [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (Q : ∀ i, QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P) (i : ι) (m : Mᵢ i) :
    pi Q (Pi.single i m) = Q i m
proof:
:= by
  rw [pi_apply, Fintype.sum_eq_single i fun j hj => ?_, Pi.single_eq_same]
  rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, map_zero]

name: Isometry.proj_comp_single_of_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Isometry.proj_comp_single_of_same [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (i : ι) (Q : QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P) :
    (proj i Q).comp (single _ i) = .ofEq (Pi.single_eq_same _ _)

name: Isometry.proj_comp_single_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Isometry.proj_comp_single_of_ne [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) (Q : QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P) :
    (proj i Q).comp (single _ j) = (0 : 0 →qᵢ Q).comp (ofEq (Pi.single_eq_of_ne h.symm _))

name: Equivalent.pi
anisotropic_of_pi
statement:
theorem anisotropic_of_pi [Fintype ι]
    {Q : ∀ i, QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P} (h : (pi Q).Anisotropic) : ∀ i, (Q i).Anisotropic
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Anisotropic, pi_apply, funext_iff, Pi.zero_apply] at h
  intro i x hx
  classical
  have := h (Pi.single i x) ?_ i
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_same] at this
    exact this
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst hji; rw [Pi.single_eq_same, hx]
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hji, map_zero]

name: nonneg_pi_iff
statement:
theorem nonneg_pi_iff {P} [Fintype ι] [AddCommMonoid P] [PartialOrder P] [IsOrderedAddMonoid P]
    [Module R P]
    {Q : ∀ i, QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P} : (∀ x, 0 ≤ pi Q x) ↔ ∀ i x, 0 ≤ Q i x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [pi, sum_apply, comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]
  constructor
  
  · intro h i x
    classical
    convert! h (Pi.single i x) using 1
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i (Finset.mem_univ _) fun j _ hji => ?_, Pi.single_eq_same]
    rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hji, map_zero]
  · rintro h x
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => h i (x i)

name: posDef_pi_iff
statement:
theorem posDef_pi_iff {P} [Fintype ι] [AddCommMonoid P] [PartialOrder P] [IsOrderedAddMonoid P]
    [Module R P]
    {Q : ∀ i, QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P} : (pi Q).PosDef ↔ ∀ i, (Q i).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [posDef_iff_nonneg, nonneg_pi_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hle, ha⟩
    intro i
    exact ⟨hle i, anisotropic_of_pi ha i⟩
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun i => (h i).1, fun x hx => funext fun i => (h i).2 _ ?_⟩
    rw [pi_apply, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ => ?_] at hx
    · exact hx _ (Finset.mem_univ _)
    exact (h j).1 _

name: polar_pi
statement:
@[simp] theorem polar_pi (Q : ∀ i, QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P) (x y : ∀ i, Mᵢ i) :
    polar (pi Q) x y = ∑ i, polar (Q i) (x i) (y i)

name: polarBilin_pi
statement:
@[simp] theorem polarBilin_pi (Q : ∀ i, QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P) :
    (pi Q).polarBilin = ∑ i, (Q i).polarBilin.compl₁₂ (.proj i) (.proj i)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext₂ fun x y => (polar_pi _ _ _).trans <| by simp

name: associated_pi
statement:
@[simp] theorem associated_pi [Invertible (2 : R)] (Q : ∀ i, QuadraticMap R (Mᵢ i) P) :
    associated (pi Q) = ∑ i, (Q i).associated.compl₁₂ (.proj i) (.proj i)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [associated, associatedHom]
  rw [polarBilin_pi, Finset.smul_sum]
  rfl

name: sigPos_le_finrank
statement: lemma sigPos_le_finrank : sigPos Q ≤ Module.finrank R M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact mem_Iic.mp <| mem_of_mem_filter _ <| max'_mem _ _

name: sigPos_isGreatest
statement:
lemma sigPos_isGreatest [Module.Finite R M] [StrongRankCondition R] : IsGreatest
    {r | ∃ V : Submodule R M, Module.finrank R V = r ∧ (Q.restrict V).PosDef} (sigPos Q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨(mem_filter.mp <| max'_mem _ _).2, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨V, rfl, hV⟩
  apply le_max'
  rw [mem_filter, mem_Iic]
  exact ⟨V.finrank_le, V, rfl, hV⟩

statement:
lemma exists_finrank_eq_sigPos_and_posDef [Module.Finite R M] [StrongRankCondition R] :
    ∃ V : Submodule R M, Module.finrank R V = sigPos Q ∧ (Q.restrict V).PosDef

lemma exists_finrank_eq_sigNeg_and_negDef [Module.Finite R M] [StrongRankCondition R] :

name: sigPos_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma sigPos_neg : sigPos (-Q) = sigNeg Q

name: sigNeg_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma sigNeg_neg : sigNeg (-Q) = sigPos Q

name: QuadraticMap.Equivalent.sigPos_eq
statement: lemma QuadraticMap.Equivalent.sigPos_eq (h : Equivalent Q Q') : sigPos Q = sigPos Q'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
  unfold sigPos
  congr! with j
  · apply (Submodule.orderIsoMapComap e.toLinearEquiv).exists_congr
    intro V
    refine .and ?_ (IsometryEquiv.map_posDef_iff _).symm
    revert j
    rw [eq_iff_eq_cancel_right]
    exact (e.finrank_map_eq _).symm
  · exact e.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: QuadraticMap.Equivalent.sigNeg_eq
statement: lemma QuadraticMap.Equivalent.sigNeg_eq (h : Equivalent Q Q') : sigNeg Q = sigNeg Q'
proof:
:=
  sigPos_eq <| match h with | ⟨e⟩ => ⟨e, by simp⟩

name: sigPos_add_finrank_le_of_nonpos
statement:
lemma sigPos_add_finrank_le_of_nonpos [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 M]
    {V : Subspace 𝕜 M} (hV : ∀ x ∈ V, Q x ≤ 0) :
    sigPos Q + Module.finrank 𝕜 V ≤ Module.finrank 𝕜 M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Vp, hr, hVp⟩ := exists_finrank_eq_sigPos_and_posDef Q
  rw [← hr]
  apply Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_le_of_disjoint
  intro W hWp hWm
  rw [le_bot_iff, Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  by_contra hx'
  have := hVp ⟨x, hWp hx⟩ (by simpa using hx')
  have := hV x (hWm hx)
  grind [restrict_apply]

name: posDef_spanSubset
statement:
private lemma posDef_spanSubset (s : Set ι) (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < w i) :
    (weightedSumSquares 𝕜 w).restrict (Pi.spanSubset 𝕜 s) |>.PosDef
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨v, hv⟩ hv'
  rw [restrict_apply, weightedSumSquares_apply]
  apply sum_pos'
  · intro i _
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · exact smul_nonneg (hs i hi).le (mul_self_nonneg _)
    · simp [Pi.mem_spanSubset_iff.mp hv i hi]
  · simp only [ne_eq, Submodule.mk_eq_zero, funext_iff, not_forall, Pi.zero_apply] at hv'
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hv'
    refine ⟨i, mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    have : i ∈ s := by
      contrapose hi
      exact Pi.mem_spanSubset_iff.mp hv i hi
    exact smul_pos (hs i this) (mul_self_pos.mpr hi)

name: negSemidef_spanSubset
statement:
private lemma negSemidef_spanSubset (s : Set ι) (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, w i ≤ 0) :
    ∀ x ∈ Pi.spanSubset 𝕜 s, (weightedSumSquares 𝕜 w) x ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp only [weightedSumSquares_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply sum_nonpos
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : i ∈ s
  · exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (hs i hi) (mul_self_nonneg _)
  · rw [Pi.mem_spanSubset_iff.mp hx i hi, mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: sigPos_weightedSumSquares
statement:
lemma sigPos_weightedSumSquares :
    sigPos (weightedSumSquares 𝕜 w) = {i | 0 < w i}.ncard
proof:
:= by
  let p : Set ι := {i | 0 < w i}
  let m : Set ι := {i | w i ≤ 0}
  convert_to sigPos _ = p.ncard
  have : p.ncard + m.ncard = Nat.card ι := by
    convert! Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl p
    ext
    grind
  have : p.ncard ≤ sigPos (weightedSumSquares 𝕜 w) :=
    (sigPos_isGreatest _).2 ⟨Pi.spanSubset 𝕜 p, Pi.dim_spanSubset,
      posDef_spanSubset p (by grind)⟩
  suffices sigPos (weightedSumSquares 𝕜 w) + m.ncard ≤ Nat.card ι by lia
  simpa using sigPos_add_finrank_le_of_nonpos <| negSemidef_spanSubset m (fun _ hi ↦ hi)

name: sigNeg_weightedSumSquares
statement:
lemma sigNeg_weightedSumSquares :
    sigNeg (weightedSumSquares 𝕜 w) = {i | w i < 0}.ncard
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sigNeg]
  convert! sigPos_weightedSumSquares (w := -w) using 2
  · ext; simp
  · simp

name: sigPos_add_sigNeg_add_radical
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_weightedSumSquares, sigPos_weightedSumSquares, sigNeg_weightedSumSquares,
    Pi.dim_spanSubset]
  calc {i | 0 < w i}.ncard + {i | w i < 0}.ncard + {i | w i = 0}.ncard
  _ = {i | 0 < w i}.ncard + {i | w i ≤ 0}.ncard := by
    rw [add_assoc, add_left_cancel_iff, ← Set.ncard_union_eq]
    · congr! 1
      ext
      grind
    · grind [disjoint_iff_ne]
  _ = Set.univ.ncard := by
    rw [← Set.ncard_union_eq]
    · congr! 1
      ext
      grind [le_iff_lt_or_eq]
    · grind [disjoint_iff_ne]
  _ = Nat.card ι := Set.ncard_univ _

name: sigPos_add_sigNeg_add_radical
statement:
lemma sigPos_add_sigNeg_add_radical [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 M] :
    sigPos Q + sigNeg Q + Module.finrank 𝕜 Q.radical = Module.finrank 𝕜 M
proof:
:= by
  have : Invertible (2 : 𝕜) := invertibleOfNonzero (NeZero.ne _)
  obtain ⟨w, e⟩ := Q.equivalent_weightedSumSquares
  rw [e.sigPos_eq, e.sigNeg_eq, e.rank_radical_eq]
  convert! QuadraticForm.sigPos_add_sigNeg_add_radical₁ (w := w)
  exact Eq.symm (Nat.card_fin (Module.finrank 𝕜 M))

name: sigPos_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares
statement:
lemma sigPos_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares (hQ : Equivalent Q (weightedSumSquares 𝕜 w)) :
    sigPos Q = {i | 0 < w i}.ncard

name: sigNeg_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares
statement:
lemma sigNeg_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares (hQ : Equivalent Q (weightedSumSquares 𝕜 w)) :

name: map_add
statement:
protected theorem map_add (f : M → N) (x y : M) :
    f (x + y) = f x + f y + polar f x y

name: polar_add
statement: theorem polar_add (f g : M → N) (x y : M) : polar (f + g) x y = polar f x y + polar g x y

name: polar_neg
statement: theorem polar_neg (f : M → N) (x y : M) : polar (-f) x y = -polar f x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [polar, Pi.neg_apply, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add]

name: polar_smul
statement:
theorem polar_smul [Monoid S] [DistribMulAction S N] (f : M → N) (s : S) (x y : M) :
    polar (s • f) x y = s • polar f x y

name: polar_comm
statement: theorem polar_comm (f : M → N) (x y : M) : polar f x y = polar f y x
proof:
:= by
  rw [polar, polar, add_comm, sub_sub, sub_sub, add_comm (f x) (f y)]

name: polar_add_left_iff
statement:
theorem polar_add_left_iff {f : M → N} {x x' y : M} :
    polar f (x + x') y = polar f x y + polar f x' y ↔
      f (x + x' + y) + (f x + f x' + f y) = f (x + x') + f (x' + y) + f (y + x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← add_assoc]
  simp only [polar, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, sub_add_eq_add_sub, add_sub]
  simp only [add_right_comm _ (f y) _, add_right_comm _ (f x') (f x)]
  rw [add_comm y x, add_right_comm _ _ (f (x + y)), add_comm _ (f (x + y)),
    add_right_comm (f (x + y)), add_left_inj]

name: polar_comp
statement:
theorem polar_comp {F : Type*} [AddCommGroup S] [FunLike F N S] [AddMonoidHomClass F N S]
    (f : M → N) (g : F) (x y : M) :
    polar (g ∘ f) x y = g (polar f x y)

name: map_add_add_add_map

theorem map_add_add_add_map (x y z : M) :
    Q (x + y + z) + (Q x + Q y + Q z) = Q (x + y) + Q (y + z) + Q (z + x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, h⟩ := Q.exists_companion
  rw [add_comm z x]
  simp only [h, LinearMap.map_add₂]
  abel

name: map_add_self

  norm_num

name: map_zero

name: polar_neg_right

name: polar_self
statement:

proof:

  rw [polar, map_add_self, sub_sub, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, ← two_smul ℕ, ← two_smul ℕ, ← mul_smul]

name: polarSym2_map_smul
statement:
lemma polarSym2_map_smul {ι} (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (g : ι → M) (l : ι → R) (p : Sym2 ι) :
    polarSym2 Q (p.map (l • g)) = (p.map l).mul • polarSym2 Q (p.map g)

:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := p; simp [← smul_assoc, mul_comm]

name: polar_smul_left_of_tower

  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul R a y, polar_smul_right, algebraMap_smul]

name: choose_exists_companion
statement: theorem choose_exists_companion : Q.exists_companion.choose = polarBilin Q
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext₂ fun x y => by
    rw [polarBilin_apply_apply, polar, Q.exists_companion.choose_spec, sub_sub,
      add_sub_cancel_left]

name: map_sum
statement:
protected theorem map_sum {ι} [DecidableEq ι] (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) :
    Q (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, Q (f i)
      + ∑ ij ∈ s.sym2 with ¬ ij.IsDiag, polarSym2 Q (ij.map f)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha ih =>
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_cons, QuadraticMap.map_add, ih, add_assoc, Finset.sym2_cons,
      Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_disjUnion, Finset.sum_map, Finset.sum_cons,
      Sym2.mkEmbedding_apply, Sym2.mk_isDiag_iff, not_true, ite_false, zero_add,
      Sym2.map_mk, polarSym2_sym2Mk, ← polarBilin_apply_apply, _root_.map_sum,
      polarBilin_apply_apply]
    congr 2
    rw [add_comm]
    congr! with i hi
    rw [ite_eq_left (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi ha).symm]

name: map_sum'
statement:
protected theorem map_sum' {ι} (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) :
    Q (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ ij ∈ s.sym2, polarSym2 Q (ij.map f) - ∑ i ∈ s, Q (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha ih =>
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_cons, QuadraticMap.map_add Q, ih, add_assoc, Finset.sym2_cons,
      Finset.sum_disjUnion, Finset.sum_map, Finset.sum_cons, Sym2.mkEmbedding_apply,
      Sym2.map_mk, polarSym2_sym2Mk, ← polarBilin_apply_apply, _root_.map_sum,
      polarBilin_apply_apply, polar_self]
    abel_nf

statement:
@[simp] theorem _root_.QuadraticMap.toQuadraticMap_polarBilin (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) :

proof:

name: _root_.QuadraticMap.polarBilin_injective
statement:
theorem _root_.QuadraticMap.polarBilin_injective (h : IsUnit (2 : R)) :
    Function.Injective (polarBilin : QuadraticMap R M N → _)
proof:
:= by
  intro Q₁ Q₂ h₁₂
  apply h.smul_left_cancel.mp
  rw [show (2 : R) = (2 : ℕ) by rfl]
  simp_rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul R, ← QuadraticMap.toQuadraticMap_polarBilin]
  exact congrArg toQuadraticMap h₁₂

proof:

name: associated_eq_self_apply
statement: theorem associated_eq_self_apply (x : M) : associatedHom S Q x x = Q x

:= by

@[simp]
theorem associated_linMulLin [Invertible (2 : R)] (f g : M →ₗ[R] R) :

      ⅟(2 : R) • ((mul R R).compl₁₂ f g + (mul R R).compl₁₂ g f)

:= by

name: _root_.LinearMap.BilinForm.toQuadraticMap_isOrtho
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.BilinForm.toQuadraticMap_isOrtho [IsCancelAdd R]

:= by
  let : AddCancelMonoid R := { ‹IsCancelAdd R›, (inferInstance : AddCommMonoid R) with }
  simp_rw [isOrtho_def, B.toQuadraticMap_apply, map_add,
    LinearMap.add_apply, add_comm _ (B y y), add_add_add_comm _ _ (B y y), add_comm (B y y)]

name: separatingLeft_of_anisotropic

name: PosDef.smul
statement:
theorem PosDef.smul {R} [CommSemiring R] [PartialOrder R]
    [Module R M] [Module R N] [PosSMulStrictMono R N]
    {Q : QuadraticMap R M N} (h : PosDef Q) {a : R} (a_pos : 0 < a) : PosDef (a • Q)
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => smul_pos a_pos (h x hx)

name: PosDef.nonneg
statement: theorem PosDef.nonneg {Q : QuadraticMap R₂ M N} (hQ : PosDef Q) (x : M) : 0 ≤ Q x
proof:
:=
  (eq_or_ne x 0).elim (fun h => h.symm ▸ (map_zero Q).symm.le) fun h => (hQ _ h).le

name: PosDef.anisotropic
statement: theorem PosDef.anisotropic {Q : QuadraticMap R₂ M N} (hQ : Q.PosDef) : Q.Anisotropic
proof:
:=
  fun x hQx => by_contradiction fun hx =>
    lt_irrefl (0 : N) <| by
      have := hQ _ hx
      rw [hQx] at this
      exact this

name: PosDef.le_zero_iff
statement:
theorem PosDef.le_zero_iff {Q : QuadraticMap R₂ M N} (hQ : PosDef Q) {x : M} :
    Q x ≤ 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by simp [h]⟩
  have : Q x = 0 := le_antisymm h (hQ.nonneg x)
  rwa [← hQ.anisotropic]

name: posDef_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem posDef_of_nonneg {Q : QuadraticMap R₂ M N} (h : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Q x) (h0 : Q.Anisotropic) :
    PosDef Q
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => lt_of_le_of_ne (h x) (Ne.symm fun hQx => hx <| h0 _ hQx)

name: posDef_iff_nonneg
statement: theorem posDef_iff_nonneg {Q : QuadraticMap R₂ M N} : PosDef Q ↔ (∀ x, 0 ≤ Q x) ∧ Q.Anisotropic
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨h.nonneg, h.anisotropic⟩, fun ⟨n, a⟩ => posDef_of_nonneg n a⟩

name: PosDef.add
statement:
theorem PosDef.add [AddLeftStrictMono N]

    PosDef (Q + Q')
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => add_pos (hQ x hx) (hQ' x hx)

name: linMulLinSelfPosDef
statement:
theorem linMulLinSelfPosDef {R} [CommSemiring R] [Module R M]
    [Semiring A] [LinearOrder A] [IsStrictOrderedRing A]
    [ExistsAddOfLE A] [Module R A] [SMulCommClass R A A] [IsScalarTower R A A] (f : M →ₗ[R] A)
    (hf : LinearMap.ker f = ⊥) : PosDef (linMulLin (A := A) f f)
proof:

  fun _x hx => mul_self_pos.2 fun h => hx <| LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mp hf _ h

name: exists_bilinForm_self_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_bilinForm_self_ne_zero [htwo : Invertible (2 : R)] {B : BilinForm R M}
    (hB₁ : B ≠ 0) (hB₂ : B.IsSymm) : ∃ x, B x x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  lift B to QuadraticForm R M using hB₂ with Q
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := QuadraticMap.exists_quadraticMap_ne_zero hB₁
  exact ⟨x, fun h => hx (Q.associated_eq_self_apply ℕ x ▸ h)⟩

name: exists_orthogonal_basis
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_basis [hK : Invertible (2 : K)] {B : LinearMap.BilinForm K V}
    (hB₂ : B.IsSymm) : ∃ v : Basis (Fin (finrank K V)) K V, B.IsOrthoᵢ v
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ d, finrank K V = d → ∃ v : Basis (Fin d) K V, B.IsOrthoᵢ v by exact this _ rfl
  intro d hd
  induction d generalizing V with
  | zero => exact ⟨basisOfFinrankZero hd, fun _ _ _ => map_zero _⟩
  | succ d ih =>
  
  obtain rfl | hB₁ := eq_or_ne B 0
  · let b := Module.finBasis K V
    rw [hd] at b
    exact ⟨b, fun i j _ => rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_bilinForm_self_ne_zero hB₁ hB₂
  rw [← Submodule.finrank_add_eq_of_isCompl (isCompl_span_singleton_orthogonal hx).symm,
    finrank_span_singleton (ne_zero_of_map hx)] at hd
  let B' := B.domRestrict₁₂ ((K ∙ x).orthogonalBilin B) ((K ∙ x).orthogonalBilin B)
  obtain ⟨v', hv₁⟩ := ih (hB₂.domRestrict _ : B'.IsSymm) (Nat.succ.inj hd)
  
  let b :=
    Basis.mkFinCons x v'
      (by
        rintro c y hy hc
        rw [add_eq_zero_iff_neg_eq] at hc
        rw [← hc, Submodule.neg_mem_iff] at hy
        have := (isCompl_span_singleton_orthogonal hx).disjoint
        rw [Submodule.disjoint_def] at this
        have := this (c • x) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ <| Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _) hy
        exact (smul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_right fun h => hx <| h.symm ▸ map_zero _)
      (by
        intro y
        refine ⟨-B x y / B x x, fun z hz => ?_⟩
        obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hz
        rw [map_smul, smul_apply, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul,
          div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx, add_neg_cancel, mul_zero])
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  rw [Basis.coe_mkFinCons]
  intro j i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;> refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j <;> intro hij <;>
    simp only [Function.onFun, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, Function.comp_apply]
  · exact (hij rfl).elim
  · rw [← hB₂.eq]
    exact (v' j).prop _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self x)
  · exact (v' i).prop _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self x)
  · exact hv₁ (ne_of_apply_ne _ hij)

name: basisRepr_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem basisRepr_apply [Fintype ι] {v : Basis ι R M} (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (w : ι → R) :
    Q.basisRepr v w = Q (∑ i : ι, w i • v i)

name: weightedSumSquares_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem weightedSumSquares_apply [Monoid S] [DistribMulAction S R] [SMulCommClass S R R]
    (w : ι → S) (v : ι → R) :
    weightedSumSquares R w v = ∑ i : ι, w i • (v i * v i)

name: basisRepr_eq_of_iIsOrtho
statement:
theorem basisRepr_eq_of_iIsOrtho {R M} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [Invertible (2 : R)] (Q : QuadraticForm R M) (v : Basis ι R M)
    (hv₂ : (associated (R := R) Q).IsOrthoᵢ v) :
    Q.basisRepr v = weightedSumSquares _ fun i => Q (v i)
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  rw [basisRepr_apply, ← @associated_eq_self_apply R, map_sum, weightedSumSquares_apply]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  rw [← @associated_eq_self_apply R, LinearMap.map_sum₂, sum_eq_single_of_mem j hj]
  · rw [map_smul, LinearMap.map_smul₂, smul_eq_mul, associated_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul, Module.End.smul_def, half_moduleEnd_apply_eq_half_smul]
    ring_nf
  · intro i _ hij
    rw [map_smul, LinearMap.map_smul₂, hv₂ hij]
    module

name: isSymm_dualProd
statement: theorem isSymm_dualProd : (dualProd R M).IsSymm

name: separatingLeft_dualProd
statement:
theorem separatingLeft_dualProd :
    (dualProd R M).SeparatingLeft ↔ Function.Injective (Module.Dual.eval R M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [separatingLeft_iff_ker_eq_bot, ker_eq_bot]
  let e := LinearEquiv.prodComm R _ _ ≪≫ₗ Module.dualProdDualEquivDual R (Module.Dual R M) M
  let h_d := e.symm.toLinearMap.comp (dualProd R M)
  refine (Function.Injective.of_comp_iff e.symm.injective
    (dualProd R M)).symm.trans ?_
  rw [← LinearEquiv.coe_toLinearMap, ← coe_comp]
  change Function.Injective h_d ↔ _
  have : h_d = prodMap id (Module.Dual.eval R M) := by
    refine ext fun x => Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · ext
      dsimp [e, h_d, Module.Dual.eval, LinearEquiv.prodComm]
      simp
    · ext
      dsimp [e, h_d, Module.Dual.eval, LinearEquiv.prodComm]
      simp
  rw [this, coe_prodMap]
  refine Prod.map_injective.trans ?_
  exact and_iff_right Function.injective_id

name: _root_.LinearMap.dualProd.toQuadraticForm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.LinearMap.dualProd.toQuadraticForm :
    (LinearMap.dualProd R M).toQuadraticMap = 2 • dualProd R M

name: LinearMap.BilinForm.linearIndependent_of_pairwise_le_zero
statement:
lemma LinearMap.BilinForm.linearIndependent_of_pairwise_le_zero {ι R M : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm R M) (hB : B.toQuadraticMap.PosDef)
    (f : Module.Dual R M) (v : ι → M)
    (hp : ∀ i, 0 < f (v i))
    (hn : Pairwise fun i j ↦ B (v i) (v j) ≤ 0) :
    LinearIndependent R v
proof:
:= by
  refine linearIndependent_iff'.mpr fun s c hc ↦ ?_
  set x := ∑ i ∈ s with 0 < c i, c i • v i with hx
  set y := ∑ i ∈ s with 0 < -c i, (-c i) • v i with hy
  replace hc : x = y := by
    classical
    simp_rw [hx, hy, neg_smul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, ← add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg]
    rw [← hc, ← Finset.sum_union, Finset.sum_subset]
    · grind only [= Finset.subset_iff, = Finset.mem_union, = Finset.mem_filter]
    · simp +contextual [eq_comm (a := (0 : R))]
    · grind only [Finset.disjoint_filter]
  have hx₀ : x = 0 := by
    suffices B x y ≤ 0 by simpa [hc, ← hB.le_zero_iff, B.toQuadraticMap_apply]
    suffices 0 ≤ ∑ x ∈ s with c x < 0, ∑ i ∈ s with 0 < c i, c x * (c i * (B (v i)) (v x)) by
      simpa [hx, hy, map_neg, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun i hi ↦ Finset.sum_nonneg fun j hj ↦ ?_
    grind [Pairwise, mul_nonneg_iff, mul_nonpos_iff]
  have H (c : ι → R) (h : ∑ i ∈ s with 0 < c i, c i • v i = 0) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) : c i ≤ 0 := by
    have : ∑ i ∈ s with 0 < c i, c i * f (v i) = 0 := by simpa using (congr(f $h))
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (by grind [mul_nonneg])] at this
    by_contra! hi'
    have : 0 < c i * f (v i) := mul_pos hi' (hp i)
    grind
  replace hx (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) : c i ≤ 0 := H _ (by grind) i hi
  replace hy (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s) : -c i ≤ 0 := H (-c ·) (by grind) i hi
  grind

name: map_finsuppSum'
statement:
theorem map_finsuppSum' (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (f : ι →₀ R) (g : ι → R → M) :
    Q (f.sum g) =
      ∑ p ∈ f.support.sym2, polarSym2 Q (p.map fun i ↦ g i (f i)) - f.sum fun i a ↦ Q (g i a)

name: apply_linearCombination'
statement:
theorem apply_linearCombination' (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) {g : ι → M} (l : ι →₀ R) :
    Q (linearCombination R g l) =
      linearCombination R (polarSym2 Q ∘ Sym2.map g) l.sym2Mul -
        linearCombination R (Q ∘ g) (l * l)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [linearCombination_apply, map_finsuppSum', Q.map_smul, mul_smul]
  rw [(l * l).sum_of_support_subset support_mul_subset_left _ <| by simp,
    l.sym2Mul.sum_of_support_subset support_sym2Mul_subset _ <| by simp]
  simp [Finsupp.sum, ← polarSym2_map_smul, mul_smul]

name: sum_polar_sub_repr_sq
statement:
theorem sum_polar_sub_repr_sq (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (bm : Basis ι R M) (x : M) :
    linearCombination R (polarSym2 Q ∘ Sym2.map bm) (bm.repr x).sym2Mul -
      linearCombination R (Q ∘ bm) (bm.repr x * bm.repr x) = Q x

name: map_finsuppSum
statement:
theorem map_finsuppSum (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (f : ι →₀ R) (g : ι → R → M) :
    Q (f.sum g) = f.sum (fun i r ↦ Q (g i r)) +
      ∑ p ∈ f.support.sym2 with ¬ p.IsDiag, polarSym2 Q (p.map fun i ↦ g i (f i))

name: apply_linearCombination
statement:
theorem apply_linearCombination (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) {g : ι → M} (l : ι →₀ R) :
    Q (linearCombination R g l) = linearCombination R (Q ∘ g) (l * l) +
      ∑ p ∈ l.support.sym2 with ¬ p.IsDiag, (p.map l).mul • polarSym2 Q (p.map g)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [linearCombination_apply, map_finsuppSum, Q.map_smul, mul_smul]
  rw [(l * l).sum_of_support_subset support_mul_subset_left _ <| by simp]
  simp [Finsupp.sum, ← polarSym2_map_smul, mul_smul]

name: sum_repr_sq_add_sum_repr_mul_polar
statement:
theorem sum_repr_sq_add_sum_repr_mul_polar (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (bm : Basis ι R M) (x : M) :
    linearCombination R (Q ∘ bm) (bm.repr x * bm.repr x) +
      ∑ p ∈ (bm.repr x).support.sym2 with ¬ p.IsDiag,
        Sym2.mul (p.map (bm.repr x)) • polarSym2 Q (p.map bm) = Q x

name: toBilin_apply
statement:
theorem toBilin_apply (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (bm : Basis ι R M) (i j : ι) :
    Q.toBilin bm (bm i) (bm j) =
      if i = j then Q (bm i) else if i < j then polar Q (bm i) (bm j) else 0

name: toQuadraticMap_toBilin
statement:
theorem toQuadraticMap_toBilin (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (bm : Basis ι R M) :
    (Q.toBilin bm).toQuadraticMap = Q
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [← bm.linearCombination_repr x, LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap_apply,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  simp_rw [LinearMap.map_sum₂, map_sum, LinearMap.map_smul₂, map_smul, toBilin_apply,
    smul_ite, smul_zero, ← Finset.sum_product', ← Finset.diag_union_offDiag,
    Finset.sum_union (Finset.disjoint_diag_offDiag _), Finset.sum_diag, ite_true]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_of_false, QuadraticMap.map_sum, ← Finset.sum_filter]
  · simp_rw [← polar_smul_right _ (bm.repr x <| Prod.snd _),
      ← polar_smul_left _ (bm.repr x <| Prod.fst _)]
    simp_rw [QuadraticMap.map_smul, mul_smul, Finset.sum_sym2_filter_not_isDiag]
    rfl
  · intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_offDiag] at hx
    simpa using hx.2.2

name: _root_.LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap_surjective
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap_surjective [Module.Free R M] :
    Function.Surjective (LinearMap.BilinMap.toQuadraticMap : LinearMap.BilinMap R M N → _)
proof:
:= by
  intro Q
  obtain ⟨ι, b⟩ := Module.Free.exists_basis (R := R) (M := M)
  let : LinearOrder ι := IsWellOrder.linearOrder WellOrderingRel
  exact ⟨_, toQuadraticMap_toBilin _ b⟩

name: add_toBilin
statement:
@[simp]
lemma add_toBilin (bm : Basis ι R M) (Q₁ Q₂ : QuadraticMap R M N) :
    (Q₁ + Q₂).toBilin bm = Q₁.toBilin bm + Q₂.toBilin bm
proof:
:= by
  refine bm.ext fun i => bm.ext fun j => ?_
  obtain h | rfl | h := lt_trichotomy i j
  · simp [h.ne, h, toBilin_apply, polar_add]
  · simp [toBilin_apply]
  · simp [h.ne', h.not_gt, toBilin_apply]

name: smul_toBilin
statement:
@[simp]
lemma smul_toBilin (bm : Basis ι R M) (s : S) (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) :
    (s • Q).toBilin bm = s • Q.toBilin bm
proof:
:= by
  refine bm.ext fun i => bm.ext fun j => ?_
  obtain h | rfl | h := lt_trichotomy i j
  · simp [h.ne, h, toBilin_apply, polar_smul]
  · simp [toBilin_apply]
  · simp [h.ne', h.not_gt, toBilin_apply]

name: coe_toLinearEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toLinearEquiv (f : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) : ⇑(f : M₁ ≃ₗ[R] M₂) = f

name: map_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_app (f : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) (m : M₁) : Q₂ (f m) = Q₁ m

name: apply_symm_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma apply_symm_apply (f : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) (x : M₂) : f (f.symm x) = x

name: symm_apply_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma symm_apply_apply (f : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) (x : M₁) : f.symm (f x) = x

name: symm_apply_eq
statement:
theorem symm_apply_eq (f : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) {x y} :
    f.symm x = y ↔ x = f y

name: eq_symm_apply
statement:
theorem eq_symm_apply (f : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) {x y} :
    y = f.symm x ↔ f y = x

name: coe_symm_toLinearEquiv
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_symm_toLinearEquiv (f : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) : f.toLinearEquiv.symm = f.symm

name: refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem refl (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) : Q.Equivalent Q

name: symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem symm (h : Q₁.Equivalent Q₂) : Q₂.Equivalent Q₁

name: trans
statement:
@[trans]
theorem trans (h : Q₁.Equivalent Q₂) (h' : Q₂.Equivalent Q₃) : Q₁.Equivalent Q₃
proof:
:=
  h'.elim <| h.elim fun f g => ⟨f.trans g⟩

name: equivalent_weightedSumSquares
statement:
theorem equivalent_weightedSumSquares (Q : QuadraticForm K V) :
    ∃ w : Fin (Module.finrank K V) → K, Equivalent Q (weightedSumSquares K w)

name: equivalent_weightedSumSquares_units_of_nondegenerate'
statement:
theorem equivalent_weightedSumSquares_units_of_nondegenerate' (Q : QuadraticForm K V)
    (hQ : (associated (R := K) Q).SeparatingLeft) :
    ∃ w : Fin (Module.finrank K V) → Kˣ, Equivalent Q (weightedSumSquares K w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv₁⟩ := exists_orthogonal_basis (associated_isSymm K Q)
  have hv₂ := hv₁.not_isOrtho_basis_self_of_separatingLeft hQ
  simp_rw [associated_eq_self_apply] at hv₂
  exact ⟨fun i => Units.mk0 _ (hv₂ i), ⟨Q.isometryEquivWeightedSumSquares v hv₁⟩⟩

name: mem_radical_iff'
statement:
lemma mem_radical_iff' {m : M} :
    m ∈ Q.radical ↔ Q m = 0 ∧ ∀ n : M, Q (m + n) = Q n
proof:
:= by
  simp +contextual [radical, QuadraticMap.polarBilin, LinearMap.ext_iff,
    QuadraticMap.polar, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero]

name: IsometryEquiv.map_radical
statement:
@[simp] lemma IsometryEquiv.map_radical {Q' : QuadraticMap R M' P}
    (e : IsometryEquiv Q Q') : Q.radical.map e.toLinearMap = Q'.radical

name: Equivalent.rank_radical_eq
statement:
lemma Equivalent.rank_radical_eq {Q' : QuadraticMap R M' P} (h : Equivalent Q Q') :
    Module.finrank R Q.radical = Module.finrank R Q'.radical
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
  rw [← e.map_radical, LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq]

name: lift_aux
statement:
private lemma lift_aux {N : Submodule R M} (hN : N ≤ Q.radical)
    (m m' : M) (hmm' : Submodule.quotientRel N m m') : Q m = Q m'
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.quotientRel_def] at hmm'
  rw [(by simp : m = m' + (m - m')), QuadraticMap.map_add Q m' (m - m'),
    (hN hmm').1, add_zero, polar_comm, ← polarBilin_apply_apply]
  simp [(hN hmm').2]

name: lift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma lift_mk {N : Submodule R M} (hN : N ≤ Q.radical) (m : M) :
    Q.lift N hN (Submodule.Quotient.mk m) = Q m

name: le_radical_iff
statement:
lemma le_radical_iff {N : Submodule R M} :
    N ≤ Q.radical ↔ ∃ Q' : QuadraticMap R (M ⧸ N) P, Q'.comp N.mkQ = Q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun hN ↦ ⟨Q.lift N hN, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨Q', rfl⟩ m hm
    simp [radical, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr hm, LinearMap.ext_iff, polar]

name: radical_le_ker_polarBilin
statement: lemma radical_le_ker_polarBilin : Q.radical ≤ Q.polarBilin.ker
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  simp +contextual [mem_radical_iff', LinearMap.ext_iff, QuadraticMap.polar]

name: radical_eq_ker_polarBilin
statement: lemma radical_eq_ker_polarBilin : Q.radical = Q.polarBilin.ker
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [mem_radical_iff', LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.ext_iff, LinearMap.zero_apply,
    QuadraticMap.polarBilin_apply_apply, QuadraticMap.polar]
  refine ⟨by simp +contextual, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  suffices Q m = 0 by grind
  specialize h m
  rwa [← two_smul R, QuadraticMap.map_smul, sub_sub, ← two_smul R, mul_smul, ← smul_sub,
    (isUnit_of_invertible 2).smul_eq_zero, two_smul, add_sub_cancel_right] at h

name: radical_eq_ker_associated
statement: lemma radical_eq_ker_associated : Q.radical = (QuadraticMap.associated Q).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_eq_ker_polarBilin]
  ext m
  simp [associated_apply, LinearMap.ext_iff, QuadraticMap.polar, invOf_smul_eq_iff]

name: nondegenerate_iff_radical_eq_bot
statement:
lemma nondegenerate_iff_radical_eq_bot :
    Q.Nondegenerate ↔ Q.radical = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Nondegenerate.radical_eq_bot, fun h ↦ ⟨h, ?_⟩⟩
  rw [← QuadraticMap.radical_eq_ker_polarBilin, h]
  nontriviality R
  simp only [rank_subsingleton', zero_le]

name: nondegenerate_associated_iff
statement:
lemma nondegenerate_associated_iff :
    (QuadraticMap.associated Q).Nondegenerate ↔ Q.Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  rw [nondegenerate_iff_radical_eq_bot, radical_eq_ker_associated,
    LinearMap.IsRefl.nondegenerate_iff_separatingLeft, LinearMap.separatingLeft_iff_ker_eq_bot]
  exact fun x y ↦ (congr_arg (· x y) (associated_flip R Q)).trans

name: nondegenerate_polar_iff
statement:
lemma nondegenerate_polar_iff :
    (QuadraticMap.polarBilin Q).Nondegenerate ↔ Q.Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  rw [nondegenerate_iff_radical_eq_bot, radical_eq_ker_polarBilin,
    LinearMap.IsRefl.nondegenerate_iff_separatingLeft, LinearMap.separatingLeft_iff_ker_eq_bot]
  exact fun x y ↦ (polar_comm Q y x).trans

name: radical_weightedSumSquares
statement:
lemma radical_weightedSumSquares :
    radical (weightedSumSquares 𝕜 w) = Pi.spanSubset 𝕜 {i | w i = 0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext v
  simp only [mem_radical_iff', weightedSumSquares_apply, ← pow_two, smul_eq_mul, Pi.add_apply,
    add_sq, mul_add, sum_add_distrib, add_eq_right, Pi.mem_spanSubset_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hv, hvv'⟩ i
    simpa [hv, Pi.single_apply, NeZero.ne, or_iff_not_imp_left] using hvv' (Pi.single i 1)
  · simpa only [← sum_add_distrib]
      using fun h ↦ ⟨sum_eq_zero (by grind), fun v ↦ sum_eq_zero (by grind)⟩

name: finrank_radical_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares
statement:
lemma finrank_radical_of_equiv_weightedSumSquares {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module 𝕜 M]
    {Q : QuadraticForm 𝕜 M} (hQ : Equivalent Q (weightedSumSquares 𝕜 w)) :
    Module.finrank 𝕜 Q.radical = {i | w i = 0}.ncard

name: equivalent_sign_ne_zero_weighted_sum_squared
statement:
theorem equivalent_sign_ne_zero_weighted_sum_squared {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℝ M]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ M] (Q : QuadraticForm ℝ M) (hQ : (associated (R := ℝ) Q).SeparatingLeft) :
    ∃ w : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ M) → SignType,
      (∀ i, w i ≠ 0) ∧ Equivalent Q (weightedSumSquares ℝ fun i ↦ (w i : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  let ⟨w, ⟨hw₁⟩⟩ := Q.equivalent_weightedSumSquares_units_of_nondegenerate' hQ
  ⟨sign ∘ ((↑) : ℝˣ → ℝ) ∘ w, fun i => sign_ne_zero.2 (w i).ne_zero,
    ⟨hw₁.trans (isometryEquivSignWeightedSumSquares (((↑) : ℝˣ → ℝ) ∘ w))⟩⟩

name: conjAct_smul_
statement:
theorem conjAct_smul_ι_mem_range_ι {x : (CliffordAlgebra Q)ˣ} (hx : x ∈ lipschitzGroup Q)
    [Invertible (2 : R)] (m : M) :
    ConjAct.toConjAct x • ι Q m ∈ LinearMap.range (ι Q)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lipschitzGroup at hx
  rw [ConjAct.units_smul_def, ConjAct.ofConjAct_toConjAct]
  induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction'' generalizing m with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    let := x.invertible
    let : Invertible (ι Q a) := by rwa [ha]
    let : Invertible (Q a) := invertibleOfInvertibleι Q a
    simp_rw [← invOf_units x, ← ha, ι_mul_ι_mul_invOf_ι, LinearMap.mem_range_self]
  | inv_mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    let := x.invertible
    let : Invertible (ι Q a) := by rwa [ha]
    let : Invertible (Q a) := invertibleOfInvertibleι Q a
    simp_rw [← invOf_units x, inv_inv, ← ha, invOf_ι_mul_ι_mul_ι, LinearMap.mem_range_self]
  | one => simp_rw [inv_one, Units.val_one, one_mul, mul_one, LinearMap.mem_range_self]
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
    simp_rw [mul_inv_rev, Units.val_mul]
    suffices ↑y * (↑z * ι Q m * ↑z⁻¹) * ↑y⁻¹ ∈ _ by
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using this
    obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := hz m
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hy z'
    simp_rw [← hz', ← hy', LinearMap.mem_range_self]

name: involute_act_
statement:
theorem involute_act_ι_mem_range_ι [Invertible (2 : R)]
    {x : (CliffordAlgebra Q)ˣ} (hx : x ∈ lipschitzGroup Q) (b : M) :
      involute (Q := Q) ↑x * ι Q b * ↑x⁻¹ ∈ LinearMap.range (ι Q)
proof:
:= by
  unfold lipschitzGroup at hx
  induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction'' generalizing b with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    let := x.invertible
    let : Invertible (ι Q a) := by rwa [ha]
    let : Invertible (Q a) := invertibleOfInvertibleι Q a
    simp_rw [← invOf_units x, ← ha, involute_ι, neg_mul, ι_mul_ι_mul_invOf_ι Q a b, ← map_neg,
      LinearMap.mem_range_self]
  | inv_mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    let := x.invertible
    let : Invertible (ι Q a) := by rwa [ha]
    let : Invertible (Q a) := invertibleOfInvertibleι Q a
    let := invertibleNeg (ι Q a)
    let := Invertible.map involute (ι Q a)
    simp_rw [← invOf_units x, inv_inv, ← ha, map_invOf, involute_ι, invOf_neg, neg_mul,
      invOf_ι_mul_ι_mul_ι, ← map_neg, LinearMap.mem_range_self]
  | one => simp_rw [inv_one, Units.val_one, map_one, one_mul, mul_one, LinearMap.mem_range_self]
  | mul y z _ _ hy hz =>
    simp_rw [mul_inv_rev, Units.val_mul, map_mul]
    suffices involute (Q := Q) ↑y * (involute (Q := Q) ↑z * ι Q b * ↑z⁻¹) * ↑y⁻¹ ∈ _ by
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using this
    obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := hz b
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hy z'
    simp_rw [← hz', ← hy', LinearMap.mem_range_self]

name: conjAct_smul_range_
statement:
theorem conjAct_smul_range_ι {x : (CliffordAlgebra Q)ˣ} (hx : x ∈ lipschitzGroup Q)
    [Invertible (2 : R)] :
    ConjAct.toConjAct x • LinearMap.range (ι Q) = LinearMap.range (ι Q)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x ∈ lipschitzGroup Q,
      ConjAct.toConjAct x • LinearMap.range (ι Q) ≤ LinearMap.range (ι Q) by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact this _ hx
    · have := smul_mono_right (ConjAct.toConjAct x) <| this _ (inv_mem hx)
      refine Eq.trans_le ?_ this
      simp only [map_inv, smul_inv_smul]
  intro x hx
  rw [Submodule.pointwise_smul_def, Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  exact conjAct_smul_ι_mem_range_ι hx _

name: star_mem
statement: theorem star_mem {x : CliffordAlgebra Q} (hx : x ∈ pinGroup Q) : star x ∈ pinGroup Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_iff] at hx ⊢
  refine ⟨?_, Unitary.star_mem hx.2⟩
  rcases hx with ⟨⟨y, hy₁, hy₂⟩, _hx₂, hx₃⟩
  simp only [Subgroup.coe_toSubmonoid, SetLike.mem_coe] at hy₁
  simp only [Units.coeHom_apply] at hy₂
  simp only [Submonoid.mem_map, Subgroup.mem_toSubmonoid, Units.coeHom_apply]
  refine ⟨star y, ?_, by simp only [hy₂, Units.coe_star]⟩
  rw [← hy₂] at hx₃
  have hy₃ : y * star y = 1 := by
    rw [← Units.val_inj]
    simp only [hx₃, Units.val_mul, Units.coe_star, Units.val_one]
  apply_fun fun x => y⁻¹ * x at hy₃
  simp only [inv_mul_cancel_left, mul_one] at hy₃
  simp only [hy₃, hy₁, inv_mem_iff]

proof:

  refine top_unique fun x hx => ?_; clear hx
  induction x using induction with
  | algebraMap => exact algebraMap_mem _ _

name: mul_add_swap_eq_polar_of_forall_mul_self_eq
statement:
theorem mul_add_swap_eq_polar_of_forall_mul_self_eq {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra R A]
    (f : M →ₗ[R] A) (hf : ∀ x, f x * f x = algebraMap _ _ (Q x)) (a b : M) :
    f a * f b + f b * f a = algebraMap R _ (QuadraticMap.polar Q a b)
proof:
:=
  calc
    f a * f b + f b * f a = f (a + b) * f (a + b) - f a * f a - f b * f b := by
      rw [f.map_add, mul_add, add_mul, add_mul]; abel
    _ = algebraMap R _ (Q (a + b)) - algebraMap R _ (Q a) - algebraMap R _ (Q b) := by
      rw [hf, hf, hf]
    _ = algebraMap R _ (Q (a + b) - Q a - Q b) := by rw [← map_sub, ← map_sub]
    _ = algebraMap R _ (QuadraticMap.polar Q a b) := rfl

name: forall_mul_self_eq_iff
statement:
theorem forall_mul_self_eq_iff {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (h2 : IsUnit (2 : A))
    (f : M →ₗ[R] A) :
    (∀ x, f x * f x = algebraMap _ _ (Q x)) ↔
      (LinearMap.mul R A).compl₂ f ∘ₗ f + (LinearMap.mul R A).flip.compl₂ f ∘ₗ f =
        Q.polarBilin.compr₂ (Algebra.linearMap R A)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [DFunLike.ext_iff]
  refine ⟨mul_add_swap_eq_polar_of_forall_mul_self_eq _, fun h x => ?_⟩
  change ∀ x y : M, f x * f y + f y * f x = algebraMap R A (QuadraticMap.polar Q x y) at h
  apply h2.mul_left_cancel
  rw [two_mul, two_mul, h x x, QuadraticMap.polar_self, two_smul, map_add]

name: mul_
statement:
theorem mul_ι_mul_ι_mul_comm (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) (a b : M) (y : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    (x * ι Q a) * (ι Q b * y) =
      algebraMap R _ (QuadraticMap.polar Q a b) * (x * y) - (x * ι Q b) * (ι Q a * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc _ _ y, ι_mul_ι_comm, sub_mul, mul_sub, Algebra.left_comm, mul_assoc,
    mul_assoc]

name: mul_
statement:
theorem mul_ι_mul_ι_of_isOrtho (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) {a b : M} (h : Q.IsOrtho a b) :
    x * ι Q a * ι Q b = -(x * ι Q b * ι Q a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, ι_mul_ι_comm_of_isOrtho h, mul_neg, mul_assoc]

name: mul_
statement:
theorem mul_ι_mul_ι_mul_comm_of_isOrtho
    (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) {a b : M} (h : Q.IsOrtho a b) (y : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    (x * ι Q a) * (ι Q b * y) = - ((x * ι Q b) * (ι Q a * y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_ι_mul_ι_mul_comm, h.polar_eq_zero, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_sub]

name: map_comp_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comp_ι (f : Q₁ →qᵢ Q₂) :

name: map_apply_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_apply_ι (f : Q₁ →qᵢ Q₂) (m : M₁) : map f (ι Q₁ m) = ι Q₂ (f m)

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : map (QuadraticMap.Isometry.id Q₁) = AlgHom.id R (CliffordAlgebra Q₁)
proof:

name: map_comp_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comp_map (f : Q₂ →qᵢ Q₃) (g : Q₁ →qᵢ Q₂) :
    (map f).comp (map g) = map (f.comp g)
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  dsimp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
  rw [map_apply_ι, map_apply_ι, map_apply_ι, QuadraticMap.Isometry.comp_apply]

name: leftInverse_map_of_leftInverse
statement:
lemma leftInverse_map_of_leftInverse {Q₁ : QuadraticForm R M₁} {Q₂ : QuadraticForm R M₂}
    (f : Q₁ →qᵢ Q₂) (g : Q₂ →qᵢ Q₁) (h : LeftInverse g f) : LeftInverse (map g) (map f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  replace h : g.comp f = QuadraticMap.Isometry.id Q₁ := DFunLike.ext _ _ h
  rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, map_comp_map, h, map_id, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq]

name: map_surjective
statement:
lemma map_surjective {Q₁ : QuadraticForm R M₁} {Q₂ : QuadraticForm R M₂} (f : Q₁ →qᵢ Q₂)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : Function.Surjective (CliffordAlgebra.map f)
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.induction
    (fun r ↦ ⟨algebraMap R (CliffordAlgebra Q₁) r, by simp only [AlgHom.commutes]⟩)
    (fun y ↦ let ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf y; ⟨CliffordAlgebra.ι Q₁ x, by simp only [map_apply_ι, hx]⟩)
    (fun _ _ ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨x * y, by simp only [map_mul, hx, hy]⟩)
    (fun _ _ ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ ⟨x + y, by simp only [map_add, hx, hy]⟩)

name: equivOfIsometry_symm
statement:

theorem equivOfIsometry_symm (e : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) :

theorem equivOfIsometry_trans (e₁₂ : Q₁.IsometryEquiv Q₂) (e₂₃ : Q₂.IsometryEquiv Q₃) :

name: toClifford_

theorem toClifford_ι (m : M) : toClifford (TensorAlgebra.ι R m) = CliffordAlgebra.ι Q m

name: one_le_evenOdd_zero
statement: theorem one_le_evenOdd_zero : 1 ≤ evenOdd Q 0

name: range_
statement: theorem range_ι_le_evenOdd_one : LinearMap.range (ι Q) ≤ evenOdd Q 1

name: evenOdd_mul_le
statement: theorem evenOdd_mul_le (i j : ZMod 2) : evenOdd Q i * evenOdd Q j ≤ evenOdd Q (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [evenOdd, Submodule.iSup_eq_span, Submodule.span_mul_span]
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  simp_rw [Set.iUnion_mul, Set.mul_iUnion, Set.iUnion_subset_iff, Set.mul_subset_iff]
  rintro ⟨xi, rfl⟩ ⟨yi, rfl⟩ x hx y hy
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨xi + yi, Nat.cast_add _ _⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [pow_add]
  exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul hx hy

name: GradedAlgebra.
statement:
theorem GradedAlgebra.ι_apply (m : M) :
    GradedAlgebra.ι Q m = DirectSum.of (fun i => ↥(evenOdd Q i)) 1 ⟨ι Q m, ι_mem_evenOdd_one Q m⟩

name: GradedAlgebra.lift_
statement:
theorem GradedAlgebra.lift_ι_eq (i' : ZMod 2) (x' : evenOdd Q i') :
    lift Q ⟨GradedAlgebra.ι Q, GradedAlgebra.ι_sq_scalar Q⟩ x' =
      DirectSum.of (fun i => evenOdd Q i) i' x'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := x'
  dsimp only [Subtype.coe_mk, DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
  induction hx' using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem i x hx =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := i
    dsimp only [Subtype.coe_mk] at hx
    induction hx using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
    | algebraMap r =>
      rw [AlgHom.commutes, DirectSum.algebraMap_apply]; rfl
    | add x y i hx hy ihx ihy =>
      rw [map_add, ihx, ihy, ← map_add]
      rfl
    | mem_mul m hm i x hx ih =>
      obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := hm
      rw [map_mul, ih, lift_ι_apply, GradedAlgebra.ι_apply Q, DirectSum.of_mul_of]
      refine DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq (Sigma.subtype_ext ?_ ?_) <;>
        dsimp only [GradedMonoid.mk, Subtype.coe_mk]
      · rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, add_comm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      rfl
  | zero =>
    rw [map_zero]
    apply Eq.symm
    apply DFinsupp.single_eq_zero.mpr; rfl
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
    rw [map_add, ihx, ihy, ← map_add]; rfl

name: iSup_
statement: theorem iSup_ι_range_eq_top : ⨆ i : ℕ, LinearMap.range (ι Q) ^ i = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal (evenOdd Q)).submodule_iSup_eq_top, eq_comm]
  calc
    
    
    ⨆ (i : ZMod 2) (j : { n : ℕ // ↑n = i }), LinearMap.range (ι Q) ^ (j : ℕ) =
        ⨆ i : Σ i : ZMod 2, { n : ℕ // ↑n = i }, LinearMap.range (ι Q) ^ (i.2 : ℕ) := by
      rw [iSup_sigma]
    _ = ⨆ i : ℕ, LinearMap.range (ι Q) ^ i :=
      Function.Surjective.iSup_congr (fun i => i.2) (fun i => ⟨⟨_, i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩) fun _ => rfl

name: evenOdd_isCompl
statement: theorem evenOdd_isCompl : IsCompl (evenOdd Q 0) (evenOdd Q 1)
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.Decomposition.isInternal (evenOdd Q)).isCompl zero_ne_one <| by
    have : (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod 2)) = {0, 1} := rfl
    simpa using congr_arg ((↑) : Finset (ZMod 2) → Set (ZMod 2)) this

name: evenOdd_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem evenOdd_induction (n : ZMod 2) {motive : ∀ x, x ∈ evenOdd Q n → Prop}
    (range_ι_pow : ∀ (v) (h : v ∈ LinearMap.range (ι Q) ^ n.val),
        motive v (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ⟨n.val, n.natCast_zmod_val⟩ h))
    (add : ∀ x y hx hy, motive x hx → motive y hy → motive (x + y) (Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy))
    (ι_mul_ι_mul :
      ∀ m₁ m₂ x hx,
        motive x hx →
          motive (ι Q m₁ * ι Q m₂ * x)
            (zero_add n ▸ SetLike.mul_mem_graded (ι_mul_ι_mem_evenOdd_zero Q m₁ m₂) hx))
    (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q n) : motive x hx
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.iSup_induction' (motive := motive) _ _ (range_ι_pow 0 (Submodule.zero_mem _)) add
  refine Subtype.rec ?_
  simp_rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_iff, add_comm n.val]
  rintro n' ⟨k, rfl⟩ xv
  simp_rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
  intro hxv
  induction hxv using Submodule.mul_induction_on' with
  | mem_mul_mem a ha b hb =>
    induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
    | algebraMap r =>
      simp_rw [← Algebra.smul_def]
      exact range_ι_pow _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hb)
    | add x y n hx hy ihx ihy =>
      simp_rw [add_mul]
      apply add _ _ _ _ ihx ihy
    | mem_mul x hx n'' y hy ihy =>
      revert hx
      simp_rw [pow_two]
      intro hx2
      induction hx2 using Submodule.mul_induction_on' with
      | mem_mul_mem m hm n hn =>
        simp_rw [LinearMap.mem_range] at hm hn
        obtain ⟨m₁, rfl⟩ := hm; obtain ⟨m₂, rfl⟩ := hn
        simp_rw [mul_assoc _ y b]
        exact ι_mul_ι_mul _ _ _ _ ihy
      | add x hx y hy ihx ihy =>
        simp_rw [add_mul]
        apply add _ _ _ _ ihx ihy
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
    apply add _ _ _ _ ihx ihy

name: even_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem even_induction {motive : ∀ x, x ∈ evenOdd Q 0 → Prop}
    (algebraMap : ∀ r : R, motive (algebraMap _ _ r) (SetLike.algebraMap_mem_graded _ _))
    (add : ∀ x y hx hy, motive x hx → motive y hy → motive (x + y) (Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy))
    (ι_mul_ι_mul :
      ∀ m₁ m₂ x hx,
        motive x hx →
          motive (ι Q m₁ * ι Q m₂ * x)
            (zero_add (0 : ZMod 2) ▸ SetLike.mul_mem_graded (ι_mul_ι_mem_evenOdd_zero Q m₁ m₂) hx))
    (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q 0) : motive x hx
proof:
:= by
  refine evenOdd_induction _ _ (motive := motive) (fun rx h => ?_) add ι_mul_ι_mul x hx
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp h
  exact algebraMap r

name: odd_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem odd_induction {P : ∀ x, x ∈ evenOdd Q 1 → Prop}
    (ι : ∀ v, P (ι Q v) (ι_mem_evenOdd_one _ _))
    (add : ∀ x y hx hy, P x hx → P y hy → P (x + y) (Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy))
    (ι_mul_ι_mul :
      ∀ m₁ m₂ x hx,
        P x hx →
          P (CliffordAlgebra.ι Q m₁ * CliffordAlgebra.ι Q m₂ * x)
            (zero_add (1 : ZMod 2) ▸ SetLike.mul_mem_graded (ι_mul_ι_mem_evenOdd_zero Q m₁ m₂) hx))
    (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q 1) : P x hx
proof:
:= by
  refine evenOdd_induction _ _ (motive := P) (fun ιv => ?_) add ι_mul_ι_mul x hx
  simp_rw [ZMod.val_one, pow_one]
  rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
  exact ι v

name: contractLeftAux_contractLeftAux
statement:
theorem contractLeftAux_contractLeftAux (v : M) (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) (fx : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    contractLeftAux Q d v (ι Q v * x, contractLeftAux Q d v (x, fx)) = Q v • fx
proof:
:= by
  simp only [contractLeftAux_apply_apply]
  rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, ι_sq_scalar, ← Algebra.smul_def, ← sub_add, mul_smul_comm, sub_self,
    zero_add]

name: contractRight_eq

theorem contractRight_eq (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) :

name: contractLeft_
statement:
theorem contractLeft_ι_mul (a : M) (b : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    d⌋(ι Q a * b) = d a • b - ι Q a * (d⌋b)
proof:
:= by

  refine foldr'_ι_mul _ _ ?_ _ _ _
  exact fun m x fx ↦ contractLeftAux_contractLeftAux Q d m x fx

name: contractRight_mul_
statement:
theorem contractRight_mul_ι (a : M) (b : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    b * ι Q a⌊d = d a • b - b⌊d * ι Q a
proof:
:= by
  rw [contractRight_eq, reverse.map_mul, reverse_ι, contractLeft_ι_mul, map_sub, map_smul,
    reverse_reverse, reverse.map_mul, reverse_ι, contractRight_eq]

statement:

name: contractLeft_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractLeft_ι (x : M) : d⌋ι Q x = algebraMap R _ (d x)
proof:
:= by

  refine (foldr'_ι _ _ ?_ _ _).trans <| by
    simp_rw [contractLeftAux_apply_apply, mul_zero, sub_zero,
      Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  exact fun m x fx ↦ contractLeftAux_contractLeftAux Q d m x fx

name: contractRight_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractRight_ι (x : M) : ι Q x⌊d = algebraMap R _ (d x)

name: contractLeft_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractLeft_algebraMap (r : R) : d⌋algebraMap R (CliffordAlgebra Q) r = 0
proof:
:= by

name: contractRight_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractRight_algebraMap (r : R) : algebraMap R (CliffordAlgebra Q) r⌊d = 0

name: contractLeft_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractLeft_one : d⌋(1 : CliffordAlgebra Q) = 0

name: contractRight_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractRight_one : (1 : CliffordAlgebra Q)⌊d = 0
proof:

name: contractLeft_contractLeft
statement: theorem contractLeft_contractLeft (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) : d⌋(d⌋x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap => simp_rw [contractLeft_algebraMap, map_zero]
  | add _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | ι_mul _ _ hx =>
    rw [contractLeft_ι_mul, map_sub, contractLeft_ι_mul, hx, map_smul, mul_zero, sub_zero, sub_self]

name: contractRight_contractRight
statement: theorem contractRight_contractRight (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) : x⌊d⌊d = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [contractRight_eq, contractRight_eq, reverse_reverse, contractLeft_contractLeft, map_zero]

name: contractLeft_comm
statement: theorem contractLeft_comm (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) : d⌋(d'⌋x) = -(d'⌋(d⌋x))
proof:
:= by
  induction x using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap => simp_rw [contractLeft_algebraMap, map_zero, neg_zero]
  | add _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, neg_add]
  | ι_mul _ _ hx =>
    simp only [contractLeft_ι_mul, map_sub, map_smul]
    rw [neg_sub, sub_sub_eq_add_sub, hx, mul_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: contractRight_comm
statement: theorem contractRight_comm (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) : x⌊d⌊d' = -(x⌊d'⌊d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contractRight_eq, contractRight_eq, contractRight_eq, contractRight_eq, reverse_reverse,
    reverse_reverse, contractLeft_comm, map_neg]

name: contractRight_contractLeft
statement: lemma contractRight_contractLeft (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) : (d ⌋ x) ⌊ d' = d ⌋ (x ⌊ d')

name: changeFormAux_changeFormAux
statement:
theorem changeFormAux_changeFormAux (B : BilinForm R M) (v : M) (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    changeFormAux Q B v (changeFormAux Q B v x) = (Q v - B v v) • x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [changeFormAux_apply_apply]
  rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, ι_sq_scalar, map_sub, contractLeft_ι_mul, ← sub_add, sub_sub_sub_comm,
    ← Algebra.smul_def, sub_self, sub_zero, contractLeft_contractLeft, add_zero, sub_smul]

name: changeForm.zero_proof
statement: theorem changeForm.zero_proof : (0 : BilinForm R M).toQuadraticMap = Q - Q

name: changeForm.add_proof
statement: theorem changeForm.add_proof : (B + B').toQuadraticMap = Q'' - Q

name: changeForm.neg_proof
statement: theorem changeForm.neg_proof : (-B).toQuadraticMap = Q - Q'

statement:
theorem changeForm.associated_neg_proof [Invertible (2 : R)] :
    (QuadraticMap.associated (R := R) (M := M) (-Q)).toQuadraticMap = 0 - Q

name: changeForm_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem changeForm_algebraMap (r : R) : changeForm h (algebraMap R _ r) = algebraMap R _ r

name: changeForm_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem changeForm_one : changeForm h (1 : CliffordAlgebra Q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using changeForm_algebraMap h (1 : R)

name: changeForm_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem changeForm_ι (m : M) : changeForm h (ι (M := M) Q m) = ι (M := M) Q' m
proof:
:=
  (foldr_ι _ _ _ _ _).trans <|
    Eq.symm <| by rw [changeFormAux_apply_apply, mul_one, contractLeft_one, sub_zero]

name: changeForm_
statement:
theorem changeForm_ι_mul (m : M) (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    changeForm h (ι Q m * x) = ι Q' m * changeForm h x - B m⌋changeForm h x

name: changeForm_
statement:
theorem changeForm_ι_mul_ι (m₁ m₂ : M) :
    changeForm h (ι Q m₁ * ι Q m₂) = ι Q' m₁ * ι Q' m₂ - algebraMap _ _ (B m₁ m₂)

name: changeForm_contractLeft
statement:
theorem changeForm_contractLeft (d : Module.Dual R M) (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    changeForm h (d⌋x) = d⌋(changeForm h x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap => simp only [contractLeft_algebraMap, changeForm_algebraMap, map_zero]
  | add _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | ι_mul _ _ hx =>
    simp only [contractLeft_ι_mul, changeForm_ι_mul, map_sub, map_smul]
    rw [← hx, contractLeft_comm, ← sub_add, sub_neg_eq_add, ← hx]

name: changeForm_self_apply
statement:
theorem changeForm_self_apply (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) : changeForm (Q' := Q)
    changeForm.zero_proof x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap => simp_rw [changeForm_algebraMap]
  | add _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy]
  | ι_mul _ _ hx => rw [changeForm_ι_mul, hx, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
      sub_zero]

name: changeForm_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem changeForm_self :
    changeForm changeForm.zero_proof = (LinearMap.id : CliffordAlgebra Q →ₗ[R] _)

name: changeForm_changeForm
statement:
theorem changeForm_changeForm (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    changeForm h' (changeForm h x) = changeForm (changeForm.add_proof h h') x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap => simp_rw [changeForm_algebraMap]
  | add _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | ι_mul _ _ hx => rw [changeForm_ι_mul, map_sub, changeForm_ι_mul, changeForm_ι_mul, hx, sub_sub,
      LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, changeForm_contractLeft, hx,
      add_comm (_ : CliffordAlgebra Q'')]

name: changeForm_comp_changeForm
statement:
theorem changeForm_comp_changeForm :
    (changeForm h').comp (changeForm h) = changeForm (changeForm.add_proof h h')

name: changeFormEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem changeFormEquiv_symm :

name: even_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem even_toSubmodule : Subalgebra.toSubmodule (even Q) = evenOdd Q 0

name: even.algHom_ext
statement:
@[ext high]
theorem even.algHom_ext ⦃f g : even Q →ₐ[R] A⦄ (h : (even.ι Q).compr₂ f = (even.ι Q).compr₂ g) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [EvenHom.ext_iff] at h
  ext ⟨x, hx⟩
  induction x, hx using even_induction with
  | algebraMap r =>
    exact (f.commutes r).trans (g.commutes r).symm
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
    have := congr_arg₂ (· + ·) ihx ihy
    exact (map_add f _ _).trans (this.trans <| (map_add g _ _).symm)
  | ι_mul_ι_mul m₁ m₂ x hx ih =>
    have := congr_arg₂ (· * ·) (LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun h m₁) m₂) ih
    exact (map_mul f _ _).trans (this.trans <| (map_mul g _ _).symm)

name: fst_fFold_fFold
snd_fFold_fFold
fFold_fFold
statement: private theorem fFold_fFold (m : M) (x : A × S f) : fFold f m (fFold f m x) = Q m • x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨g, hg⟩⟩ := x
  ext : 2
  · change f.bilin m m * a = Q m • a
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, f.contract]
  · ext m₁
    change f.bilin _ _ * g m = Q m • g m₁
    refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hg
    · rintro _ ⟨b, m₃, rfl⟩
      change f.bilin _ _ * (f.bilin _ _ * b) = Q m • (f.bilin _ _ * b)
      rw [← smul_mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, f.contract_mid]
    · simp
    · rintro x y _hx _hy ihx ihy
      rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, mul_add, smul_add, ihx, ihy]
    · rintro x hx _c ihx
      rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, mul_smul_comm, ihx, smul_comm]

name: aux_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aux_one : aux f 1 = 1

name: aux_
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aux_ι (m₁ m₂ : M) : aux f ((even.ι Q).bilin m₁ m₂) = f.bilin m₁ m₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [CliffordAlgebra.even.lift.aux_apply]
  refine (congr_arg Prod.fst (foldr_mul Q (fFold f) _ _ _ _)).trans ?_
  rw [foldr_ι, foldr_ι]
  exact mul_one _

name: aux_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aux_algebraMap (r) :
    aux f (algebraMap R (even Q) r) = algebraMap R A r

name: aux_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem aux_mul (x y : even Q) : aux f (x * y) = aux f x * aux f y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, x_property⟩ := x
  cases y
  refine (congr_arg Prod.fst (foldr_mul _ _ _ _ _ _)).trans ?_
  dsimp only
  induction x, x_property using even_induction Q with
  | algebraMap r =>
    generalize_proofs at ⊢
    simpa using! Algebra.smul_def r _
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
    rw [map_add, Prod.fst_add]
    simp [ihx, ihy, ← add_mul, ← map_add]
  | ι_mul_ι_mul m₁ m₂ x hx ih =>
    simp [aux_apply, ih, ← mul_assoc]

theorem foldr_ι (f : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] N) (hf) (n : N) (m : M) : foldr Q f hf n (ι Q m) = f m n

name: foldr_prod_map_
statement:
theorem foldr_prod_map_ι (l : List M) (f : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] N) (hf) (n : N) :
    foldr Q f hf n (l.map <| ι Q).prod = List.foldr (fun m n => f m n) n l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rw [List.map_nil, List.prod_nil, List.foldr_nil, foldr_one]
  | cons hd tl ih => rw [List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.foldr_cons, foldr_mul, foldr_ι, ih]

name: foldl_reverse

theorem foldl_reverse (f : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] N) (hf) (n : N) (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) :

proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_arg (foldr Q f hf n) <| reverse_reverse _

statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldl_one (f : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] N) (hf) (n : N) : foldl Q f hf n 1 = n

name: foldl_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldl_mul (f : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] N) (hf) (n : N) (a b : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    foldl Q f hf n (a * b) = foldl Q f hf (foldl Q f hf n a) b
proof:
:= by

name: foldl_prod_map_
statement:
theorem foldl_prod_map_ι (l : List M) (f : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] N) (hf) (n : N) :

proof:
:= by

name: right_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem right_induction {P : CliffordAlgebra Q → Prop} (algebraMap : ∀ r : R, P (algebraMap _ _ r))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) (mul_ι : ∀ m x, P x → P (x * ι Q m)) : ∀ x, P x
proof:
:= by
  /- It would be neat if we could prove this via `foldr` like how we prove
    `CliffordAlgebra.induction`, but going via the grading seems easier. -/
  intro x
  have : x ∈ ⊤ := Submodule.mem_top (R := R)
  rw [← iSup_ι_range_eq_top] at this
  induction this using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem i x hx =>
    induction hx using Submodule.pow_induction_on_right' with
    | algebraMap r => exact algebraMap r
    | add _x _y _i _ _ ihx ihy => exact add _ _ ihx ihy
    | mul_mem _i x _hx px m hm =>
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
      exact mul_ι _ _ px
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero] using algebraMap 0
  | add _x _y _ _ ihx ihy =>
    exact add _ _ ihx ihy

name: left_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem left_induction {P : CliffordAlgebra Q → Prop} (algebraMap : ∀ r : R, P (algebraMap _ _ r))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) (ι_mul : ∀ x m, P x → P (ι Q m * x)) : ∀ x, P x
proof:
:= by
  refine reverse_involutive.surjective.forall.2 ?_
  intro x
  induction x using CliffordAlgebra.right_induction with
  | algebraMap r => simpa only [reverse.commutes] using algebraMap r
  | add _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using add _ _ hx hy
  | mul_ι _ _ hx => simpa only [reverse.map_mul, reverse_ι] using ι_mul _ _ hx

name: foldr'Aux_apply_apply
statement:
theorem foldr'Aux_apply_apply (f : M →ₗ[R] CliffordAlgebra Q × N →ₗ[R] N) (m : M) (x_fx) :
    foldr'Aux Q f m x_fx = (ι Q m * x_fx.1, f m x_fx)

name: foldr'Aux_foldr'Aux
statement:
theorem foldr'Aux_foldr'Aux (f : M →ₗ[R] CliffordAlgebra Q × N →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ m x fx, f m (ι Q m * x, f m (x, fx)) = Q m • fx) (v : M) (x_fx) :
    foldr'Aux Q f v (foldr'Aux Q f v x_fx) = Q v • x_fx
proof:
:= by
  simp only [foldr'Aux_apply_apply]
  rw [← mul_assoc, ι_sq_scalar, ← Algebra.smul_def, hf, Prod.smul_mk]

name: foldr'_algebraMap
statement:
theorem foldr'_algebraMap (f : M →ₗ[R] CliffordAlgebra Q × N →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ m x fx, f m (ι Q m * x, f m (x, fx)) = Q m • fx) (n r) :
    foldr' Q f hf n (algebraMap R _ r) = r • n

name: foldr'_
statement:
theorem foldr'_ι (f : M →ₗ[R] CliffordAlgebra Q × N →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ m x fx, f m (ι Q m * x, f m (x, fx)) = Q m • fx) (n m) :
    foldr' Q f hf n (ι Q m) = f m (1, n)

name: foldr'_
statement:
theorem foldr'_ι_mul (f : M →ₗ[R] CliffordAlgebra Q × N →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ m x fx, f m (ι Q m * x, f m (x, fx)) = Q m • fx) (n m) (x) :
    foldr' Q f hf n (ι Q m * x) = f m (x, foldr' Q f hf n x)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [foldr']
  rw [foldr_mul, foldr_ι, foldr'Aux_apply_apply]
  refine congr_arg (f m) (Prod.mk.eta.symm.trans ?_)
  congr 1
  induction x using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp_rw [foldr_algebraMap, Prod.smul_mk, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, Prod.fst_add, hx, hy]
  | ι_mul m x hx => rw [foldr_mul, foldr_ι, foldr'Aux_apply_apply, hx]

name: ofBaseChangeAux_
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofBaseChangeAux_ι (Q : QuadraticForm R V) (v : V) :

name: ofBaseChange_tmul_
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofBaseChange_tmul_ι (Q : QuadraticForm R V) (z : A) (v : V) :
    ofBaseChange A Q (z ⊗ₜ ι Q v) = ι (Q.baseChange A) (z ⊗ₜ v)
proof:
:= by
  change algebraMap _ _ z * ofBaseChangeAux A Q (ι Q v) = ι (Q.baseChange A) (z ⊗ₜ[R] v)
  rw [ofBaseChangeAux_ι, ← Algebra.smul_def, ← map_smul, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul,
    mul_one]

name: ofBaseChange_tmul_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofBaseChange_tmul_one (Q : QuadraticForm R V) (z : A) :
    ofBaseChange A Q (z ⊗ₜ 1) = algebraMap _ _ z
proof:
:= by
  change algebraMap _ _ z * ofBaseChangeAux A Q 1 = _
  rw [map_one, mul_one]

name: toBaseChange_
statement:
@[simp] theorem toBaseChange_ι (Q : QuadraticForm R V) (z : A) (v : V) :
    toBaseChange A Q (ι (Q.baseChange A) (z ⊗ₜ v)) = z ⊗ₜ ι Q v

name: toBaseChange_comp_involute
statement:
theorem toBaseChange_comp_involute (Q : QuadraticForm R V) :
    (toBaseChange A Q).comp (involute : CliffordAlgebra (Q.baseChange A) →ₐ[A] _) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id _ _) involute).comp (toBaseChange A Q)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  change toBaseChange A Q (involute (ι (Q.baseChange A) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] v)))
    = (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id _ _) involute :
        A ⊗[R] CliffordAlgebra Q →ₐ[A] _)
      (toBaseChange A Q (ι (Q.baseChange A) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] v)))
  rw [toBaseChange_ι, involute_ι, map_neg (toBaseChange A Q), toBaseChange_ι,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply, involute_ι, TensorProduct.tmul_neg]

name: toBaseChange_involute
statement:
theorem toBaseChange_involute (Q : QuadraticForm R V) (x : CliffordAlgebra (Q.baseChange A)) :
    toBaseChange A Q (involute x) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (involute.toLinearMap) (toBaseChange A Q x)

name: toBaseChange_comp_reverseOp
statement:
theorem toBaseChange_comp_reverseOp (Q : QuadraticForm R V) :
    (toBaseChange A Q).op.comp reverseOp =
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.opAlgEquiv R A A (CliffordAlgebra Q)).toAlgHom.comp <|
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map
          (AlgEquiv.toOpposite A A).toAlgHom (reverseOp (Q := Q))).comp
        (toBaseChange A Q))
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  change op (toBaseChange A Q (reverse (ι (Q.baseChange A) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] v)))) =
    Algebra.TensorProduct.opAlgEquiv R A A (CliffordAlgebra Q)
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgEquiv.toOpposite A A).toAlgHom (reverseOp (Q := Q))
        (toBaseChange A Q (ι (Q.baseChange A) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] v))))
  rw [toBaseChange_ι, reverse_ι, toBaseChange_ι, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.opAlgEquiv_tmul, reverseOp_ι]
  rfl

name: toBaseChange_reverse
statement:
theorem toBaseChange_reverse (Q : QuadraticForm R V) (x : CliffordAlgebra (Q.baseChange A)) :
    toBaseChange A Q (reverse x) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id reverse (toBaseChange A Q x)
proof:
:= by
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun (toBaseChange_comp_reverseOp A Q) x
  refine (congr_arg unop this).trans ?_; clear this
  refine (LinearMap.congr_fun (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.map_comp _ _ _ _).symm _).trans ?_
  rw [reverse, AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_toLinearMap, AlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv_toOpposite]
  dsimp
  
  rw [LinearEquiv.self_trans_symm]
  rfl

name: toBaseChange_comp_ofBaseChange

theorem toBaseChange_comp_ofBaseChange (Q : QuadraticForm R V) :

name: ofBaseChange_comp_toBaseChange
statement:
theorem ofBaseChange_comp_toBaseChange (Q : QuadraticForm R V) :

proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change ofBaseChange A Q (toBaseChange A Q (ι (Q.baseChange A) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x)))
    = ι (Q.baseChange A) (1 ⊗ₜ[R] x)
  rw [toBaseChange_ι, ofBaseChange_tmul_ι]

name: reverse_mem_evenOdd_iff

name: involute_eq_of_mem_even
statement: theorem involute_eq_of_mem_even {x : CliffordAlgebra Q} (h : x ∈ evenOdd Q 0) : involute x = x
proof:

  | algebraMap r => exact AlgHom.commutes _ _
  | add x y _hx _hy ihx ihy =>
    rw [map_add, ihx, ihy]

  | add x y _hx _hy ihx ihy =>
    rw [map_add, ihx, ihy, neg_add]
  | ι_mul_ι_mul m₁ m₂ x _hx ihx =>
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, involute_ι, involute_ι, ihx, neg_mul_neg, mul_neg]

name: invOf_

name: toEven_
statement: theorem toEven_ι (m : M) : (toEven Q (ι Q m) : CliffordAlgebra (Q' Q)) = e0 Q * v Q m
proof:

  rw [LinearMap.codRestrict_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]

name: ofEven_
statement:
theorem ofEven_ι (x y : M × R) :
    ofEven Q ((even.ι (Q' Q)).bilin x y) =
      (ι Q x.1 + algebraMap R _ x.2) * (ι Q y.1 - algebraMap R _ y.2)

name: toEven_comp_ofEven
statement: theorem toEven_comp_ofEven : (toEven Q).comp (ofEven Q) = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:=
  even.algHom_ext (Q' Q) <|
    EvenHom.ext <|
      LinearMap.ext fun m₁ =>
        LinearMap.ext fun m₂ =>
          Subtype.ext <|
            let ⟨m₁, r₁⟩ := m₁
            let ⟨m₂, r₂⟩ := m₂
            calc
              ↑(toEven Q (ofEven Q ((even.ι (Q' Q)).bilin (m₁, r₁) (m₂, r₂)))) =
                  (e0 Q * v Q m₁ + algebraMap R _ r₁) * (e0 Q * v Q m₂ - algebraMap R _ r₂) := by
                rw [ofEven_ι, map_mul, map_add, map_sub, AlgHom.commutes,
                  AlgHom.commutes, Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_add, Subalgebra.coe_sub,
                  toEven_ι, toEven_ι, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap]
              _ =
                  e0 Q * v Q m₁ * (e0 Q * v Q m₂) + r₁ • e0 Q * v Q m₂ - r₂ • e0 Q * v Q m₁ -
                    algebraMap R _ (r₁ * r₂) := by
                rw [mul_sub, add_mul, add_mul, ← Algebra.commutes, ← Algebra.smul_def, ← map_mul, ←
                  Algebra.smul_def, sub_add_eq_sub_sub, smul_mul_assoc, smul_mul_assoc]
              _ =
                  v Q m₁ * v Q m₂ + r₁ • e0 Q * v Q m₂ + v Q m₁ * r₂ • e0 Q +
                    r₁ • e0 Q * r₂ • e0 Q := by
                have h1 : e0 Q * v Q m₁ * (e0 Q * v Q m₂) = v Q m₁ * v Q m₂ := by
                  rw [← mul_assoc, e0_mul_v_mul_e0]
                have h2 : -(r₂ • e0 Q * v Q m₁) = v Q m₁ * r₂ • e0 Q := by
                  rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, ← smul_neg, neg_e0_mul_v]
                have h3 : -algebraMap R _ (r₁ * r₂) = r₁ • e0 Q * r₂ • e0 Q := by
                  rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_mul_smul_comm, e0_mul_e0, smul_neg]
                rw [sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, h1, h2, h3]
              _ = ι (Q' Q) (m₁, r₁) * ι (Q' Q) (m₂, r₂) := by
                rw [ι_eq_v_add_smul_e0, ι_eq_v_add_smul_e0, mul_add, add_mul, add_mul, add_assoc]

name: ofEven_comp_toEven
statement: theorem ofEven_comp_toEven : (ofEven Q).comp (toEven Q) = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:=
  CliffordAlgebra.hom_ext <|
    LinearMap.ext fun m =>
      calc
        ofEven Q (toEven Q (ι Q m)) = ofEven Q ⟨_, (toEven Q (ι Q m)).prop⟩ := by
          rw [Subtype.coe_eta]
        _ = (ι Q 0 + algebraMap R _ 1) * (ι Q m - algebraMap R _ 0) := by
          simp_rw [toEven_ι]
          exact ofEven_ι Q _ _
        _ = ι Q m := by rw [map_one, map_zero, map_zero, sub_zero, zero_add, one_mul]

name: coe_toEven_reverse_involute
statement:
theorem coe_toEven_reverse_involute (x : CliffordAlgebra Q) :
    ↑(toEven Q (reverse (involute x))) =
      reverse (Q := Q' Q) (toEven Q x : CliffordAlgebra (Q' Q))
proof:
:= by
  induction x using CliffordAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap r => simp only [AlgHom.commutes, Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap, reverse.commutes]
  | ι m =>
    simp only [involute_ι, Subalgebra.coe_neg, toEven_ι, reverse.map_mul, reverse_v, reverse_e0,
      reverse_ι, neg_e0_mul_v, map_neg]
  | mul x y hx hy => simp only [map_mul, Subalgebra.coe_mul, reverse.map_mul, hx, hy]
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, Subalgebra.coe_add, hx, hy]
