name: domCoprod.summand_mk''
statement:
theorem domCoprod.summand_mk'' (a : Mᵢ [⋀^ιa]→ₗ[R'] N₁) (b : Mᵢ [⋀^ιb]→ₗ[R'] N₂)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (ιa ⊕ ιb)) :
    domCoprod.summand a b (Quotient.mk'' σ) =
      Equiv.Perm.sign σ •
        (MultilinearMap.domCoprod ↑a ↑b : MultilinearMap R' (fun _ => Mᵢ) (N₁ ⊗ N₂)).domDomCongr
          σ

name: domCoprod.summand_add_swap_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem domCoprod.summand_add_swap_smul_eq_zero (a : Mᵢ [⋀^ιa]→ₗ[R'] N₁)
    (b : Mᵢ [⋀^ιb]→ₗ[R'] N₂) (σ : Perm.ModSumCongr ιa ιb) {v : ιa ⊕ ιb → Mᵢ}
    {i j : ιa ⊕ ιb} (hv : v i = v j) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    domCoprod.summand a b σ v + domCoprod.summand a b (swap i j • σ) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction σ using Quotient.inductionOn'
  dsimp only [Quotient.liftOn'_mk'', Quotient.map'_mk'', MulAction.Quotient.smul_mk,
    domCoprod.summand]
  rw [smul_eq_mul, Perm.sign_mul, Perm.sign_swap hij]
  simp only [one_mul, neg_mul, Function.comp_apply, Units.neg_smul, Perm.coe_mul,
    _root_.smul_apply, _root_.neg_apply, MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply,
    MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply]
  convert! add_neg_cancel (G := N₁ ⊗[R'] N₂) _ using 6 <;>
    · ext k
      rw [Equiv.apply_swap_eq_self hv]

name: domCoprod.summand_eq_zero_of_smul_invariant
statement:
theorem domCoprod.summand_eq_zero_of_smul_invariant (a : Mᵢ [⋀^ιa]→ₗ[R'] N₁)
    (b : Mᵢ [⋀^ιb]→ₗ[R'] N₂) (σ : Perm.ModSumCongr ιa ιb) {v : ιa ⊕ ιb → Mᵢ}
    {i j : ιa ⊕ ιb} (hv : v i = v j) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    swap i j • σ = σ → domCoprod.summand a b σ v = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction σ using Quotient.inductionOn' with | _ σ
  dsimp only [Quotient.liftOn'_mk'', Quotient.map'_mk'', _root_.smul_apply,
    MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, MultilinearMap.domCoprod_apply, domCoprod.summand]
  intro hσ
  obtain ⟨⟨sl, sr⟩, hσ⟩ := QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply.mp (Quotient.exact' hσ)
  rcases hi : σ⁻¹ i with i' | i' <;> rcases hj : σ⁻¹ j with j' | j' <;>
    rw [Perm.inv_eq_iff_eq] at hi hj <;> subst hi hj
  
  case inl.inr => simpa using Equiv.congr_fun hσ (Sum.inl i')
  case inr.inl => simpa using Equiv.congr_fun hσ (Sum.inr i')
  
  case inl.inl =>
    suffices (a fun i ↦ v (σ (Sum.inl i))) = 0 by simp_all
    exact AlternatingMap.map_eq_zero_of_eq _ _ hv fun hij' => hij (hij' ▸ rfl)
  case inr.inr =>
    suffices (b fun i ↦ v (σ (Sum.inr i))) = 0 by simp_all
    exact b.map_eq_zero_of_eq _ hv fun hij' => hij (hij' ▸ rfl)

name: domCoprod_coe
statement:
theorem domCoprod_coe (a : Mᵢ [⋀^ιa]→ₗ[R'] N₁) (b : Mᵢ [⋀^ιb]→ₗ[R'] N₂) :
    (↑(a.domCoprod b) : MultilinearMap R' (fun _ => Mᵢ) _) =
      ∑ σ : Perm.ModSumCongr ιa ιb, domCoprod.summand a b σ

name: domCoprod'_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem domCoprod'_apply (a : Mᵢ [⋀^ιa]→ₗ[R'] N₁) (b : Mᵢ [⋀^ιb]→ₗ[R'] N₂) :
    domCoprod' (a ⊗ₜ[R'] b) = domCoprod a b

name: MultilinearMap.domCoprod_alternization_coe
statement:
theorem MultilinearMap.domCoprod_alternization_coe [DecidableEq ιa] [DecidableEq ιb]
    (a : MultilinearMap R' (fun _ : ιa => Mᵢ) N₁) (b : MultilinearMap R' (fun _ : ιb => Mᵢ) N₂) :
    MultilinearMap.domCoprod (MultilinearMap.alternatization a)
      (MultilinearMap.alternatization b) =
      ∑ σa : Perm ιa, ∑ σb : Perm ιb,
        Equiv.Perm.sign σa • Equiv.Perm.sign σb •
          MultilinearMap.domCoprod (a.domDomCongr σa) (b.domDomCongr σb)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← MultilinearMap.domCoprod'_apply, MultilinearMap.alternatization_coe]
  simp_rw [TensorProduct.sum_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_sum, _root_.map_sum,
    ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
  rfl

name: MultilinearMap.domCoprod_alternization
statement:
theorem MultilinearMap.domCoprod_alternization [DecidableEq ιa] [DecidableEq ιb]
    (a : MultilinearMap R' (fun _ : ιa => Mᵢ) N₁) (b : MultilinearMap R' (fun _ : ιb => Mᵢ) N₂) :
    MultilinearMap.alternatization (MultilinearMap.domCoprod a b) =
      a.alternatization.domCoprod (MultilinearMap.alternatization b)
proof:
:= by
  apply coe_multilinearMap_injective
  rw [domCoprod_coe, MultilinearMap.alternatization_coe,
    Finset.sum_partition (QuotientGroup.leftRel (Perm.sumCongrHom ιa ιb).range)]
  congr 1
  ext1 σ
  induction σ using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | h σ =>
  set f := sumCongrHom ιa ιb
  calc
    ∑ τ ∈ _, sign τ • domDomCongr τ (a.domCoprod b) =
        ∑ τ ∈ {τ | τ⁻¹ * σ ∈ f.range}, sign τ • domDomCongr τ (a.domCoprod b) := by
      simp [QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply, f, Quotient.eq]
    _ = ∑ τ ∈ {τ | τ⁻¹ ∈ f.range}, sign (σ * τ) • domDomCongr (σ * τ) (a.domCoprod b) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← Finset.map_univ_equiv (Equiv.mulLeft σ), Finset.filter_map, Finset.sum_map]
      simp [-MonoidHom.mem_range]
    _ = ∑ τ, sign (σ * f τ) • domDomCongr (σ * f τ) (a.domCoprod b) := by
      simp_rw [f, Subgroup.inv_mem_iff, MonoidHom.mem_range, Finset.univ_filter_exists,
        Finset.sum_image sumCongrHom_injective.injOn]
    _ = ∑ τ : Perm ιa × Perm ιb,
         sign σ • (domDomCongrEquiv σ) (sign τ.1 • sign τ.2 •
           (domDomCongr τ.1 a).domCoprod (domDomCongr τ.2 b)) := by
      simp [f, domDomCongr_mul, domCoprod_domDomCongr_sumCongr, mul_smul]
    _ = domCoprod.summand (alternatization a) (alternatization b) (Quotient.mk'' σ) := by
      simp [domCoprod.summand_mk'', domCoprod_alternization_coe, ← domDomCongrEquiv_apply,
        Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_product']

name: MultilinearMap.domCoprod_alternization_eq
statement:
theorem MultilinearMap.domCoprod_alternization_eq [DecidableEq ιa] [DecidableEq ιb]
    (a : Mᵢ [⋀^ιa]→ₗ[R'] N₁) (b : Mᵢ [⋀^ιb]→ₗ[R'] N₂) :
    MultilinearMap.alternatization
      (MultilinearMap.domCoprod a b : MultilinearMap R' (fun _ : ιa ⊕ ιb => Mᵢ) (N₁ ⊗ N₂)) =
      ((Fintype.card ιa).factorial * (Fintype.card ιb).factorial) • a.domCoprod b
proof:
:= by
  rw [MultilinearMap.domCoprod_alternization, coe_alternatization, coe_alternatization, mul_smul,
    ← AlternatingMap.domCoprod'_apply, ← AlternatingMap.domCoprod'_apply,
    ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
    LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower AlternatingMap.domCoprod',
    LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower AlternatingMap.domCoprod']

name: map_linearDependent
statement:
theorem map_linearDependent {K M N : Type*} [Ring K] [IsDomain K] [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [IsTorsionFree K N] (f : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[K] N)
    (v : ι → M) (h : ¬LinearIndependent K v) : f v = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, g, h, i, hi, hz⟩ := not_linearIndependent_iff.mp h
  let := Classical.decEq ι
  suffices f (update v i (g i • v i)) = 0 by
    rw [f.map_update_smul, Function.update_eq_self, smul_eq_zero] at this
    exact Or.resolve_left this hz
  rw [← Finset.insert_erase hi, Finset.sum_insert (s.notMem_erase i), add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at h
  rw [h, f.map_update_neg, f.map_update_sum, neg_eq_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j hj
  obtain ⟨hij, _⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hj
  rw [f.map_update_smul, f.map_update_self _ hij.symm, smul_zero]

name: alternization_map_eq_zero_of_eq_aux
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_apply]
  exact
    Finset.sum_involution (fun σ _ => swap i j * σ)
      (fun σ _ => by simp [Perm.sign_swap i_ne_j, apply_swap_eq_self hv])
      (fun σ _ _ => (not_congr swap_mul_eq_iff).mpr i_ne_j) (fun σ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
      fun σ _ => swap_mul_involutive i j σ

name: alternatization_def
statement:
theorem alternatization_def (m : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M) N') :
    ⇑(alternatization m) = (∑ σ : Perm ι, Equiv.Perm.sign σ • m.domDomCongr σ :)

name: alternatization_coe
statement:
theorem alternatization_coe (m : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M) N') :

name: coe_alternatization
statement:
theorem coe_alternatization [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (a : M [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R] N') :
    MultilinearMap.alternatization (a : MultilinearMap R (fun _ => M) N')
    = Nat.factorial (Fintype.card ι) • a
proof:
:= by
  apply AlternatingMap.coe_injective
  simp_rw [MultilinearMap.alternatization_def, ← coe_domDomCongr, domDomCongr_perm, coe_smul,
    smul_smul, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_perm,
    ← coe_multilinearMap, coe_smul]

name: compMultilinearMap_alternatization
statement:
theorem compMultilinearMap_alternatization (g : N' →ₗ[R] N'₂)
    (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M) N') :

      = g.compAlternatingMap (MultilinearMap.alternatization f)

name: Module.Basis.ext_alternating
statement:
theorem Module.Basis.ext_alternating {f g : N₁ [⋀^ι]→ₗ[R'] N₂} (e : Basis ι₁ R' N₁)
    (h : ∀ v : ι → ι₁, Function.Injective v → (f fun i => e (v i)) = g fun i => e (v i)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine AlternatingMap.coe_multilinearMap_injective (Basis.ext_multilinear (fun _ ↦ e) fun v => ?_)
  by_cases hi : Function.Injective v
  · exact h v hi
  · have : ¬Function.Injective fun i => e (v i) := hi.imp Function.Injective.of_comp
    rw [coe_multilinearMap, coe_multilinearMap, f.map_eq_zero_of_not_injective _ this,
      g.map_eq_zero_of_not_injective _ this]

name: induction_lon
statement:
theorem induction_lon {R : Type*} [Semiring R] {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι]
    {M : ι → Type*} [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid <| M i] [(i : ι) → Module R (M i)]
    {motive : (⨁ i, M i) → Prop} (x : ⨁ i, M i)
    (zero : motive 0)
    (lof : ∀ i (x : M i), motive (lof R ι M i x))
    (add : ∀ (x y : ⨁ i, M i), motive x → motive y → motive (x + y)) : motive x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => exact zero
  | of => exact lof _ _
  | add x y hx hy => exact add x y hx hy

name: rel_id

name: identify_one
statement: theorem identify_one (i : I) : ι' R A (DirectSum.lof R I A i 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  suffices ι' R A (DirectSum.lof R I A i 1) = mkAlgHom R A 1 by simpa [← ι_apply]
  exact Quotient.sound <| RingCon.le_ringConGen _ _ <| rel_id R A (i := i)

name: mul_injections
statement:
theorem mul_injections (a₁ a₂ : A i) :
    ι' R A (DirectSum.lof R I A i a₁) * ι' R A (DirectSum.lof R I A i a₂)
      = ι' R A (DirectSum.lof R I A i (a₁ * a₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ι_apply, ← ι_apply, ← RingCon.coe_mul]
  refine Quotient.sound <| RingCon.le_ringConGen _ _ <| ?_
  convert! rel.prod
  simp

statement:
theorem Basis.linearEquiv_dual_iff_finiteDimensional [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] :

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨e⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨(Module.Free.chooseBasis K V).toDualEquiv⟩⟩
  rw [FiniteDimensional, ← Module.rank_lt_aleph0_iff]

  apply (lift_rank_lt_rank_dual this).ne

name: Projective.exists_dual_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Projective.exists_dual_ne_zero (R : Type*) [Semiring R] [Module R V]
    [Projective R V] {x : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) : ∃ f : Dual R V, f x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  have ⟨M, _, _, _, ⟨i, s, his⟩⟩ := Projective.iff_split.mp ‹Projective R V›
  let b := Free.chooseBasis R M
  have : i x ≠ 0 := i.map_eq_zero_iff (injective_of_comp_eq_id i s his) |>.not.mpr hx
  have ⟨j, hj⟩ := not_forall.mp fun h ↦ b.repr.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr this <| Finsupp.ext h
  ⟨b.coord j ∘ₗ i, hj⟩

proof:

proof:
:=

name: finite_dual_iff
statement: theorem finite_dual_iff [Free K V] : Module.Finite K (Dual K V) ↔ Module.Finite K V
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ inferInstance⟩
  have ⟨⟨ι, b⟩⟩ := Free.exists_basis (R := K) (M := V)
  cases finite_or_infinite ι
  · exact .of_basis b
  nontriviality K
  have ⟨n, hn⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_nat_not_surjective K (Dual K V)
  let g := Finsupp.llift K K K ι ≪≫ₗ b.repr.dualMap
  exact hn (LinearMap.funLeft K K (Fin.valEmbedding.trans (Infinite.natEmbedding ι)) ∘ₗ _)
    ((Function.Embedding.injective _).surjective_comp_right.comp g.symm.surjective) |>.elim

name: exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem
statement:
theorem exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem
    {R M : Type*} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {p : Submodule R M}
    {x : M} (hx : x ∉ p) (hp' : Projective R (M ⧸ p)) :
    ∃ f : Dual R M, f x ≠ 0 ∧ p.map f = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ f : Dual R (M ⧸ p), f (p.mkQ x) ≠ 0 by
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := this; exact ⟨f.comp p.mkQ, hf, by simp [Submodule.map_comp]⟩
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, ← Submodule.mkQ_apply] at hx
  exact Projective.exists_dual_ne_zero R hx

name: exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_lt_top
statement:
theorem exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_lt_top
    {R M : Type*} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {p : Submodule R M}
    (hp : p < ⊤) (hp' : Projective R (M ⧸ p)) :
    ∃ f : Dual R M, f ≠ 0 ∧ p.map f = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : M, x ∉ p := by rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top] at hp; contrapose! hp; ext; simp [hp]
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hf'⟩ := p.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem hx hp'
  exact ⟨f, by aesop, hf'⟩

name: span_eq_top_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem span_eq_top_of_ne_zero [IsReflexive R M]
    {s : Set (M →ₗ[R] R)} [Projective R ((M →ₗ[R] R) ⧸ (span R s))]
    (h : ∀ z ≠ 0, ∃ f ∈ s, f z ≠ 0) : span R s = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hn
  obtain ⟨φ, φne, hφ⟩ := exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_lt_top hn.lt_top inferInstance
  let φs := (evalEquiv R M).symm φ
  have this f (hf : f ∈ s) : f φs = 0 := by
    rw [← mem_bot R, ← hφ, mem_map]
    exact ⟨f, subset_span hf, (apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply R M f φ).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨x, xs, hx⟩ := h φs (by simp [φne, φs])
  exact hx <| this x xs

name: _root_.FiniteDimensional.mem_span_of_iInf_ker_le_ker
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hK
  rcases exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem hK inferInstance with ⟨φ, φne, hφ⟩
  let φs := (Module.evalEquiv 𝕜 E).symm φ
  have : K φs = 0 := by
    refine h <| (Submodule.mem_iInf _).2 fun i ↦ (mem_bot 𝕜).1 ?_
    rw [← hφ, Submodule.mem_map]
    exact ⟨L i, Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩, (apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply 𝕜 E _ φ).symm⟩
  simp only [apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply, φs, φne] at this

name: _root_.mem_span_of_iInf_ker_le_ker
statement:
theorem _root_.mem_span_of_iInf_ker_le_ker [Finite ι] {L : ι → E →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜} {K : E →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜}
    (h : ⨅ i, ker (L i) ≤ ker K) : K ∈ span 𝕜 (range L)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let φ : E →ₗ[𝕜] ι → 𝕜 := LinearMap.pi L
  let p := ⨅ i, ker (L i)
  have p_eq : p = ker φ := (ker_pi L).symm
  let ψ : (E ⧸ p) →ₗ[𝕜] ι → 𝕜 := p.liftQ φ p_eq.le
  have _ : FiniteDimensional 𝕜 (E ⧸ p) := of_injective ψ (ker_eq_bot.1 (ker_liftQ_eq_bot' p φ p_eq))
  let L' i : (E ⧸ p) →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜 := p.liftQ (L i) (iInf_le _ i)
  let K' : (E ⧸ p) →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜 := p.liftQ K h
  have : ⨅ i, ker (L' i) ≤ ker K' := by
    simp_rw +zetaDelta [← ker_pi, pi_liftQ_eq_liftQ_pi, ker_liftQ_eq_bot' p φ p_eq]
    exact bot_le
  obtain ⟨c, hK'⟩ :=
    (mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun 𝕜).1 (FiniteDimensional.mem_span_of_iInf_ker_le_ker this)
  refine (mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun 𝕜).2 ⟨c, ?_⟩
  conv_lhs => enter [2]; intro i; rw [← p.liftQ_mkQ (L i) (iInf_le _ i)]
  rw [← p.liftQ_mkQ K h]
  ext x
  convert! LinearMap.congr_fun hK' (p.mkQ x)
  simp only [L', LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, smul_apply, coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]

name: dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator_eq {W : Subspace K V} :
    W.dualAnnihilator.dualCoannihilator = W
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun v ↦ Function.mtr ?_) (le_dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator _)
  simp only [mem_dualAnnihilator, mem_dualCoannihilator]
  rw [← Quotient.mk_eq_zero W, ← Module.forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K]
  push Not
  refine fun ⟨φ, hφ⟩ ↦ ⟨φ.comp W.mkQ, fun w hw ↦ ?_, hφ⟩
  rw [comp_apply, mkQ_apply, (Quotient.mk_eq_zero W).mpr hw, φ.map_zero]

statement:

  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h ▸ dualAnnihilator_bot⟩
  refine W.eq_bot_iff.mpr fun v hv ↦ (forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff R v).mp fun f ↦ ?_

name: range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker_of_surjective

name: range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker_of_subtype_range_surjective
statement:
theorem range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker_of_subtype_range_surjective (f : M →ₗ[R] M')
    (hf : Function.Surjective (range f).subtype.dualMap) :
    LinearMap.range f.dualMap = (ker f).dualAnnihilator
proof:
:= by
  have rr_surj : Function.Surjective f.rangeRestrict := by
    rw [← range_eq_top, range_rangeRestrict]
  have := range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker_of_surjective f.rangeRestrict rr_surj
  convert! this using 1
  · calc
      _ = range ((range f).subtype.comp f.rangeRestrict).dualMap := by simp
      _ = _ := ?_
    rw [← dualMap_comp_dualMap, range_comp_of_range_eq_top]
    rwa [range_eq_top]
  · apply congr_arg
    exact (ker_rangeRestrict f).symm

name: range_eq_top_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma range_eq_top_of_ne_zero {K V₁ : Type*} [DivisionSemiring K] [AddCommMonoid V₁] [Module K V₁]
    {f : Module.Dual K V₁} (hf : f ≠ 0) : LinearMap.range f = ⊤

name: finrank_ker_add_one_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma finrank_ker_add_one_of_ne_zero :
    finrank K (LinearMap.ker f) + 1 = finrank K V₁
proof:
:= by
  suffices finrank K (LinearMap.range f) = 1 by
    rw [← (LinearMap.ker f).finrank_quotient_add_finrank, add_comm, add_left_inj,
    f.quotKerEquivRange.finrank_eq, this]
  rw [range_eq_top_of_ne_zero hf, finrank_top, finrank_self]

name: isCompl_ker_of_disjoint_of_ne_bot
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hpf, codisjoint_iff.mpr <| eq_of_le_of_finrank_le le_top ?_⟩
  have : finrank K ↑(LinearMap.ker f ⊔ p) = finrank K (LinearMap.ker f) + finrank K p := by
    simp [← Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq (LinearMap.ker f) p, hpf.eq_bot]
  rwa [finrank_top, this, ← finrank_ker_add_one_of_ne_zero hf, add_le_add_iff_left,
    Submodule.one_le_finrank_iff]

name: eq_of_ker_eq_of_apply_eq
statement:
lemma eq_of_ker_eq_of_apply_eq [FiniteDimensional K V₁] {f g : Module.Dual K V₁} (x : V₁)
    (h : LinearMap.ker f = LinearMap.ker g) (h' : f x = g x) (hx : f x ≠ 0) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  let p := K ∙ x
  have hp : p ≠ ⊥ := by aesop
  have hpf : Disjoint (LinearMap.ker f) p := by
    rw [disjoint_iff, Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
    rintro y ⟨hfy : f y = 0, hpy : y ∈ p⟩
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hpy
    have ht : t = 0 := by simpa [hx] using hfy
    simp [ht]
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by aesop
  ext v
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ : ∃ᵉ (y ∈ LinearMap.ker f) (z ∈ p), y + z = v := by
    have : v ∈ (⊤ : Submodule K V₁) := Submodule.mem_top
    rwa [← (isCompl_ker_of_disjoint_of_ne_bot hf hpf hp).sup_eq_top, Submodule.mem_sup] at this
  have hy' : g y = 0 := by rwa [← LinearMap.mem_ker, ← h]
  replace hy : f y = 0 := by rwa [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hy
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hz
  simp [h', hy, hy']

name: dualMap_surjective_of_injective
statement:
theorem dualMap_surjective_of_injective {f : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Surjective f.dualMap
proof:
:= fun φ ↦
  have ⟨f', hf'⟩ := f.exists_leftInverse_of_injective (ker_eq_bot.mpr hf)
  ⟨φ.comp f', ext fun x ↦ congr(φ <| $hf' x)⟩

name: range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker
statement:
theorem range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker (f : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂) :

name: dualMap_surjective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dualMap_surjective_iff {f : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂} :
    Function.Surjective f.dualMap ↔ Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker,
      ← Submodule.dualAnnihilator_bot, Subspace.dualAnnihilator_inj, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]

name: dualPairing_nondegenerate
statement: theorem dualPairing_nondegenerate (W : Subspace K V₁) : W.dualPairing.Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [LinearMap.separatingLeft_iff_ker_eq_bot, dualPairing_eq]
    apply LinearEquiv.ker
  · intro x h
    rw [← forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K x]
    intro φ
    simpa only [Submodule.dualPairing_apply, dualLift_of_subtype] using

name: dualCopairing_nondegenerate

    apply LinearEquiv.ker
  · rintro ⟨x⟩
    simp only [Quotient.quot_mk_eq_mk, dualCopairing_apply, Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    rw [← forall_mem_dualAnnihilator_apply_eq_zero_iff, SetLike.forall]
    exact id

name: dualAnnihilator_inf_eq
statement:
theorem dualAnnihilator_inf_eq (W W' : Subspace K V₁) :
    (W ⊓ W').dualAnnihilator = W.dualAnnihilator ⊔ W'.dualAnnihilator
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (sup_dualAnnihilator_le_inf W W')
  let F : V₁ →ₗ[K] (V₁ ⧸ W) × V₁ ⧸ W' := (Submodule.mkQ W).prod (Submodule.mkQ W')
  have : LinearMap.ker F = W ⊓ W' := by simp only [F, LinearMap.ker_prod, ker_mkQ]
  rw [← this, ← LinearMap.range_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_ker]
  intro φ
  rw [LinearMap.mem_range]
  rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [Submodule.mem_sup]
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩ := (dualProdDualEquivDual K (V₁ ⧸ W) (V₁ ⧸ W')).surjective x
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := (dualQuotEquivDualAnnihilator W).symm.surjective a
  obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := (dualQuotEquivDualAnnihilator W').symm.surjective b
  use a', a'.property, b', b'.property
  rfl

name: dualAnnihilator_iInf_eq
statement:
theorem dualAnnihilator_iInf_eq {ι : Sort*} [Finite ι] (W : ι → Subspace K V₁) :
    (⨅ i : ι, W i).dualAnnihilator = ⨆ i : ι, (W i).dualAnnihilator
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iInf_plift_down W, ← iSup_plift_down fun i ↦ (W i).dualAnnihilator]
  refine Finite.induction_empty_option
    (P := fun α ↦ ∀ W : α → _, (⨅ i, W i).dualAnnihilator = ⨆ i, (W i).dualAnnihilator) ?_ ?_ ?_
    (PLift ι) (fun i ↦ W i.down)
  · intro α β h hyp W
    rw [← h.iInf_comp, hyp _, ← h.iSup_comp]
  · intro W
    rw [iSup_of_empty', iInf_of_isEmpty, sInf_empty, sSup_empty, dualAnnihilator_top]
  · intro α _ h W
    rw [iInf_option, iSup_option, dualAnnihilator_inf_eq, h]

name: isCompl_dualAnnihilator
statement:
theorem isCompl_dualAnnihilator {W W' : Subspace K V₁} (h : IsCompl W W') :
    IsCompl W.dualAnnihilator W'.dualAnnihilator
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCompl_iff, disjoint_iff, codisjoint_iff] at h ⊢
  rw [← dualAnnihilator_inf_eq, ← dualAnnihilator_sup_eq, h.1, h.2, dualAnnihilator_top,
    dualAnnihilator_bot]
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: finrank_range_dualMap_eq_finrank_range
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finrank_range_dualMap_eq_finrank_range (f : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂) :
    finrank K (LinearMap.range f.dualMap) = finrank K (LinearMap.range f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [congr_arg dualMap (show f = (range f).subtype.comp f.rangeRestrict by rfl),
    ← dualMap_comp_dualMap, range_comp,
    range_eq_top.mpr (dualMap_surjective_of_injective (range f).injective_subtype),
    Submodule.map_top, finrank_range_of_inj, Subspace.dual_finrank_eq]
  exact dualMap_injective_of_surjective (range_eq_top.mp f.range_rangeRestrict)

name: dualMap_injective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dualMap_injective_iff {f : V₁ →ₗ[K] V₂} :
    Function.Injective f.dualMap ↔ Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Function.mtr fun not_surj inj ↦ ?_, dualMap_injective_of_surjective⟩
  rw [← range_eq_top, ← Ne, ← lt_top_iff_ne_top] at not_surj
  obtain ⟨φ, φ0, range_le_ker⟩ := (range f).exists_le_ker_of_lt_top not_surj
  exact φ0 (inj <| ext fun x ↦ range_le_ker ⟨x, rfl⟩)

name: dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator_eq
statement:
theorem dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator_eq {W : Subspace K (Dual K V)} [FiniteDimensional K W] :
    W.dualCoannihilator.dualAnnihilator = W
proof:
:=
  let e := (LinearEquiv.ofBijective _ W.flip_quotDualCoannihilatorToDual_bijective).trans
    (Submodule.dualQuotEquivDualAnnihilator _)
  letI : AddCommGroup W := inferInstance
  haveI : FiniteDimensional K W.dualCoannihilator.dualAnnihilator := LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional e
  (eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq W.le_dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator e.finrank_eq).symm

statement:
theorem dualCoannihilator_inf (W W' : Subspace K (Dual K V))
    [FiniteDimensional K W] [FiniteDimensional K W'] :

proof:
:= by

name: dualCoannihilator_iInf
statement:
theorem dualCoannihilator_iInf {ι : Type*} (W : ι → Subspace K (Module.Dual K V))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (W i)] :
    (⨅ i, W i).dualCoannihilator = ⨆ i, (W i).dualCoannihilator
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι
  · simp [iInf_of_isEmpty, iSup_of_empty']
  have := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr <|
    FG.of_le (Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp inferInstance) (iInf_le W <| Classical.arbitrary ι)
  rw [← dualAnnihilator_inj, dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator_eq, dualAnnihilator_iSup_eq]
  simp only [dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator_eq]

name: dualAnnihilator_dualAnnihilator_eq_map
statement:
theorem dualAnnihilator_dualAnnihilator_eq_map (W : Subspace K V) [FiniteDimensional K W] :
    W.dualAnnihilator.dualAnnihilator = W.map (Dual.eval K V)
proof:
:= by
  let e1 := (Free.chooseBasis K W).toDualEquiv ≪≫ₗ W.quotAnnihilatorEquiv.symm
  have := e1.finiteDimensional
  let e2 := (Free.chooseBasis K _).toDualEquiv ≪≫ₗ W.dualAnnihilator.dualQuotEquivDualAnnihilator
  have := LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (V₂ := W.dualAnnihilator.dualAnnihilator) e2
  rw [eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq (map_le_dualAnnihilator_dualAnnihilator W)]
  rw [← (equivMapOfInjective _ (eval_apply_injective K (V := V)) W).finrank_eq, e1.finrank_eq]
  exact e2.finrank_eq

name: span_flip_eq_top_iff_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem span_flip_eq_top_iff_linearIndependent {ι α F} [Finite ι] [Field F] {f : ι → α → F} :
    span F (Set.range <| flip f) = ⊤ ↔ LinearIndependent F f
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearIndependent_iff_ker, ← Submodule.map_eq_top_iff (e := Finsupp.llift F F F ι),
    ← Subspace.dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator_eq (W := map ..), dualAnnihilator_eq_top_iff]
  congr!
  rw [SetLike.ext'_iff, map_span, Submodule.coe_dualCoannihilator_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  ext
  simp [funext_iff, Finsupp.linearCombination, Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_apply, flip]

name: Module.exists_dual_forall_apply_eq_one
statement:
lemma Module.exists_dual_forall_apply_eq_one {ι K V : Type*} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    {s : Set ι} {v : ι → V} (hli : LinearIndepOn K v s) :
    ∃ f : Dual K V, ∀ i ∈ s, f (v i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  replace hli : LinearIndepOn K id (v '' s) := LinearIndepOn.id_image hli
  let b : Basis _ K V := .mk (hli.linearIndepOn_extend (Set.subset_univ _)) <| by
    simpa using hli.span_extend_eq_span <| Set.subset_univ _
  refine ⟨b.constr K 1, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  replace hi : v i ∈ hli.extend (Set.subset_univ _) :=
    hli.subset_extend _ <| Set.mem_image_of_mem v hi
  let ri : hli.extend (Set.subset_univ _) := ⟨v i, hi⟩
  have : b ri = v i := by simp [b, ri]
  simp [← this]

name: LinearEquiv.dualMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LinearEquiv.dualMap_apply (f : M₁ ≃ₗ[R] M₂) (g : Dual R M₂) (x : M₁) :
    f.dualMap g x = g (f x)

name: LinearEquiv.dualMap_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LinearEquiv.dualMap_refl :
    (LinearEquiv.refl R M₁).dualMap = LinearEquiv.refl R (Dual R M₁)

name: LinearEquiv.dualMap_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LinearEquiv.dualMap_symm {f : M₁ ≃ₗ[R] M₂} :
    (LinearEquiv.dualMap f).symm = LinearEquiv.dualMap f.symm

name: LinearEquiv.dualMap_trans
statement:
theorem LinearEquiv.dualMap_trans {M₃ : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M₃] [Module R M₃] (f : M₁ ≃ₗ[R] M₂)
    (g : M₂ ≃ₗ[R] M₃) : g.dualMap.trans f.dualMap = (f.trans g).dualMap

name: Module.Dual.eval_naturality
statement:
theorem Module.Dual.eval_naturality (f : M₁ →ₗ[R] M₂) :
    f.dualMap.dualMap ∘ₗ eval R M₁ = eval R M₂ ∘ₗ f

name: Dual.apply_one_mul_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Dual.apply_one_mul_eq (f : Dual R R) (r : R) :
    f 1 * r = f r
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← mul_one r, ← smul_eq_mul]
  rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: LinearMap.range_dualMap_dual_eq_span_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
lemma LinearMap.range_dualMap_dual_eq_span_singleton (f : Dual R M₁) :
    range f.dualMap = R ∙ f
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨r, hr⟩ ↦ ⟨r 1, ?_⟩, fun ⟨r, hr⟩ ↦ ⟨r • LinearMap.id, ?_⟩⟩
  · ext; simp [dualMap_apply', ← hr]
  · ext; simp [dualMap_apply', ← hr]

name: bijective_dual_eval
statement: lemma bijective_dual_eval [IsReflexive R M] : Bijective (Dual.eval R M)

name: erange_coe
statement: theorem erange_coe : LinearMap.range (eval R M) = ⊤

name: evalEquiv_toLinearMap
statement: @[simp] lemma evalEquiv_toLinearMap : evalEquiv R M = Dual.eval R M

name: evalEquiv_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma evalEquiv_apply (m : M) : evalEquiv R M m = Dual.eval R M m

name: apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma apply_evalEquiv_symm_apply (f : Dual R M) (g : Dual R (Dual R M)) :
    f ((evalEquiv R M).symm g) = g f
proof:
:= by
  set m := (evalEquiv R M).symm g
  rw [← (evalEquiv R M).apply_symm_apply g, evalEquiv_apply, Dual.eval_apply]

name: symm_dualMap_evalEquiv
statement:
@[simp] lemma symm_dualMap_evalEquiv :
    (evalEquiv R M).symm.dualMap = Dual.eval R (Dual R M)

name: Dual.eval_comp_comp_evalEquiv_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma Dual.eval_comp_comp_evalEquiv_eq
    {M' : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M'] [Module R M'] {f : M →ₗ[R] M'} :
    Dual.eval R M' ∘ₗ f ∘ₗ (evalEquiv R M).symm = f.dualMap.dualMap
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc, LinearEquiv.comp_toLinearMap_symm_eq,
    evalEquiv_toLinearMap, eval_naturality]

name: dualMap_dualMap_eq_iff_of_injective
statement:
lemma dualMap_dualMap_eq_iff_of_injective
    {M' : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M'] [Module R M'] {f g : M →ₗ[R] M'}
    (h : Injective (Dual.eval R M')) :
    f.dualMap.dualMap = g.dualMap.dualMap ↔ f = g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Dual.eval_comp_comp_evalEquiv_eq]
  refine ⟨fun hfg => ?_, fun a ↦ congrArg (Dual.eval R M').comp
    (congrFun (congrArg LinearMap.comp a) (evalEquiv R M).symm.toLinearMap)⟩
  rw [propext (cancel_left h), LinearEquiv.eq_comp_toLinearMap_iff] at hfg
  exact hfg

name: dualMap_dualMap_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma dualMap_dualMap_eq_iff
    {M' : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M'] [Module R M'] [IsReflexive R M'] {f g : M →ₗ[R] M'} :
    f.dualMap.dualMap = g.dualMap.dualMap ↔ f = g

name: IsReflexive.of_split
statement:
lemma IsReflexive.of_split (i : N →ₗ[R] M) (s : M →ₗ[R] N) (H : s ∘ₗ i = .id) :
    IsReflexive R N where
  bijective_dual_eval'
proof:
:=
    ⟨.of_comp (f := i.dualMap.dualMap) <|
      (bijective_dual_eval R M).1.comp (injective_of_comp_eq_id i _ H),
    .of_comp (g := s) <| (surjective_of_comp_eq_id i.dualMap.dualMap s.dualMap.dualMap <|
      congr_arg (dualMap ∘ dualMap) H).comp (bijective_dual_eval R M).2⟩

name: mapEvalEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapEvalEquiv_apply (W : Submodule R M) :
    mapEvalEquiv R M W = W.map (Dual.eval R M)

name: mapEvalEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapEvalEquiv_symm_apply (W'' : Submodule R (Dual R (Dual R M))) :
    (mapEvalEquiv R M).symm W'' = W''.comap (Dual.eval R M)

name: equiv
statement:
lemma equiv (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) : IsReflexive R N where
  bijective_dual_eval'
proof:
:= by
    let ed : Dual R (Dual R N) ≃ₗ[R] Dual R (Dual R M) := e.symm.dualMap.dualMap
    have : Dual.eval R N = ed.symm.comp ((Dual.eval R M).comp e.symm.toLinearMap) := by
      ext m f
      exact DFunLike.congr_arg f (e.apply_symm_apply m).symm
    simp only [this,
      coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, EquivLike.comp_bijective]
    exact Bijective.comp (bijective_dual_eval R M) (LinearEquiv.bijective _)

name: dualRestrict_def
statement: theorem dualRestrict_def (W : Submodule R M) : W.dualRestrict = W.subtype.dualMap

name: dualRestrict_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dualRestrict_apply (W : Submodule R M) (φ : Module.Dual R M) (x : W) :
    W.dualRestrict φ x = φ (x : M)

name: mem_dualAnnihilator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_dualAnnihilator (φ : Module.Dual R M) : φ ∈ W.dualAnnihilator ↔ ∀ w ∈ W, φ w = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [dualAnnihilator, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.ext_iff, dualRestrict_apply,
    Subtype.forall, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: dualRestrict_ker_eq_dualAnnihilator
statement:
theorem dualRestrict_ker_eq_dualAnnihilator (W : Submodule R M) :
    LinearMap.ker W.dualRestrict = W.dualAnnihilator

name: mem_dualCoannihilator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_dualCoannihilator {Φ : Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)} (x : M) :
    x ∈ Φ.dualCoannihilator ↔ ∀ φ ∈ Φ, (φ x : R) = 0

name: dualAnnihilator_map_dualMap_le
statement:
lemma dualAnnihilator_map_dualMap_le {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N]
    (W : Submodule R M) (f : N →ₗ[R] M) :
    W.dualAnnihilator.map f.dualMap ≤ (W.comap f).dualAnnihilator

name: comap_dualAnnihilator
statement:
theorem comap_dualAnnihilator (Φ : Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)) :
    Φ.dualAnnihilator.comap (Module.Dual.eval R M) = Φ.dualCoannihilator

name: map_dualCoannihilator_le
statement:
theorem map_dualCoannihilator_le (Φ : Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)) :
    Φ.dualCoannihilator.map (Module.Dual.eval R M) ≤ Φ.dualAnnihilator

name: dualAnnihilator_gc
statement:
theorem dualAnnihilator_gc :
    GaloisConnection
      (OrderDual.toDual ∘ (dualAnnihilator : Submodule R M → Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)))
      (dualCoannihilator ∘ OrderDual.ofDual)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b
  induction b using OrderDual.rec
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, OrderDual.toDual_le_toDual, OrderDual.ofDual_toDual,
    SetLike.le_def, mem_dualAnnihilator, mem_dualCoannihilator]
  grind

name: le_dualAnnihilator_iff_le_dualCoannihilator
statement:
theorem le_dualAnnihilator_iff_le_dualCoannihilator {U : Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)}
    {V : Submodule R M} : U ≤ V.dualAnnihilator ↔ V ≤ U.dualCoannihilator

name: dualAnnihilator_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dualAnnihilator_bot : (⊥ : Submodule R M).dualAnnihilator = ⊤

name: dualAnnihilator_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dualAnnihilator_top : (⊤ : Submodule R M).dualAnnihilator = ⊥

name: dualCoannihilator_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dualCoannihilator_bot : (⊥ : Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)).dualCoannihilator = ⊤

name: dualAnnihilator_anti
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem dualAnnihilator_anti {U V : Submodule R M} (hUV : U ≤ V) :
    V.dualAnnihilator ≤ U.dualAnnihilator

name: dualCoannihilator_anti
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem dualCoannihilator_anti {U V : Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)} (hUV : U ≤ V) :
    V.dualCoannihilator ≤ U.dualCoannihilator

name: le_dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator
statement:
theorem le_dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator (U : Submodule R M) :
    U ≤ U.dualAnnihilator.dualCoannihilator

name: le_dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator
statement:
theorem le_dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator (U : Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)) :
    U ≤ U.dualCoannihilator.dualAnnihilator

name: dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator
statement:
theorem dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator (U : Submodule R M) :
    U.dualAnnihilator.dualCoannihilator.dualAnnihilator = U.dualAnnihilator

name: dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator
statement:
theorem dualCoannihilator_dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator (U : Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)) :
    U.dualCoannihilator.dualAnnihilator.dualCoannihilator = U.dualCoannihilator

name: dualAnnihilator_sup_eq
statement:
theorem dualAnnihilator_sup_eq (U V : Submodule R M) :
    (U ⊔ V).dualAnnihilator = U.dualAnnihilator ⊓ V.dualAnnihilator

name: dualCoannihilator_sup_eq
statement:
theorem dualCoannihilator_sup_eq (U V : Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)) :
    (U ⊔ V).dualCoannihilator = U.dualCoannihilator ⊓ V.dualCoannihilator

name: dualAnnihilator_iSup_eq
statement:
theorem dualAnnihilator_iSup_eq {ι : Sort*} (U : ι → Submodule R M) :
    (⨆ i : ι, U i).dualAnnihilator = ⨅ i : ι, (U i).dualAnnihilator

name: dualCoannihilator_iSup_eq
statement:
theorem dualCoannihilator_iSup_eq {ι : Sort*} (U : ι → Submodule R (Module.Dual R M)) :
    (⨆ i : ι, U i).dualCoannihilator = ⨅ i : ι, (U i).dualCoannihilator

name: sup_dualAnnihilator_le_inf
statement:
theorem sup_dualAnnihilator_le_inf (U V : Submodule R M) :
    U.dualAnnihilator ⊔ V.dualAnnihilator ≤ (U ⊓ V).dualAnnihilator
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_dualAnnihilator_iff_le_dualCoannihilator, dualCoannihilator_sup_eq]
  apply inf_le_inf <;> exact le_dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator _

name: iSup_dualAnnihilator_le_iInf
statement:
theorem iSup_dualAnnihilator_le_iInf {ι : Sort*} (U : ι → Submodule R M) :
    ⨆ i : ι, (U i).dualAnnihilator ≤ (⨅ i : ι, U i).dualAnnihilator
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_dualAnnihilator_iff_le_dualCoannihilator, dualCoannihilator_iSup_eq]
  apply iInf_mono
  exact fun i : ι => le_dualAnnihilator_dualCoannihilator (U i)

name: coe_dualAnnihilator_span
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_dualAnnihilator, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ← LinearMap.mem_ker]
  exact span_le

name: coe_dualCoannihilator_span
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have (φ : _) : x ∈ LinearMap.ker φ ↔ φ ∈ LinearMap.ker (Module.Dual.eval R M x) := by simp
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_dualCoannihilator, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ← LinearMap.mem_ker, this]
  exact span_le

name: ker_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_range
statement:
theorem ker_dualMap_eq_dualAnnihilator_range :
    LinearMap.ker f.dualMap = (range f).dualAnnihilator
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp_rw [mem_ker, LinearMap.ext_iff, Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator,
    ← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_range, Set.forall_mem_range, dualMap_apply, zero_apply]

name: range_dualMap_le_dualAnnihilator_ker
statement:
theorem range_dualMap_le_dualAnnihilator_ker :
    LinearMap.range f.dualMap ≤ (ker f).dualAnnihilator

name: ker_dualMap_eq_dualCoannihilator_range
statement:
theorem ker_dualMap_eq_dualCoannihilator_range (f : M →ₗ[R] M') :
    LinearMap.ker f.dualMap = (range (Dual.eval R M' ∘ₗ f)).dualCoannihilator
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [LinearMap.ext_iff (f := dualMap f x)]

name: dualCoannihilator_range_eq_ker_flip
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dualCoannihilator_range_eq_ker_flip (B : M →ₗ[R] M' →ₗ[R] R) :
    (range B).dualCoannihilator = LinearMap.ker B.flip
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [LinearMap.ext_iff (f := B.flip x)]

name: toDual_apply
statement: theorem toDual_apply (i j : ι) : b.toDual (b i) (b j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toDual, constr_basis b, constr_basis b]
  simp only [eq_comm]

name: toDual_linearCombination_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDual_linearCombination_left (f : ι →₀ R) (i : ι) :
    b.toDual (Finsupp.linearCombination R b f) (b i) = f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, toDual_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_boole,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finsupp.if_mem_support]

name: toDual_linearCombination_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDual_linearCombination_right (f : ι →₀ R) (i : ι) :
    b.toDual (b i) (Finsupp.linearCombination R b f) = f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
  simp_rw [map_smul, toDual_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_boole, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
    Finsupp.if_mem_support]

name: toDual_apply_left
statement: theorem toDual_apply_left (m : M) (i : ι) : b.toDual m (b i) = b.repr m i

name: toDual_apply_right
statement: theorem toDual_apply_right (i : ι) (m : M) : b.toDual (b i) m = b.repr m i

name: coe_toDual_self
statement: theorem coe_toDual_self (i : ι) : b.toDual (b i) = b.coord i

name: toDualFlip_apply
statement: theorem toDualFlip_apply (m₁ m₂ : M) : b.toDualFlip m₁ m₂ = b.toDual m₂ m₁

name: toDual_eq_repr
statement: theorem toDual_eq_repr (m : M) (i : ι) : b.toDual m (b i) = b.repr m i

name: toDual_eq_equivFun
statement: theorem toDual_eq_equivFun [Finite ι] (m : M) (i : ι) : b.toDual m (b i) = b.equivFun m i

name: toDual_injective
statement: theorem toDual_injective : Injective b.toDual
proof:
:= fun x y h ↦ b.ext_elem_iff.mpr fun i ↦ by
  simp_rw [← toDual_eq_repr]; exact DFunLike.congr_fun h _

name: toDual_inj
statement: theorem toDual_inj (m : M) (a : b.toDual m = 0) : m = 0

name: toDual_ker
statement: theorem toDual_ker : LinearMap.ker b.toDual = ⊥

name: toDual_range
statement: theorem toDual_range [Finite ι] : LinearMap.range b.toDual = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff'.2 fun f => ⟨Finsupp.linearCombination R b <|
    Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm fun i => f (b i), b.ext fun i => by simp⟩

name: sum_dual_apply_smul_coord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_dual_apply_smul_coord [Fintype ι] (f : Module.Dual R M) :
    (∑ x, f (b x) • b.coord x) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp_rw [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm (f _), ← smul_eq_mul,
    ← f.map_smul, ← map_sum, Basis.coord_apply, Basis.sum_repr]

name: toDualEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDualEquiv_apply (m : M) : b.toDualEquiv m = b.toDual m

name: dualBasis_apply_self
statement:
theorem dualBasis_apply_self (i j : ι) : b.dualBasis i (b j) =
    if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  convert! b.toDual_apply i j using 2
  rw [@eq_comm _ j i]

name: linearCombination_dualBasis
statement:
theorem linearCombination_dualBasis (f : ι →₀ R) (i : ι) :
    Finsupp.linearCombination R b.dualBasis f (b i) = f i
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum_fintype, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  · simp_rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, dualBasis_apply_self, mul_boole,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq, ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  · intro
    rw [zero_smul]

name: dualBasis_repr
statement: @[simp] theorem dualBasis_repr (l : Dual R M) (i : ι) : b.dualBasis.repr l i = l (b i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← linearCombination_dualBasis b, Basis.linearCombination_repr b.dualBasis l]

name: dualBasis_apply
statement: theorem dualBasis_apply (i : ι) (m : M) : b.dualBasis i m = b.repr m i

name: coe_dualBasis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_dualBasis : ⇑b.dualBasis = b.coord
proof:
:= by
  ext i x
  apply dualBasis_apply

name: toDual_toDual
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toDual_toDual : b.dualBasis.toDual.comp b.toDual = Dual.eval R M
proof:
:= by
  refine b.ext fun i => b.dualBasis.ext fun j => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, toDual_apply_left, coe_toDual_self, ← coe_dualBasis,
    Dual.eval_apply, Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply, dualBasis_apply_self]

name: dualBasis_equivFun
statement:
theorem dualBasis_equivFun [Finite ι] (l : Dual R M) (i : ι) :
    b.dualBasis.equivFun l i = l (b i)

name: eval_injective
statement: theorem eval_injective {ι : Type*} (b : Basis ι R M) : Function.Injective (Dual.eval R M)
proof:
:= by
  intro m m' eq
  simp_rw [LinearMap.ext_iff, Dual.eval_apply] at eq
  exact b.ext_elem fun i ↦ eq (b.coord i)

name: eval_ker
statement: theorem eval_ker {ι : Type*} (b : Basis ι R M) : LinearMap.ker (Dual.eval R M) = ⊥

name: eval_range
statement:
theorem eval_range {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (b : Basis ι R M) :
    LinearMap.range (Dual.eval R M) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
    cases nonempty_fintype ι
    rw [← b.toDual_toDual, range_comp, b.toDual_range, Submodule.map_top, toDual_range _]

name: dualBasis_coord_toDualEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma dualBasis_coord_toDualEquiv_apply [Finite ι] (i : ι) (f : M) :
    b.dualBasis.coord i (b.toDualEquiv f) = b.coord i f

name: coord_toDualEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
lemma coord_toDualEquiv_symm_apply [Finite ι] (i : ι) (f : Module.Dual R M) :
    b.coord i (b.toDualEquiv.symm f) = b.dualBasis.coord i f

name: linearCombination_coord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearCombination_coord [Finite ι] (b : Basis ι R M) (f : ι →₀ R) (i : ι) :
    Finsupp.linearCombination R b.coord f (b i) = f i
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq ι
  rw [← coe_dualBasis, linearCombination_dualBasis]

name: coeffs_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffs_apply (h : DualBases e ε) (m : M) (i : ι) : h.coeffs m i = ε i m

name: lc_def
statement: theorem lc_def (e : ι → M) (l : ι →₀ R) : lc e l = Finsupp.linearCombination R e l

name: dual_lc
statement: theorem dual_lc (l : ι →₀ R) (i : ι) : ε i (DualBases.lc e l) = l i
proof:
:= by
  rw [lc, map_finsuppSum, Finsupp.sum_eq_single i (g := fun a b ↦ (ε i) (b • e a))]
  · simp [h.eval_same, smul_eq_mul]
  · intro q _ q_ne
    simp [h.eval_of_ne q_ne.symm, smul_eq_mul]
  · simp

name: coeffs_lc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffs_lc (l : ι →₀ R) : h.coeffs (DualBases.lc e l) = l

name: lc_coeffs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lc_coeffs (m : M) : DualBases.lc e (h.coeffs m) = m

name: coe_basis
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_basis : ⇑h.basis = e
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [Basis.apply_eq_iff]
  ext j
  rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | hne
  · simp [h.eval_same]
  · simp [hne, h.eval_of_ne hne.symm]

name: mem_of_mem_span
statement:
theorem mem_of_mem_span {H : Set ι} {x : M} (hmem : x ∈ Submodule.span R (e '' H)) :
    ∀ i : ι, ε i x ≠ 0 → i ∈ H
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  rcases (Finsupp.mem_span_image_iff_linearCombination _).mp hmem with ⟨l, supp_l, rfl⟩
  apply not_imp_comm.mp ((Finsupp.mem_supported' _ _).mp supp_l i)
  rwa [← lc_def, h.dual_lc] at hi

name: liftQ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftQ₂_mk {M' : Submodule R M} {N' : Submodule S N} {f : M →ₛₗ[ρ] N →ₛₗ[σ] P}
    (hM' : M' ≤ f.ker) (hN' : N' ≤ f.flip.ker) (m : M) (n : N) :
    f.liftQ₂ M' N' hM' hN' (Submodule.Quotient.mk m) (Submodule.Quotient.mk n) = f m n

name: piQuotientLift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem piQuotientLift_mk [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ∀ i, Submodule R (Ms i))
    (q : Submodule R N) (f : ∀ i, Ms i →ₗ[R] N) (hf : ∀ i, p i ≤ q.comap (f i)) (x : ∀ i, Ms i) :
    (piQuotientLift p q f hf fun i => Quotient.mk (x i)) = Quotient.mk (lsum _ _ R f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [piQuotientLift, lsum_apply, sum_apply, ← mkQ_apply, lsum_apply, sum_apply, _root_.map_sum]
  simp only [coe_proj, mapQ_apply, mkQ_apply, comp_apply]

name: piQuotientLift_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem piQuotientLift_single [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (p : ∀ i, Submodule R (Ms i))
    (q : Submodule R N) (f : ∀ i, Ms i →ₗ[R] N) (hf : ∀ i, p i ≤ q.comap (f i)) (i)
    (x : Ms i ⧸ p i) : piQuotientLift p q f hf (Pi.single i x) = mapQ _ _ (f i) (hf i) x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [piQuotientLift, lsum_apply, sum_apply, comp_apply, proj_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_same]
  · rintro j - hj
    rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hj, map_zero]
  · intros
    have := Finset.mem_univ i
    contradiction

name: quotientPiLift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientPiLift_mk (p : ∀ i, Submodule R (Ms i)) (f : ∀ i, Ms i →ₗ[R] Ns i)
    (hf : ∀ i, p i ≤ ker (f i)) (x : ∀ i, Ms i) :
    quotientPiLift p f hf (Quotient.mk x) = fun i => f i (x i)

name: map_add
statement:
theorem map_add (x y : ((i : ι) → Ms i) ⧸ pi Set.univ p) :
    toFun p (x + y) = toFun p x + toFun p y
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.map_add (quotientPiLift p (fun i => (p i).mkQ) fun i => (ker_mkQ (p i)).ge) x y

name: map_smul
statement:
theorem map_smul (r : R) (x : ((i : ι) → Ms i) ⧸ pi Set.univ p) :
    toFun p (r • x) = (RingHom.id R r) • toFun p x
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.map_smul (quotientPiLift p (fun i => (p i).mkQ) fun i => (ker_mkQ (p i)).ge) r x

name: left_inv
statement: theorem left_inv : Function.LeftInverse (invFun p) (toFun p)
proof:
:= fun x =>
  Submodule.Quotient.induction_on _ x fun x' => by
    dsimp only [toFun, invFun]
    rw [quotientPiLift_mk p, funext fun i => (mkQ_apply (p i) (x' i)), piQuotientLift_mk p,
      lsum_single, id_apply]

name: right_inv
statement: theorem right_inv : Function.RightInverse (invFun p) (toFun p)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [toFun, invFun]
  rw [Function.rightInverse_iff_comp, ← coe_comp, ← @id_coe R]
  congr
  refine pi_ext fun i x ↦ ?_
  induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with | _ x'
  refine funext fun j ↦ ?_
  rw [comp_apply, piQuotientLift_single, mapQ_apply,
    quotientPiLift_mk, id_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp only [mkQ_apply, coe_single]
  · subst hij
    rw [Pi.single_eq_same, Pi.single_eq_same]
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij), Pi.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij), Quotient.mk_zero]

name: mapQ_comp
statement:
theorem mapQ_comp {R₃ M₃ : Type*} [Ring R₃] [AddCommGroup M₃] [Module R₃ M₃] (p₂ : Submodule R₂ M₂)
    (p₃ : Submodule R₃ M₃) {τ₂₃ : R₂ →+* R₃} {τ₁₃ : R →+* R₃} [RingHomCompTriple τ₁₂ τ₂₃ τ₁₃]
    (f : M →ₛₗ[τ₁₂] M₂) (g : M₂ →ₛₗ[τ₂₃] M₃) (hf : p ≤ p₂.comap f) (hg : p₂ ≤ p₃.comap g)
    (h := hf.trans (comap_mono hg)) :
    p.mapQ p₃ (g.comp f) h = (p₂.mapQ p₃ g hg).comp (p.mapQ p₂ f hf)

name: mapQ_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapQ_id (h : p ≤ p.comap LinearMap.id := (by rw [comap_id])) :

name: mapQ_pow
statement:
theorem mapQ_pow {f : M →ₗ[R] M} (h : p ≤ p.comap f) (k : ℕ)
    (h' : p ≤ p.comap (f ^ k) := p.le_comap_pow_of_le_comap h k) :
    p.mapQ p (f ^ k) h' = p.mapQ p f h ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [Module.End.one_eq_id]
  | succ k ih =>
    simp only [Module.End.iterate_succ]
    rw [mapQ_comp, ih]
    exact p.le_comap_pow_of_le_comap h k

name: comap_liftQ

proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (by rintro ⟨x⟩ hx; exact ⟨_, hx, rfl⟩)
    (by rw [map_le_iff_le_comap, ← comap_comp, liftQ_mkQ])

name: map_liftQ

proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (by rintro _ ⟨⟨x⟩, hxq, rfl⟩; exact ⟨x, hxq, rfl⟩)
    (by rintro _ ⟨x, hxq, rfl⟩; exact ⟨Quotient.mk x, hxq, rfl⟩)

name: span_preimage_eq
statement:
theorem span_preimage_eq [RingHomSurjective τ₁₂] {f : M →ₛₗ[τ₁₂] M₂} {s : Set M₂} (h₀ : s.Nonempty)
    (h₁ : s ⊆ range f) : span R (f ⁻¹' s) = (span R₂ s).comap f
proof:
:= by
  suffices (span R₂ s).comap f ≤ span R (f ⁻¹' s) by exact le_antisymm (span_preimage_le f s) this
  have hk : ker f ≤ span R (f ⁻¹' s) := by
    let y := Classical.choose h₀
    have hy : y ∈ s := Classical.choose_spec h₀
    rw [ker_le_iff]
    use y, h₁ hy
    rw [← Set.singleton_subset_iff] at hy
    exact Set.Subset.trans subset_span (span_mono (Set.preimage_mono hy))
  rw [← left_eq_sup] at hk
  rw [coe_range f] at h₁
  rw [hk, ← LinearMap.map_le_map_iff, map_span, map_comap_eq, Set.image_preimage_eq_of_subset h₁]
  exact inf_le_right

name: Quotient.equiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Quotient.equiv_apply (f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) (hf : P.map (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) = Q) (a : M ⧸ P) :
    equiv P Q f hf a = P.mapQ Q (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) (map_le_iff_le_comap.mp hf.le) a

name: Quotient.equiv_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Quotient.equiv_trans {R₃ : Type*} {O : Type*} [Ring R₃] [AddCommGroup O] [Module R₃ O]
    {σ₂₃ : R₂ →+* R₃} {σ₃₂ : R₃ →+* R₂} {σ₁₃ : R →+* R₃} {σ₃₁ : R₃ →+* R}
    [RingHomInvPair σ₂₃ σ₃₂] [RingHomInvPair σ₃₂ σ₂₃]
    [RingHomInvPair σ₁₃ σ₃₁] [RingHomInvPair σ₃₁ σ₁₃]
    [RingHomCompTriple σ₁₂ σ₂₃ σ₁₃] [RingHomCompTriple σ₃₂ σ₂₁ σ₃₁]
    (S : Submodule R₃ O) (e : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) (f : N ≃ₛₗ[σ₂₃] O)
    (he : P.map (e : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] N) = Q) (hf : Q.map (f : N →ₛₗ[σ₂₃] O) = S)
    (hef : P.map ((e.trans f : M ≃ₛₗ[σ₁₃] O) : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₃] O) = S) :
    Quotient.equiv P S (e.trans f) hef =
      (Quotient.equiv P Q e he).trans (Quotient.equiv Q S f hf)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  
  simp only [Quotient.equiv_apply, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_trans]
  
  rw [mapQ_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: range_mkQ_comp

name: range_eq_top_of_cancel

theorem range_eq_top_of_cancel {f : M →ₛₗ[τ₁₂] M₂}

proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (0 : M₂ →ₗ[R₂] M₂ ⧸ (range f)).comp f = 0 := zero_comp _
  rw [← Submodule.ker_mkQ (range f), ← h 0 (range f).mkQ (Eq.trans h₁ (range_mkQ_comp _).symm)]
  exact ker_zero

statement:

name: linearIndepOn_iUnion_of_directed
statement:
theorem linearIndepOn_iUnion_of_directed {η : Type*} {s : η → Set ι} (hs : Directed (· ⊆ ·) s)
    (h : ∀ i, LinearIndepOn R v (s i)) : LinearIndepOn R v (⋃ i, s i)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hη : Nonempty η
  · refine linearIndepOn_of_finite (⋃ i, s i) fun t ht ft => ?_
    rcases finite_subset_iUnion ft ht with ⟨I, fi, hI⟩
    rcases hs.finset_le fi.toFinset with ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact (h i).mono (Subset.trans hI <| iUnion₂_subset fun j hj => hi j (fi.mem_toFinset.2 hj))
  · refine (linearIndepOn_empty R v).mono (t := iUnion (s ·)) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨i, _⟩, _⟩
    exact hη ⟨i⟩

name: iSupIndep_range_lsingle
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_range_lsingle :
    iSupIndep fun i : ι ↦ LinearMap.range (Finsupp.lsingle (R := R) (M := M) i)
proof:
:= by
  refine fun i ↦ disjoint_iff_inf_le.mpr ?_
  rintro x ⟨⟨m, rfl⟩, hm⟩
  suffices ⨆ j ≠ i, LinearMap.range (Finsupp.lsingle j) ≤ Finsupp.supported M R {i}ᶜ by
    have := (Finsupp.mem_supported ..).mp (this hm); simp_all
  refine iSup₂_le fun j ne ↦ ?_
  rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  simp [Finsupp.mem_supported, ne]

name: LinearMap.iSupIndep_map
statement:
theorem LinearMap.iSupIndep_map (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (inj : Injective f) {m : ι → Submodule R M}

proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [iSupIndep, disjoint_iff_inf_le] at ind ⊢
  rintro i _ ⟨⟨x, hxi, rfl⟩, hx⟩
  rw [ind i ⟨hxi, _⟩]; · simp
  simp_rw [← Submodule.map_iSup] at hx
  have ⟨y, hy, eq⟩ := hx
  simpa [← inj eq]

name: linearIndependent_inl_union_inr'
proof:
:= by
  have : linearCombination R (Sum.elim (inl R M M' ∘ v) (inr R M M' ∘ v')) =
      .prodMap (linearCombination R v) (linearCombination R v') ∘ₗ
      (sumFinsuppLEquivProdFinsupp R).toLinearMap := by ext (_ | _) <;> simp
  rw [LinearIndependent, this]

name: LinearIndependent.inl_union_inr
statement:
theorem LinearIndependent.inl_union_inr {s : Set M} {t : Set M'}
    (hs : LinearIndependent R (fun x => x : s → M))
    (ht : LinearIndependent R (fun x => x : t → M')) :
    LinearIndependent R (fun x => x : ↥(inl R M M' '' s ∪ inr R M M' '' t) → M × M')
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  let e : s ⊕ t ≃ ↥(inl R M M' '' s ∪ inr R M M' '' t) :=
    .ofBijective (Sum.elim (fun i ↦ ⟨_, .inl ⟨_, i.2, rfl⟩⟩) fun i ↦ ⟨_, .inr ⟨_, i.2, rfl⟩⟩)
      ⟨by rintro (_ | _) (_ | _) eq <;> simp [hs.ne_zero, ht.ne_zero] at eq <;> aesop,
        by rintro ⟨_, ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, _, rfl⟩⟩ <;> aesop⟩
  refine (linearIndependent_equiv' e ?_).mp (linearIndependent_inl_union_inr' hs ht)
  ext (_ | _) <;> rfl

name: exists_maximal_linearIndepOn'
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_linearIndepOn' (v : ι → M) :
    ∃ s : Set ι, (LinearIndepOn R v s) ∧ ∀ t : Set ι, s ⊆ t → (LinearIndepOn R v t) → s = t
proof:
:= by
  let indep : Set ι → Prop := fun s => LinearIndepOn R v s
  let X := { I : Set ι // indep I }
  let r : X → X → Prop := fun I J => I.1 ⊆ J.1
  have key : ∀ c : Set X, IsChain r c → indep (⋃ (I : X) (_ : I ∈ c), I) := by
    intro c hc
    dsimp [indep]
    rw [linearIndepOn_iffₛ]
    intro f hfsupp g hgsupp hsum
    rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty c with (rfl | hn)
    · rw [show f = 0 by simpa using! hfsupp, show g = 0 by simpa using! hgsupp]
    have : Std.Refl r := ⟨fun _ => Set.Subset.refl _⟩
    classical
    obtain ⟨I, _I_mem, hI⟩ : ∃ I ∈ c, (f.support ∪ g.support : Set ι) ⊆ I :=
      f.support.coe_union _ ▸ hc.directedOn.exists_mem_subset_of_finset_subset_biUnion hn <| by
        simpa using! And.intro hfsupp hgsupp
    exact linearIndepOn_iffₛ.mp I.2 f (subset_union_left.trans hI)
      g (subset_union_right.trans hI) hsum
  obtain ⟨⟨I, hli : indep I⟩, hmax : ∀ a, r ⟨I, hli⟩ a → r a ⟨I, hli⟩⟩ :=
    exists_maximal_of_chains_bounded (r := r)
      (fun c hc => ⟨⟨⋃ I ∈ c, (I : Set ι), key c hc⟩, fun I => Set.subset_biUnion_of_mem⟩)
      Set.Subset.trans
  exact ⟨I, hli, fun J hsub hli => Set.Subset.antisymm hsub (hmax ⟨J, hli⟩ hsub)⟩

name: Submodule.codisjoint_span_image_of_codisjoint
statement:
lemma Submodule.codisjoint_span_image_of_codisjoint (hv : Submodule.span R (Set.range v) = ⊤)

theorem Fintype.linearIndependent_iff' [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :

name: LinearIndepOn.pair_iff
statement:
lemma LinearIndepOn.pair_iff {i j : ι} (f : ι → M) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    LinearIndepOn R f {i,j} ↔ ∀ c d : R, c • f i + d • f j = 0 → c = 0 ∧ d = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndepOn_iff'']
  refine ⟨fun h c d hcd ↦ ?_, fun h t g ht hg0 h0 ↦ ?_⟩
  · specialize h {i, j} (Pi.single i c + Pi.single j d)
    simpa +contextual [Finset.sum_pair, Pi.single_apply, hij, hij.symm, hcd] using h
  have ht' : t ⊆ {i, j} := by simpa [← Finset.coe_subset]
  rw [Finset.sum_subset ht', Finset.sum_pair hij] at h0
  · obtain ⟨hi0, hj0⟩ := h _ _ h0
    exact fun k hkt ↦ Or.elim (ht hkt) (fun h ↦ h ▸ hi0) (fun h ↦ h ▸ hj0)
  simp +contextual [hg0]

name: LinearIndependent.pair_iff
statement:
lemma LinearIndependent.pair_iff :
    LinearIndependent R ![x, y] ↔ ∀ (s t : R), s • x + t • y = 0 → s = 0 ∧ t = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← linearIndepOn_univ_iff, ← Finset.coe_univ, show @Finset.univ (Fin 2) _ = {0,1} from rfl,
    Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, LinearIndepOn.pair_iff _ (by trivial)]
  simp

name: LinearIndependent.pair_symm_iff
statement:
lemma LinearIndependent.pair_symm_iff :
    LinearIndependent R ![x, y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![y, x]
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x y : M, LinearIndependent R ![x, y] → LinearIndependent R ![y, x] by tauto
  simp only [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
  intro x y h s t
  specialize h t s
  rwa [add_comm, and_comm]

name: LinearIndependent.pair_neg_left_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma LinearIndependent.pair_neg_left_iff :
    LinearIndependent R ![-x, y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
proof:
:= by
  rw [pair_iff, pair_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h s t hst ↦ ?_, fun h s t hst ↦ ?_⟩ <;> simpa using h (-s) t (by simpa using hst)

name: LinearIndependent.pair_neg_right_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma LinearIndependent.pair_neg_right_iff :
    LinearIndependent R ![x, -y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]

name: LinearIndependent.pair_smul_smul_iff
statement:
lemma LinearIndependent.pair_smul_smul_iff {u v : R} (hu : IsUnit u) (hv : IsUnit v) :
    LinearIndependent R ![u • x, v • y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h s t hst ↦ ?_, fun h s t hst ↦ ?_⟩
  · specialize h (s * hu.unit⁻¹) (t * hv.unit⁻¹)
    simp only [Units.mul_left_eq_zero] at h
    apply h
    simpa [← mul_smul, mul_assoc]
  · specialize h (s * hu.unit) (t * hv.unit)
    simp only [Units.mul_left_eq_zero] at h
    apply h
    simpa [mul_smul]

name: LinearIndependent.pair_smul_iff
statement:
lemma LinearIndependent.pair_smul_iff {u : S} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent R ![u • x, u • y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h s t hst ↦ ?_, fun h s t hst ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact h s t (by rw [← smul_comm u s, ← smul_comm u t, ← smul_add, hst, smul_zero])
  · specialize h (u • s) (u • t) (by rw [smul_assoc, smul_assoc, smul_comm u s, smul_comm u t, hst])
    exact ⟨(smul_eq_zero_iff_right hu).mp h.1, (smul_eq_zero_iff_right hu).mp h.2⟩

name: LinearIndependent.pair_add_smul_add_smul_iff_aux
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LinearIndependent.pair_iff] at h' ⊢
  intro s t hst
  specialize h' (a • s + c • t) (b • s + d • t) (by simp only [← hst, smul_add, add_smul,
    smul_assoc, smul_comm a s, smul_comm c t, smul_comm b s, smul_comm d t]; abel)
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h'
  constructor
  · suffices (a * d) • s = (b * c) • s by
      by_contra hs; exact h (_root_.smul_left_injective S hs ‹_›)
    calc (a * d) • s
        = d • a • s := by rw [mul_comm, mul_smul]
      _ = -(d • c • t) := by rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← smul_add, h₁, smul_zero]
      _ = (b * c) • s := ?_
    · rw [mul_comm, mul_smul, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, add_comm, smul_comm d c, ← smul_add, h₂,
        smul_zero]
  · suffices (a * d) • t = (b * c) • t by
      by_contra ht; exact h (_root_.smul_left_injective S ht ‹_›)
    calc (a * d) • t
        = a • d • t := by rw [mul_smul]
      _ = -(a • b • s) := by rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← smul_add, add_comm, h₂, smul_zero]
      _ = (b * c) • t := ?_
    · rw [mul_smul, neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, smul_comm a b, ← smul_add, h₁, smul_zero]

name: LinearIndependent.pair_add_smul_add_smul_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma LinearIndependent.pair_add_smul_add_smul_iff [Nontrivial R] :
    LinearIndependent R ![a • x + b • y, c • x + d • y] ↔
      LinearIndependent R ![x, y] ∧ a * d ≠ b * c
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (a * d) (b * c) with h | h
  · suffices ¬ LinearIndependent R ![a • x + b • y, c • x + d • y] by simpa [h]
    rw [pair_iff]
    push Not
    by_cases hbd : b = 0 ∧ d = 0
    · simp only [hbd.1, hbd.2, zero_smul, add_zero]
      by_cases hac : a = 0 ∧ c = 0; · exact ⟨1, 0, by simp [hac.1, hac.2], by simp⟩
      refine ⟨c • 1, -a • 1, ?_, by aesop⟩
      simp only [smul_assoc, one_smul, neg_smul]
      module
    refine ⟨d • 1, -b • 1, ?_, by contrapose! hbd; simp_all⟩
    simp only [smul_add, smul_assoc, one_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm d, h]
    module
  refine ⟨fun h' ↦ ⟨?_, h⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ pair_add_smul_add_smul_iff_aux _ _ _ _ h₂ h₁⟩
  suffices LinearIndependent R ![(a * d - b * c) • x, (a * d - b * c) • y] by
    rwa [pair_smul_iff (sub_ne_zero_of_ne h)] at this
  convert! pair_add_smul_add_smul_iff_aux d (-b) (-c) a (by simpa [mul_comm d a]) h' using 1
  module_nf

name: LinearIndependent.pair_add_smul_right_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma LinearIndependent.pair_add_smul_right_iff :
    LinearIndependent R ![x, c • x + y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial S with hS | hS; · simp [hS.elim c 0]
  nontriviality R
  simpa using pair_add_smul_add_smul_iff (x := x) (y := y) 1 0 c 1

name: LinearIndependent.pair_add_smul_left_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma LinearIndependent.pair_add_smul_left_iff :
    LinearIndependent R ![x + b • y, y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
proof:
:= by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial S with hS | hS; · simp [hS.elim b 0]
  nontriviality R
  simpa using pair_add_smul_add_smul_iff (x := x) (y := y) 1 b 0 1

name: LinearIndependent.pair_add_right_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma LinearIndependent.pair_add_right_iff :
    LinearIndependent R ![x, x + y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ x y : M, LinearIndependent R ![x, x + y] → LinearIndependent R ![x, y] from
    ⟨this x y, fun h ↦ by simpa using this (-x) (x + y) (by simpa)⟩
  simp only [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
  intro x y h s t h'
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h (s - t) t (by rw [sub_smul, smul_add, ← h']; abel)
  rw [h₂, sub_zero] at h₁
  tauto

name: LinearIndependent.pair_add_left_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma LinearIndependent.pair_add_left_iff :
    LinearIndependent R ![x + y, y] ↔ LinearIndependent R ![x, y]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pair_symm_iff, add_comm, pair_add_right_iff, pair_symm_iff]

name: linearIndepOn_id_iUnion_finite
statement:
theorem linearIndepOn_id_iUnion_finite {f : ι → Set M} (hl : ∀ i, LinearIndepOn R id (f i))
    (hd : ∀ i, ∀ t : Set ι, t.Finite → i ∉ t → Disjoint (span R (f i)) (⨆ i ∈ t, span R (f i))) :
    LinearIndepOn R id (⋃ i, f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [iUnion_eq_iUnion_finset f]
  apply linearIndepOn_iUnion_of_directed
  · apply directed_of_isDirected_le
    exact fun t₁ t₂ ht => iUnion_mono fun i => iUnion_subset_iUnion_const fun h => ht h
  intro t
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s his ih =>
    rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
    refine (hl _).id_union ih ?_
    rw [span_iUnion₂]
    exact hd i s s.finite_toSet his

name: linearIndependent_iUnion_finite
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_iUnion_finite {η : Type*} {ιs : η → Type*} {f : ∀ j : η, ιs j → M}
    (hindep : ∀ j, LinearIndependent R (f j))
    (hd : ∀ i, ∀ t : Set η,
      t.Finite → i ∉ t → Disjoint (span R (range (f i))) (⨆ i ∈ t, span R (range (f i)))) :
    LinearIndependent R fun ji : Σ j, ιs j => f ji.1 ji.2
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality R
  apply LinearIndependent.of_linearIndepOn_id_range
  · rintro ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ ⟨y₁, y₂⟩ hxy
    by_cases h_cases : x₁ = y₁
    · subst h_cases
      refine Sigma.eq rfl ?_
      rw [LinearIndependent.injective (hindep _) hxy]
    · have h0 : f x₁ x₂ = 0 := by
        apply
          disjoint_def.1 (hd x₁ {y₁} (finite_singleton y₁) fun h => h_cases (eq_of_mem_singleton h))
            (f x₁ x₂) (subset_span (mem_range_self _))
        rw [iSup_singleton]
        simp only at hxy
        rw [hxy]
        exact subset_span (mem_range_self y₂)
      exact False.elim ((hindep x₁).ne_zero _ h0)
  rw [range_sigma_eq_iUnion_range]
  apply linearIndepOn_id_iUnion_finite (fun j => (hindep j).linearIndepOn_id) hd

name: exists_maximal_linearIndepOn
statement:
theorem exists_maximal_linearIndepOn (v : ι → M) :
    ∃ s : Set ι, (LinearIndepOn R v s) ∧ ∀ i ∉ s, ∃ a : R, a ≠ 0 ∧ a • v i ∈ span R (v '' s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rcases exists_maximal_linearIndepOn' R v with ⟨I, hIlinind, hImaximal⟩
    use I, hIlinind
    intro i hi
    specialize hImaximal (I ∪ {i}) (by simp)
    set J := I ∪ {i} with hJ
    have memJ : ∀ {x}, x ∈ J ↔ x = i ∨ x ∈ I := by simp [hJ]
    have hiJ : i ∈ J := by simp [J]
    have h := by
      refine mt hImaximal ?_
      · intro h2
        rw [h2] at hi
        exact absurd hiJ hi
    obtain ⟨f, supp_f, sum_f, f_ne⟩ := linearDepOn_iff.mp h
    have hfi : f i ≠ 0 := by
      contrapose hIlinind
      refine linearDepOn_iff.mpr ⟨f, ?_, sum_f, f_ne⟩
      simp only [Finsupp.mem_supported, hJ] at supp_f ⊢
      rintro x hx
      refine (memJ.mp (supp_f hx)).resolve_left ?_
      rintro rfl
      exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hx) hIlinind
    use f i, hfi
    have hfi' : i ∈ f.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hfi
    rw [← Finset.insert_erase hfi', Finset.sum_insert (Finset.notMem_erase _ _),
      add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at sum_f
    rw [sum_f]
    refine neg_mem (sum_mem fun c hc => smul_mem _ _ (subset_span ⟨c, ?_, rfl⟩))
    exact (memJ.mp (supp_f (Finset.erase_subset _ _ hc))).resolve_left (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hc)

name: linearIndependent_algHom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[stacks 0CKM]
lemma linearIndependent_algHom_toLinearMap
    (K M L) [CommSemiring K] [Semiring M] [Algebra K M] [CommRing L] [IsDomain L] [Algebra K L] :
    LinearIndependent L (AlgHom.toLinearMap : (M →ₐ[K] L) → M →ₗ[K] L)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearIndependent.of_comp (LinearMap.ltoFun K M L L)
  exact (linearIndependent_monoidHom M L).comp
    (RingHom.toMonoidHom ∘ AlgHom.toRingHom)
    (fun _ _ e ↦ AlgHom.ext (DFunLike.congr_fun e :))

name: linearIndependent_algHom_toLinearMap'
statement:
lemma linearIndependent_algHom_toLinearMap' (K M L) [CommRing K] [IsDomain K]
    [Semiring M] [Algebra K M] [CommRing L] [IsDomain L] [Algebra K L] [IsTorsionFree K L] :
    LinearIndependent K (AlgHom.toLinearMap : (M →ₐ[K] L) → M →ₗ[K] L)

name: LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent
statement:
lemma LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    {f : M →ₗ[R] N} {ι : Type*} {v : ι → M}
    (hv : Submodule.span R (.range v) = ⊤) (hli : LinearIndependent R (f ∘ v)) :
    Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_
  have : x ∈ Submodule.span R (.range v) := by rw [hv]; exact mem_top
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp this
  simp only [map_finsuppSum, map_smul] at hx
  obtain rfl := linearIndependent_iff.mp hli c hx
  simp

name: LinearMap.bijective_of_linearIndependent_of_span_eq_top
statement:
lemma LinearMap.bijective_of_linearIndependent_of_span_eq_top {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R N] {f : M →ₗ[R] N} {ι : Type*} {v : ι → M} (hv : Submodule.span R (Set.range v) = ⊤)
    (hli : LinearIndependent R (f ∘ v)) (hsp : Submodule.span R (Set.range <| f ∘ v) = ⊤) :
    Function.Bijective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent hv hli, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.range_comp, ← Submodule.map_span, hv, Submodule.map_top] at hsp
  rwa [← range_eq_top]

name: LinearIndepOn.insert'
statement:
lemma LinearIndepOn.insert' {s : Set ι} {i : ι} (hs : LinearIndepOn R v s)
    (hx : ∀ r : R, r • v i ∈ Submodule.span R (v '' s) → r = 0) :
    LinearIndepOn R v (insert i s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.union_singleton]
  refine hs.union (.singleton' fun r hr ↦ hx _ <| by simp [hr]) ?_
  simp +contextual [disjoint_span_singleton'', hx]

name: LinearIndepOn.id_insert'
statement:
lemma LinearIndepOn.id_insert' {s : Set M} {x : M} (hs : LinearIndepOn R id s)
    (hx : ∀ r : R, r • x ∈ Submodule.span R s → r = 0) : LinearIndepOn R id (insert x s)

name: LinearIndependent.of_pairwise_dual_eq_zero_one
statement:
theorem LinearIndependent.of_pairwise_dual_eq_zero_one (v : ι → M) (f : ι → Dual R M)
    (h1 : Pairwise fun i j ↦ f i (v j) = 0)
    (h2 : ∀ i, (f i) (v i) = 1) :
    LinearIndependent R v
proof:
:= by
  refine linearIndependent_iff'.mpr fun s g hrel i hi ↦ ?_
  have aux (j : ι) (hjs : j ∈ s) (hji : j ≠ i) : g j * (f i) (v j) = 0 := by simp [h1 hji.symm]
  simpa [s.sum_eq_single i aux (by lia), h2 i] using congr_arg (f i) hrel

name: LinearIndependent.update
statement:
lemma LinearIndependent.update [DecidableEq ι] [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {f : ι → M} (hf : LinearIndependent R f) (i : ι) (m : M)
    (hg : ∃ r ∈ nonZeroDivisors R, ∃ l : ι →₀ R,
      l i ∈ nonZeroDivisors R ∧ r • m = linearCombination R f l) :
    LinearIndependent R (Function.update f i m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearIndependent_iff] at hf ⊢
  obtain ⟨r, hr, l, hl, hg⟩ := hg
  intros l' hl'
  apply_fun (r • ·) at hl'
  simp_rw [Pi.update_eq_sub_add_single, ← bilinearCombination_apply _ (S := R), map_add, map_sub,
    bilinearCombination_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    linearCombination_single_index, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_zero, smul_comm r (l' i) m,
    hg, ← LinearMap.map_smul, smul_smul, ← linearCombination_single, ← map_sub, ← map_add] at hl'
  replace hl' : ∀ j, (r * l' j - (single i (r * l' i)) j) + l' i * l j = 0 :=
    fun j ↦ DFunLike.congr_fun (hf _ hl') j
  grind [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff]

name: mem_span_insert_exchange
statement:
theorem mem_span_insert_exchange :
    x ∈ span K (insert y s) → x ∉ span K s → y ∈ span K (insert x s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_span_insert, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  rintro a z hz rfl h
  refine ⟨a⁻¹, -a⁻¹ • z, smul_mem _ _ hz, ?_⟩
  have a0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp_all
  match_scalars <;> simp [a0]

name: LinearIndepOn.insert
statement:
protected theorem LinearIndepOn.insert {s : Set ι} {x : ι} (hs : LinearIndepOn K v s)
    (hx : v x ∉ span K (v '' s)) : LinearIndepOn K v (insert x s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← union_singleton]
  have x0 : v x ≠ 0 := fun h => hx (h ▸ zero_mem _)
  apply hs.union (LinearIndepOn.singleton x0)
  rwa [image_singleton, disjoint_span_singleton' x0]

name: LinearIndepOn.id_insert
statement:
protected theorem LinearIndepOn.id_insert (hs : LinearIndepOn K id s) (hx : x ∉ span K s) :
    LinearIndepOn K id (insert x s)

name: linearIndependent_option'
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_option' :
    LinearIndependent K (fun o => Option.casesOn' o x v : Option ι → V) ↔
      LinearIndependent K v ∧ x ∉ Submodule.span K (range v)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [← linearIndependent_equiv (Equiv.optionEquivSumPUnit.{u'} ι).symm, linearIndependent_sum,
    @range_unique _ PUnit, @linearIndependent_unique_iff PUnit, disjoint_span_singleton]
  dsimp [(· ∘ ·)]
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1, fun hx => h.2.1 <| h.2.2 hx⟩, fun h => ⟨h.1, ?_, fun hx => (h.2 hx).elim⟩⟩
  rintro rfl
  exact h.2 (zero_mem _)

    (hx : x ∉ Submodule.span K (range v)) :
    LinearIndependent K (fun o => Option.casesOn' o x v : Option ι → V)

name: linearIndependent_option
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_option {v : Option ι → V} : LinearIndependent K v ↔
    LinearIndependent K (v ∘ (↑) : ι → V) ∧
      v none ∉ Submodule.span K (range (v ∘ (↑) : ι → V))

name: linearIndepOn_insert
statement:
theorem linearIndepOn_insert {s : Set ι} {a : ι} {f : ι → V} (has : a ∉ s) :
    LinearIndepOn K f (insert a s) ↔ LinearIndepOn K f s ∧ f a ∉ Submodule.span K (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [LinearIndepOn, LinearIndepOn, ← linearIndependent_equiv
    ((Equiv.optionEquivSumPUnit _).trans (Equiv.Set.insert has).symm), linearIndependent_option]
  simp only [comp_def]
  rw [range_comp']
  simp

name: linearIndepOn_id_insert
statement:
theorem linearIndepOn_id_insert (hxs : x ∉ s) :
    LinearIndepOn K id (insert x s) ↔ LinearIndepOn K id s ∧ x ∉ Submodule.span K s

name: linearIndepOn_insert_iff
statement:
theorem linearIndepOn_insert_iff {s : Set ι} {a : ι} {f : ι → V} :
    LinearIndepOn K f (insert a s) ↔ LinearIndepOn K f s ∧ (f a ∈ span K (f '' s) → a ∈ s)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases has : a ∈ s
  · simp [insert_eq_of_mem has, has]
  simp [linearIndepOn_insert has, has]

name: linearIndepOn_id_insert_iff
statement:
theorem linearIndepOn_id_insert_iff {a : V} {s : Set V} :
    LinearIndepOn K id (insert a s) ↔ LinearIndepOn K id s ∧ (a ∈ span K s → a ∈ s)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using linearIndepOn_insert_iff (a := a) (f := id)

name: LinearIndepOn.mem_span_iff
statement:
theorem LinearIndepOn.mem_span_iff {s : Set ι} {a : ι} {f : ι → V} (h : LinearIndepOn K f s) :
    f a ∈ Submodule.span K (f '' s) ↔ (LinearIndepOn K f (insert a s) → a ∈ s)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases has : a ∈ s
  · exact iff_of_true (subset_span <| mem_image_of_mem f has) fun _ ↦ has
  simp [linearIndepOn_insert_iff, h, has]

name: LinearIndepOn.notMem_span_iff
statement:
theorem LinearIndepOn.notMem_span_iff {s : Set ι} {a : ι} {f : ι → V} (h : LinearIndepOn K f s) :
    f a ∉ Submodule.span K (f '' s) ↔ LinearIndepOn K f (insert a s) ∧ a ∉ s

name: LinearIndepOn.mem_span_iff_id
statement:
theorem LinearIndepOn.mem_span_iff_id {s : Set V} {a : V} (h : LinearIndepOn K id s) :
    a ∈ Submodule.span K s ↔ (LinearIndepOn K id (insert a s) → a ∈ s)

name: LinearIndepOn.notMem_span_iff_id
statement:
theorem LinearIndepOn.notMem_span_iff_id {s : Set V} {a : V} (h : LinearIndepOn K id s) :
    a ∉ Submodule.span K s ↔ LinearIndepOn K id (insert a s) ∧ a ∉ s

name: linearIndepOn_id_pair
statement:
theorem linearIndepOn_id_pair {x y : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : ∀ a : K, a • x ≠ y) :
    LinearIndepOn K id {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  rw [pair_comm]; exact .id_insert (.singleton hx) <| by simpa [mem_span_singleton]

name: linearIndepOn_pair_iff
statement:
theorem linearIndepOn_pair_iff {i j : ι} (v : ι → V) (hij : i ≠ j) (hi : v i ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndepOn K v {i, j} ↔ ∀ (c : K), c • v i ≠ v j
proof:
:= by
  rw [pair_comm]
  convert! linearIndepOn_insert (s := { i }) (a := j) hij.symm
  simp [hi, mem_span_singleton]

name: LinearIndependent.pair_iff'
statement:
theorem LinearIndependent.pair_iff' {x y : V} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent K ![x, y] ↔ ∀ a : K, a • x ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← linearIndepOn_univ_iff, ← Finset.coe_univ, show @Finset.univ (Fin 2) _ = {0,1} from rfl,
    Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, linearIndepOn_pair_iff _ (by simp) (by simpa)]
  simp

name: linearIndependent_finCons
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_finCons {n} {v : Fin n → V} :
    LinearIndependent K (Fin.cons x v : Fin (n + 1) → V) ↔
      LinearIndependent K v ∧ x ∉ Submodule.span K (range v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← linearIndependent_equiv (finSuccEquiv n).symm, linearIndependent_option]
  rfl

lemma LinearIndependent.finSnoc {n} {v : Fin n → V} (hv : LinearIndependent K v)

name: LinearIndependent.finSnoc_of_not_mem_span_over
statement:
theorem LinearIndependent.finSnoc_of_not_mem_span_over
    {R : Type*} {K : Type*} {M : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [DivisionRing K] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Algebra R K] [Module K M] [Module R M] [IsScalarTower R K M] [FaithfulSMul R K]
    {n : ℕ} {v : Fin n → M} (hv : LinearIndependent R v) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∉ Submodule.span K (Set.range v)) :
    LinearIndependent R (Fin.snoc v x)
proof:
:= by
  apply hv.finSnoc' v x
  intro c y hcy heq
  by_contra hc
  apply hx
  have hc' : algebraMap R K c ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [ne_eq, FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_eq_zero_iff]
  rw [← algebraMap_smul K c x] at heq
  rw [(eq_inv_smul_iff₀ hc').mpr (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left heq), smul_neg]
  exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.span_subset_span R K _ hcy))

name: linearIndependent_finSucc
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_finSucc {n} {v : Fin (n + 1) → V} :
    LinearIndependent K v ↔
      LinearIndependent K (Fin.tail v) ∧ v 0 ∉ Submodule.span K (range <| Fin.tail v)

name: linearIndependent_finSucc'
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_finSucc' {n} {v : Fin (n + 1) → V} : LinearIndependent K v ↔
    LinearIndependent K (Fin.init v) ∧ v (Fin.last _) ∉ Submodule.span K (range <| Fin.init v)

name: linearIndependent_fin2
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_fin2 {f : Fin 2 → V} :
    LinearIndependent K f ↔ f 1 ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a : K, a • f 1 ≠ f 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearIndependent_finSucc, linearIndependent_unique_iff, range_unique, mem_span_singleton,
    not_exists, show Fin.tail f default = f 1 by rw [← Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]; rfl]

name: exists_linearIndepOn_extension
statement:
theorem exists_linearIndepOn_extension {s t : Set ι} (hs : LinearIndepOn K v s) (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    ∃ b ⊆ t, s ⊆ b ∧ v '' t ⊆ span K (v '' b) ∧ LinearIndepOn K v b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, sb, h⟩ := by
    refine zorn_subset_nonempty { b | b ⊆ t ∧ LinearIndepOn K v b} ?_ _ ⟨hst, hs⟩
    · refine fun c hc cc _c0 => ⟨⋃₀ c, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
      · exact sUnion_subset fun x xc => (hc xc).1
      · exact linearIndepOn_sUnion_of_directed cc.directedOn fun x xc => (hc xc).2
      · exact subset_sUnion_of_mem
  refine ⟨b, h.prop.1, sb, fun _ ⟨x, hx, hvx⟩ => by_contra fun hn ↦ hn ?_, h.prop.2⟩
  subst hvx
  exact subset_span <| mem_image_of_mem v <| h.mem_of_prop_insert
    ⟨insert_subset hx h.prop.1, h.prop.2.insert hn⟩

name: exists_linearIndepOn_id_extension
statement:
theorem exists_linearIndepOn_id_extension (hs : LinearIndepOn K id s) (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    ∃ b ⊆ t, s ⊆ b ∧ t ⊆ span K b ∧ LinearIndepOn K id b
proof:
:= by
  convert! exists_linearIndepOn_extension hs hst <;> simp

name: exists_linearIndependent
statement:
theorem exists_linearIndependent :
    ∃ b ⊆ t, span K b = span K t ∧ LinearIndependent K ((↑) : b → V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb₁, -, hb₂, hb₃⟩ :=
    exists_linearIndepOn_id_extension (linearIndependent_empty K V) (Set.empty_subset t)
  exact ⟨b, hb₁, (span_eq_of_le _ hb₂ (Submodule.span_mono hb₁)).symm, hb₃⟩

name: exists_linearIndependent'
statement:
lemma exists_linearIndependent' (v : ι → V) :
    ∃ (κ : Type u') (a : κ → ι), Injective a ∧
      Submodule.span K (Set.range (v ∘ a)) = Submodule.span K (Set.range v) ∧
      LinearIndependent K (v ∘ a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hsp, hli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent K (Set.range v)
  choose f hf using ht
  let s : Set ι := Set.range (fun a : t ↦ f a.property)
  have hs {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) : v i ∈ t := by obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hi; simp [hf]
  let f' (a : s) : t := ⟨v a.val, hs a.property⟩
  refine ⟨s, Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective, hsp.symm ▸ by congr; aesop, ?_⟩
  · rw [← show Subtype.val ∘ f' = v ∘ Subtype.val by ext; simp [f']]
    apply hli.comp
    rintro ⟨i, x, rfl⟩ ⟨j, y, rfl⟩ hij
    simp only [Subtype.ext_iff, hf, f'] at hij
    simp [hij]

statement: theorem LinearIndepOn.extend_subset (hs : LinearIndepOn K v s) (hst : s ⊆ t) : hs.extend hst ⊆ t

statement:
theorem LinearIndepOn.linearIndepOn_extend (hs : LinearIndepOn K v s) (hst : s ⊆ t) :
