name: exists_rank_normal_form
statement:
theorem exists_rank_normal_form [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (M : Matrix m m R) :
    ∃ (V U : Matrix m m R) (e : m ≃ Fin M.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card m - M.rank)),
      IsUnit V ∧ IsUnit U ∧
      V * M * U = (fromBlocks 1 0 0 0).submatrix e e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨L, L', D, hM0⟩ := Matrix.Pivot.exists_list_transvec_mul_diagonal_mul_list_transvec M
  set E := fun i ↦ if D i = 0 then 1 else (D i)⁻¹ with E_def
  set s : Finset m := .filter (fun i ↦ D i ≠ 0) .univ with s_def
  set V := diagonal E * (L.reverse.map (toMatrix ∘ .inv)).prod with V_def
  set U := (L'.reverse.map (toMatrix ∘ .inv)).prod with U_def
  have hUdet : IsUnit U.det := (isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).1 <| isUnit_prod_comp_inverse _
  have hVdet : IsUnit V.det := by
    rw [V_def, det_mul, det_diagonal]
    exact IsUnit.mk0 _ (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 (by grind)) |>.mul <|
      (isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).1 (isUnit_prod_comp_inverse _)
  have hM : V * M * U = diagonal (fun i ↦ if i ∈ s then 1 else 0) := by
    rw [V_def, U_def, hM0, mul_assoc, mul_assoc _ (L'.map _).prod, prod_mul_reverse_inv_prod,
      mul_one, ← mul_assoc, mul_assoc _ (L.reverse.map _).prod, reverse_inv_prod_mul_prod, mul_one]
    ext
    simp only [E_def, mul_diagonal, diagonal_apply, ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, s_def,
      Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, ite_not]
    split_ifs with h1 h2 <;> first | rw [← h1, h2] | rw [← h1, inv_mul_cancel₀ h2] | rfl
  have hs : s.card = M.rank := by
    simp [← rank_mul_eq_right_of_isUnit_det V M hVdet, ← rank_mul_eq_left_of_isUnit_det U (V * M)
      hUdet, hM, rank_diagonal]
  set e : m ≃ Fin M.rank ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card m - M.rank) :=
    (Equiv.sumCompl (· ∈ s)).symm.trans <| (Finset.equivFinOfCardEq hs).sumCongr <|
      Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq <| by rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_coe, hs] with he
  refine ⟨V, U, e, (isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).2 hVdet, isUnit_prod_comp_inverse _, ?_⟩
  rw [hM, ← diagonal_one, ← diagonal_zero, fromBlocks_diagonal, submatrix_diagonal_equiv]
  refine congrArg _ (funext fun i ↦ ?_)
  split_ifs with hi <;> simp [he, hi]

name: cRank_diagonal
statement:
theorem cRank_diagonal [DecidableEq m] (w : m → R) :
    (diagonal w).cRank = lift.{uR} #{i // (w i) ≠ 0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set w' : {i // (w i) ≠ 0} → _ := fun i ↦ (diagonal w) i
  have h : LinearIndependent R w' := by
    have hli' := Pi.linearIndependent_single_of_ne_zero (R := R)
      (v := fun i : m ↦ if w i = 0 then (1 : R) else w i) (by simp [ite_eq_iff'])
    convert! hli'.comp Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective
    ext ⟨j, hj⟩ k
    simp [w', diagonal, hj, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  have hrw : insert 0 (range (diagonal w).col) = insert 0 (range w') := by
    suffices ∀ a, diagonal w a = 0 ∨ ∃ b, w b ≠ 0 ∧ diagonal w b = diagonal w a
      by aesop (add simp [col_eq_transpose, subset_def])
    simp_rw [or_iff_not_imp_right, not_exists, not_and, not_imp_not]
    simp +contextual [funext_iff, diagonal]
  rw [cRank, ← span_insert_zero, hrw, span_insert_zero, rank_span h,
    ← lift_umax, ← Cardinal.mk_range_eq_of_injective h.injective, lift_id']

proof:

  refine add_left_injective (finrank R (LinearMap.ker (mulVecLin A))) ?_
  dsimp only
  trans finrank R { x // x ∈ LinearMap.range (mulVecLin (Aᴴ * A)) } +
    finrank R { x // x ∈ LinearMap.ker (mulVecLin (Aᴴ * A)) }

    finrank R { x // x ∈ LinearMap.ker (mulVecLin (Aᵀ * A)) }

name: rank_add_rank_le_card_of_mul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma rank_add_rank_le_card_of_mul_eq_zero [Field R] [Finite l] [Fintype m]
    {A : Matrix l m R} {B : Matrix m n R} (hAB : A * B = 0) :
    A.rank + B.rank ≤ Fintype.card m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let el : Basis l R (l → R) := Pi.basisFun R l
  let em : Basis m R (m → R) := Pi.basisFun R m
  let en : Basis n R (n → R) := Pi.basisFun R n
  rw [Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin A el em,
      Matrix.rank_eq_finrank_range_toLin B em en,
      ← Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card R,
      ← LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (Matrix.toLin em el A),
      add_le_add_iff_left]
  apply Submodule.finrank_mono
  rw [LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff, ← Matrix.toLin_mul, hAB, map_zero]

name: Matrix.rank_vecMulVec.

theorem Matrix.rank_vecMulVec.{u} {K m n : Type u} [CommRing K] [Fintype n]

name: add_mul_mul_invOf_mul_eq_one
statement:
lemma add_mul_mul_invOf_mul_eq_one :
    (A + U*C*V)*(⅟A - ⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (A + U*C*V)*(⅟A - ⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A)
    _ = A*⅟A - A*⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A + U*C*V*⅟A - U*C*V*⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A := by
      simp_rw [add_sub_assoc, add_mul, mul_sub, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 + U*C*V*⅟A) - (U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A + U*C*V*⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A) := by
      rw [mul_invOf_self, Matrix.one_mul]
      abel
    _ = 1 + U*C*V*⅟A - (U + U*C*V*⅟A*U)*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A := by
      rw [sub_right_inj, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.add_mul]
    _ = 1 + U*C*V*⅟A - U*C*(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A := by
      congr
      simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_invOf_cancel_right, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_invOf_cancel_right]
      abel

name: add_mul_mul_invOf_mul_eq_one'
statement:
lemma add_mul_mul_invOf_mul_eq_one' :
    (⅟A - ⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A)*(A + U*C*V) = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (⅟A - ⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A)*(A + U*C*V)
    _ = ⅟A*A - ⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A*A + ⅟A*U*C*V - ⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A*U*C*V := by
      simp_rw [add_sub_assoc, _root_.mul_add, _root_.sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (1 + ⅟A*U*C*V) - (⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V + ⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*V*⅟A*U*C*V) := by
      rw [invOf_mul_self, Matrix.invOf_mul_cancel_right]
      abel
    _ = 1 + ⅟A*U*C*V - ⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*(V + V*⅟A*U*C*V) := by
      rw [sub_right_inj, Matrix.mul_add]
      simp_rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 + ⅟A*U*C*V - ⅟A*U*⅟(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*(⅟C + V*⅟A*U)*C*V := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.invOf_mul_cancel_right]
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.invOf_mul_cancel_right]
      abel

name: invOf_add_mul_mul
statement:
theorem invOf_add_mul_mul [Invertible (A + U * C * V)] :
    ⅟(A + U * C * V) = ⅟A - ⅟A * U * ⅟(⅟C + V * ⅟A * U) * V * ⅟A
proof:
:= by
  let := invertibleAddMulMul A U C V
  convert! (rfl : ⅟(A + U * C * V) = _)

name: add_mul_mul_mul_invOf_eq_one
statement:
lemma add_mul_mul_mul_invOf_eq_one :
    (A + U * C * V) * (⅟A - ⅟A * U * C * ⅟(C + C * V * ⅟A * U * C) * C * V * ⅟A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.add_mul, mul_invOf_self']
  rw [add_sub_assoc, add_eq_left, sub_eq_zero]
  simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_invOf_self', Matrix.one_mul]
  simp only [← Matrix.add_mul]
  congr
  rw [← Matrix.mul_right_eq_iff_eq_mul_invOf]
  simp only [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: add_mul_mul_mul_invOf_eq_one'
statement:
lemma add_mul_mul_mul_invOf_eq_one' :
    (⅟A - ⅟A * U * C * ⅟(C + C * V * ⅟A * U * C) * C * V * ⅟A) * (A + U * C * V) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.sub_mul, invOf_mul_self']
  rw [sub_add, sub_eq_self, sub_eq_zero]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_sub]
  congr
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← Matrix.mul_add]
  rw [Matrix.invOf_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul_left]
  simp only [Matrix.add_mul, invOf_mul_self', Matrix.mul_one, add_right_inj]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: invOf_add_mul_mul'
statement:
theorem invOf_add_mul_mul' [Invertible (A + U * C * V)] :
    ⅟(A + U * C * V) = ⅟A - ⅟A * U * C * ⅟(C + C * V * ⅟A * U * C) * C * V * ⅟A
proof:
:= by
  let := invertibleAddMulMul' A U C V
  convert! (rfl : ⅟(A + U * C * V) = _)

name: inv_pow'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_pow' (A : M) (n : ℕ) : A⁻¹ ^ n = (A ^ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ A, mul_inv_rev, ← ih, ← pow_succ']

name: pow_sub'
statement:
theorem pow_sub' (A : M) {m n : ℕ} (ha : IsUnit A.det) (h : n ≤ m) :
    A ^ (m - n) = A ^ m * (A ^ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le h, pow_add, Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_nonsing_inv,
    tsub_add_cancel_of_le h, Matrix.mul_one]
  simpa using ha.pow n

name: pow_inv_comm'
statement: theorem pow_inv_comm' (A : M) (m n : ℕ) : A⁻¹ ^ m * A ^ n = A ^ n * A⁻¹ ^ m
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n IH =>
    rcases m with m | m
    · simp
    rcases nonsing_inv_cancel_or_zero A with ⟨h, h'⟩ | h
    · calc
        A⁻¹ ^ (m + 1) * A ^ (n + 1) = A⁻¹ ^ m * (A⁻¹ * A) * A ^ n := by
          simp only [pow_succ A⁻¹, pow_succ' A, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = A ^ n * A⁻¹ ^ m := by simp only [h, Matrix.mul_one, IH m]
        _ = A ^ n * (A * A⁻¹) * A⁻¹ ^ m := by simp only [h', Matrix.mul_one]
        _ = A ^ (n + 1) * A⁻¹ ^ (m + 1) := by
          simp only [pow_succ A, pow_succ' A⁻¹, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    · simp [h]

name: _root_.IsUnit.det_zpow
statement: theorem _root_.IsUnit.det_zpow {A : M} (h : IsUnit A.det) (n : ℤ) : IsUnit (A ^ n).det
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with n | n
  · simpa using h.pow n
  · simpa using h.pow n.succ

name: isUnit_det_zpow_iff
statement: theorem isUnit_det_zpow_iff {A : M} {z : ℤ} : IsUnit (A ^ z).det ↔ IsUnit A.det ∨ z = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction z with
  | zero => simp
  | succ z =>
    rw [← Int.natCast_succ, zpow_natCast, det_pow, isUnit_pow_succ_iff, ← Int.ofNat_zero,
      Int.ofNat_inj]
    simp
  | pred z =>
    rw [← neg_add', ← Int.natCast_succ, zpow_neg_natCast, isUnit_nonsing_inv_det_iff, det_pow,
      isUnit_pow_succ_iff, neg_eq_zero, ← Int.ofNat_zero, Int.ofNat_inj]
    simp

theorem zpow_neg {A : M} (h : IsUnit A.det) : ∀ n : ℤ, A ^ (-n) = (A ^ n)⁻¹

  | -[n+1] => by
    rw [zpow_negSucc, neg_negSucc, zpow_natCast, nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv]
    rw [det_pow]
    exact h.pow _

statement: theorem inv_zpow' {A : M} (h : IsUnit A.det) (n : ℤ) : A⁻¹ ^ n = A ^ (-n)

name: zpow_add_one
statement:
theorem zpow_add_one {A : M} (h : IsUnit A.det) : ∀ n : ℤ, A ^ (n + 1) = A ^ n * A
  | (n : ℕ) => by simp only [← Nat.cast_succ, pow_succ, zpow_natCast]
  | -[n+1] =>
    calc
      A ^ (-(n + 1) + 1 : ℤ) = (A ^ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
        rw [neg_add, neg_add_cancel_right, zpow_neg h, zpow_natCast]
      _ = (A * A ^ n)⁻¹ * A := by
        rw [mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_assoc, nonsing_inv_mul _ h, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = A ^ (-(n + 1 : ℤ)) * A := by
        rw [zpow_neg h, ← Int.natCast_succ, zpow_natCast, pow_succ']

name: zpow_sub_one
statement: theorem zpow_sub_one {A : M} (h : IsUnit A.det) (n : ℤ) : A ^ (n - 1) = A ^ n * A⁻¹
proof:
:=
  calc
    A ^ (n - 1) = A ^ (n - 1) * A * A⁻¹ := by
      rw [mul_assoc, mul_nonsing_inv _ h, mul_one]
    _ = A ^ n * A⁻¹ := by rw [← zpow_add_one h, sub_add_cancel]

name: zpow_add
statement: theorem zpow_add {A : M} (ha : IsUnit A.det) (m n : ℤ) : A ^ (m + n) = A ^ m * A ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ihn => simp only [← add_assoc, zpow_add_one ha, ihn, mul_assoc]
  | pred n ihn => rw [zpow_sub_one ha, ← mul_assoc, ← ihn, ← zpow_sub_one ha, add_sub_assoc]

name: zpow_add_of_nonpos
statement:
theorem zpow_add_of_nonpos {A : M} {m n : ℤ} (hm : m ≤ 0) (hn : n ≤ 0) :
    A ^ (m + n) = A ^ m * A ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases nonsing_inv_cancel_or_zero A with (⟨h, _⟩ | h)
  · exact zpow_add (isUnit_det_of_left_inverse h) m n
  · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_neg_ofNat hm
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_neg_ofNat hn
    simp_rw [← neg_add, ← Int.natCast_add, zpow_neg_natCast, ← inv_pow', h, pow_add]

name: zpow_add_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem zpow_add_of_nonneg {A : M} {m n : ℤ} (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hn : 0 ≤ n) :
    A ^ (m + n) = A ^ m * A ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hm
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hn
  rw [← Int.natCast_add, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, pow_add]

name: zpow_one_add
statement: theorem zpow_one_add {A : M} (h : IsUnit A.det) (i : ℤ) : A ^ (1 + i) = A * A ^ i

name: SemiconjBy.zpow_right
statement:
theorem SemiconjBy.zpow_right {A X Y : M} (hx : IsUnit X.det) (hy : IsUnit Y.det)
    (h : SemiconjBy A X Y) : ∀ m : ℤ, SemiconjBy A (X ^ m) (Y ^ m)
  | (n : ℕ) => by simp [h.pow_right n]
  | -[n+1] => by
    have hx' : IsUnit (X ^ n.succ).det
proof:
:= by
      rw [det_pow]
      exact hx.pow n.succ
    have hy' : IsUnit (Y ^ n.succ).det := by
      rw [det_pow]
      exact hy.pow n.succ
    rw [zpow_negSucc, zpow_negSucc, nonsing_inv_apply _ hx', nonsing_inv_apply _ hy', SemiconjBy]
    refine (isRegular_of_isLeftRegular_det hy'.isRegular.left).left ?_
    dsimp only
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← (h.pow_right n.succ).eq, mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_smul,
      mul_adjugate, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_smul (Y ^ _) (↑hy'.unit⁻¹ : R),
      mul_adjugate, smul_smul, smul_smul, hx'.val_inv_mul,
      hy'.val_inv_mul, one_smul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul]

name: Commute.zpow_right
statement: theorem Commute.zpow_right {A B : M} (h : Commute A B) (m : ℤ) : Commute A (B ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  rcases nonsing_inv_cancel_or_zero B with (⟨hB, _⟩ | hB)
  · refine SemiconjBy.zpow_right ?_ ?_ h _ <;> exact isUnit_det_of_left_inverse hB
  · cases m
    · simpa using h.pow_right _
    · simp [← inv_pow', hB]

statement:
theorem zpow_add_one_of_ne_neg_one {A : M} : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ -1 → A ^ (n + 1) = A ^ n * A
  | (n : ℕ), _ => by simp only [pow_succ, ← Nat.cast_succ, zpow_natCast]
  | -1, h => absurd rfl h
  | -((n : ℕ) + 2), _ => by
    rcases nonsing_inv_cancel_or_zero A with (⟨h, _⟩ | h)
    · apply zpow_add_one (isUnit_det_of_left_inverse h)
    · change A ^ (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) = A ^ (-((n + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)) * A
      simp_rw [zpow_neg_natCast, ← inv_pow', h, zero_pow <| Nat.succ_ne_zero _, zero_mul]

name: zpow_mul
statement:
theorem zpow_mul (A : M) (h : IsUnit A.det) : ∀ m n : ℤ, A ^ (m * n) = (A ^ m) ^ n
  | (m : ℕ), (n : ℕ) => by
    rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, ← pow_mul, ← zpow_natCast, Int.natCast_mul]
  | (m : ℕ), -[n+1] => by
    rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_negSucc, ← pow_mul, ofNat_mul_negSucc, zpow_neg_natCast]
  | -[m+1], (n : ℕ) => by
    rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_negSucc, ← inv_pow', ← pow_mul, negSucc_mul_ofNat, zpow_neg_natCast,
        inv_pow']
  | -[m+1], -[n+1] => by
    rw [zpow_negSucc, zpow_negSucc, negSucc_mul_negSucc, ← Int.natCast_mul, zpow_natCast, inv_pow',
      ← pow_mul, nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv]
    rw [det_pow]
    exact h.pow _

name: fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₁₁ (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix l m α)
    (D : Matrix l n α) [Invertible A] :
    fromBlocks A B C D =
      fromBlocks 1 0 (C * ⅟A) 1 * fromBlocks A 0 0 (D - C * ⅟A * B) *
        fromBlocks 1 (⅟A * B) 0 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fromBlocks_multiply, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add,
    Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, invOf_mul_self, Matrix.mul_invOf_cancel_left,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, add_sub_cancel]

name: fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₂₂ (A : Matrix l m α) (B : Matrix l n α) (C : Matrix n m α)
    (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible D] :
    fromBlocks A B C D =
      fromBlocks 1 (B * ⅟D) 0 1 * fromBlocks (A - B * ⅟D * C) 0 0 D *
        fromBlocks 1 0 (⅟D * C) 1
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.reindex (Equiv.sumComm _ _) (Equiv.sumComm _ _)).injective <| by
    simpa [reindex_apply, Equiv.sumComm_symm, ← submatrix_mul_equiv _ _ _ (Equiv.sumComm n m), ←
      submatrix_mul_equiv _ _ _ (Equiv.sumComm n l), Equiv.sumComm_apply,
      fromBlocks_submatrix_sum_swap_sum_swap] using fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₁₁ D C B A

name: invOf_fromBlocks_zero
statement:
theorem invOf_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_eq (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (D : Matrix n n α)
    [Invertible A] [Invertible D] [Invertible (fromBlocks A B 0 D)] :
    ⅟(fromBlocks A B 0 D) = fromBlocks (⅟A) (-(⅟A * B * ⅟D)) 0 (⅟D)
proof:
:= by
  let := fromBlocksZero₂₁Invertible A B D
  convert! (rfl : ⅟(fromBlocks A B 0 D) = _)

name: invOf_fromBlocks_zero
statement:
theorem invOf_fromBlocks_zero₁₂_eq (A : Matrix m m α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α)

    ⅟(fromBlocks A 0 C D) = fromBlocks (⅟A) 0 (-(⅟D * C * ⅟A)) (⅟D)
proof:
:= by
  let := fromBlocksZero₁₂Invertible A C D
  convert! (rfl : ⅟(fromBlocks A 0 C D) = _)

name: isUnit_fromBlocks_zero
statement:

theorem isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁ {A : Matrix m m α} {B : Matrix m n α} {D : Matrix n n α} :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₁₂ {A : Matrix m m α} {C : Matrix n m α} {D : Matrix n n α} :

name: inv_fromBlocks_zero
statement:
theorem inv_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_of_isUnit_iff (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (D : Matrix n n α)
    (hAD : IsUnit A ↔ IsUnit D) :
    (fromBlocks A B 0 D)⁻¹ = fromBlocks A⁻¹ (-(A⁻¹ * B * D⁻¹)) 0 D⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : IsUnit A
  · have hD := hAD.mp hA
    cases hA.nonempty_invertible
    cases hD.nonempty_invertible
    let := fromBlocksZero₂₁Invertible A B D
    simp_rw [← invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, invOf_fromBlocks_zero₂₁_eq]
  · have hD := hAD.not.mp hA
    have : ¬IsUnit (fromBlocks A B 0 D) :=
      isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₂₁.not.mpr (not_and'.mpr fun _ => hA)
    simp_rw [nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse, Ring.inverse_non_unit _ hA, Ring.inverse_non_unit _ hD,
      Ring.inverse_non_unit _ this, Matrix.zero_mul, neg_zero, fromBlocks_zero]

name: inv_fromBlocks_zero
statement:
theorem inv_fromBlocks_zero₁₂_of_isUnit_iff (A : Matrix m m α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α)
    (hAD : IsUnit A ↔ IsUnit D) :
    (fromBlocks A 0 C D)⁻¹ = fromBlocks A⁻¹ 0 (-(D⁻¹ * C * A⁻¹)) D⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : IsUnit A
  · have hD := hAD.mp hA
    cases hA.nonempty_invertible
    cases hD.nonempty_invertible
    let := fromBlocksZero₁₂Invertible A C D
    simp_rw [← invOf_eq_nonsing_inv, invOf_fromBlocks_zero₁₂_eq]
  · have hD := hAD.not.mp hA
    have : ¬IsUnit (fromBlocks A 0 C D) :=
      isUnit_fromBlocks_zero₁₂.not.mpr (not_and'.mpr fun _ => hA)
    simp_rw [nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse, Ring.inverse_non_unit _ hA, Ring.inverse_non_unit _ hD,
      Ring.inverse_non_unit _ this, Matrix.zero_mul, neg_zero, fromBlocks_zero]

name: invOf_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem invOf_fromBlocks₂₂_eq (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α)
    (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible D] [Invertible (A - B * ⅟D * C)]
    [Invertible (fromBlocks A B C D)] :
    ⅟(fromBlocks A B C D) =
      fromBlocks (⅟(A - B * ⅟D * C)) (-(⅟(A - B * ⅟D * C) * B * ⅟D))
        (-(⅟D * C * ⅟(A - B * ⅟D * C))) (⅟D + ⅟D * C * ⅟(A - B * ⅟D * C) * B * ⅟D)
proof:
:= by
  let := fromBlocks₂₂Invertible A B C D
  convert! (rfl : ⅟(fromBlocks A B C D) = _)

name: invOf_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem invOf_fromBlocks₁₁_eq (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α)
    (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] [Invertible (D - C * ⅟A * B)]
    [Invertible (fromBlocks A B C D)] :
    ⅟(fromBlocks A B C D) =
      fromBlocks (⅟A + ⅟A * B * ⅟(D - C * ⅟A * B) * C * ⅟A) (-(⅟A * B * ⅟(D - C * ⅟A * B)))
        (-(⅟(D - C * ⅟A * B) * C * ⅟A)) (⅟(D - C * ⅟A * B))
proof:
:= by
  let := fromBlocks₁₁Invertible A B C D
  convert! (rfl : ⅟(fromBlocks A B C D) = _)

name: det_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem det_fromBlocks₁₁ (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α)
    (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible A] :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).det = det A * det (D - C * ⅟A * B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fromBlocks_eq_of_invertible₁₁ (A := A), det_mul, det_mul, det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁,
    det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, det_one, det_one, one_mul, one_mul, mul_one]

name: det_fromBlocks_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_fromBlocks_one₁₁ (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) (D : Matrix n n α) :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks 1 B C D).det = det (D - C * B)
proof:
:= by
  have : Invertible (1 : Matrix m m α) := invertibleOne
  rw [det_fromBlocks₁₁, invOf_one, Matrix.mul_one, det_one, one_mul]

name: det_fromBlocks
statement:
theorem det_fromBlocks₂₂ (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α)
    (D : Matrix n n α) [Invertible D] :
    (Matrix.fromBlocks A B C D).det = det D * det (A - B * ⅟D * C)
proof:
:= by
  have : fromBlocks A B C D =
      (fromBlocks D C B A).submatrix (Equiv.sumComm _ _) (Equiv.sumComm _ _) := by
    ext (i j)
    cases i <;> cases j <;> rfl
  rw [this, det_submatrix_equiv_self, det_fromBlocks₁₁]

name: det_fromBlocks_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem det_fromBlocks_one₂₂ (A : Matrix m m α) (B : Matrix m n α) (C : Matrix n m α) :

proof:
:= by
  have : Invertible (1 : Matrix n n α) := invertibleOne
  rw [det_fromBlocks₂₂, invOf_one, Matrix.mul_one, det_one, one_mul]

name: det_one_add_mul_comm
statement:
theorem det_one_add_mul_comm (A : Matrix m n α) (B : Matrix n m α) :
    det (1 + A * B) = det (1 + B * A)
proof:
:=
  calc
    det (1 + A * B) = det (fromBlocks 1 (-A) B 1) := by
      rw [det_fromBlocks_one₂₂, Matrix.neg_mul, sub_neg_eq_add]
    _ = det (1 + B * A) := by rw [det_fromBlocks_one₁₁, Matrix.mul_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]

name: det_one_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow
statement:
theorem det_one_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow {ι : Type*} [Unique ι] (u v : m → α) :
    det (1 + replicateCol ι u * replicateRow ι v) = 1 + v ⬝ᵥ u
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_one_add_mul_comm, det_unique, Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq,
    Matrix.replicateRow_mul_replicateCol_apply]

name: det_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow
statement:
theorem det_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow {ι : Type*} [Unique ι]
    {A : Matrix m m α} (hA : IsUnit A.det) (u v : m → α) :
    (A + replicateCol ι u * replicateRow ι v).det =
    A.det * (1 + replicateRow ι v * A⁻¹ * replicateCol ι u).det
proof:
:= by
  nth_rewrite 1 [← Matrix.mul_one A]
  rwa [← Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv_cancel_left A (replicateCol ι u * replicateRow ι v),
    ← Matrix.mul_add, det_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, det_one_add_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: det_add_mul
statement:
theorem det_add_mul {A : Matrix m m α} (U : Matrix m n α)
    (V : Matrix n m α) (hA : IsUnit A.det) :
    (A + U * V).det = A.det * (1 + V * A⁻¹ * U).det
proof:
:= by
  nth_rewrite 1 [← Matrix.mul_one A]
  rwa [← Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv_cancel_left A (U * V), ← Matrix.mul_add,
    det_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, det_one_add_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: Matrix.toLin_apply
statement:
theorem Matrix.toLin_apply [Fintype m] (M : Matrix m n R) (v : M₁) :
    Matrix.toLin v₁ v₂ M v = ∑ j, (M *ᵥ v₁.repr v) j • v₂ j
proof:
:=
  show v₂.equivFun.symm (Matrix.toLin' M (v₁.repr v)) = _ by

name: Matrix.toLin_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Matrix.toLin_self [Fintype m] (M : Matrix m n R) (i : n) :
    Matrix.toLin v₁ v₂ M (v₁ i) = ∑ j, M j i • v₂ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.toLin_apply, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _hj ↦ ?_]
  rw [Basis.repr_self, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.sum_eq_single i, Finsupp.single_eq_same,
    mul_one]
  · intro i' _ i'_ne
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne i'_ne, mul_zero]
  · intros
    have := Finset.mem_univ i
    contradiction

name: Matrix.toLin_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem Matrix.toLin_apply_eq_zero_iff {R M₁ M₂ : Type*} [Finite m] [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module R M₁] [Module R M₂]
    {v₁ : Basis n R M₁} {v₂ : Basis m R M₂} {A : Matrix m n R} {x : M₁} :
    A.toLin v₁ v₂ x = 0 ↔ ∀ j, (A *ᵥ v₁.repr x) j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite m
  rw [toLin_apply]
  exact ⟨Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp v₂.linearIndependent _, fun h ↦ by simp [h]⟩

name: lie_end_of_apply_eq_smul
statement:
lemma lie_end_of_apply_eq_smul {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (b : Basis ι R M) (a : ι → R) (s : Module.End R M)
    (hs : ∀ k, s (b k) = a k • b k) (i j : ι) :
    ⁅s, b.end (i, j)⁆ = (a i - a j) • b.end (i, j)
proof:
:= by
  refine b.ext fun k ↦ ?_
  simp only [Ring.lie_def, LinearMap.sub_apply, End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    Basis.end_apply_apply, smul_ite, smul_zero, sub_smul]
  rcases eq_or_ne j k with rfl | hjk
  · simp [hs, Basis.end_apply_apply]
  · simp [hs, Basis.end_apply_apply, hjk]

name: isStablyFiniteRing_iff_injective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isStablyFiniteRing_iff_injective_of_surjective :
    IsStablyFiniteRing A ↔ ∀ n (f : Module.End A (Fin n → A)), Surjective f → Injective f
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isStablyFiniteRing_iff_isDedekindFiniteMonoid_moduleEnd, isDedekindFiniteMonoid_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h n f surj ↦ ?_, fun h n f g eq ↦ ?_⟩
  · have ⟨g, eq⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property _ .id surj
    exact injective_of_comp_eq_id _ _ (h _ eq)
  · have surj := surjective_of_comp_eq_id _ _ eq
    have := (LinearEquiv.ofBijective f ⟨h _ _ surj, surj⟩).symm_comp
    rwa [← left_inv_eq_right_inv this eq]

name: single_mem_jacobson_matrix
statement:
theorem single_mem_jacobson_matrix (I : Ideal R) :
    ∀ x ∈ I.jacobson, ∀ (i j : n), single i j x ∈ (I.matrix n).jacobson
proof:
:= by
  
  
  simp_rw [Ideal.mem_jacobson_iff]
  intro x xIJ p q M
  have ⟨z, zMx⟩ := xIJ (M q p)
  let N : Matrix n n R := 1 - ∑ i, single i q (if i = q then 1 - z else (M i p) * x * z)
  use N
  intro i j
  obtain rfl | qj := eq_or_ne q j
  · by_cases iq : i = q
    · simp [iq, N, zMx, single, mul_apply, sum_apply, ite_and, sub_mul]
    · convert! I.mul_mem_left (-M i p * x) zMx
      simp [iq, N, single, mul_apply, sum_apply, ite_and, sub_mul]
      simp [sub_add, mul_add, mul_sub, mul_assoc]
  · simp [N, qj, sum_apply, mul_apply]

name: matrix_jacobson_le

    I.jacobson.matrix n ≤ (I.matrix n).jacobson
proof:
:= by
  intro M MI
  rw [matrix_eq_sum_single M]
  apply sum_mem
  intro i _
  apply sum_mem
  intro j _
  apply single_mem_jacobson_matrix I _ (MI i j)

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using h i j, fun h i' j' ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain hi | rfl := ne_or_eq i i'
  · simpa [hi] using c.refl 0
  obtain hj | rfl := ne_or_eq j j'
  · simpa [hj] using c.refl _
  simpa using h

name: jacobson_matrix_le
statement:
private lemma jacobson_matrix_le (I : TwoSidedIdeal R) :
    (I.matrix n).jacobson ≤ I.jacobson.matrix n
proof:
:= by
  
  
  intro M Mmem p q
  simp only [zero_apply, ← mem_iff]
  rw [mem_jacobson_iff]
  replace Mmem := mul_mem_right _ _ (single q p 1) Mmem
  rw [mem_jacobson_iff] at Mmem
  intro y
  specialize Mmem (y • single p p 1)
  have ⟨N, NxMI⟩ := Mmem
  use N p p
  simpa [mul_apply, single, ite_and] using! NxMI p p

  · change asIdeal (I.matrix n).jacobson ≥ asIdeal (I.jacobson.matrix n)

:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb h
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_rowStochastic_iff_sum] at hx hy ⊢
  simp [add_nonneg, ha, hb, mul_nonneg, hx, hy, sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, h]

name: permMatrix_mem_rowStochastic
statement:
@[simp, grind ←]
lemma permMatrix_mem_rowStochastic {σ : Equiv.Perm n} :
    σ.permMatrix R ∈ rowStochastic R n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_rowStochastic_iff_sum]
  refine ⟨fun i j => ?g1, ?g2⟩
  case g1 => aesop
  case g2 => simp [Equiv.toPEquiv_apply]

name: mem_colStochastic
statement:
lemma mem_colStochastic :
    M ∈ colStochastic R n ↔ (∀ i j, 0 ≤ M i j) ∧ 1 ᵥ* M = 1

name: mem_colStochastic_iff_sum
statement:
lemma mem_colStochastic_iff_sum :
    M ∈ colStochastic R n ↔
      (∀ i j, 0 ≤ M i j) ∧ (∀ j, ∑ i, M i j = 1)

name: nonneg_of_mem_colStochastic
statement: lemma nonneg_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) {i j : n} : 0 ≤ M i j

name: sum_col_of_mem_colStochastic
statement: lemma sum_col_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) (i : n) : ∑ j, M j i = 1

name: one_vecMul_of_mem_colStochastic
statement: lemma one_vecMul_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) : 1 ᵥ* M = 1

name: le_one_of_mem_colStochastic
statement:
lemma le_one_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n) {i j : n} :
    M j i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_col_of_mem_colStochastic hM i]
  exact single_le_sum (fun k _ => hM.1 k _) (mem_univ j)

name: nonneg_mulVec_of_mem_colStochastic
statement:
lemma nonneg_mulVec_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n)
    (hx : ∀ i : n, 0 ≤ x i) : ∀ j : n, 0 ≤ (M *ᵥ x) j
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro k _
  refine Left.mul_nonneg ?_ (hx k)
  exact nonneg_of_mem_colStochastic hM

name: nonneg_vecMul_of_mem_colStochastic
statement:
lemma nonneg_vecMul_of_mem_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n)
    (hx : ∀ i : n, 0 ≤ x i) : ∀ j : n, 0 ≤ (x ᵥ* M) j
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro k _
  refine Left.mul_nonneg (hx k) ?_
  exact nonneg_of_mem_colStochastic hM

name: mulVec_dotProduct_one_eq_one_colStochastic
statement:
lemma mulVec_dotProduct_one_eq_one_colStochastic (hM : M ∈ colStochastic R n)
    (hx : 1 ⬝ᵥ x = 1) : 1 ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ x) = 1

name: sum_mulVec_of_mem_colStochastic
statement:
lemma sum_mulVec_of_mem_colStochastic {M : Matrix n n R} {x : n → R}
    (hA : M ∈ colStochastic R n) : ∑ i, (M *ᵥ x) i = ∑ i, x i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp [sum_col_of_mem_colStochastic hA, ← Finset.sum_mul]

name: convex_colStochastic
statement: lemma convex_colStochastic : Convex R (colStochastic R n : Set (Matrix n n R))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb h
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_colStochastic_iff_sum] at hx hy ⊢
  simp [add_nonneg, ha, hb, mul_nonneg, hx, hy, sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, h]

name: permMatrix_mem_colStochastic
statement:
@[simp, grind ←]
lemma permMatrix_mem_colStochastic {σ : Equiv.Perm n} :
    σ.permMatrix R ∈ colStochastic R n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_colStochastic_iff_sum]
  refine ⟨fun i j => ?g1, ?g2⟩
  case g1 => aesop
  case g2 => simp [Equiv.toPEquiv_apply, ← Equiv.eq_symm_apply σ]

name: transpose_mem_rowStochastic_iff_mem_colStochastic
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma transpose_mem_rowStochastic_iff_mem_colStochastic :
    Mᵀ ∈ rowStochastic R n ↔ M ∈ colStochastic R n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_colStochastic_iff_sum, mem_rowStochastic_iff_sum, transpose_apply,
    and_congr_left_iff]
  exact fun _ ↦ forall_comm

name: transpose_mem_colStochastic_iff_mem_rowStochastic
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma transpose_mem_colStochastic_iff_mem_rowStochastic :
    Mᵀ ∈ colStochastic R n ↔ M ∈ rowStochastic R n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_colStochastic_iff_sum, mem_rowStochastic_iff_sum, transpose_apply,
    and_congr_left_iff]
  exact fun _ ↦ forall_comm

name: reindex_mem_rowStochastic
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ ↦ by simpa using nonneg_of_mem_rowStochastic hM, by simp [submatrix_mulVec_equiv, hM.2]⟩

name: reindex_mem_rowStochastic_iff
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, reindex_mem_rowStochastic⟩
  have : M = (M.reindex e₁ e₂).reindex e₁.symm e₂.symm := by simp
  rw [this]
  exact reindex_mem_rowStochastic h

name: reindex_mem_colStochastic_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [← transpose_transpose (reindex e₁ e₂ M), transpose_reindex,
    transpose_mem_colStochastic_iff_mem_rowStochastic, reindex_mem_rowStochastic_iff,
    ← transpose_mem_colStochastic_iff_mem_rowStochastic, transpose_transpose]

name: detp_transpose
statement: @[simp] lemma detp_transpose : A.transpose.detp s = A.detp s
proof:
:=
  sum_equiv (.inv _) (by simp) fun σ _ ↦ prod_equiv σ (by simp) (by simp)

name: detp_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma detp_zero [Nonempty n] : (0 : Matrix n n R).detp s = 0

name: detp_one_diagonal
statement:
@[simp]
lemma detp_one_diagonal (d : n → R) : detp 1 (diagonal d) = ∏ i, d i
proof:
:= by
  rw [detp, sum_eq_single_of_mem 1]
  · simp
  · simp [ofSign]
  · rintro σ - hσ1
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_forall.mp (mt Perm.ext_iff.mpr hσ1)
    exact prod_eq_zero (mem_univ i) (diagonal_apply_ne' _ hi)

name: detp_one_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma detp_one_one : detp 1 (1 : Matrix n n R) = 1

name: detp_neg_one_diagonal
statement:
@[simp]
lemma detp_neg_one_diagonal (d : n → R) : detp (-1) (diagonal d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [detp, sum_eq_zero]
  intro σ hσ
  have hσ1 : σ ≠ 1 := by
    contrapose hσ
    rw [hσ, mem_ofSign, sign_one]
    decide
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_forall.mp (mt Perm.ext_iff.mpr hσ1)
  exact prod_eq_zero (mem_univ i) (diagonal_apply_ne' _ hi)

name: detp_neg_one_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma detp_neg_one_one : detp (-1) (1 : Matrix n n R) = 0

name: detp_one_of_isEmpty
statement: @[simp] lemma detp_one_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty n] : A.detp 1 = 1

name: detp_neg_one_of_isEmpty
statement: @[simp] lemma detp_neg_one_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty n] : A.detp (-1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [detp, ofSign, univ_unique]
  convert sum_empty
  simp +decide

name: detp_submatrix_equiv_equiv
statement:
@[simp] lemma detp_submatrix_equiv_equiv (f g : m ≃ n) :
    (A.submatrix f g).detp s = A.detp (s * sign (f.symm.trans g))
proof:
:=
  sum_equiv (equivCongr f g) (by simp) fun _ _ ↦ prod_equiv f (by simp) fun _ _ ↦ by simp

name: detp_submatrix_equiv_self
statement: lemma detp_submatrix_equiv_self (e : m ≃ n) : (A.submatrix e e).detp s = A.detp s

name: detp_smul
statement: lemma detp_smul (c : R) : (c • A).detp s = c ^ Fintype.card n * A.detp s

name: detp_map
statement:
lemma detp_map {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) :
    (A.map f).detp s = f (A.detp s)

name: IsDetpBalanced.refl
statement: lemma IsDetpBalanced.refl (a : R) : A.IsDetpBalanced a a

name: IsDetpBalanced.of_eq
statement: lemma IsDetpBalanced.of_eq (eq : A.detp 1 = A.detp (-1)) : A.IsDetpBalanced a b

name: IsDetpBalanced.symm
statement: lemma IsDetpBalanced.symm : A.IsDetpBalanced a b → A.IsDetpBalanced b a

name: IsDetpBalanced_comm
statement: lemma IsDetpBalanced_comm : A.IsDetpBalanced a b ↔ A.IsDetpBalanced b a

name: IsDetpBalanced.trans
statement:
lemma IsDetpBalanced.trans [IsCancelAdd R]
    (hab : A.IsDetpBalanced a b) (hbc : A.IsDetpBalanced b c) :
    A.IsDetpBalanced a c
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsDetpBalanced] at *
  apply add_left_cancel (a := b * detp 1 A + b * detp (-1) A)
  convert congr($hab + $hbc) using 1 <;> abel

name: IsDetpBalanced.mul_add_mul_eq
statement:
lemma IsDetpBalanced.mul_add_mul_eq (h : A.IsDetpBalanced a b) (s t : ℤˣ) :
    a * A.detp s + b * A.detp t = b * A.detp s + a * A.detp t
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | rfl := Int.units_eq_one_or s <;> obtain rfl | rfl := Int.units_eq_one_or t
  · rw [add_comm]
  · rw [h]
  · rw [add_comm, ← h, add_comm]
  · rw [add_comm]

name: isDetpBalanced_transpose_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma isDetpBalanced_transpose_iff : Aᵀ.IsDetpBalanced a b ↔ A.IsDetpBalanced a b

name: IsDetpBalanced.submatrix_equiv
statement:
lemma IsDetpBalanced.submatrix_equiv (e₁ e₂ : m ≃ n) (h : A.IsDetpBalanced a b) :
    (A.submatrix e₁ e₂).IsDetpBalanced a b

name: isDetpBalanced_submatrix_equiv_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma isDetpBalanced_submatrix_equiv_iff {e₁ e₂ : m ≃ n} :
    (A.submatrix e₁ e₂).IsDetpBalanced a b ↔ A.IsDetpBalanced a b where
  mp h
proof:
:= by simpa using h.submatrix_equiv e₁.symm e₂.symm
  mpr := (·.submatrix_equiv ..)

name: IsDetpBalanced.smul
statement:
lemma IsDetpBalanced.smul (h : A.IsDetpBalanced a b) (c : R) :
    (c • A).IsDetpBalanced a b
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsDetpBalanced, detp_smul, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (c ^ _), mul_assoc,
    ← mul_add, h.mul_add_mul_eq]

name: Nonsingular.eq_of_IsDetpBalanced
statement:
lemma Nonsingular.eq_of_IsDetpBalanced (hA : A.Nonsingular) (hAd : A.IsDetpBalanced a b) :
    a = b

name: IsDetpBalanced.eq_of_nonsingular
statement:
lemma IsDetpBalanced.eq_of_nonsingular (hA : A.IsDetpBalanced a b) (hAn : A.Nonsingular) :
    a = b

name: nonsingular_one
statement: @[simp] lemma nonsingular_one : (1 : Matrix n n R).Nonsingular
proof:
:=
  fun a b h ↦ by simpa [IsDetpBalanced] using h

name: Nonsingular.of_isEmpty
statement: @[simp] lemma Nonsingular.of_isEmpty [IsEmpty n] : A.Nonsingular

name: nonsingular_transpose_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma nonsingular_transpose_iff : Aᵀ.Nonsingular ↔ A.Nonsingular

statement:
@[simp] lemma nonsingular_submatrix_equiv_iff {e₁ e₂ : m ≃ n} :
    (A.submatrix e₁ e₂).Nonsingular ↔ A.Nonsingular

name: detp_eq_of_row_eq
statement:
lemma detp_eq_of_row_eq {p q : n} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hrow : A.row p = A.row q)
    (s : ℤˣ := 1) (t : ℤˣ := -1) : A.detp s = A.detp t
proof:
:= by
  have : A.detp 1 = A.detp (-1) := sum_equiv (.mulRight <| swap p q) (by simp [hpq])
    fun _ _ ↦ prod_equiv (swap p q) (by simp) (by aesop (add simp row))
  obtain rfl | rfl := Int.units_eq_one_or s <;>
  obtain rfl | rfl := Int.units_eq_one_or t <;>
  first | rfl | rw [this]

name: detp_eq_of_col_eq
statement:
lemma detp_eq_of_col_eq {p q : n} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hcol : A.col p = A.col q)
    (s : ℤˣ := 1) (t : ℤˣ := -1) : A.detp s = A.detp t
proof:
:= by
  simpa using detp_eq_of_row_eq (A := Aᵀ) hpq hcol s t

name: detp_eq_of_row_eq_zero
statement: lemma detp_eq_of_row_eq_zero {p : n} (hrow : A.row p = 0) : A.detp s = 0

name: detp_eq_of_col_eq_zero
statement: lemma detp_eq_of_col_eq_zero {p : n} (hcol : A.col p = 0) : A.detp s = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using detp_eq_of_row_eq_zero (A := Aᵀ) s hcol

name: IsDetpBalanced.submatrix_of_card_le
statement:
lemma IsDetpBalanced.submatrix_of_card_le {a b : R} (h : A.IsDetpBalanced a b)
    (le : Fintype.card n ≤ Fintype.card m) (f g : m → n) :
    (A.submatrix f g).IsDetpBalanced a b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f.Injective; swap
  · obtain ⟨p, q, eq, ne⟩ := Function.not_injective_iff.mp hf
    exact .of_eq (detp_eq_of_row_eq ne <| by ext; simp [eq])
  by_cases hg : g.Injective; swap
  · obtain ⟨p, q, eq, ne⟩ := Function.not_injective_iff.mp hg
    exact .of_eq (detp_eq_of_col_eq ne <| by ext; simp [eq])
  let f' := Equiv.ofBijective f <| (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card _).mpr
    ⟨hf, (Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf).antisymm le⟩
  let g' := Equiv.ofBijective g <| (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card _).mpr
    ⟨hg, (Fintype.card_le_of_injective g hg).antisymm le⟩
  rwa [show f = f' by rfl, show g = g' by rfl, isDetpBalanced_submatrix_equiv_iff]

name: adjp_apply
statement:
lemma adjp_apply (i j : n) :
    adjp s A i j = ∑ σ ∈ (ofSign s).filter (· j = i), ∏ k ∈ {j}ᶜ, A k (σ k)

name: adjp_transpose
statement: lemma adjp_transpose : A.transpose.adjp s = (A.adjp s).transpose
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ _ ↦ sum_equiv (.inv _) (by aesop) fun σ hσ ↦ prod_equiv σ (by aesop) (by simp)

name: adjp_none_right
statement:
private lemma adjp_none_right (A : Matrix (Option n) (Option n) R) (i : Option n) :
    A.adjp s i none = (A.submatrix some <| swap none i ∘ some).detp (sign (swap none i) * s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjp, of_apply, detp]
  convert sum_image (g := fun σ ↦ decomposeOption.symm (i, σ))
    ((Equiv.injective _).comp (Prod.mk_right_injective i)).injOn
  · ext σ; simp only [mem_filter, mem_ofSign, mem_image]
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨σ.removeNone, by rw [← optionCongr_sign]; aesop⟩, by aesop⟩
  convert (prod_image (Option.some_injective n).injOn).symm
  · rfl
  · apply SetLike.coe_injective; simp [← Set.compl_range_some]

name: adjp_none_none
statement:
lemma adjp_none_none (A : Matrix (Option n) (Option n) R) :
    A.adjp s none none = (A.submatrix some some).detp s

name: adjp_some_none
statement:
lemma adjp_some_none (A : Matrix (Option n) (Option n) R) :
    A.adjp s (some i) none = (A.submatrix some (Function.update some i none)).detp (-s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjp_none_right]; congr
  · simp
  · ext1; aesop

name: adjp_none_some
statement:
lemma adjp_none_some (A : Matrix (Option n) (Option n) R) :
    A.adjp s none (some i) = (A.submatrix (Function.update some i none) some).detp (-s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← detp_transpose]; simp [← A.transpose.adjp_some_none, adjp_transpose]

name: detp_mul
statement:
theorem detp_mul :
    detp 1 (A * B) + (detp 1 A * detp (-1) B + detp (-1) A * detp 1 B) =
      detp (-1) (A * B) + (detp 1 A * detp 1 B + detp (-1) A * detp (-1) B)
proof:
:= by
  have hf {s t} {σ : Perm n} (hσ : σ ∈ ofSign s) :
      ofSign (t * s) = (ofSign t).map (mulRightEmbedding σ) := by
    ext τ
    simp_rw [mem_map, mulRightEmbedding_apply, ← eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq, exists_eq_right,
      mem_ofSign, map_mul, map_inv, mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul, mem_ofSign.mp hσ]
  have h {s t} : detp s A * detp t B =
      ∑ σ ∈ ofSign s, ∑ τ ∈ ofSign (t * s), ∏ k, A k (σ k) * B (σ k) (τ k) := by
    simp_rw [detp, sum_mul_sum, prod_mul_distrib]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun σ hσ ↦ ?_
    simp_rw [hf hσ, sum_map, mulRightEmbedding_apply, Perm.mul_apply]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun τ hτ ↦ (congr_arg (_ * ·) (Equiv.prod_comp σ _).symm)
  let ι : Perm n ↪ (n → n) := ⟨_, coe_fn_injective⟩
  have hι {σ x} : ι σ x = σ x := rfl
  let bij : Finset (n → n) := (disjUnion (ofSign 1) (ofSign (-1)) ofSign_disjoint).map ι
  replace h (s) : detp s (A * B) =
      ∑ σ ∈ bijᶜ, ∑ τ ∈ ofSign s, ∏ i : n, A i (σ i) * B (σ i) (τ i) +
        (detp 1 A * detp s B + detp (-1) A * detp (-s) B) := by
    simp_rw [h, neg_mul_neg, mul_one, detp, mul_apply, prod_univ_sum, Fintype.piFinset_univ]
    rw [sum_comm, ← sum_compl_add_sum bij, sum_map, sum_disjUnion]
    simp_rw [hι]
  rw [h, h, neg_neg, add_assoc]
  conv_rhs => rw [add_assoc]
  refine congr_arg₂ (· + ·) (sum_congr rfl fun σ hσ ↦ ?_) (add_comm _ _)
  replace hσ : ¬ Function.Injective σ := by
    contrapose hσ
    rw [notMem_compl, mem_map, ofSign_disjUnion]
    exact ⟨Equiv.ofBijective σ hσ.bijective_of_finite, mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨i, j, hσ, hij⟩ := Function.not_injective_iff.mp hσ
  replace hσ k : σ (swap i j k) = σ k := by
    rw [swap_apply_def]
    split_ifs with h h <;> simp only [hσ, h]
  rw [← mul_neg_one, hf (mem_ofSign.mpr (sign_swap hij)), sum_map]
  simp_rw [prod_mul_distrib, mulRightEmbedding_apply, Perm.mul_apply]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun τ hτ ↦ congr_arg (_ * ·) ?_
  rw [← Equiv.prod_comp (swap i j)]
  simp only [hσ]

name: mul_adjp_apply_eq
statement: theorem mul_adjp_apply_eq : (A * adjp s A) i i = detp s A
proof:
:= by
  have key := sum_fiberwise_eq_sum_filter (ofSign s) univ (· i) fun σ ↦ ∏ k, A k (σ k)
  simp_rw [mem_univ, filter_true] at key
  simp_rw [mul_apply, adjp_apply, mul_sum, detp, ← key]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ sum_congr rfl fun σ hσ ↦ ?_
  rw [← prod_mul_prod_compl ({i} : Finset n), prod_singleton, (mem_filter.mp hσ).2]

name: mul_adjp_apply_ne
statement: theorem mul_adjp_apply_ne (h : i ≠ j) : (A * adjp 1 A) i j = (A * adjp (-1) A) i j
proof:
:= by
  let A' : Matrix n n R := A.updateRow j (A i)
  have h' s : (A * adjp s A) i j = (A' * adjp s A') j j := sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦
    congr_arg₂ (· * ·) (by simp [A']) <| sum_congr rfl fun σ hσ ↦ prod_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ by aesop
  simp_rw [h', mul_adjp_apply_eq]
  apply detp_eq_of_row_eq h
  simp [A', Matrix.row_apply', h]

name: adjp_mul_apply_eq
statement: theorem adjp_mul_apply_eq : (adjp s A * A) i i = detp s A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← detp_transpose, ← mul_adjp_apply_eq _ _ i, adjp_transpose, ← transpose_mul, transpose_apply]

name: adjp_mul_apply_ne
statement: theorem adjp_mul_apply_ne (h : i ≠ j) : (adjp 1 A * A) i j = (adjp (-1) A * A) i j
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← transpose_apply (_ * _) j i, transpose_mul,
    ← adjp_transpose, mul_adjp_apply_ne _ _ _ h.symm]

name: mul_adjp_add_detp
statement: theorem mul_adjp_add_detp : A * adjp 1 A + detp (-1) A • 1 = A * adjp (-1) A + detp 1 A • 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | h <;> simp_rw [add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  · simp_rw [mul_adjp_apply_eq, one_apply_eq, mul_one, add_comm]
  · simp_rw [mul_adjp_apply_ne A i j h, one_apply_ne h, mul_zero]

name: detp_option_expand_row_none
statement:
lemma detp_option_expand_row_none (A : Matrix (Option n) (Option n) R) :
    A.detp s = A none none * (A.submatrix some some).detp s +
      ∑ k : n, A none (some k) * (A.submatrix some (Function.update some k none)).detp (-s)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← A.mul_adjp_apply_eq s none, mul_apply,
    Fintype.sum_option, adjp_none_none, adjp_some_none]

name: isAddUnit_mul
statement:
theorem isAddUnit_mul {d : n → R} (hAB : A * B = diagonal d) (i j k : n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    IsAddUnit (A i k * B k j)
proof:
:= by
  revert k
  rw [← IsAddUnit.sum_univ_iff, ← mul_apply, hAB, diagonal_apply_ne _ hij]
  exact isAddUnit_zero

name: isAddUnit_detp_mul_detp
statement:
theorem isAddUnit_detp_mul_detp {d : n → R} (hAB : A * B = diagonal d) :
    IsAddUnit (detp 1 A * detp (-1) B + detp (-1) A * detp 1 B)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ {s t}, s ≠ t → IsAddUnit (detp s A * detp t B) from
    (h (by decide)).add (h (by decide))
  intro s t h
  simp_rw [detp, sum_mul_sum, IsAddUnit.sum_iff]
  intro σ hσ τ hτ
  rw [mem_ofSign] at hσ hτ
  rw [← hσ, ← hτ, ← sign_inv] at h
  replace h := ne_of_apply_ne sign h
  rw [ne_eq, eq_comm, eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one, eq_comm] at h
  simp_rw [Equiv.ext_iff, not_forall, Perm.mul_apply, Perm.one_apply] at h
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h
  rw [mul_comm, ← Equiv.prod_comp σ, mul_comm, ← prod_mul_distrib,
    ← mul_prod_erase univ _ (mem_univ k), ← smul_eq_mul]
  exact (isAddUnit_mul hAB k (τ (σ k)) (σ k) hk).smul_right _

name: isAddUnit_detp_smul_mul_adjp
statement:
theorem isAddUnit_detp_smul_mul_adjp {d : n → R} (hAB : A * B = diagonal d) :
    IsAddUnit (detp 1 A • (B * adjp (-1) B) + detp (-1) A • (B * adjp 1 B))
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ {s t}, s ≠ t → IsAddUnit (detp s A • (B * adjp t B)) from
    (h (by decide)).add (h (by decide))
  intro s t h
  rw [isAddUnit_iff]
  intro i j
  simp_rw [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_apply, detp, adjp_apply, mul_sum, sum_mul,
    IsAddUnit.sum_iff]
  intro k hk σ hσ τ hτ
  rw [mem_filter] at hσ
  rw [mem_ofSign] at hσ hτ
  rw [← hσ.1, ← hτ, ← sign_inv] at h
  replace h := ne_of_apply_ne sign h
  rw [ne_eq, eq_comm, eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one] at h
  obtain ⟨l, hl1, hl2⟩ := exists_mem_ne (one_lt_card_support_of_ne_one h) (τ⁻¹ j)
  rw [mem_support, ne_comm] at hl1
  rw [ne_eq, ← mem_singleton, ← mem_compl] at hl2
  rw [← prod_mul_prod_compl {τ⁻¹ j}, mul_mul_mul_comm, mul_comm, ← smul_eq_mul]
  apply IsAddUnit.smul_right
  have h0 : ∀ k, k ∈ ({τ⁻¹ j} : Finset n)ᶜ ↔ τ k ∈ ({j} : Finset n)ᶜ := by
    simp [inv_def, eq_symm_apply]
  rw [← prod_equiv τ h0 fun _ _ ↦ rfl, ← prod_mul_distrib, ← mul_prod_erase _ _ hl2, ← smul_eq_mul]
  exact (isAddUnit_mul hAB l (σ (τ l)) (τ l) hl1).smul_right _

name: detp_smul_add_adjp
statement:
theorem detp_smul_add_adjp (hAB : A * B = 1) :
    detp 1 B • A + adjp (-1) B = detp (-1) B • A + adjp 1 B
proof:
:= by
  have key := congr(A * $(mul_adjp_add_detp B))
  simp_rw [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, hAB, one_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, mul_one] at key
  rwa [add_comm, eq_comm, add_comm]

name: detp_smul_adjp
statement:
theorem detp_smul_adjp (hAB : A * B = 1) :
    A + (detp 1 A • adjp (-1) B + detp (-1) A • adjp 1 B) =
      detp 1 A • adjp 1 B + detp (-1) A • adjp (-1) B
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := detp_mul A B
  rw [hAB, detp_one_one, detp_neg_one_one, zero_add] at h0
  have h := detp_smul_add_adjp hAB
  replace h := congr(detp 1 A • $h + detp (-1) A • $h.symm)
  simp only [smul_add, smul_smul] at h
  rwa [add_add_add_comm, ← add_smul, add_add_add_comm, ← add_smul, ← h0, add_smul, one_smul,
    add_comm A, add_assoc, ((isAddUnit_detp_mul_detp hAB).smul_right _).add_right_inj] at h

    (A : P → Matrix m n α) (B : ¬P → Matrix m n α) (i : m) (j : n) :
    dite P A B i j = dite P (A · i j) (B · i j)

name: ite_apply
statement:

    (A : Matrix m n α) (B : Matrix m n α) (i : m) (j : n) :

name: reindex_trans
statement:

theorem reindex_trans {l₂ o₂ : Type*} (eₘ : m ≃ l) (eₙ : n ≃ o) (eₘ₂ : l ≃ l₂) (eₙ₂ : o ≃ o₂) :
    (reindex eₘ eₙ).trans (reindex eₘ₂ eₙ₂) =
      (reindex (eₘ.trans eₘ₂) (eₙ.trans eₙ₂) : Matrix m n α ≃ _)
proof:
:=
  Equiv.ext fun A => (A.submatrix_submatrix eₘ.symm eₙ.symm eₘ₂.symm eₙ₂.symm :)

name: _root_.AddMonoidHom.map_trace
statement:
theorem _root_.AddMonoidHom.map_trace [AddCommMonoid S] {F : Type*} [FunLike F R S]
    [AddMonoidHomClass F R S] (f : F) (A : Matrix n n R) :
    f (trace A) = trace (A.map f)
proof:
:=
  map_sum f (fun i => diag A i) Finset.univ

name: trace_one
statement:

statement:

name: trace_mul_single
statement:

name: trace_surjective
statement:
theorem trace_surjective [AddCommMonoid R] [Nonempty n] :
    Function.Surjective (trace : Matrix n n R → R)
proof:
:= fun r ↦ by
  classical
  inhabit n
  exact ⟨single default default r, trace_single_eq_same default r⟩

name: ext_iff_trace_mul_left
statement:
theorem ext_iff_trace_mul_left [NonAssocSemiring R] {A B : Matrix m n R} :
    A = B ↔ ∀ x, (x * A).trace = (x * B).trace
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x => h ▸ rfl, fun h => ?_⟩
  ext i j
  classical
  simpa [trace_single_mul] using h (single j i (1 : R))

name: ext_iff_trace_mul_right
statement:
theorem ext_iff_trace_mul_right [NonAssocSemiring R] {A B : Matrix m n R} :
    A = B ↔ ∀ x, (A * x).trace = (B * x).trace
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x => h ▸ rfl, fun h => ?_⟩
  ext i j
  classical
  simpa [trace_mul_single] using h (single j i (1 : R))

statement:
theorem blockTriangular_reindex_iff {b : n → α} {e : m ≃ n} :

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · convert! h.submatrix
    simp only [reindex_apply, submatrix_submatrix, submatrix_id_id, Equiv.symm_comp_self]

    simp only [comp_assoc b e e.symm, Equiv.self_comp_symm, comp_id]

name: isIndecomposable_iff_blockTriangular_const
statement:
lemma isIndecomposable_iff_blockTriangular_const [Nontrivial α] [Finite m] [Zero R]
    (M : Matrix m m R) :
    M.IsIndecomposable ↔ ∀ b : m → α, M.BlockTriangular b → ∃ a, b = const m a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsIndecomposable]
  refine ⟨fun h b hb ↦ ?_, fun h i j A B D e he ↦ ?_⟩
  · contrapose! h
    have : Fintype m := .ofFinite m
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty m with hm | hm
    · exact False.elim <| h (Nonempty.some inferInstance) (IsEmpty.congr_fun _ _)
    obtain ⟨K, k, hKk⟩ : ∃ K k, b k < b K := by
      obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Finite.exists_max b
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, b k ≠ b K := by simpa using ne_iff.mp <| h (b K)
      exact ⟨K, k, (hK k).lt_of_ne hk⟩
    let s := {k // b k < b K}
    let t := {k // ¬ b k < b K}
    have : Nonempty s := ⟨⟨k, hKk⟩⟩
    have : Nonempty t := ⟨⟨K, lt_irrefl _⟩⟩
    let e : Fin (card s) ⊕ Fin (card t) ≃ m :=
      ((Fintype.equivFin _).sumCongr (Fintype.equivFin _)).symm.trans (Equiv.sumCompl _)
    let M' := M.submatrix e e
    suffices M'.toBlocks₂₁ = 0 by
      refine ⟨_, _, M'.toBlocks₁₁, M'.toBlocks₁₂, M'.toBlocks₂₂, e, ?_, card_ne_zero, card_ne_zero⟩
      simp [← this, M'.fromBlocks_toBlocks, M']
    have hp (x : Fin (card s)) : b (e (.inl x)) < b K := ((equivFin s).symm x).property
    have hn (x : Fin (card t)) : b K ≤ b (e (.inr x)) := not_lt.mp ((equivFin t).symm x).property
    ext i j
    replace hb : M (e (Sum.inr i)) (e (Sum.inl j)) = 0 := hb (lt_of_lt_of_le (hp j) (hn i))
    simpa [M', toBlocks₂₁]
  · obtain ⟨a₁, a₂, ha₁₂⟩ : ∃ a₁ a₂ : α, a₁ < a₂ := exists_pair_lt α
    set b : m → α := fun k ↦ Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ a₁) (fun _ ↦ a₂) (e.symm k) with hb
    have hBT : M.BlockTriangular b := by
      rw [he, Matrix.blockTriangular_reindex_iff]
      rintro (r | r) (s | s) hrs
      · aesop
      · exact False.elim <| lt_irrefl a₁ <| ha₁₂.trans <| by aesop
      · simp
      · aesop
    contrapose! ha₁₂
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h b hBT
    rw [hb] at ha
    obtain rfl : a₁ = a := by simpa using congr_fun ha <| e <| .inl <| Nonempty.some ⟨⟨0, by lia⟩⟩
    obtain rfl : a₂ = a₁ := by simpa using congr_fun ha <| e <| .inr <| Nonempty.some ⟨⟨0, by lia⟩⟩
    exact le_refl _

proof:

name: equiv_block_det
statement:
theorem equiv_block_det (M : Matrix m m R) {p q : m → Prop} [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q]
    (e : ∀ x, q x ↔ p x) : (toSquareBlockProp M p).det = (toSquareBlockProp M q).det
proof:
:= by
  convert!
    Matrix.det_reindex_self (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight e)
      (toSquareBlockProp M q)

name: det_toSquareBlock_id
statement: theorem det_toSquareBlock_id (M : Matrix m m R) (i : m) : (M.toSquareBlock id i).det = M i i
proof:
:=
  letI : Unique { a // id a = i } := ⟨⟨⟨i, rfl⟩⟩, fun j => Subtype.ext j.property⟩
  (det_unique _).trans rfl

name: det_toBlock
statement:
theorem det_toBlock (M : Matrix m m R) (p : m → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    M.det =
      (fromBlocks (toBlock M p p) (toBlock M p fun j => ¬p j) (toBlock M (fun j => ¬p j) p) <|
          toBlock M (fun j => ¬p j) fun j => ¬p j).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.det_reindex_self (Equiv.sumCompl p).symm M]
  rw [det_apply', det_apply']
  congr; ext σ; congr; ext x
  generalize hy : σ x = y
  cases x <;> cases y <;>
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply, toBlock_apply, Equiv.symm_symm, Equiv.sumCompl_apply_inr,
      Equiv.sumCompl_apply_inl, fromBlocks_apply₁₁, fromBlocks_apply₁₂, fromBlocks_apply₂₁,
      fromBlocks_apply₂₂, Matrix.submatrix_apply]

name: twoBlockTriangular_det
statement:
theorem twoBlockTriangular_det (M : Matrix m m R) (p : m → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (h : ∀ i, ¬p i → ∀ j, p j → M i j = 0) :
    M.det = (toSquareBlockProp M p).det * (toSquareBlockProp M fun i => ¬p i).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_toBlock M p]
  convert!
    det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁ (toBlock M p p) (toBlock M p fun j => ¬p j)
      (toBlock M (fun j => ¬p j) fun j => ¬p j)
  ext i j
  exact h (↑i) i.2 (↑j) j.2

name: twoBlockTriangular_det'
statement:
theorem twoBlockTriangular_det' (M : Matrix m m R) (p : m → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (h : ∀ i, p i → ∀ j, ¬p j → M i j = 0) :
    M.det = (toSquareBlockProp M p).det * (toSquareBlockProp M fun i => ¬p i).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [M.twoBlockTriangular_det fun i => ¬p i, mul_comm]
  · congr 1
    exact equiv_block_det _ fun _ => not_not.symm
  · simpa only [Classical.not_not] using h

name: BlockTriangular.det
statement:
protected theorem BlockTriangular.det [DecidableEq α] [LinearOrder α] (hM : BlockTriangular M b) :
    M.det = ∏ a ∈ univ.image b, (M.toSquareBlock b a).det
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ hs : Finset α, univ.image b = hs → M.det = ∏ a ∈ hs, (M.toSquareBlock b a).det by
    exact this _ rfl
  intro s hs
  induction s using Finset.eraseInduction generalizing m with | H s ih =>
  subst hs
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty m
  · simp
  let k := (univ.image b).max' (univ_nonempty.image _)
  rw [twoBlockTriangular_det' M fun i => b i = k]
  · have : univ.image b = insert k ((univ.image b).erase k) := by
      rw [insert_erase]
      apply max'_mem
    rw [this, prod_insert (notMem_erase _ _)]
    refine congr_arg _ ?_
    let b' := fun i : { a // b a ≠ k } => b ↑i
    have h' : BlockTriangular (M.toSquareBlockProp fun i => b i ≠ k) b' := hM.submatrix
    have hb' : image b' univ = (image b univ).erase k := by
      convert! image_subtype_ne_univ_eq_image_erase k b
    rw [ih _ (max'_mem _ _) h' hb']
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun l hl => ?_
    let he : { a // b' a = l } ≃ { a // b a = l } :=
      haveI hc : ∀ i, b i = l → b i ≠ k := fun i hi => ne_of_eq_of_ne hi (ne_of_mem_erase hl)
      Equiv.subtypeSubtypeEquivSubtype @hc
    rw [toSquareBlock_def, ← Matrix.det_reindex_self he.symm]
    rfl
  · intro i hi j hj
    apply hM
    rw [hi]
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne _ hj
    exact Finset.le_max' (univ.image b) _ (mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_univ _))

name: BlockTriangular.det_fintype
statement:
theorem BlockTriangular.det_fintype [DecidableEq α] [Fintype α] [LinearOrder α]
    (h : BlockTriangular M b) : M.det = ∏ k : α, (M.toSquareBlock b k).det
proof:
:= by
  refine h.det.trans (prod_subset (subset_univ _) fun a _ ha => ?_)
  have : IsEmpty { i // b i = a } := ⟨fun i => ha <| mem_image.2 ⟨i, mem_univ _, i.2⟩⟩
  exact det_isEmpty

name: matrixOfPolynomials_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem matrixOfPolynomials_isUpperTriangular {R} [Semiring R] {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → R[X])
    (h_deg : ∀ i, (p i).natDegree ≤ i) :
    (Matrix.of (fun (i j : Fin n) => (p j).coeff i)).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:=
  fun _ j h => by
    exact coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt <| Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (h_deg j) h

name: det_matrixOfPolynomials
statement:
theorem det_matrixOfPolynomials {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → R[X])
    (h_deg : ∀ i, (p i).natDegree = i) (h_monic : ∀ i, Monic <| p i) :
    (Matrix.of (fun (i j : Fin n) => (p j).coeff i)).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular (Matrix.matrixOfPolynomials_isUpperTriangular p (fun i ↦
      Nat.le_of_eq (h_deg i)))]
  convert! prod_const_one with x _
  rw [Matrix.of_apply, ← h_deg, coeff_natDegree, (h_monic x).leadingCoeff]

name: BlockTriangular.toBlock_inverse_mul_toBlock_eq_one
statement:
theorem BlockTriangular.toBlock_inverse_mul_toBlock_eq_one [LinearOrder α] [Invertible M]
    (hM : BlockTriangular M b) (k : α) :
    ((M⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => b i < k) fun i => b i < k) *
        M.toBlock (fun i => b i < k) fun i => b i < k) =
      1
proof:
:= by
  let p i := b i < k
  have h_sum :
    M⁻¹.toBlock p p * M.toBlock p p +
        (M⁻¹.toBlock p fun i => ¬p i) * M.toBlock (fun i => ¬p i) p =
      1 := by
    rw [← toBlock_mul_eq_add, inv_mul_of_invertible M, toBlock_one_self]
  have h_zero : M.toBlock (fun i => ¬p i) p = 0 := by
    ext i j
    simpa using hM (lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 (le_of_not_gt i.2))
  simpa [h_zero] using h_sum

name: BlockTriangular.inv_toBlock
statement:
theorem BlockTriangular.inv_toBlock [LinearOrder α] [Invertible M] (hM : BlockTriangular M b)
    (k : α) :
    (M.toBlock (fun i => b i < k) fun i => b i < k)⁻¹ =
      M⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => b i < k) fun i => b i < k

name: toBlock_inverse_eq_zero
statement:
theorem toBlock_inverse_eq_zero [LinearOrder α] [Invertible M] (hM : BlockTriangular M b) (k : α) :
    (M⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => k ≤ b i) fun i => b i < k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let p i := b i < k
  let q i := ¬b i < k
  have h_sum : M⁻¹.toBlock q p * M.toBlock p p + M⁻¹.toBlock q q * M.toBlock q p = 0 := by
    rw [← toBlock_mul_eq_add, inv_mul_of_invertible M, toBlock_one_disjoint]
    rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
    exact fun i h => h.1 h.2
  have h_zero : M.toBlock q p = 0 := by
    ext i j
    simpa using hM (lt_of_lt_of_le j.2 <| le_of_not_gt i.2)
  have h_mul_eq_zero : M⁻¹.toBlock q p * M.toBlock p p = 0 := by simpa [h_zero] using h_sum
  have : Invertible (M.toBlock p p) := hM.invertibleToBlock k
  have : (fun i => k ≤ b i) = q := by
    ext
    exact not_lt.symm
  rw [this, ← Matrix.zero_mul (M.toBlock p p)⁻¹, ← h_mul_eq_zero,
    mul_inv_cancel_right_of_invertible]

name: blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular
statement:
theorem blockTriangular_inv_of_blockTriangular [LinearOrder α] [Invertible M]
    (hM : BlockTriangular M b) : BlockTriangular M⁻¹ b
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ hs : Finset α, univ.image b = hs → BlockTriangular M⁻¹ b by exact this _ rfl
  intro s hs
  induction s using Finset.strongInduction generalizing m with | H s ih =>
  subst hs
  intro i j hij
  have : Inhabited m := ⟨i⟩
  let k := (univ.image b).max' (univ_nonempty.image _)
  let b' := fun i : { a // b a < k } => b ↑i
  let A := M.toBlock (fun i => b i < k) fun j => b j < k
  obtain hbi | hi : b i = k ∨ _ := (le_max' _ (b i) <| mem_image_of_mem _ <| mem_univ _).eq_or_lt
  · have : M⁻¹.toBlock (fun i => k ≤ b i) (fun i => b i < k) ⟨i, hbi.ge⟩ ⟨j, hbi ▸ hij⟩ = 0 := by
      simp only [toBlock_inverse_eq_zero hM k, Matrix.zero_apply]
    simp [this.symm]
  have : Invertible A := hM.invertibleToBlock _
  have hA : A.BlockTriangular b' := hM.submatrix
  have hb' : image b' univ ⊂ image b univ := by
    convert! image_subtype_univ_ssubset_image_univ k b _ (fun a => a < k) (lt_irrefl _)
    convert! max'_mem (α := α) _ _
  have hij' : b' ⟨j, hij.trans hi⟩ < b' ⟨i, hi⟩ := by simp_rw [b', hij]
  simp [A, hM.inv_toBlock k, (ih (image b' univ) hb' hA rfl hij').symm]

statement:

  have := congr_arg Matrix.det (mvPolynomialX_mapMatrix_eval (1 : Matrix m m R))

  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp [mvPolynomialX]
