statement:
@[simp]
theorem preimage_coe_affineSpan_singleton (x : P) :
    ((↑) : affineSpan k ({x} : Set P) → P) ⁻¹' {x} = univ

name: subsingleton_of_subsingleton_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_subsingleton_span_eq_top {s : Set P} (h₁ : s.Subsingleton)
    (h₂ : affineSpan k s = ⊤) : Subsingleton P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := AffineSubspace.nonempty_of_affineSpan_eq_top k V P h₂
  have : s = {p} := Subset.antisymm (fun q hq => h₁ hq hp) (by simp [hp])
  rw [this, AffineSubspace.ext_iff, AffineSubspace.top_coe, eq_comm, affineSpan_singleton,
    coe_singleton, ← subsingleton_iff_singleton (mem_univ _)] at h₂
  exact subsingleton_of_univ_subsingleton h₂

name: eq_univ_of_subsingleton_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem eq_univ_of_subsingleton_span_eq_top {s : Set P} (h₁ : s.Subsingleton)
    (h₂ : affineSpan k s = ⊤) : s = (univ : Set P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := AffineSubspace.nonempty_of_affineSpan_eq_top k V P h₂
  have : s = {p} := Subset.antisymm (fun q hq => h₁ hq hp) (by simp [hp])
  rw [this, eq_comm, ← subsingleton_iff_singleton (mem_univ p), subsingleton_univ_iff]
  exact subsingleton_of_subsingleton_span_eq_top h₁ h₂

name: direction_lt_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem direction_lt_of_nonempty {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} (h : s₁ < s₂)
    (hn : (s₁ : Set P).Nonempty) : s₁.direction < s₂.direction
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hn
  rw [lt_iff_le_and_exists] at h
  rcases h with ⟨hle, p₂, hp₂, hp₂s₁⟩
  rw [SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists]
  use direction_le hle, p₂ -ᵥ p, vsub_mem_direction hp₂ (hle hp)
  intro hm
  rw [vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem hp p₂] at hm
  exact hp₂s₁ hm

name: vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_left
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_left {s : Set P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) :
    vectorSpan k s = Submodule.span k ((p -ᵥ ·) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vectorSpan_def]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_mono ?_)
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro v ⟨p₁, hp₁, p₂, hp₂, hv⟩
    simp_rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_left p₁ p₂ p] at hv
    rw [← hv, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_span]
    exact fun m hm => Submodule.sub_mem _ (hm ⟨p₂, hp₂, rfl⟩) (hm ⟨p₁, hp₁, rfl⟩)
  · rintro v ⟨p₂, hp₂, hv⟩
    exact ⟨p, hp, p₂, hp₂, hv⟩

name: vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right {s : Set P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) :
    vectorSpan k s = Submodule.span k ((· -ᵥ p) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vectorSpan_def]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_mono ?_)
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro v ⟨p₁, hp₁, p₂, hp₂, hv⟩
    simp_rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right p₁ p₂ p] at hv
    rw [← hv, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_span]
    exact fun m hm => Submodule.sub_mem _ (hm ⟨p₁, hp₁, rfl⟩) (hm ⟨p₂, hp₂, rfl⟩)
  · rintro v ⟨p₂, hp₂, hv⟩
    exact ⟨p₂, hp₂, p, hp, hv⟩

name: vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_left_ne
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_left_ne {s : Set P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) :
    vectorSpan k s = Submodule.span k ((p -ᵥ ·) '' (s \ {p}))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_left k hp, ← Set.insert_eq_of_mem hp, ←
      Set.insert_sdiff_singleton, Set.image_insert_eq]
  simp [Submodule.span_insert_eq_span]

name: vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right_ne
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right_ne {s : Set P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) :
    vectorSpan k s = Submodule.span k ((· -ᵥ p) '' (s \ {p}))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right k hp, ← Set.insert_eq_of_mem hp, ←
      Set.insert_sdiff_singleton, Set.image_insert_eq]
  simp [Submodule.span_insert_eq_span]

name: vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_finset_right_ne
vectorSpan_image_eq_span_vsub_set_left_ne
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_image_eq_span_vsub_set_left_ne (p : ι → P) {s : Set ι} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    vectorSpan k (p '' s) = Submodule.span k ((p i -ᵥ ·) '' p '' (s \ {i}))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_left k (Set.mem_image_of_mem p hi), ← Set.insert_eq_of_mem hi, ←
      Set.insert_sdiff_singleton, Set.image_insert_eq]
  simp [Submodule.span_insert_eq_span]

name: vectorSpan_image_eq_span_vsub_set_right_ne
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_image_eq_span_vsub_set_right_ne (p : ι → P) {s : Set ι} {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ s) :
    vectorSpan k (p '' s) = Submodule.span k ((· -ᵥ p i) '' p '' (s \ {i}))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right k (Set.mem_image_of_mem p hi), ← Set.insert_eq_of_mem hi,
      ← Set.insert_sdiff_singleton, Set.image_insert_eq]
  simp [Submodule.span_insert_eq_span]

name: vectorSpan_range_eq_span_range_vsub_left
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_range_eq_span_range_vsub_left (p : ι → P) (i0 : ι) :
    vectorSpan k (Set.range p) = Submodule.span k (Set.range fun i : ι => p i0 -ᵥ p i)
proof:
:= by

name: vectorSpan_range_eq_span_range_vsub_left_ne
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_range_eq_span_range_vsub_left_ne (p : ι → P) (i₀ : ι) :
    vectorSpan k (Set.range p) =
      Submodule.span k (Set.range fun i : { x // x ≠ i₀ } => p i₀ -ᵥ p i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.image_univ, vectorSpan_image_eq_span_vsub_set_left_ne k _ (Set.mem_univ i₀)]
  congr with v
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Subtype.exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨i₁, ⟨⟨_, hi₁⟩, rfl⟩⟩, hv⟩
    exact ⟨i₁, hi₁, hv⟩
  · exact fun ⟨i₁, hi₁, hv⟩ => ⟨p i₁, ⟨i₁, ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hi₁⟩, rfl⟩, hv⟩

statement:

proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.image_univ, vectorSpan_image_eq_span_vsub_set_right_ne k _ (Set.mem_univ i₀)]
  congr with v
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Subtype.exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨i₁, ⟨⟨_, hi₁⟩, rfl⟩⟩, hv⟩
    exact ⟨i₁, hi₁, hv⟩
  · exact fun ⟨i₁, hi₁, hv⟩ => ⟨p i₁, ⟨i₁, ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hi₁⟩, rfl⟩, hv⟩

name: affineSpan_coe_preimage_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem affineSpan_coe_preimage_eq_top (A : Set P) [Nonempty A] :
    affineSpan k (((↑) : affineSpan k A → P) ⁻¹' A) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ -
  refine affineSpan_induction' (fun y hy ↦ ?_) (fun c u hu v hv w hw ↦ ?_) hx
  · exact subset_affineSpan _ _ hy
  · exact AffineSubspace.smul_vsub_vadd_mem _ _

name: affineSpan_singleton_union_vadd_eq_top_of_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem affineSpan_singleton_union_vadd_eq_top_of_span_eq_top {s : Set V} (p : P)
    (h : Submodule.span k (Set.range ((↑) : s → V)) = ⊤) :
    affineSpan k ({p} ∪ (fun v => v +ᵥ p) '' s) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  convert!
    ext_of_direction_eq _
      ⟨p, mem_affineSpan k (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_singleton _)), mem_top k V p⟩
  rw [direction_affineSpan, direction_top,
    vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right k (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_singleton _) : p ∈ _),
    eq_top_iff, ← h]
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro v ⟨v', rfl⟩
  use (v' : V) +ᵥ p
  simp

name: mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq
statement:
lemma mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq {p p₁ p₂ : P} :

name: direction_sup
statement:
theorem direction_sup {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} {p₁ p₂ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ s₁) (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ s₂) :
    (s₁ ⊔ s₂).direction = s₁.direction ⊔ s₂.direction ⊔ k ∙ (p₂ -ᵥ p₁)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · change (affineSpan k ((s₁ : Set P) ∪ s₂)).direction ≤ _
    rw [← mem_coe] at hp₁
    rw [direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_eq_span_vsub_set_right k (Set.mem_union_left _ hp₁),
      Submodule.span_le]
    rintro v ⟨p₃, hp₃, rfl⟩
    rcases hp₃ with hp₃ | hp₃
    · rw [sup_assoc, sup_comm, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_sup]
      use 0, Submodule.zero_mem _, p₃ -ᵥ p₁, vsub_mem_direction hp₃ hp₁
      rw [zero_add]
    · rw [sup_assoc, SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_sup]
      use 0, Submodule.zero_mem _, p₃ -ᵥ p₁
      rw [and_comm, zero_add]
      use rfl
      rw [← vsub_add_vsub_cancel p₃ p₂ p₁, Submodule.mem_sup]
      use p₃ -ᵥ p₂, vsub_mem_direction hp₃ hp₂, p₂ -ᵥ p₁, Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _
  · refine sup_le (sup_direction_le _ _) ?_
    rw [direction_eq_vectorSpan, vectorSpan_def]
    exact
      sInf_le_sInf fun p hp =>
        Set.Subset.trans
          (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2
            (vsub_mem_vsub (mem_affineSpan k (Set.mem_union_right _ hp₂))
              (mem_affineSpan k (Set.mem_union_left _ hp₁))))
          hp

name: direction_sup_eq_sup_direction
statement:
lemma direction_sup_eq_sup_direction {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp₁ : p ∈ s₁)
    (hp₂ : p ∈ s₂) : (s₁ ⊔ s₂).direction = s₁.direction ⊔ s₂.direction

name: direction_affineSpan_insert
statement:
theorem direction_affineSpan_insert {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p₁ p₂ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ s) :
    (affineSpan k (insert p₂ (s : Set P))).direction =
    Submodule.span k {p₂ -ᵥ p₁} ⊔ s.direction
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup_comm, ← Set.union_singleton, ← AffineSubspace.coe_singleton (k := k) p₂]
  change (s ⊔ {p₂}).direction = _
  simp [direction_sup hp₁ (mem_singleton _)]

name: mem_affineSpan_insert_iff
statement:
theorem mem_affineSpan_insert_iff {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p₁ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ s) (p₂ p : P) :
    p ∈ affineSpan k (insert p₂ (s : Set P)) ↔
      ∃ r : k, ∃ p0 ∈ s, p = r • (p₂ -ᵥ p₁ : V) +ᵥ p0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_coe] at hp₁
  rw [← vsub_right_mem_direction_iff_mem (mem_affineSpan k (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hp₁)),
    direction_affineSpan_insert hp₁, Submodule.mem_sup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v₁, hv₁, v₂, hv₂, hp⟩
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hv₁
    rcases hv₁ with ⟨r, rfl⟩
    use r, v₂ +ᵥ p₁, vadd_mem_of_mem_direction hv₂ hp₁
    symm at hp
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq] at hp
    rw [hp, vadd_vadd]
  · rintro ⟨r, p₃, hp₃, rfl⟩
    use r • (p₂ -ᵥ p₁), Submodule.mem_span_singleton.2 ⟨r, rfl⟩, p₃ -ᵥ p₁,
      vsub_mem_direction hp₃ hp₁
    rw [vadd_vsub_assoc]

name: vectorSpan_union_of_mem_of_mem
statement:
lemma vectorSpan_union_of_mem_of_mem {s₁ s₂ : Set P} {p : P} (hp₁ : p ∈ s₁) (hp₂ : p ∈ s₂) :
    vectorSpan k (s₁ ∪ s₂) = vectorSpan k s₁ ⊔ vectorSpan k s₂
proof:

    direction_sup_eq_sup_direction (mem_affineSpan k hp₁) (mem_affineSpan k hp₂)]

name: coe_prod

prod_top_top

name: _root_.vectorSpan_prod_le
statement:
theorem _root_.vectorSpan_prod_le (s : Set P) (t : Set Q) :
    vectorSpan k (s ×ˢ t) ≤ (vectorSpan k s).prod (vectorSpan k t)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [vectorSpan_def, Set.prod_vsub_prod_comm] using Submodule.span_prod_le (s -ᵥ s) (t -ᵥ t)

name: direction_prod_le
statement:
theorem direction_prod_le (s : AffineSubspace k P) (t : AffineSubspace k Q) :
    (s.prod t).direction ≤ s.direction.prod t.direction
proof:
:= by
  simpa [direction_eq_vectorSpan, coe_prod] using vectorSpan_prod_le (s : Set P) (t : Set Q)

name: _root_.vectorSpan_prod_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.vectorSpan_prod_eq {s : Set P} {t : Set Q} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty) :
    vectorSpan k (s ×ˢ t) = (vectorSpan k s).prod (vectorSpan k t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vectorSpan_def, Set.prod_vsub_prod_comm]
  exact Submodule.span_prod_eq k hs.zero_mem_vsub_self ht.zero_mem_vsub_self

name: direction_prod_eq
proof:
:= by
  simp [direction_eq_vectorSpan, vectorSpan_prod_eq, nonempty_iff_ne_bot, ht, hs]

name: _root_.affineSpan_prod_eq
statement:
theorem _root_.affineSpan_prod_eq (s : Set P) (t : Set Q) :
    affineSpan k (s ×ˢ t) = (affineSpan k s).prod (affineSpan k t)
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hs
  · simp
  rcases t.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ht
  · simp
  apply AffineSubspace.ext_of_direction_eq
  · simp [direction_prod_eq, Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp, hs, ht, direction_affineSpan,
      vectorSpan_prod_eq]
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ht
    use ⟨x, y⟩
    simp [mem_affineSpan, hx, hy]

name: Parallel.symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem Parallel.symm {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} (h : s₁ ∥ s₂) : s₂ ∥ s₁
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨v, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨-v, ?_⟩
  rw [map_map, ← coe_trans_to_affineMap, ← constVAdd_add, neg_add_cancel, constVAdd_zero,
    coe_refl_to_affineMap, map_id]

proof:

  rcases h₁₂ with ⟨v₁₂, rfl⟩
  rcases h₂₃ with ⟨v₂₃, rfl⟩

name: parallel_bot_iff_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parallel_bot_iff_eq_bot {s : AffineSubspace k P} : s ∥ ⊥ ↔ s = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h ▸ Parallel.refl _⟩
  rcases h with ⟨v, h⟩
  rwa [eq_comm, map_eq_bot_iff] at h

name: bot_parallel_iff_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bot_parallel_iff_eq_bot {s : AffineSubspace k P} : ⊥ ∥ s ↔ s = ⊥

name: parallel_iff_direction_eq_and_eq_bot_iff_eq_bot
statement:
theorem parallel_iff_direction_eq_and_eq_bot_iff_eq_bot {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} :
    s₁ ∥ s₂ ↔ s₁.direction = s₂.direction ∧ (s₁ = ⊥ ↔ s₂ = ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨h.direction_eq, ?_, ?_⟩, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rintro rfl
    exact bot_parallel_iff_eq_bot.1 h
  · rintro rfl
    exact parallel_bot_iff_eq_bot.1 h
  · rcases h with ⟨hd, hb⟩
    by_cases hs₁ : s₁ = ⊥
    · rw [hs₁, bot_parallel_iff_eq_bot]
      exact hb.1 hs₁
    · have hs₂ : s₂ ≠ ⊥ := hb.not.1 hs₁
      rcases (nonempty_iff_ne_bot s₁).2 hs₁ with ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩
      rcases (nonempty_iff_ne_bot s₂).2 hs₂ with ⟨p₂, hp₂⟩
      refine ⟨p₂ -ᵥ p₁, (eq_iff_direction_eq_of_mem hp₂ ?_).2 ?_⟩
      · rw [mem_map]
        refine ⟨p₁, hp₁, ?_⟩
        simp
      · simpa using hd.symm

statement:
theorem affineSpan_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq_and_eq_empty_iff_eq_empty {s₁ s₂ : Set P} :
    affineSpan k s₁ ∥ affineSpan k s₂ ↔ vectorSpan k s₁ = vectorSpan k s₂ ∧ (s₁ = ∅ ↔ s₂ = ∅)
proof:
:= by
  repeat rw [← direction_affineSpan, ← affineSpan_eq_bot k]
  exact parallel_iff_direction_eq_and_eq_bot_iff_eq_bot

name: affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_exists_unit_smul'
statement:
lemma affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_exists_unit_smul' [IsDomain k] [Module.IsTorsionFree k V]
    {p₁ q₁ p₂ q₂ : P} :
    line[k, p₁, q₁] ∥ line[k, p₂, q₂] ↔ ∃ z : kˣ, z • (q₁ -ᵥ p₁) = q₂ -ᵥ p₂

name: affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_exists_unit_smul
statement:
lemma affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_exists_unit_smul [IsDomain k] [Module.IsTorsionFree k V]
    {p₁ q₁ p₂ q₂ : P} :
    line[k, p₁, q₁] ∥ line[k, p₂, q₂] ↔ ∃ z : kˣ, z • (q₂ -ᵥ p₂) = q₁ -ᵥ p₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_exists_unit_smul']
  exact ⟨fun ⟨z, hz⟩ ↦ ⟨z⁻¹, by simp [← hz]⟩, fun ⟨z, hz⟩ ↦ ⟨z⁻¹, by simp [← hz]⟩⟩

name: direction_affineSpan_pair_le_iff_exists_smul
statement:
lemma direction_affineSpan_pair_le_iff_exists_smul {p₁ q₁ p₂ q₂ : P} :
    line[k, p₁, q₁].direction ≤ line[k, p₂, q₂].direction ↔ ∃ z : k, z • (q₂ -ᵥ p₂) = q₁ -ᵥ p₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [direction_affineSpan, direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_pair_rev, vectorSpan_pair_rev,

name: affineSpan_pair_comm
statement:
theorem affineSpan_pair_comm {p₁ p₂ : P} :
    line[k, p₁, p₂] = line[k, p₂, p₁]

name: affineSpan_pair_eq_of_mem_of_mem_of_ne
statement:
lemma affineSpan_pair_eq_of_mem_of_mem_of_ne {p₁ p₂ p₃ p₄ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ line[k, p₃, p₄])
    (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ line[k, p₃, p₄]) (hp₁₂ : p₁ ≠ p₂) : line[k, p₁, p₂] = line[k, p₃, p₄]
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (affineSpan_pair_le_of_mem_of_mem hp₁ hp₂) ?_
  rw [← vsub_vadd p₁ p₃, vadd_left_mem_affineSpan_pair] at hp₁
  rcases hp₁ with ⟨r₁, hp₁⟩
  rw [← vsub_vadd p₂ p₃, vadd_left_mem_affineSpan_pair] at hp₂
  rcases hp₂ with ⟨r₂, hp₂⟩
  have hr₀ : r₂ - r₁ ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sub_ne_zero]
    rintro rfl
    simp_all
  have hr : (r₂ - r₁) • (p₄ -ᵥ p₃) = p₂ -ᵥ p₁ := by
    simp [sub_smul, hp₁, hp₂]
  rw [← eq_inv_smul_iff₀ hr₀] at hr
  refine affineSpan_pair_le_of_mem_of_mem ?_ ?_
  · convert! smul_vsub_vadd_mem_affineSpan_pair (-r₁ * (r₂ - r₁)⁻¹) p₁ p₂
    simp [mul_smul, ← hr, hp₁]
  · convert! smul_vsub_vadd_mem_affineSpan_pair ((1 - r₁) * (r₂ - r₁)⁻¹) p₁ p₂
    simp [mul_smul, ← hr, sub_smul, hp₁]

name: affineSpan_pair_eq_of_left_mem_of_ne
statement:
lemma affineSpan_pair_eq_of_left_mem_of_ne {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h : p₁ ∈ line[k, p₂, p₃])
    (hne : p₁ ≠ p₃) : line[k, p₁, p₃] = line[k, p₂, p₃]

name: affineSpan_pair_eq_of_right_mem_of_ne
statement:
lemma affineSpan_pair_eq_of_right_mem_of_ne {p₁ p₂ p₃ : P} (h : p₁ ∈ line[k, p₂, p₃])
    (hne : p₁ ≠ p₂) :
    line[k, p₂, p₁] = line[k, p₂, p₃]

name: exists_eq_smul_of_parallel
statement:
theorem exists_eq_smul_of_parallel {p₁ p₂ p₃ p₄ p₅ p₆ : P} (h₂ : p₂ ∉ line[k, p₁, p₃])
    (h₁₂₄₅ : line[k, p₁, p₂] ∥ line[k, p₄, p₅])
    (h₂₃₅₆ : line[k, p₅, p₆].direction ≤ line[k, p₂, p₃].direction)
    (h₃₁₆₄ : line[k, p₆, p₄].direction ≤ line[k, p₃, p₁].direction) :
    ∃ r : k, r ≠ 0 ∧ p₅ -ᵥ p₄ = r • (p₂ -ᵥ p₁) ∧ p₆ -ᵥ p₅ = r • (p₃ -ᵥ p₂) ∧
      p₄ -ᵥ p₆ = r • (p₁ -ᵥ p₃)
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_exists_unit_smul'] at h₁₂₄₅
  rw [direction_affineSpan_pair_le_iff_exists_smul] at h₂₃₅₆ h₃₁₆₄
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁⟩ := h₁₂₄₅
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂⟩ := h₂₃₅₆
  obtain ⟨r₃, hr₃⟩ := h₃₁₆₄
  rw [Units.smul_def] at hr₁
  by_cases h : (r₁ : k) = r₂
  · refine ⟨r₁, r₁.ne_zero, hr₁.symm, h ▸ hr₂.symm, ?_⟩
    rw [← neg_inj, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, ← smul_neg, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev,
      ← vsub_add_vsub_cancel p₆ p₅ p₄, ← vsub_add_vsub_cancel p₃ p₂ p₁, smul_add, hr₁, h, hr₂]
  · exfalso
    have h₁₂ : (r₁ : k) • (p₂ -ᵥ p₁) + r₂ • (p₃ -ᵥ p₂) ∈ vectorSpan k {p₁, p₃} := by
      rw [hr₁, hr₂, add_comm, vsub_add_vsub_cancel, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, neg_mem_iff, ← hr₃]
      exact smul_vsub_mem_vectorSpan_pair _ _ _
    have h₁₁ : (r₁ : k) • (p₂ -ᵥ p₁) + (r₁ : k) • (p₃ -ᵥ p₂) ∈ vectorSpan k {p₁, p₃} := by
      rw [add_comm, ← smul_add, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
      exact smul_vsub_rev_mem_vectorSpan_pair _ _ _
    have h₂₁ : (r₂ - r₁) • (p₃ -ᵥ p₂) ∈ vectorSpan k {p₁, p₃} := by
      simpa [sub_smul] using sub_mem h₁₂ h₁₁
    rw [Submodule.smul_mem_iff _ (by rwa [sub_ne_zero, ne_comm]), ← direction_affineSpan,
      vsub_left_mem_direction_iff_mem (right_mem_affineSpan_pair _ _ _)] at h₂₁
    exact h₂ h₂₁

name: vectorSpan_eq_bot_iff_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vectorSpan_eq_bot_iff_subsingleton {s : Set P} : vectorSpan k s = ⊥ ↔ s.Subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, vectorSpan_of_subsingleton _⟩
  by_contra hns
  rw [Set.not_subsingleton_iff] at hns
  obtain ⟨p, hp, q, hq, hpq⟩ := hns
  have hpq' := vsub_mem_vectorSpan k hp hq
  simp_all

name: mem_spanPoints
statement:
theorem mem_spanPoints (p : P) (s : Set P) : p ∈ s → p ∈ spanPoints k s
  | hp => ⟨p, hp, 0, Submodule.zero_mem _, (zero_vadd V p).symm⟩

/

name: subset_spanPoints
statement: theorem subset_spanPoints (s : Set P) : s ⊆ spanPoints k s
proof: := fun p => mem_spanPoints k p s

name: spanPoints_nonempty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem spanPoints_nonempty (s : Set P) : (spanPoints k s).Nonempty ↔ s.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · contrapose
    rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty, Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty]
    intro h
    simp [h, spanPoints]
  · exact fun h => h.mono (subset_spanPoints _ _)

name: vadd_mem_spanPoints_of_mem_spanPoints_of_mem_vectorSpan
statement:
theorem vadd_mem_spanPoints_of_mem_spanPoints_of_mem_vectorSpan {s : Set P} {p : P} {v : V}
    (hp : p ∈ spanPoints k s) (hv : v ∈ vectorSpan k s) : v +ᵥ p ∈ spanPoints k s
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp with ⟨p₂, ⟨hp₂, ⟨v₂, ⟨hv₂, hv₂p⟩⟩⟩⟩
  rw [hv₂p, vadd_vadd]
  exact ⟨p₂, hp₂, v + v₂, (vectorSpan k s).add_mem hv hv₂, rfl⟩

name: vsub_mem_vectorSpan_of_mem_spanPoints_of_mem_spanPoints
statement:
theorem vsub_mem_vectorSpan_of_mem_spanPoints_of_mem_spanPoints {s : Set P} {p₁ p₂ : P}
    (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ spanPoints k s) (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ spanPoints k s) : p₁ -ᵥ p₂ ∈ vectorSpan k s
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp₁ with ⟨p₁a, ⟨hp₁a, ⟨v₁, ⟨hv₁, hv₁p⟩⟩⟩⟩
  rcases hp₂ with ⟨p₂a, ⟨hp₂a, ⟨v₂, ⟨hv₂, hv₂p⟩⟩⟩⟩
  rw [hv₁p, hv₂p, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub (v₁ +ᵥ p₁a), vadd_vsub_assoc, add_comm, add_sub_assoc]
  have hv₁v₂ : v₁ - v₂ ∈ vectorSpan k s := (vectorSpan k s).sub_mem hv₁ hv₂
  refine (vectorSpan k s).add_mem ?_ hv₁v₂
  exact vsub_mem_vectorSpan k hp₁a hp₂a

name: vsub_self_of_zero_mem
statement:
lemma vsub_self_of_zero_mem {s : AffineSubspace k V} (hs : 0 ∈ s) :
    (s : Set V) -ᵥ s = s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
    simpa using s.smul_vsub_vadd_mem 1 ha hb hs
  · exact fun h => ⟨x, h, 0, hs, by simp⟩

name: vsub_self_eq_iff_zero_mem
statement:
@[simp] lemma vsub_self_eq_iff_zero_mem {s : AffineSubspace k V} [Nonempty s] :
    (s : Set V) -ᵥ s = s ↔ 0 ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, vsub_self_of_zero_mem⟩
  obtain x : s := Classical.choice inferInstance
  suffices (x : V) - x ∈ (s : Set _) by aesop
  rw [← h, mem_vsub]
  aesop

name: directionOfNonempty_eq_direction
statement:
theorem directionOfNonempty_eq_direction {s : AffineSubspace k P} (h : (s : Set P).Nonempty) :
    directionOfNonempty h = s.direction
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_le.2 Set.Subset.rfl)
  rw [← SetLike.coe_subset_coe, directionOfNonempty, direction, Submodule.coe_set_mk,
    AddSubmonoid.coe_set_mk]
  exact vsub_set_subset_vectorSpan k _

name: coe_direction_eq_vsub_set
statement:
theorem coe_direction_eq_vsub_set {s : AffineSubspace k P} (h : (s : Set P).Nonempty) :
    (s.direction : Set V) = (s : Set P) -ᵥ s

name: mem_direction_iff_eq_vsub
statement:
theorem mem_direction_iff_eq_vsub {s : AffineSubspace k P} (h : (s : Set P).Nonempty) (v : V) :
    v ∈ s.direction ↔ ∃ p₁ ∈ s, ∃ p₂ ∈ s, v = p₁ -ᵥ p₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_direction_eq_vsub_set h, Set.mem_vsub]
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, eq_comm]

name: vadd_mem_of_mem_direction
statement:
theorem vadd_mem_of_mem_direction {s : AffineSubspace k P} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ s.direction) {p : P}
    (hp : p ∈ s) : v +ᵥ p ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_direction_iff_eq_vsub ⟨p, hp⟩] at hv
  rcases hv with ⟨p₁, hp₁, p₂, hp₂, hv⟩
  rw [hv]
  convert s.smul_vsub_vadd_mem 1 hp₁ hp₂ hp
  rw [one_smul]

name: vsub_mem_direction
statement:
theorem vsub_mem_direction {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p₁ p₂ : P} (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ s) (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ s) :
    p₁ -ᵥ p₂ ∈ s.direction

name: vadd_mem_iff_mem_direction
statement:
theorem vadd_mem_iff_mem_direction {s : AffineSubspace k P} (v : V) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) :
    v +ᵥ p ∈ s ↔ v ∈ s.direction
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa using vsub_mem_direction h hp, fun h => vadd_mem_of_mem_direction h hp⟩

name: vadd_mem_iff_mem_of_mem_direction
statement:
theorem vadd_mem_iff_mem_of_mem_direction {s : AffineSubspace k P} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ s.direction)
    {p : P} : v +ᵥ p ∈ s ↔ p ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => vadd_mem_of_mem_direction hv h⟩
  convert! vadd_mem_of_mem_direction (Submodule.neg_mem _ hv) h
  simp

name: coe_direction_eq_vsub_set_right
statement:
theorem coe_direction_eq_vsub_set_right {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) :
    (s.direction : Set V) = (· -ᵥ p) '' s
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_direction_eq_vsub_set ⟨p, hp⟩]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rintro v ⟨p₁, hp₁, p₂, hp₂, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(p₁ -ᵥ p₂) +ᵥ p,
      vadd_mem_of_mem_direction (vsub_mem_direction hp₁ hp₂) hp, vadd_vsub _ _⟩
  · rintro v ⟨p₂, hp₂, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p₂, hp₂, p, hp, rfl⟩

name: coe_direction_eq_vsub_set_left
statement:
theorem coe_direction_eq_vsub_set_left {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) :
    (s.direction : Set V) = (p -ᵥ ·) '' s
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← Submodule.neg_mem_iff, ← SetLike.mem_coe,
    coe_direction_eq_vsub_set_right hp, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_image]
  conv_lhs =>
    congr
    ext
    rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, neg_inj]

name: mem_direction_iff_eq_vsub_right
statement:
theorem mem_direction_iff_eq_vsub_right {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) (v : V) :
    v ∈ s.direction ↔ ∃ p₂ ∈ s, v = p₂ -ᵥ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_direction_eq_vsub_set_right hp]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨p₂, hp₂, hv⟩ => ⟨p₂, hp₂, hv.symm⟩, fun ⟨p₂, hp₂, hv⟩ => ⟨p₂, hp₂, hv.symm⟩⟩

name: mem_direction_iff_eq_vsub_left
statement:
theorem mem_direction_iff_eq_vsub_left {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) (v : V) :
    v ∈ s.direction ↔ ∃ p₂ ∈ s, v = p -ᵥ p₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, coe_direction_eq_vsub_set_left hp]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨p₂, hp₂, hv⟩ => ⟨p₂, hp₂, hv.symm⟩, fun ⟨p₂, hp₂, hv⟩ => ⟨p₂, hp₂, hv.symm⟩⟩

name: direction_eq_self_iff_zero_mem
statement:
@[simp] lemma direction_eq_self_iff_zero_mem {s : AffineSubspace k V} :
    s.direction = s ↔ 0 ∈ s where
  mp h
proof:
:= by rw [← h]; simp
  mpr h := by
    ext x
    rw [Submodule.mem_toAffineSubspace, ← SetLike.mem_coe]
    simp [s.coe_direction_eq_vsub_set ⟨0, h⟩, vsub_self_of_zero_mem h]

name: ext_of_direction_eq
statement:
theorem ext_of_direction_eq {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} (hd : s₁.direction = s₂.direction)
    (hn : ((s₁ : Set P) ∩ s₂).Nonempty) : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  have hq1 := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_left hn.some_mem
  have hq2 := Set.mem_of_mem_inter_right hn.some_mem
  constructor
  · intro hp
    rw [← vsub_vadd p hn.some]
    refine vadd_mem_of_mem_direction ?_ hq2
    rw [← hd]
    exact vsub_mem_direction hp hq1
  · intro hp
    rw [← vsub_vadd p hn.some]
    refine vadd_mem_of_mem_direction ?_ hq1
    rw [hd]
    exact vsub_mem_direction hp hq2

name: eq_iff_direction_eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem eq_iff_direction_eq_of_mem {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (h₁ : p ∈ s₁)
    (h₂ : p ∈ s₂) : s₁ = s₂ ↔ s₁.direction = s₂.direction
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ rfl, fun h => ext_of_direction_eq h ⟨p, h₁, h₂⟩⟩

name: mem_mk'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_mk' {p q : P} {direction : Submodule k V} : q ∈ mk' p direction ↔ q -ᵥ p ∈ direction

name: self_mem_mk'
statement: theorem self_mem_mk' (p : P) (direction : Submodule k V) : p ∈ mk' p direction

name: vadd_mem_mk'
statement:
theorem vadd_mem_mk' {v : V} (p : P) {direction : Submodule k V} (hv : v ∈ direction) :
    v +ᵥ p ∈ mk' p direction

name: mk'_nonempty
statement: theorem mk'_nonempty (p : P) (direction : Submodule k V) : (mk' p direction : Set P).Nonempty

name: direction_mk'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem direction_mk' (p : P) (direction : Submodule k V) :
    (mk' p direction).direction = direction
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [mem_direction_iff_eq_vsub (mk'_nonempty _ _)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p₁, hp₁, p₂, hp₂, rfl⟩
    simpa using direction.sub_mem hp₁ hp₂
  · exact fun hv => ⟨v +ᵥ p, vadd_mem_mk' _ hv, p, self_mem_mk' _ _, (vadd_vsub _ _).symm⟩

name: mk'_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk'_eq {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) : mk' p s.direction = s

name: spanPoints_subset_coe_of_subset_coe
statement:
theorem spanPoints_subset_coe_of_subset_coe {s : Set P} {s₁ : AffineSubspace k P} (h : s ⊆ s₁) :
    spanPoints k s ⊆ s₁
proof:
:= by
  rintro p ⟨p₁, hp₁, v, hv, hp⟩
  rw [hp]
  have hp₁s₁ : p₁ ∈ (s₁ : Set P) := Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset hp₁ h
  refine vadd_mem_of_mem_direction ?_ hp₁s₁
  have hs : vectorSpan k s ≤ s₁.direction := vectorSpan_mono k h
  rw [SetLike.le_def] at hs
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe]
  exact Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset hv hs

name: toAffineSubspace_direction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toAffineSubspace_direction (s : Submodule k V) : s.toAffineSubspace.direction = s

name: coe_affineSpan
statement: theorem coe_affineSpan (s : Set P) : (affineSpan k s : Set P) = spanPoints k s

name: mem_affineSpan_iff_exists
statement:
lemma mem_affineSpan_iff_exists {p : P} {s : Set P} : p ∈ affineSpan k s ↔
    ∃ p₁ ∈ s, ∃ v ∈ vectorSpan k s, p = v +ᵥ p₁

name: subset_affineSpan
statement: theorem subset_affineSpan (s : Set P) : s ⊆ affineSpan k s

name: direction_affineSpan
statement: theorem direction_affineSpan (s : Set P) : (affineSpan k s).direction = vectorSpan k s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro v ⟨p₁, ⟨p₂, hp₂, v₁, hv₁, hp₁⟩, p₃, ⟨p₄, hp₄, v₂, hv₂, hp₃⟩, rfl⟩
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe]
    rw [hp₁, hp₃, vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub, vadd_vsub_assoc]
    exact
      (vectorSpan k s).sub_mem ((vectorSpan k s).add_mem hv₁ (vsub_mem_vectorSpan k hp₂ hp₄)) hv₂
  · exact vectorSpan_mono k (subset_spanPoints k s)

name: mem_affineSpan
statement: theorem mem_affineSpan {p : P} {s : Set P} (hp : p ∈ s) : p ∈ affineSpan k s

name: vectorSpan_add_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vectorSpan_add_self (s : Set V) : (vectorSpan k s : Set V) + s = affineSpan k s
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [mem_add, coe_affineSpan, spanPoints]
  grind

name: vadd_mem_affineSpan_of_mem_affineSpan_of_mem_vectorSpan
statement:
theorem vadd_mem_affineSpan_of_mem_affineSpan_of_mem_vectorSpan {s : Set P} {p : P} {v : V}
    (hp : p ∈ affineSpan k s) (hv : v ∈ vectorSpan k s) : v +ᵥ p ∈ affineSpan k s

name: vsub_mem_vectorSpan_of_mem_affineSpan_of_mem_affineSpan
statement:
theorem vsub_mem_vectorSpan_of_mem_affineSpan_of_mem_affineSpan {s : Set P} {p₁ p₂ : P}
    (hp₁ : p₁ ∈ affineSpan k s) (hp₂ : p₂ ∈ affineSpan k s) : p₁ -ᵥ p₂ ∈ vectorSpan k s

name: affineSpan_le_of_subset_coe
statement:
theorem affineSpan_le_of_subset_coe {s : Set P} {s₁ : AffineSubspace k P} (h : s ⊆ s₁) :
    affineSpan k s ≤ s₁

name: le_def
statement: theorem le_def (s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) : s₁ ≤ s₂ ↔ (s₁ : Set P) ⊆ s₂

name: le_def'
statement: theorem le_def' (s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) : s₁ ≤ s₂ ↔ ∀ p ∈ s₁, p ∈ s₂

name: lt_def
statement: theorem lt_def (s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) : s₁ < s₂ ↔ (s₁ : Set P) ⊂ s₂

name: not_le_iff_exists
statement: theorem not_le_iff_exists (s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) : ¬s₁ ≤ s₂ ↔ ∃ p ∈ s₁, p ∉ s₂

name: exists_of_lt
statement: theorem exists_of_lt {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} (h : s₁ < s₂) : ∃ p ∈ s₂, p ∉ s₁

name: lt_iff_le_and_exists
statement:
theorem lt_iff_le_and_exists (s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) :
    s₁ < s₂ ↔ s₁ ≤ s₂ ∧ ∃ p ∈ s₂, p ∉ s₁

name: eq_of_direction_eq_of_nonempty_of_le
statement:
theorem eq_of_direction_eq_of_nonempty_of_le {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P}
    (hd : s₁.direction = s₂.direction) (hn : (s₁ : Set P).Nonempty) (hle : s₁ ≤ s₂) : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:=
  let ⟨p, hp⟩ := hn
  ext_of_direction_eq hd ⟨p, hp, hle hp⟩

name: affineSpan_eq_sInf
statement:
theorem affineSpan_eq_sInf (s : Set P) :
    affineSpan k s = sInf { s' : AffineSubspace k P | s ⊆ s' }

name: span_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_empty : affineSpan k (∅ : Set P) = ⊥

name: span_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem span_univ : affineSpan k (Set.univ : Set P) = ⊤

name: _root_.affineSpan_le
statement:
theorem _root_.affineSpan_le {s : Set P} {Q : AffineSubspace k P} :
    affineSpan k s ≤ Q ↔ s ⊆ (Q : Set P)

name: span_union
statement: theorem span_union (s t : Set P) : affineSpan k (s ∪ t) = affineSpan k s ⊔ affineSpan k t

name: span_iUnion
statement:
theorem span_iUnion {ι : Type*} (s : ι → Set P) :
    affineSpan k (⋃ i, s i) = ⨆ i, affineSpan k (s i)

name: top_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem top_coe : ((⊤ : AffineSubspace k P) : Set P) = Set.univ

name: mem_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_top (p : P) : p ∈ (⊤ : AffineSubspace k P)

name: mk'_top
statement: @[simp] lemma mk'_top (p : P) : mk' p (⊤ : Submodule k V) = ⊤

name: direction_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem direction_top : (⊤ : AffineSubspace k P).direction = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := S.nonempty
  ext v
  refine ⟨imp_intro Submodule.mem_top, fun _hv => ?_⟩
  have hpv : ((v +ᵥ p) -ᵥ p : V) ∈ (⊤ : AffineSubspace k P).direction :=
    vsub_mem_direction (mem_top k V _) (mem_top k V _)
  rwa [vadd_vsub] at hpv

name: bot_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bot_coe : ((⊥ : AffineSubspace k P) : Set P) = ∅

name: bot_ne_top
statement: theorem bot_ne_top : (⊥ : AffineSubspace k P) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro contra
  rw [AffineSubspace.ext_iff, bot_coe, top_coe] at contra
  exact Set.empty_ne_univ contra

name: nonempty_of_affineSpan_eq_top
statement: theorem nonempty_of_affineSpan_eq_top {s : Set P} (h : affineSpan k s = ⊤) : s.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
  rintro rfl
  rw [AffineSubspace.span_empty] at h
  exact bot_ne_top k V P h

name: vectorSpan_eq_top_of_affineSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem vectorSpan_eq_top_of_affineSpan_eq_top {s : Set P} (h : affineSpan k s = ⊤) :
    vectorSpan k s = ⊤

name: affineSpan_eq_top_iff_vectorSpan_eq_top_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem affineSpan_eq_top_iff_vectorSpan_eq_top_of_nonempty {s : Set P} (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    affineSpan k s = ⊤ ↔ vectorSpan k s = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨vectorSpan_eq_top_of_affineSpan_eq_top k V P, ?_⟩
  intro h
  suffices Nonempty (affineSpan k s) by
    obtain ⟨p, hp : p ∈ affineSpan k s⟩ := this
    rw [eq_iff_direction_eq_of_mem hp (mem_top k V p), direction_affineSpan, h, direction_top]
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨⟨x, mem_affineSpan k hx⟩⟩

name: affineSpan_eq_top_iff_vectorSpan_eq_top_of_nontrivial
statement:
theorem affineSpan_eq_top_iff_vectorSpan_eq_top_of_nontrivial {s : Set P} [Nontrivial P] :
    affineSpan k s = ⊤ ↔ vectorSpan k s = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hs | hs
  · simp [hs, subsingleton_iff_bot_eq_top, AddTorsor.subsingleton_iff V P, not_subsingleton]
  · rw [affineSpan_eq_top_iff_vectorSpan_eq_top_of_nonempty k V P hs]

name: card_pos_of_affineSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem card_pos_of_affineSpan_eq_top {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p : ι → P}
    (h : affineSpan k (range p) = ⊤) : 0 < Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, ⟨i, -⟩⟩ := nonempty_of_affineSpan_eq_top k V P h
  exact Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨i⟩

name: notMem_bot
statement: theorem notMem_bot (p : P) : p ∉ (⊥ : AffineSubspace k P)

name: direction_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem direction_bot : (⊥ : AffineSubspace k P).direction = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [direction_eq_vectorSpan, bot_coe, vectorSpan_def, vsub_empty, Submodule.span_empty]

name: coe_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_eq_bot_iff (Q : AffineSubspace k P) : (Q : Set P) = ∅ ↔ Q = ⊥

name: coe_eq_univ_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_eq_univ_iff (Q : AffineSubspace k P) : (Q : Set P) = univ ↔ Q = ⊤

name: nonempty_iff_ne_bot
statement: theorem nonempty_iff_ne_bot (Q : AffineSubspace k P) : (Q : Set P).Nonempty ↔ Q ≠ ⊥

name: eq_bot_or_nonempty
statement: theorem eq_bot_or_nonempty (Q : AffineSubspace k P) : Q = ⊥ ∨ (Q : Set P).Nonempty

name: direction_eq_top_iff_of_nonempty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem direction_eq_top_iff_of_nonempty {s : AffineSubspace k P} (h : (s : Set P).Nonempty) :
    s.direction = ⊤ ↔ s = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hd
    rw [← direction_top k V P] at hd
    refine ext_of_direction_eq hd ?_
    simp [h]
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: coe_inf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_inf (s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) : ↑(s₁ ⊓ s₂) = (s₁ : Set P) ∩ s₂

name: mem_inf_iff
statement: theorem mem_inf_iff (p : P) (s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) : p ∈ s₁ ⊓ s₂ ↔ p ∈ s₁ ∧ p ∈ s₂

name: direction_inf
statement:
theorem direction_inf (s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) :
    (s₁ ⊓ s₂).direction ≤ s₁.direction ⊓ s₂.direction
proof:
:= by
  simp only [direction_eq_vectorSpan, vectorSpan_def]
  exact
    le_inf (sInf_le_sInf fun p hp => trans (vsub_self_mono inter_subset_left) hp)
      (sInf_le_sInf fun p hp => trans (vsub_self_mono inter_subset_right) hp)

name: direction_inf_of_mem
statement:
theorem direction_inf_of_mem {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (h₁ : p ∈ s₁) (h₂ : p ∈ s₂) :
    (s₁ ⊓ s₂).direction = s₁.direction ⊓ s₂.direction
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [Submodule.mem_inf, ← vadd_mem_iff_mem_direction v h₁, ← vadd_mem_iff_mem_direction v h₂, ←
    vadd_mem_iff_mem_direction v ((mem_inf_iff p s₁ s₂).2 ⟨h₁, h₂⟩), mem_inf_iff]

name: direction_inf_of_mem_inf
statement:
theorem direction_inf_of_mem_inf {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (h : p ∈ s₁ ⊓ s₂) :
    (s₁ ⊓ s₂).direction = s₁.direction ⊓ s₂.direction
proof:
:=
  direction_inf_of_mem ((mem_inf_iff p s₁ s₂).1 h).1 ((mem_inf_iff p s₁ s₂).1 h).2

name: coe_sInf
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_sInf (t : Set (AffineSubspace k P)) :
    ((sInf t : AffineSubspace k P) : Set P) = ⋂ s ∈ t, s

name: mem_sInf_iff
statement: theorem mem_sInf_iff (p : P) (t : Set (AffineSubspace k P)) : p ∈ sInf t ↔ ∀ s ∈ t, p ∈ s

name: direction_sInf
statement:
theorem direction_sInf (t : Set (AffineSubspace k P)) :
    direction (sInf t) ≤ ⨅ s ∈ t, s.direction
proof:
:= by
  simp only [direction_eq_vectorSpan, vectorSpan_def]
  exact le_iInf₂ fun s hs => Submodule.span_mono <| vsub_self_mono <| biInter_subset_of_mem hs

name: direction_sInf_of_mem
statement:
theorem direction_sInf_of_mem (t : Set (AffineSubspace k P)) (p : P) (h : ∀ s ∈ t, p ∈ s) :
    direction (sInf t) = ⨅ s ∈ t, s.direction
proof:
:= by
  apply (direction_sInf t).antisymm
  intro v hv
  rw [← vadd_mem_iff_mem_direction v ((mem_sInf_iff p t).mpr h), mem_sInf_iff]
  intro s hs
  rw [vadd_mem_iff_mem_direction v (h s hs)]
  simp only [Submodule.mem_iInf] at hv
  exact hv s hs

name: direction_sInf_of_mem_sInf
statement:
theorem direction_sInf_of_mem_sInf (t : Set (AffineSubspace k P)) (p : P) (h : p ∈ sInf t) :
    direction (sInf t) = ⨅ s ∈ t, s.direction
proof:
:=
  direction_sInf_of_mem t p <| (mem_sInf_iff p t).mp h

name: coe_iInf
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_iInf (s : ι → AffineSubspace k P) :
    ((iInf s : AffineSubspace k P) : Set P) = ⋂ i, s i

name: mem_iInf_iff
statement: theorem mem_iInf_iff (s : ι → AffineSubspace k P) (p : P) : p ∈ iInf s ↔ ∀ i, p ∈ s i

name: direction_iInf
statement:
theorem direction_iInf (s : ι → AffineSubspace k P) :
    (iInf s).direction ≤ ⨅ i, (s i).direction

name: direction_iInf_of_mem
statement:
theorem direction_iInf_of_mem (s : ι → AffineSubspace k P) (p : P) (h : ∀ i, p ∈ s i) :
    (iInf s).direction = ⨅ i, (s i).direction
proof:
:= by
  rw [iInf, direction_sInf_of_mem _ p ?_, iInf_range]
  rwa [Set.forall_mem_range]

name: direction_iInf_of_mem_iInf
statement:
theorem direction_iInf_of_mem_iInf (s : ι → AffineSubspace k P) (p : P) (h : p ∈ iInf s) :
    (iInf s).direction = ⨅ i, (s i).direction
proof:
:= by
  rw [iInf, direction_sInf_of_mem_sInf _ p h, iInf_range]

name: direction_le
statement: theorem direction_le {s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P} (h : s₁ ≤ s₂) : s₁.direction ≤ s₂.direction
proof:
:= by
  simp only [direction_eq_vectorSpan, vectorSpan_def]
  exact vectorSpan_mono k h

name: sup_direction_le
statement:
theorem sup_direction_le (s₁ s₂ : AffineSubspace k P) :
    s₁.direction ⊔ s₂.direction ≤ (s₁ ⊔ s₂).direction
proof:
:= by
  simp only [direction_eq_vectorSpan, vectorSpan_def]
  exact
    sup_le
      (sInf_le_sInf fun p hp => Set.Subset.trans (vsub_self_mono (le_sup_left : s₁ ≤ s₁ ⊔ s₂)) hp)
      (sInf_le_sInf fun p hp => Set.Subset.trans (vsub_self_mono (le_sup_right : s₂ ≤ s₁ ⊔ s₂)) hp)

name: sup_direction_lt_of_nonempty_of_inter_empty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂⟩ := h2
  rw [SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists]
  use sup_direction_le s₁ s₂, p₂ -ᵥ p₁,
    vsub_mem_direction ((le_sup_right : s₂ ≤ s₁ ⊔ s₂) hp₂) ((le_sup_left : s₁ ≤ s₁ ⊔ s₂) hp₁)
  intro h
  rw [Submodule.mem_sup] at h
  rcases h with ⟨v₁, hv₁, v₂, hv₂, hv₁v₂⟩
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, add_comm v₁, add_assoc, ←
    vadd_vsub_assoc, ← neg_neg v₂, add_comm, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← vsub_vadd_eq_vsub_sub,
    vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq] at hv₁v₂
  refine Set.Nonempty.ne_empty ?_ he
  use v₁ +ᵥ p₁, vadd_mem_of_mem_direction hv₁ hp₁
  rw [hv₁v₂]
  exact vadd_mem_of_mem_direction (Submodule.neg_mem _ hv₂) hp₂

name: inter_nonempty_of_nonempty_of_sup_direction_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
  have hlt := sup_direction_lt_of_nonempty_of_inter_empty h1 h2 h
  rw [hd] at hlt
  exact not_top_lt hlt

name: inter_eq_singleton_of_nonempty_of_isCompl
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := inter_nonempty_of_nonempty_of_sup_direction_eq_top h1 h2 hd.sup_eq_top
  use p
  ext q
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hq1, hq2⟩
    have hqp : q -ᵥ p ∈ s₁.direction ⊓ s₂.direction :=
      ⟨vsub_mem_direction hq1 hp.1, vsub_mem_direction hq2 hp.2⟩
    rwa [hd.inf_eq_bot, Submodule.mem_bot, vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq] at hqp
  · exact fun h => h.symm ▸ hp

name: affineSpan_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem affineSpan_coe (s : AffineSubspace k P) : affineSpan k (s : Set P) = s
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (subset_affineSpan _ _)
  rintro p ⟨p₁, hp₁, v, hv, rfl⟩
  exact vadd_mem_of_mem_direction hv hp₁

name: mk'_le_mk'_iff
statement:

theorem mk'_le_mk'_iff (p : P) {d₁ d₂ : Submodule k V} : mk' p d₁ ≤ mk' p d₂ ↔ d₁ ≤ d₂
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [SetLike.le_def, mem_mk']
  refine ⟨fun h x hx ↦ ?_, fun h x hx ↦ h hx⟩
  simpa using h (show (x +ᵥ p) -ᵥ p ∈ d₁ by simpa using hx)

name: affineSpan_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem affineSpan_induction {x : P} {s : Set P} {p : P → Prop} (h : x ∈ affineSpan k s)
    (mem : ∀ x : P, x ∈ s → p x)
    (smul_vsub_vadd : ∀ (c : k) (u v w : P), p u → p v → p w → p (c • (u -ᵥ v) +ᵥ w)) : p x

name: affineSpan_induction'
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem affineSpan_induction' {s : Set P} {p : ∀ x, x ∈ affineSpan k s → Prop}
    (mem : ∀ (y) (hys : y ∈ s), p y (subset_affineSpan k _ hys))
    (smul_vsub_vadd : ∀ (c : k) (u hu v hv w hw), p u hu → p v hv → p w hw →
      p (c • (u -ᵥ v) +ᵥ w) (AffineSubspace.smul_vsub_vadd_mem _ _ hu hv hw))
    {x : P} (h : x ∈ affineSpan k s) : p x h
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ (hx : x ∈ affineSpan k s), p x hx from this.elim fun hx hc ↦ hc
  
  
  
  
  refine affineSpan_induction h ?mem ?smul_vsub_vadd
  · exact fun y hy ↦ ⟨subset_affineSpan _ _ hy, mem y hy⟩
  · exact fun c u v w hu hv hw ↦
      hu.elim fun hu' hu ↦ hv.elim fun hv' hv ↦ hw.elim fun hw' hw ↦
        ⟨AffineSubspace.smul_vsub_vadd_mem _ _ hu' hv' hw',
              smul_vsub_vadd _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hu hv hw⟩

proof:

statement:
theorem affineSpan_insert_eq_affineSpan {p : P} {ps : Set P} (h : p ∈ affineSpan k ps) :

name: affineSpan_le_toAffineSubspace_span
statement:
lemma affineSpan_le_toAffineSubspace_span {s : Set V} :
    affineSpan k s ≤ (Submodule.span k s).toAffineSubspace
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simp only [Submodule.mem_toAffineSubspace]
  induction hx using affineSpan_induction' with
  | mem x hx => exact Submodule.subset_span hx
  | smul_vsub_vadd c u _ v _ w _ hu hv hw =>
    simp only [vsub_eq_sub, vadd_eq_add]
    apply Submodule.add_mem _ _ hw
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.sub_mem _ hu hv)

lemma affineSpan_subset_span {s : Set V} :
    (affineSpan k s : Set V) ⊆ Submodule.span k s

name: affineSpan_insert_zero
statement:
lemma affineSpan_insert_zero (s : Set V) :
    (affineSpan k (insert 0 s) : Set V) = Submodule.span k s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.span_insert_zero]
  refine affineSpan_subset_span.antisymm ?_
  rw [← vectorSpan_add_self, vectorSpan_def]
  refine Subset.trans ?_ <| subset_add_left _ <| mem_insert ..
  gcongr
  exact subset_sub_left <| mem_insert ..

name: direction_shift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem direction_shift (s : AffineSubspace k P) (c : P) (r : k) :
    (s.shift c r).direction = s.direction
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.eq_bot_or_nonempty with h | h
  · simp [shift, h]
  have h : Nonempty s := by simpa using! h
  simp [shift, h]

name: shift_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_top (c : P) (r : k) : shift ⊤ c r = ⊤

name: shift_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_bot (c : P) (r : k) : shift ⊥ c r = ⊥

name: shift_eq
statement:
theorem shift_eq {s : AffineSubspace k P} (p : s) (c : P) (r : k) :
    s.shift c r = s.map (AffineEquiv.constVAdd k P ((1 - r) • (c -ᵥ p)))
proof:
:= by
  have h : Nonempty s := ⟨p⟩
  simp only [shift, h, ↓reduceDIte]
  ext q
  simp only [mem_map, AffineEquiv.coe_toAffineMap, AffineEquiv.constVAdd_apply]
  constructor <;> intro ⟨x, hx, heq⟩ <;> rw [← heq]
  · refine ⟨(1 - r) • (p.val -ᵥ h.some.val) +ᵥ x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact vadd_mem_of_mem_direction (smul_mem _ _ (vsub_mem_direction p.prop h.some.prop)) hx
    · rw [vadd_vadd, ← smul_add, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]
  · refine ⟨(1 - r) • (h.some.val -ᵥ p.val) +ᵥ x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact vadd_mem_of_mem_direction (smul_mem _ _ (vsub_mem_direction h.some.prop p.prop)) hx
    · rw [vadd_vadd, ← smul_add, vsub_add_vsub_cancel]

name: shift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_zero (s : AffineSubspace k P) [h : Nonempty s] (c : P) :
    s.shift c 0 = mk' c s.direction
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_of_direction_eq (by simp) ⟨c, ?_⟩
  suffices ∃ x ∈ s, (c -ᵥ h.some) +ᵥ x = c by simpa [shift, h]
  exact ⟨h.some, by simp⟩

name: shift_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shift_one (s : AffineSubspace k P) (c : P) : s.shift c 1 = s
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.eq_bot_or_nonempty with h | h
  · simp [h]
  have h : Nonempty s := by simpa using! h
  simp [shift, h]

name: vadd_mem_shift
statement:
theorem vadd_mem_shift {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) (c : P) (r : k) :
    (1 - r) • (c -ᵥ p) +ᵥ p ∈ s.shift c r

name: lineMap_mem_shift
statement:
theorem lineMap_mem_shift {s : AffineSubspace k P} {p : P} (hp : p ∈ s) (c : P) (r : k) :
    lineMap c p r ∈ s.shift c r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lineMap_apply_one_sub, lineMap_apply]
  exact vadd_mem_shift hp c r

name: affineCombination_mem_shift
statement:
theorem affineCombination_mem_shift {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nontrivial ι]
    (p : ι → P) (i : ι) {w : ι → k} (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
    affineCombination k univ p w ∈ (affineSpan k <| p '' {i}ᶜ).shift (p i) (1 - w i)
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial k
  · suffices (affineSpan k <| p '' {i}ᶜ) = ⊤ by simp [this]
    have : Subsingleton P := (AddTorsor.subsingleton_iff V P).mp <| Module.subsingleton k V
    simp
  classical
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_ne i
  rw [shift_eq ⟨p j, mem_affineSpan k <| Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hj⟩]
  suffices ∃ q ∈ affineSpan k (p '' {i}ᶜ), w i • (p i -ᵥ p j) +ᵥ q = affineCombination k univ p w by
    simpa
  refine ⟨-(w i • (p i -ᵥ p j)) +ᵥ affineCombination k univ p w, ?_, by simp⟩
  rw [← affineCombination_piSingle k _ p (mem_univ i),
    ← affineCombination_piSingle k _ p (mem_univ j), affineCombination_vsub, ← map_smul, ← map_neg,
    weightedVSub_vadd_affineCombination]
  refine affineCombination_mem_affineSpan_image ?_ (fun i' _ hi ↦ by aesop) _
  simp [sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, hw]

name: _root_.AffineIndependent.affineCombination_mem_shift_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.AffineIndependent.affineCombination_mem_shift_iff
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nontrivial ι] {p : ι → P}
    (h : AffineIndependent k p) (i : ι) {w : ι → k} (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) (c : k) :
    affineCombination k univ p w ∈ (affineSpan k <| p '' {i}ᶜ).shift (p i) c ↔
    w i = 1 - c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ by simpa [h] using affineCombination_mem_shift p i hw⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_ne i
  rw [shift_eq ⟨p j, mem_affineSpan k <| Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hj⟩]
  suffices ∀ q ∈ affineSpan k (p '' {i}ᶜ),
    (1 - c) • (p i -ᵥ p j) +ᵥ q = affineCombination k univ p w → w i = 1 - c by simpa
  intro q hqmem heq
  obtain ⟨t, w', ht, hw', rfl⟩ := eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_image hqmem
  have ht : (t : Set ι).indicator w' i = 0 := Set.indicator_of_notMem (by simpa using ht) w'
  rw [affineCombination_indicator_subset _ _ t.subset_univ,
    ← affineCombination_piSingle k _ p (mem_univ i),
    ← affineCombination_piSingle k _ p (mem_univ j), affineCombination_vsub, ← map_smul,
    weightedVSub_vadd_affineCombination, h.affineCombination_eq_iff_eq ?_ hw] at heq
  · simpa [hj.symm, ht] using (heq i (mem_univ i)).symm
  · simp [sum_add_distrib, sum_indicator_subset, ← mul_sum, hw']

name: shift_eq_map_homothety
statement:
theorem shift_eq_map_homothety (s : AffineSubspace k P) (c : P) {r : k} (hr : IsUnit r) :
    s.shift c r = s.map (homothety c r)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hr.exists_right_inv
  rcases s.eq_bot_or_nonempty with h | h
  · simp [h]
  have h : Nonempty s := by simpa using! h
  rw [s.shift_eq h.some]
  ext p
  suffices (∃ y ∈ s, (1 - r) • (c -ᵥ h.some) +ᵥ y = p) ↔ ∃ y ∈ s, r • (y -ᵥ c) +ᵥ c = p by
    simpa [homothety_def]
  constructor <;> intro ⟨x, hmem, heq⟩ <;> rw [← heq]
  · refine ⟨t • (x -ᵥ h.some.val) +ᵥ h.some.val, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine vadd_mem_of_mem_direction ?_ h.some.prop
      exact smul_mem _ _ <| vsub_mem_direction hmem h.some.prop
    · rw [vadd_vsub_assoc, smul_add, smul_smul, ht, sub_eq_add_neg, add_smul, one_smul, one_smul,
        neg_smul, ← smul_neg, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev]
      simp_rw [add_comm _ (r • (h.some.val -ᵥ c)), ← vadd_vadd, vsub_vadd_comm x h.some.val c]
  · refine ⟨r • (x -ᵥ h.some.val) +ᵥ h.some.val, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine vadd_mem_of_mem_direction ?_ h.some.prop
      exact smul_mem _ _ <| vsub_mem_direction hmem h.some.prop
    · rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_smul, one_smul, neg_smul, ← smul_neg, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev,
        ← vadd_vadd, vadd_vadd _ _ h.some.val, ← smul_add, add_comm, vsub_add_vsub_cancel,
        vadd_vadd, add_comm, ← vadd_vadd, vsub_vadd]

name: closedInterior_inter_shift_zero
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm (fun p ⟨hp, hshift⟩ ↦ ?_) (by simp [s.point_mem_closedInterior i])
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_of_fintype <|
    s.closedInterior_subset_affineSpan hp
  suffices w = Pi.single i 1 by simp [this]
  rw [affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_iff hw] at hp
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, s.independent.affineCombination_mem_shift_iff i hw, sub_zero] at hshift
  ext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · aesop
  rw [← univ.sum_erase_add w (mem_univ i), hshift, add_eq_right,
    sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ ↦ (hp j).1] at hw
  simp [hw j (by simpa using hj), hj]

name: disjoint_closedInterior_shift
statement:
theorem disjoint_closedInterior_shift {x : k} (hx : x < 0 ∨ 1 < x) :
    Disjoint s.closedInterior <| (affineSpan k (s.points '' {i}ᶜ)).shift (s.points i) x
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun p hleft hright ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_of_fintype <|
    s.closedInterior_subset_affineSpan hleft
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, s.independent.affineCombination_mem_shift_iff i hw] at hright
  rw [affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_iff hw] at hleft
  grind

name: closedInterior_inter_shift_aux
statement:
private theorem closedInterior_inter_shift_aux {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) {x : k} (hxpos : 0 < x)
    (hx1 : x ≤ 1) {w : Fin n → k} (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
    (∀ j, w j ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) ∧ w i = 1 - x ↔
    (∀ j, j ≠ i → x⁻¹ * w j ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) ∧ x⁻¹ * (w i - 1) + 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show x⁻¹ * (w i - 1) + 1 = 0 ↔ w i = 1 - x by grind]
  refine and_congr_left fun hi ↦ ⟨fun hj j hji ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun hj ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact mul_nonneg (by simpa using hxpos.le) (hj j).1
  · rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, add_comm, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at hi
    rw [inv_mul_le_one₀ hxpos, hi, le_sub_iff_add_le, ← hw]
    exact add_le_sum (fun i _ ↦ (hj i).1) (mem_univ j) (mem_univ i) hji
  · suffices ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j from
      fun j ↦ ⟨this j, hw ▸ Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ this j) (mem_univ j)⟩
    intro j
    by_cases hji : j = i <;> aesop

name: closedInterior_inter_shift_eq_homothety
statement:
theorem closedInterior_inter_shift_eq_homothety {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (s : Affine.Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) {x : k} (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) :
    s.closedInterior ∩ (affineSpan k (s.points '' {i}ᶜ)).shift (s.points i) x =
    homothety (s.points i) x '' (s.faceOpposite i).closedInterior
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.1.eq_or_lt with hx0 | hxpos
  · simpa [hx0.symm, nonempty_closedInterior] using s.closedInterior_inter_shift_zero i
  ext p
  by_cases hp : p ∈ affineSpan k (.range s.points)
  · obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_of_fintype hp
    rw [Set.mem_inter_iff, SetLike.mem_coe, s.independent.affineCombination_mem_shift_iff i hw,
      affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_iff hw, Set.mem_image]
    simp_rw [AffineMap.homothety_eq_iff_of_mul_eq_one (mul_inv_cancel₀ hxpos.ne.symm),
      univ.homothety_affineCombination _ _ (mem_univ i)]
    simp only [↓existsAndEq, and_true]
    rw [faceOpposite, affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_face_iff_mem_Icc,
      closedInterior_inter_shift_aux i hxpos hx.2 hw]
    · simp only [mem_compl, mem_singleton, not_not, forall_eq]
      congrm (∀ j, (hj : _) → $(by simp [lineMap_apply, hj])) ∧ $(by simp [lineMap_apply])
    · simp [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hw]
  · apply iff_of_false (hp <| s.closedInterior_subset_affineSpan ·.1)
    rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
    exact hp <| homothety_mem (mem_affineSpan _ (by simp)) _ <|
      affineSpan_mono _ (by simp) ((s.faceOpposite i).closedInterior_subset_affineSpan hq)

name: univ_centroid_eq
statement:
theorem univ_centroid_eq (s : Simplex k P n) :
    Finset.univ.centroid k s.points = s.centroid

name: centroid_mem_affineSpan
statement:
theorem centroid_mem_affineSpan [CharZero k] {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n) :
    s.centroid ∈ affineSpan k (Set.range s.points)

name: centroid_eq_affineCombination
statement:
theorem centroid_eq_affineCombination (s : Simplex k P n) :
    s.centroid = affineCombination k univ s.points (centroidWeights k univ)

name: centroid_notMem_affineSpan_of_ne_univ
statement:
theorem centroid_notMem_affineSpan_of_ne_univ [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n)
    {t : Set (Fin (n + 1))} (ht : t ≠ Set.univ) :
    s.centroid ∉ affineSpan k (s.points '' t)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hssubset : t ⊂ Set.univ := by grind
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.exists_of_ssubset hssubset
  rw [s.centroid_eq_affineCombination] at h
  set w := (centroidWeights k (univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))) with wdef
  have hw : ∑ i, w i = 1 := by rw [sum_centroidWeights_eq_one_of_nonempty _ _ (by simp)]
  have h1 := AffineIndependent.eq_zero_of_affineCombination_mem_affineSpan s.independent hw h
    (by simp) hi.2
  have h2 : w i = (1 : k) / (n + 1) := by
    simp [wdef, centroidWeights_apply, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_add,
      Nat.cast_one]
  simp only [h2, one_div, inv_eq_zero] at h1
  norm_cast at h1

name: centroid_vsub_eq
statement:
theorem centroid_vsub_eq {n : ℕ} [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n) (p : P) :
    s.centroid -ᵥ p = (n + 1 : k)⁻¹ • ∑ x, (s.points x -ᵥ p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centroid_vsub_const _ _ (by simp), centroid_def, affineCombination_eq_linear_combination
    (hw := sum_centroidWeights_eq_one_of_nonempty _ _ (by simp))]
  simp [smul_sum]

name: centroid_eq_smul_sum_vsub_vadd
statement:
theorem centroid_eq_smul_sum_vsub_vadd [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.centroid = (n + 1 : k)⁻¹ • ∑ x, (s.points x -ᵥ s.points i) +ᵥ s.points i

name: smul_centroid_vsub_point_eq_sum_vsub
statement:
theorem smul_centroid_vsub_point_eq_sum_vsub [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ((n : k) + 1) • (s.centroid -ᵥ s.points i) = ∑ x, (s.points x -ᵥ s.points i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centroid_eq_smul_sum_vsub_vadd s i, vadd_vsub, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀, one_smul]
  norm_cast

name: centroid_weighted_vsub_eq_zero
statement:
theorem centroid_weighted_vsub_eq_zero [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n) :
    ∑ i, (s.points i -ᵥ s.centroid) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := centroid_vsub_eq s s.centroid
  simp only [vsub_self] at h
  symm at h
  rw [smul_eq_zero_iff_right (inv_ne_zero (by norm_cast))] at h
  exact h

name: eq_centroid_iff_sum_vsub_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_centroid_iff_sum_vsub_eq_zero [CharZero k] {s : Simplex k P n} {p : P} :
    p = s.centroid ↔ ∑ i, (s.points i -ᵥ p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h, centroid_weighted_vsub_eq_zero]
  · intro h
    rw [← vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq]
    have : ∑ i, (s.points i -ᵥ p) = ∑ i, ((s.points i -ᵥ s.centroid) - (p -ᵥ s.centroid)) := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      rw [vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ _ s.centroid]
    rw [this, sum_sub_distrib, centroid_weighted_vsub_eq_zero] at h
    simp only [sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] at h
    have h' : ((n : k) + 1) • (p -ᵥ s.centroid) = 0 := by norm_cast
    rw [smul_eq_zero_iff_right (by norm_cast)] at h'
    exact h'

name: face_centroid_eq_centroid
statement:
theorem face_centroid_eq_centroid {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n) {fs : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {m : ℕ}
    (h : #fs = m + 1) : Finset.univ.centroid k (s.face h).points = fs.centroid k s.points
proof:
:= by
  convert! (Finset.univ.centroid_map k (fs.orderEmbOfFin h).toEmbedding s.points).symm
  rw [← Finset.coe_inj, Finset.coe_map, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ]
  simp

name: centroid_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centroid_eq_iff [CharZero k] {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n) {fs₁ fs₂ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))}
    {m₁ m₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : #fs₁ = m₁ + 1) (h₂ : #fs₂ = m₂ + 1) :
    fs₁.centroid k s.points = fs₂.centroid k s.points ↔ fs₁ = fs₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, @congrArg _ _ fs₁ fs₂ (fun z => Finset.centroid k z s.points)⟩
  rw [Finset.centroid_eq_affineCombination_fintype,
    Finset.centroid_eq_affineCombination_fintype] at h
  have ha :=
    (affineIndependent_iff_indicator_eq_of_affineCombination_eq k s.points).1 s.independent _ _ _ _
      (fs₁.sum_centroidWeightsIndicator_eq_one_of_card_eq_add_one k h₁)
      (fs₂.sum_centroidWeightsIndicator_eq_one_of_card_eq_add_one k h₂) h
  simp_rw [Finset.coe_univ, Set.indicator_univ, funext_iff,
    Finset.centroidWeightsIndicator_def, Finset.centroidWeights, h₁, h₂] at ha
  ext i
  specialize ha i
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : k) + 1 ≠ 0 := fun n h => by norm_cast at h
  
  
  
  constructor <;> intro hi <;> by_contra hni
  · simp [hni, hi, key] at ha
  · simpa [hni, hi, key] using ha.symm

name: face_centroid_eq_iff
statement:
theorem face_centroid_eq_iff [CharZero k] {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n)
    {fs₁ fs₂ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {m₁ m₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : #fs₁ = m₁ + 1) (h₂ : #fs₂ = m₂ + 1) :
    Finset.univ.centroid k (s.face h₁).points = Finset.univ.centroid k (s.face h₂).points ↔
      fs₁ = fs₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [face_centroid_eq_centroid, face_centroid_eq_centroid]
  exact s.centroid_eq_iff h₁ h₂

name: centroid_eq_of_range_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.image_univ, ← Set.image_univ, ← Finset.coe_univ] at h
  exact
    Finset.univ.centroid_eq_of_inj_on_of_image_eq k _
      (fun _ _ _ _ he => AffineIndependent.injective s₁.independent he)
      (fun _ _ _ _ he => AffineIndependent.injective s₂.independent he) h

name: affineIndependent_points_update_centroid
statement:
theorem affineIndependent_points_update_centroid [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    AffineIndependent k (Function.update s.points i s.centroid)
proof:
:= by
  have : s.centroid ∉ affineSpan k (s.points '' {i}ᶜ) :=
    s.centroid_notMem_affineSpan_of_ne_univ (by simp)
  exact AffineIndependent.affineIndependent_update_of_notMem_affineSpan s.independent this

name: centroid_map
statement:
theorem centroid_map [CharZero k] {V₂ P₂ : Type*} [AddCommGroup V₂] [Module k V₂]
    [AffineSpace V₂ P₂] {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n) (f : P →ᵃ[k] P₂)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (s.map f hf).centroid = f (s.centroid)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centroid, map_points, centroid_eq_affineCombination, Finset.map_affineCombination]
  · rw [Finset.centroid]
  · rw [sum_centroidWeights_eq_one_of_card_ne_zero]
    simp

name: centroid_reindex
statement:
theorem centroid_reindex {m n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P m)
    (e : Fin (m + 1) ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    (s.reindex e).centroid = s.centroid
proof:
:= by
  rw [centroid, centroid]
  simp only [centroid_eq_affineCombination]
  simp only [reindex]
  have h_eq : m = n := by simpa using Fintype.card_eq.2 ⟨e⟩
  subst h_eq
  convert! Finset.univ.affineCombination_map e.toEmbedding _ _ <;> simp [Function.comp_assoc]

name: centroid_restrict
statement:
theorem centroid_restrict [CharZero k] {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n) (S : AffineSubspace k P)
    (hS : affineSpan k (Set.range s.points) ≤ S) :
    haveI
proof:
:= Nonempty.map (AffineSubspace.inclusion hS) inferInstance
    (s.restrict S hS).centroid = s.centroid := by
  rw [eq_comm]
  have := Nonempty.map (AffineSubspace.inclusion hS) inferInstance
  have hf : Function.Injective (S.subtype) := by
    simp only [coe_subtype, Subtype.val_injective]
  exact (s.restrict S hS).centroid_map S.subtype hf

name: faceOppositeCentroid_mem_affineSpan_face
statement:
theorem faceOppositeCentroid_mem_affineSpan_face [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.faceOppositeCentroid i ∈ affineSpan k (Set.range (s.faceOpposite i).points)

name: faceOppositeCentroid_eq_affineCombination
statement:
theorem faceOppositeCentroid_eq_affineCombination (s : Affine.Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.faceOppositeCentroid i = ((affineCombination k {i}ᶜ s.points) fun _ ↦ (↑n)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  unfold faceOppositeCentroid
  have : s.faceOpposite i = s.face (fs := {i}ᶜ) (by simp [card_compl, NeZero.one_le]) := by rfl
  rw [this]
  unfold centroid
  rw [face_centroid_eq_centroid, centroid_def, centroidWeights_eq_const, card_compl]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin, card_singleton, add_tsub_cancel_right]
  rfl

name: faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_sum_vsub
statement:
theorem faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_sum_vsub [CharZero k] (s : Affine.Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.faceOppositeCentroid i -ᵥ (s.points i) = (n : k)⁻¹ • ∑ x, (s.points x -ᵥ s.points i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceOppositeCentroid_eq_affineCombination,
    affineCombination_eq_weightedVSubOfPoint_vadd_of_sum_eq_one _ _ _ ?_ (s.points i)]
  · simp only [weightedVSubOfPoint_apply, vadd_vsub]
    have h (i : Fin (n + 1)) : ∑ j ∈ {i}ᶜ, (n : k)⁻¹ • (s.points j -ᵥ s.points i) =
      ∑ j : (Fin (n + 1)), ((n : k)⁻¹ • (s.points j -ᵥ s.points i)) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_compl_add_sum {i}]
      simp
    rw [h i, smul_sum]
  · simp only [sum_const, card_compl, Fintype.card_fin, card_singleton, add_tsub_cancel_right,
      nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne (n : k))]

name: faceOppositeCentroid_eq_sum_vsub_vadd
statement:
theorem faceOppositeCentroid_eq_sum_vsub_vadd [CharZero k] (s : Affine.Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.faceOppositeCentroid i = (n : k)⁻¹ • ∑ x, (s.points x -ᵥ s.points i) +ᵥ (s.points i)

name: point_vsub_faceOppositeCentroid_eq_smul_sum_vsub
statement:
theorem point_vsub_faceOppositeCentroid_eq_smul_sum_vsub [CharZero k] (s : Affine.Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.points i -ᵥ s.faceOppositeCentroid i = (n : k)⁻¹ • ∑ x, (s.points i -ᵥ s.points x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_sum_vsub, ← neg_smul,
    Lean.Grind.Ring.neg_eq_mul_neg_one, ← smul_smul, smul_sum]
  simp only [neg_smul, one_smul, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev]

name: smul_faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_sum_vsub
statement:
theorem smul_faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_sum_vsub [CharZero k] (s : Affine.Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (n : k) • (s.faceOppositeCentroid i -ᵥ s.points i) = ∑ x, (s.points x -ᵥ s.points i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [faceOppositeCentroid_eq_sum_vsub_vadd, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne (n : k)),
    one_smul]

name: smul_centroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point
statement:
theorem smul_centroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point [CharZero k]
    (s : Affine.Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (n + 1 : k) • (s.centroid -ᵥ s.points i) =
    (n : k) • (s.faceOppositeCentroid i -ᵥ s.points i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_sum_vsub s i,
    smul_centroid_vsub_point_eq_sum_vsub s i]

name: faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_faceOppositeCentroid
statement:
theorem faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_faceOppositeCentroid [CharZero k] (s : Affine.Simplex k P n)
    (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.faceOppositeCentroid i -ᵥ s.faceOppositeCentroid j =
    (n : k)⁻¹ • (s.points j -ᵥ s.points i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceOppositeCentroid_eq_sum_vsub_vadd s i, faceOppositeCentroid_eq_sum_vsub_vadd s j,
    vadd_vsub_vadd_comm _ _ (s.points i) (s.points j)]
  have h1 (i : Fin (n + 1)) : ∑ x, (s.points x -ᵥ s.points i) =
      ∑ x, (s.points x -ᵥ s.points 0 - (s.points i -ᵥ s.points 0)) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    simp
  simp_rw [h1 i, h1 j, sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [smul_sub, smul_sub, sub_sub_sub_cancel_left, ← smul_sub, ← sum_sub_distrib,
    vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right, sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have : (s.points i -ᵥ s.points j) = -(s.points j -ᵥ s.points i) := by simp
  rw [this, ← sub_eq_add_neg, add_smul, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, one_smul, smul_add, add_comm]
  have : (n : k)⁻¹ • n • (s.points j -ᵥ s.points i) =
      (n : k)⁻¹ • (n : k) • (s.points j -ᵥ s.points i) := by
    norm_cast0
    congr 1
  rw [this, smul_smul, inv_eq_one_div, one_div_mul_cancel (NeZero.ne (n : k)), one_smul]

name: faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_vsub
statement:
theorem faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_vsub [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.faceOppositeCentroid i -ᵥ s.points i =
    (n + 1 : k) • (s.faceOppositeCentroid i -ᵥ s.centroid)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ (s.centroid) (s.points i),
    faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_sum_vsub, centroid_vsub_eq,
    ← sub_smul, smul_smul]
  congr
  rw [mul_sub, add_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne (n : k)), mul_inv_cancel₀ (by norm_cast),
    one_mul]
  grind

name: point_vsub_faceOppositeCentroid_eq_smul_vsub
statement:
theorem point_vsub_faceOppositeCentroid_eq_smul_vsub [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.points i -ᵥ s.faceOppositeCentroid i =
    (n + 1 : k) • (s.centroid -ᵥ s.faceOppositeCentroid i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_vsub, ← neg_smul,
    ← neg_smul_neg, neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, neg_neg]

name: point_vsub_centroid_eq_smul_vsub
statement:
theorem point_vsub_centroid_eq_smul_vsub [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.points i -ᵥ s.centroid = (n : k) • (s.centroid -ᵥ s.faceOppositeCentroid i)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ _ (s.points i),
    faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_sum_vsub,
    centroid_vsub_eq, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev,
    centroid_vsub_eq, ← sub_smul, smul_smul, ← neg_smul]
  congr
  simp_rw [mul_sub, sub_eq_iff_eq_add, neg_add_eq_sub]
  symm
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add, mul_inv_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne (n : k))]
  have : (↑n + (1 : k))⁻¹ = 1 * (↑n + (1 : k))⁻¹ := by simp
  nth_rw 2 [this]
  rw [← add_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by norm_cast)]

name: centroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_vsub
statement:
theorem centroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_vsub [CharZero k]
    (s : Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.centroid -ᵥ s.points i = (n : k) • (s.faceOppositeCentroid i -ᵥ s.centroid)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, point_vsub_centroid_eq_smul_vsub, ← neg_smul_neg,
    neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, ← neg_smul, neg_neg]

name: faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_centroid_eq_smul_vsub
statement:
theorem faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_centroid_eq_smul_vsub [CharZero k]
    (s : Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.faceOppositeCentroid i -ᵥ s.centroid = (n : k)⁻¹ • (s.centroid -ᵥ s.points i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [centroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_vsub, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne (n : k)), one_smul]

name: centroid_vsub_faceOppositeCentroid_eq_smul_vsub
statement:
theorem centroid_vsub_faceOppositeCentroid_eq_smul_vsub [CharZero k]
    (s : Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.centroid -ᵥ s.faceOppositeCentroid i = (n : k)⁻¹ • (s.points i -ᵥ s.centroid)
proof:
:= by
  rw [point_vsub_centroid_eq_smul_vsub, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne (n : k)), one_smul]

name: centroid_eq_smul_vsub_vadd_point
statement:
theorem centroid_eq_smul_vsub_vadd_point [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.centroid = (n : k) • (s.faceOppositeCentroid i -ᵥ s.centroid) +ᵥ s.points i

name: faceOppositeCentroid_eq_smul_vsub_vadd_point
statement:
theorem faceOppositeCentroid_eq_smul_vsub_vadd_point [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.faceOppositeCentroid i = (n : k)⁻¹ • (s.centroid -ᵥ s.points i) +ᵥ s.centroid
proof:
:= by
  rw [centroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_vsub, eq_vadd_iff_vsub_eq, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (NeZero.ne (n : k)), one_smul]

name: faceOppositeCentroid_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem faceOppositeCentroid_map [CharZero k] {V₂ P₂ : Type*} [AddCommGroup V₂]
    [Module k V₂] [AffineSpace V₂ P₂] {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (s : Simplex k P n) (f : P →ᵃ[k] P₂)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) {i : Fin (n + 1)} :
    (s.map f hf).faceOppositeCentroid i = f (s.faceOppositeCentroid i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [faceOppositeCentroid, faceOpposite_map, centroid_eq_affineCombination, map_points]
  rw [Finset.map_affineCombination]
  rw [sum_centroidWeights_eq_one_of_card_ne_zero]
  simp

name: faceOppositeCentroid_restrict
statement:
@[simp] theorem faceOppositeCentroid_restrict [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n)
    (S : AffineSubspace k P) (hS : affineSpan k (Set.range s.points) ≤ S) {i : Fin (n + 1)} :
    haveI
proof:
:= Nonempty.map (AffineSubspace.inclusion hS) inferInstance
    (s.restrict S hS).faceOppositeCentroid i = s.faceOppositeCentroid i := by
  rw [eq_comm]
  have := Nonempty.map (AffineSubspace.inclusion hS) inferInstance
  have hf : Function.Injective (S.subtype) := by
    simp only [coe_subtype, Subtype.val_injective]
  exact (s.restrict S hS).faceOppositeCentroid_map S.subtype hf (i := i)

name: faceOppositeCentroid_reindex
statement:
@[simp] theorem faceOppositeCentroid_reindex {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] [NeZero n] (s : Simplex k P m)
    (e : Fin (m + 1) ≃ Fin (n + 1)) :
    (s.reindex e).faceOppositeCentroid = s.faceOppositeCentroid ∘ e.symm
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [faceOppositeCentroid]
  obtain rfl : m = n := by simpa using Fintype.card_eq.2 ⟨e⟩
  exact centroid_eq_of_range_eq <| Affine.Simplex.range_faceOpposite_reindex s e i

theorem faceOppositeCentroid_mem_median (s : Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :

name: centroid_mem_median
statement:
theorem centroid_mem_median [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.centroid ∈ s.median i
proof:
:= by
  rw [median]
  have h : s.centroid = ((n : k) * (1 / (n + 1))) • (s.faceOppositeCentroid i -ᵥ s.points i)
    +ᵥ s.points i := by
    rw [eq_vadd_iff_vsub_eq, centroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_vsub,
      faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_point_eq_smul_vsub, smul_smul, one_div, mul_assoc,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (by norm_cast), mul_one]
  rw [h]
  exact smul_vsub_vadd_mem_affineSpan_pair _ _ _

name: median_eq_line_point_centroid
statement:
theorem median_eq_line_point_centroid [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    s.median i = line[k, s.points i, s.centroid]
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : s.median i ≤ line[k, s.points i, s.centroid] := by
    unfold median
    apply affineSpan_pair_le_of_right_mem
    rw [faceOppositeCentroid_eq_smul_vsub_vadd_point]
    have h : (n : k)⁻¹ • (s.centroid -ᵥ s.points i) = (-1 / n : k) • (s.points i -ᵥ s.centroid)
        := by
      rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev]
      have : -(s.points i -ᵥ s.centroid) = (-1 : k) • (s.points i -ᵥ s.centroid) := by simp
      rw [this, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      rw [mul_neg_one, inv_eq_one_div, neg_div]
    rw [h]
    exact smul_vsub_rev_vadd_mem_affineSpan_pair _ _ _
  have h2 : line[k, s.points i, s.centroid] ≤ s.median i := by
    rw [median]
    apply affineSpan_pair_le_of_right_mem
    exact centroid_mem_median s i
  exact le_antisymm h1 h2

name: eq_centroid_of_forall_mem_median
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq]
  set i₀ : Fin (n + 1) := 0
  have hp : p = (p -ᵥ s.centroid) +ᵥ s.centroid := by rw [vsub_vadd]
  let s' : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) := {i₀}ᶜ
  let u : s' → V := fun i => s.points i -ᵥ s.centroid
  have h_span : ∀ i : s', p -ᵥ s.centroid ∈ (Submodule.span k ({u i} : Set V)) := by
    intro i
    have hi := h i
    grind only [median_eq_line_point_centroid, vadd_right_mem_affineSpan_pair,
      Submodule.smul_mem, Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self]
  have hi : LinearIndependent k u := by
    set p : Fin (n + 1) → P := fun x => if x = i₀ then s.centroid else s.points x
    have hindep : AffineIndependent k p := by
      have := affineIndependent_points_update_centroid s i₀
      unfold Function.update at this
      grind
    have h1 := (affineIndependent_iff_linearIndependent_vsub k p i₀).mp hindep
    simp_rw [ne_eq, p] at h1
    set f : {x // x ∈ ({i₀}ᶜ : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))} → {x // x ≠ i₀} :=
      have h (x : {x // x ∈ ({i₀}ᶜ : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))}) : x.val ≠ i₀ := by
        grind [mem_compl, Finset.notMem_singleton]
      fun x => ⟨x.val, h x⟩
    have f_inj : Function.Injective f := by intro x y hxy; grind
    have h2 := h1.comp f f_inj
    convert! h2 using 1
    grind only [mem_compl, Finset.notMem_singleton]
  have he : ∃ i j : s', i ≠ j := by
    simp only [ne_eq, Subtype.exists, Subtype.mk.injEq, exists_prop]
    have hcard : s'.card = n := by
      rw [Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_fin, card_singleton, add_tsub_cancel_right]
    have hcard' : 1 < #s' := by grind
    rw [Finset.one_lt_card_iff] at hcard'
    tauto
  choose i j hij using he
  have h_ij : Disjoint ({i} : Set {x // x ∈ s'}) {j} := by simp [hij]
  have h_disjoint : Disjoint (Submodule.span k {u i}) (Submodule.span k {u j}) := by
    simp_rw [← Set.image_singleton, hi.disjoint_span_image h_ij]
  exact Submodule.disjoint_def.1 h_disjoint _ (h_span i) (h_span j)

name: affineSpan_range_medial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem affineSpan_range_medial [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n) :
    affineSpan k (Set.range (s.medial.points)) = affineSpan k (Set.range (s.points))
proof:
:= by
  have hmem1 : s.medial.points 0 ∈ affineSpan k (Set.range s.medial.points) :=
    mem_affineSpan _ (by simp)
  have hmem2 : s.medial.points 0 ∈ affineSpan k (Set.range s.points) := by
    apply Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset (s.faceOppositeCentroid_mem_affineSpan_face 0)
    exact affineSpan_mono k (by simp)
  rw [eq_iff_direction_eq_of_mem hmem1 hmem2]
  simp_rw [direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_def]
  suffices Set.range s.medial.points -ᵥ Set.range s.medial.points
    = (-n : k)⁻¹ • (Set.range s.points -ᵥ Set.range s.points) by
    rw [this, Submodule.span_smul_eq_of_isUnit]
    simpa using NeZero.ne n
  ext v
  suffices (∃ a b, (n : k)⁻¹ • (s.points b -ᵥ s.points a) = v) ↔
    ∃ a b, -((n : k)⁻¹ • (s.points a -ᵥ s.points b)) = v by
    simpa [Set.mem_vsub, Set.mem_smul_set, medial_points,
      faceOppositeCentroid_vsub_faceOppositeCentroid]
  congrm ∃ a b, ?_ = v
  simp [← smul_neg]

name: medial_restrict
statement:
theorem medial_restrict [CharZero k] (s : Simplex k P n) (S : AffineSubspace k P)
    (hS : affineSpan k (Set.range s.points) ≤ S) :
    haveI
proof:
:= Nonempty.map (AffineSubspace.inclusion hS) inferInstance
    (s.restrict S hS).medial = s.medial.restrict S (s.affineSpan_range_medial ▸ hS) := by
  have := Nonempty.map (AffineSubspace.inclusion hS) inferInstance
  ext i
  simp [medial_points]

statement:
lemma affineCombination_mem_affineSpan_faceOpposite_iff {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {s : Simplex k P n}
    {w : Fin (n + 1) → k} (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) {i : Fin (n + 1)} :
    Finset.univ.affineCombination k s.points w ∈
      affineSpan k (Set.range (s.faceOpposite i).points) ↔ w i = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [range_faceOpposite_points] at h
    exact s.independent.eq_zero_of_affineCombination_mem_affineSpan hw h (Finset.mem_univ i)
      (by simp)
  · rw [range_faceOpposite_points]
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial k with hk | hk
    · have : Subsingleton V := Module.subsingleton k _
      have : Subsingleton P := (AddTorsor.subsingleton_iff V P).1 inferInstance
      rw [(affineSpan_eq_top_iff_nonempty_of_subsingleton k).2 (by simp)]
      simp
    · exact affineCombination_mem_affineSpan_image hw (by simpa using h) s.points

name: affineCombination_mem_setInterior_iff
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨w', hw', hw'01, hww'⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨w, hw, h, rfl⟩⟩
  simp_rw [← (affineIndependent_iff_eq_of_fintype_affineCombination_eq k s.points).1
    s.independent w' w hw' hw hww']
  exact hw'01

name: setInterior_reindex
statement:
@[simp] lemma setInterior_reindex (I : Set k) {m n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n)
    (e : Fin (n + 1) ≃ Fin (m + 1)) : (s.reindex e).setInterior I = s.setInterior I
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  refine ⟨fun ⟨w, hw, hwI, h⟩ ↦ ?_, fun ⟨w, hw, hwI, h⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · subst h
    simp_rw [reindex]
    rw [← Function.comp_id w, ← e.self_comp_symm, ← Function.comp_assoc,
      ← Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, ← Finset.univ.affineCombination_map e.symm.toEmbedding,
      map_univ_equiv]
    have hw' : ∑ i, (w ∘ e) i = 1 := by rwa [sum_comp_equiv, map_univ_equiv]
    rw [affineCombination_mem_setInterior_iff hw']
    exact fun i ↦ hwI (e i)
  · subst h
    rw [← Function.comp_id w, ← Function.comp_id s.points, ← e.symm_comp_self,
      ← Function.comp_assoc, ← Function.comp_assoc, ← e.coe_toEmbedding,
      ← Finset.univ.affineCombination_map e.toEmbedding, map_univ_equiv]
    change Finset.univ.affineCombination k (s.reindex e).points _ ∈ _
    have hw' : ∑ i, (w ∘ e.symm) i = 1 := by rwa [sum_comp_equiv, map_univ_equiv]
    rw [affineCombination_mem_setInterior_iff hw']
    exact fun i ↦ hwI (e.symm i)

name: setInterior_mono
statement:
lemma setInterior_mono {I J : Set k} (hij : I ⊆ J) {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n) :

proof:
:=
  fun _ ⟨w, hw, hw01, hww⟩ ↦ ⟨w, hw, fun i ↦ hij (hw01 i), hww⟩

name: setInterior_subset_affineSpan
statement:
lemma setInterior_subset_affineSpan {I : Set k} {n : ℕ} {s : Simplex k P n} :
    s.setInterior I ⊆ affineSpan k (Set.range s.points)

:= by
  rintro p ⟨w, hw, hi, rfl⟩

name: setInterior_map
statement:
lemma setInterior_map (I : Set k) {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n) {f : P →ᵃ[k] P₂}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) : (s.map f hf).setInterior I = f '' s.setInterior I
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  rw [Set.mem_image]
  by_cases hp : p ∈ affineSpan k (Set.range (s.map f hf).points)
  · obtain ⟨w, hw1, hw⟩ := eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_of_fintype hp
    rw [hw, Affine.Simplex.affineCombination_mem_setInterior_iff hw1, Simplex.map_points,
      ← Finset.map_affineCombination _ _ _ hw1]
    simp_rw [hf.eq_iff]
    simp [Affine.Simplex.affineCombination_mem_setInterior_iff hw1]
  · apply iff_of_false
    · exact fun h ↦ hp (Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset h (s.map f hf).setInterior_subset_affineSpan)
    · contrapose hp
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩ := hp
      rw [s.map_points, Set.range_comp, ← AffineSubspace.map_span, AffineSubspace.mem_map]
      exact ⟨q, (Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset hq s.setInterior_subset_affineSpan), hqp⟩

name: setInterior_restrict
proof:
:= Nonempty.map (AffineSubspace.inclusion hS) inferInstance
    (s.restrict S hS).setInterior I = S.subtype ⁻¹' (s.setInterior I) := by
  let := Nonempty.map (AffineSubspace.inclusion hS) inferInstance
  rw [← S.subtype_injective.image_injective.eq_iff,
    Set.image_preimage_eq_of_subset (s.setInterior_subset_affineSpan.trans (by simpa using! hS)),
    ← (s.restrict S hS).setInterior_map I S.subtype_injective]
  rfl
