name: affineCombination_mem_setInterior_face_iff_mem
statement:
lemma affineCombination_mem_setInterior_face_iff_mem (I : Set k) {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n)
    {fs : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {m : ℕ} (h : #fs = m + 1) {w : Fin (n + 1) → k}
    (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) : Finset.univ.affineCombination k s.points w ∈ (s.face h).setInterior I ↔
      (∀ i ∈ fs, w i ∈ I) ∧ (∀ i ∉ fs, w i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hi ↦ ?_, fun ⟨hii, hi0⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨w', hw', he⟩ := eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_of_fintype
      (Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset hi setInterior_subset_affineSpan)
    rw [he, affineCombination_mem_setInterior_iff hw'] at hi
    have he' := s.independent.indicator_extend_eq_of_affineCombination_comp_embedding_eq_of_fintype
      hw hw' (fs.orderEmbOfFin h).toEmbedding he.symm
    simp_rw [he'.symm]
    refine ⟨fun i hi ↦ ?_, fun i hi ↦ by simp [hi]⟩
    simp only [RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding, range_orderEmbOfFin, mem_coe, hi, Set.indicator_of_mem]
    rw [← mem_coe, ← fs.range_orderEmbOfFin h] at hi
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hi
    simp [(fs.orderEmbOfFin h).injective.extend_apply, hi]
  · let w' : Fin (m + 1) → k := w ∘ fs.orderEmbOfFin h
    have hw' : ∑ i, w' i = 1 := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_of_injective _ (fs.orderEmbOfFin h).injective w' w
        (fun i hi ↦ hi0 _ (by simpa using hi)) (fun _ ↦ rfl), hw]
    have hw'01 (i) : w' i ∈ I := hii (fs.orderEmbOfFin h i) (by simp)
    rw [← (s.face h).affineCombination_mem_setInterior_iff hw'] at hw'01
    convert! hw'01
    convert! Finset.univ.affineCombination_map (fs.orderEmbOfFin h).toEmbedding w s.points using 1
    simp only [map_orderEmbOfFin_univ, Finset.affineCombination_indicator_subset _ _ fs.subset_univ]
    congr
    grind [Set.indicator_eq_self, mem_support]

name: affineCombination_mem_interior_face_iff_mem_Ioo
statement:
lemma affineCombination_mem_interior_face_iff_mem_Ioo {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n)
    {fs : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {m : ℕ} (h : #fs = m + 1) {w : Fin (n + 1) → k}
    (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) : Finset.univ.affineCombination k s.points w ∈ (s.face h).interior ↔
      (∀ i ∈ fs, w i ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) ∧ (∀ i ∉ fs, w i = 0)

lemma affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_face_iff_mem_Icc {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n)

    (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) : Finset.univ.affineCombination k s.points w ∈ (s.face h).closedInterior ↔
      (∀ i ∈ fs, w i ∈ Set.Icc 0 1) ∧ (∀ i ∉ fs, w i = 0)

name: affineCombination_mem_interior_face_iff_pos
statement:
lemma affineCombination_mem_interior_face_iff_pos [IsOrderedAddMonoid k] {n : ℕ}
    (s : Simplex k P n) {fs : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (h : #fs = m + 1)
    {w : Fin (n + 1) → k} (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
    Finset.univ.affineCombination k s.points w ∈ (s.face h).interior ↔
      (∀ i ∈ fs, 0 < w i) ∧ (∀ i ∉ fs, w i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [s.affineCombination_mem_interior_face_iff_mem_Ioo h hw]
  refine ⟨by grind, fun ⟨hii, hi0⟩ ↦ ⟨fun i hi ↦ ⟨hii i hi, ?_⟩, hi0⟩⟩
  rw [← hw, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ fs) fun j _ ↦ hi0 j]
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hji⟩ := fs.exists_mem_ne (by grind [→ NeZero.ne]) i
  exact Finset.single_lt_sum hji hi hj (hii j hj) fun t ht _ ↦ (hii t ht).le

name: affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_face_iff_nonneg
statement:
lemma affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_face_iff_nonneg [IsOrderedAddMonoid k] {n : ℕ}
    (s : Simplex k P n) {fs : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {m : ℕ} (h : #fs = m + 1)
    {w : Fin (n + 1) → k} (hw : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
    Finset.univ.affineCombination k s.points w ∈ (s.face h).closedInterior ↔
      (∀ i ∈ fs, 0 ≤ w i) ∧ (∀ i ∉ fs, w i = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [s.affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_face_iff_mem_Icc h hw]
  refine ⟨by grind, fun ⟨hii, hi0⟩ ↦ ⟨fun i hi ↦ ⟨hii i hi, ?_⟩, hi0⟩⟩
  rw [← hw, ← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ fs) fun j _ ↦ hi0 j]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun t ht ↦ (hii t ht)) hi

name: closedInterior_face_subset_closedInterior
statement:
theorem closedInterior_face_subset_closedInterior [ZeroLEOneClass k] {n : ℕ} (s : Simplex k P n)
    {fs : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {m : ℕ} (h : #fs = m + 1) :
    (s.face h).closedInterior ⊆ s.closedInterior
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have hp' : p ∈ affineSpan k (Set.range s.points) :=
    Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset hp <|
      (s.face h).closedInterior_subset_affineSpan.trans <|
        affineSpan_mono k <| by simp
  obtain ⟨w, hw1, rfl⟩ := eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_of_fintype hp'
  rw [affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_face_iff_mem_Icc _ _ hw1] at hp
  rw [affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_iff hw1]
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ fs <;> aesop

name: point_mem_closedInterior_face_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem point_mem_closedInterior_face_iff [Nontrivial k] [ZeroLEOneClass k] {n : ℕ}
    (s : Simplex k P n) {fs : Finset (Fin (n + 1))} {m : ℕ} (h : #fs = m + 1) {j : Fin (n + 1)} :
    s.points j ∈ (s.face h).closedInterior ↔ j ∈ fs
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hj ↦ ?_, fun hfs ↦ ?_⟩
  · suffices s.points j ∈ affineSpan k (s.points '' fs) by simpa
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hw', hs⟩ := hj
    rw [← hs]
    exact Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset (affineCombination_mem_affineSpan hw _) (by simp)
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, fs.orderEmbOfFin h i = j := range_orderEmbOfFin fs h |>.ge hfs
    exact point_mem_closedInterior _ _

name: closedInterior_face_ssubset_closedInterior
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Classical.not_forall.mp <| Finset.eq_univ_iff_forall.not.mp hfs
  apply (Set.ssubset_iff_of_subset (s.closedInterior_face_subset_closedInterior h)).mpr
  exact ⟨s.points a, s.point_mem_closedInterior a, fun hs ↦ ha (by simpa using hs)⟩

name: disjoint_interior_closedInterior_face
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun p hleft hright ↦ ?_
  have hp : p ∈ affineSpan k (Set.range s.points) :=
    Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset hleft <| s.interior_subset_closedInterior.trans <|
      s.closedInterior_subset_affineSpan
  grind [affineCombination_mem_interior_iff, affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_face_iff_mem_Icc,
    eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_of_fintype]

name: closedInterior_eq_interior_union
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro p hp
    obtain hp' := Set.mem_of_mem_of_subset hp s.closedInterior_subset_affineSpan
    obtain ⟨w, hw1, rfl⟩ := eq_affineCombination_of_mem_affineSpan_of_fintype hp'
    rw [Set.mem_union, or_iff_not_imp_left]
    intro h
    rw [affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_iff hw1] at hp
    simp_rw [affineCombination_mem_interior_iff hw1, Set.mem_Ioo] at h
    push +distrib Not at h
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : Fin (n + 1), w j = 0 := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := h
      · exact ⟨i, le_antisymm hi (hp i).1⟩
      · have hi1 : w i = 1 := le_antisymm (hp i).2 hi
        rw [← hi1, ← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (show i ∈ Finset.univ by simp), add_eq_right,
          Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ ↦ (hp j).1)] at hw1
        exact ⟨i + 1, hw1 _ (by simp)⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, ?_⟩
    rw [faceOpposite, affineCombination_mem_closedInterior_face_iff_mem_Icc _ _ hw1]
    exact ⟨fun k _ ↦ hp k, by simpa using hj⟩
  · refine Set.union_subset s.interior_subset_closedInterior (Set.iUnion_subset fun i ↦ ?_)
    exact s.closedInterior_faceOpposite_subset_closedInterior i

name: closedInterior_sdiff_interior
statement:
theorem closedInterior_sdiff_interior [IsOrderedAddMonoid k] [ZeroLEOneClass k]
    {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (s : Simplex k P n) :
    s.closedInterior \ s.interior = ⋃ i : Fin (n + 1), (s.faceOpposite i).closedInterior
proof:
:= by
  simpa [closedInterior_eq_interior_union] using
    fun i ↦ (s.disjoint_interior_closedInterior_faceOpposite i).symm

name: gradedCommAux_lof_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedCommAux_lof_tmul (i j : ι) (a : 𝒜 i) (b : ℬ j) :
    gradedCommAux R 𝒜 ℬ (lof R _ 𝒜ℬ (i, j) (a ⊗ₜ b)) =
      (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (j * i) • lof R _ ℬ𝒜 (j, i) (b ⊗ₜ a)

name: gradedCommAux_comp_gradedCommAux
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedCommAux_comp_gradedCommAux :
    gradedCommAux R 𝒜 ℬ ∘ₗ gradedCommAux R ℬ 𝒜 = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext i a b
  dsimp
  rw [gradedCommAux_lof_tmul, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, gradedCommAux_lof_tmul, smul_smul,
    mul_comm i.2 i.1, Int.units_mul_self, one_smul]

name: gradedComm_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gradedComm_symm : (gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ).symm = gradedComm R ℬ 𝒜

name: gradedComm_of_tmul_of
statement:
theorem gradedComm_of_tmul_of (i j : ι) (a : 𝒜 i) (b : ℬ j) :
    gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ (lof R _ 𝒜 i a ⊗ₜ lof R _ ℬ j b) =
      (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (j * i) • (lof R _ ℬ _ b ⊗ₜ lof R _ 𝒜 _ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradedComm]
  dsimp only [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_ofLinearMap]
  rw [TensorProduct.directSum_lof_tmul_lof, gradedCommAux_lof_tmul, Units.smul_def,
    
    ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, LinearEquiv.map_smul, TensorProduct.directSum_symm_lof_tmul,
    Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, ← Units.smul_def]

name: gradedComm_tmul_of_zero
statement:
theorem gradedComm_tmul_of_zero (a : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) (b : ℬ 0) :
    gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ (a ⊗ₜ lof R _ ℬ 0 b) = lof R _ ℬ _ b ⊗ₜ a
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    (gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.mk R (⨁ i, 𝒜 i) (⨁ i, ℬ i)).flip (lof R _ ℬ 0 b) =
      TensorProduct.mk R _ _ (lof R _ ℬ 0 b) from
    DFunLike.congr_fun this a
  ext i a
  dsimp
  rw [gradedComm_of_tmul_of, zero_mul, uzpow_zero, one_smul]

name: gradedComm_of_zero_tmul
statement:
theorem gradedComm_of_zero_tmul (a : 𝒜 0) (b : ⨁ i, ℬ i) :

proof:
:= by
  suffices
    (gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.mk R (⨁ i, 𝒜 i) (⨁ i, ℬ i)) (lof R _ 𝒜 0 a) =
      (TensorProduct.mk R _ _).flip (lof R _ 𝒜 0 a) from
    DFunLike.congr_fun this b
  ext i b
  dsimp
  rw [gradedComm_of_tmul_of, mul_zero, uzpow_zero, one_smul]

name: gradedComm_algebraMap
statement:
theorem gradedComm_algebraMap [DirectSum.GSemiring 𝒜] [DirectSum.GSemiring ℬ]
    [DirectSum.GAlgebra R 𝒜] [DirectSum.GAlgebra R ℬ] (r : R) :
    gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ (algebraMap R _ r) = algebraMap R _ r

name: tmul_of_gradedMul_of_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_of_gradedMul_of_tmul (j₁ i₂ : ι)
    (a₁ : ⨁ i, 𝒜 i) (b₁ : ℬ j₁) (a₂ : 𝒜 i₂) (b₂ : ⨁ i, ℬ i) :
    gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ (a₁ ⊗ₜ lof R _ ℬ j₁ b₁) (lof R _ 𝒜 i₂ a₂ ⊗ₜ b₂) =
      (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (j₁ * i₂) • ((a₁ * lof R _ 𝒜 _ a₂) ⊗ₜ (lof R _ ℬ _ b₁ * b₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [gradedMul]
  dsimp only [curry_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply, assoc_tmul,
    map_tmul, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq, assoc_symm_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
    LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
  rw [mul_comm j₁ i₂, gradedComm_of_tmul_of]
  
  rw [Units.smul_def, Units.smul_def, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R]
  
  rw [← smul_tmul', LinearEquiv.map_smul, tmul_smul, LinearEquiv.map_smul, map_smul]
  dsimp

name: algebraMap_gradedMul
statement:
theorem algebraMap_gradedMul (r : R) (x : (⨁ i, 𝒜 i) ⊗[R] (⨁ i, ℬ i)) :
    gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ (algebraMap R _ r ⊗ₜ 1) x = r • x
proof:
:= by
  suffices gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ (algebraMap R _ r ⊗ₜ 1) = DistribSMul.toLinearMap R _ r by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun this x
  ext ia a ib b
  dsimp
  erw [tmul_of_gradedMul_of_tmul]
  rw [zero_mul, uzpow_zero, one_smul, smul_tmul']
  erw [one_mul, _root_.Algebra.smul_def]

name: one_gradedMul
statement:
theorem one_gradedMul (x : (⨁ i, 𝒜 i) ⊗[R] (⨁ i, ℬ i)) :
    gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  
  simpa only [RingHom.map_one, one_smul] using! algebraMap_gradedMul 𝒜 ℬ 1 x

name: gradedMul_algebraMap
statement:
theorem gradedMul_algebraMap (x : (⨁ i, 𝒜 i) ⊗[R] (⨁ i, ℬ i)) (r : R) :
    gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ x (algebraMap R _ r ⊗ₜ 1) = r • x
proof:
:= by
  suffices (gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ).flip (algebraMap R _ r ⊗ₜ 1) = DistribSMul.toLinearMap R _ r by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun this x
  ext
  dsimp
  erw [tmul_of_gradedMul_of_tmul]
  rw [mul_zero, uzpow_zero, one_smul, smul_tmul',
      mul_one, _root_.Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.commutes]
  rfl

name: gradedMul_one
statement:
theorem gradedMul_one (x : (⨁ i, 𝒜 i) ⊗[R] (⨁ i, ℬ i)) :
    gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ x 1 = x
proof:
:= by
  
  simpa only [RingHom.map_one, one_smul] using! gradedMul_algebraMap 𝒜 ℬ x 1

name: gradedMul_assoc
statement:
theorem gradedMul_assoc (x y z : DirectSum _ 𝒜 ⊗[R] DirectSum _ ℬ) :
    gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ (gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ x y) z = gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ x (gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ y z)
proof:
:= by
  let mA := gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ
    
  suffices LinearMap.llcomp R _ _ _ mA ∘ₗ mA =
      (LinearMap.llcomp R _ _ _ LinearMap.lflip.toLinearMap <|
        LinearMap.llcomp R _ _ _ mA.flip ∘ₗ mA).flip by
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun this x) y) z
  ext ixa xa ixb xb iya ya iyb yb iza za izb zb
  dsimp [mA]
  simp_rw [tmul_of_gradedMul_of_tmul, Units.smul_def, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R,
    LinearMap.map_smul₂, map_smul, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_mul_of,
    ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, tmul_of_gradedMul_of_tmul, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, ← DirectSum.of_mul_of,
    ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, mul_assoc]
  simp_rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, ← Units.smul_def, smul_smul, ← uzpow_add, add_mul, mul_add]
  congr 2
  abel

name: gradedComm_gradedMul
statement:
theorem gradedComm_gradedMul (x y : DirectSum _ 𝒜 ⊗[R] DirectSum _ ℬ) :
    gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ (gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ x y)
      = gradedMul R ℬ 𝒜 (gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ x) (gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ y)
proof:
:= by
  suffices (gradedMul R 𝒜 ℬ).compr₂ (gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ).toLinearMap
      = (gradedMul R ℬ 𝒜 ∘ₗ (gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ).toLinearMap).compl₂
        (gradedComm R 𝒜 ℬ).toLinearMap from
    LinearMap.congr_fun₂ this x y
  ext i₁ a₁ j₁ b₁ i₂ a₂ j₂ b₂
  dsimp
  rw [gradedComm_of_tmul_of, gradedComm_of_tmul_of, tmul_of_gradedMul_of_tmul]
  
  simp_rw [Units.smul_def, ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, LinearEquiv.map_smul, map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply]
  simp_rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, ← Units.smul_def, DirectSum.lof_eq_of, DirectSum.of_mul_of,
    ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R, gradedComm_of_tmul_of, tmul_of_gradedMul_of_tmul, smul_smul,
    DirectSum.lof_eq_of, ← DirectSum.of_mul_of, ← DirectSum.lof_eq_of R]
  simp_rw [← uzpow_add, mul_add, add_mul, mul_comm i₁ j₂]
  congr 1
  abel_nf
  rw [two_nsmul, uzpow_add, uzpow_add, Int.units_mul_self, one_mul]

name: of_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem of_one : of R 𝒜 ℬ 1 = 1

name: of_symm_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem of_symm_one : (of R 𝒜 ℬ).symm 1 = 1

name: of_symm_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem of_symm_of (x : A ⊗[R] B) : (of R 𝒜 ℬ).symm (of R 𝒜 ℬ x) = x

name: symm_of_of
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_of_of (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) : of R 𝒜 ℬ ((of R 𝒜 ℬ).symm x) = x

name: hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {M} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] ⦃f g : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ →ₗ[R] M⦄
    (h : f ∘ₗ of R 𝒜 ℬ = (g ∘ₗ of R 𝒜 ℬ : A ⊗[R] B →ₗ[R] M)) :
    f = g

name: auxEquiv_tmul
statement:
theorem auxEquiv_tmul (a : A) (b : B) :
    auxEquiv R 𝒜 ℬ (a ᵍ⊗ₜ b) = decompose 𝒜 a ⊗ₜ decompose ℬ b

name: auxEquiv_one
statement: theorem auxEquiv_one : auxEquiv R 𝒜 ℬ 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← of_one, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def, auxEquiv_tmul 𝒜 ℬ, DirectSum.decompose_one,
    DirectSum.decompose_one, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]

name: auxEquiv_symm_one
statement: theorem auxEquiv_symm_one : (auxEquiv R 𝒜 ℬ).symm 1 = 1

name: mulHom_apply
statement:
theorem mulHom_apply (x y : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) :
    mulHom 𝒜 ℬ x y
      = (auxEquiv R 𝒜 ℬ).symm (gradedMul R (𝒜 ·) (ℬ ·) (auxEquiv R 𝒜 ℬ x) (auxEquiv R 𝒜 ℬ y))

name: mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def (x y : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) : x * y = mulHom 𝒜 ℬ x y

name: auxEquiv_mul
statement:
theorem auxEquiv_mul (x y : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) :
    auxEquiv R 𝒜 ℬ (x * y) = gradedMul R (𝒜 ·) (ℬ ·) (auxEquiv R 𝒜 ℬ x) (auxEquiv R 𝒜 ℬ y)

name: tmul_coe_mul_coe_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_coe_mul_coe_tmul {j₁ i₂ : ι} (a₁ : A) (b₁ : ℬ j₁) (a₂ : 𝒜 i₂) (b₂ : B) :
    (a₁ ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b₁ : B) * (a₂ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) =
      (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (j₁ * i₂) • ((a₁ * a₂ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ (b₁ * b₂ : B))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [mul_def, mulHom_apply, of_symm_of]
  dsimp [auxEquiv, tmul]
  rw [decompose_coe, decompose_coe]
  simp_rw [← lof_eq_of R]
  rw [tmul_of_gradedMul_of_tmul]
  simp_rw [lof_eq_of R]
  
  rw [@Units.smul_def _ _ (_) (_), ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, LinearEquiv.map_smul, map_smul,
    Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R, ← @Units.smul_def _ _ (_) (_)]
  simp [decompose_symm_mul, decompose_symm_of, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: tmul_zero_coe_mul_coe_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_zero_coe_mul_coe_tmul {i₂ : ι} (a₁ : A) (b₁ : ℬ 0) (a₂ : 𝒜 i₂) (b₂ : B) :
    (a₁ ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b₁ : B) * (a₂ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) =
      ((a₁ * a₂ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ (b₁ * b₂ : B))

name: tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul {j₁ : ι} (a₁ : A) (b₁ : ℬ j₁) (a₂ : 𝒜 0) (b₂ : B) :
    (a₁ ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b₁ : B) * (a₂ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) =
      ((a₁ * a₂ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ (b₁ * b₂ : B))

name: tmul_one_mul_coe_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_one_mul_coe_tmul {i₂ : ι} (a₁ : A) (a₂ : 𝒜 i₂) (b₂ : B) :
    (a₁ ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) * (a₂ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = (a₁ * a₂ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ (b₂ : B)
proof:
:= by
  convert! tmul_zero_coe_mul_coe_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a₁ (@GradedMonoid.GOne.one _ (ℬ ·) _ _) a₂ b₂
  rw [SetLike.coe_gOne, one_mul]

name: tmul_coe_mul_one_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_coe_mul_one_tmul {j₁ : ι} (a₁ : A) (b₁ : ℬ j₁) (b₂ : B) :
    (a₁ ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b₁ : B) * (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = (a₁ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ (b₁ * b₂ : B)
proof:
:= by
  convert! tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a₁ b₁ (@GradedMonoid.GOne.one _ (𝒜 ·) _ _) b₂
  rw [SetLike.coe_gOne, mul_one]

name: tmul_one_mul_one_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_one_mul_one_tmul (a₁ : A) (b₂ : B) :
    (a₁ ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B) * (1 : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) = (a₁ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ (b₂ : B)
proof:
:= by
  convert!
    tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a₁ (GradedMonoid.GOne.one (A := (ℬ ·)))
      (GradedMonoid.GOne.one (A := (𝒜 ·))) b₂
  · rw [SetLike.coe_gOne, mul_one]
  · rw [SetLike.coe_gOne, one_mul]

name: algebraMap_def
statement: lemma algebraMap_def (r : R) : algebraMap R (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) r = algebraMap R A r ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] 1

name: tmul_algebraMap_mul_coe_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_algebraMap_mul_coe_tmul {i₂ : ι} (a₁ : A) (r : R) (a₂ : 𝒜 i₂) (b₂ : B) :
    (a₁ ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] algebraMap R B r * (a₂ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ)
      = (a₁ * a₂ : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ (algebraMap R B r * b₂ : B)
proof:
:=
  tmul_zero_coe_mul_coe_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a₁ (GAlgebra.toFun (A := (ℬ ·)) r) a₂ b₂

name: tmul_coe_mul_algebraMap_tmul
statement:
theorem tmul_coe_mul_algebraMap_tmul {j₁ : ι} (a₁ : A) (b₁ : ℬ j₁) (r : R) (b₂ : B) :
    (a₁ ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] (b₁ : B) * algebraMap R A r ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] b₂ : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ)
      = (a₁ * algebraMap R A r : A) ᵍ⊗ₜ (b₁ * b₂ : B)
proof:
:=
  tmul_coe_mul_zero_coe_tmul 𝒜 ℬ a₁ b₁ (GAlgebra.toFun (A := (𝒜 ·)) r) b₂

name: algebraMap_def'
statement: lemma algebraMap_def' (r : R) : algebraMap R (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) r = 1 ᵍ⊗ₜ[R] algebraMap R B r

name: lift_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_tmul (f : A →ₐ[R] C) (g : B →ₐ[R] C)
    (h_anti_commutes : ∀ ⦃i j⦄ (a : 𝒜 i) (b : ℬ j), f a * g b = (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (j * i) • (g b * f a))
    (a : A) (b : B) :
    lift 𝒜 ℬ f g h_anti_commutes (a ᵍ⊗ₜ b) = f a * g b

name: algHom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma algHom_ext ⦃f g : (𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) →ₐ[R] C⦄
    (ha : f.comp (includeLeft 𝒜 ℬ) = g.comp (includeLeft 𝒜 ℬ))
    (hb : f.comp (includeRight 𝒜 ℬ) = g.comp (includeRight 𝒜 ℬ)) : f = g
proof:
:=
  (liftEquiv 𝒜 ℬ).symm.injective <| Subtype.ext <| Prod.ext ha hb

name: auxEquiv_comm
statement:
lemma auxEquiv_comm (x : 𝒜 ᵍ⊗[R] ℬ) :
    auxEquiv R ℬ 𝒜 (comm 𝒜 ℬ x) = gradedComm R (𝒜 ·) (ℬ ·) (auxEquiv R 𝒜 ℬ x)

name: comm_coe_tmul_coe
statement:
@[simp] lemma comm_coe_tmul_coe {i j : ι} (a : 𝒜 i) (b : ℬ j) :
    comm 𝒜 ℬ (a ᵍ⊗ₜ b) = (-1 : ℤˣ) ^ (j * i) • (b ᵍ⊗ₜ a : ℬ ᵍ⊗[R] 𝒜)
proof:
:=
  (auxEquiv R ℬ 𝒜).injective <| by
    simp_rw [auxEquiv_comm, auxEquiv_tmul, decompose_coe, ← lof_eq_of R, gradedComm_of_tmul_of,
      @Units.smul_def _ _ (_) (_), ← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R]
    
    rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul, auxEquiv_tmul]
    simp_rw [decompose_coe, lof_eq_of]

name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mem_lineStab_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.mem_lineStab_iff (A : SpecialLinearGroup ι F)
    (L : Submodule F (ι → F)) : A ∈ lineStab L ↔ ∀ w : ι → F, A • w - w ∈ L

name: PSL.smul_submodule
statement:
lemma PSL.smul_submodule (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) (p : ℙ F (ι → F)) :
    (g • p).submodule = g • p.submodule
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Projectivization.ind with | _ v hv => ?_
  simp [Submodule.ext_iff, Submodule.pointwise_smul_def, Submodule.mem_span_singleton, smul_comm]

name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab_smul
statement:
lemma Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab_smul
    (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F) (L : Submodule F (ι → F)) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab (g • L) =
      MulAut.conj g • Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab L
proof:
:= by
  ext A
  rw [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  simp only [mem_lineStab_iff, Submodule.mem_smul_pointwise_iff_exists, MulAut.smul_def,
    MulAut.inv_apply, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]
  refine ⟨fun hA w ↦ ?_, fun hA w ↦ ⟨g⁻¹ • (A • w - w), ?_, by simp⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨v, hv, hvw⟩ := hA (g • w)
    simp_all [eq_comm (a := g • v), sub_eq_iff_eq_add, mul_smul]
  · simpa [mul_smul, smul_sub] using hA (g⁻¹ • w)

name: PSL.iwasawaT_map_conj
statement:
lemma PSL.iwasawaT_map_conj (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F)
    (H : Subgroup (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F)) :
    Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.center (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F)))
        (MulAut.conj g • H) =
      MulAut.conj (QuotientGroup.mk g : Matrix.ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup ι F) •
        Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.center (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F))) H
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_map, Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem,
    MulAut.smul_def, MulAut.inv_apply, MulAut.conj_symm_apply, QuotientGroup.mk'_apply]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨a, ha, ha'⟩ ↦ ⟨g⁻¹ * a * g, ha, by simp [ha']⟩,
    fun ⟨a, ha, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨g * a * g⁻¹, by simp [mul_assoc, ha], by simp [hx, mul_assoc]⟩⟩

name: LinearMap.exists_restrict_span_singleton_eq_smul_id
statement:
private lemma LinearMap.exists_restrict_span_singleton_eq_smul_id
    {R V : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V]
    {v : V} {A : V →ₗ[R] V} (hAv : A v ∈ Submodule.span R {v}) :
    ∃ c : R, A v = c • v ∧ ∃ hcomap : Submodule.span R {v} ≤ (Submodule.span R {v}).comap A,
      A.restrict hcomap = (c • LinearMap.id : Submodule.span R {v} →ₗ[R] _)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hAv
  refine ⟨c, hc.symm, fun w hw ↦ ?_, LinearMap.ext fun ⟨w, hw⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  <;> obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hw
  · simpa [Submodule.mem_comap, map_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hAv
  · simp [Subtype.ext_iff, ← hc, smul_comm a c v]

name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab_fix_of_span
statement:
lemma Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab_fix_of_span
    (v : ι → F) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup ι F)
    (hA : A ∈ lineStab (Submodule.span F {v})) :
    A • v = v
proof:
:= by
  set L : Submodule F (ι → F) := Submodule.span F {v}
  obtain ⟨c, hcv, hcomap, hres⟩ :=
    LinearMap.exists_restrict_span_singleton_eq_smul_id (A := A.toLin'.toLinearMap)
      (by simpa using! add_mem (hA v) (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self v))
  have hQ : L.mapQ L A.toLin'.toLinearMap hcomap = LinearMap.id := LinearMap.ext fun x ↦ by
    induction x using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
    | _ w => simpa [Submodule.Quotient.eq] using! hA w
  have hdet := A.toLin'.toLinearMap.det_eq_det_mul_det L hcomap
  rw [show LinearMap.det A.toLin'.toLinearMap = 1 by simp [toLin'_to_linearMap],
      hres, hQ, LinearMap.det_smul, finrank_span_singleton hv, pow_one,
      LinearMap.det_id, LinearMap.det_id, mul_one, mul_one] at hdet
  exact hcv.trans (hdet ▸ one_smul F v)

name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab_isMulCommutative_of_span'
statement:
lemma Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab_isMulCommutative_of_span'
    (v : ι → F) (hv : v ≠ 0) (A B : SpecialLinearGroup ι F)
    (hA : A ∈ SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab (Submodule.span F {v}))
    (hB : B ∈ SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab (Submodule.span F {v})) :
    A * B = B * A
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext <| ext_iff_smul.2 fun w ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp (hA w)
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp (hB w)
  simp only [coe_mul, mul_smul, ← Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.smul_def]
  rw [← sub_add_cancel (A • w) w, ← hα, ← sub_add_cancel (B • w) w,
    ← hβ, smul_add, smul_add, ← sub_left_inj (a := w), ← add_sub, ← hα, ← add_sub, ← hβ,
    smul_comm, lineStab_fix_of_span v hv A hA, smul_comm, lineStab_fix_of_span v hv B hB, add_comm]

name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab_isMulCommutative_of_span
statement:
lemma Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab_isMulCommutative_of_span
    (v : ι → F) (hv : v ≠ 0) : IsMulCommutative (lineStab (Submodule.span F {v}))
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨fun ⟨A, hA⟩ ⟨B, hB⟩ ↦ by simpa using lineStab_isMulCommutative_of_span' v hv A B hA hB⟩⟩

name: transvection_mem_lineStab
statement:
lemma transvection_mem_lineStab {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (b : F) :
    transvection hij b ∈ lineStab (Submodule.span F {(Pi.single i (1 : F) : ι → F)})
proof:
:=
  fun w ↦ Submodule.mem_span_singleton.2 ⟨b * w j, by simp [mul_smul,
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.smul_def, transvection_coe, add_smul, Matrix.single_mulVec_eq]⟩

name: transvection_mem_lineStab_sup
statement:
lemma transvection_mem_lineStab_sup (t : TransvectionStruct (Fin 2) F) :
    t.toSpecialLinearGroup ∈
      lineStab (Submodule.span F {(Pi.single 0 1 : Fin 2 → F)})
      ⊔ lineStab (Submodule.span F {(Pi.single 1 1 : Fin 2 → F)})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, c⟩ := t
  simp only [Fin.isValue, TransvectionStruct.toSpecialLinearGroup_mk]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> try tauto
  · exact Subgroup.mem_sup_left <| transvection_mem_lineStab zero_ne_one c
  · exact Subgroup.mem_sup_right <| transvection_mem_lineStab one_ne_zero c

name: SL_card_two_lineStab_sup_eq_top
statement:
lemma SL_card_two_lineStab_sup_eq_top :
    lineStab (Submodule.span F {(Pi.single 0 1: Fin 2 → F)}) ⊔
      lineStab (Submodule.span F {(Pi.single 1 1: Fin 2 → F)}) =
      (⊤ : Subgroup SL(2, F))
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm le_top fun M _ ↦ SL2.transvection_induction _
      (fun i j hij a ↦ by simpa using transvection_mem_lineStab_sup ⟨i, j, hij, a⟩)
      (fun _ _ ↦ mul_mem) M

name: PSL.iSup_lineStab_eq_top
statement:
lemma PSL.iSup_lineStab_eq_top :
    (⨆ p : ℙ F (Fin 2 → F), lineStab p.submodule) = (⊤ : Subgroup SL(2, F))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm le_top (SL2Gen.SL_card_two_lineStab_sup_eq_top (F := F) ▸
    sup_le ?_ ?_)
  <;> rw [← Projectivization.submodule_mk (K := F) _ (Pi.single_ne_zero_iff.2 one_ne_zero)]
  <;> exact le_iSup_iff.2 fun b a ↦ a _

name: PSL.iSup_iwasawaT_eq_top
statement:
lemma PSL.iSup_iwasawaT_eq_top :
    iSup (PSL.iwasawaT (F := F) (ι := Fin 2)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have step1 : iSup (PSL.iwasawaT (F := F) (ι := Fin 2)) =
      Subgroup.map (QuotientGroup.mk' (Subgroup.center (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) F)))
        (⨆ p : ℙ F (Fin 2 → F),
          Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.lineStab (F := F) (ι := Fin 2) p.submodule) := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_iSup]
  rw [step1, PSL.iSup_lineStab_eq_top]
  exact Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective _ (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective _)

name: PSL_commutator_eq_top
statement:
lemma PSL_commutator_eq_top (hF : ∃ a : F, a ≠ 0 ∧ a ^ 2 ≠ 1) :
    commutator PSL(2, F) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hasq⟩ := hF
  have : Group.IsPerfect SL(2, F) := ⟨SL2.commutator_eq_top ha hasq⟩
  have : Group.IsPerfect (Matrix.ProjectiveSpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) F) := inferInstance
  exact this.commutator_eq_top

name: field_cond_of_four_le_card
statement:
private lemma field_cond_of_four_le_card (hF : 4 ≤ Nat.card F) :
    ∃ a : F, a ≠ 0 ∧ a ^ 2 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite F := (Nat.card_pos_iff.1 (by omega)).2
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : IsCyclic Fˣ := by infer_instance
  refine ⟨x, Units.ne_zero x, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  grw [Nat.card_eq_card_units_add_one F, ← orderOf_eq_card_of_forall_mem_zpowers hx,
    orderOf_le_of_pow_eq_one zero_lt_two (Units.ext <| by simpa using h)] at hF
  omega
